verses.textZh: 在乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯和希西家作犹大王的时候，亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚看见异象，是关于犹大和耶路撒冷的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯和希西家作犹大王的时候，亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚看见异象，是关于犹大和耶路撒冷的：
verses.textZhCuv: 当乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯、希西家作犹大王的时候，亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示，论到犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: The vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the visions that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem. He saw these visions during the years when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem, which he saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.textEn: The vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

verses.textZh: 诸天哪！要听。大地啊！要留心听。 因为耶和华说： "我把孩子养育，使他们成长， 他们却背叛了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天哪！要听。大地啊！要留心听。 因为耶和华说： "我把孩子养育，使他们成长， 他们却背叛了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 天哪，要听！地啊，侧耳而听！ 因为耶和华说： 我养育儿女，将他们养大， 他们竟悖逆我。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear me, you heavens! Listen, earth! For the Lord has spoken: "I reared children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for the Lord has spoken: "Children have I reared and brought up, but they have rebelled against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth! For the Lord has spoken: "I have nourished and brought up children, And they have rebelled against Me;
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, O heavens! Pay attention, earth! This is what the Lord says: "The children I raised and cared for have rebelled against me.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, heavens, and hear, earth; For the Lord has spoken: "Sons I have raised and brought up, But they have revolted against Me.
verses.textEn: Hear me, you heavens! Listen, earth! For the Lord has spoken: "I reared children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against me.

verses.textZh: 牛认识主人， 驴认识主人的槽； 以色列却不认识我， 我的子民不明白我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛认识主人， 驴认识主人的槽； 以色列却不认识我， 我的子民不明白我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 牛认识主人， 驴认识主人的槽， 以色列却不认识； 我的民却不留意。
verses.textEnNiv: The ox knows its master, the donkey its owner’s manger, but Israel does not know, my people do not understand."
verses.textEnEsv: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s crib, but Israel does not know, my people do not understand."
verses.textEnNkjv: The ox knows its owner And the donkey its master’s crib; But Israel does not know, My people do not consider."
verses.textEnNlt: Even an ox knows its owner, and a donkey recognizes its master’s care— but Israel doesn’t know its master. My people don’t recognize my care for them."
verses.textEnNasb: "An ox knows its owner, And a donkey its master’s manger, But Israel does not know, My people do not understand."
verses.textEn: The ox knows its master, the donkey its owner’s manger, but Israel does not know, my people do not understand."

verses.textZh: 嗐！犯罪的国， 罪孽深重的子民， 行恶的子孙， 败坏的儿女！ 他们离弃了耶和华， 藐视以色列的圣者， 他们转离了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 嗐！犯罪的国， 罪孽深重的子民， 行恶的子孙， 败坏的儿女！ 他们离弃了耶和华， 藐视以色列的圣者， 他们转离了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 嗐！犯罪的国民， 担着罪孽的百姓； 行恶的种类， 败坏的儿女！ 他们离弃耶和华， 藐视以色列的圣者， 与他生疏，往后退步。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the sinful nation, a people whose guilt is great, a brood of evildoers, children given to corruption! They have forsaken the Lord ; they have spurned the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the Lord , they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they are utterly estranged.
verses.textEnNkjv: Alas, sinful nation, A people laden with iniquity, A brood of evildoers, Children who are corrupters! They have forsaken the Lord, They have provoked to anger The Holy One of Israel, They have turned away backward.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, what a sinful nation they are— loaded down with a burden of guilt. They are evil people, corrupt children who have rejected the Lord . They have despised the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on him.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, sinful nation, People weighed down with guilt, Offspring of evildoers, Sons who act corruptly! They have abandoned the Lord, They have despised the Holy One of Israel, They have turned away from Him.
verses.textEn: Woe to the sinful nation, a people whose guilt is great, a brood of evildoers, children given to corruption! They have forsaken the Lord ; they have spurned the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on him.

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么屡次悖逆， 还要受责打吗？ 你们整个头都受了伤， 整个心都发昏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么屡次悖逆， 还要受责打吗？ 你们整个头都受了伤， 整个心都发昏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为什么屡次悖逆， 还要受责打吗？ 你们已经满头疼痛， 全心发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: Why should you be beaten anymore? Why do you persist in rebellion? Your whole head is injured, your whole heart afflicted.
verses.textEnEsv: Why will you still be struck down? Why will you continue to rebel? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should you be stricken again? You will revolt more and more. The whole head is sick, And the whole heart faints.
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you continue to invite punishment? Must you rebel forever? Your head is injured, and your heart is sick.
verses.textEnNasb: Where will you be stricken again, As you continue in your rebellion? The entire head is sick And the entire heart is faint.
verses.textEn: Why should you be beaten anymore? Why do you persist in rebellion? Your whole head is injured, your whole heart afflicted.

verses.textZh: 从脚掌到头顶，没有一处是完全的； 尽是创伤、鞭痕和流血的伤口； 没有挤干净伤口，没有包扎， 也没有用膏油滋润。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从脚掌到头顶，没有一处是完全的； 尽是创伤、鞭痕和流血的伤口； 没有挤干净伤口，没有包扎， 也没有用膏油滋润。
verses.textZhCuv: 从脚掌到头顶， 没有一处完全的， 尽是伤口、青肿，与新打的伤痕， 都没有收口，没有缠裹， 也没有用膏滋润。
verses.textEnNiv: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head there is no soundness— only wounds and welts and open sores, not cleansed or bandaged or soothed with olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: From the sole of the foot even to the head, there is no soundness in it, but bruises and sores and raw wounds; they are not pressed out or bound up or softened with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the sole of the foot even to the head, Thereis no soundness in it, But wounds and bruises and putrefying sores; They have not been closed or bound up, Or soothed with ointment.
verses.textEnNlt: You are battered from head to foot— covered with bruises, welts, and infected wounds— without any soothing ointments or bandages.
verses.textEnNasb: From the sole of the foot even to the head There is nothing healthy in it, Only bruises, slashes, and raw wounds; Not pressed out nor bandaged, Nor softened with oil.
verses.textEn: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head there is no soundness— only wounds and welts and open sores, not cleansed or bandaged or soothed with olive oil.

verses.textZh: 你们的土地荒凉， 你们的城镇被火烧毁， 你们的田地，在你们面前给外族人侵吞； 被外族人倾覆之后，就荒凉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的土地荒凉， 你们的城镇被火烧毁， 你们的田地，在你们面前给外族人侵吞； 被外族人倾覆之后，就荒凉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的地土已经荒凉； 你们的城邑被火焚毁。 你们的田地在你们眼前为外邦人所侵吞， 既被外邦人倾覆就成为荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: Your country is desolate, your cities burned with fire; your fields are being stripped by foreigners right before you, laid waste as when overthrown by strangers.
verses.textEnEsv: Your country lies desolate; your cities are burned with fire; in your very presence foreigners devour your land; it is desolate, as overthrown by foreigners.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your country is desolate, Your cities are burned with fire; Strangers devour your land in your presence; And itis desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.textEnNlt: Your country lies in ruins, and your towns are burned. Foreigners plunder your fields before your eyes and destroy everything they see.
verses.textEnNasb: Your land is desolate, Your cities are burned with fire; As for your fields, strangers are devouring them in front of you; It is desolation, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.textEn: Your country is desolate, your cities burned with fire; your fields are being stripped by foreigners right before you, laid waste as when overthrown by strangers.

verses.textZh: 仅存的锡安居民 ， 好象葡萄园中的草棚， 瓜田里的茅屋， 被围困的城镇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仅存的锡安居民 ， 好象葡萄园中的草棚， 瓜田里的茅屋， 被围困的城镇。
verses.textZhCuv: 仅存锡安城 ， 好像葡萄园的草棚， 瓜田的茅屋， 被围困的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: Daughter Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a cucumber field, like a city under siege.
verses.textEnEsv: And the daughter of Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard, like a lodge in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, As a hut in a garden of cucumbers, As a besieged city.
verses.textEnNlt: Beautiful Jerusalem stands abandoned like a watchman’s shelter in a vineyard, like a lean-to in a cucumber field after the harvest, like a helpless city under siege.
verses.textEnNasb: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, Like a watchman’s hut in a cucumber field, like a city under watch.
verses.textEn: Daughter Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a cucumber field, like a city under siege.

verses.textZh: 若不是万军之耶和华 给我们留下一些生还者， 我们早已像所多玛、 蛾摩拉一样了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 若不是万军之耶和华 给我们留下一些生还者， 我们早已像所多玛、 蛾摩拉一样了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是万军之耶和华给我们稍留余种， 我们早已像所多玛、蛾摩拉的样子了。
verses.textEnNiv: Unless the Lord Almighty had left us some survivors, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.
verses.textEnEsv: If the Lord of hosts had not left us a few survivors, we should have been like Sodom, and become like Gomorrah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unless the Lord of hosts Had left to us a very small remnant, We would have become like Sodom, We would have been made like Gomorrah.
verses.textEnNlt: If the Lord of Heaven’s Armies had not spared a few of us, we would have been wiped out like Sodom, destroyed like Gomorrah.
verses.textEnNasb: If the Lord of armies Had not left us a few survivors, We would be like Sodom, We would be like Gomorrah.
verses.textEn: Unless the Lord Almighty had left us some survivors, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.

verses.textZh: 你们这些所多玛的官长啊！要听耶和华的话； 你们这些蛾摩拉的人民啊！要侧耳听我们神的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们这些所多玛的官长啊！要听耶和华的话； 你们这些蛾摩拉的人民啊！要侧耳听我们神的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这所多玛的官长啊， 要听耶和华的话！ 你们这蛾摩拉的百姓啊， 要侧耳听我们神的训诲！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear the word of the Lord , you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
verses.textEnEsv: Hear the word of the Lord , you rulers of Sodom! Give ear to the teaching of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear the word of the Lord, You rulers of Sodom; Give ear to the law of our God, You people of Gomorrah:
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the Lord , you leaders of "Sodom." Listen to the law of our God, people of "Gomorrah."
verses.textEnNasb: Hear the word of the Lord, You rulers of Sodom; Listen to the instruction of our God, You people of Gomorrah!
verses.textEn: Hear the word of the Lord , you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："你们献上众多祭物， 对我有甚么益处呢？ 公绵羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂肪，我已经够了； 公牛、羊羔和公山羊的血，我都不喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："你们献上众多祭物， 对我有甚么益处呢？ 公绵羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂肪，我已经够了； 公牛、羊羔和公山羊的血，我都不喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 你们所献的许多祭物与我何益呢？ 公绵羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂油， 我已经够了； 公牛的血，羊羔的血，公山羊的血， 我都不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: "The multitude of your sacrifices— what are they to me?" says the Lord . "I have more than enough of burnt offerings, of rams and the fat of fattened animals; I have no pleasure in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: "What to me is the multitude of your sacrifices? says the Lord ; I have had enough of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed beasts; I do not delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of goats.
verses.textEnNkjv: "To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?" Says the Lord. "I have had enough of burnt offerings of rams And the fat of fed cattle. I do not delight in the blood of bulls, Or of lambs or goats.
verses.textEnNlt: "What makes you think I want all your sacrifices?" says the Lord . "I am sick of your burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened cattle. I get no pleasure from the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: "What are your many sacrifices to Me?" Says the Lord. "I have had enough of burnt offerings of rams And the fat of fattened cattle; And I take no pleasure in the blood of bulls, lambs, or goats.
verses.textEn: "The multitude of your sacrifices— what are they to me?" says the Lord . "I have more than enough of burnt offerings, of rams and the fat of fattened animals; I have no pleasure in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

verses.textZh: 你们来朝见我的时候， 谁要求你们这样践踏我的院子呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们来朝见我的时候， 谁要求你们这样践踏我的院子呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们来朝见我， 谁向你们讨这些， 使你们践踏我的院宇呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When you come to appear before me, who has asked this of you, this trampling of my courts?
verses.textEnEsv: "When you come to appear before me, who has required of you this trampling of my courts?
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you come to appear before Me, Who has required this from your hand, To trample My courts?
verses.textEnNlt: When you come to worship me, who asked you to parade through my courts with all your ceremony?
verses.textEnNasb: "When you come to appear before Me, Who requires of you this trampling of My courtyards?
verses.textEn: When you come to appear before me, who has asked this of you, this trampling of my courts?

verses.textZh: 不要再带没有意义的供物来了， 烧献祭物的香气也是我厌恶的。 我厌烦月朔、安息日和集会； 作罪孽又守严肃会，是我不能容忍的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要再带没有意义的供物来了， 烧献祭物的香气也是我厌恶的。 我厌烦月朔、安息日和集会； 作罪孽又守严肃会，是我不能容忍的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要再献虚浮的供物。 香品是我所憎恶的； 月朔和安息日，并宣召的大会， 也是我所憎恶的； 作罪孽，又守严肃会， 我也不能容忍。
verses.textEnNiv: Stop bringing meaningless offerings! Your incense is detestable to me. New Moons, Sabbaths and convocations— I cannot bear your worthless assemblies.
verses.textEnEsv: Bring no more vain offerings; incense is an abomination to me. New moon and Sabbath and the calling of convocations— I cannot endure iniquity and solemn assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bring no more futile sacrifices; Incense is an abomination to Me. The New Moons, the Sabbaths, and the calling of assemblies— I cannot endure iniquity and the sacred meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Stop bringing me your meaningless gifts; the incense of your offerings disgusts me! As for your celebrations of the new moon and the Sabbath and your special days for fasting— they are all sinful and false. I want no more of your pious meetings.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not go on bringing your worthless offerings, Incense is an abomination to Me. New moon and Sabbath, the proclamation of an assembly— I cannot endure wrongdoing and the festive assembly.
verses.textEn: Stop bringing meaningless offerings! Your incense is detestable to me. New Moons, Sabbaths and convocations— I cannot bear your worthless assemblies.

verses.textZh: 你们的月朔和制定的节期，我心里恨恶； 它们都成了我的重担， 我已承担得不耐烦了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的月朔和制定的节期，我心里恨恶； 它们都成了我的重担， 我已承担得不耐烦了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的月朔和节期，我心里恨恶， 我都以为麻烦； 我担当，便不耐烦。
verses.textEnNiv: Your New Moon feasts and your appointed festivals I hate with all my being. They have become a burden to me; I am weary of bearing them.
verses.textEnEsv: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hates; they have become a burden to me; I am weary of bearing them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your New Moons and your appointed feasts My soul hates; They are a trouble to Me, I am weary of bearing them.
verses.textEnNlt: I hate your new moon celebrations and your annual festivals. They are a burden to me. I cannot stand them!
verses.textEnNasb: " I hate your new moon festivals and your appointed feasts, They have become a burden to Me; I am tired of bearing them.
verses.textEn: Your New Moon feasts and your appointed festivals I hate with all my being. They have become a burden to me; I am weary of bearing them.

verses.textZh: 所以你们张开双手的时候， 我必掩眼不看你们； 即使你们多多祷告， 我也不听； 你们的手都沾满血腥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们张开双手的时候， 我必掩眼不看你们； 即使你们多多祷告， 我也不听； 你们的手都沾满血腥。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们举手祷告，我必遮眼不看； 就是你们多多地祈祷，我也不听。 你们的手都满了杀人的血。
verses.textEnNiv: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I hide my eyes from you; even when you offer many prayers, I am not listening. Your hands are full of blood!
verses.textEnEsv: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you; even though you make many prayers, I will not listen; your hands are full of blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you spread out your hands, I will hide My eyes from you; Even though you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.
verses.textEnNlt: When you lift up your hands in prayer, I will not look. Though you offer many prayers, I will not listen, for your hands are covered with the blood of innocent victims.
verses.textEnNasb: "So when you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; Yes, even though you offer many prayers, I will not be listening. Your hands are covered with blood.
verses.textEn: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I hide my eyes from you; even when you offer many prayers, I am not listening. Your hands are full of blood!

verses.textZh: 你们要洗涤自己，洁净自己； 从我眼前除掉你们的恶行； 要停止作恶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要洗涤自己，洁净自己； 从我眼前除掉你们的恶行； 要停止作恶，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要洗濯、自洁， 从我眼前除掉你们的恶行， 要止住作恶，
verses.textEnNiv: Wash and make yourselves clean. Take your evil deeds out of my sight; stop doing wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your deeds from before my eyes; cease to do evil,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean; Put away the evil of your doings from before My eyes. Cease to do evil,
verses.textEnNlt: Wash yourselves and be clean! Get your sins out of my sight. Give up your evil ways.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean; Remove the evil of your deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil,
verses.textEn: Wash and make yourselves clean. Take your evil deeds out of my sight; stop doing wrong.

verses.textZh: 学习行善， 寻求公平， 指责残暴的人， 替孤儿伸冤， 为寡妇辨屈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 学习行善， 寻求公平， 指责残暴的人， 替孤儿伸冤， 为寡妇辨屈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 学习行善， 寻求公平， 解救受欺压的； 给孤儿伸冤， 为寡妇辨屈。
verses.textEnNiv: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verses.textEnEsv: learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring justice to the fatherless, plead the widow’s cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: Learn to do good; Seek justice, Rebuke the oppressor; Defend the fatherless, Plead for the widow.
verses.textEnNlt: Learn to do good. Seek justice. Help the oppressed. Defend the cause of orphans. Fight for the rights of widows.
verses.textEnNasb: Learn to do good; Seek justice, Rebuke the oppressor, Obtain justice for the orphan, Plead for the widow’s case.
verses.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："你们来，我们彼此辩论； 你们的罪虽像朱红， 必变成雪白； 虽红如丹颜， 必白如羊毛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："你们来，我们彼此辩论； 你们的罪虽像朱红， 必变成雪白； 虽红如丹颜， 必白如羊毛。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 你们来，我们彼此辩论。 你们的罪虽像朱红，必变成雪白； 虽红如丹颜，必白如羊毛。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come now, let us settle the matter," says the Lord . "Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.
verses.textEnEsv: "Come now, let us reason together, says the Lord : though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come now, and let us reason together," Says the Lord, "Though your sins are like scarlet, They shall be as white as snow; Though they are red like crimson, They shall be as wool.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come now, let’s settle this," says the Lord . "Though your sins are like scarlet, I will make them as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, I will make them as white as wool.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come now, and let us debate your case," Says the Lord, "Though your sins are as scarlet, They shall become as white as snow; Though they are red like crimson, They shall be like wool.
verses.textEn: "Come now, let us settle the matter," says the Lord . "Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.

verses.textZh: 你们若愿意听从， 就必得吃地上的美物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若愿意听从， 就必得吃地上的美物；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若甘心听从， 必吃地上的美物，
verses.textEnNiv: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land;
verses.textEnEsv: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;
verses.textEnNkjv: If you are willing and obedient, You shall eat the good of the land;
verses.textEnNlt: If you will only obey me, you will have plenty to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you are willing and obedient, You will eat the best of the land;
verses.textEn: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land;

verses.textZh: 你们若不听从，反而悖逆， 就必被刀剑吞灭。" 这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若不听从，反而悖逆， 就必被刀剑吞灭。" 这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不听从，反倒悖逆， 必被刀剑吞灭。 这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textEnNiv: but if you resist and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword." For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be eaten by the sword; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you refuse and rebel, You shall be devoured by the sword"; For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you turn away and refuse to listen, you will be devoured by the sword of your enemies. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: But if you refuse and rebel, You will be devoured by the sword." For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: but if you resist and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword." For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 那忠贞的城，怎么会变成妓女！ 她从前充满公平， 有公义居在其中， 现在却有凶手居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那忠贞的城，怎么会变成妓女！ 她从前充满公平， 有公义居在其中， 现在却有凶手居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 可叹，忠信的城变为妓女！ 从前充满了公平， 公义居在其中， 现今却有凶手居住。
verses.textEnNiv: See how the faithful city has become a prostitute! She once was full of justice; righteousness used to dwell in her— but now murderers!
verses.textEnEsv: How the faithful city has become a whore, she who was full of justice! Righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
verses.textEnNkjv: How the faithful city has become a harlot! It was full of justice; Righteousness lodged in it, But now murderers.
verses.textEnNlt: See how Jerusalem, once so faithful, has become a prostitute. Once the home of justice and righteousness, she is now filled with murderers.
verses.textEnNasb: How the faithful city has become a prostitute, She who was full of justice! Righteousness once dwelt in her, But now murderers.
verses.textEn: See how the faithful city has become a prostitute! She once was full of justice; righteousness used to dwell in her— but now murderers!

verses.textZh: 你的银子变成了渣滓， 你的酒用水搀混。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的银子变成了渣滓， 你的酒用水搀混。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的银子变为渣滓； 你的酒用水搀对。
verses.textEnNiv: Your silver has become dross, your choice wine is diluted with water.
verses.textEnEsv: Your silver has become dross, your best wine mixed with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your silver has become dross, Your wine mixed with water.
verses.textEnNlt: Once like pure silver, you have become like worthless slag. Once so pure, you are now like watered-down wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Your silver has become waste matter, Your drink diluted with water.
verses.textEn: Your silver has become dross, your choice wine is diluted with water.

verses.textZh: 你的官长存心悖逆， 与盗贼同伙； 人都贪爱贿赂， 追索私酬； 他们不替孤儿伸冤， 寡妇的案件也呈不到他们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的官长存心悖逆， 与盗贼同伙； 人都贪爱贿赂， 追索私酬； 他们不替孤儿伸冤， 寡妇的案件也呈不到他们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的官长居心悖逆， 与盗贼作伴， 各都喜爱贿赂， 追求赃私。 他们不为孤儿伸冤； 寡妇的案件也不得呈到他们面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Your rulers are rebels, partners with thieves; they all love bribes and chase after gifts. They do not defend the cause of the fatherless; the widow’s case does not come before them.
verses.textEnEsv: Your princes are rebels and companions of thieves. Everyone loves a bribe and runs after gifts. They do not bring justice to the fatherless, and the widow’s cause does not come to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your princes are rebellious, And companions of thieves; Everyone loves bribes, And follows after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, Nor does the cause of the widow come before them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your leaders are rebels, the companions of thieves. All of them love bribes and demand payoffs, but they refuse to defend the cause of orphans or fight for the rights of widows.
verses.textEnNasb: Your rulers are rebels And companions of thieves; Everyone loves a bribe And chases after gifts. They do not obtain justice for the orphan, Nor does the widow’s case come before them.
verses.textEn: Your rulers are rebels, partners with thieves; they all love bribes and chase after gifts. They do not defend the cause of the fatherless; the widow’s case does not come before them.

verses.textZh: 因此，主万军之耶和华， 以色列的大能者说： "哎！我要向我的对头雪恨， 向我的仇敌报复。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主万军之耶和华， 以色列的大能者说： "哎！我要向我的对头雪恨， 向我的仇敌报复。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，主－万军之耶和华、 以色列的大能者说： 哎！我要向我的对头雪恨， 向我的敌人报仇。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord, the Lord Almighty, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: "Ah! I will vent my wrath on my foes and avenge myself on my enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord declares, the Lord of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel: "Ah, I will get relief from my enemies and avenge myself on my foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord says, The Lord of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, "Ah, I will rid Myself of My adversaries, And take vengeance on My enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says, "I will take revenge on my enemies and pay back my foes!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord God of armies, The Mighty One of Israel, declares, "Ah, I will have satisfaction against My adversaries, And avenge Myself on My enemies.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord, the Lord Almighty, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: "Ah! I will vent my wrath on my foes and avenge myself on my enemies.

verses.textZh: 我必把手转过来攻击你； 我要炼除你的渣滓，如同用碱来炼一样， 我要除去你的一切杂质。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把手转过来攻击你； 我要炼除你的渣滓，如同用碱来炼一样， 我要除去你的一切杂质。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必反手加在你身上， 炼尽你的渣滓， 除净你的杂质。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn my hand against you; I will thoroughly purge away your dross and remove all your impurities.
verses.textEnEsv: I will turn my hand against you and will smelt away your dross as with lye and remove all your alloy.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will turn My hand against you, And thoroughly purge away your dross, And take away all your alloy.
verses.textEnNlt: I will raise my fist against you. I will melt you down and skim off your slag. I will remove all your impurities.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also turn My hand against you, And smelt away your impurities as with lye; And I will remove all your slag.
verses.textEn: I will turn my hand against you; I will thoroughly purge away your dross and remove all your impurities.

verses.textZh: 我必恢复你的审判官，像起初一样； 也必恢复你的谋士，像起先一般； 以后，你必称为公义的城、 忠贞的城。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必恢复你的审判官，像起初一样； 也必恢复你的谋士，像起先一般； 以后，你必称为公义的城、 忠贞的城。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必复还你的审判官，像起初一样， 复还你的谋士，像起先一般。 然后，你必称为公义之城， 忠信之邑。
verses.textEnNiv: I will restore your leaders as in days of old, your rulers as at the beginning. Afterward you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called the city of righteousness, the faithful city."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will restore your judges as at the first, And your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called the city of righteousness, the faithful city."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will give you good judges again and wise counselors like you used to have. Then Jerusalem will again be called the Home of Justice and the Faithful City."
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will restore your judges as at first, And your counselors as at the beginning; After that you will be called the city of righteousness, A faithful city."
verses.textEn: I will restore your leaders as in days of old, your rulers as at the beginning. Afterward you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City."

verses.textZh: 锡安必因公平蒙救赎， 城中悔改的人也必因公义蒙救赎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安必因公平蒙救赎， 城中悔改的人也必因公义蒙救赎。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安必因公平得蒙救赎； 其中归正的人必因公义得蒙救赎。
verses.textEnNiv: Zion will be delivered with justice, her penitent ones with righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Zion shall be redeemed by justice, and those in her who repent, by righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, And her penitents with righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Zion will be restored by justice; those who repent will be revived by righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: Zion will be redeemed with justice And her repentant ones with righteousness.
verses.textEn: Zion will be delivered with justice, her penitent ones with righteousness.

verses.textZh: 但悖逆的和犯罪的，必一同灭亡， 离弃耶和华的，也必灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但悖逆的和犯罪的，必一同灭亡， 离弃耶和华的，也必灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 但悖逆的和犯罪的必一同败亡； 离弃耶和华的必致消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: But rebels and sinners will both be broken, and those who forsake the Lord will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: But rebels and sinners shall be broken together, and those who forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The destruction of transgressors and of sinners shallbe together, And those who forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
verses.textEnNlt: But rebels and sinners will be completely destroyed, and those who desert the Lord will be consumed.
verses.textEnNasb: But wrongdoers and sinners together will be broken, And those who abandon the Lord will come to an end.
verses.textEn: But rebels and sinners will both be broken, and those who forsake the Lord will perish.

verses.textZh: 你们必因你们所喜爱的橡树抱愧， 必因你们所选择的园子蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必因你们所喜爱的橡树抱愧， 必因你们所选择的园子蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 那等人必因你们所喜爱的橡树抱愧； 你们必因所选择的园子蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: "You will be ashamed because of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be disgraced because of the gardens that you have chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks that you desired; and you shall blush for the gardens that you have chosen.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they shall be ashamed of the terebinth trees Which you have desired; And you shall be embarrassed because of the gardens Which you have chosen.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be ashamed of your idol worship in groves of sacred oaks. You will blush because you worshiped in gardens dedicated to idols.
verses.textEnNasb: You certainly will be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, And you will be embarrassed by the gardens which you have chosen.
verses.textEn: "You will be ashamed because of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be disgraced because of the gardens that you have chosen.

verses.textZh: 因为你们必像一棵叶子凋落的橡树， 又如一个缺水的园子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们必像一棵叶子凋落的橡树， 又如一个缺水的园子。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你们必如叶子枯干的橡树， 好像无水浇灌的园子。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be like an oak with fading leaves, like a garden without water.
verses.textEnEsv: For you shall be like an oak whose leaf withers, and like a garden without water.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you shall be as a terebinth whose leaf fades, And as a garden that has no water.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be like a great tree with withered leaves, like a garden without water.
verses.textEnNasb: For you will be like an oak whose leaf withers away, Or like a garden that has no water.
verses.textEn: You will be like an oak with fading leaves, like a garden without water.

verses.textZh: 有权势的必如麻絮， 他所作的好象火星； 都要一同焚毁， 没有人能扑灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有权势的必如麻絮， 他所作的好象火星； 都要一同焚毁， 没有人能扑灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 有权势的必如麻瓤； 他的工作好像火星， 都要一同焚毁，无人扑灭。
verses.textEnNiv: The mighty man will become tinder and his work a spark; both will burn together, with no one to quench the fire."
verses.textEnEsv: And the strong shall become tinder, and his work a spark, and both of them shall burn together, with none to quench them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The strong shall be as tinder, And the work of it as a spark; Both will burn together, And no one shall quench them.
verses.textEnNlt: The strongest among you will disappear like straw; their evil deeds will be the spark that sets it on fire. They and their evil works will burn up together, and no one will be able to put out the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: The strong man will become like flax fiber, And his work a spark. So they shall both burn together And there will be no one to extinguish them.
verses.textEn: The mighty man will become tinder and his work a spark; both will burn together, with no one to quench the fire."

verses.textZh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得到默示，有关犹大和耶路撒冷：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得到默示，有关犹大和耶路撒冷：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示，论到犹大和耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:
verses.textEnEsv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a vision that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNasb: The word which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:

verses.textZh: 在末后的日子， 耶和华殿的山， 必被坚立，超乎众山， 必被高举，过于万岭； 万国都要流归这山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在末后的日子， 耶和华殿的山， 必被坚立，超乎众山， 必被高举，过于万岭； 万国都要流归这山。
verses.textZhCuv: 末后的日子，耶和华殿的山必坚立， 超乎诸山，高举过于万岭； 万民都要流归这山。
verses.textEnNiv: In the last days the mountain of the Lord ’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall come to pass in the latter days that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established as the highest of the mountains, and shall be lifted up above the hills; and all the nations shall flow to it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the Lord’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And all nations shall flow to it.
verses.textEnNlt: In the last days, the mountain of the Lord ’s house will be the highest of all— the most important place on earth. It will be raised above the other hills, and people from all over the world will stream there to worship.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it will come about that In the last days The mountain of the house of the Lord Will be established as the chief of the mountains, And will be raised above the hills; And all the nations will stream to it.
verses.textEn: In the last days the mountain of the Lord ’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.

verses.textZh: 必有多国的人前来，说： "来吧！我们上耶和华的山， 登雅各神的殿； 他必把他的道指教我们， 我们也必遵行他的路。" 因为训诲必出于锡安， 耶和华的话必来自耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有多国的人前来，说： "来吧！我们上耶和华的山， 登雅各神的殿； 他必把他的道指教我们， 我们也必遵行他的路。" 因为训诲必出于锡安， 耶和华的话必来自耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有许多国的民前往，说： 来吧，我们登耶和华的山， 奔雅各神的殿。 主必将他的道教训我们； 我们也要行他的路。 因为训诲必出于锡安； 耶和华的言语必出于耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Many peoples will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths." The law will go out from Zion, the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: and many peoples shall come, and say: "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the house of the God of Jacob, that he may teach us his ways and that we may walk in his paths." For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many people shall come and say, "Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths." For out of Zion shall go forth the law, And the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: People from many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the house of Jacob’s God. There he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths." For the Lord ’s teaching will go out from Zion; his word will go out from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And many peoples will come and say, "Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the Lord, To the house of the God of Jacob; So that He may teach us about His ways, And that we may walk in His paths." For the law will go out from Zion And the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Many peoples will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths." The law will go out from Zion, the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他要在列国施行审判， 为多国的人断定是非。 他们必把刀打成犁头，把矛枪打成镰刀。 这国不举刀攻击那国， 他们也不再学习战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在列国施行审判， 为多国的人断定是非。 他们必把刀打成犁头，把矛枪打成镰刀。 这国不举刀攻击那国， 他们也不再学习战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必在列国中施行审判， 为许多国民断定是非。 他们要将刀打成犁头， 把枪打成镰刀。 这国不举刀攻击那国； 他们也不再学习战事。
verses.textEnNiv: He will judge between the nations and will settle disputes for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall judge between the nations, and shall decide disputes for many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall judge between the nations, And rebuke many people; They shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will mediate between nations and will settle international disputes. They will hammer their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer fight against nation, nor train for war anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will judge between the nations, And will mediate for many peoples; And they will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning knives. Nation will not lift up a sword against nation, And never again will they learn war.
verses.textEn: He will judge between the nations and will settle disputes for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

verses.textZh: 雅各家啊，来吧！我们要在耶和华的光中行走！
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家啊，来吧！我们要在耶和华的光中行走！
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家啊，来吧！ 我们在耶和华的光明中行走。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, descendants of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: O house of Jacob, come and let us walk In the light of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, descendants of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Come, house of Jacob, and let’s walk in the light of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Come, descendants of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你离弃了你的子民雅各家， 是因为他们充满了东方的迷信， 和占卜的人，像非利士人一样， 并且与外族人击掌交易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你离弃了你的子民雅各家， 是因为他们充满了东方的迷信， 和占卜的人，像非利士人一样， 并且与外族人击掌交易。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华，你离弃了你百姓雅各家， 是因他们充满了东方的风俗， 作观兆的，像非利士人一样， 并与外邦人击掌。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , have abandoned your people, the descendants of Jacob. They are full of superstitions from the East; they practice divination like the Philistines and embrace pagan customs.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have rejected your people, the house of Jacob, because they are full of things from the east and of fortune-tellers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have forsaken Your people, the house of Jacob, Because they are filled with eastern ways; They are soothsayers like the Philistines, And they are pleased with the children of foreigners.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has rejected his people, the descendants of Jacob, because they have filled their land with practices from the East and with sorcerers, as the Philistines do. They have made alliances with pagans.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, Because they are filled with influences from the east, And they are soothsayers like the Philistines. They also strike bargains with the children of foreigners.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , have abandoned your people, the descendants of Jacob. They are full of superstitions from the East; they practice divination like the Philistines and embrace pagan customs.

verses.textZh: 他们的地满了金银， 他们的财宝没有穷尽， 他们的地满了马匹， 他们的车辆也无数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的地满了金银， 他们的财宝没有穷尽， 他们的地满了马匹， 他们的车辆也无数。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的国满了金银， 财宝也无穷； 他们的地满了马匹， 车辆也无数。
verses.textEnNiv: Their land is full of silver and gold; there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses; there is no end to their chariots.
verses.textEnEsv: Their land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no end to their treasures; their land is filled with horses, and there is no end to their chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their land is also full of silver and gold, And there is no end to their treasures; Their land is also full of horses, And there is no end to their chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel is full of silver and gold; there is no end to its treasures. Their land is full of warhorses; there is no end to its chariots.
verses.textEnNasb: Their land has also been filled with silver and gold And there is no end to their treasures; Their land has also been filled with horses, And there is no end to their chariots.
verses.textEn: Their land is full of silver and gold; there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses; there is no end to their chariots.

verses.textZh: 他们的地满了偶像； 他们敬拜自己双手所做的， 就是他们的指头所做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的地满了偶像； 他们敬拜自己双手所做的， 就是他们的指头所做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的地满了偶像； 他们跪拜自己手所造的， 就是自己指头所做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.
verses.textEnEsv: Their land is filled with idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their own fingers have made.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their land is also full of idols; They worship the work of their own hands, That which their own fingers have made.
verses.textEnNlt: Their land is full of idols; the people worship things they have made with their own hands.
verses.textEnNasb: Their land has also been filled with idols; They worship the work of their hands, That which their fingers have made.
verses.textEn: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.

verses.textZh: 卑贱人向偶像俯首， 尊贵人也降卑， 所以不可饶恕他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 卑贱人向偶像俯首， 尊贵人也降卑， 所以不可饶恕他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 卑贱人屈膝； 尊贵人下跪； 所以不可饶恕他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So people will be brought low and everyone humbled— do not forgive them.
verses.textEnEsv: So man is humbled, and each one is brought low— do not forgive them!
verses.textEnNkjv: People bow down, And each man humbles himself; Therefore do not forgive them.
verses.textEnNlt: So now they will be humbled, and all will be brought low— do not forgive them.
verses.textEnNasb: So the common person has been humbled And the person of importance has been brought low, But do not forgive them.
verses.textEn: So people will be brought low and everyone humbled— do not forgive them.

verses.textZh: 要进入岩洞，藏在泥土中； 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要进入岩洞，藏在泥土中； 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当进入岩穴，藏在土中， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: Go into the rocks, hide in the ground from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty!
verses.textEnEsv: Enter into the rock and hide in the dust from before the terror of the Lord , and from the splendor of his majesty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, From the terror of the Lord And the glory of His majesty.
verses.textEnNlt: Crawl into caves in the rocks. Hide in the dust from the terror of the Lord and the glory of his majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: Enter the rocky place and hide in the dust From the terror of the Lord and from the splendor of His majesty.
verses.textEn: Go into the rocks, hide in the ground from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty!

verses.textZh: 到那日，眼目高傲的人必降卑， 性情骄傲的人也必俯首， 唯独耶和华被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，眼目高傲的人必降卑， 性情骄傲的人也必俯首， 唯独耶和华被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，眼目高傲的必降为卑； 性情狂傲的都必屈膝； 惟独耶和华被尊崇。
verses.textEnNiv: The eyes of the arrogant will be humbled and human pride brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.textEnEsv: The haughty looks of man shall be brought low, and the lofty pride of men shall be humbled, and the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, The haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, And the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.textEnNlt: Human pride will be brought down, and human arrogance will be humbled. Only the Lord will be exalted on that day of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: The proud look of humanity will be brought low, And the arrogance of people will be humbled; And the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.
verses.textEn: The eyes of the arrogant will be humbled and human pride brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华必有一日， 要攻击一切骄傲的、狂妄的， 和所有高抬自己的， 他们都要降卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华必有一日， 要攻击一切骄傲的、狂妄的， 和所有高抬自己的， 他们都要降卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有万军耶和华降罚的一个日子， 要临到骄傲狂妄的； 一切自高的都必降为卑；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty has a day in store for all the proud and lofty, for all that is exalted (and they will be humbled),
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord of hosts has a day against all that is proud and lofty, against all that is lifted up—and it shall be brought low;
verses.textEnNkjv: For the day of the Lord of hosts Shallcome upon everything proud and lofty, Upon everything lifted up— And it shall be brought low—
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has a day of reckoning. He will punish the proud and mighty and bring down everything that is exalted.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord of armies will have a day of reckoning Against everyone who is arrogant and haughty, And against everyone who is lifted up, That he may be brought low.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty has a day in store for all the proud and lofty, for all that is exalted (and they will be humbled),

verses.textZh: 又要攻击黎巴嫩所有高大的香柏树， 和巴珊所有的橡树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要攻击黎巴嫩所有高大的香柏树， 和巴珊所有的橡树。
verses.textZhCuv: 又临到黎巴嫩高大的香柏树和巴珊的橡树；
verses.textEnNiv: for all the cedars of Lebanon, tall and lofty, and all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.textEnEsv: against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up; and against all the oaks of Bashan;
verses.textEnNkjv: Upon all the cedars of Lebanon thatare high and lifted up, And upon all the oaks of Bashan;
verses.textEnNlt: He will cut down the tall cedars of Lebanon and all the mighty oaks of Bashan.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be against all the cedars of Lebanon that are lofty and lifted up, Against all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.textEn: for all the cedars of Lebanon, tall and lofty, and all the oaks of Bashan,

verses.textZh: 又攻击所有的高山， 和所有的峻岭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又攻击所有的高山， 和所有的峻岭；
verses.textZhCuv: 又临到一切高山的峻岭；
verses.textEnNiv: for all the towering mountains and all the high hills,
verses.textEnEsv: against all the lofty mountains, and against all the uplifted hills;
verses.textEnNkjv: Upon all the high mountains, And upon all the hills thatare lifted up;
verses.textEnNlt: He will level all the high mountains and all the lofty hills.
verses.textEnNasb: Against all the lofty mountains, Against all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.textEn: for all the towering mountains and all the high hills,

verses.textZh: 攻击每一个高台， 和每一道坚固的城墙；
verses.textZhCnvs: 攻击每一个高台， 和每一道坚固的城墙；
verses.textZhCuv: 又临到高台和坚固城墙；
verses.textEnNiv: for every lofty tower and every fortified wall,
verses.textEnEsv: against every high tower, and against every fortified wall;
verses.textEnNkjv: Upon every high tower, And upon every fortified wall;
verses.textEnNlt: He will break down every high tower and every fortified wall.
verses.textEnNasb: Against every high tower, Against every fortified wall,
verses.textEn: for every lofty tower and every fortified wall,

verses.textZh: 攻击所有他施的船只， 和所有美丽的船。
verses.textZhCnvs: 攻击所有他施的船只， 和所有美丽的船。
verses.textZhCuv: 又临到他施的船只并一切可爱的美物。
verses.textEnNiv: for every trading ship and every stately vessel.
verses.textEnEsv: against all the ships of Tarshish, and against all the beautiful craft.
verses.textEnNkjv: Upon all the ships of Tarshish, And upon all the beautiful sloops.
verses.textEnNlt: He will destroy all the great trading ships and every magnificent vessel.
verses.textEnNasb: Against all the ships of Tarshish And against all the delightful ships.
verses.textEn: for every trading ship and every stately vessel.

verses.textZh: 人的高傲必变为谦虚， 人的狂妄都必降为卑微， 在那日，唯独耶和华被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的高傲必变为谦虚， 人的狂妄都必降为卑微， 在那日，唯独耶和华被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 骄傲的必屈膝； 狂妄的必降卑。 在那日，惟独耶和华被尊崇；
verses.textEnNiv: The arrogance of man will be brought low and human pride humbled; the Lord alone will be exalted in that day,
verses.textEnEsv: And the haughtiness of man shall be humbled, and the lofty pride of men shall be brought low, and the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, And the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; The Lord alone will be exalted in that day,
verses.textEnNlt: Human pride will be humbled, and human arrogance will be brought down. Only the Lord will be exalted on that day of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: And the pride of humanity will be humbled And the arrogance of people will be brought low; And the Lord alone will be exalted on that day,
verses.textEn: The arrogance of man will be brought low and human pride humbled; the Lord alone will be exalted in that day,

verses.textZh: 偶像却必全然消逝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偶像却必全然消逝。
verses.textZhCuv: 偶像必全然废弃。
verses.textEnNiv: and the idols will totally disappear.
verses.textEnEsv: And the idols shall utterly pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the idols He shall utterly abolish.
verses.textEnNlt: Idols will completely disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: And the idols will completely vanish.
verses.textEn: and the idols will totally disappear.

verses.textZh: 耶和华起来，使大地震动的时候， 人必进入石洞， 进入土穴， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华起来，使大地震动的时候， 人必进入石洞， 进入土穴， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华兴起，使地大震动的时候， 人就进入石洞，进入土穴， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: People will flee to caves in the rocks and to holes in the ground from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And people shall enter the caves of the rocks and the holes of the ground, from before the terror of the Lord , and from the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall go into the holes of the rocks, And into the caves of the earth, From the terror of the Lord And the glory of His majesty, When He arises to shake the earth mightily.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord rises to shake the earth, his enemies will crawl into holes in the ground. They will hide in caves in the rocks from the terror of the Lord and the glory of his majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: People will go into caves of the rocks And into holes in the ground Away from the terror of the Lord And the splendor of His majesty, When He arises to terrify the earth.
verses.textEn: People will flee to caves in the rocks and to holes in the ground from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.

verses.textZh: 到那日，人必把那些自己所做、 供自己敬拜的金偶像和银偶像， 拋给田鼠和蝙蝠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，人必把那些自己所做、 供自己敬拜的金偶像和银偶像， 拋给田鼠和蝙蝠。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，人必将为拜而造的金偶像、银偶像 抛给田鼠和蝙蝠。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day people will throw away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and idols of gold, which they made to worship.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day mankind will cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which they made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day a man will cast away his idols of silver And his idols of gold, Which they made, each for himself to worship, To the moles and bats,
verses.textEnNlt: On that day of judgment they will abandon the gold and silver idols they made for themselves to worship. They will leave their gods to the rodents and bats,
verses.textEnNasb: On that day people will throw away to the moles and the bats Their idols of silver and their idols of gold, Which they made for themselves to worship,
verses.textEn: In that day people will throw away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and idols of gold, which they made to worship.

verses.textZh: 这样，当耶和华起来，大地震动的时候， 他们就能进入盘石缝中和岩石隙里， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，当耶和华起来，大地震动的时候， 他们就能进入盘石缝中和岩石隙里， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 到耶和华兴起，使地大震动的时候， 人好进入磐石洞中和岩石穴里， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and to the overhanging crags from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: to enter the caverns of the rocks and the clefts of the cliffs, from before the terror of the Lord , and from the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: To go into the clefts of the rocks, And into the crags of the rugged rocks, From the terror of the Lord And the glory of His majesty, When He arises to shake the earth mightily.
verses.textEnNlt: while they crawl away into caverns and hide among the jagged rocks in the cliffs. They will try to escape the terror of the Lord and the glory of his majesty as he rises to shake the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: In order to go into the clefts of the rocks and the crannies of the cliffs Before the terror of the Lord and the splendor of His majesty, When He arises to terrify the earth.
verses.textEn: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and to the overhanging crags from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.

verses.textZh: 你们不要倚靠世人， 他的鼻孔里只有一口气息， 他实在算得甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要倚靠世人， 他的鼻孔里只有一口气息， 他实在算得甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们休要倚靠世人。 他鼻孔里不过有气息； 他在一切事上可算什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Stop trusting in mere humans, who have but a breath in their nostrils. Why hold them in esteem?
verses.textEnEsv: Stop regarding man in whose nostrils is breath, for of what account is he?
verses.textEnNkjv: Sever yourselves from such a man, Whose breath is in his nostrils; For of what account is he?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t put your trust in mere humans. They are as frail as breath. What good are they?
verses.textEnNasb: Take no account of man, whose breath of life is in his nostrils; For why should he be esteemed?
verses.textEn: Stop trusting in mere humans, who have but a breath in their nostrils. Why hold them in esteem?

verses.textZh: 看哪！主万军之耶和华，快要从耶路撒冷和犹大， 除掉人所倚靠的和所倚赖的，就是众人所倚靠的粮， 众人所倚赖的水；
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！主万军之耶和华，快要从耶路撒冷和犹大， 除掉人所倚靠的和所倚赖的，就是众人所倚靠的粮， 众人所倚赖的水；
verses.textZhCuv: 主－万军之耶和华从耶路撒冷和犹大， 除掉众人所倚靠的，所仗赖的， 就是所倚靠的粮，所仗赖的水；
verses.textEnNiv: See now, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, is about to take from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: all supplies of food and all supplies of water,
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, the Lord God of hosts is taking away from Jerusalem and from Judah support and supply, all support of bread, and all support of water;
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, Takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah The stock and the store, The whole supply of bread and the whole supply of water;
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, will take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything they depend on: every bit of bread and every drop of water,
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, the Lord God of armies is going to remove from Jerusalem and Judah Both supply and support, the entire supply of bread And the entire supply of water;
verses.textEn: See now, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, is about to take from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: all supplies of food and all supplies of water,

verses.textZh: 除掉勇士和战士、 审判官和先知、 占卜的和长老、
verses.textZhCnvs: 除掉勇士和战士、 审判官和先知、 占卜的和长老、
verses.textZhCuv: 除掉勇士和战士， 审判官和先知， 占卜的和长老，
verses.textEnNiv: the hero and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the diviner and the elder,
verses.textEnEsv: the mighty man and the soldier, the judge and the prophet, the diviner and the elder,
verses.textEnNkjv: The mighty man and the man of war, The judge and the prophet, And the diviner and the elder;
verses.textEnNlt: all their heroes and soldiers, judges and prophets, fortune-tellers and elders,
verses.textEnNasb: The mighty man and the warrior, The judge and the prophet, The diviner and the elder,
verses.textEn: the hero and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the diviner and the elder,

verses.textZh: 五十夫长和尊贵的人、 谋士和有技艺的工人， 以及精通法术的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 五十夫长和尊贵的人、 谋士和有技艺的工人， 以及精通法术的。
verses.textZhCuv: 五十夫长和尊贵人， 谋士和有巧艺的， 以及妙行法术的。
verses.textEnNiv: the captain of fifty and the man of rank, the counselor, skilled craftsman and clever enchanter.
verses.textEnEsv: the captain of fifty and the man of rank, the counselor and the skillful magician and the expert in charms.
verses.textEnNkjv: The captain of fifty and the honorable man, The counselor and the skillful artisan, And the expert enchanter.
verses.textEnNlt: army officers and high officials, advisers, skilled sorcerers, and astrologers.
verses.textEnNasb: The captain of fifty and the esteemed person, The counselor and the expert artisan, And the skillful enchanter.
verses.textEn: the captain of fifty and the man of rank, the counselor, skilled craftsman and clever enchanter.

verses.textZh: 我必使孩童作他们的领袖， 使婴孩管辖他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使孩童作他们的领袖， 使婴孩管辖他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：我必使孩童作他们的首领， 使婴孩辖管他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will make mere youths their officials; children will rule over them."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make boys their princes, and infants shall rule over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will give children tobe their princes, And babes shall rule over them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make boys their leaders, and toddlers their rulers.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make mere boys their leaders, And mischievous children will rule over them,
verses.textEn: "I will make mere youths their officials; children will rule over them."

verses.textZh: 人民必互相压迫， 人欺压人，也欺压自己的邻舍； 年轻人要欺凌老年人， 卑贱人必欺凌尊贵人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民必互相压迫， 人欺压人，也欺压自己的邻舍； 年轻人要欺凌老年人， 卑贱人必欺凌尊贵人。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓要彼此欺压； 各人受邻舍的欺压。 少年人必侮慢老年人； 卑贱人必侮慢尊贵人。
verses.textEnNiv: People will oppress each other— man against man, neighbor against neighbor. The young will rise up against the old, the nobody against the honored.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people will oppress one another, every one his fellow and every one his neighbor; the youth will be insolent to the elder, and the despised to the honorable.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people will be oppressed, Every one by another and every one by his neighbor; The child will be insolent toward the elder, And the base toward the honorable."
verses.textEnNlt: People will oppress each other— man against man, neighbor against neighbor. Young people will insult their elders, and vulgar people will sneer at the honorable.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people will be oppressed, Each one by another, and each one by his neighbor; The youth will assault the elder, And the contemptible person will assault the one honored.
verses.textEn: People will oppress each other— man against man, neighbor against neighbor. The young will rise up against the old, the nobody against the honored.

verses.textZh: 人若在父家里，拉住自己一个兄弟，说： "你有一件外衣，你就作我们的官长吧！ 这败落的事就归你的手处理。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若在父家里，拉住自己一个兄弟，说： "你有一件外衣，你就作我们的官长吧！ 这败落的事就归你的手处理。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人在父家拉住弟兄，说： 你有衣服，可以作我们的官长。 这败落的事归在你手下吧！
verses.textEnNiv: A man will seize one of his brothers in his father’s house, and say, "You have a cloak, you be our leader; take charge of this heap of ruins!"
verses.textEnEsv: For a man will take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying: "You have a cloak; you shall be our leader, and this heap of ruins shall be under your rule";
verses.textEnNkjv: When a man takes hold of his brother In the house of his father, saying, "You have clothing; You be our ruler, And let these ruins be under your power,"
verses.textEnNlt: In those days a man will say to his brother, "Since you have a coat, you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of ruins!"
verses.textEnNasb: When a man lays hold of his brother in his father’s house, saying, "You have a cloak, you shall be our ruler! And these ruins will be under your authority,"
verses.textEn: A man will seize one of his brothers in his father’s house, and say, "You have a cloak, you be our leader; take charge of this heap of ruins!"

verses.textZh: 那时，那人必高声说： "我不作医治你们的人 ， 因为我家里没有粮食，也没有外衣， 你们不要立我作人民的官长。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，那人必高声说： "我不作医治你们的人 ， 因为我家里没有粮食，也没有外衣， 你们不要立我作人民的官长。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他必扬声说： 我不作医治你们的人； 因我家中没有粮食，也没有衣服， 你们不可立我作百姓的官长。
verses.textEnNiv: But in that day he will cry out, "I have no remedy. I have no food or clothing in my house; do not make me the leader of the people."
verses.textEnEsv: in that day he will speak out, saying: "I will not be a healer; in my house there is neither bread nor cloak; you shall not make me leader of the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day he will protest, saying, "I cannot cure your ills, For in my house is neither food nor clothing; Do not make me a ruler of the people."
verses.textEnNlt: But he will reply, "No! I can’t help. I don’t have any extra food or clothes. Don’t put me in charge!"
verses.textEnNasb: He will protest on that day, saying, "I will not be your healer, For in my house there is neither bread nor cloak; You should not appoint me ruler of the people."
verses.textEn: But in that day he will cry out, "I have no remedy. I have no food or clothing in my house; do not make me the leader of the people."

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷败落，犹大倾倒， 是因为他们的舌头和行为都敌对耶和华， 惹怒了他那充满荣光的眼目。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷败落，犹大倾倒， 是因为他们的舌头和行为都敌对耶和华， 惹怒了他那充满荣光的眼目。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷败落， 犹大倾倒； 因为他们的舌头和行为与耶和华反对， 惹了他荣光的眼目。
verses.textEnNiv: Jerusalem staggers, Judah is falling; their words and deeds are against the Lord , defying his glorious presence.
verses.textEnEsv: For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because their speech and their deeds are against the Lord , defying his glorious presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Jerusalem stumbled, And Judah is fallen, Because their tongue and their doings Are against the Lord, To provoke the eyes of His glory.
verses.textEnNlt: For Jerusalem will stumble, and Judah will fall, because they speak out against the Lord and refuse to obey him. They provoke him to his face.
verses.textEnNasb: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen, Because their speech and their actions are against the Lord, To rebel against His glorious presence.
verses.textEn: Jerusalem staggers, Judah is falling; their words and deeds are against the Lord , defying his glorious presence.

verses.textZh: 他们面上的表情指证他们的不对； 他们像所多玛一般宣扬自己的罪恶， 并不隐瞒； 他们有祸了， 因为他们自招祸害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们面上的表情指证他们的不对； 他们像所多玛一般宣扬自己的罪恶， 并不隐瞒； 他们有祸了， 因为他们自招祸害。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的面色证明自己的不正； 他们述说自己的罪恶，并不隐瞒， 好像所多玛一样。 他们有祸了！因为作恶自害。
verses.textEnNiv: The look on their faces testifies against them; they parade their sin like Sodom; they do not hide it. Woe to them! They have brought disaster upon themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: For the look on their faces bears witness against them; they proclaim their sin like Sodom; they do not hide it. Woe to them! For they have brought evil on themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: The look on their countenance witnesses against them, And they declare their sin as Sodom; They do not hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought evil upon themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: The very look on their faces gives them away. They display their sin like the people of Sodom and don’t even try to hide it. They are doomed! They have brought destruction upon themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: The expression of their faces testifies against them, And they display their sin like Sodom; They do not even conceal it. Woe to them! For they have done evil to themselves.
verses.textEn: The look on their faces testifies against them; they parade their sin like Sodom; they do not hide it. Woe to them! They have brought disaster upon themselves.

verses.textZh: 你们要告诉义人，他们必得福乐， 因为他们必享自己行为所结的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要告诉义人，他们必得福乐， 因为他们必享自己行为所结的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要论义人说：他必享福乐， 因为要吃自己行为所结的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell the righteous that it shall be well with them, for they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Say to the righteous that itshallbe well withthem, For they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell the godly that all will be well for them. They will enjoy the rich reward they have earned!
verses.textEnNasb: Say to the righteous that it will go well for them, For they will eat the fruit of their actions.
verses.textEn: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their deeds.

verses.textZh: 恶人却有祸了，他们必遭灾难， 因为他们必按自己手所作的得报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人却有祸了，他们必遭灾难， 因为他们必按自己手所作的得报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人有祸了！他必遭灾难！ 因为要照自己手所行的受报应。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them! They will be paid back for what their hands have done.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to the wicked! It shall be ill with him, for what his hands have dealt out shall be done to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to the wicked! Itshallbe ill withhim, For the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the wicked are doomed, for they will get exactly what they deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to the wicked! It will go badly for him, For what he deserves will be done to him.
verses.textEn: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them! They will be paid back for what their hands have done.

verses.textZh: 至于我的子民，孩童欺压他们， 妇女管辖他们； 我的子民啊！那引导你们的，使你们走错了路， 并且混乱了你们所走的方向。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我的子民，孩童欺压他们， 妇女管辖他们； 我的子民啊！那引导你们的，使你们走错了路， 并且混乱了你们所走的方向。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我的百姓， 孩童欺压他们， 妇女辖管他们。 我的百姓啊，引导你的使你走错， 并毁坏你所行的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: Youths oppress my people, women rule over them. My people, your guides lead you astray; they turn you from the path.
verses.textEnEsv: My people— infants are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, your guides mislead you and they have swallowed up the course of your paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor My people, children are their oppressors, And women rule over them. O My people! Those who lead you cause you to err, And destroy the way of your paths."
verses.textEnNlt: Childish leaders oppress my people, and women rule over them. O my people, your leaders mislead you; they send you down the wrong road.
verses.textEnNasb: My people! Their oppressors treat them violently, And women rule over them. My people! Those who guide you lead you astray And confuse the direction of your paths.
verses.textEn: Youths oppress my people, women rule over them. My people, your guides lead you astray; they turn you from the path.

verses.textZh: 耶和华起来辩论， 站着审判人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华起来辩论， 站着审判人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华起来辩论， 站着审判众民。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord takes his place in court; he rises to judge the people.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has taken his place to contend; he stands to judge peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord stands up to plead, And stands to judge the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord takes his place in court and presents his case against his people.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord arises to contend, And stands to judge the people.
verses.textEn: The Lord takes his place in court; he rises to judge the people.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必审问他子民中的长老和领袖，说： "那吞尽葡萄园的，就是你们； 从贫穷人那里掠夺的，都在你们家中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必审问他子民中的长老和领袖，说： "那吞尽葡萄园的，就是你们； 从贫穷人那里掠夺的，都在你们家中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必审问他民中的长老和首领，说： 吃尽葡萄园果子的就是你们； 向贫穷人所夺的都在你们家中。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord enters into judgment against the elders and leaders of his people: "It is you who have ruined my vineyard; the plunder from the poor is in your houses.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will enter into judgment with the elders and princes of his people: "It is you who have devoured the vineyard, the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will enter into judgment With the elders of His people And His princes: "For you have eaten up the vineyard; The plunder of the poor is in your houses.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord comes forward to pronounce judgment on the elders and rulers of his people: "You have ruined Israel, my vineyard. Your houses are filled with things stolen from the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord enters into judgment with the elders and leaders of His people, "It is you who have devoured the vineyard; The goods stolen from the poor are in your houses.
verses.textEn: The Lord enters into judgment against the elders and leaders of his people: "It is you who have ruined my vineyard; the plunder from the poor is in your houses.

verses.textZh: 主万军之耶和华说： "你们为甚么压迫我的子民， 搓磨贫穷人的脸呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主万军之耶和华说： "你们为甚么压迫我的子民， 搓磨贫穷人的脸呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 主－万军之耶和华说： 你们为何压制我的百姓， 搓磨贫穷人的脸呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What do you mean by crushing my people and grinding the faces of the poor?" declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: What do you mean by crushing my people, by grinding the face of the poor?" declares the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: What do you mean by crushing My people And grinding the faces of the poor?" Says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: How dare you crush my people, grinding the faces of the poor into the dust?" demands the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "What do you mean by crushing My people And oppressing the face of the poor?" Declares the Lord God of armies.
verses.textEn: What do you mean by crushing my people and grinding the faces of the poor?" declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又说： "因为锡安的女子高傲， 走路挺直颈项，媚眼看人， 俏步徐行， 用脚发出叮当声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又说： "因为锡安的女子高傲， 走路挺直颈项，媚眼看人， 俏步徐行， 用脚发出叮当声。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又说： 因为锡安的女子狂傲， 行走挺项，卖弄眼目， 俏步徐行，脚下玎珰，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord says, "The women of Zion are haughty, walking along with outstretched necks, flirting with their eyes, strutting along with swaying hips, with ornaments jingling on their ankles.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with outstretched necks, glancing wantonly with their eyes, mincing along as they go, tinkling with their feet,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Lord says: "Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, And walk with outstretched necks And wanton eyes, Walking and mincing as they go, Making a jingling with their feet,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "Beautiful Zion is haughty: craning her elegant neck, flirting with her eyes, walking with dainty steps, tinkling her ankle bracelets.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the Lord said, "Because the daughters of Zion are haughty And walk with heads held high and seductive eyes, And go along with mincing steps And jingle the anklets on their feet,
verses.textEn: The Lord says, "The women of Zion are haughty, walking along with outstretched necks, flirting with their eyes, strutting along with swaying hips, with ornaments jingling on their ankles.

verses.textZh: 因此，主必使锡安的女子头顶长出秃疮； 耶和华又使她们露出前额。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主必使锡安的女子头顶长出秃疮； 耶和华又使她们露出前额。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主必使锡安的女子头长秃疮； 耶和华又使她们赤露下体。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the women of Zion; the Lord will make their scalps bald."
verses.textEnEsv: therefore the Lord will strike with a scab the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will lay bare their secret parts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord will strike with a scab The crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, And the Lord will uncover their secret parts."
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord will send scabs on her head; the Lord will make beautiful Zion bald."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will afflict the scalp of the daughters of Zion with scabs, And the Lord will make their foreheads bare."
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the women of Zion; the Lord will make their scalps bald."

verses.textZh: 到那日，主必除掉她们华美的脚钏、发网、月牙圈、
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，主必除掉她们华美的脚钏、发网、月牙圈、
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，主必除掉她们华美的脚钏、发网、月牙圈、
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord will snatch away their finery: the bangles and headbands and crescent necklaces,
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord will take away the finery of the anklets, the headbands, and the crescents;
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day the Lord will take away the finery: The jingling anklets, the scarves, and the crescents;
verses.textEnNlt: On that day of judgment the Lord will strip away everything that makes her beautiful: ornaments, headbands, crescent necklaces,
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, headbands, crescent ornaments,
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord will snatch away their finery: the bangles and headbands and crescent necklaces,

verses.textZh: 耳坠、手镯、蒙脸的帕子、
verses.textZhCnvs: 耳坠、手镯、蒙脸的帕子、
verses.textZhCuv: 耳环、手镯、蒙脸的帕子、
verses.textEnNiv: the earrings and bracelets and veils,
verses.textEnEsv: the pendants, the bracelets, and the scarves;
verses.textEnNkjv: The pendants, the bracelets, and the veils;
verses.textEnNlt: earrings, bracelets, and veils;
verses.textEnNasb: dangling earrings, bracelets, veils,
verses.textEn: the earrings and bracelets and veils,

verses.textZh: 头饰、脚环、华带、香盒、符囊、
verses.textZhCnvs: 头饰、脚环、华带、香盒、符囊、
verses.textZhCuv: 华冠、足链、华带、香盒、符囊、
verses.textEnNiv: the headdresses and anklets and sashes, the perfume bottles and charms,
verses.textEnEsv: the headdresses, the armlets, the sashes, the perfume boxes, and the amulets;
verses.textEnNkjv: The headdresses, the leg ornaments, and the headbands; The perfume boxes, the charms,
verses.textEnNlt: scarves, ankle bracelets, sashes, perfumes, and charms;
verses.textEnNasb: headdresses, ankle chains, sashes, perfume boxes, amulets,
verses.textEn: the headdresses and anklets and sashes, the perfume bottles and charms,

verses.textZh: 戒指、鼻环、
verses.textZhCnvs: 戒指、鼻环、
verses.textZhCuv: 戒指、鼻环、
verses.textEnNiv: the signet rings and nose rings,
verses.textEnEsv: the signet rings and nose rings;
verses.textEnNkjv: and the rings; The nose jewels,
verses.textEnNlt: rings, jewels,
verses.textEnNasb: finger rings, nose rings,
verses.textEn: the signet rings and nose rings,

verses.textZh: 美服、外衣、钱袋、
verses.textZhCnvs: 美服、外衣、钱袋、
verses.textZhCuv: 吉服、外套、云肩、荷包、
verses.textEnNiv: the fine robes and the capes and cloaks, the purses
verses.textEnEsv: the festal robes, the mantles, the cloaks, and the handbags;
verses.textEnNkjv: the festal apparel, and the mantles; The outer garments, the purses,
verses.textEnNlt: party clothes, gowns, capes, and purses;
verses.textEnNasb: festive robes, outer garments, shawls, purses,
verses.textEn: the fine robes and the capes and cloaks, the purses

verses.textZh: 镜子、细麻衬衣、头巾、蒙身帕子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 镜子、细麻衬衣、头巾、蒙身帕子。
verses.textZhCuv: 手镜、细麻衣、裹头巾、蒙身的帕子。
verses.textEnNiv: and mirrors, and the linen garments and tiaras and shawls.
verses.textEnEsv: the mirrors, the linen garments, the turbans, and the veils.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the mirrors; The fine linen, the turbans, and the robes.
verses.textEnNlt: mirrors, fine linen garments, head ornaments, and shawls.
verses.textEnNasb: papyrus garments, undergarments, headbands, and veils.
verses.textEn: and mirrors, and the linen garments and tiaras and shawls.

verses.textZh: 必有腐臭代替馨香， 绳子代替腰带， 光秃代替美发， 麻衣系腰代替美服， 烙痕代替美貌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有腐臭代替馨香， 绳子代替腰带， 光秃代替美发， 麻衣系腰代替美服， 烙痕代替美貌。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有臭烂代替馨香， 绳子代替腰带， 光秃代替美发， 麻衣系腰代替华服， 烙伤代替美容。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a sash, a rope; instead of well-dressed hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, branding.
verses.textEnEsv: Instead of perfume there will be rottenness; and instead of a belt, a rope; and instead of well-set hair, baldness; and instead of a rich robe, a skirt of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it shall be: Instead of a sweet smell there will be a stench; Instead of a sash, a rope; Instead of well-set hair, baldness; Instead of a rich robe, a girding of sackcloth; And branding instead of beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead of smelling of sweet perfume, she will stink. She will wear a rope for a sash, and her elegant hair will fall out. She will wear rough burlap instead of rich robes. Shame will replace her beauty.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it will come about that instead of balsam oil there will be a stench; Instead of a belt, a rope; Instead of well-set hair, a plucked-out scalp; Instead of fine clothes, a robe of sackcloth; And branding instead of beauty.
verses.textEn: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a sash, a rope; instead of well-dressed hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, branding.

verses.textZh: 你的男丁要倒在刀下， 你的勇士必死在战场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的男丁要倒在刀下， 你的勇士必死在战场。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的男丁必倒在刀下； 你的勇士必死在阵上。
verses.textEnNiv: Your men will fall by the sword, your warriors in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: Your men shall fall by the sword and your mighty men in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your men shall fall by the sword, And your mighty in the war.
verses.textEnNlt: The men of the city will be killed with the sword, and her warriors will die in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Your men will fall by the sword And your mighty ones in battle.
verses.textEn: Your men will fall by the sword, your warriors in battle.

verses.textZh: 锡安的城门必悲哀哭号， 锡安被掠夺，成了一片荒凉后，必坐在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的城门必悲哀哭号， 锡安被掠夺，成了一片荒凉后，必坐在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安 的城门必悲伤、哀号； 她必荒凉坐在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: The gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And her gates shall lament and mourn; empty, she shall sit on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her gates shall lament and mourn, And she being desolate shall sit on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: The gates of Zion will weep and mourn. The city will be like a ravaged woman, huddled on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And her gates will lament and mourn, And she will sit deserted on the ground.
verses.textEn: The gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.

verses.textZh: 到那日，七个女人必拉住一个男人，说："我们吃自己的饭，穿自己的衣服；只求你让我们归在你名下，使我们的羞辱可以除掉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，七个女人必拉住一个男人，说："我们吃自己的饭，穿自己的衣服；只求你让我们归在你名下，使我们的羞辱可以除掉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在那日，七个女人必拉住一个男人，说：「我们吃自己的食物，穿自己的衣服，但求你许我们归你名下；求你除掉我们的羞耻。」
verses.textEnNiv: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, "We will eat our own food and provide our own clothes; only let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!"
