verses.textEnEsv: And seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, "We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes, only let us be called by your name; take away our reproach."
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, "We will eat our own food and wear our own apparel; Only let us be called by your name, To take away our reproach."
verses.textEnNlt: In that day so few men will be left that seven women will fight for each man, saying, "Let us all marry you! We will provide our own food and clothing. Only let us take your name so we won’t be mocked as old maids."
verses.textEnNasb: For seven women will take hold of one man on that day, saying, "We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes, only let us be called by your name; take away our disgrace!"
verses.textEn: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, "We will eat our own food and provide our own clothes; only let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!"

verses.textZh: 到那日，从耶和华那里发生的苗必华美荣耀；那地的果实成为以色列那些逃脱的人的夸耀和光荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，从耶和华那里发生的苗必华美荣耀；那地的果实成为以色列那些逃脱的人的夸耀和光荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，耶和华发生的苗必华美尊荣，地的出产必为以色列逃脱的人显为荣华茂盛。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Branch of the Lord will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of the survivors in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the branch of the Lord shall be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land shall be the pride and honor of the survivors of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day the Branch of the Lord shall be beautiful and glorious; And the fruit of the earth shallbe excellent and appealing For those of Israel who have escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: But in that day, the branch of the Lord will be beautiful and glorious; the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of all who survive in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Branch of the Lord will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth will be the pride and the beauty of the survivors of Israel.
verses.textEn: In that day the Branch of the Lord will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of the survivors in Israel.

verses.textZh: 那时，锡安余剩、仍留在耶路撒冷的人，就是所有登记在耶路撒冷活人名册上的，都必称为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，锡安余剩、仍留在耶路撒冷的人，就是所有登记在耶路撒冷活人名册上的，都必称为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华也必在锡安全山，并各会众以上，使白日有烟云，黑夜有火焰的光。因为在全荣耀之上必有遮蔽。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are left in Zion, who remain in Jerusalem, will be called holy, all who are recorded among the living in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And he who is left in Zion and remains in Jerusalem will be called holy, everyone who has been recorded for life in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass that hewhois left in Zion and remains in Jerusalem will be called holy—everyone who is recorded among the living in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: All who remain in Zion will be a holy people— those who survive the destruction of Jerusalem and are recorded among the living.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that the one who is left in Zion and remains behind in Jerusalem will be called holy—everyone who is recorded for life in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Those who are left in Zion, who remain in Jerusalem, will be called holy, all who are recorded among the living in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 主要用审判的灵和焚烧的灵把锡安女子的污秽洗去，又把耶路撒冷中间的血腥洗净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主要用审判的灵和焚烧的灵把锡安女子的污秽洗去，又把耶路撒冷中间的血腥洗净。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有亭子，白日可以得荫避暑，也可以作为藏身之处，躲避狂风暴雨。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will wash away the filth of the women of Zion; he will cleanse the bloodstains from Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.
verses.textEnEsv: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains of Jerusalem from its midst by a spirit of judgment and by a spirit of burning.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and purged the blood of Jerusalem from her midst, by the spirit of judgment and by the spirit of burning,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will wash the filth from beautiful Zion and cleanse Jerusalem of its bloodstains with the hot breath of fiery judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and purged the bloodshed of Jerusalem from her midst, by the spirit of judgment and the spirit of burning,
verses.textEn: The Lord will wash away the filth of the women of Zion; he will cleanse the bloodstains from Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.

verses.textZh: 然后，耶和华必在锡安全山之上，并会众之上，在日间创造云和烟，夜间创造有火焰的光亮，因为在一切荣耀之上，必有遮盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，耶和华必在锡安全山之上，并会众之上，在日间创造云和烟，夜间创造有火焰的光亮，因为在一切荣耀之上，必有遮盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 然后，耶和华必在锡安全山之上，并会众之上，在日间创造云和烟，夜间创造有火焰的光亮，因为在一切荣耀之上，必有遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord will create over all of Mount Zion and over those who assemble there a cloud of smoke by day and a glow of flaming fire by night; over everything the glory will be a canopy.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord will create over the whole site of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud by day, and smoke and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory there will be a canopy.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the Lord will create above every dwelling place of Mount Zion, and above her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day and the shining of a flaming fire by night. For over all the glory there willbe a covering.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will provide shade for Mount Zion and all who assemble there. He will provide a canopy of cloud during the day and smoke and flaming fire at night, covering the glorious land.
verses.textEnNasb: then the Lord will create over the entire area of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud by day, and smoke, and the brightness of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory will be a canopy.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord will create over all of Mount Zion and over those who assemble there a cloud of smoke by day and a glow of flaming fire by night; over everything the glory will be a canopy.

verses.textZh: 也必有亭子，日间可以使人得阴凉、避炎热，也可以作避难时藏身之所，或作躲避狂风暴雨之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也必有亭子，日间可以使人得阴凉、避炎热，也可以作避难时藏身之所，或作躲避狂风暴雨之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 也必有亭子，日间可以使人得阴凉、避炎热，也可以作避难时藏身之所，或作躲避狂风暴雨之处。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be a shelter and shade from the heat of the day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and rain.
verses.textEnEsv: There will be a booth for shade by day from the heat, and for a refuge and a shelter from the storm and rain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there will be a tabernacle for shade in the daytime from the heat, for a place of refuge, and for a shelter from storm and rain.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be a shelter from daytime heat and a hiding place from storms and rain.
verses.textEnNasb: And there will be a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and refuge and protection from the storm and the rain.
verses.textEn: It will be a shelter and shade from the heat of the day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and rain.

verses.textZh: 我要为我所爱的唱歌， 这歌是关于他的葡萄园： 我所爱的人有一个葡萄园，在肥美的山冈上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要为我所爱的唱歌， 这歌是关于他的葡萄园： 我所爱的人有一个葡萄园，在肥美的山冈上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要为我所亲爱的唱歌， 是我所爱者的歌，论他葡萄园的事： 我所亲爱的有葡萄园在肥美的山冈上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sing for the one I love a song about his vineyard: My loved one had a vineyard on a fertile hillside.
verses.textEnEsv: Let me sing for my beloved my love song concerning his vineyard: My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now let me sing to my Well-beloved A song of my Beloved regarding His vineyard: My Well-beloved has a vineyard On a very fruitful hill.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I will sing for the one I love a song about his vineyard: My beloved had a vineyard on a rich and fertile hill.
verses.textEnNasb: Let me sing now for my beloved A song of my beloved about His vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a fertile hill.
verses.textEn: I will sing for the one I love a song about his vineyard: My loved one had a vineyard on a fertile hillside.

verses.textZh: 他把园子的泥土挖松了，捡去石头， 栽种了上好的葡萄树； 在园中建造了一座守望楼， 又凿了一个榨酒池。 他期望结出好葡萄， 却结出野葡萄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把园子的泥土挖松了，捡去石头， 栽种了上好的葡萄树； 在园中建造了一座守望楼， 又凿了一个榨酒池。 他期望结出好葡萄， 却结出野葡萄。
verses.textZhCuv: 他刨挖园子，捡去石头， 栽种上等的葡萄树， 在园中盖了一座楼， 又凿出压酒池； 指望结好葡萄， 反倒结了野葡萄。
verses.textEnNiv: He dug it up and cleared it of stones and planted it with the choicest vines. He built a watchtower in it and cut out a winepress as well. Then he looked for a crop of good grapes, but it yielded only bad fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: He dug it and cleared it of stones, and planted it with choice vines; he built a watchtower in the midst of it, and hewed out a wine vat in it; and he looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He dug it up and cleared out its stones, And planted it with the choicest vine. He built a tower in its midst, And also made a winepress in it; So He expected it to bring forth good grapes, But it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.textEnNlt: He plowed the land, cleared its stones, and planted it with the best vines. In the middle he built a watchtower and carved a winepress in the nearby rocks. Then he waited for a harvest of sweet grapes, but the grapes that grew were bitter.
verses.textEnNasb: He dug it all around, cleared it of stones, And planted it with the choicest vine. And He built a tower in the middle of it, And also carved out a wine vat in it; Then He expected it to produce good grapes, But it produced only worthless ones.
verses.textEn: He dug it up and cleared it of stones and planted it with the choicest vines. He built a watchtower in it and cut out a winepress as well. Then he looked for a crop of good grapes, but it yielded only bad fruit.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的居民和犹大人哪！ 现在请你们在我与我的葡萄园之间断定是非吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的居民和犹大人哪！ 现在请你们在我与我的葡萄园之间断定是非吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的居民和犹大人哪， 请你们现今在我与我的葡萄园中，断定是非。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now you dwellers in Jerusalem and people of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, Judge, please, between Me and My vineyard.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, you people of Jerusalem and Judah, you judge between me and my vineyard.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, you inhabitants of Jerusalem and people of Judah, Judge between Me and My vineyard.
verses.textEn: "Now you dwellers in Jerusalem and people of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.

verses.textZh: 我为我的葡萄园所作的以外，还有甚么要作的呢？ 我期望它结出好葡萄，它为甚么倒结出野葡萄呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为我的葡萄园所作的以外，还有甚么要作的呢？ 我期望它结出好葡萄，它为甚么倒结出野葡萄呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我为我葡萄园所做之外， 还有什么可做的呢？ 我指望结好葡萄， 怎么倒结了野葡萄呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What more could have been done for my vineyard than I have done for it? When I looked for good grapes, why did it yield only bad?
verses.textEnEsv: What more was there to do for my vineyard, that I have not done in it? When I looked for it to yield grapes, why did it yield wild grapes?
verses.textEnNkjv: What more could have been done to My vineyard That I have not done in it? Why then, when I expected it to bring forth good grapes, Did it bring forth wild grapes?
verses.textEnNlt: What more could I have done for my vineyard that I have not already done? When I expected sweet grapes, why did my vineyard give me bitter grapes?
verses.textEnNasb: "What more was there to do for My vineyard that I have not done in it? Why, when I expected it to produce good grapes did it produce worthless ones?
verses.textEn: What more could have been done for my vineyard than I have done for it? When I looked for good grapes, why did it yield only bad?

verses.textZh: 现在我告诉你们，我要怎样处理我的葡萄园： 我要把它的篱笆撤去，使它被吞灭； 我要把它的围墙拆毁，使它被践踏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我告诉你们，我要怎样处理我的葡萄园： 我要把它的篱笆撤去，使它被吞灭； 我要把它的围墙拆毁，使它被践踏。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我告诉你们， 我要向我葡萄园怎样行： 我必撤去篱笆，使它被吞灭， 拆毁墙垣，使它被践踏。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I will tell you what I am going to do to my vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be destroyed; I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled.
verses.textEnEsv: And now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will remove its hedge, and it shall be devoured; I will break down its wall, and it shall be trampled down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, please let Me tell you what I will do to My vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it shall be burned; And break down its wall, and it shall be trampled down.
verses.textEnNlt: Now let me tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will tear down its hedges and let it be destroyed. I will break down its walls and let the animals trample it.
verses.textEnNasb: "So now let Me tell you what I am going to do to My vineyard: I will remove its hedge and it will be consumed; I will break down its wall and it will become trampled ground.
verses.textEn: Now I will tell you what I am going to do to my vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be destroyed; I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled.

verses.textZh: 我要使它荒废， 不再修剪，也不再耕耘， 荆棘和蒺藜却要长起来； 我也要吩咐云不再降雨在园子上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使它荒废， 不再修剪，也不再耕耘， 荆棘和蒺藜却要长起来； 我也要吩咐云不再降雨在园子上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使它荒废，不再修理， 不再锄刨，荆棘蒺藜倒要生长。 我也必命云不降雨在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and briers and thorns will grow there. I will command the clouds not to rain on it."
verses.textEnEsv: I will make it a waste; it shall not be pruned or hoed, and briers and thorns shall grow up; I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will lay it waste; It shall not be pruned or dug, But there shall come up briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds That they rain no rain on it."
verses.textEnNlt: I will make it a wild place where the vines are not pruned and the ground is not hoed, a place overgrown with briers and thorns. I will command the clouds to drop no rain on it.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will lay it waste; It will not be pruned nor hoed, But briars and thorns will come up. I will also command the clouds not to rain on it."
verses.textEn: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and briers and thorns will grow there. I will command the clouds not to rain on it."

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华的葡萄园就是以色列家， 他喜悦的树就是犹大人； 他期望的是公平，但看到的只是流血的事； 他期望的是公义，听到的只是哀叫声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华的葡萄园就是以色列家， 他喜悦的树就是犹大人； 他期望的是公平，但看到的只是流血的事； 他期望的是公义，听到的只是哀叫声。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华的葡萄园就是以色列家； 他所喜爱的树就是犹大人。 他指望的是公平， 谁知倒有暴虐 ； 指望的是公义， 谁知倒有冤声。
verses.textEnNiv: The vineyard of the Lord Almighty is the nation of Israel, and the people of Judah are the vines he delighted in. And he looked for justice, but saw bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard cries of distress.
verses.textEnEsv: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are his pleasant planting; and he looked for justice, but behold, bloodshed; for righteousness, but behold, an outcry!
verses.textEnNkjv: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, And the men of Judah are His pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression; For righteousness, but behold, a cry for help.
verses.textEnNlt: The nation of Israel is the vineyard of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. The people of Judah are his pleasant garden. He expected a crop of justice, but instead he found oppression. He expected to find righteousness, but instead he heard cries of violence.
verses.textEnNasb: For the vineyard of the Lord of armies is the house of Israel, And the people of Judah are His delightful plant. So He waited for justice, but behold, there was bloodshed; For righteousness, but behold, a cry for help.
verses.textEn: The vineyard of the Lord Almighty is the nation of Israel, and the people of Judah are the vines he delighted in. And he looked for justice, but saw bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard cries of distress.

verses.textZh: 那些使房屋连接房屋，使田地连接田地， 以致不留余地的人，有祸了！ 你们只可以独居在境内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些使房屋连接房屋，使田地连接田地， 以致不留余地的人，有祸了！ 你们只可以独居在境内。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些以房接房， 以地连地， 以致不留余地的， 只顾自己独居境内。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field till no space is left and you live alone in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who join house to house, who add field to field, until there is no more room, and you are made to dwell alone in the midst of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who join house to house; They add field to field, Till thereis no place Where they may dwell alone in the midst of the land!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow for you who buy up house after house and field after field, until everyone is evicted and you live alone in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who attach house to house and join field to field, Until there is no more room, And you alone are a landowner in the midst of the land!
verses.textEn: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field till no space is left and you live alone in the land.

verses.textZh: 我听闻万军之耶和华说："必有许多房屋变成荒凉， 甚至那些又大又美的房屋也没有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听闻万军之耶和华说："必有许多房屋变成荒凉， 甚至那些又大又美的房屋也没有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 我耳闻万军之耶和华说： 必有许多又大又美的房屋 成为荒凉，无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty has declared in my hearing: "Surely the great houses will become desolate, the fine mansions left without occupants.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts has sworn in my hearing: "Surely many houses shall be desolate, large and beautiful houses, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: In my hearing the Lord of hosts said, "Truly, many houses shall be desolate, Great and beautiful ones, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: But I have heard the Lord of Heaven’s Armies swear a solemn oath: "Many houses will stand deserted; even beautiful mansions will be empty.
verses.textEnNasb: In my ears the Lord of armies has sworn, "Many houses shall certainly become desolate, Even great and fine ones, without occupants.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty has declared in my hearing: "Surely the great houses will become desolate, the fine mansions left without occupants.

verses.textZh: 十公顷葡萄园只出二十二公升酒； 二百二十公升谷种只结二十二公升粮食。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 十公顷葡萄园只出二十二公升酒； 二百二十公升谷种只结二十二公升粮食。"
verses.textZhCuv: 三十亩葡萄园只出一罢特酒； 一贺梅珥谷种只结一伊法粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: A ten-acre vineyard will produce only a bath of wine; a homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain."
verses.textEnEsv: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield but one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield but an ephah."
verses.textEnNkjv: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, And a homer of seed shall yield one ephah."
verses.textEnNlt: Ten acres of vineyard will not produce even six gallons of wine. Ten baskets of seed will yield only one basket of grain."
verses.textEnNasb: "For ten acres of vineyard will yield only one bath of wine, And a homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain."
verses.textEn: A ten-acre vineyard will produce only a bath of wine; a homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain."

verses.textZh: 那些清早起来，追求浓酒， 留连到晚上，以致因酒发烧的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些清早起来，追求浓酒， 留连到晚上，以致因酒发烧的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些清早起来追求浓酒， 留连到夜深，甚至因酒发烧的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who rise early in the morning to run after their drinks, who stay up late at night till they are inflamed with wine.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who rise early in the morning, that they may run after strong drink, who tarry late into the evening as wine inflames them!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who rise early in the morning, That they may follow intoxicating drink; Who continue until night, till wine inflames them!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow for those who get up early in the morning looking for a drink of alcohol and spend long evenings drinking wine to make themselves flaming drunk.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who rise early in the morning so that they may pursue intoxicating drink, Who stay up late in the evening so that wine may inflame them!
verses.textEn: Woe to those who rise early in the morning to run after their drinks, who stay up late at night till they are inflamed with wine.

verses.textZh: 在他们的筵席上，有琴、瑟、手鼓、笛和酒， 但他们不理耶和华的作为， 也不留心他手所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们的筵席上，有琴、瑟、手鼓、笛和酒， 但他们不理耶和华的作为， 也不留心他手所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在筵席上 弹琴，鼓瑟，击鼓，吹笛，饮酒， 却不顾念耶和华的作为， 也不留心他手所做的。
verses.textEnNiv: They have harps and lyres at their banquets, pipes and timbrels and wine, but they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord , no respect for the work of his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: They have lyre and harp, tambourine and flute and wine at their feasts, but they do not regard the deeds of the Lord , or see the work of his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: The harp and the strings, The tambourine and flute, And wine are in their feasts; But they do not regard the work of the Lord, Nor consider the operation of His hands.
verses.textEnNlt: They furnish wine and lovely music at their grand parties— lyre and harp, tambourine and flute— but they never think about the Lord or notice what he is doing.
verses.textEnNasb: Their banquets are accompanied by lyre and harp, by tambourine and flute, and by wine; But they do not pay attention to the deeds of the Lord, Nor do they consider the work of His hands.
verses.textEn: They have harps and lyres at their banquets, pipes and timbrels and wine, but they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord , no respect for the work of his hands.

verses.textZh: 所以我的人民因无知被掳去； 他们的尊贵人十分饥饿； 他们的群众极其干渴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我的人民因无知被掳去； 他们的尊贵人十分饥饿； 他们的群众极其干渴。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我的百姓因无知就被掳去； 他们的尊贵人甚是饥饿， 群众极其干渴。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore my people will go into exile for lack of understanding; those of high rank will die of hunger and the common people will be parched with thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my people go into exile for lack of knowledge; their honored men go hungry, and their multitude is parched with thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore my people have gone into captivity, Because theyhave no knowledge; Their honorable men are famished, And their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: So my people will go into exile far away because they do not know me. Those who are great and honored will starve, and the common people will die of thirst.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore My people go into exile for their lack of knowledge; And their nobles are famished, And their multitude is parched with thirst.
verses.textEn: Therefore my people will go into exile for lack of understanding; those of high rank will die of hunger and the common people will be parched with thirst.

verses.textZh: 故此，阴间扩张它的咽喉，张大它的口，没有限量； 耶路撒冷城的荣耀 、群众、喧嚷的人和在城中作乐的人，都要下到阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 故此，阴间扩张它的咽喉，张大它的口，没有限量； 耶路撒冷城的荣耀 、群众、喧嚷的人和在城中作乐的人，都要下到阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，阴间扩张其欲， 开了无限量的口； 他们的荣耀、群众、繁华， 并快乐的人都落在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore Death expands its jaws, opening wide its mouth; into it will descend their nobles and masses with all their brawlers and revelers.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its appetite and opened its mouth beyond measure, and the nobility of Jerusalem and her multitude will go down, her revelers and he who exults in her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Sheol has enlarged itself And opened its mouth beyond measure; Their glory and their multitude and their pomp, And he who is jubilant, shall descend into it.
verses.textEnNlt: The grave is licking its lips in anticipation, opening its mouth wide. The great and the lowly and all the drunken mob will be swallowed up.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its throat and opened its mouth beyond measure; And Jerusalem’s splendor, her multitude, her noise of revelry, and the jubilant within her, descend into it.
verses.textEn: Therefore Death expands its jaws, opening wide its mouth; into it will descend their nobles and masses with all their brawlers and revelers.

verses.textZh: 卑贱人俯首，尊贵人降卑， 眼目高傲的也降卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 卑贱人俯首，尊贵人降卑， 眼目高傲的也降卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 卑贱人被压服； 尊贵人降为卑； 眼目高傲的人也降为卑。
verses.textEnNiv: So people will be brought low and everyone humbled, the eyes of the arrogant humbled.
verses.textEnEsv: Man is humbled, and each one is brought low, and the eyes of the haughty are brought low.
verses.textEnNkjv: People shall be brought down, Each man shall be humbled, And the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled.
verses.textEnNlt: Humanity will be destroyed, and people brought down; even the arrogant will lower their eyes in humiliation.
verses.textEnNasb: So the common people will be humbled and the person of importance brought low, The eyes of the haughty also will be brought low.
verses.textEn: So people will be brought low and everyone humbled, the eyes of the arrogant humbled.

verses.textZh: 唯独万军之耶和华，因公平被高举； 至圣的神，因公义显为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独万军之耶和华，因公平被高举； 至圣的神，因公义显为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有万军之耶和华因公平而崇高； 圣者神因公义显为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord Almighty will be exalted by his justice, and the holy God will be proved holy by his righteous acts.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord of hosts is exalted in justice, and the Holy God shows himself holy in righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, And God who is holy shall be hallowed in righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will be exalted by his justice. The holiness of God will be displayed by his righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord of armies will be exalted in judgment, And the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness.
verses.textEn: But the Lord Almighty will be exalted by his justice, and the holy God will be proved holy by his righteous acts.

verses.textZh: 那时羊羔必来吃草，像在自己的草场一样； 富裕者的荒场被寄居者随意吃用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时羊羔必来吃草，像在自己的草场一样； 富裕者的荒场被寄居者随意吃用。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，羊羔必来吃草，如同在自己的草场； 丰肥人的荒场被游行的人吃尽。
verses.textEnNiv: Then sheep will graze as in their own pasture; lambs will feed among the ruins of the rich.
verses.textEnEsv: Then shall the lambs graze as in their pasture, and nomads shall eat among the ruins of the rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the lambs shall feed in their pasture, And in the waste places of the fat ones strangers shall eat.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day lambs will find good pastures, and fattened sheep and young goats will feed among the ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, And strangers will eat in the ruins of the wealthy.
verses.textEn: Then sheep will graze as in their own pasture; lambs will feed among the ruins of the rich.

verses.textZh: 那些人虚假的绳索牵引罪孽， 又像用车绳拉罪恶的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人虚假的绳索牵引罪孽， 又像用车绳拉罪恶的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些以虚假之细绳牵罪孽的人！ 他们又像以套绳拉罪恶，
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who draw sin along with cords of deceit, and wickedness as with cart ropes,
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, who draw sin as with cart ropes,
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of vanity, And sin as if with a cart rope;
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow for those who drag their sins behind them with ropes made of lies, who drag wickedness behind them like a cart!
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who drag wrongdoing with the cords of deceit, And sin as if with cart ropes;
verses.textEn: Woe to those who draw sin along with cords of deceit, and wickedness as with cart ropes,

verses.textZh: 他们说："愿他赶快、迅速地成就他的作为，给我们看看！ 愿以色列的圣者所计划的临近！ 愿它来到，好让我们知道！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："愿他赶快、迅速地成就他的作为，给我们看看！ 愿以色列的圣者所计划的临近！ 愿它来到，好让我们知道！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：任他急速行，赶快成就他的作为， 使我们看看； 任以色列圣者所谋划的临近成就， 使我们知道。
verses.textEnNiv: to those who say, "Let God hurry; let him hasten his work so we may see it. The plan of the Holy One of Israel— let it approach, let it come into view, so we may know it."
verses.textEnEsv: who say: "Let him be quick, let him speed his work that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near, and let it come, that we may know it!"
verses.textEnNkjv: That say, "Let Him make speed and hasten His work, That we may see it; And let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, That we may know it."
verses.textEnNlt: They even mock God and say, "Hurry up and do something! We want to see what you can do. Let the Holy One of Israel carry out his plan, for we want to know what it is."
verses.textEnNasb: Who say, "Let Him hurry, let Him do His work quickly, so that we may see it; And let the plan of the Holy One of Israel approach And come to pass, so that we may know it!"
verses.textEn: to those who say, "Let God hurry; let him hasten his work so we may see it. The plan of the Holy One of Israel— let it approach, let it come into view, so we may know it."

verses.textZh: 那些称恶为善，称善为恶， 以暗为光，以光为暗， 以苦为甜，以甜为苦的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些称恶为善，称善为恶， 以暗为光，以光为暗， 以苦为甜，以甜为苦的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些称恶为善，称善为恶， 以暗为光，以光为暗， 以苦为甜，以甜为苦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; Who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; Who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow for those who say that evil is good and good is evil, that dark is light and light is dark, that bitter is sweet and sweet is bitter.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; Who substitute darkness for light and light for darkness; Who substitute bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!
verses.textEn: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.

verses.textZh: 那些自以为有智慧， 自视为聪明的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些自以为有智慧， 自视为聪明的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些自以为有智慧， 自看为通达的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and shrewd in their own sight!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to thosewhoare wise in their own eyes, And prudent in their own sight!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow for those who are wise in their own eyes and think themselves so clever.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes And clever in their own sight!
verses.textEn: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.

verses.textZh: 那些勇于喝酒， 又精于调和浓酒的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些勇于喝酒， 又精于调和浓酒的人，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些勇于饮酒， 以能力调浓酒的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine and champions at mixing drinks,
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine, and valiant men in mixing strong drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to men mighty at drinking wine, Woe to men valiant for mixing intoxicating drink,
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow for those who are heroes at drinking wine and boast about all the alcohol they can hold.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who are heroes in drinking wine, And valiant men in mixing intoxicating drink,
verses.textEn: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine and champions at mixing drinks,

verses.textZh: 他们因受了贿赂，就称恶人为义； 却把义人的权益夺去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因受了贿赂，就称恶人为义； 却把义人的权益夺去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因受贿赂，就称恶人为义， 将义人的义夺去。
verses.textEnNiv: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice to the innocent.
verses.textEnEsv: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, and deprive the innocent of his right!
verses.textEnNkjv: Who justify the wicked for a bribe, And take away justice from the righteous man!
verses.textEnNlt: They take bribes to let the wicked go free, and they punish the innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: Who declare the wicked innocent for a bribe, And take away the rights of the ones who are in the right!
verses.textEn: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice to the innocent.

verses.textZh: 因此，火舌怎样吞灭碎秸， 干草怎样落在火焰之中， 照样，他们的根必像腐朽之物，他们的花必像尘土飞扬； 因为他们弃绝万军之耶和华的训诲， 藐视以色列圣者的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，火舌怎样吞灭碎秸， 干草怎样落在火焰之中， 照样，他们的根必像腐朽之物，他们的花必像尘土飞扬； 因为他们弃绝万军之耶和华的训诲， 藐视以色列圣者的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 火苗怎样吞灭碎秸， 干草怎样落在火焰之中， 照样，他们的根必像朽物， 他们的花必像灰尘飞腾； 因为他们厌弃万军之耶和华的训诲， 藐视以色列圣者的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, as tongues of fire lick up straw and as dry grass sinks down in the flames, so their roots will decay and their flowers blow away like dust; for they have rejected the law of the Lord Almighty and spurned the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root will be as rottenness, and their blossom go up like dust; for they have rejected the law of the Lord of hosts, and have despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, as the fire devours the stubble, And the flame consumes the chaff, So their root will be as rottenness, And their blossom will ascend like dust; Because they have rejected the law of the Lord of hosts, And despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, just as fire licks up stubble and dry grass shrivels in the flame, so their roots will rot and their flowers wither. For they have rejected the law of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies; they have despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes stubble, And dry grass collapses in the flame, So their root will become like rot, and their blossom blow away like dust; For they have rejected the Law of the Lord of armies, And discarded the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Therefore, as tongues of fire lick up straw and as dry grass sinks down in the flames, so their roots will decay and their flowers blow away like dust; for they have rejected the law of the Lord Almighty and spurned the word of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华的怒气向他的子民发作， 他伸出手来击打他们， 群山都震动，他们的尸体在街上好象粪土， 虽然这样，他的怒气还未转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华的怒气向他的子民发作， 他伸出手来击打他们， 群山都震动，他们的尸体在街上好象粪土， 虽然这样，他的怒气还未转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作。 他的手伸出攻击他们，山岭就震动； 他们的尸首在街市上好像粪土。 虽然如此，他的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord ’s anger burns against his people; his hand is raised and he strikes them down. The mountains shake, and the dead bodies are like refuse in the streets. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against his people, and he stretched out his hand against them and struck them, and the mountains quaked; and their corpses were as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the anger of the Lord is aroused against His people; He has stretched out His hand against them And stricken them, And the hills trembled. Their carcasses were as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord ’s anger burns against his people, and why he has raised his fist to crush them. The mountains tremble, and the corpses of his people litter the streets like garbage. But even then the Lord ’s anger is not satisfied. His fist is still poised to strike!
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason the anger of the Lord has burned against His people, And He has stretched out His hand against them and struck them. And the mountains quaked, and their corpses lay like refuse in the middle of the streets. Despite all this, His anger is not spent, But His hand is still stretched out.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord ’s anger burns against his people; his hand is raised and he strikes them down. The mountains shake, and the dead bodies are like refuse in the streets. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

verses.textZh: 他必竖立旗帜，招一国的人从远方而来， 发出哨声把他们从地极召来； 看！他们必急速快奔而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必竖立旗帜，招一国的人从远方而来， 发出哨声把他们从地极召来； 看！他们必急速快奔而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必竖立大旗，招远方的国民， 发嘶声叫他们从地极而来； 看哪，他们必急速奔来。
verses.textEnNiv: He lifts up a banner for the distant nations, he whistles for those at the ends of the earth. Here they come, swiftly and speedily!
verses.textEnEsv: He will raise a signal for nations far away, and whistle for them from the ends of the earth; and behold, quickly, speedily they come!
verses.textEnNkjv: He will lift up a banner to the nations from afar, And will whistle to them from the end of the earth; Surely they shall come with speed, swiftly.
verses.textEnNlt: He will send a signal to distant nations far away and whistle to those at the ends of the earth. They will come racing toward Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He will also lift up a flag to the distant nation, And whistle for it from the ends of the earth; And behold, it will come with speed swiftly.
verses.textEn: He lifts up a banner for the distant nations, he whistles for those at the ends of the earth. Here they come, swiftly and speedily!

verses.textZh: 他们当中没有疲倦的，没有绊倒的， 没有打盹的，也没有睡觉的； 他们的腰带没有放松， 鞋带也没有折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当中没有疲倦的，没有绊倒的， 没有打盹的，也没有睡觉的； 他们的腰带没有放松， 鞋带也没有折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中没有疲倦的，绊跌的； 没有打盹的，睡觉的； 腰带并不放松， 鞋带也不折断。
verses.textEnNiv: Not one of them grows tired or stumbles, not one slumbers or sleeps; not a belt is loosened at the waist, not a sandal strap is broken.
verses.textEnEsv: None is weary, none stumbles, none slumbers or sleeps, not a waistband is loose, not a sandal strap broken;
verses.textEnNkjv: No one will be weary or stumble among them, No one will slumber or sleep; Nor will the belt on their loins be loosed, Nor the strap of their sandals be broken;
verses.textEnNlt: They will not get tired or stumble. They will not stop for rest or sleep. Not a belt will be loose, not a sandal strap broken.
verses.textEnNasb: No one in it is tired or stumbles, No one slumbers or sleeps; Nor is the undergarment at his waist loosened, Nor his sandal strap broken.
verses.textEn: Not one of them grows tired or stumbles, not one slumbers or sleeps; not a belt is loosened at the waist, not a sandal strap is broken.

verses.textZh: 他们的箭锐利，所有的弓都上了弦； 他们的马蹄看来像火石，车辆似旋风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的箭锐利，所有的弓都上了弦； 他们的马蹄看来像火石，车辆似旋风。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的箭快利， 弓也上了弦。 马蹄算如坚石， 车轮好像旋风。
verses.textEnNiv: Their arrows are sharp, all their bows are strung; their horses’ hooves seem like flint, their chariot wheels like a whirlwind.
verses.textEnEsv: their arrows are sharp, all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs seem like flint, and their wheels like the whirlwind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whose arrows are sharp, And all their bows bent; Their horses’ hooves will seem like flint, And their wheels like a whirlwind.
verses.textEnNlt: Their arrows will be sharp and their bows ready for battle. Sparks will fly from their horses’ hooves, and the wheels of their chariots will spin like a whirlwind.
verses.textEnNasb: Its arrows are sharp and all its bows are bent; The hoofs of its horses seem like flint, and its chariot wheels like a storm wind.
verses.textEn: Their arrows are sharp, all their bows are strung; their horses’ hooves seem like flint, their chariot wheels like a whirlwind.

verses.textZh: 他们的吼叫像母狮，他们的咆哮如幼狮； 他们咆哮，攫取猎物， 把它叼去，无人援救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的吼叫像母狮，他们的咆哮如幼狮； 他们咆哮，攫取猎物， 把它叼去，无人援救。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要吼叫，像母狮子， 咆哮，像少壮狮子； 他们要咆哮抓食， 坦然叼去，无人救回。
verses.textEnNiv: Their roar is like that of the lion, they roar like young lions; they growl as they seize their prey and carry it off with no one to rescue.
verses.textEnEsv: Their roaring is like a lion, like young lions they roar; they growl and seize their prey; they carry it off, and none can rescue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their roaring willbe like a lion, They will roar like young lions; Yes, they will roar And lay hold of the prey; They will carry it away safely, And no one will deliver.
verses.textEnNlt: They will roar like lions, like the strongest of lions. Growling, they will pounce on their victims and carry them off, and no one will be there to rescue them.
verses.textEnNasb: Its roaring is like a lioness, and it roars like young lions; It growls as it seizes the prey And carries it off with no one to save it.
verses.textEn: Their roar is like that of the lion, they roar like young lions; they growl as they seize their prey and carry it off with no one to rescue.

verses.textZh: 到那日，他们要向以色列人咆哮， 像海浪的澎湃声一样； 人若望着这地，就只见黑暗与灾难； 光在云中也成了黑暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，他们要向以色列人咆哮， 像海浪的澎湃声一样； 人若望着这地，就只见黑暗与灾难； 光在云中也成了黑暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，他们要向以色列人吼叫， 像海浪匉訇； 人若望地，只见黑暗艰难， 光明在云中变为昏暗。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks at the land, there is only darkness and distress; even the sun will be darkened by clouds.
verses.textEnEsv: They will growl over it on that day, like the growling of the sea. And if one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress; and the light is darkened by its clouds.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day they will roar against them Like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks to the land, Behold, darkness and sorrow; And the light is darkened by the clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: They will roar over their victims on that day of destruction like the roaring of the sea. If someone looks across the land, only darkness and distress will be seen; even the light will be darkened by clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will roar against it on that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks across to the land, behold, there is darkness and distress; Even the light is darkened by its clouds.
verses.textEn: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks at the land, there is only darkness and distress; even the sun will be darkened by clouds.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅王去世那年，我看见主坐在高高的宝座上，他的衣裳垂下，充满圣殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅王去世那年，我看见主坐在高高的宝座上，他的衣裳垂下，充满圣殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 当乌西雅王崩的那年，我见主坐在高高的宝座上。他的衣裳垂下，遮满圣殿。
verses.textEnNiv: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: In the year that King Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up; and the train of his robe filled the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, and the train of His robe filled the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: It was in the year King Uzziah died that I saw the Lord. He was sitting on a lofty throne, and the train of his robe filled the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: In the year of King Uzziah’s death I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, lofty and exalted, with the train of His robe filling the temple.
verses.textEn: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple.

verses.textZh: 在他上面有撒拉弗侍立，各有六个翅膀；用两个翅膀遮脸，两个翅膀遮脚，两个翅膀飞翔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他上面有撒拉弗侍立，各有六个翅膀；用两个翅膀遮脸，两个翅膀遮脚，两个翅膀飞翔。
verses.textZhCuv: 其上有撒拉弗侍立，各有六个翅膀：用两个翅膀遮脸，两个翅膀遮脚，两个翅膀飞翔；
verses.textEnNiv: Above him were seraphim, each with six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.
verses.textEnEsv: Above him stood the seraphim. Each had six wings: with two he covered his face, and with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.
verses.textEnNkjv: Above it stood seraphim; each one had six wings: with two he covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.
verses.textEnNlt: Attending him were mighty seraphim, each having six wings. With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.
verses.textEnNasb: Seraphim were standing above Him, each having six wings: with two each covered his face, and with two each covered his feet, and with two each flew.
verses.textEn: Above him were seraphim, each with six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此高呼着说： "圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！万军之耶和华！ 他的荣光充满全地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此高呼着说： "圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！万军之耶和华！ 他的荣光充满全地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼此呼喊说： 圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！万军之耶和华； 他的荣光充满全地！
verses.textEnNiv: And they were calling to one another: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Almighty; the whole earth is full of his glory."
verses.textEnEsv: And one called to another and said: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts; the whole earth is full of his glory!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And one cried to another and said: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts; The whole earth is full of His glory!"
verses.textEnNlt: They were calling out to each other, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies! The whole earth is filled with his glory!"
verses.textEnNasb: And one called out to another and said, "Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord of armies. The whole earth is full of His glory."
verses.textEn: And they were calling to one another: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Almighty; the whole earth is full of his glory."

verses.textZh: 因呼叫者的声音，门槛的根基震撼，殿也充满了烟云。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因呼叫者的声音，门槛的根基震撼，殿也充满了烟云。
verses.textZhCuv: 因呼喊者的声音，门槛的根基震动，殿充满了烟云。
verses.textEnNiv: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.
verses.textEnEsv: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the posts of the door were shaken by the voice of him who cried out, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.textEnNlt: Their voices shook the Temple to its foundations, and the entire building was filled with smoke.
verses.textEnNasb: And the foundations of the thresholds trembled at the voice of him who called out, while the temple was filling with smoke.
verses.textEn: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.

verses.textZh: 那时我说： "我有祸了，我灭亡了！ 因为我是个嘴唇不洁的人， 又住在嘴唇不洁的人民中间， 又因为我亲眼看见了大君王万军之耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我说： "我有祸了，我灭亡了！ 因为我是个嘴唇不洁的人， 又住在嘴唇不洁的人民中间， 又因为我亲眼看见了大君王万军之耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我说：「祸哉！我灭亡了！因为我是嘴唇不洁的人，又住在嘴唇不洁的民中，又因我眼见大君王－万军之耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to me!" I cried. "I am ruined! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips, and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: And I said: "Woe is me! For I am lost; for I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts!"
verses.textEnNkjv: So I said: "Woe is me, for I am undone! Because I am a man of unclean lips, And I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips; For my eyes have seen the King, The Lord of hosts."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "It’s all over! I am doomed, for I am a sinful man. I have filthy lips, and I live among a people with filthy lips. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Woe to me, for I am ruined! Because I am a man of unclean lips, And I live among a people of unclean lips; For my eyes have seen the King, the Lord of armies."
verses.textEn: "Woe to me!" I cried. "I am ruined! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips, and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Almighty."

verses.textZh: 有一个撒拉弗飞到我面前，手里拿着烧红的炭，是用火钳从祭坛上取来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个撒拉弗飞到我面前，手里拿着烧红的炭，是用火钳从祭坛上取来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一撒拉弗飞到我跟前，手里拿着红炭，是用火剪从坛上取下来的，
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having in his hand a burning coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having in his hand a live coal which he had taken with the tongs from the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a burning coal he had taken from the altar with a pair of tongs.
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a burning coal in his hand, which he had taken from the altar with tongs.
verses.textEn: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.

verses.textZh: 他用炭沾我的口，说："看哪！这炭沾了你的嘴唇，你的罪孽就除掉，你的罪恶就赦免了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用炭沾我的口，说："看哪！这炭沾了你的嘴唇，你的罪孽就除掉，你的罪恶就赦免了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 将炭沾我的口，说：「看哪，这炭沾了你的嘴，你的罪孽便除掉，你的罪恶就赦免了。」
verses.textEnNiv: With it he touched my mouth and said, "See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin atoned for."
verses.textEnEsv: And he touched my mouth and said: "Behold, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away, and your sin atoned for."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he touched my mouth withit, and said: "Behold, this has touched your lips; Your iniquity is taken away, And your sin purged."
verses.textEnNlt: He touched my lips with it and said, "See, this coal has touched your lips. Now your guilt is removed, and your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNasb: He touched my mouth with it and said, "Behold, this has touched your lips; and your guilt is taken away and atonement is made for your sin."
verses.textEn: With it he touched my mouth and said, "See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin atoned for."

verses.textZh: 我又听见主的声音说："我可以差遣谁呢？谁肯为我们去呢？"我说："我在这里，请差遣我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见主的声音说："我可以差遣谁呢？谁肯为我们去呢？"我说："我在这里，请差遣我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又听见主的声音说：「我可以差遣谁呢？谁肯为我们去呢？」我说：「我在这里，请差遣我！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?" And I said, "Here am I. Send me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?" Then I said, "Here I am! Send me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying: "Whom shall I send, And who will go for Us?" Then I said, "Here am I! Send me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard the Lord asking, "Whom should I send as a messenger to this people? Who will go for us?" I said, "Here I am. Send me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for Us?" Then I said, "Here am I. Send me!"
verses.textEn: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?" And I said, "Here am I. Send me!"

verses.textZh: 他说："你去告诉这子民，说： ‘你们听了又听，却不明白； 看了又看，却不晓得。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："你去告诉这子民，说： ‘你们听了又听，却不明白； 看了又看，却不晓得。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「你去告诉这百姓说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Go and tell this people: " ‘Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.’
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Go, and say to this people: "‘Keep on hearing, but do not understand; keep on seeing, but do not perceive.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Go, and tell this people: ‘Keep on hearing, but do not understand; Keep on seeing, but do not perceive.’
verses.textEnNlt: And he said, "Yes, go, and say to this people, ‘Listen carefully, but do not understand. Watch closely, but learn nothing.’
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "Go, and tell this people: ‘Keep on listening, but do not understand; And keep on looking, but do not gain knowledge.’
verses.textEn: He said, "Go and tell this people: " ‘Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.’

verses.textZh: 你要使这子民的心思迟钝 ， 耳朵不灵， 眼睛昏暗， 免得他们眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白， 回转过来，得到医治。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要使这子民的心思迟钝 ， 耳朵不灵， 眼睛昏暗， 免得他们眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白， 回转过来，得到医治。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要使这百姓心蒙脂油， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛昏迷； 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白， 回转过来，便得医治。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make the heart of this people calloused; make their ears dull and close their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed."
verses.textEnEsv: Make the heart of this people dull, and their ears heavy, and blind their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Make the heart of this people dull, And their ears heavy, And shut their eyes; Lest they see with their eyes, And hear with their ears, And understand with their heart, And return and be healed."
verses.textEnNlt: Harden the hearts of these people. Plug their ears and shut their eyes. That way, they will not see with their eyes, nor hear with their ears, nor understand with their hearts and turn to me for healing."
verses.textEnNasb: "Make the hearts of this people insensitive, Their ears dull, And their eyes blind, So that they will not see with their eyes, Hear with their ears, Understand with their hearts, And return and be healed."
verses.textEn: Make the heart of this people calloused; make their ears dull and close their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed."

verses.textZh: 于是我说："主啊，这要到几时为止呢？"他回答说： "直到城镇荒凉，无人居住； 房屋空置无人， 地土废弃荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我说："主啊，这要到几时为止呢？"他回答说： "直到城镇荒凉，无人居住； 房屋空置无人， 地土废弃荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说：「主啊，这到几时为止呢？」他说： 直到城邑荒凉，无人居住， 房屋空闲无人，地土极其荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "For how long, Lord?" And he answered: "Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left deserted and the fields ruined and ravaged,
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "How long, O Lord?" And he said: "Until cities lie waste without inhabitant, and houses without people, and the land is a desolate waste,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "Lord, how long?" And He answered: "Until the cities are laid waste and without inhabitant, The houses are without a man, The land is utterly desolate,
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "Lord, how long will this go on?" And he replied, "Until their towns are empty, their houses are deserted, and the whole country is a wasteland;
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Lord, how long?" And He answered, "Until cities are devastated and without inhabitant, Houses are without people And the land is utterly desolate,
verses.textEn: Then I said, "For how long, Lord?" And he answered: "Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left deserted and the fields ruined and ravaged,

verses.textZh: 耶和华要把人迁到远方， 在这境内必有很多被撇下的地土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华要把人迁到远方， 在这境内必有很多被撇下的地土。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且耶和华将人迁到远方， 在这境内撇下的地土很多。
verses.textEnNiv: until the Lord has sent everyone far away and the land is utterly forsaken.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord removes people far away, and the forsaken places are many in the midst of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has removed men far away, And the forsaken places are many in the midst of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: until the Lord has sent everyone away, and the entire land of Israel lies deserted.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has completely removed people, And there are many forsaken places in the midst of the land.
verses.textEn: until the Lord has sent everyone far away and the land is utterly forsaken.

verses.textZh: 境内剩下的人，虽然只有十分之一， 也必被消灭。 但正如栗树和橡树， 虽然被砍下，树的余干还存留在那里。 这圣洁的苗裔，就是这国的余干。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 境内剩下的人，虽然只有十分之一， 也必被消灭。 但正如栗树和橡树， 虽然被砍下，树的余干还存留在那里。 这圣洁的苗裔，就是这国的余干。"
verses.textZhCuv: 境内剩下的人若还有十分之一， 也必被吞灭， 像栗树、橡树虽被砍伐， 树𣎴子却仍存留。 这圣洁的种类在国中也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: And though a tenth remains in the land, it will again be laid waste. But as the terebinth and oak leave stumps when they are cut down, so the holy seed will be the stump in the land."
verses.textEnEsv: And though a tenth remain in it, it will be burned again, like a terebinth or an oak, whose stump remains when it is felled." The holy seed is its stump.
verses.textEnNkjv: But yet a tenth willbe in it, And will return and be for consuming, As a terebinth tree or as an oak, Whose stump remains when it is cut down. So the holy seed shallbe its stump."
verses.textEnNlt: If even a tenth—a remnant—survive, it will be invaded again and burned. But as a terebinth or oak tree leaves a stump when it is cut down, so Israel’s stump will be a holy seed."
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet there will still be a tenth portion in it, And it will again be subject to burning, Like a terebinth or an oak Whose stump remains when it is cut down. The holy seed is its stump."
verses.textEn: And though a tenth remains in the land, it will again be laid waste. But as the terebinth and oak leave stumps when they are cut down, so the holy seed will be the stump in the land."

verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to make war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ahaz, son of Jotham and grandson of Uzziah, was king of Judah, King Rezin of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah, the king of Israel, set out to attack Jerusalem. However, they were unable to carry out their plan.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the days of Ahaz, the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Aram and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to wage war against it, but could not conquer it.
verses.textEn: When Ahaz son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was king of Judah, King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem, but they could not overpower it.

verses.textZhCnvs: 到那时，耶和华必发出哨声，把埃及河流尽头的苍蝇和亚述地的蜂子召来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，耶和华要发嘶声，使埃及江河源头的苍蝇和亚述地的蜂子飞来；
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord will whistle for flies from the Nile delta in Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord will whistle for the fly that is at the end of the streams of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass in that day That the Lord will whistle for the fly That is in the farthest part of the rivers of Egypt, And for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Lord will whistle for the army of southern Egypt and for the army of Assyria. They will swarm around you like flies and bees.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord will whistle for the fly that is in the remotest part of the canals of Egypt and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord will whistle for flies from the Nile delta in Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 牠们都必飞来，落在陡峭的山谷中、岩石的穴里、一切荆棘丛中和所有的草场上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们都必飞来，落在陡峭的山谷中、岩石的穴里、一切荆棘丛中和所有的草场上。
verses.textZhCuv: 都必飞来，落在荒凉的谷内、磐石的穴里，和一切荆棘篱笆中，并一切的草场上。
verses.textEnNiv: They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.
verses.textEnEsv: And they will all come and settle in the steep ravines, and in the clefts of the rocks, and on all the thornbushes, and on all the pastures.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will come, and all of them will rest In the desolate valleys and in the clefts of the rocks, And on all thorns and in all pastures.
verses.textEnNlt: They will come in vast hordes and settle in the fertile areas and also in the desolate valleys, caves, and thorny places.
verses.textEnNasb: They will all come and settle on the steep ravines, on the ledges of the cliffs, on all the thorn bushes, and on all the watering places.
verses.textEn: They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.

verses.textZh: 到那日，主必用大河那边租来的剃刀，就是亚述王，剃去你们的头发和脚上的毛，并且剃净你们的胡须。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，主必用大河那边租来的剃刀，就是亚述王，剃去你们的头发和脚上的毛，并且剃净你们的胡须。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，主必用大河外赁的剃头刀，就是亚述王，剃去头发和脚上的毛，并要剃净胡须。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates River—the king of Assyria—to shave your heads and private parts, and to cut off your beards also.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired beyond the River —with the king of Assyria—the head and the hair of the feet, and it will sweep away the beard also.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the same day the Lord will shave with a hired razor, With those from beyond the River, with the king of Assyria, The head and the hair of the legs, And will also remove the beard.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Lord will hire a "razor" from beyond the Euphrates River —the king of Assyria—and use it to shave off everything: your land, your crops, and your people.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord will shave with a razor, hired from regions beyond the Euphrates River (that is, with the king of Assyria), the head and the hair of the legs; and it will also remove the beard.
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates River—the king of Assyria—to shave your heads and private parts, and to cut off your beards also.

verses.textZh: 到那时，一个人只能养活一头母牛犊和两只母绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那时，一个人只能养活一头母牛犊和两只母绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，一个人要养活一只母牛犊，两只母绵羊；
verses.textEnNiv: In that day, a person will keep alive a young cow and two goats.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day a man will keep alive a young cow and two sheep,
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be in that day That a man will keep alive a young cow and two sheep;
verses.textEnNlt: In that day a farmer will be fortunate to have a cow and two sheep or goats left.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on that day a person may keep alive only a heifer and a pair of sheep;
verses.textEn: In that day, a person will keep alive a young cow and two goats.

verses.textZh: 因为出的奶多，他就可以吃乳酪；境内剩下的人，都要吃乳酪和蜂蜜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为出的奶多，他就可以吃乳酪；境内剩下的人，都要吃乳酪和蜂蜜。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境内所剩的人都要吃奶油与蜂蜜。
verses.textEnNiv: And because of the abundance of the milk they give, there will be curds to eat. All who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.
verses.textEnEsv: and because of the abundance of milk that they give, he will eat curds, for everyone who is left in the land will eat curds and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be, from the abundance of milk they give, That he will eat curds; For curds and honey everyone will eat who is left in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, there will be enough milk for everyone because so few people will be left in the land. They will eat their fill of yogurt and honey.
verses.textEnNasb: and because of the abundance of the milk produced he will eat curds, for everyone who is left within the land will eat curds and honey.
verses.textEn: And because of the abundance of the milk they give, there will be curds to eat. All who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.

verses.textZh: 到那日，从前种一千棵葡萄树，价值一万一千四百克银子的地方，现在却成为荆棘和蒺藜生长之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，从前种一千棵葡萄树，价值一万一千四百克银子的地方，现在却成为荆棘和蒺藜生长之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 「从前，凡种一千棵葡萄树、值银一千舍客勒的地方，到那时必长荆棘和蒺藜。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day every place where there used to be a thousand vines, worth a thousand shekels of silver, will become briers and thorns.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall happen in that day, That wherever there could be a thousand vines Worth a thousand shekels of silver, It will be for briers and thorns.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the lush vineyards, now worth 1,000 pieces of silver, will become patches of briers and thorns.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about on that day, that every place where there used to be a thousand vines, valued at a thousand shekels of silver, will become briars and thorns.
verses.textEn: In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.

verses.textZh: 人到那里去，必须携带弓和箭，因为遍地都是荆棘和蒺藜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人到那里去，必须携带弓和箭，因为遍地都是荆棘和蒺藜。
verses.textZhCuv: 人上那里去，必带弓箭，因为遍地满了荆棘和蒺藜。
verses.textEnNiv: Hunters will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.
verses.textEnEsv: With bow and arrows a man will come there, for all the land will be briers and thorns.
verses.textEnNkjv: With arrows and bows men will come there, Because all the land will become briers and thorns.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire land will become a vast expanse of briers and thorns, a hunting ground overrun by wildlife.
verses.textEnNasb: People will come there with bows and arrows, because all the land will be briars and thorns.
verses.textEn: Hunters will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.

verses.textZh: 以前所有用锄头挖掘的山地，你因为惧怕荆棘和蒺藜，都不敢上那里去；那里就成了放牛之地，羊群践踏之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以前所有用锄头挖掘的山地，你因为惧怕荆棘和蒺藜，都不敢上那里去；那里就成了放牛之地，羊群践踏之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有用锄刨挖的山地，你因怕荆棘和蒺藜，不敢上那里去；只可成了放牛之处，为羊践踏之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for all the hills that used to be hoed with a hoe, you will not come there for fear of briers and thorns, but they will become a place where cattle are let loose and where sheep tread.
verses.textEnNkjv: And to any hill which could be dug with the hoe, You will not go there for fear of briers and thorns; But it will become a range for oxen And a place for sheep to roam.
verses.textEnNlt: No one will go to the fertile hillsides where the gardens once grew, for briers and thorns will cover them. Cattle, sheep, and goats will graze there.
verses.textEnNasb: As for all the hills which used to be cultivated with the plow, you will not go there for fear of briars and thorns; but they will become a place for pasturing oxen and for sheep to trample.
verses.textEn: As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："你拿一块大版，用通用的文字写上‘玛黑珥．沙拉勒．哈施．罢斯’ 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："你拿一块大版，用通用的文字写上‘玛黑珥．沙拉勒．哈施．罢斯’ 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「你取一个大牌，拿人所用的笔 ，写上『玛黑珥‧沙拉勒‧哈施‧罢斯』 。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, "Take a large tablet and write on it in common characters, ‘Belonging to Maher-shalal-hash-baz.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Lord said to me, "Take a large scroll, and write on it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Make a large signboard and clearly write this name on it: Maher-shalal-hash-baz. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "Take for yourself a large tablet and write on it in ordinary letters: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz."

verses.textZh: 我要叫两个诚实的见证人，就是乌利亚祭司和耶比利家的儿子撒迦利亚，来为我作见证。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要叫两个诚实的见证人，就是乌利亚祭司和耶比利家的儿子撒迦利亚，来为我作见证。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要用诚实的见证人，祭司乌利亚和耶比利家的儿子撒迦利亚记录这事。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I called in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will get reliable witnesses, Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah, to attest for me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will take for Myself faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah."
verses.textEnNlt: I asked Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah, both known as honest men, to witness my doing this.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will take to Myself faithful witnesses for testimony, Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah."
verses.textEn: So I called in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me.

verses.textZh: 我亲近了女先知，就是我妻子，她就怀孕生子。耶和华对我说："给他起名叫‘玛黑珥．沙拉勒．哈施．罢斯’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲近了女先知，就是我妻子，她就怀孕生子。耶和华对我说："给他起名叫‘玛黑珥．沙拉勒．哈施．罢斯’，
verses.textZhCuv: 我－以赛亚与妻子 同室；她怀孕生子，耶和华就对我说：「给他起名叫玛黑珥‧沙拉勒‧哈施‧罢斯；
verses.textEnNiv: Then I made love to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said to me, "Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
verses.textEnEsv: And I went to the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son. Then the Lord said to me, "Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I went to the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son. Then the Lord said to me, "Call his name Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz;
verses.textEnNlt: Then I slept with my wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said, "Call him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.textEnNasb: So I approached the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. Then the Lord said to me, "Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz;
verses.textEn: Then I made love to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said to me, "Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

verses.textZh: 因为在这孩子晓得喊叫父母以先，大马士革的财宝和撒玛利亚的掳物，必在亚述王面前被搬了去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在这孩子晓得喊叫父母以先，大马士革的财宝和撒玛利亚的掳物，必在亚述王面前被搬了去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在这小孩子不晓得叫父叫母之先，大马士革的财宝和撒马利亚的掳物必在亚述王面前搬了去。」
verses.textEnNiv: For before the boy knows how to say ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria."
verses.textEnEsv: for before the boy knows how to cry ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria will be carried away before the king of Assyria."
verses.textEnNkjv: for before the child shall have knowledge to cry ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria will be taken away before the king of Assyria."
verses.textEnNlt: For before this child is old enough to say ‘Papa’ or ‘Mama,’ the king of Assyria will carry away both the abundance of Damascus and the riches of Samaria."
verses.textEnNasb: for before the boy knows how to cry out ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria will be carried away before the king of Assyria."
verses.textEn: For before the boy knows how to say ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria."

verses.textZh: 耶和华又再告诉我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又再告诉我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又晓谕我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord spoke to me again:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to me again:
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord also spoke to me again, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord spoke to me again and said,
verses.textEnNasb: Again the Lord spoke to me further, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord spoke to me again:

verses.textZh: "这子民既然厌弃了西罗亚缓流的水， 却喜悦利汛和利玛利的儿子，
verses.textZhCnvs: "这子民既然厌弃了西罗亚缓流的水， 却喜悦利汛和利玛利的儿子，
verses.textZhCuv: 「这百姓既厌弃西罗亚缓流的水，喜悦利汛和利玛利的儿子；
verses.textEnNiv: "Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
verses.textEnEsv: "Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and rejoice over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Inasmuch as these people refused The waters of Shiloah that flow softly, And rejoice in Rezin and in Remaliah’s son;
verses.textEnNlt: "My care for the people of Judah is like the gently flowing waters of Shiloah, but they have rejected it. They are rejoicing over what will happen to King Rezin and King Pekah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Inasmuch as these people have rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah And rejoice in Rezin and the son of Remaliah;
verses.textEn: "Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

verses.textZh: 因此，主必使大河又强又大的水临到他们， 就是亚述王和他一切威荣， 水必涨起来，高过所有的水道；水要泛滥，漫过所有的河岸；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主必使大河又强又大的水临到他们， 就是亚述王和他一切威荣， 水必涨起来，高过所有的水道；水要泛滥，漫过所有的河岸；
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，主必使大河翻腾的水猛然冲来，就是亚述王和他所有的威势，必漫过一切的水道，涨过两岸；
verses.textEnNiv: therefore the Lord is about to bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates— the king of Assyria with all his pomp. It will overflow all its channels, run over all its banks
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, the Lord is bringing up against them the waters of the River, mighty and many, the king of Assyria and all his glory. And it will rise over all its channels and go over all its banks,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord brings up over them The waters of the River, strong and mighty— The king of Assyria and all his glory; He will go up over all his channels And go over all his banks.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, the Lord will overwhelm them with a mighty flood from the Euphrates River —the king of Assyria and all his glory. This flood will overflow all its channels
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, behold, the Lord is about to bring on them the strong and abundant waters of the Euphrates River, That is, the king of Assyria and all his glory; And it will rise over all its channels and go over all its banks.
verses.textEn: therefore the Lord is about to bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates— the king of Assyria with all his pomp. It will overflow all its channels, run over all its banks

verses.textZh: 然后必冲入犹大，涨溢泛滥， 直到颈项， 以马内利啊！它展开的翅膀必遮遍你广阔的地土。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后必冲入犹大，涨溢泛滥， 直到颈项， 以马内利啊！它展开的翅膀必遮遍你广阔的地土。"
verses.textZhCuv: 必冲入犹大，涨溢氾滥，直到颈项。以马内利啊，他展开翅膀，遍满你的地。」
verses.textEnNiv: and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it, passing through it and reaching up to the neck. Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land, Immanuel !"
verses.textEnEsv: and it will sweep on into Judah, it will overflow and pass on, reaching even to the neck, and its outspread wings will fill the breadth of your land, O Immanuel."
verses.textEnNkjv: He will pass through Judah, He will overflow and pass over, He will reach up to the neck; And the stretching out of his wings Will fill the breadth of Your land, O Immanuel.
verses.textEnNlt: and sweep into Judah until it is chin deep. It will spread its wings, submerging your land from one end to the other, O Immanuel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it will sweep on into Judah, it will overflow and pass through, It will reach as far as the neck; And the spread of its wings will fill the expanse of your land, Immanuel.
verses.textEn: and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it, passing through it and reaching up to the neck. Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land, Immanuel !"

verses.textZh: 列国之民啊！你们尽管作恶，但你们终必毁灭！ 所有在远处的人民啊，要留心听！ 你们尽管束腰吧，你们终必毁灭！ 你们尽管束腰吧，你们终必毁灭！
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国之民啊！你们尽管作恶，但你们终必毁灭！ 所有在远处的人民啊，要留心听！ 你们尽管束腰吧，你们终必毁灭！ 你们尽管束腰吧，你们终必毁灭！
verses.textZhCuv: 列国的人民哪，任凭你们喧嚷，终必破坏； 远方的众人哪，当侧耳而听！ 任凭你们束起腰来，终必破坏； 你们束起腰来，终必破坏。
verses.textEnNiv: Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, and be shattered! Prepare for battle, and be shattered!
verses.textEnEsv: Be broken, you peoples, and be shattered; give ear, all you far countries; strap on your armor and be shattered; strap on your armor and be shattered.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Be shattered, O you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Give ear, all you from far countries. Gird yourselves, but be broken in pieces; Gird yourselves, but be broken in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: "Huddle together, you nations, and be terrified. Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, but you will be crushed! Yes, prepare for battle, but you will be crushed!
verses.textEnNasb: "Be broken, you peoples, and be shattered; And listen, all remote places of the earth. Get ready, yet be shattered; Get ready, yet be shattered.
verses.textEn: Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, and be shattered! Prepare for battle, and be shattered!

verses.textZh: 你们尽管计划阴谋吧，这些终必失败； 你们尽管提议吧，这些终必不能成立， 因为神与我们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们尽管计划阴谋吧，这些终必失败； 你们尽管提议吧，这些终必不能成立， 因为神与我们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 任凭你们同谋，终归无有； 任凭你们言定，终不成立； 因为神与我们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Devise your strategy, but it will be thwarted; propose your plan, but it will not stand, for God is with us.
verses.textEnEsv: Take counsel together, but it will come to nothing; speak a word, but it will not stand, for God is with us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take counsel together, but it will come to nothing; Speak the word, but it will not stand, For God is with us."
verses.textEnNlt: Call your councils of war, but they will be worthless. Develop your strategies, but they will not succeed. For God is with us! "
verses.textEnNasb: "Devise a plan, but it will fail; State a proposal, but it will not stand, For God is with us."
verses.textEn: Devise your strategy, but it will be thwarted; propose your plan, but it will not stand, for God is with us.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以大能的手托住我，教导我不要走这子民所走的道路；他对我这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以大能的手托住我，教导我不要走这子民所走的道路；他对我这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华以大能的手，指教我不可行这百姓所行的道，对我这样说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people:
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord spoke thus to me with his strong hand upon me, and warned me not to walk in the way of this people, saying:
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord spoke thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has given me a strong warning not to think like everyone else does. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: For so the Lord spoke to me with mighty power and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people:

verses.textZh: "这子民所称为阴谋的，你们都不要称为阴谋； 他们所怕的，你们不要怕，也不要畏惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这子民所称为阴谋的，你们都不要称为阴谋； 他们所怕的，你们不要怕，也不要畏惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这百姓说同谋背叛，你们不要说同谋背叛。他们所怕的，你们不要怕，也不要畏惧。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not call conspiracy everything this people calls a conspiracy; do not fear what they fear, and do not dread it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not call conspiracy all that this people calls conspiracy, and do not fear what they fear, nor be in dread.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not say, ‘A conspiracy,’ Concerning all that this people call a conspiracy, Nor be afraid of their threats, nor be troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t call everything a conspiracy, like they do, and don’t live in dread of what frightens them.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are not to say, ‘It is a conspiracy!’ Regarding everything that this people call a conspiracy, And you are not to fear what they fear or be in dread of it.
verses.textEn: "Do not call conspiracy everything this people calls a conspiracy; do not fear what they fear, and do not dread it.

verses.textZh: 你们要尊万军之耶和华为圣， 他是你们当怕的， 也是你们当畏惧的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要尊万军之耶和华为圣， 他是你们当怕的， 也是你们当畏惧的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但要尊万军之耶和华为圣，以他为你们所当怕的，所当畏惧的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy, he is the one you are to fear, he is the one you are to dread.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord of hosts, him you shall honor as holy. Let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts, Him you shall hallow; Let Him be your fear, And let Him be your dread.
verses.textEnNlt: Make the Lord of Heaven’s Armies holy in your life. He is the one you should fear. He is the one who should make you tremble.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is the Lord of armies whom you are to regard as holy. And He shall be your fear, And He shall be your dread.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy, he is the one you are to fear, he is the one you are to dread.

verses.textZh: 他必向信靠他的人作圣所， 却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头、跌人的盘石； 又向耶路撒冷的居民作陷阱和网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必向信靠他的人作圣所， 却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头、跌人的盘石； 又向耶路撒冷的居民作陷阱和网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必作为圣所，却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石；向耶路撒冷的居民作为圈套和网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: He will be a holy place; for both Israel and Judah he will be a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will become a sanctuary and a stone of offense and a rock of stumbling to both houses of Israel, a trap and a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
