verses.textEnNkjv: He will be as a sanctuary, But a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense To both the houses of Israel, As a trap and a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He will keep you safe. But to Israel and Judah he will be a stone that makes people stumble, a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then He will become a sanctuary; But to both houses of Israel, He will be a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense, And a snare and a trap for the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: He will be a holy place; for both Israel and Judah he will be a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.

verses.textZh: 许多人必在其上绊跌、仆倒、跌碎， 并且陷入网罗被捉住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人必在其上绊跌、仆倒、跌碎， 并且陷入网罗被捉住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 许多人必在其上绊脚跌倒，而且跌碎，并陷入网罗，被缠住。」
verses.textEnNiv: Many of them will stumble; they will fall and be broken, they will be snared and captured."
verses.textEnEsv: And many shall stumble on it. They shall fall and be broken; they shall be snared and taken."
verses.textEnNkjv: And many among them shall stumble; They shall fall and be broken, Be snared and taken."
verses.textEnNlt: Many will stumble and fall, never to rise again. They will be snared and captured."
verses.textEnNasb: "Many will stumble over them, Then they will fall and be broken; They will be snared and caught."
verses.textEn: Many of them will stumble; they will fall and be broken, they will be snared and captured."

verses.textZh: 你要卷起律法书，在我的门徒中间封住训诲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要卷起律法书，在我的门徒中间封住训诲。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要卷起律法书，在我门徒中间封住训诲。
verses.textEnNiv: Bind up this testimony of warning and seal up God’s instruction among my disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: Bind up the testimony; seal the teaching among my disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bind up the testimony, Seal the law among my disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: Preserve the teaching of God; entrust his instructions to those who follow me.
verses.textEnNasb: Bind up the testimony, seal the Law among my disciples.
verses.textEn: Bind up this testimony of warning and seal up God’s instruction among my disciples.

verses.textZh: 我要等候那掩面不顾雅各家的耶和华，我要仰视他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要等候那掩面不顾雅各家的耶和华，我要仰视他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要等候那掩面不顾雅各家的耶和华；我也要仰望他。
verses.textEnNiv: I will wait for the Lord , who is hiding his face from the descendants of Jacob. I will put my trust in him.
verses.textEnEsv: I will wait for the Lord , who is hiding his face from the house of Jacob, and I will hope in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will wait on the Lord, Who hides His face from the house of Jacob; And I will hope in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will wait for the Lord , who has turned away from the descendants of Jacob. I will put my hope in him.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will wait for the Lord who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob; I will wait eagerly for Him.
verses.textEn: I will wait for the Lord , who is hiding his face from the descendants of Jacob. I will put my trust in him.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我和耶和华赐给我的孩子，在以色列中作预兆与奇迹，都是从住在锡安山的万军之耶和华来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我和耶和华赐给我的孩子，在以色列中作预兆与奇迹，都是从住在锡安山的万军之耶和华来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我与耶和华所给我的儿女，就是从住在锡安山万军之耶和华来的，在以色列中作为预兆和奇迹。
verses.textEnNiv: Here am I, and the children the Lord has given me. We are signs and symbols in Israel from the Lord Almighty, who dwells on Mount Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord has given me are signs and portents in Israel from the Lord of hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Here am I and the children whom the Lord has given me! We are for signs and wonders in Israel From the Lord of hosts, Who dwells in Mount Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: I and the children the Lord has given me serve as signs and warnings to Israel from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies who dwells in his Temple on Mount Zion.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord has given me are for signs and wonders in Israel from the Lord of armies, who dwells on Mount Zion.
verses.textEn: Here am I, and the children the Lord has given me. We are signs and symbols in Israel from the Lord Almighty, who dwells on Mount Zion.

verses.textZh: 有人对你们说："要求问那些交鬼的和行巫术的，就是那些喃喃细语的人。"一族之民不应当求问自己的神吗？他们怎能为活人求问死人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人对你们说："要求问那些交鬼的和行巫术的，就是那些喃喃细语的人。"一族之民不应当求问自己的神吗？他们怎能为活人求问死人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 有人对你们说：「当求问那些交鬼的和行巫术的，就是声音绵蛮，言语微细的。」你们便回答说：「百姓不当求问自己的神吗？岂可为活人求问死人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When someone tells you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.textEnEsv: And when they say to you, "Inquire of the mediums and the necromancers who chirp and mutter," should not a people inquire of their God? Should they inquire of the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they say to you, "Seek those who are mediums and wizards, who whisper and mutter," should not a people seek their God? Shouldthey seek the dead on behalf of the living?
verses.textEnNlt: Someone may say to you, "Let’s ask the mediums and those who consult the spirits of the dead. With their whisperings and mutterings, they will tell us what to do." But shouldn’t people ask God for guidance? Should the living seek guidance from the dead?
verses.textEnNasb: When they say to you, "Consult the mediums and the spiritists who whisper and mutter," should a people not consult their God? Should they consult the dead in behalf of the living?
verses.textEn: When someone tells you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?

verses.textZh: 他们应当求问神的训诲和法度；他们若不照着这些准则说话，就见不到曙光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们应当求问神的训诲和法度；他们若不照着这些准则说话，就见不到曙光。
verses.textZhCuv: 人当以训诲和法度为标准；他们所说的，若不与此相符，必不得见晨光。
verses.textEnNiv: Consult God’s instruction and the testimony of warning. If anyone does not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
verses.textEnEsv: To the teaching and to the testimony! If they will not speak according to this word, it is because they have no dawn.
verses.textEnNkjv: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, itis because there is no light in them.
verses.textEnNlt: Look to God’s instructions and teachings! People who contradict his word are completely in the dark.
verses.textEnNasb: To the Law and to the testimony! If they do not speak in accordance with this word, it is because they have no dawn.
verses.textEn: Consult God’s instruction and the testimony of warning. If anyone does not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.

verses.textZh: 他们必经过这地，受困迫、受饥饿；他们饥饿的时候，就恼怒，咒骂自己的王和自己的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必经过这地，受困迫、受饥饿；他们饥饿的时候，就恼怒，咒骂自己的王和自己的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必经过这地，受艰难，受饥饿；饥饿的时候，心中焦躁，咒骂自己的君王和自己的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.
verses.textEnEsv: They will pass through the land, greatly distressed and hungry. And when they are hungry, they will be enraged and will speak contemptuously against their king and their God, and turn their faces upward.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will pass through it hard-pressed and hungry; and it shall happen, when they are hungry, that they will be enraged and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
verses.textEnNlt: They will go from one place to another, weary and hungry. And because they are hungry, they will rage and curse their king and their God. They will look up to heaven
verses.textEnNasb: They will pass through the land dejected and hungry, and it will turn out that when they are hungry, they will become enraged and curse their king and their God as they face upward.
verses.textEn: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.

verses.textZh: 他们仰脸向天观望，又俯视大地，只见困苦、黑暗、可怕的幽暗；他们必被赶入幽黑的黑暗中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们仰脸向天观望，又俯视大地，只见困苦、黑暗、可怕的幽暗；他们必被赶入幽黑的黑暗中。
verses.textZhCuv: 仰观上天，俯察下地，不料，尽是艰难、黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。他们必被赶入乌黑的黑暗中去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: And they will look to the earth, but behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish. And they will be thrust into thick darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will look to the earth, and see trouble and darkness, gloom of anguish; and theywillbe driven into darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: and down at the earth, but wherever they look, there will be trouble and anguish and dark despair. They will be thrown out into the darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will look to the earth, and behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and they will be driven away into darkness.
verses.textEn: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.

verses.textZh: 但那受过困苦的，必不再见幽暗。以前神使西布伦和拿弗他利地被轻视，日后却要使它们在沿海之路、约旦河外和外族人的加利利，得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那受过困苦的，必不再见幽暗。以前神使西布伦和拿弗他利地被轻视，日后却要使它们在沿海之路、约旦河外和外族人的加利利，得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那受过痛苦的必不再见幽暗。 从前神使西布伦地和拿弗他利地被藐视，末后却使这沿海的路，约旦河外，外邦人的加利利地得着荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the nations, by the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan—
verses.textEnEsv: But there will be no gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the latter time he has made glorious the way of the sea, the land beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the gloom will not be upon her who is distressed, As when at first He lightly esteemed The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, And afterward more heavily oppressed her, By the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, In Galilee of the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, that time of darkness and despair will not go on forever. The land of Zebulun and Naphtali will be humbled, but there will be a time in the future when Galilee of the Gentiles, which lies along the road that runs between the Jordan and the sea, will be filled with glory.
verses.textEnNasb: But there will be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In earlier times He treated the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali with contempt, but later on He will make it glorious, by the way of the sea, on the other side of the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the nations, by the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan—

verses.textZh: 行在黑暗中的人民， 看见了大光； 住在死荫之地的人， 有光照耀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行在黑暗中的人民， 看见了大光； 住在死荫之地的人， 有光照耀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在黑暗中行走的百姓看见了大光； 住在死荫之地的人有光照耀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of deep darkness a light has dawned.
verses.textEnEsv: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light; those who dwelt in a land of deep darkness, on them has light shone.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people who walked in darkness Have seen a great light; Those who dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, Upon them a light has shined.
verses.textEnNlt: The people who walk in darkness will see a great light. For those who live in a land of deep darkness, a light will shine.
verses.textEnNasb: The people who walk in darkness Will see a great light; Those who live in a dark land, The light will shine on them.
verses.textEn: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of deep darkness a light has dawned.

verses.textZh: 你使这国之民增多， 又加添他们的欢乐； 他们在你面前欢乐， 好象收割时的欢乐一样； 又像人在均分战利品时的快乐一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使这国之民增多， 又加添他们的欢乐； 他们在你面前欢乐， 好象收割时的欢乐一样； 又像人在均分战利品时的快乐一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使这国民繁多， 加增他们的喜乐； 他们在你面前欢喜， 好像收割的欢喜， 像人分掳物那样的快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: You have enlarged the nation and increased their joy; they rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest, as warriors rejoice when dividing the plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: You have multiplied the nation; you have increased its joy; they rejoice before you as with joy at the harvest, as they are glad when they divide the spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have multiplied the nation And increased its joy; They rejoice before You According to the joy of harvest, As men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.textEnNlt: You will enlarge the nation of Israel, and its people will rejoice. They will rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest and like warriors dividing the plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: You will multiply the nation, You will increase their joy; They will rejoice in Your presence As with the joy of harvest, As people rejoice when they divide the spoils.
verses.textEn: You have enlarged the nation and increased their joy; they rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest, as warriors rejoice when dividing the plunder.

verses.textZh: 因为他们所负的轭和肩头上的杖，以及欺压他们的人的棍，你都折断了，像在米甸的日子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们所负的轭和肩头上的杖，以及欺压他们的人的棍，你都折断了，像在米甸的日子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们所负的重轭 和肩头上的杖， 并欺压他们人的棍， 你都已经折断， 好像在米甸的日子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: For as in the day of Midian’s defeat, you have shattered the yoke that burdens them, the bar across their shoulders, the rod of their oppressor.
verses.textEnEsv: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff for his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as on the day of Midian.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have broken the yoke of his burden And the staff of his shoulder, The rod of his oppressor, As in the day of Midian.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will break the yoke of their slavery and lift the heavy burden from their shoulders. You will break the oppressor’s rod, just as you did when you destroyed the army of Midian.
verses.textEnNasb: For You will break the yoke of their burden and the staff on their shoulders, The rod of their oppressor, as at the battle of Midian.
verses.textEn: For as in the day of Midian’s defeat, you have shattered the yoke that burdens them, the bar across their shoulders, the rod of their oppressor.

verses.textZh: 因为战士在战争喧嚷中所穿的靴，和辊在血中的袍，都必烧毁，成了烧火的燃料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为战士在战争喧嚷中所穿的靴，和辊在血中的袍，都必烧毁，成了烧火的燃料。
verses.textZhCuv: 战士在乱杀之间所穿戴的盔甲， 并那滚在血中的衣服， 都必作为可烧的， 当作火柴。
verses.textEnNiv: Every warrior’s boot used in battle and every garment rolled in blood will be destined for burning, will be fuel for the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: For every boot of the tramping warrior in battle tumult and every garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: For every warrior’s sandal from the noisy battle, And garments rolled in blood, Will be used for burning and fuel of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The boots of the warrior and the uniforms bloodstained by war will all be burned. They will be fuel for the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: For every boot of the marching warrior in the roar of battle, And cloak rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
verses.textEn: Every warrior’s boot used in battle and every garment rolled in blood will be destined for burning, will be fuel for the fire.

verses.textZh: 因为有一个婴孩为我们而生，有一个儿子赐给我们； 政权必担在他的肩头上； 他的名必称为"奇妙的策士、全能的神、永恒的父、和平的君"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有一个婴孩为我们而生，有一个儿子赐给我们； 政权必担在他的肩头上； 他的名必称为"奇妙的策士、全能的神、永恒的父、和平的君"。
verses.textZhCuv: 因有一婴孩为我们而生； 有一子赐给我们。 政权必担在他的肩头上； 他名称为「奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君」。
verses.textEnNiv: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.textEnEsv: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder, and his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: For unto us a Child is born, Unto us a Son is given; And the government will be upon His shoulder. And His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.textEnNlt: For a child is born to us, a son is given to us. The government will rest on his shoulders. And he will be called: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.textEnNasb: For a Child will be born to us, a Son will be given to us; And the government will rest on His shoulders; And His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Eternal Father, Prince of Peace.
verses.textEn: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

verses.textZh: 他的政权与平安必无穷无尽地增加， 他在大卫的宝座上治理他的国， 以公平和公义使国坚立稳固， 从现在直到永远。 万军之耶和华的热心必成全这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的政权与平安必无穷无尽地增加， 他在大卫的宝座上治理他的国， 以公平和公义使国坚立稳固， 从现在直到永远。 万军之耶和华的热心必成全这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的政权与平安必加增无穷。 他必在大卫的宝座上治理他的国， 以公平公义使国坚定稳固， 从今直到永远。 万军之耶和华的热心必成就这事。
verses.textEnNiv: Of the greatness of his government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on David’s throne and over his kingdom, establishing and upholding it with justice and righteousness from that time on and forever. The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the increase of his government and of peace there will be no end, on the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish it and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from this time forth and forevermore. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the increase of His government and peace Therewillbe no end, Upon the throne of David and over His kingdom, To order it and establish it with judgment and justice From that time forward, even forever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.
verses.textEnNlt: His government and its peace will never end. He will rule with fairness and justice from the throne of his ancestor David for all eternity. The passionate commitment of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will make this happen!
verses.textEnNasb: There will be no end to the increase of His government or of peace On the throne of David and over his kingdom, To establish it and to uphold it with justice and righteousness From then on and forevermore. The zeal of the Lord of armies will accomplish this.
verses.textEn: Of the greatness of his government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on David’s throne and over his kingdom, establishing and upholding it with justice and righteousness from that time on and forever. The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.

verses.textZh: 主发出一个信息攻击雅各家， 信息落在以色列家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主发出一个信息攻击雅各家， 信息落在以色列家。
verses.textZhCuv: 主使一言入于雅各家， 落于以色列家。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob; it will fall on Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has sent a word against Jacob, and it will fall on Israel;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord sent a word against Jacob, And it has fallen on Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has spoken out against Jacob; his judgment has fallen upon Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord sends a message against Jacob, And it falls on Israel.
verses.textEn: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob; it will fall on Israel.

verses.textZh: 所有的人民，就是以法莲和撒玛利亚的居民， 都要知道这事； 他们凭着骄傲和自大的心说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的人民，就是以法莲和撒玛利亚的居民， 都要知道这事； 他们凭着骄傲和自大的心说：
verses.textZhCuv: 这众百姓，就是以法莲 和撒马利亚的居民，都要知道； 他们凭骄傲自大的心说：
verses.textEnNiv: All the people will know it— Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria— who say with pride and arrogance of heart,
verses.textEnEsv: and all the people will know, Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart:
verses.textEnNkjv: All the people will know— Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria— Who say in pride and arrogance of heart:
verses.textEnNlt: And the people of Israel and Samaria, who spoke with such pride and arrogance, will soon know it.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people know it, That is, Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, Asserting in pride and in arrogance of heart:
verses.textEn: All the people will know it— Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria— who say with pride and arrogance of heart,

verses.textZh: "砖墙倒塌了， 我们就用凿好的石头来建筑； 桑树砍倒了， 我们就用香柏树替换。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "砖墙倒塌了， 我们就用凿好的石头来建筑； 桑树砍倒了， 我们就用香柏树替换。"
verses.textZhCuv: 砖墙塌了，我们却要凿石头建筑； 桑树砍了，我们却要换香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: "The bricks have fallen down, but we will rebuild with dressed stone; the fig trees have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars."
verses.textEnEsv: "The bricks have fallen, but we will build with dressed stones; the sycamores have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place."
verses.textEnNkjv: "The bricks have fallen down, But we will rebuild with hewn stones; The sycamores are cut down, But we will replace them with cedars."
verses.textEnNlt: They said, "We will replace the broken bricks of our ruins with finished stone, and replant the felled sycamore-fig trees with cedars."
verses.textEnNasb: "The bricks have fallen down, But we will rebuild with smooth stones; The sycamores have been cut down, But we will replace them with cedars."
verses.textEn: "The bricks have fallen down, but we will rebuild with dressed stone; the fig trees have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars."

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华必兴起利汛的敌人来攻击以色列， 并且要激动以色列的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华必兴起利汛的敌人来攻击以色列， 并且要激动以色列的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，耶和华要高举利汛的敌人 来攻击以色列， 并要激动以色列的仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord has strengthened Rezin’s foes against them and has spurred their enemies on.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord raises the adversaries of Rezin against him, and stirs up his enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord shall set up The adversaries of Rezin against him, And spur his enemies on,
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord will bring Rezin’s enemies against Israel and stir up all their foes.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord raises superior adversaries against them from Rezin And provokes their enemies,
verses.textEn: But the Lord has strengthened Rezin’s foes against them and has spurred their enemies on.

verses.textZh: 东有亚兰人，西有非利士人； 他们张开口来要吞灭以色列。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东有亚兰人，西有非利士人； 他们张开口来要吞灭以色列。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCuv: 东有亚兰人，西有非利士人； 他们张口要吞吃以色列。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
verses.textEnNiv: Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west have devoured Israel with open mouth. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
verses.textEnEsv: The Syrians on the east and the Philistines on the west devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Syrians before and the Philistines behind; And they shall devour Israel with an open mouth. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNlt: The Syrians from the east and the Philistines from the west will bare their fangs and devour Israel. But even then the Lord ’s anger will not be satisfied. His fist is still poised to strike.
verses.textEnNasb: The Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west; And they devour Israel with gaping jaws. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away, And His hand is still stretched out.
verses.textEn: Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west have devoured Israel with open mouth. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

verses.textZh: 这人民还没有回转、归向那击打他们的万军之耶和华， 也没有寻求他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人民还没有回转、归向那击打他们的万军之耶和华， 也没有寻求他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这百姓还没有归向击打他们的主， 也没有寻求万军之耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: But the people have not returned to him who struck them, nor have they sought the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: The people did not turn to him who struck them, nor inquire of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the people do not turn to Him who strikes them, Nor do they seek the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: For after all this punishment, the people will still not repent. They will not seek the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the people do not turn back to Him who struck them, Nor do they seek the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: But the people have not returned to him who struck them, nor have they sought the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华在一日之间，必从以色列中剪除头和尾、棕枝与芦苇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华在一日之间，必从以色列中剪除头和尾、棕枝与芦苇。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，耶和华一日之间 必从以色列中剪除头与尾， 棕枝与芦苇－
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord will cut off from Israel both head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day;
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed in one day—
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord will cut off head and tail from Israel, Palm branch and bulrush in one day.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, in a single day the Lord will destroy both the head and the tail, the noble palm branch and the lowly reed.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord cuts off head and tail from Israel, Both palm branch and bulrush in a single day.
verses.textEn: So the Lord will cut off from Israel both head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day;

verses.textZh: 长老和尊贵人就是头； 用谎言教导人的先知就是尾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 长老和尊贵人就是头； 用谎言教导人的先知就是尾。
verses.textZhCuv: 长老和尊贵人就是头， 以谎言教人的先知就是尾。
verses.textEnNiv: the elders and dignitaries are the head, the prophets who teach lies are the tail.
verses.textEnEsv: the elder and honored man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail;
verses.textEnNkjv: The elder and honorable, he is the head; The prophet who teaches lies, he is the tail.
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of Israel are the head, and the lying prophets are the tail.
verses.textEnNasb: The head is the elder and esteemed man, And the prophet who teaches falsehood is the tail.
verses.textEn: the elders and dignitaries are the head, the prophets who teach lies are the tail.

verses.textZh: 因为那些领导这人民的，使他们走错了路； 那些被领导的，都必一片混乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那些领导这人民的，使他们走错了路； 那些被领导的，都必一片混乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，引导这百姓的使他们走错了路； 被引导的都必败亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who guide this people mislead them, and those who are guided are led astray.
verses.textEnEsv: for those who guide this people have been leading them astray, and those who are guided by them are swallowed up.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the leaders of this people cause them to err, And thosewhoare led by them are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: For the leaders of the people have misled them. They have led them down the path of destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who guide this people are leading them astray; And those who are guided by them are confused.
verses.textEn: Those who guide this people mislead them, and those who are guided are led astray.

verses.textZh: 因此，主不喜欢他们的年轻人， 也不怜恤他们的孤儿寡妇； 因为他们各人都是不敬虔的，是邪恶的， 各人的口都说愚昧的话。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主不喜欢他们的年轻人， 也不怜恤他们的孤儿寡妇； 因为他们各人都是不敬虔的，是邪恶的， 各人的口都说愚昧的话。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主必不喜悦他们的少年人， 也不怜恤他们的孤儿寡妇； 因为，各人是亵渎的，是行恶的， 并且各人的口都说愚妄的话。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men, nor will he pity the fatherless and widows, for everyone is ungodly and wicked, every mouth speaks folly. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord does not rejoice over their young men, and has no compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is godless and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord will have no joy in their young men, Nor have mercy on their fatherless and widows; For everyone is a hypocrite and an evildoer, And every mouth speaks folly. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord takes no pleasure in the young men and shows no mercy even to the widows and orphans. For they are all wicked hypocrites, and they all speak foolishness. But even then the Lord ’s anger will not be satisfied. His fist is still poised to strike.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord does not rejoice over their young men, Nor does He have compassion on their orphans or their widows; For every one of them is godless and an evildoer, And every mouth is speaking foolishness. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away, And His hand is still stretched out.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men, nor will he pity the fatherless and widows, for everyone is ungodly and wicked, every mouth speaks folly. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

verses.textZh: 邪恶像火一般焚烧， 吞灭荆棘蒺藜， 连树林中的密丛也烧起火来， 它们旋转上腾，成了烟柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 邪恶像火一般焚烧， 吞灭荆棘蒺藜， 连树林中的密丛也烧起火来， 它们旋转上腾，成了烟柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 邪恶像火焚烧， 烧灭荆棘和蒺藜， 在稠密的树林中着起来， 就成为烟柱，旋转上腾。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes briers and thorns, it sets the forest thickets ablaze, so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.
verses.textEnEsv: For wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes briers and thorns; it kindles the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: For wickedness burns as the fire; It shall devour the briers and thorns, And kindle in the thickets of the forest; They shall mount up like rising smoke.
verses.textEnNlt: This wickedness is like a brushfire. It burns not only briers and thorns but also sets the forests ablaze. Its burning sends up clouds of smoke.
verses.textEnNasb: For wickedness burns like a fire; It consumes briars and thorns; It also sets the thickets of the forest aflame And they roll upward in a column of smoke.
verses.textEn: Surely wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes briers and thorns, it sets the forest thickets ablaze, so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.

verses.textZh: 因着万军之耶和华的烈怒，地被烧毁， 人民成了烧火的燃料一般， 没有人顾惜自己的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着万军之耶和华的烈怒，地被烧毁， 人民成了烧火的燃料一般， 没有人顾惜自己的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 因万军之耶和华的烈怒，地都烧遍； 百姓成为火柴； 无人怜爱弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: By the wrath of the Lord Almighty the land will be scorched and the people will be fuel for the fire; they will not spare one another.
verses.textEnEsv: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts the land is scorched, and the people are like fuel for the fire; no one spares another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts The land is burned up, And the people shall be as fuel for the fire; No man shall spare his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: The land will be blackened by the fury of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. The people will be fuel for the fire, and no one will spare even his own brother.
verses.textEnNasb: By the wrath of the Lord of armies the land is burned, And the people are like fuel for the fire; No one spares his brother.
verses.textEn: By the wrath of the Lord Almighty the land will be scorched and the people will be fuel for the fire; they will not spare one another.

verses.textZh: 有人在右边切肉，仍然饥饿； 在左边吞吃，仍然不饱足； 各人竟吃自己手臂的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人在右边切肉，仍然饥饿； 在左边吞吃，仍然不饱足； 各人竟吃自己手臂的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人右边抢夺，仍受饥饿， 左边吞吃，仍不饱足； 各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: On the right they will devour, but still be hungry; on the left they will eat, but not be satisfied. Each will feed on the flesh of their own offspring :
verses.textEnEsv: They slice meat on the right, but are still hungry, and they devour on the left, but are not satisfied; each devours the flesh of his own arm,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall snatch on the right hand And be hungry; He shall devour on the left hand And not be satisfied; Every man shall eat the flesh of his own arm.
verses.textEnNlt: They will attack their neighbor on the right but will still be hungry. They will devour their neighbor on the left but will not be satisfied. In the end they will even eat their own children.
verses.textEnNasb: They devour what is on the right hand but are still hungry, And they eat what is on the left hand, but they are not satisfied; Each of them eats the flesh of his own arm.
verses.textEn: On the right they will devour, but still be hungry; on the left they will eat, but not be satisfied. Each will feed on the flesh of their own offspring :

verses.textZh: 玛拿西吞吃以法莲，以法莲吞吃玛拿西，又一起攻击犹大。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西吞吃以法莲，以法莲吞吃玛拿西，又一起攻击犹大。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西吞吃 以法莲； 以法莲吞吃玛拿西， 又一同攻击犹大。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
verses.textEnNiv: Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, and Ephraim on Manasseh; together they will turn against Judah. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
verses.textEnEsv: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim devours Manasseh; together they are against Judah. For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNkjv: Manasseh shalldevour Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; Together they shallbe against Judah. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, Ephraim will feed on Manasseh, and both will devour Judah. But even then the Lord ’s anger will not be satisfied. His fist is still poised to strike.
verses.textEnNasb: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh, And together they are against Judah. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away And His hand is still stretched out.
verses.textEn: Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, and Ephraim on Manasseh; together they will turn against Judah. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

verses.textZh: 那些制定奸恶律例的， 和那些记录诡诈判语的，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些制定奸恶律例的， 和那些记录诡诈判语的，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些设立不义之律例的 和记录奸诈之判语的，
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who make unjust laws, to those who issue oppressive decrees,
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who decree iniquitous decrees, and the writers who keep writing oppression,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, Who write misfortune, Which they have prescribed
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits the unjust judges and those who issue unfair laws.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who enact unjust statutes And to those who constantly record harmful decisions,
verses.textEn: Woe to those who make unjust laws, to those who issue oppressive decrees,

verses.textZh: 他们想藉此屈枉穷乏人的公义， 剥夺我子民中困苦人的权利， 使寡妇作了他们的掠物， 使孤儿作了他们的掳物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们想藉此屈枉穷乏人的公义， 剥夺我子民中困苦人的权利， 使寡妇作了他们的掠物， 使孤儿作了他们的掳物。
verses.textZhCuv: 为要屈枉穷乏人， 夺去我民中困苦人的理， 以寡妇当作掳物， 以孤儿当作掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: to deprive the poor of their rights and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people, making widows their prey and robbing the fatherless.
verses.textEnEsv: to turn aside the needy from justice and to rob the poor of my people of their right, that widows may be their spoil, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
verses.textEnNkjv: To rob the needy of justice, And to take what is right from the poor of My people, That widows may be their prey, And that they may rob the fatherless.
verses.textEnNlt: They deprive the poor of justice and deny the rights of the needy among my people. They prey on widows and take advantage of orphans.
verses.textEnNasb: So as to deprive the needy of justice And rob the poor among My people of their rights, So that widows may be their spoil And that they may plunder the orphans.
verses.textEn: to deprive the poor of their rights and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people, making widows their prey and robbing the fatherless.

verses.textZh: 到降罚的日子，有灾祸从远方来到， 那时你们要怎样行呢？ 你们可以向谁逃奔求助呢？ 你们可以把你们的财宝撇在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 到降罚的日子，有灾祸从远方来到， 那时你们要怎样行呢？ 你们可以向谁逃奔求助呢？ 你们可以把你们的财宝撇在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 到降罚的日子，有灾祸从远方临到， 那时，你们怎样行呢？ 你们向谁逃奔求救呢？ 你们的荣耀 存留何处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What will you do on the day of reckoning, when disaster comes from afar? To whom will you run for help? Where will you leave your riches?
verses.textEnEsv: What will you do on the day of punishment, in the ruin that will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your wealth?
verses.textEnNkjv: What will you do in the day of punishment, And in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your glory?
verses.textEnNlt: What will you do when I punish you, when I send disaster upon you from a distant land? To whom will you turn for help? Where will your treasures be safe?
verses.textEnNasb: Now what will you do in the day of punishment, And in the devastation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your wealth?
verses.textEn: What will you do on the day of reckoning, when disaster comes from afar? To whom will you run for help? Where will you leave your riches?

verses.textZh: 你们只能屈身在被掳的人中间， 或是仆倒在被杀的人中间。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们只能屈身在被掳的人中间， 或是仆倒在被杀的人中间。 虽然这样，耶和华的怒气还没有转消， 他的手仍然伸出。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们只得屈身在被掳的人以下， 仆倒在被杀的人以下。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing will remain but to cringe among the captives or fall among the slain. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
verses.textEnEsv: Nothing remains but to crouch among the prisoners or fall among the slain. For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNkjv: Without Me they shall bow down among the prisoners, And they shall fall among the slain." For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.textEnNlt: You will stumble along as prisoners or lie among the dead. But even then the Lord ’s anger will not be satisfied. His fist is still poised to strike.
verses.textEnNasb: Nothing remains but to crouch among the captives Or fall among those killed. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away And His hand is still stretched out.
verses.textEn: Nothing will remain but to cringe among the captives or fall among the slain. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

verses.textZh: 亚述啊！我怒气的棍子，有祸了。 他们手中拿着我忿怒的杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述啊！我怒气的棍子，有祸了。 他们手中拿着我忿怒的杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述是我怒气的棍， 手中拿我恼恨的杖。
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to the Assyrian, the rod of my anger, in whose hand is the club of my wrath!
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to Assyria, the rod of my anger; the staff in their hands is my fury!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger And the staff in whose hand is My indignation.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits Assyria, the rod of my anger. I use it as a club to express my anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger And the staff in whose hands is My indignation,
verses.textEn: "Woe to the Assyrian, the rod of my anger, in whose hand is the club of my wrath!

verses.textZh: 我要差派他去攻击一个不敬虔的国， 吩咐他去攻击我恼怒的子民， 掳去掠物，抢夺掳物， 把他们践踏，像街上的泥土一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要差派他去攻击一个不敬虔的国， 吩咐他去攻击我恼怒的子民， 掳去掠物，抢夺掳物， 把他们践踏，像街上的泥土一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要打发他攻击亵渎的国民， 吩咐他攻击我所恼怒的百姓， 抢财为掳物，夺货为掠物， 将他们践踏，像街上的泥土一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I send him against a godless nation, I dispatch him against a people who anger me, to seize loot and snatch plunder, and to trample them down like mud in the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to take spoil and seize plunder, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will send him against an ungodly nation, And against the people of My wrath I will give him charge, To seize the spoil, to take the prey, And to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.textEnNlt: I am sending Assyria against a godless nation, against a people with whom I am angry. Assyria will plunder them, trampling them like dirt beneath its feet.
verses.textEnNasb: I send it against a godless nation And commission it against the people of My fury To capture spoils and to seize plunder, And to trample them down like mud in the streets.
verses.textEn: I send him against a godless nation, I dispatch him against a people who anger me, to seize loot and snatch plunder, and to trample them down like mud in the streets.

verses.textZh: 但亚述并没有这样想过， 他心里也没有这样打算； 他心里倒想毁灭、 剪除多国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但亚述并没有这样想过， 他心里也没有这样打算； 他心里倒想毁灭、 剪除多国。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，他不是这样的意思； 他心也不这样打算。 他心里倒想毁灭， 剪除不少的国。
verses.textEnNiv: But this is not what he intends, this is not what he has in mind; his purpose is to destroy, to put an end to many nations.
verses.textEnEsv: But he does not so intend, and his heart does not so think; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off nations not a few;
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet he does not mean so, Nor does his heart think so; But itis in his heart to destroy, And cut off not a few nations.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king of Assyria will not understand that he is my tool; his mind does not work that way. His plan is simply to destroy, to cut down nation after nation.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet it does not so intend, Nor does it plan so in its heart, But rather it is its purpose to destroy And to eliminate many nations.
verses.textEn: But this is not what he intends, this is not what he has in mind; his purpose is to destroy, to put an end to many nations.

verses.textZh: 因为他说："在我手下的众领袖不都是王吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他说："在我手下的众领袖不都是王吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：我的臣仆岂不都是王吗？
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Are not my commanders all kings?’ he says.
verses.textEnEsv: for he says: "Are not my commanders all kings?
verses.textEnNkjv: For he says, ‘Are not my princes altogether kings?
verses.textEnNlt: He will say, ‘Each of my princes will soon be a king.
verses.textEnNasb: For it says, "Are not my officers all kings?
verses.textEn: ‘Are not my commanders all kings?’ he says.

verses.textZh: 迦勒挪不是像迦基米施吗？ 哈玛不是像亚珥拔吗？ 撒玛利亚不是像大马士革吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒挪不是像迦基米施吗？ 哈玛不是像亚珥拔吗？ 撒玛利亚不是像大马士革吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒挪岂不像迦基米施吗？ 哈马岂不像亚珥拔吗？ 撒马利亚岂不像大马士革吗？
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Has not Kalno fared like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad, and Samaria like Damascus?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
verses.textEnNlt: We destroyed Calno just as we did Carchemish. Hamath fell before us as Arpad did. And we destroyed Samaria just as we did Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is not Calno like Carchemish, Or Hamath like Arpad, Or Samaria like Damascus?
verses.textEn: ‘Has not Kalno fared like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad, and Samaria like Damascus?

verses.textZh: 我的手伸展到这些充满偶像的国， 他们雕刻的像比耶路撒冷和撒玛利亚的还多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的手伸展到这些充满偶像的国， 他们雕刻的像比耶路撒冷和撒玛利亚的还多。
verses.textZhCuv: 我手已经搆到有偶像的国； 这些国雕刻的偶像 过于耶路撒冷和撒马利亚的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: As my hand seized the kingdoms of the idols, kingdoms whose images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria—
verses.textEnEsv: As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols, whose carved images were greater than those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
verses.textEnNkjv: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, Whose carved images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, we have finished off many a kingdom whose gods were greater than those in Jerusalem and Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: "As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols, Whose carved images were greater than those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
verses.textEn: As my hand seized the kingdoms of the idols, kingdoms whose images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria—

verses.textZh: 我怎样对待撒玛利亚和其中的偶像， 不也照样对待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我怎样对待撒玛利亚和其中的偶像， 不也照样对待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我怎样待撒马利亚和其中的偶像， 岂不照样待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像吗？
verses.textEnNiv: shall I not deal with Jerusalem and her images as I dealt with Samaria and her idols?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: shall I not do to Jerusalem and her idols as I have done to Samaria and her images?"
verses.textEnNkjv: As I have done to Samaria and her idols, Shall I not do also to Jerusalem and her idols?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So we will defeat Jerusalem and her gods, just as we destroyed Samaria with hers.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Shall I not do the same to Jerusalem and her images Just as I have done to Samaria and her idols?"
verses.textEn: shall I not deal with Jerusalem and her images as I dealt with Samaria and her idols?’ "

verses.textZh: 主在锡安山和耶路撒冷成全了他一切工作的时候，他必说：我要惩罚亚述王自大的心所结的果子，和他眼目高傲的态度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主在锡安山和耶路撒冷成全了他一切工作的时候，他必说：我要惩罚亚述王自大的心所结的果子，和他眼目高傲的态度。
verses.textZhCuv: 主在锡安山和耶路撒冷成就他一切工作的时候，主说：「我必罚亚述王自大的心和他高傲眼目的荣耀。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord has finished all his work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will say, "I will punish the king of Assyria for the willful pride of his heart and the haughty look in his eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord has finished all his work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, he will punish the speech of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria and the boastful look in his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Lord has performed all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, thatHewillsay, "I will punish the fruit of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his haughty looks."
verses.textEnNlt: After the Lord has used the king of Assyria to accomplish his purposes on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, he will turn against the king of Assyria and punish him—for he is proud and arrogant.
verses.textEnNasb: So it will be that when the Lord has completed all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, He will say, "I will punish the fruit of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria and the arrogant pride of his eyes."
verses.textEn: When the Lord has finished all his work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will say, "I will punish the king of Assyria for the willful pride of his heart and the haughty look in his eyes.

verses.textZh: 因为他说： "我靠着我手的能力和我的智慧行事， 因为我很聪明； 我挪移了列国的地界， 抢夺了他们积蓄的财宝， 并且我像个勇士般使他们的居民全都俯伏下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他说： "我靠着我手的能力和我的智慧行事， 因为我很聪明； 我挪移了列国的地界， 抢夺了他们积蓄的财宝， 并且我像个勇士般使他们的居民全都俯伏下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他说： 我所成就的事是靠我手的能力 和我的智慧， 我本有聪明。 我挪移列国的地界， 抢夺他们所积蓄的财宝； 并且我像勇士，使坐宝座的降为卑。
verses.textEnNiv: For he says: " ‘By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, because I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of nations, I plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their kings.
verses.textEnEsv: For he says: "By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding; I remove the boundaries of peoples, and plunder their treasures; like a bull I bring down those who sit on thrones.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he says: "By the strength of my hand I have done it, And by my wisdom, for I am prudent; Also I have removed the boundaries of the people, And have robbed their treasuries; So I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man.
verses.textEnNlt: He boasts, "By my own powerful arm I have done this. With my own shrewd wisdom I planned it. I have broken down the defenses of nations and carried off their treasures. I have knocked down their kings like a bull.
verses.textEnNasb: For he has said, "By the power of my hand and by my wisdom I did this, Because I have understanding; And I removed the boundaries of the peoples And plundered their treasures, And like a powerful man I brought down their inhabitants,
verses.textEn: For he says: " ‘By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, because I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of nations, I plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their kings.

verses.textZh: 我的手伸到列国的财宝那里，好象抓到鸟窝一样； 我取得了全地，好象人拾起被弃的雀蛋； 没有动翅膀的，没有张嘴的，也没有鸣叫的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的手伸到列国的财宝那里，好象抓到鸟窝一样； 我取得了全地，好象人拾起被弃的雀蛋； 没有动翅膀的，没有张嘴的，也没有鸣叫的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的手搆到列国的财宝， 好像人搆到鸟窝； 我也得了全地， 好像人拾起所弃的雀蛋。 没有动翅膀的； 没有张嘴的，也没有鸣叫的。
verses.textEnNiv: As one reaches into a nest, so my hand reached for the wealth of the nations; as people gather abandoned eggs, so I gathered all the countries; not one flapped a wing, or opened its mouth to chirp.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: My hand has found like a nest the wealth of the peoples; and as one gathers eggs that have been forsaken, so I have gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved a wing or opened the mouth or chirped."
verses.textEnNkjv: My hand has found like a nest the riches of the people, And as one gathers eggs thatare left, I have gathered all the earth; And there was no one who moved his wing, Nor opened his mouth with even a peep."
verses.textEnNlt: I have robbed their nests of riches and gathered up kingdoms as a farmer gathers eggs. No one can even flap a wing against me or utter a peep of protest."
verses.textEnNasb: And my hand reached to the riches of the peoples like a nest, And as one gathers abandoned eggs, I gathered all the earth; And there was not one that flapped its wing, opened its beak, or chirped."
verses.textEn: As one reaches into a nest, so my hand reached for the wealth of the nations; as people gather abandoned eggs, so I gathered all the countries; not one flapped a wing, or opened its mouth to chirp.’ "

verses.textZh: 斧头怎可以向用斧头砍木的人自夸呢？ 锯子怎可以向拉锯的人自大呢？ 好比棍能挥动那举起棍的， 又好比杖举起那不是木头的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 斧头怎可以向用斧头砍木的人自夸呢？ 锯子怎可以向拉锯的人自大呢？ 好比棍能挥动那举起棍的， 又好比杖举起那不是木头的。
verses.textZhCuv: 斧岂可向用斧砍木的自夸呢？ 锯岂可向用锯的自大呢？ 好比棍抡起那举棍的， 好比杖举起那非木的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Does the ax raise itself above the person who swings it, or the saw boast against the one who uses it? As if a rod were to wield the person who lifts it up, or a club brandish the one who is not wood!
verses.textEnEsv: Shall the axe boast over him who hews with it, or the saw magnify itself against him who wields it? As if a rod should wield him who lifts it, or as if a staff should lift him who is not wood!
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall the ax boast itself against him who chops with it? Or shall the saw exalt itself against him who saws with it? As if a rod could wield itself against those who lift it up, Or as if a staff could lift up, asifitwere not wood!
verses.textEnNlt: But can the ax boast greater power than the person who uses it? Is the saw greater than the person who saws? Can a rod strike unless a hand moves it? Can a wooden cane walk by itself?
verses.textEnNasb: Is the axe to boast itself over the one who chops with it? Is the saw to exalt itself over the one who wields it? That would be like a club wielding those who lift it, Or like a rod lifting the one who is not wood.
verses.textEn: Does the ax raise itself above the person who swings it, or the saw boast against the one who uses it? As if a rod were to wield the person who lifts it up, or a club brandish the one who is not wood!

verses.textZh: 因此，主万军之耶和华必打发令人消瘦的病临到亚述王肥壮的军人中间， 在他的荣耀之下必燃起火焰，如同火烧一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主万军之耶和华必打发令人消瘦的病临到亚述王肥壮的军人中间， 在他的荣耀之下必燃起火焰，如同火烧一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，主－万军之耶和华 必使亚述王的肥壮人变为瘦弱， 在他的荣华之下必有火着起， 如同焚烧一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will send a wasting disease upon his sturdy warriors; under his pomp a fire will be kindled like a blazing flame.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord God of hosts will send wasting sickness among his stout warriors, and under his glory a burning will be kindled, like the burning of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord, the Lord of hosts, Will send leanness among his fat ones; And under his glory He will kindle a burning Like the burning of a fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, will send a plague among Assyria’s proud troops, and a flaming fire will consume its glory.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord, the God of armies, will send a wasting disease among his stout warriors; And under his glory a fire will be kindled like a burning flame.
verses.textEn: Therefore, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will send a wasting disease upon his sturdy warriors; under his pomp a fire will be kindled like a blazing flame.

verses.textZh: 以色列的光必变成火，他的圣者必成为火焰； 在一日之间把亚述王的荆棘和蒺藜焚烧与吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的光必变成火，他的圣者必成为火焰； 在一日之间把亚述王的荆棘和蒺藜焚烧与吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的光必如火； 他的圣者必如火焰。 在一日之间，将亚述王的荆棘 和蒺藜焚烧净尽；
verses.textEnNiv: The Light of Israel will become a fire, their Holy One a flame; in a single day it will burn and consume his thorns and his briers.
verses.textEnEsv: The light of Israel will become a fire, and his Holy One a flame, and it will burn and devour his thorns and briers in one day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Light of Israel will be for a fire, And his Holy One for a flame; It will burn and devour His thorns and his briers in one day.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord , the Light of Israel, will be a fire; the Holy One will be a flame. He will devour the thorns and briers with fire, burning up the enemy in a single night.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Light of Israel will become a fire and Israel’s Holy One a flame, And it will burn and devour his thorns and his briars in a single day.
verses.textEn: The Light of Israel will become a fire, their Holy One a flame; in a single day it will burn and consume his thorns and his briers.

verses.textZh: 又把他树林和丰盛果园的荣美全部灭尽，包括灵魂和身体，好象一个患病的人渐渐虚弱一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把他树林和丰盛果园的荣美全部灭尽，包括灵魂和身体，好象一个患病的人渐渐虚弱一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将他树林和肥田的荣耀全然烧尽， 好像拿军旗的昏过去一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The splendor of his forests and fertile fields it will completely destroy, as when a sick person wastes away.
verses.textEnEsv: The glory of his forest and of his fruitful land the Lord will destroy, both soul and body, and it will be as when a sick man wastes away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, Both soul and body; And they will be as when a sick man wastes away.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will consume Assyria’s glory like a fire consumes a forest in a fruitful land; it will waste away like sick people in a plague.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will destroy the glory of his forest and of his fruitful garden, both soul and body, And it will be as when a sick person wastes away.
verses.textEn: The splendor of his forests and fertile fields it will completely destroy, as when a sick person wastes away.

verses.textZh: 他林中剩下的树，数目必定稀少， 连小孩子也能把它们的数目写下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他林中剩下的树，数目必定稀少， 连小孩子也能把它们的数目写下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他林中剩下的树必稀少， 就是孩子也能写其数。
verses.textEnNiv: And the remaining trees of his forests will be so few that a child could write them down.
verses.textEnEsv: The remnant of the trees of his forest will be so few that a child can write them down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the rest of the trees of his forest Will be so few in number That a child may write them.
verses.textEnNlt: Of all that glorious forest, only a few trees will survive— so few that a child could count them!
verses.textEnNasb: And the rest of the trees of his forest will be so small in number That a child could write them down.
verses.textEn: And the remaining trees of his forests will be so few that a child could write them down.

verses.textZh: 到那日，以色列的余民和雅各家逃脱的人，必不再倚靠那击打他们的，却要诚实地倚靠耶和华以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，以色列的余民和雅各家逃脱的人，必不再倚靠那击打他们的，却要诚实地倚靠耶和华以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，以色列所剩下的和雅各家所逃脱的，不再倚靠那击打他们的，却要诚实倚靠耶和华－以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the remnant of Israel, the survivors of Jacob, will no longer rely on him who struck them down but will truly rely on the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no more lean on him who struck them, but will lean on the Lord , the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass in that day That the remnant of Israel, And such as have escaped of the house of Jacob, Will never again depend on him who defeated them, But will depend on the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the remnant left in Israel, the survivors in the house of Jacob, will no longer depend on allies who seek to destroy them. But they will faithfully trust the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on that day the remnant of Israel, and those of the house of Jacob who have escaped, will no longer rely on the one who struck them, but will truly rely on the Lord, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: In that day the remnant of Israel, the survivors of Jacob, will no longer rely on him who struck them down but will truly rely on the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 那些余民，就是雅各家的余民， 必回转归向大能的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些余民，就是雅各家的余民， 必回转归向大能的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所剩下的，就是雅各家所剩下的，必归回全能的神。
verses.textEnNiv: A remnant will return, a remnant of Jacob will return to the Mighty God.
verses.textEnEsv: A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, To the Mighty God.
verses.textEnNlt: A remnant will return; yes, the remnant of Jacob will return to the Mighty God.
verses.textEnNasb: A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
verses.textEn: A remnant will return, a remnant of Jacob will return to the Mighty God.

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！你的人民虽然像海沙那样多，却只有余剩的人可以归回， 因为灭绝的事已经定了，公义必如洪水泛滥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！你的人民虽然像海沙那样多，却只有余剩的人可以归回， 因为灭绝的事已经定了，公义必如洪水泛滥。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你的百姓虽多如海沙，惟有剩下的归回。原来灭绝的事已定，必有公义施行，如水涨溢。
verses.textEnNiv: Though your people be like the sand by the sea, Israel, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overwhelming and righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: For though your people Israel be as the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. Destruction is decreed, overflowing with righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though your people, O Israel, be as the sand of the sea, A remnant of them will return; The destruction decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: But though the people of Israel are as numerous as the sand of the seashore, only a remnant of them will return. The Lord has rightly decided to destroy his people.
verses.textEnNasb: For though your people, Israel, may be like the sand of the sea, Only a remnant within them will return; A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
verses.textEn: Though your people be like the sand by the sea, Israel, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overwhelming and righteous.

verses.textZh: 主万军之耶和华必在全地之中，作成已定的毁灭之事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主万军之耶和华必在全地之中，作成已定的毁灭之事。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主－万军之耶和华在全地之中必成就所定规的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord God of hosts will make a full end, as decreed, in the midst of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord God of hosts Will make a determined end In the midst of all the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, has already decided to destroy the entire land.
verses.textEnNasb: For a complete destruction, one that is determined, the Lord God of armies will execute in the midst of the whole land.
verses.textEn: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land.

verses.textZh: 因此，主万军之耶和华这样说："我的子民、锡安的居民哪！亚述人虽然用棍击打你们，又像埃及一样举杖攻击你们，你们却不要怕他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主万军之耶和华这样说："我的子民、锡安的居民哪！亚述人虽然用棍击打你们，又像埃及一样举杖攻击你们，你们却不要怕他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主－万军之耶和华如此说：「住锡安我的百姓啊，亚述王虽然用棍击打你，又照埃及的样子举杖攻击你，你却不要怕他。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says: "My people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians, who beat you with a rod and lift up a club against you, as Egypt did.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God of hosts: "O my people, who dwell in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrians when they strike with the rod and lift up their staff against you as the Egyptians did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God of hosts: "O My people, who dwell in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrian. He shall strike you with a rod and lift up his staff against you, in the manner of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, says: "O my people in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians when they oppress you with rod and club as the Egyptians did long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God of armies says: "My people, you who dwell in Zion, do not fear the Assyrian who strikes you with the rod, and lifts up his staff against you the way Egypt did.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says: "My people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians, who beat you with a rod and lift up a club against you, as Egypt did.

verses.textZh: 因为还有短暂的时候，我向你们发的恼怒就要完结，我的怒气要转向他们，使他们灭亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为还有短暂的时候，我向你们发的恼怒就要完结，我的怒气要转向他们，使他们灭亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为还有一点点时候，向你们发的忿恨就要完毕，我的怒气要向他发作，使他灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Very soon my anger against you will end and my wrath will be directed to their destruction."
verses.textEnEsv: For in a very little while my fury will come to an end, and my anger will be directed to their destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: For yet a very little while and the indignation will cease, as will My anger in their destruction."
verses.textEnNlt: In a little while my anger against you will end, and then my anger will rise up to destroy them."
verses.textEnNasb: For in a very little while My indignation against you will be ended and My anger will be directed toward their destruction."
verses.textEn: Very soon my anger against you will end and my wrath will be directed to their destruction."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华必兴起鞭子攻击他们，好象在俄立盘石那里击杀米甸人一样；他的杖要伸到海上，他必把杖举起，像在埃及一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华必兴起鞭子攻击他们，好象在俄立盘石那里击杀米甸人一样；他的杖要伸到海上，他必把杖举起，像在埃及一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华要兴起鞭来攻击他，好像在俄立磐石那里杀戮米甸人一样。耶和华的杖要向海伸出，把杖举起，像在埃及一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty will lash them with a whip, as when he struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb; and he will raise his staff over the waters, as he did in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord of hosts will wield against them a whip, as when he struck Midian at the rock of Oreb. And his staff will be over the sea, and he will lift it as he did in Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord of hosts will stir up a scourge for him like the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb; as His rod was on the sea, so will He lift it up in the manner of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies will lash them with his whip, as he did when Gideon triumphed over the Midianites at the rock of Oreb, or when the Lord ’s staff was raised to drown the Egyptian army in the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies will wield a whip against him like the defeat of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and His staff will be over the sea, and He will lift it up the way He did in Egypt.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty will lash them with a whip, as when he struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb; and he will raise his staff over the waters, as he did in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 到那日，亚述人的重压必从你们的肩头上挪开，他们的轭必离开你们的颈项；那轭必因肥壮的缘故折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，亚述人的重压必从你们的肩头上挪开，他们的轭必离开你们的颈项；那轭必因肥壮的缘故折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，亚述王的重担必离开你的肩头；他的轭必离开你的颈项；那轭也必因肥壮的缘故撑断 。」
verses.textEnNiv: In that day their burden will be lifted from your shoulders, their yoke from your neck; the yoke will be broken because you have grown so fat.
verses.textEnEsv: And in that day his burden will depart from your shoulder, and his yoke from your neck; and the yoke will be broken because of the fat."
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in that day That his burden will be taken away from your shoulder, And his yoke from your neck, And the yoke will be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Lord will end the bondage of his people. He will break the yoke of slavery and lift it from their shoulders.
verses.textEnNasb: So it will be on that day, that his burden will be removed from your shoulders, and his yoke from your neck; and the yoke will be broken because of fatness.
verses.textEn: In that day their burden will be lifted from your shoulders, their yoke from your neck; the yoke will be broken because you have grown so fat.

verses.textZh: 亚述人来到亚叶， 经过米矶仑； 在密抹存放军队行装。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述人来到亚叶， 经过米矶仑； 在密抹存放军队行装。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王来到亚叶， 经过米矶仑， 在密抹安放辎重。
verses.textEnNiv: They enter Aiath; they pass through Migron; they store supplies at Mikmash.
verses.textEnEsv: He has come to Aiath; he has passed through Migron; at Michmash he stores his baggage;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has come to Aiath, He has passed Migron; At Michmash he has attended to his equipment.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, the Assyrians are now at Aiath. They are passing through Migron and are storing their equipment at Micmash.
verses.textEnNasb: He has come against Aiath, He has passed through Migron; At Michmash he deposited his baggage.
verses.textEn: They enter Aiath; they pass through Migron; they store supplies at Mikmash.

verses.textZh: 他们过了隘口， 在迦巴住宿； 拉玛人战兢，扫罗的基比亚人逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们过了隘口， 在迦巴住宿； 拉玛人战兢，扫罗的基比亚人逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们过了隘口， 在迦巴住宿。 拉玛人战兢； 扫罗的基比亚人逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: They go over the pass, and say, "We will camp overnight at Geba." Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul flees.
verses.textEnEsv: they have crossed over the pass; at Geba they lodge for the night; Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul has fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have gone along the ridge, They have taken up lodging at Geba. Ramah is afraid, Gibeah of Saul has fled.
verses.textEnNlt: They are crossing the pass and are camping at Geba. Fear strikes the town of Ramah. All the people of Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, are running for their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: They have gone through the pass, saying, "Geba will be our encampment for the night." Ramah is terrified, and Gibeah of Saul has fled.
verses.textEn: They go over the pass, and say, "We will camp overnight at Geba." Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul flees.

verses.textZh: 迦琳的居民哪，高声叫喊吧！ 莱煞人和可怜的亚拿突啊，留心听吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦琳的居民哪，高声叫喊吧！ 莱煞人和可怜的亚拿突啊，留心听吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 迦琳的居民 哪，要高声呼喊！ 莱煞人哪，须听！ 哀哉！困苦的亚拿突啊。
verses.textEnNiv: Cry out, Daughter Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Poor Anathoth!
verses.textEnEsv: Cry aloud, O daughter of Gallim! Give attention, O Laishah! O poor Anathoth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your voice, O daughter of Gallim! Cause it to be heard as far as Laish— O poor Anathoth!
verses.textEnNlt: Scream in terror, you people of Gallim! Shout out a warning to Laishah. Oh, poor Anathoth!
verses.textEnNasb: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Pay attention, Laishah and wretched Anathoth!
verses.textEn: Cry out, Daughter Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Poor Anathoth!

verses.textZh: 玛得米那人逃跑， 基柄的居民避难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛得米那人逃跑， 基柄的居民避难。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛得米那人躲避； 基柄的居民逃遁。
verses.textEnNiv: Madmenah is in flight; the people of Gebim take cover.
verses.textEnEsv: Madmenah is in flight; the inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
verses.textEnNkjv: Madmenah has fled, The inhabitants of Gebim seek refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: There go the people of Madmenah, all fleeing. The citizens of Gebim are trying to hide.
verses.textEnNasb: Madmenah has fled. The inhabitants of Gebim have sought refuge.
verses.textEn: Madmenah is in flight; the people of Gebim take cover.

verses.textZh: 就在今日，亚述王要停留在挪伯； 他要挥拳攻击锡安居民 的山，就是耶路撒冷的山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在今日，亚述王要停留在挪伯； 他要挥拳攻击锡安居民 的山，就是耶路撒冷的山。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，亚述王要在挪伯歇兵， 向锡安女子的山－ 就是耶路撒冷的山－抡手攻他。
verses.textEnNiv: This day they will halt at Nob; they will shake their fist at the mount of Daughter Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: This very day he will halt at Nob; he will shake his fist at the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: As yet he will remain at Nob that day; He will shake his fist at the mount of the daughter of Zion, The hill of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: The enemy stops at Nob for the rest of that day. He shakes his fist at beautiful Mount Zion, the mountain of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet today he will halt at Nob; He shakes his fist at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: This day they will halt at Nob; they will shake their fist at the mount of Daughter Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 看哪！主万军之耶和华在可怕的震撼声中，把树枝削去； 身量高的必被砍下， 高大的必被伐倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！主万军之耶和华在可怕的震撼声中，把树枝削去； 身量高的必被砍下， 高大的必被伐倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，主－万军之耶和华 以惊吓削去树枝； 长高的必被砍下， 高大的必被伐倒。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will lop off the boughs with great power. The lofty trees will be felled, the tall ones will be brought low.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord God of hosts will lop the boughs with terrifying power; the great in height will be hewn down, and the lofty will be brought low.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the Lord, The Lord of hosts, Will lop off the bough with terror; Those of high stature willbe hewn down, And the haughty will be humbled.
verses.textEnNlt: But look! The Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, will chop down the mighty tree of Assyria with great power! He will cut down the proud. That lofty tree will be brought down.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord, the God of armies, will lop off the branches with terrifying power; Those also who are tall in stature will be cut down, And those who are lofty will be brought low.
verses.textEn: See, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will lop off the boughs with great power. The lofty trees will be felled, the tall ones will be brought low.

verses.textZh: 树林中的密丛，他必用铁器砍下； 黎巴嫩的树木必被大能者伐倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 树林中的密丛，他必用铁器砍下； 黎巴嫩的树木必被大能者伐倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 稠密的树林，他要用铁器砍下； 黎巴嫩的树木必被大能者伐倒。
verses.textEnNiv: He will cut down the forest thickets with an ax; Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
verses.textEnEsv: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with an axe, and Lebanon will fall by the Majestic One.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, And Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
verses.textEnNlt: He will cut down the forest trees with an ax. Lebanon will fall to the Mighty One.
verses.textEnNasb: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with an iron axe, And Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
verses.textEn: He will cut down the forest thickets with an ax; Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.

verses.textZh: 从耶西的树干必生出一根嫩芽， 从他的根而出的枝条必结果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从耶西的树干必生出一根嫩芽， 从他的根而出的枝条必结果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 从耶西的本 必发一条； 从他根生的枝子必结果实。
verses.textEnNiv: A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse; from his roots a Branch will bear fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: There shall come forth a shoot from the stump of Jesse, and a branch from his roots shall bear fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: There shall come forth a Rod from the stem of Jesse, And a Branch shall grow out of his roots.
verses.textEnNlt: Out of the stump of David’s family will grow a shoot— yes, a new Branch bearing fruit from the old root.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a shoot will spring from the stem of Jesse, And a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
verses.textEn: A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse; from his roots a Branch will bear fruit.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵必停留在他身上， 就是智慧的灵和聪明的灵， 谋略的灵和能力的灵， 知识的灵和敬畏耶和华的灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵必停留在他身上， 就是智慧的灵和聪明的灵， 谋略的灵和能力的灵， 知识的灵和敬畏耶和华的灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵必住在他身上， 就是使他有智慧和聪明的灵， 谋略和能力的灵， 知识和敬畏耶和华的灵。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit of the Lord will rest on him— the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of might, the Spirit of the knowledge and fear of the Lord —
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The Spirit of the Lord shall rest upon Him, The Spirit of wisdom and understanding, The Spirit of counsel and might, The Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Spirit of the Lord will rest on him— the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The Spirit of the Lord will rest on Him, The spirit of wisdom and understanding, The spirit of counsel and strength, The spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Spirit of the Lord will rest on him— the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of might, the Spirit of the knowledge and fear of the Lord —

verses.textZh: 他必以敬畏耶和华为乐。 他不凭眼睛所见的施行审判， 也不凭耳朵所听的断定是非；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必以敬畏耶和华为乐。 他不凭眼睛所见的施行审判， 也不凭耳朵所听的断定是非；
verses.textZhCuv: 他必以敬畏耶和华为乐； 行审判不凭眼见， 断是非也不凭耳闻；
verses.textEnNiv: and he will delight in the fear of the Lord . He will not judge by what he sees with his eyes, or decide by what he hears with his ears;
verses.textEnEsv: And his delight shall be in the fear of the Lord . He shall not judge by what his eyes see, or decide disputes by what his ears hear,
verses.textEnNkjv: His delight is in the fear of the Lord, And He shall not judge by the sight of His eyes, Nor decide by the hearing of His ears;
verses.textEnNlt: He will delight in obeying the Lord . He will not judge by appearance nor make a decision based on hearsay.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will delight in the fear of the Lord, And He will not judge by what His eyes see, Nor make decisions by what His ears hear;
verses.textEn: and he will delight in the fear of the Lord . He will not judge by what he sees with his eyes, or decide by what he hears with his ears;

verses.textZh: 却要以公义审判贫穷人， 以正直判断地上的困苦人； 以口中的杖击打世界， 以嘴里的气杀死恶人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却要以公义审判贫穷人， 以正直判断地上的困苦人； 以口中的杖击打世界， 以嘴里的气杀死恶人。
verses.textZhCuv: 却要以公义审判贫穷人， 以正直判断世上的谦卑人， 以口中的杖击打世界， 以嘴里的气杀戮恶人。
verses.textEnNiv: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: but with righteousness he shall judge the poor, and decide with equity for the meek of the earth; and he shall strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he shall kill the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: But with righteousness He shall judge the poor, And decide with equity for the meek of the earth; He shall strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, And with the breath of His lips He shall slay the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: He will give justice to the poor and make fair decisions for the exploited. The earth will shake at the force of his word, and one breath from his mouth will destroy the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: But with righteousness He will judge the poor, And decide with fairness for the humble of the earth; And He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, And with the breath of His lips He will slay the wicked.
verses.textEn: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.

verses.textZh: 公义必作他腰间的带子， 信实必作他胁下的带子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公义必作他腰间的带子， 信实必作他胁下的带子。
verses.textZhCuv: 公义必当他的腰带； 信实必当他胁下的带子。
verses.textEnNiv: Righteousness will be his belt and faithfulness the sash around his waist.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteousness shall be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his loins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteousness shall be the belt of His loins, And faithfulness the belt of His waist.
verses.textEnNlt: He will wear righteousness like a belt and truth like an undergarment.
verses.textEnNasb: Also righteousness will be the belt around His hips, And faithfulness the belt around His waist.
verses.textEn: Righteousness will be his belt and faithfulness the sash around his waist.

verses.textZh: 豺狼必与绵羊羔同住， 豹子要与山羊羔同卧， 牛犊、幼狮和肥畜必同群； 小孩子要牵引牠们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 豺狼必与绵羊羔同住， 豹子要与山羊羔同卧， 牛犊、幼狮和肥畜必同群； 小孩子要牵引牠们。
verses.textZhCuv: 豺狼必与绵羊羔同居， 豹子与山羊羔同卧； 少壮狮子与牛犊并肥畜同群； 小孩子要牵引它们。
verses.textEnNiv: The wolf will live with the lamb, the leopard will lie down with the goat, the calf and the lion and the yearling together; and a little child will lead them.
verses.textEnEsv: The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the young goat, and the calf and the lion and the fattened calf together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, The leopard shall lie down with the young goat, The calf and the young lion and the fatling together; And a little child shall lead them.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the wolf and the lamb will live together; the leopard will lie down with the baby goat. The calf and the yearling will be safe with the lion, and a little child will lead them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And the wolf will dwell with the lamb, And the leopard will lie down with the young goat, And the calf and the young lion and the fattened steer will be together; And a little boy will lead them.
verses.textEn: The wolf will live with the lamb, the leopard will lie down with the goat, the calf and the lion and the yearling together; and a little child will lead them.

verses.textZh: 牛必与母熊一同吃食， 牛犊必与小熊一起躺卧； 狮子就像牛一般吃草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛必与母熊一同吃食， 牛犊必与小熊一起躺卧； 狮子就像牛一般吃草。
verses.textZhCuv: 牛必与熊同食； 牛犊必与小熊同卧； 狮子必吃草，与牛一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The cow will feed with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
verses.textEnEsv: The cow and the bear shall graze; their young shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cow and the bear shall graze; Their young ones shall lie down together; And the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.textEnNlt: The cow will graze near the bear. The cub and the calf will lie down together. The lion will eat hay like a cow.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the cow and the bear will graze, Their young will lie down together, And the lion will eat straw like the ox.
verses.textEn: The cow will feed with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.

verses.textZh: 吃奶的婴儿必在虺蛇的洞口玩耍， 断奶的孩子必放他的手在毒蛇的穴上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃奶的婴儿必在虺蛇的洞口玩耍， 断奶的孩子必放他的手在毒蛇的穴上。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃奶的孩子必玩耍在虺蛇的洞口； 断奶的婴儿必按手在毒蛇的穴上。
verses.textEnNiv: The infant will play near the cobra’s den, and the young child will put its hand into the viper’s nest.
verses.textEnEsv: The nursing child shall play over the hole of the cobra, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder’s den.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nursing child shall play by the cobra’s hole, And the weaned child shall put his hand in the viper’s den.
verses.textEnNlt: The baby will play safely near the hole of a cobra. Yes, a little child will put its hand in a nest of deadly snakes without harm.
verses.textEnNasb: The nursing child will play by the hole of the cobra, And the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
verses.textEn: The infant will play near the cobra’s den, and the young child will put its hand into the viper’s nest.

verses.textZh: 在我整个圣山上面，这一切都不行伤害或毁灭之事； 因为认识耶和华的知识要充满大地， 好象海水覆盖海洋一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我整个圣山上面，这一切都不行伤害或毁灭之事； 因为认识耶和华的知识要充满大地， 好象海水覆盖海洋一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 在我圣山的遍处， 这一切都不伤人，不害物； 因为认识耶和华的知识要充满遍地， 好像水充满洋海一般。
verses.textEnNiv: They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain, for the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not hurt or destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain, For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord As the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing will hurt or destroy in all my holy mountain, for as the waters fill the sea, so the earth will be filled with people who know the Lord .
