verses.textEnNasb: They will not hurt or destroy in all My holy mountain, For the earth will be full of the knowledge of the Lord As the waters cover the sea.
verses.textEn: They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain, for the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶西的根必竖立起来， 作万族的旗帜； 列国的人必寻求他， 他安息之所必大有荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶西的根必竖立起来， 作万族的旗帜； 列国的人必寻求他， 他安息之所必大有荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，耶西的根立作万民的大旗；外邦人必寻求他，他安息之所大有荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples; the nations will rally to him, and his resting place will be glorious.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the root of Jesse, who shall stand as a signal for the peoples—of him shall the nations inquire, and his resting place shall be glorious.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And in that day there shall be a Root of Jesse, Who shall stand as a banner to the people; For the Gentiles shall seek Him, And His resting place shall be glorious."
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the heir to David’s throne will be a banner of salvation to all the world. The nations will rally to him, and the land where he lives will be a glorious place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on that day The nations will resort to the root of Jesse, Who will stand as a signal flag for the peoples; And His resting place will be glorious.
verses.textEn: In that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples; the nations will rally to him, and his resting place will be glorious.

verses.textZh: 到那日， 主必再用自己的手， 赎回他子民中的余民， 就是从亚述、埃及、巴忒罗、古实、以拦、示拿和哈马， 以及众海岛所剩下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日， 主必再用自己的手， 赎回他子民中的余民， 就是从亚述、埃及、巴忒罗、古实、以拦、示拿和哈马， 以及众海岛所剩下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，主必二次伸手救回自己百姓中所余剩的，就是在亚述、埃及、巴忒罗、古实、以拦、示拿、哈马，并众海岛所剩下的。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to reclaim the surviving remnant of his people from Assyria, from Lower Egypt, from Upper Egypt, from Cush, from Elam, from Babylonia, from Hamath and from the islands of the Mediterranean.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord will extend his hand yet a second time to recover the remnant that remains of his people, from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the coastlands of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in that day That the Lord shall set His hand again the second time To recover the remnant of His people who are left, From Assyria and Egypt, From Pathros and Cush, From Elam and Shinar, From Hamath and the islands of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to bring back the remnant of his people— those who remain in Assyria and northern Egypt; in southern Egypt, Ethiopia, and Elam; in Babylonia, Hamath, and all the distant coastlands.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it will happen on that day that the Lord Will again recover with His hand the second time The remnant of His people who will remain, From Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, And from the islands of the sea.
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to reclaim the surviving remnant of his people from Assyria, from Lower Egypt, from Upper Egypt, from Cush, from Elam, from Babylonia, from Hamath and from the islands of the Mediterranean.

verses.textZh: 他必向列国竖起旗帜， 召聚以色列被掳去的人， 又从地的四方 聚集分散了的犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必向列国竖起旗帜， 召聚以色列被掳去的人， 又从地的四方 聚集分散了的犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必向列国竖立大旗， 招回以色列被赶散的人， 又从地的四方聚集分散的犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; he will assemble the scattered people of Judah from the four quarters of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: He will raise a signal for the nations and will assemble the banished of Israel, and gather the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will set up a banner for the nations, And will assemble the outcasts of Israel, And gather together the dispersed of Judah From the four corners of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: He will raise a flag among the nations and assemble the exiles of Israel. He will gather the scattered people of Judah from the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will lift up a flag for the nations And assemble the banished ones of Israel, And will gather the dispersed of Judah From the four corners of the earth.
verses.textEn: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; he will assemble the scattered people of Judah from the four quarters of the earth.

verses.textZh: 以法莲的嫉妒必消除， 那敌视犹大的必被剪除； 以法莲必不再嫉妒犹大， 犹大也必不再敌视以法莲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲的嫉妒必消除， 那敌视犹大的必被剪除； 以法莲必不再嫉妒犹大， 犹大也必不再敌视以法莲。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲的嫉妒就必消散； 扰害犹大的必被剪除。 以法莲必不嫉妒犹大， 犹大也不扰害以法莲。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim’s jealousy will vanish, and Judah’s enemies will be destroyed; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, nor Judah hostile toward Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: The jealousy of Ephraim shall depart, and those who harass Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not be jealous of Judah, and Judah shall not harass Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the envy of Ephraim shall depart, And the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not envy Judah, And Judah shall not harass Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last the jealousy between Israel and Judah will end. They will not be rivals anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the jealousy of Ephraim will depart, And those who harass Judah will be eliminated; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, And Judah will not harass Ephraim.
verses.textEn: Ephraim’s jealousy will vanish, and Judah’s enemies will be destroyed; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, nor Judah hostile toward Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 他们要向西飞，扑在非利士人的山麓上， 一起掳掠东方人； 他们必把手伸到以东和摩押之上， 亚扪人必顺服他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要向西飞，扑在非利士人的山麓上， 一起掳掠东方人； 他们必把手伸到以东和摩押之上， 亚扪人必顺服他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要向西飞， 扑在非利士人的肩头上 ， 一同掳掠东方人， 伸手按住以东和摩押； 亚扪人也必顺服他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; together they will plunder the people to the east. They will subdue Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.
verses.textEnEsv: But they shall swoop down on the shoulder of the Philistines in the west, and together they shall plunder the people of the east. They shall put out their hand against Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites shall obey them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they shall fly down upon the shoulder of the Philistines toward the west; Together they shall plunder the people of the East; They shall lay their hand on Edom and Moab; And the people of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.textEnNlt: They will join forces to swoop down on Philistia to the west. Together they will attack and plunder the nations to the east. They will occupy the lands of Edom and Moab, and Ammon will obey them.
verses.textEnNasb: They will swoop down on the slopes of the Philistines on the west; Together they will plunder the people of the east; They will possess Edom and Moab, And the sons of Ammon will be subject to them.
verses.textEn: They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; together they will plunder the people to the east. They will subdue Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使埃及的海湾干涸； 他要用热风在大河之上挥手， 他要击打它，使它分成七道支流， 使人走过去也不会把鞋弄湿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使埃及的海湾干涸； 他要用热风在大河之上挥手， 他要击打它，使它分成七道支流， 使人走过去也不会把鞋弄湿。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使埃及海汊枯干， 抡手用暴热的风使大河分为七条， 令人过去不致湿脚。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will dry up the gulf of the Egyptian sea; with a scorching wind he will sweep his hand over the Euphrates River. He will break it up into seven streams so that anyone can cross over in sandals.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will utterly destroy the tongue of the Sea of Egypt, and will wave his hand over the River with his scorching breath, and strike it into seven channels, and he will lead people across in sandals.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will utterly destroy the tongue of the Sea of Egypt; With His mighty wind He will shake His fist over the River, And strike it in the seven streams, And make men cross over dry-shod.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will make a dry path through the gulf of the Red Sea. He will wave his hand over the Euphrates River, sending a mighty wind to divide it into seven streams so it can easily be crossed on foot.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will utterly destroy The tongue of the Sea of Egypt; And He will wave His hand over the Euphrates River With His scorching wind; And He will strike it into seven streams And make people walk over in dry sandals.
verses.textEn: The Lord will dry up the gulf of the Egyptian sea; with a scorching wind he will sweep his hand over the Euphrates River. He will break it up into seven streams so that anyone can cross over in sandals.

verses.textZh: 为着神的余民， 就是那些在亚述剩下归回的， 必有一条大路给他们归回， 正如以色列人从埃及地上来的日子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为着神的余民， 就是那些在亚述剩下归回的， 必有一条大路给他们归回， 正如以色列人从埃及地上来的日子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 为主余剩的百姓， 就是从亚述剩下回来的， 必有一条大道， 如当日以色列从埃及地上来一样。
verses.textEnNiv: There will be a highway for the remnant of his people that is left from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And there will be a highway from Assyria for the remnant that remains of his people, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: There will be a highway for the remnant of His people Who will be left from Assyria, As it was for Israel In the day that he came up from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: He will make a highway for the remnant of his people, the remnant coming from Assyria, just as he did for Israel long ago when they returned from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: And there will be a highway from Assyria For the remnant of His people who will be left, Just as there was for Israel On the day that they came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: There will be a highway for the remnant of his people that is left from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 到那日，你必说： "耶和华啊！我要称谢你， 因为你虽曾向我发怒， 你的怒气却已转消， 你又安慰了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，你必说： "耶和华啊！我要称谢你， 因为你虽曾向我发怒， 你的怒气却已转消， 你又安慰了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，你必说： 耶和华啊，我要称谢你！ 因为你虽然向我发怒， 你的怒气却已转消； 你又安慰了我。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day you will say: "I will praise you, Lord . Although you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you have comforted me.
verses.textEnEsv: You will say in that day: "I will give thanks to you, O Lord , for though you were angry with me, your anger turned away, that you might comfort me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day you will say: "O Lord, I will praise You; Though You were angry with me, Your anger is turned away, and You comfort me.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day you will sing: "I will praise you, O Lord ! You were angry with me, but not anymore. Now you comfort me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will say on that day, "I will give thanks to You, Lord; For although You were angry with me, Your anger is turned away, And You comfort me.
verses.textEn: In that day you will say: "I will praise you, Lord . Although you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you have comforted me.

verses.textZh: 看哪！神是我的拯救； 我要倚靠他，并不惧怕， 因为耶和华神是我的力量，我的诗歌， 他也成了我的拯救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！神是我的拯救； 我要倚靠他，并不惧怕， 因为耶和华神是我的力量，我的诗歌， 他也成了我的拯救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪！神是我的拯救； 我要倚靠他，并不惧怕。 因为主耶和华是我的力量， 是我的诗歌， 他也成了我的拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. The Lord , the Lord himself, is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation."
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the Lord God is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, God is my salvation, I will trust and not be afraid; ‘For Yah, the Lord, is my strength and song; He also has become my salvation.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: See, God has come to save me. I will trust in him and not be afraid. The Lord God is my strength and my song; he has given me victory."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, God is my salvation, I will trust and not be afraid; For the Lord God is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation."
verses.textEn: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. The Lord , the Lord himself, is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation."

verses.textZh: 所以你们要快乐地 从救恩的泉源打水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要快乐地 从救恩的泉源打水。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们必从救恩的泉源欢然取水。
verses.textEnNiv: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore with joy you will draw water From the wells of salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: With joy you will drink deeply from the fountain of salvation!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you will joyously draw water From the springs of salvation.
verses.textEn: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.

verses.textZh: 到那日，你们必说： "要称谢耶和华，呼求他的名； 在万民中传扬他的作为， 使他们谨记他那至高的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，你们必说： "要称谢耶和华，呼求他的名； 在万民中传扬他的作为， 使他们谨记他那至高的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那日，你们要说： 当称谢耶和华，求告他的名； 将他所行的传扬在万民中， 提说他的名已被尊崇。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day you will say: "Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done, and proclaim that his name is exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: And you will say in that day: "Give thanks to the Lord , call upon his name, make known his deeds among the peoples, proclaim that his name is exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day you will say: "Praise the Lord, call upon His name; Declare His deeds among the peoples, Make mention that His name is exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: In that wonderful day you will sing: "Thank the Lord ! Praise his name! Tell the nations what he has done. Let them know how mighty he is!
verses.textEnNasb: And on that day you will say, "Give thanks to the Lord, call on His name. Make known His deeds among the peoples; Make them remember that His name is exalted."
verses.textEn: In that day you will say: "Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done, and proclaim that his name is exalted.

verses.textZh: 你们要唱歌赞美耶和华，因为他作了极美的事； 愿这事传遍全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要唱歌赞美耶和华，因为他作了极美的事； 愿这事传遍全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要向耶和华唱歌， 因他所行的甚是美好； 但愿这事普传天下。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord , for he has done glorious things; let this be known to all the world.
verses.textEnEsv: "Sing praises to the Lord , for he has done gloriously; let this be made known in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord, For He has done excellent things; This is known in all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to the Lord , for he has done wonderful things. Make known his praise around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord in song, for He has done glorious things; Let this be known throughout the earth.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord , for he has done glorious things; let this be known to all the world.

verses.textZh: 锡安的居民哪，当喊叫欢呼！ 因为以色列的圣者在你们中间是伟大的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的居民哪，当喊叫欢呼！ 因为以色列的圣者在你们中间是伟大的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的居民哪，当扬声欢呼， 因为在你们中间的以色列圣者乃为至大。
verses.textEnNiv: Shout aloud and sing for joy, people of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you."
verses.textEnEsv: Shout, and sing for joy, O inhabitant of Zion, for great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Cry out and shout, O inhabitant of Zion, For great is the Holy One of Israel in your midst!"
verses.textEnNlt: Let all the people of Jerusalem shout his praise with joy! For great is the Holy One of Israel who lives among you."
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice and shout for joy, you inhabitant of Zion, For great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Shout aloud and sing for joy, people of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you."

verses.textZh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得到关于巴比伦的默示：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得到关于巴比伦的默示：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示，论巴比伦。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle concerning Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaiah son of Amoz received this message concerning the destruction of Babylon:
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw:
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:

verses.textZh: 你要在光秃的山上竖起旗帜， 向众人扬声挥手， 叫他们进入权贵的门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在光秃的山上竖起旗帜， 向众人扬声挥手， 叫他们进入权贵的门。
verses.textZhCuv: 应当在净光的山竖立大旗， 向群众扬声招手， 使他们进入贵胄的门。
verses.textEnNiv: Raise a banner on a bare hilltop, shout to them; beckon to them to enter the gates of the nobles.
verses.textEnEsv: On a bare hill raise a signal; cry aloud to them; wave the hand for them to enter the gates of the nobles.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lift up a banner on the high mountain, Raise your voice to them; Wave your hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.
verses.textEnNlt: "Raise a signal flag on a bare hilltop. Call up an army against Babylon. Wave your hand to encourage them as they march into the palaces of the high and mighty.
verses.textEnNasb: Lift up a flag on the bare hill, Raise your voice to them, Wave the hand that they may enter the doors of the nobles.
verses.textEn: Raise a banner on a bare hilltop, shout to them; beckon to them to enter the gates of the nobles.

verses.textZh: 我向我特选的军兵下了命令； 我也呼召了我的勇士， 就是那些骄傲自夸的人， 去执行我在怒气中所要作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向我特选的军兵下了命令； 我也呼召了我的勇士， 就是那些骄傲自夸的人， 去执行我在怒气中所要作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我吩咐我所挑出来的人； 我招呼我的勇士－ 就是那矜夸高傲之辈， 为要成就我怒中所定的。
verses.textEnNiv: I have commanded those I prepared for battle; I have summoned my warriors to carry out my wrath— those who rejoice in my triumph.
verses.textEnEsv: I myself have commanded my consecrated ones, and have summoned my mighty men to execute my anger, my proudly exulting ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have commanded My sanctified ones; I have also called My mighty ones for My anger— Those who rejoice in My exaltation."
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Lord , have dedicated these soldiers for this task. Yes, I have called mighty warriors to express my anger, and they will rejoice when I am exalted."
verses.textEnNasb: I have commanded My consecrated ones, I have also called for My warriors Who boast in My eminence, To execute My anger.
verses.textEn: I have commanded those I prepared for battle; I have summoned my warriors to carry out my wrath— those who rejoice in my triumph.

verses.textZh: 听啊！山上有喧哗的声音， 好象是众多的人民； 听啊！有多国的人的嘈杂声， 好象是列国聚集在一起。 万军之耶和华正在数点军兵，预备打仗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听啊！山上有喧哗的声音， 好象是众多的人民； 听啊！有多国的人的嘈杂声， 好象是列国聚集在一起。 万军之耶和华正在数点军兵，预备打仗。
verses.textZhCuv: 山间有多人的声音， 好像是大国人民。 有许多国的民聚集哄嚷的声音； 这是万军之耶和华点齐军队，预备打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, a noise on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations massing together! The Lord Almighty is mustering an army for war.
verses.textEnEsv: The sound of a tumult is on the mountains as of a great multitude! The sound of an uproar of kingdoms, of nations gathering together! The Lord of hosts is mustering a host for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, Like that of many people! A tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together! The Lord of hosts musters The army for battle.
verses.textEnNlt: Hear the noise on the mountains! Listen, as the vast armies march! It is the noise and shouting of many nations. The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has called this army together.
verses.textEnNasb: A sound of a roar on the mountains, Like that of many people! A sound of an uproar of kingdoms, Of nations gathered together! The Lord of armies is mustering the army for battle.
verses.textEn: Listen, a noise on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations massing together! The Lord Almighty is mustering an army for war.

verses.textZh: 他们从远地而来， 从天边而来。 就是耶和华和他恼怒的工具， 要毁灭这全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从远地而来， 从天边而来。 就是耶和华和他恼怒的工具， 要毁灭这全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从远方来， 从天边来， 就是耶和华并他恼恨的兵器 要毁灭这全地。
verses.textEnNiv: They come from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens— the Lord and the weapons of his wrath— to destroy the whole country.
verses.textEnEsv: They come from a distant land, from the end of the heavens, the Lord and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.textEnNkjv: They come from a far country, From the end of heaven— The Lord and His weapons of indignation, To destroy the whole land.
verses.textEnNlt: They come from distant countries, from beyond the farthest horizons. They are the Lord ’s weapons to carry out his anger. With them he will destroy the whole land.
verses.textEnNasb: They are coming from a distant country, From the farthest horizons, The Lord and the weapons of His indignation, To destroy the whole land.
verses.textEn: They come from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens— the Lord and the weapons of his wrath— to destroy the whole country.

verses.textZh: 哀号吧！因为耶和华的日子近了， 这日子来到，好象毁灭从全能者那里来到一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哀号吧！因为耶和华的日子近了， 这日子来到，好象毁灭从全能者那里来到一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要哀号， 因为耶和华的日子临近了！ 这日来到， 好像毁灭从全能者来到。
verses.textEnNiv: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near; as destruction from the Almighty it will come!
verses.textEnNkjv: Wail, for the day of the Lordis at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: Scream in terror, for the day of the Lord has arrived— the time for the Almighty to destroy.
verses.textEnNasb: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.textEn: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

verses.textZh: 因此，各人的手都必发软， 各人也必心惊胆战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，各人的手都必发软， 各人也必心惊胆战。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，人手都必软弱； 人心都必消化。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this, all hands will go limp, every heart will melt with fear.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and every human heart will melt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all hands will be limp, Every man’s heart will melt,
verses.textEnNlt: Every arm is paralyzed with fear. Every heart melts,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore all hands will fall limp, And every human heart will melt.
verses.textEn: Because of this, all hands will go limp, every heart will melt with fear.

verses.textZh: 他们都要惊惶失措， 疼痛与痛苦必抓住他们； 他们必绞痛，像生产中的妇人一样。 他们在惊愕中彼此对望， 面色像火焰一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都要惊惶失措， 疼痛与痛苦必抓住他们； 他们必绞痛，像生产中的妇人一样。 他们在惊愕中彼此对望， 面色像火焰一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必惊惶悲痛； 愁苦必将他们抓住。 他们疼痛，好像产难的妇人一样， 彼此惊奇相看，脸如火焰。
verses.textEnNiv: Terror will seize them, pain and anguish will grip them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at each other, their faces aflame.
verses.textEnEsv: They will be dismayed: pangs and agony will seize them; they will be in anguish like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at one another; their faces will be aflame.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will be afraid. Pangs and sorrows will take hold of them; They will be in pain as a woman in childbirth; They will be amazed at one another; Their faces willbelike flames.
verses.textEnNlt: and people are terrified. Pangs of anguish grip them, like those of a woman in labor. They look helplessly at one another, their faces aflame with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: They will be terrified, Pains and anguish will take hold of them; They will writhe like a woman in labor, They will look at one another in astonishment, Their faces aflame.
verses.textEn: Terror will seize them, pain and anguish will grip them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at each other, their faces aflame.

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华的日子快来到， 必有残忍、愤恨与烈怒， 使这地荒凉， 使其中的罪人灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华的日子快来到， 必有残忍、愤恨与烈怒， 使这地荒凉， 使其中的罪人灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的日子临到， 必有残忍、忿恨、烈怒， 使这地荒凉， 从其中除灭罪人。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the day of the Lord is coming —a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger— to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the day of the Lord comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger, to make the land a desolation and to destroy its sinners from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the day of the Lord comes, Cruel, with both wrath and fierce anger, To lay the land desolate; And He will destroy its sinners from it.
verses.textEnNlt: For see, the day of the Lord is coming— the terrible day of his fury and fierce anger. The land will be made desolate, and all the sinners destroyed with it.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the day of the Lord is coming, Cruel, with fury and burning anger, To make the land a desolation; And He will exterminate its sinners from it.
verses.textEn: See, the day of the Lord is coming —a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger— to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it.

verses.textZh: 天上的星星和众星座 不再发光； 太阳刚出来就变为黑暗， 月亮也不再发光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的星星和众星座 不再发光； 太阳刚出来就变为黑暗， 月亮也不再发光。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上的众星群宿都不发光； 日头一出就变黑暗； 月亮也不放光。
verses.textEnNiv: The stars of heaven and their constellations will not show their light. The rising sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light.
verses.textEnEsv: For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not give their light; the sun will be dark at its rising, and the moon will not shed its light.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the stars of heaven and their constellations Will not give their light; The sun will be darkened in its going forth, And the moon will not cause its light to shine.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens will be black above them; the stars will give no light. The sun will be dark when it rises, and the moon will provide no light.
verses.textEnNasb: For the stars of heaven and their constellations Will not flash their light; The sun will be dark when it rises And the moon will not shed its light.
verses.textEn: The stars of heaven and their constellations will not show their light. The rising sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light.

verses.textZh: 我必因世界的邪恶施行刑罚， 也必因恶人的罪孽惩罚他们； 我要使狂妄人的骄傲止息， 使强暴人的狂傲降卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必因世界的邪恶施行刑罚， 也必因恶人的罪孽惩罚他们； 我要使狂妄人的骄傲止息， 使强暴人的狂傲降卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必因邪恶刑罚世界， 因罪孽刑罚恶人， 使骄傲人的狂妄止息， 制伏强暴人的狂傲。
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish the world for its evil, the wicked for their sins. I will put an end to the arrogance of the haughty and will humble the pride of the ruthless.
verses.textEnEsv: I will punish the world for its evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; I will put an end to the pomp of the arrogant, and lay low the pompous pride of the ruthless.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will punish the world for its evil, And the wicked for their iniquity; I will halt the arrogance of the proud, And will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.textEnNlt: "I, the Lord , will punish the world for its evil and the wicked for their sin. I will crush the arrogance of the proud and humble the pride of the mighty.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will punish the world for its evil And the wicked for their wrongdoing; I will also put an end to the audacity of the proud And humiliate the arrogance of the tyrants.
verses.textEn: I will punish the world for its evil, the wicked for their sins. I will put an end to the arrogance of the haughty and will humble the pride of the ruthless.

verses.textZh: 我必使人比精金还少， 使人比俄斐的金更稀罕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使人比精金还少， 使人比俄斐的金更稀罕。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使人比精金还少， 使人比俄斐纯金更少。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make people scarcer than pure gold, more rare than the gold of Ophir.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make people more rare than fine gold, and mankind than the gold of Ophir.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make a mortal more rare than fine gold, A man more than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make people scarcer than gold— more rare than the fine gold of Ophir.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make mortal man scarcer than pure gold And mankind than the gold of Ophir.
verses.textEn: I will make people scarcer than pure gold, more rare than the gold of Ophir.

verses.textZh: 在万军之耶和华发怒的时候， 就是我大发烈怒的日子， 我要使天震动， 大地必摇撼，离开本位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在万军之耶和华发怒的时候， 就是我大发烈怒的日子， 我要使天震动， 大地必摇撼，离开本位。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－万军之耶和华在忿恨中发烈怒的日子， 必使天震动， 使地摇撼，离其本位。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble; and the earth will shake from its place at the wrath of the Lord Almighty, in the day of his burning anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place, at the wrath of the Lord of hosts in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will shake the heavens, And the earth will move out of her place, In the wrath of the Lord of hosts And in the day of His fierce anger.
verses.textEnNlt: For I will shake the heavens. The earth will move from its place when the Lord of Heaven’s Armies displays his wrath in the day of his fierce anger."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, And the earth will be shaken from its place At the fury of the Lord of armies In the day of His burning anger.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble; and the earth will shake from its place at the wrath of the Lord Almighty, in the day of his burning anger.

verses.textZh: 人必像被追猎的羚羊， 又像无人招聚的羊群， 各自归向本族， 各自逃回本地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人必像被追猎的羚羊， 又像无人招聚的羊群， 各自归向本族， 各自逃回本地。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必像被追赶的鹿， 像无人收聚的羊， 各归回本族， 各逃到本土。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a hunted gazelle, like sheep without a shepherd, they will all return to their own people, they will flee to their native land.
verses.textEnEsv: And like a hunted gazelle, or like sheep with none to gather them, each will turn to his own people, and each will flee to his own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be as the hunted gazelle, And as a sheep that no man takes up; Every man will turn to his own people, And everyone will flee to his own land.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone in Babylon will run about like a hunted gazelle, like sheep without a shepherd. They will try to find their own people and flee to their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be that, like a hunted gazelle, Or like sheep with no one to gather them, Each of them will turn to his own people, And each of them will flee to his own land.
verses.textEn: Like a hunted gazelle, like sheep without a shepherd, they will all return to their own people, they will flee to their native land.

verses.textZh: 凡被追上的，必被刺死； 凡被捉住的，必倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡被追上的，必被刺死； 凡被捉住的，必倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡被仇敌追上的必被刺死； 凡被捉住的必被刀杀。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever is captured will be thrust through; all who are caught will fall by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is found will be thrust through, and whoever is caught will fall by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone who is found will be thrust through, And everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who is captured will be cut down— run through with a sword.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who is found will be thrust through, And anyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
verses.textEn: Whoever is captured will be thrust through; all who are caught will fall by the sword.

verses.textZh: 他们的婴孩必在他们眼前被摔死； 他们的房屋必被抢掠， 他们的妻子必被污辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的婴孩必在他们眼前被摔死； 他们的房屋必被抢掠， 他们的妻子必被污辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的婴孩必在他们眼前摔碎； 他们的房屋必被抢夺； 他们的妻子必被玷污。
verses.textEnNiv: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be looted and their wives violated.
verses.textEnEsv: Their infants will be dashed in pieces before their eyes; their houses will be plundered and their wives ravished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their children also will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; Their houses will be plundered And their wives ravished.
verses.textEnNlt: Their little children will be dashed to death before their eyes. Their homes will be sacked, and their wives will be raped.
verses.textEnNasb: Their little ones also will be dashed to pieces Before their eyes; Their houses will be plundered And their wives raped.
verses.textEn: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be looted and their wives violated.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要激动玛代人来攻击他们。 玛代人不重视银子，也不喜爱金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要激动玛代人来攻击他们。 玛代人不重视银子，也不喜爱金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必激动米底亚人来攻击他们。 米底亚人不注重银子， 也不喜爱金子。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I will stir up against them the Medes, who do not care for silver and have no delight in gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am stirring up the Medes against them, who have no regard for silver and do not delight in gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, Who will not regard silver; And asfor gold, they will not delight in it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I will stir up the Medes against Babylon. They cannot be tempted by silver or bribed with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am going to stir up the Medes against them, Who will not value silver or take pleasure in gold.
verses.textEn: See, I will stir up against them the Medes, who do not care for silver and have no delight in gold.

verses.textZh: 他们的弓箭必射倒年轻人， 他们不怜悯妇人腹中的婴儿； 他们的眼也不顾惜小孩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的弓箭必射倒年轻人， 他们不怜悯妇人腹中的婴儿； 他们的眼也不顾惜小孩。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必用弓击碎少年人， 不怜悯妇人所生的， 眼也不顾惜孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: Their bows will strike down the young men; they will have no mercy on infants, nor will they look with compassion on children.
verses.textEnEsv: Their bows will slaughter the young men; they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb; their eyes will not pity children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also their bows will dash the young men to pieces, And they will have no pity on the fruit of the womb; Their eye will not spare children.
verses.textEnNlt: The attacking armies will shoot down the young men with arrows. They will have no mercy on helpless babies and will show no compassion for children."
verses.textEnNasb: And their bows will mow down the young men, They will not even have compassion on the fruit of the womb, Nor will their eye pity children.
verses.textEn: Their bows will strike down the young men; they will have no mercy on infants, nor will they look with compassion on children.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦本是列国中的华美，是迦勒底人引以为傲的荣耀， 必像神倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦本是列国中的华美，是迦勒底人引以为傲的荣耀， 必像神倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦素来为列国的荣耀， 为迦勒底人所矜夸的华美， 必像神所倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the pride and glory of the Babylonians, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the splendor and pomp of the Chaldeans, will be like Sodom and Gomorrah when God overthrew them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, The beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, Will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.textEnNlt: Babylon, the most glorious of kingdoms, the flower of Chaldean pride, will be devastated like Sodom and Gomorrah when God destroyed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Babylon, the beauty of kingdoms, the glory of the Chaldeans’ pride, Will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.textEn: Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the pride and glory of the Babylonians, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.textZh: 那地必永远没有居民，世世代代无人居住； 阿拉伯人不在那里搭帐幕； 牧羊人也不领羊群躺卧在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地必永远没有居民，世世代代无人居住； 阿拉伯人不在那里搭帐幕； 牧羊人也不领羊群躺卧在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 其内必永无人烟， 世世代代无人居住。 阿拉伯人也不在那里支搭帐棚； 牧羊的人也不使羊群卧在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: She will never be inhabited or lived in through all generations; there no nomads will pitch their tents, there no shepherds will rest their flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: It will never be inhabited or lived in for all generations; no Arab will pitch his tent there; no shepherds will make their flocks lie down there.
verses.textEnNkjv: It will never be inhabited, Nor will it be settled from generation to generation; Nor will the Arabian pitch tents there, Nor will the shepherds make their sheepfolds there.
verses.textEnNlt: Babylon will never be inhabited again. It will remain empty for generation after generation. Nomads will refuse to camp there, and shepherds will not bed down their sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: It will never be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation; Nor will the Arab pitch his tent there, Nor will shepherds allow their flocks to lie down there.
verses.textEn: She will never be inhabited or lived in through all generations; there no nomads will pitch their tents, there no shepherds will rest their flocks.

verses.textZh: 躺卧在那里的，只有旷野的走兽； 充满着他们房屋的，只有吼叫着的野兽； 鸵鸟住在那里，野山羊在那里跳跃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 躺卧在那里的，只有旷野的走兽； 充满着他们房屋的，只有吼叫着的野兽； 鸵鸟住在那里，野山羊在那里跳跃。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有旷野的走兽卧在那里； 咆哮的兽满了房屋。 鸵鸟住在那里； 野山羊在那里跳舞。
verses.textEnNiv: But desert creatures will lie there, jackals will fill her houses; there the owls will dwell, and there the wild goats will leap about.
verses.textEnEsv: But wild animals will lie down there, and their houses will be full of howling creatures; there ostriches will dwell, and there wild goats will dance.
verses.textEnNkjv: But wild beasts of the desert will lie there, And their houses will be full of owls; Ostriches will dwell there, And wild goats will caper there.
verses.textEnNlt: Desert animals will move into the ruined city, and the houses will be haunted by howling creatures. Owls will live among the ruins, and wild goats will go there to dance.
verses.textEnNasb: But desert creatures will lie down there, And their houses will be full of owls; Ostriches also will live there, and shaggy goats will frolic there.
verses.textEn: But desert creatures will lie there, jackals will fill her houses; there the owls will dwell, and there the wild goats will leap about.

verses.textZh: 豺狼必在巴比伦的宫中呼号， 野狗必在他们华美的殿里吠叫。 巴比伦受罚的时候临近了， 它的日子必不长久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 豺狼必在巴比伦的宫中呼号， 野狗必在他们华美的殿里吠叫。 巴比伦受罚的时候临近了， 它的日子必不长久。
verses.textZhCuv: 豺狼必在它宫中呼号； 野狗必在它华美殿内吼叫。 巴比伦受罚的时候临近； 它的日子必不长久。
verses.textEnNiv: Hyenas will inhabit her strongholds, jackals her luxurious palaces. Her time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.
verses.textEnEsv: Hyenas will cry in its towers, and jackals in the pleasant palaces; its time is close at hand and its days will not be prolonged.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hyenas will howl in their citadels, And jackals in their pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, And her days will not be prolonged."
verses.textEnNlt: Hyenas will howl in its fortresses, and jackals will make dens in its luxurious palaces. Babylon’s days are numbered; its time of destruction will soon arrive.
verses.textEnNasb: Hyenas will howl in their fortified towers And jackals in their luxurious palaces. Her fateful time also will soon come, And her days will not be prolonged.
verses.textEn: Hyenas will inhabit her strongholds, jackals her luxurious palaces. Her time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.

verses.textZh: 耶和华怜悯雅各， 再拣选以色列， 使他们安居在自己的国土上的时候， 外族人必与他们联合， 归属于雅各家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华怜悯雅各， 再拣选以色列， 使他们安居在自己的国土上的时候， 外族人必与他们联合， 归属于雅各家。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要怜恤雅各，必再拣选以色列，将他们安置在本地。寄居的必与他们联合，紧贴雅各家。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will have compassion on Jacob; once again he will choose Israel and will settle them in their own land. Foreigners will join them and unite with the descendants of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose Israel, and will set them in their own land, and sojourners will join them and will attach themselves to the house of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will still choose Israel, and settle them in their own land. The strangers will be joined with them, and they will cling to the house of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord will have mercy on the descendants of Jacob. He will choose Israel as his special people once again. He will bring them back to settle once again in their own land. And people from many different nations will come and join them there and unite with the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord has compassion on Jacob and again chooses Israel, and settles them on their own land, then strangers will join them and attach themselves to the house of Jacob.
verses.textEn: The Lord will have compassion on Jacob; once again he will choose Israel and will settle them in their own land. Foreigners will join them and unite with the descendants of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 以色列人必把他们带回自己的国土去， 以色列家必在耶和华所赐的地上得着这些外族人作仆婢； 也要掳掠那些掳掠过他们的， 并且统治那些欺压过他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人必把他们带回自己的国土去， 以色列家必在耶和华所赐的地上得着这些外族人作仆婢； 也要掳掠那些掳掠过他们的， 并且统治那些欺压过他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人必将他们带回本土；以色列家必在耶和华的地上得外邦人为仆婢，也要掳掠先前掳掠他们的，辖制先前欺压他们的。
verses.textEnNiv: Nations will take them and bring them to their own place. And Israel will take possession of the nations and make them male and female servants in the Lord ’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.
verses.textEnEsv: And the peoples will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess them in the Lord ’s land as male and female slaves. They will take captive those who were their captors, and rule over those who oppressed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then people will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess them for servants and maids in the land of the Lord; they will take them captive whose captives they were, and rule over their oppressors.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations of the world will help the people of Israel to return, and those who come to live in the Lord ’s land will serve them. Those who captured Israel will themselves be captured, and Israel will rule over its enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: The peoples will take them along and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will make them their own possession in the land of the Lord as male and female servants; and they will take their captors captive and will rule over their oppressors.
verses.textEn: Nations will take them and bring them to their own place. And Israel will take possession of the nations and make them male and female servants in the Lord ’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使你脱离痛苦、愁烦、被迫作的苦工，得享安息的日子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使你脱离痛苦、愁烦、被迫作的苦工，得享安息的日子，
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华使你脱离愁苦、烦恼，并人勉强你做的苦工，得享安息的日子，
verses.textEnNiv: On the day the Lord gives you relief from your suffering and turmoil and from the harsh labor forced on you,
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord has given you rest from your pain and turmoil and the hard service with which you were made to serve,
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in the day the Lord gives you rest from your sorrow, and from your fear and the hard bondage in which you were made to serve,
verses.textEnNlt: In that wonderful day when the Lord gives his people rest from sorrow and fear, from slavery and chains,
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be on the day when the Lord gives you rest from your hardship, your turmoil, and from the harsh service in which you have been enslaved,
verses.textEn: On the day the Lord gives you relief from your suffering and turmoil and from the harsh labor forced on you,

verses.textZh: 你必唱出这首诗歌来讽刺巴比伦王，说： "欺压人的，怎么止息了呢！ 强暴怎么止住了呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必唱出这首诗歌来讽刺巴比伦王，说： "欺压人的，怎么止息了呢！ 强暴怎么止住了呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 你必题这诗歌论巴比伦王说： 欺压人的何竟息灭？ 强暴的何竟止息？
verses.textEnNiv: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has come to an end! How his fury has ended!
verses.textEnEsv: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: "How the oppressor has ceased, the insolent fury ceased!
verses.textEnNkjv: that you will take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say: "How the oppressor has ceased, The golden city ceased!
verses.textEnNlt: you will taunt the king of Babylon. You will say, "The mighty man has been destroyed. Yes, your insolence is ended.
verses.textEnNasb: that you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon, and say, "How the oppressor has ceased, And how the onslaught has ceased!
verses.textEn: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has come to an end! How his fury has ended!

verses.textZh: 耶和华折断了恶人的杖 和统治者的棒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华折断了恶人的杖 和统治者的棒，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华折断了恶人的杖， 辖制人的圭，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has broken the rod of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of rulers,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked, The scepter of the rulers;
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has crushed your wicked power and broken your evil rule.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked, The scepter of rulers,
verses.textEn: The Lord has broken the rod of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

verses.textZh: 就是那在忿怒中不住击打众民、 在怒气中管辖列国、毫无抑制地施行迫害的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是那在忿怒中不住击打众民、 在怒气中管辖列国、毫无抑制地施行迫害的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在忿怒中连连攻击众民的， 在怒气中辖制列国， 行逼迫无人阻止的。
verses.textEnNiv: which in anger struck down peoples with unceasing blows, and in fury subdued nations with relentless aggression.
verses.textEnEsv: that struck the peoples in wrath with unceasing blows, that ruled the nations in anger with unrelenting persecution.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who struck the people in wrath with a continual stroke, He who ruled the nations in anger, Is persecuted and no one hinders.
verses.textEnNlt: You struck the people with endless blows of rage and held the nations in your angry grip with unrelenting tyranny.
verses.textEnNasb: Which used to strike the peoples in fury with unceasing strokes, Which subdued the nations in anger with unrestrained persecution.
verses.textEn: which in anger struck down peoples with unceasing blows, and in fury subdued nations with relentless aggression.

verses.textZh: 现在全地都平静安息， 各人都发声欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在全地都平静安息， 各人都发声欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在全地得安息，享平静； 人皆发声欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: All the lands are at rest and at peace; they break into singing.
verses.textEnEsv: The whole earth is at rest and quiet; they break forth into singing.
verses.textEnNkjv: The whole earth is at rest and quiet; They break forth into singing.
verses.textEnNlt: But finally the earth is at rest and quiet. Now it can sing again!
verses.textEnNasb: "The whole earth is at rest and is quiet; They break forth into shouts of joy.
verses.textEn: All the lands are at rest and at peace; they break into singing.

verses.textZh: 连松树和黎巴嫩的香柏树都因你欢乐，说： ‘自从你躺下以后，再没有砍伐的人上来砍伐我们了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 连松树和黎巴嫩的香柏树都因你欢乐，说： ‘自从你躺下以后，再没有砍伐的人上来砍伐我们了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 松树和黎巴嫩的香柏树 都因你欢乐，说： 自从你仆倒， 再无人上来砍伐我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the junipers and the cedars of Lebanon gloat over you and say, "Now that you have been laid low, no one comes to cut us down."
verses.textEnEsv: The cypresses rejoice at you, the cedars of Lebanon, saying, ‘Since you were laid low, no woodcutter comes up against us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed the cypress trees rejoice over you, And the cedars of Lebanon, Saying, ‘Since you were cut down, No woodsman has come up against us.’
verses.textEnNlt: Even the trees of the forest— the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon— sing out this joyous song: ‘Since you have been cut down, no one will come now to cut us down!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Even the juniper trees rejoice over you, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, ‘Since you have been laid low, no tree cutter comes up against us.’
verses.textEn: Even the junipers and the cedars of Lebanon gloat over you and say, "Now that you have been laid low, no one comes to cut us down."

verses.textZh: 地下的阴间因你震动，并迎接你的来临； 又因你而唤醒了所有曾在地上作过领袖的阴魂； 又使所有曾在列国中作君王的，都离位站起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地下的阴间因你震动，并迎接你的来临； 又因你而唤醒了所有曾在地上作过领袖的阴魂； 又使所有曾在列国中作君王的，都离位站起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你下到阴间， 阴间就因你震动来迎接你， 又因你惊动在世曾为首领的阴魂， 并使那曾为列国君王的， 都离位站起。
verses.textEnNiv: The realm of the dead below is all astir to meet you at your coming; it rouses the spirits of the departed to greet you— all those who were leaders in the world; it makes them rise from their thrones— all those who were kings over the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: Sheol beneath is stirred up to meet you when you come; it rouses the shades to greet you, all who were leaders of the earth; it raises from their thrones all who were kings of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hell from beneath is excited about you, To meet you at your coming; It stirs up the dead for you, All the chief ones of the earth; It has raised up from their thrones All the kings of the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: "In the place of the dead there is excitement over your arrival. The spirits of world leaders and mighty kings long dead stand up to see you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Sheol below is excited about you, to meet you when you come; It stirs the spirits of the dead for you, all the leaders of the earth; It raises all the kings of the nations from their thrones.
verses.textEn: The realm of the dead below is all astir to meet you at your coming; it rouses the spirits of the departed to greet you— all those who were leaders in the world; it makes them rise from their thrones— all those who were kings over the nations.

verses.textZh: 他们都必答话，对你说： ‘你也变为衰弱，像我们一样吗？ 你也与我们相似吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都必答话，对你说： ‘你也变为衰弱，像我们一样吗？ 你也与我们相似吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都要发言对你说： 你也变为软弱像我们一样吗？ 你也成了我们的样子吗？
verses.textEnNiv: They will all respond, they will say to you, "You also have become weak, as we are; you have become like us."
verses.textEnEsv: All of them will answer and say to you: ‘You too have become as weak as we! You have become like us!’
verses.textEnNkjv: They all shall speak and say to you: ‘Have you also become as weak as we? Have you become like us?
verses.textEnNlt: With one voice they all cry out, ‘Now you are as weak as we are!
verses.textEnNasb: "They will all respond and say to you, ‘Even you have become weak as we, You have become like us.
verses.textEn: They will all respond, they will say to you, "You also have become weak, as we are; you have become like us."

verses.textZh: 你的威势和你的琴瑟音乐， 都被带下阴间了； 你下面铺的是虫， 上面盖的是蛆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的威势和你的琴瑟音乐， 都被带下阴间了； 你下面铺的是虫， 上面盖的是蛆。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的威势和你琴瑟的声音都下到阴间。 你下铺的是虫，上盖的是蛆。
verses.textEnNiv: All your pomp has been brought down to the grave, along with the noise of your harps; maggots are spread out beneath you and worms cover you.
verses.textEnEsv: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, the sound of your harps; maggots are laid as a bed beneath you, and worms are your covers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, And the sound of your stringed instruments; The maggot is spread under you, And worms cover you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Your might and power were buried with you. The sound of the harp in your palace has ceased. Now maggots are your sheet, and worms your blanket.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Your pride and the music of your harps Have been brought down to Sheol; Maggots are spread out as your bed beneath you And worms are your covering.’
verses.textEn: All your pomp has been brought down to the grave, along with the noise of your harps; maggots are spread out beneath you and worms cover you.

verses.textZh: 明亮之星、清晨之子啊！ 你怎么从天上坠落？ 你这倾覆列国的， 怎么被砍倒在地上？
verses.textZhCnvs: 明亮之星、清晨之子啊！ 你怎么从天上坠落？ 你这倾覆列国的， 怎么被砍倒在地上？
verses.textZhCuv: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊， 你何竟从天坠落？ 你这攻败列国的何竟被砍倒在地上？
verses.textEnNiv: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! You have been cast down to the earth, you who once laid low the nations!
verses.textEnEsv: "How you are fallen from heaven, O Day Star, son of Dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, you who laid the nations low!
verses.textEnNkjv: "How you are fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! How you are cut down to the ground, You who weakened the nations!
verses.textEnNlt: "How you are fallen from heaven, O shining star, son of the morning! You have been thrown down to the earth, you who destroyed the nations of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: "How you have fallen from heaven, You star of the morning, son of the dawn! You have been cut down to the earth, You who defeated the nations!
verses.textEn: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! You have been cast down to the earth, you who once laid low the nations!

verses.textZh: 你心里曾说： ‘我要升到天上， 我要高举我的宝座到神的众星之上， 我要坐在聚会的山上， 在北方的极处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你心里曾说： ‘我要升到天上， 我要高举我的宝座到神的众星之上， 我要坐在聚会的山上， 在北方的极处。
verses.textZhCuv: 你心里曾说： 我要升到天上； 我要高举我的宝座在神众星以上； 我要坐在聚会的山上，在北方的极处。
verses.textEnNiv: You said in your heart, "I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit enthroned on the mount of assembly, on the utmost heights of Mount Zaphon.
verses.textEnEsv: You said in your heart, ‘I will ascend to heaven; above the stars of God I will set my throne on high; I will sit on the mount of assembly in the far reaches of the north;
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have said in your heart: ‘I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God; I will also sit on the mount of the congregation On the farthest sides of the north;
verses.textEnNlt: For you said to yourself, ‘I will ascend to heaven and set my throne above God’s stars. I will preside on the mountain of the gods far away in the north.
verses.textEnNasb: "But you said in your heart, ‘I will ascend to heaven; I will raise my throne above the stars of God, And I will sit on the mount of assembly In the recesses of the north.
verses.textEn: You said in your heart, "I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit enthroned on the mount of assembly, on the utmost heights of Mount Zaphon.

verses.textZh: 我要升到云的高处， 我要使自己像那至高者一般。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要升到云的高处， 我要使自己像那至高者一般。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我要升到高云之上； 我要与至上者同等。
verses.textEnNiv: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High."
verses.textEnEsv: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds, I will be like the Most High.’
verses.textEnNlt: I will climb to the highest heavens and be like the Most High.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.’
verses.textEn: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High."

verses.textZh: 然而，你却被拋下阴间， 落到坑中的极处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，你却被拋下阴间， 落到坑中的极处。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，你必坠落阴间， 到坑中极深之处。
verses.textEnNiv: But you are brought down to the realm of the dead, to the depths of the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: But you are brought down to Sheol, to the far reaches of the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, To the lowest depths of the Pit.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you will be brought down to the place of the dead, down to its lowest depths.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nevertheless you will be brought down to Sheol, To the recesses of the pit.
verses.textEn: But you are brought down to the realm of the dead, to the depths of the pit.

verses.textZh: 那些看见你的，都必定睛看你， 他们必注视着你，说： ‘那使大地震动， 使列国摇撼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些看见你的，都必定睛看你， 他们必注视着你，说： ‘那使大地震动， 使列国摇撼，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡看见你的都要定睛看你， 留意看你，说： 使大地战抖， 使列国震动，
verses.textEnNiv: Those who see you stare at you, they ponder your fate: "Is this the man who shook the earth and made kingdoms tremble,
verses.textEnEsv: Those who see you will stare at you and ponder over you: ‘Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who shook kingdoms,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Those who see you will gaze at you, And consider you, saying: ‘Is this the man who made the earth tremble, Who shook kingdoms,
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone there will stare at you and ask, ‘Can this be the one who shook the earth and made the kingdoms of the world tremble?
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who see you will stare at you, They will closely examine you, saying, ‘Is this the man who made the earth tremble, Who shook kingdoms,
verses.textEn: Those who see you stare at you, they ponder your fate: "Is this the man who shook the earth and made kingdoms tremble,

verses.textZh: 使世界如同荒野， 倾覆城镇， 又不释放囚犯的，就是这人吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 使世界如同荒野， 倾覆城镇， 又不释放囚犯的，就是这人吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 使世界如同荒野， 使城邑倾覆， 不释放被掳的人归家， 是这个人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: the man who made the world a wilderness, who overthrew its cities and would not let his captives go home?"
verses.textEnEsv: who made the world like a desert and overthrew its cities, who did not let his prisoners go home?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Who made the world as a wilderness And destroyed its cities, Who did not open the house of his prisoners?’
verses.textEnNlt: Is this the one who destroyed the world and made it into a wasteland? Is this the king who demolished the world’s greatest cities and had no mercy on his prisoners?’
verses.textEnNasb: Who made the world like a wilderness And overthrew its cities, Who did not allow his prisoners to go home?’
verses.textEn: the man who made the world a wilderness, who overthrew its cities and would not let his captives go home?"

verses.textZh: 列国的君王都在荣耀中安睡， 各在自己的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的君王都在荣耀中安睡， 各在自己的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国的君王 俱各在自己阴宅的荣耀中安睡。
verses.textEnNiv: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: All the kings of the nations lie in glory, each in his own tomb;
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the kings of the nations, All of them, sleep in glory, Everyone in his own house;
verses.textEnNlt: "The kings of the nations lie in stately glory, each in his own tomb,
verses.textEnNasb: "All the kings of the nations lie in glory, Each in his own tomb.
verses.textEn: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.

verses.textZh: 但你要从你的坟墓中被逐出， 好象一根被厌弃的树枝， 你被那些遭刀剑所杀的人掩盖， 就是那些被拋到坑中石头那里的人。 你就像一具遭人践踏的尸体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你要从你的坟墓中被逐出， 好象一根被厌弃的树枝， 你被那些遭刀剑所杀的人掩盖， 就是那些被拋到坑中石头那里的人。 你就像一具遭人践踏的尸体。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独你被抛弃， 不得入你的坟墓， 好像可憎的枝子， 以被杀的人为衣， 就是被刀刺透， 坠落坑中石头那里的； 你又像被践踏的尸首一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But you are cast out of your tomb like a rejected branch; you are covered with the slain, with those pierced by the sword, those who descend to the stones of the pit. Like a corpse trampled underfoot,
verses.textEnEsv: but you are cast out, away from your grave, like a loathed branch, clothed with the slain, those pierced by the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit, like a dead body trampled underfoot.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you are cast out of your grave Like an abominable branch, Like the garment of those who are slain, Thrust through with a sword, Who go down to the stones of the pit, Like a corpse trodden underfoot.
verses.textEnNlt: but you will be thrown out of your grave like a worthless branch. Like a corpse trampled underfoot, you will be dumped into a mass grave with those killed in battle. You will descend to the pit.
verses.textEnNasb: "But you have been hurled out of your tomb Like a rejected branch, Clothed with those killed who have been pierced with a sword, Who go down to the stones of the pit Like a trampled corpse.
verses.textEn: But you are cast out of your tomb like a rejected branch; you are covered with the slain, with those pierced by the sword, those who descend to the stones of the pit. Like a corpse trampled underfoot,

verses.textZh: 你必不得与别的君王同葬， 因为你败坏了你的国， 杀戮了你的人民； 愿那些恶人的后裔永远不被人提说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必不得与别的君王同葬， 因为你败坏了你的国， 杀戮了你的人民； 愿那些恶人的后裔永远不被人提说。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不得与君王同葬； 因为你败坏你的国，杀戮你的民。 恶人后裔的名，必永不提说。
verses.textEnNiv: you will not join them in burial, for you have destroyed your land and killed your people. Let the offspring of the wicked never be mentioned again.
verses.textEnEsv: You will not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, you have slain your people. "May the offspring of evildoers nevermore be named!
verses.textEnNkjv: You will not be joined with them in burial, Because you have destroyed your land And slain your people. The brood of evildoers shall never be named.
verses.textEnNlt: You will not be given a proper burial, for you have destroyed your nation and slaughtered your people. The descendants of such an evil person will never again receive honor.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will not be united with them in burial, Because you have ruined your country, You have killed your people. May the descendants of evildoers never be mentioned.
verses.textEn: you will not join them in burial, for you have destroyed your land and killed your people. Let the offspring of the wicked never be mentioned again.

verses.textZh: 因为他们的祖宗犯了罪孽， 你们要为他的子孙预备屠杀之处； 不要让他们兴起来，占有地土， 在世上布满城镇。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的祖宗犯了罪孽， 你们要为他的子孙预备屠杀之处； 不要让他们兴起来，占有地土， 在世上布满城镇。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先人既有罪孽， 就要预备杀戮他的子孙， 免得他们兴起来，得了遍地， 在世上修满城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: Prepare a place to slaughter his children for the sins of their ancestors; they are not to rise to inherit the land and cover the earth with their cities.
verses.textEnEsv: Prepare slaughter for his sons because of the guilt of their fathers, lest they rise and possess the earth, and fill the face of the world with cities."
verses.textEnNkjv: Prepare slaughter for his children Because of the iniquity of their fathers, Lest they rise up and possess the land, And fill the face of the world with cities."
verses.textEnNlt: Kill this man’s children! Let them die because of their father’s sins! They must not rise and conquer the earth, filling the world with their cities."
verses.textEnNasb: "Prepare a place of slaughter for his sons Because of the wrongdoing of their fathers. They must not arise and take possession of the earth, And fill the surface of the world with cities."
verses.textEn: Prepare a place to slaughter his children for the sins of their ancestors; they are not to rise to inherit the land and cover the earth with their cities.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说："我必兴起攻击他们，把巴比伦的名号、所剩余的人，以及后裔子孙，都一同剪除。"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说："我必兴起攻击他们，把巴比伦的名号、所剩余的人，以及后裔子孙，都一同剪除。"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说： 我必兴起攻击他们， 将巴比伦的名号和所余剩的人， 连子带孙一并剪除。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will rise up against them," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will wipe out Babylon’s name and survivors, her offspring and descendants," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I will rise up against them," declares the Lord of hosts, "and will cut off from Babylon name and remnant, descendants and posterity," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "For I will rise up against them," says the Lord of hosts, "And cut off from Babylon the name and remnant, And offspring and posterity," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "I, myself, have risen against Babylon! I will destroy its children and its children’s children," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will rise up against them," declares the Lord of armies, "and eliminate from Babylon name and survivors, offspring and descendants," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I will rise up against them," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will wipe out Babylon’s name and survivors, her offspring and descendants," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我必使巴比伦被箭猪所占，又使它变为泥沼之地；我必用毁灭的扫帚把它扫净。"这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必使巴比伦被箭猪所占，又使它变为泥沼之地；我必用毁灭的扫帚把它扫净。"这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使巴比伦为箭猪所得， 又变为水池； 我要用灭亡的扫帚扫净它。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will turn her into a place for owls and into swampland; I will sweep her with the broom of destruction," declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I will make it a possession of the hedgehog, and pools of water, and I will sweep it with the broom of destruction," declares the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, And marshes of muddy water; I will sweep it with the broom of destruction," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will make Babylon a desolate place of owls, filled with swamps and marshes. I will sweep the land with the broom of destruction. I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also make it the property of the hedgehog and swamps of water, and I will sweep it away with the broom of destruction," declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: "I will turn her into a place for owls and into swampland; I will sweep her with the broom of destruction," declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华起了誓，说： "我怎样想，事就怎样成就； 我怎样计划，事就怎样立定，
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华起了誓，说： "我怎样想，事就怎样成就； 我怎样计划，事就怎样立定，
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华起誓说： 我怎样思想，必照样成就； 我怎样定意，必照样成立，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty has sworn, "Surely, as I have planned, so it will be, and as I have purposed, so it will happen.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts has sworn: "As I have planned, so shall it be, and as I have purposed, so shall it stand,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts has sworn, saying, "Surely, as I have thought, so it shall come to pass, And as I have purposed, so it shall stand:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has sworn this oath: "It will all happen as I have planned. It will be as I have decided.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies has sworn, saying, "Certainly, just as I have intended, so it has happened, and just as I have planned, so it will stand,
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty has sworn, "Surely, as I have planned, so it will be, and as I have purposed, so it will happen.

verses.textZh: 就是在我的地上粉碎亚述人， 在我的山上践踏他； 他所加的轭必离开以色列人， 他所加的重担必离开以色列人的肩头。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是在我的地上粉碎亚述人， 在我的山上践踏他； 他所加的轭必离开以色列人， 他所加的重担必离开以色列人的肩头。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在我地上打折亚述人， 在我山上将他践踏。 他加的轭必离开以色列人； 他加的重担必离开他们的肩头。
verses.textEnNiv: I will crush the Assyrian in my land; on my mountains I will trample him down. His yoke will be taken from my people, and his burden removed from their shoulders."
verses.textEnEsv: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and on my mountains trample him underfoot; and his yoke shall depart from them, and his burden from their shoulder."
verses.textEnNkjv: That I will break the Assyrian in My land, And on My mountains tread him underfoot. Then his yoke shall be removed from them, And his burden removed from their shoulders.
verses.textEnNlt: I will break the Assyrians when they are in Israel; I will trample them on my mountains. My people will no longer be their slaves nor bow down under their heavy loads.
verses.textEnNasb: to break Assyria in My land, and I will trample him on My mountains. Then his yoke will be removed from them, and his burden removed from their shoulders.
verses.textEn: I will crush the Assyrian in my land; on my mountains I will trample him down. His yoke will be taken from my people, and his burden removed from their shoulders."

verses.textZh: 这就是对全地所定的旨意， 就是向列国伸出的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是对全地所定的旨意， 就是向列国伸出的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是向全地所定的旨意； 这是向万国所伸出的手。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the plan determined for the whole world; this is the hand stretched out over all nations.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the purpose that is purposed concerning the whole earth, and this is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the purpose that is purposed against the whole earth, And this is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: I have a plan for the whole earth, a hand of judgment upon all the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the plan devised against the entire earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out against all the nations.
verses.textEn: This is the plan determined for the whole world; this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华决定的事， 谁能阻拦呢？ 他的手伸了出来， 谁能使他收回呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华决定的事， 谁能阻拦呢？ 他的手伸了出来， 谁能使他收回呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华既然定意，谁能废弃呢？ 他的手已经伸出，谁能转回呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord Almighty has purposed, and who can thwart him? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord of hosts has purposed, and who will annul it? His hand is stretched out, and who will turn it back?
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord of hosts has purposed, And who will annul it? His hand is stretched out, And who will turn it back?"
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has spoken— who can change his plans? When his hand is raised, who can stop him?"
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord of armies has planned, and who can frustrate it? And as for His stretched-out hand, who can turn it back?"
verses.textEn: For the Lord Almighty has purposed, and who can thwart him? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯王去世的那一年，有以下的默示：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯王去世的那一年，有以下的默示：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯王崩的那年，就有以下的默示：
verses.textEnNiv: This prophecy came in the year King Ahaz died:
verses.textEnEsv: In the year that King Ahaz died came this oracle:
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the burden which came in the year that King Ahaz died.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me the year King Ahaz died:
verses.textEnNasb: In the year that King Ahaz died, this pronouncement came:
verses.textEn: This prophecy came in the year King Ahaz died:

verses.textZh: 非利士全地啊！ 不要因为那击打你们的杖折断了就欢喜， 因为从蛇的根必生出毒蛇来， 牠所生的，是会飞的蛇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士全地啊！ 不要因为那击打你们的杖折断了就欢喜， 因为从蛇的根必生出毒蛇来， 牠所生的，是会飞的蛇。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士全地啊， 不要因击打你的杖折断就喜乐。 因为从蛇的根必生出毒蛇； 它所生的是火焰的飞龙。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken; from the root of that snake will spring up a viper, its fruit will be a darting, venomous serpent.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of you, that the rod that struck you is broken, for from the serpent’s root will come forth an adder, and its fruit will be a flying fiery serpent.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not rejoice, all you of Philistia, Because the rod that struck you is broken; For out of the serpent’s roots will come forth a viper, And its offspring willbe a fiery flying serpent.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not rejoice, you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken— that the king who attacked you is dead. For from that snake a more poisonous snake will be born, a fiery serpent to destroy you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not rejoice, Philistia, all of you, Because the rod that struck you is broken; For from the serpent’s root a viper will come out, And its fruit will be a winged serpent.
verses.textEn: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken; from the root of that snake will spring up a viper, its fruit will be a darting, venomous serpent.

verses.textZh: 最贫寒的人必有食物吃， 贫乏人必安然躺卧； 我必用饥荒毁灭你的根， 你余剩的人，必被饥荒所杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最贫寒的人必有食物吃， 贫乏人必安然躺卧； 我必用饥荒毁灭你的根， 你余剩的人，必被饥荒所杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 贫寒人的长子必有所食； 穷乏人必安然躺卧。 我必以饥荒治死你的根； 你所余剩的人必被杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: The poorest of the poor will find pasture, and the needy will lie down in safety. But your root I will destroy by famine; it will slay your survivors.
verses.textEnEsv: And the firstborn of the poor will graze, and the needy lie down in safety; but I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant it will slay.
verses.textEnNkjv: The firstborn of the poor will feed, And the needy will lie down in safety; I will kill your roots with famine, And it will slay your remnant.
verses.textEnNlt: I will feed the poor in my pasture; the needy will lie down in peace. But as for you, I will wipe you out with famine and destroy the few who remain.
verses.textEnNasb: " Those who are most helpless will eat, And the poor will lie down in security; I will kill your root with famine, And it will kill your survivors.
verses.textEn: The poorest of the poor will find pasture, and the needy will lie down in safety. But your root I will destroy by famine; it will slay your survivors.

verses.textZh: 城门啊，要哀号！城镇啊，要呼叫！ 非利士全地啊，要战栗发软！ 因为有烟从北方来， 在他的行伍中没有离队逃走的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城门啊，要哀号！城镇啊，要呼叫！ 非利士全地啊，要战栗发软！ 因为有烟从北方来， 在他的行伍中没有离队逃走的。
verses.textZhCuv: 门哪，应当哀号！ 城啊，应当呼喊！ 非利士全地啊，你都消化了！ 因为有烟从北方出来， 他行伍中并无乱队的。
verses.textEnNiv: Wail, you gate! Howl, you city! Melt away, all you Philistines! A cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there is not a straggler in its ranks.
verses.textEnEsv: Wail, O gate; cry out, O city; melt in fear, O Philistia, all of you! For smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wail, O gate! Cry, O city! All you of Philistia are dissolved; For smoke will come from the north, And no one willbe alone in his appointed times."
verses.textEnNlt: Wail at the gates! Weep in the cities! Melt with fear, you Philistines! A powerful army comes like smoke from the north. Each soldier rushes forward eager to fight.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wail, you gate; cry, you city; Melt away, Philistia, all of you! For smoke comes from the north, And there is no straggler in his ranks.
verses.textEn: Wail, you gate! Howl, you city! Melt away, all you Philistines! A cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there is not a straggler in its ranks.

verses.textZh: 人要怎样回答外族的使者呢？要说： "耶和华建立了锡安， 他子民中的困苦人必在其中避难。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要怎样回答外族的使者呢？要说： "耶和华建立了锡安， 他子民中的困苦人必在其中避难。"
verses.textZhCuv: 可怎样回答外邦 的使者呢？ 必说：耶和华建立了锡安； 他百姓中的困苦人必投奔在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: What answer shall be given to the envoys of that nation? "The Lord has established Zion, and in her his afflicted people will find refuge."
verses.textEnEsv: What will one answer the messengers of the nation? "The Lord has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people find refuge."
verses.textEnNkjv: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord has founded Zion, And the poor of His people shall take refuge in it.
verses.textEnNlt: What should we tell the Philistine messengers? Tell them, "The Lord has built Jerusalem ; its walls will give refuge to his oppressed people."
verses.textEnNasb: "What answer will one give the messengers of the nation? That the Lord has founded Zion, And the poor of His people will take refuge in it."
verses.textEn: What answer shall be given to the envoys of that nation? "The Lord has established Zion, and in her his afflicted people will find refuge."

verses.textZh: 关于摩押的默示： 一夜之间，摩押的亚珥受到蹂躏，就灭亡了！ 一夜之间，摩押的基珥受到蹂躏，也灭亡了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于摩押的默示： 一夜之间，摩押的亚珥受到蹂躏，就灭亡了！ 一夜之间，摩押的基珥受到蹂躏，也灭亡了！
verses.textZhCuv: 论摩押的默示： 一夜之间，摩押的亚珥变为荒废， 归于无有； 一夜之间，摩押的基珥变为荒废， 归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night!
verses.textEnEsv: An oracle concerning Moab. Because Ar of Moab is laid waste in a night, Moab is undone; because Kir of Moab is laid waste in a night, Moab is undone.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste And destroyed, Because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste And destroyed,
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Moab: In one night the town of Ar will be leveled, and the city of Kir will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning Moab: Certainly in a night Ar of Moab is devastated and ruined; Certainly in a night Kir of Moab is devastated and ruined.
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night!

verses.textZh: 他们进入房子 ，又往底本，上到高处去哭泣， 摩押人为尼波和米底巴哀号； 各人头上都光秃，胡须剃净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进入房子 ，又往底本，上到高处去哭泣， 摩押人为尼波和米底巴哀号； 各人头上都光秃，胡须剃净。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上巴益，又往底本， 到高处去哭泣。 摩押人因尼波和米底巴哀号， 各人头上光秃， 胡须剃净。
verses.textEnNiv: Dibon goes up to its temple, to its high places to weep; Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba. Every head is shaved and every beard cut off.
verses.textEnEsv: He has gone up to the temple, and to Dibon, to the high places to weep; over Nebo and over Medeba Moab wails. On every head is baldness; every beard is shorn;
verses.textEnNkjv: He has gone up to the temple and Dibon, To the high places to weep. Moab will wail over Nebo and over Medeba; On all their heads willbe baldness, And every beard cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: Your people will go to their temple in Dibon to mourn. They will go to their sacred shrines to weep. They will wail for the fate of Nebo and Medeba, shaving their heads in sorrow and cutting off their beards.
verses.textEnNasb: The people have gone up to the temple and to Dibon, to the high places to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba; Everyone’s head is bald and every beard is cut off.
verses.textEn: Dibon goes up to its temple, to its high places to weep; Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba. Every head is shaved and every beard cut off.

verses.textZh: 他们在街上都腰束麻布； 在房顶上，在广场上， 各人都哀号，流泪痛哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在街上都腰束麻布； 在房顶上，在广场上， 各人都哀号，流泪痛哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在街市上都腰束麻布， 在房顶上和宽阔处俱各哀号， 眼泪汪汪。
verses.textEnNiv: In the streets they wear sackcloth; on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.
verses.textEnEsv: in the streets they wear sackcloth; on the housetops and in the squares everyone wails and melts in tears.
verses.textEnNkjv: In their streets they will clothe themselves with sackcloth; On the tops of their houses And in their streets Everyone will wail, weeping bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: They will wear burlap as they wander the streets. From every home and public square will come the sound of wailing.
verses.textEnNasb: In their streets they have put on sackcloth; On their housetops and in their public squares Everyone is wailing, overcome with weeping.
verses.textEn: In the streets they wear sackcloth; on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.

verses.textZh: 希实本和以利亚利都呼喊， 他们的声音达到雅杂， 因此摩押配带武器的人大声呼叫， 各人的心都战兢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希实本和以利亚利都呼喊， 他们的声音达到雅杂， 因此摩押配带武器的人大声呼叫， 各人的心都战兢。
verses.textZhCuv: 希实本和以利亚利悲哀的声音达到雅杂， 所以摩押带兵器的高声喊嚷， 人心战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out, their voices are heard all the way to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out, and their hearts are faint.
verses.textEnEsv: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voice is heard as far as Jahaz; therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; his soul trembles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heshbon and Elealeh will cry out, Their voice shall be heard as far as Jahaz; Therefore the armed soldiers of Moab will cry out; His life will be burdensome to him.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Heshbon and Elealeh will cry out; their voices will be heard as far away as Jahaz! The bravest warriors of Moab will cry out in utter terror. They will be helpless with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: Heshbon and Elealeh also cry out, Their voice is heard all the way to Jahaz; Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; His soul trembles within him.
verses.textEn: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out, their voices are heard all the way to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out, and their hearts are faint.

verses.textZh: 我的心为摩押哀号， 它的逃民一直去到琐珥，如同一头三岁大的牝牛，要挣脱苦轭， 他们登上鲁希的山坡，随走随哭， 他们在何罗念的路上，发出灭亡的哀号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心为摩押哀号， 它的逃民一直去到琐珥，如同一头三岁大的牝牛，要挣脱苦轭， 他们登上鲁希的山坡，随走随哭， 他们在何罗念的路上，发出灭亡的哀号。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心为摩押悲哀； 他的贵胄 逃到琐珥， 到伊基拉‧施利施亚。 他们上鲁希坡，随走随哭； 在何罗念的路上，因毁灭举起哀声。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they lament their destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart cries out for Moab; her fugitives flee to Zoar, to Eglath-shelishiyah. For at the ascent of Luhith they go up weeping; on the road to Horonaim they raise a cry of destruction;
verses.textEnNkjv: "My heart will cry out for Moab; His fugitives shallflee to Zoar, Like a three-year-old heifer. For by the Ascent of Luhith They will go up with weeping; For in the way of Horonaim They will raise up a cry of destruction,
verses.textEnNlt: My heart weeps for Moab. Its people flee to Zoar and Eglath-shelishiyah. Weeping, they climb the road to Luhith. Their cries of distress can be heard all along the road to Horonaim.
verses.textEnNasb: My heart cries out for Moab; His fugitives are as far as Zoar and Eglath-shelishiyah, For they go up the ascent of Luhith weeping; Indeed, on the road to Horonaim they raise a cry of distress over their collapse.
verses.textEn: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they lament their destruction.

verses.textZh: 因为宁林的众水都已荒凉， 青草枯干，嫩草灭没， 完全没有青绿之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为宁林的众水都已荒凉， 青草枯干，嫩草灭没， 完全没有青绿之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为宁林的水成为干涸， 青草枯干，嫩草灭没， 青绿之物，一无所有。
