verses.textEnNiv: The waters of Nimrim are dried up and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone and nothing green is left.
verses.textEnEsv: the waters of Nimrim are a desolation; the grass is withered, the vegetation fails, the greenery is no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate, For the green grass has withered away; The grass fails, there is nothing green.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the waters of Nimrim are dried up! The grassy banks are scorched. The tender plants are gone; nothing green remains.
verses.textEnNasb: For the waters of Nimrim are desolate. Indeed, the grass is withered, the new growth has died, There is no greenery.
verses.textEn: The waters of Nimrim are dried up and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone and nothing green is left.

verses.textZh: 所以，他们把所得的和所积蓄的财富， 都带过了柳树溪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，他们把所得的和所积蓄的财富， 都带过了柳树溪。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，摩押人所得的财物 和所积蓄的都要运过柳树河。
verses.textEnNiv: So the wealth they have acquired and stored up they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the abundance they have gained and what they have laid up they carry away over the Brook of the Willows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the abundance they have gained, And what they have laid up, They will carry away to the Brook of the Willows.
verses.textEnNlt: The people grab their possessions and carry them across the Ravine of Willows.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the abundance which they have acquired and stored up, They carry it off over the brook of Arabim.
verses.textEn: So the wealth they have acquired and stored up they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.

verses.textZh: 哀号的声音传遍了摩押四境， 哀声直达以基莲，又传到比珥．以琳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哀号的声音传遍了摩押四境， 哀声直达以基莲，又传到比珥．以琳。
verses.textZhCuv: 哀声遍闻摩押的四境； 哀号的声音达到以基莲； 哀号的声音达到比珥‧以琳。
verses.textEnNiv: Their outcry echoes along the border of Moab; their wailing reaches as far as Eglaim, their lamentation as far as Beer Elim.
verses.textEnEsv: For a cry has gone around the land of Moab; her wailing reaches to Eglaim; her wailing reaches to Beer-elim.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the cry has gone all around the borders of Moab, Its wailing to Eglaim And its wailing to Beer Elim.
verses.textEnNlt: A cry of distress echoes through the land of Moab from one end to the other— from Eglaim to Beer-elim.
verses.textEnNasb: For the cry of distress has gone around the territory of Moab, Its wailing goes as far as Eglaim and its howling to Beer-elim.
verses.textEn: Their outcry echoes along the border of Moab; their wailing reaches as far as Eglaim, their lamentation as far as Beer Elim.

verses.textZh: 底们 的水充满了血， 我还要把更多的灾祸加给底们， 使狮子临到摩押逃难的人和那地余下的人中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底们 的水充满了血， 我还要把更多的灾祸加给底们， 使狮子临到摩押逃难的人和那地余下的人中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 底们的水充满了血； 我还要加增底们的灾难， 叫狮子来追上摩押逃脱的民 和那地上所余剩的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring still more upon Dimon — a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon those who remain in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: For the waters of Dibon are full of blood; for I will bring upon Dibon even more, a lion for those of Moab who escape, for the remnant of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the waters of Dimon will be full of blood; Because I will bring more upon Dimon, Lions upon him who escapes from Moab, And on the remnant of the land."
verses.textEnNlt: The stream near Dibon runs red with blood, but I am still not finished with Dibon! Lions will hunt down the survivors— both those who try to escape and those who remain behind.
verses.textEnNasb: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; I will certainly bring added woes upon Dimon, A lion upon the fugitives of Moab and the remnant of the land.
verses.textEn: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring still more upon Dimon — a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon those who remain in the land.

verses.textZh: 你们要把羊羔送给那地的掌权者， 从西拉经过旷野，送到锡安居民 的山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把羊羔送给那地的掌权者， 从西拉经过旷野，送到锡安居民 的山。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当将羊羔奉给那地掌权的， 从西拉往旷野，送到锡安城 的山。
verses.textEnNiv: Send lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land, from Sela, across the desert, to the mount of Daughter Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela, by way of the desert, to the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, From Sela to the wilderness, To the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: Send lambs from Sela as tribute to the ruler of the land. Send them through the desert to the mountain of beautiful Zion.
verses.textEnNasb: Send the tribute lamb to the ruler of the land, From Sela by way of the wilderness to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
verses.textEn: Send lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land, from Sela, across the desert, to the mount of Daughter Zion.

verses.textZh: 摩押的居民在亚嫩渡口， 像游荡的飞鸟，又像被赶出巢窝的鸟儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的居民在亚嫩渡口， 像游荡的飞鸟，又像被赶出巢窝的鸟儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押的居民 在亚嫩渡口， 必像游飞的鸟，如拆窝的雏。
verses.textEnNiv: Like fluttering birds pushed from the nest, so are the women of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.
verses.textEnEsv: Like fleeing birds, like a scattered nest, so are the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it shall be as a wandering bird thrown out of the nest; So shall be the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.
verses.textEnNlt: The women of Moab are left like homeless birds at the shallow crossings of the Arnon River.
verses.textEnNasb: Then, like fluttering birds or scattered nestlings, The daughters of Moab will be at the crossing places of the Arnon.
verses.textEn: Like fluttering birds pushed from the nest, so are the women of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.

verses.textZh: "求你给我们献谋略，作裁判！ 使你的影子在午间如同黑夜， 把被赶逐的人隐藏起来，不可出卖逃亡的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "求你给我们献谋略，作裁判！ 使你的影子在午间如同黑夜， 把被赶逐的人隐藏起来，不可出卖逃亡的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你献谋略，行公平， 使你的影子在午间如黑夜， 隐藏被赶散的人，不可显露逃民。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make up your mind," Moab says. "Render a decision. Make your shadow like night— at high noon. Hide the fugitives, do not betray the refugees.
verses.textEnEsv: "Give counsel; grant justice; make your shade like night at the height of noon; shelter the outcasts; do not reveal the fugitive;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take counsel, execute judgment; Make your shadow like the night in the middle of the day; Hide the outcasts, Do not betray him who escapes.
verses.textEnNlt: "Help us," they cry. "Defend us against our enemies. Protect us from their relentless attack. Do not betray us now that we have escaped.
verses.textEnNasb: " Give us advice, make a decision; Cast your shadow like night at high noon; Hide the outcasts, do not betray the fugitive.
verses.textEn: "Make up your mind," Moab says. "Render a decision. Make your shadow like night— at high noon. Hide the fugitives, do not betray the refugees.

verses.textZh: 让摩押那些被赶逐的人与你同住， 求你作他们的隐密处，使他们脱离毁灭者的面。 勒索人的必要终止，毁灭人的也将止息， 欺压人的必从这地灭绝；
verses.textZhCnvs: 让摩押那些被赶逐的人与你同住， 求你作他们的隐密处，使他们脱离毁灭者的面。 勒索人的必要终止，毁灭人的也将止息， 欺压人的必从这地灭绝；
verses.textZhCuv: 求你容我这被赶散的人和你同居。 至于摩押，求你作他的隐密处， 脱离灭命者的面。 勒索人的归于无有， 毁灭的事止息了， 欺压人的从国中除灭了，
verses.textEnNiv: Let the Moabite fugitives stay with you; be their shelter from the destroyer." The oppressor will come to an end, and destruction will cease; the aggressor will vanish from the land.
verses.textEnEsv: let the outcasts of Moab sojourn among you; be a shelter to them from the destroyer. When the oppressor is no more, and destruction has ceased, and he who tramples underfoot has vanished from the land,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let My outcasts dwell with you, O Moab; Be a shelter to them from the face of the spoiler. For the extortioner is at an end, Devastation ceases, The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Let our refugees stay among you. Hide them from our enemies until the terror is past." When oppression and destruction have ended and enemy raiders have disappeared,
verses.textEnNasb: "Let the outcasts of Moab stay with you; Be a hiding place to them from the destroyer." For the oppressor has come to an end, destruction has ceased, Oppressors have been removed from the land.
verses.textEn: Let the Moabite fugitives stay with you; be their shelter from the destroyer." The oppressor will come to an end, and destruction will cease; the aggressor will vanish from the land.

verses.textZh: 必有一个宝座在慈爱中建立； 必有一位凭信实坐在上面，就是在大卫的帐棚里； 他必施行审判，寻求公平， 并且迅速行公义。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有一个宝座在慈爱中建立； 必有一位凭信实坐在上面，就是在大卫的帐棚里； 他必施行审判，寻求公平， 并且迅速行公义。"
verses.textZhCuv: 必有宝座因慈爱坚立； 必有一位诚诚实实坐在其上， 在大卫帐幕中施行审判， 寻求公平，速行公义。
verses.textEnNiv: In love a throne will be established; in faithfulness a man will sit on it— one from the house of David— one who in judging seeks justice and speeds the cause of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: then a throne will be established in steadfast love, and on it will sit in faithfulness in the tent of David one who judges and seeks justice and is swift to do righteousness."
verses.textEnNkjv: In mercy the throne will be established; And One will sit on it in truth, in the tabernacle of David, Judging and seeking justice and hastening righteousness."
verses.textEnNlt: then God will establish one of David’s descendants as king. He will rule with mercy and truth. He will always do what is just and be eager to do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: A throne will be established in faithfulness, And a judge will sit on it in trustworthiness in the tent of David; Moreover, he will seek justice, And be prompt in righteousness.
verses.textEn: In love a throne will be established; in faithfulness a man will sit on it— one from the house of David— one who in judging seeks justice and speeds the cause of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 我们听说过摩押的骄傲，十分骄傲； 也听说过它的狂妄、骄傲和忿怒， 它那浮夸的话都是虚假。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听说过摩押的骄傲，十分骄傲； 也听说过它的狂妄、骄傲和忿怒， 它那浮夸的话都是虚假。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们听说摩押人骄傲， 是极其骄傲； 听说他狂妄、骄傲、忿怒； 他夸大的话是虚空的。
verses.textEnNiv: We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her conceit, her pride and her insolence; but her boasts are empty.
verses.textEnEsv: We have heard of the pride of Moab— how proud he is!— of his arrogance, his pride, and his insolence; in his idle boasting he is not right.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have heard of the pride of Moab— Heis very proud— Of his haughtiness and his pride and his wrath; But his lies shall not be so.
verses.textEnNlt: We have heard about proud Moab— about its pride and arrogance and rage. But all that boasting has disappeared.
verses.textEnNasb: We have heard of the pride of Moab, an excessive pride; Even of his arrogance, pride, and fury; His idle boasts are false.
verses.textEn: We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her conceit, her pride and her insolence; but her boasts are empty.

verses.textZh: 因此，摩押人必哀哭，各人一同为摩押哀哭， 摩押人又要为吉珥．哈列设的葡萄饼哀叹忧伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，摩押人必哀哭，各人一同为摩押哀哭， 摩押人又要为吉珥．哈列设的葡萄饼哀叹忧伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，摩押人必为摩押哀号； 人人都要哀号。 你们摩押人要为吉珥‧哈列设的葡萄饼哀叹， 极其忧伤。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Moabites wail, they wail together for Moab. Lament and grieve for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let Moab wail for Moab, let everyone wail. Mourn, utterly stricken, for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Moab shall wail for Moab; Everyone shall wail. For the foundations of Kir Hareseth you shall mourn; Surely theyare stricken.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire land of Moab weeps. Yes, everyone in Moab mourns for the cakes of raisins from Kir-hareseth. They are all gone now.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Moab will wail; everyone of Moab will wail. You will moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth As those who are utterly stricken.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Moabites wail, they wail together for Moab. Lament and grieve for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth.

verses.textZh: 因为希实本的田地和西比玛的葡萄树都衰残了， 它们美好的枝子曾醉倒了列国的君主。 它的嫩枝直达雅谢，蔓延到旷野， 又向外伸展，越过盐海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为希实本的田地和西比玛的葡萄树都衰残了， 它们美好的枝子曾醉倒了列国的君主。 它的嫩枝直达雅谢，蔓延到旷野， 又向外伸展，越过盐海。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为希实本的田地 和西比玛的葡萄树都衰残了。 列国的君主折断其上美好的枝子； 这枝子长到雅谢延到旷野， 嫩枝向外探出，直探过盐海。
verses.textEnNiv: The fields of Heshbon wither, the vines of Sibmah also. The rulers of the nations have trampled down the choicest vines, which once reached Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots spread out and went as far as the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah; the lords of the nations have struck down its branches, which reached to Jazer and strayed to the desert; its shoots spread abroad and passed over the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the fields of Heshbon languish, And the vine of Sibmah; The lords of the nations have broken down its choice plants, Which have reached to Jazer And wandered through the wilderness. Her branches are stretched out, They are gone over the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: The farms of Heshbon are abandoned; the vineyards at Sibmah are deserted. The rulers of the nations have broken down Moab— that beautiful grapevine. Its tendrils spread north as far as the town of Jazer and trailed eastward into the wilderness. Its shoots reached so far west that they crossed over the Dead Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: For the fields of Heshbon have withered, the vines of Sibmah as well; The lords of the nations have trampled down its choice clusters Which reached as far as Jazer and wandered to the deserts; Its tendrils spread themselves out and passed over the sea.
verses.textEn: The fields of Heshbon wither, the vines of Sibmah also. The rulers of the nations have trampled down the choicest vines, which once reached Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots spread out and went as far as the sea.

verses.textZh: 因此，我要为西比玛的葡萄树哀哭，像雅谢人的哀哭一样。 希实本和以利亚利啊！我要用眼泪浸透你； 因为有吶喊的声音临到你夏天的果子和你收割的庄稼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我要为西比玛的葡萄树哀哭，像雅谢人的哀哭一样。 希实本和以利亚利啊！我要用眼泪浸透你； 因为有吶喊的声音临到你夏天的果子和你收割的庄稼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我要为西比玛的葡萄树哀哭， 与雅谢人哀哭一样。 希实本、以利亚利啊， 我要以眼泪浇灌你； 因为有交战呐喊的声音 临到你夏天的果子， 并你收割的庄稼。
verses.textEnNiv: So I weep, as Jazer weeps, for the vines of Sibmah. Heshbon and Elealeh, I drench you with tears! The shouts of joy over your ripened fruit and over your harvests have been stilled.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I drench you with my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh; for over your summer fruit and your harvest the shout has ceased.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will bewail the vine of Sibmah, With the weeping of Jazer; I will drench you with my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh; For battle cries have fallen Over your summer fruits and your harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: So now I weep for Jazer and the vineyards of Sibmah; my tears will flow for Heshbon and Elealeh. There are no more shouts of joy over your summer fruits and harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I will weep bitterly for Jazer, for the vine of Sibmah; I will drench you with my tears, Heshbon and Elealeh; For the shouting over your summer fruits and your harvest has fallen away.
verses.textEn: So I weep, as Jazer weeps, for the vines of Sibmah. Heshbon and Elealeh, I drench you with tears! The shouts of joy over your ripened fruit and over your harvests have been stilled.

verses.textZh: 欢喜快乐都从肥美的田地中被取去了； 葡萄园里必再没有歌唱，也没有欢呼； 踹酒的不能在榨酒池里踹出酒来； 我止息了欢呼的声音！
verses.textZhCnvs: 欢喜快乐都从肥美的田地中被取去了； 葡萄园里必再没有歌唱，也没有欢呼； 踹酒的不能在榨酒池里踹出酒来； 我止息了欢呼的声音！
verses.textZhCuv: 从肥美的田中夺去了欢喜快乐； 在葡萄园里必无歌唱，也无欢呼的声音。 踹酒的在酒榨中不得踹出酒来； 我使他欢呼的声音止息。
verses.textEnNiv: Joy and gladness are taken away from the orchards; no one sings or shouts in the vineyards; no one treads out wine at the presses, for I have put an end to the shouting.
verses.textEnEsv: And joy and gladness are taken away from the fruitful field, and in the vineyards no songs are sung, no cheers are raised; no treader treads out wine in the presses; I have put an end to the shouting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gladness is taken away, And joy from the plentiful field; In the vineyards there will be no singing, Nor will there be shouting; No treaders will tread out wine in the presses; I have made their shouting cease.
verses.textEnNlt: Gone now is the gladness, gone the joy of harvest. There will be no singing in the vineyards, no more happy shouts, no treading of grapes in the winepresses. I have ended all their harvest joys.
verses.textEnNasb: Gladness and joy are taken away from the fruitful field; In the vineyards also there will be no cries of joy or jubilant shouting, No treader treads out wine in the presses, For I have made the shouting to cease.
verses.textEn: Joy and gladness are taken away from the orchards; no one sings or shouts in the vineyards; no one treads out wine at the presses, for I have put an end to the shouting.

verses.textZh: 因此，我的心肠为摩押哀鸣，有如琴瑟； 我的肺腑也为吉珥．哈列设哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我的心肠为摩押哀鸣，有如琴瑟； 我的肺腑也为吉珥．哈列设哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我心腹为摩押哀鸣如琴； 我心肠为吉珥‧哈列设也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my inner parts moan like a lyre for Moab, and my inmost self for Kir-hareseth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore my heart shall resound like a harp for Moab, And my inner being for Kir Heres.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart’s cry for Moab is like a lament on a harp. I am filled with anguish for Kir-hareseth.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore my inner being sounds like a harp for Moab. And my heart for Kir-hareseth.
verses.textEn: My heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.

verses.textZh: 到那时，摩押人虽朝见他们的神， 虽在高处弄得疲乏不堪， 又到他们的圣所去祷告， 却总不得亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那时，摩押人虽朝见他们的神， 虽在高处弄得疲乏不堪， 又到他们的圣所去祷告， 却总不得亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押人朝见的时候，在高处疲乏，又到他圣所祈祷，也不蒙应允。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moab appears at her high place, she only wears herself out; when she goes to her shrine to pray, it is to no avail.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, when he comes to his sanctuary to pray, he will not prevail.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass, When it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, That he will come to his sanctuary to pray; But he will not prevail.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Moab will worship at their pagan shrines, but it will do them no good. They will cry to the gods in their temples, but no one will be able to save them.
verses.textEnNasb: So it will come about when Moab presents himself, When he tires himself upon his high place And comes to his sanctuary to pray, That he will not prevail.
verses.textEn: When Moab appears at her high place, she only wears herself out; when she goes to her shrine to pray, it is to no avail.

verses.textZh: 以上是耶和华从前论到摩押所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上是耶和华从前论到摩押所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华从前论摩押的话。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word the Lord has already spoken concerning Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the word that the Lord spoke concerning Moab in the past.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the word which the Lord has spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has already said these things about Moab in the past.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the word which the Lord spoke earlier concerning Moab.
verses.textEn: This is the word the Lord has already spoken concerning Moab.

verses.textZh: 但现在耶和华宣告说："三年之内，按照雇工的年数，摩押的荣耀和他所有的群众，都必被藐视；余下的人必稀少，微不足道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在耶和华宣告说："三年之内，按照雇工的年数，摩押的荣耀和他所有的群众，都必被藐视；余下的人必稀少，微不足道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在耶和华说：「三年之内，照雇工的年数，摩押的荣耀与他的群众必被藐视，余剩的人甚少无几。」
verses.textEnNiv: But now the Lord says: "Within three years, as a servant bound by contract would count them, Moab’s splendor and all her many people will be despised, and her survivors will be very few and feeble."
verses.textEnEsv: But now the Lord has spoken, saying, "In three years, like the years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will be brought into contempt, in spite of all his great multitude, and those who remain will be very few and feeble."
verses.textEnNkjv: But now the Lord has spoken, saying, "Within three years, as the years of a hired man, the glory of Moab will be despised with all that great multitude, and the remnant willbe very small and feeble."
verses.textEnNlt: But now the Lord says, "Within three years, counting each day, the glory of Moab will be ended. From its great population, only a feeble few will be left alive."
verses.textEnNasb: But now the Lord has spoken, saying, "Within three years, as a hired worker would count them, the glory of Moab will become contemptible along with all his great population, and his remnant will be very small and impotent."
verses.textEn: But now the Lord says: "Within three years, as a servant bound by contract would count them, Moab’s splendor and all her many people will be despised, and her survivors will be very few and feeble."

verses.textZh: 关于大马士革的默示： "看哪！大马士革快要被废弃， 不再是一个城市， 它必变作废墟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于大马士革的默示： "看哪！大马士革快要被废弃， 不再是一个城市， 它必变作废墟。
verses.textZhCuv: 论大马士革的默示： 看哪，大马士革已被废弃，不再为城， 必变作乱堆。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Damascus: "See, Damascus will no longer be a city but will become a heap of ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: An oracle concerning Damascus. Behold, Damascus will cease to be a city and will become a heap of ruins.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Damascus. "Behold, Damascus will cease from being a city, And it will be a ruinous heap.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Damascus: "Look, the city of Damascus will disappear! It will become a heap of ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning Damascus: "Behold, Damascus is about to be removed from being a city And will become a fallen ruin.
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Damascus: "See, Damascus will no longer be a city but will become a heap of ruins.

verses.textZh: 亚罗珥的城市必被撇弃， 成为牧放羊群之处，羊群必在那里躺卧， 没有人惊扰牠们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚罗珥的城市必被撇弃， 成为牧放羊群之处，羊群必在那里躺卧， 没有人惊扰牠们。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚罗珥的城邑已被撇弃， 必成为牧羊之处； 羊在那里躺卧，无人惊吓。
verses.textEnNiv: The cities of Aroer will be deserted and left to flocks, which will lie down, with no one to make them afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: The cities of Aroer are deserted; they will be for flocks, which will lie down, and none will make them afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; They will be for flocks Which lie down, and no one will make them afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: The towns of Aroer will be deserted. Flocks will graze in the streets and lie down undisturbed, with no one to chase them away.
verses.textEnNasb: "The cities of Aroer are abandoned; They will be for herds to lie down in, And there will be no one to frighten them.
verses.textEn: The cities of Aroer will be deserted and left to flocks, which will lie down, with no one to make them afraid.

verses.textZh: 以法莲的堡垒必失去， 大马士革的国权也必消逝； 亚兰的余民 必像以色列人的荣耀一般消灭。" 这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲的堡垒必失去， 大马士革的国权也必消逝； 亚兰的余民 必像以色列人的荣耀一般消灭。" 这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲不再有保障； 大马士革不再有国权； 亚兰所剩下的 必像以色列人的荣耀消灭一样。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, and royal power from Damascus; the remnant of Aram will be like the glory of the Israelites," declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus; and the remnant of Syria will be like the glory of the children of Israel, declares the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fortress also will cease from Ephraim, The kingdom from Damascus, And the remnant of Syria; They will be as the glory of the children of Israel," Says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: The fortified towns of Israel will also be destroyed, and the royal power of Damascus will end. All that remains of Syria will share the fate of Israel’s departed glory," declares the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, And sovereignty from Damascus And the remnant of Aram; They will be like the glory of the sons of Israel," Declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, and royal power from Damascus; the remnant of Aram will be like the glory of the Israelites," declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: "到那日，雅各的荣耀必衰落， 他肥胖的身体必消瘦。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，雅各的荣耀必衰落， 他肥胖的身体必消瘦。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，雅各的荣耀必至枵薄； 他肥胖的身体必渐瘦弱。
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day the glory of Jacob will fade; the fat of his body will waste away.
verses.textEnEsv: And in that day the glory of Jacob will be brought low, and the fat of his flesh will grow lean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In that day it shall come to pass That the glory of Jacob will wane, And the fatness of his flesh grow lean.
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day Israel’s glory will grow dim; its robust body will waste away.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on that day the glory of Jacob will fade, And the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
verses.textEn: "In that day the glory of Jacob will fade; the fat of his body will waste away.

verses.textZh: 就像收割的人收聚庄稼， 用手割取穗子； 又像人在利乏音谷， 拾取遗落的穗子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就像收割的人收聚庄稼， 用手割取穗子； 又像人在利乏音谷， 拾取遗落的穗子。
verses.textZhCuv: 就必像收割的人收敛禾稼， 用手割取穗子， 又像人在利乏音谷拾取遗落的穗子。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be as when reapers harvest the standing grain, gathering the grain in their arms— as when someone gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be as when the reaper gathers standing grain and his arm harvests the ears, and as when one gleans the ears of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be as when the harvester gathers the grain, And reaps the heads with his arm; It shall be as he who gathers heads of grain In the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole land will look like a grainfield after the harvesters have gathered the grain. It will be desolate, like the fields in the valley of Rephaim after the harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be like the reaper gathering the standing grain, As his arm harvests the ears, Or it will be like one gleaning ears of grain In the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: It will be as when reapers harvest the standing grain, gathering the grain in their arms— as when someone gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.textZh: 虽然其中有少许遗下的穗子，却好象橄榄树被打过一样。 在树顶上，只剩下两三个果子； 在那本是多结果子的果树枝上， 只留下四五个果子。" 这是耶和华以色列的神说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然其中有少许遗下的穗子，却好象橄榄树被打过一样。 在树顶上，只剩下两三个果子； 在那本是多结果子的果树枝上， 只留下四五个果子。" 这是耶和华以色列的神说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 其间所剩下的不多，好像人打橄榄树－ 在尽上的枝梢上只剩两三个果子； 在多果树的旁枝上只剩四五个果子。 这是耶和华－以色列的神说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet some gleanings will remain, as when an olive tree is beaten, leaving two or three olives on the topmost branches, four or five on the fruitful boughs," declares the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Gleanings will be left in it, as when an olive tree is beaten— two or three berries in the top of the highest bough, four or five on the branches of a fruit tree, declares the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet gleaning grapes will be left in it, Like the shaking of an olive tree, Two or three olives at the top of the uppermost bough, Four or five in its most fruitful branches," Says the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Only a few of its people will be left, like stray olives left on a tree after the harvest. Only two or three remain in the highest branches, four or five scattered here and there on the limbs," declares the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet gleanings will be left in it like the shaking of an olive tree, Two or three olives on the topmost branch, Four or five on the branches of a fruitful tree, Declares the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: Yet some gleanings will remain, as when an olive tree is beaten, leaving two or three olives on the topmost branches, four or five on the fruitful boughs," declares the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 到那日，人必仰望他们的创造主， 他们必亲眼看见以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，人必仰望他们的创造主， 他们必亲眼看见以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，人必仰望造他们的主，眼目重看以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day people will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day man will look to his Maker, and his eyes will look on the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day a man will look to his Maker, And his eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last the people will look to their Creator and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day man will look to his Maker And his eyes will look to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: In that day people will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们必不仰望自己双手所做的祭坛， 也不再看着自己指头所做的， 无论是亚舍拉，或是香坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不仰望自己双手所做的祭坛， 也不再看着自己指头所做的， 无论是亚舍拉，或是香坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必不仰望祭坛，就是自己手所筑的，也不重看自己指头所做的，无论是木偶是日像。
verses.textEnNiv: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands, and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles and the incense altars their fingers have made.
verses.textEnEsv: He will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, and he will not look on what his own fingers have made, either the Asherim or the altars of incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not look to the altars, The work of his hands; He will not respect what his fingers have made, Nor the wooden images nor the incense altars.
verses.textEnNlt: They will no longer look to their idols for help or worship what their own hands have made. They will never again bow down to their Asherah poles or worship at the pagan shrines they have built.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, Nor will he look to that which his fingers have made, Even the Asherim and incense altars.
verses.textEn: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands, and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles and the incense altars their fingers have made.

verses.textZh: 到那日，他们那些因以色列人而撇弃的坚固城， 必像树林中和山顶上被撇弃的地方， 这样，地就荒凉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，他们那些因以色列人而撇弃的坚固城， 必像树林中和山顶上被撇弃的地方， 这样，地就荒凉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那日，他们的坚固城必像树林中和山顶上所撇弃的地方，就是从前在以色列人面前被人撇弃的。这样，地就荒凉了。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day their strong cities, which they left because of the Israelites, will be like places abandoned to thickets and undergrowth. And all will be desolation.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day their strong cities will be like the deserted places of the wooded heights and the hilltops, which they deserted because of the children of Israel, and there will be desolation.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day his strong cities will be as a forsaken bough And an uppermost branch, Which they left because of the children of Israel; And there will be desolation.
verses.textEnNlt: Their largest cities will be like a deserted forest, like the land the Hivites and Amorites abandoned when the Israelites came here so long ago. It will be utterly desolate.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day their strong cities will be like abandoned places in the forest, Or like branches which they abandoned before the sons of Israel; And the land will be a desolation.
verses.textEn: In that day their strong cities, which they left because of the Israelites, will be like places abandoned to thickets and undergrowth. And all will be desolation.

verses.textZh: 因为你忘记了那拯救你的神， 又不记念那作你避难所的盘石， 所以你虽然栽下佳美的树秧子， 种下异种的幼苗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你忘记了那拯救你的神， 又不记念那作你避难所的盘石， 所以你虽然栽下佳美的树秧子， 种下异种的幼苗，
verses.textZhCuv: 因你忘记救你的神， 不记念你能力的磐石； 所以，你栽上佳美的树秧子， 插上异样的栽子。
verses.textEnNiv: You have forgotten God your Savior; you have not remembered the Rock, your fortress. Therefore, though you set out the finest plants and plant imported vines,
verses.textEnEsv: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation and have not remembered the Rock of your refuge; therefore, though you plant pleasant plants and sow the vine-branch of a stranger,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have forgotten the God of your salvation, And have not been mindful of the Rock of your stronghold, Therefore you will plant pleasant plants And set out foreign seedlings;
verses.textEnNlt: Why? Because you have turned from the God who can save you. You have forgotten the Rock who can hide you. So you may plant the finest grapevines and import the most expensive seedlings.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation And have not remembered the rock of your refuge. Therefore you plant delightful plants And set them with vine shoots of a strange god.
verses.textEn: You have forgotten God your Savior; you have not remembered the Rock, your fortress. Therefore, though you set out the finest plants and plant imported vines,

verses.textZh: 又在你栽种的日子里，细心地在周围圈上篱笆， 到早晨，又使你所栽种的开花， 但在愁苦与极度伤痛的日子里， 所收割的就只有一小堆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在你栽种的日子里，细心地在周围圈上篱笆， 到早晨，又使你所栽种的开花， 但在愁苦与极度伤痛的日子里， 所收割的就只有一小堆。
verses.textZhCuv: 栽种的日子，你周围圈上篱笆， 又到早晨使你所种的开花； 但在愁苦极其伤痛的日子， 所收割的都飞去了。
verses.textEnNiv: though on the day you set them out, you make them grow, and on the morning when you plant them, you bring them to bud, yet the harvest will be as nothing in the day of disease and incurable pain.
verses.textEnEsv: though you make them grow on the day that you plant them, and make them blossom in the morning that you sow, yet the harvest will flee away in a day of grief and incurable pain.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the day you will make your plant to grow, And in the morning you will make your seed to flourish; But the harvest willbe a heap of ruins In the day of grief and desperate sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: They may sprout on the day you set them out; yes, they may blossom on the very morning you plant them, but you will never pick any grapes from them. Your only harvest will be a load of grief and unrelieved pain.
verses.textEnNasb: On the day that you plant it you carefully fence it in, And in the morning you bring your seed to blossom; But the harvest will flee On a day of illness and incurable pain.
verses.textEn: though on the day you set them out, you make them grow, and on the morning when you plant them, you bring them to bud, yet the harvest will be as nothing in the day of disease and incurable pain.

verses.textZh: 唉！许多民族在喧哗， 他们喧嚷好象海浪澎湃； 列国在咆哮， 他们吼叫，好象洪水奔流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唉！许多民族在喧哗， 他们喧嚷好象海浪澎湃； 列国在咆哮， 他们吼叫，好象洪水奔流。
verses.textZhCuv: 唉！多民哄嚷，好像海浪匉訇； 列邦奔腾，好像猛水滔滔；
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the many nations that rage— they rage like the raging sea! Woe to the peoples who roar— they roar like the roaring of great waters!
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, the thunder of many peoples; they thunder like the thundering of the sea! Ah, the roar of nations; they roar like the roaring of mighty waters!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to the multitude of many people Who make a noise like the roar of the seas, And to the rushing of nations That make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! The armies of many nations roar like the roaring of the sea. Hear the thunder of the mighty forces as they rush forward like thundering waves.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, the uproar of many peoples Who roar like the roaring of the seas, And the rumbling of nations Who rush on like the rumbling of mighty waters!
verses.textEn: Woe to the many nations that rage— they rage like the raging sea! Woe to the peoples who roar— they roar like the roaring of great waters!

verses.textZh: 万族怒号，好象众水涌流， 但神必斥责他们，使他们远远逃跑； 他们又被追赶，如同山上风前的糠秕， 又像暴风前的尘土卷动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万族怒号，好象众水涌流， 但神必斥责他们，使他们远远逃跑； 他们又被追赶，如同山上风前的糠秕， 又像暴风前的尘土卷动。
verses.textZhCuv: 列邦奔腾，好像多水滔滔； 但神斥责他们，他们就远远逃避， 又被追赶，如同山上的风前糠， 又如暴风前的旋风土。
verses.textEnNiv: Although the peoples roar like the roar of surging waters, when he rebukes them they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweed before a gale.
verses.textEnEsv: The nations roar like the roaring of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far away, chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind and whirling dust before the storm.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters; But God will rebuke them and they will flee far away, And be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, Like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.textEnNlt: But though they thunder like breakers on a beach, God will silence them, and they will run away. They will flee like chaff scattered by the wind, like a tumbleweed whirling before a storm.
verses.textEnNasb: The nations rumble on like the rumbling of many waters, But He will rebuke them, and they will flee far away, And be chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind, Or like whirling dust before a gale.
verses.textEn: Although the peoples roar like the roar of surging waters, when he rebukes them they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweed before a gale.

verses.textZh: 在晚上有惊恐， 未到早晨，他们就没有了， 这是那些抢夺我们的人所得的分， 是那些掠劫我们的人应得的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在晚上有惊恐， 未到早晨，他们就没有了， 这是那些抢夺我们的人所得的分， 是那些掠劫我们的人应得的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 到晚上有惊吓，未到早晨他们就没有了。这是掳掠我们之人所得的分，是抢夺我们之人的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: In the evening, sudden terror! Before the morning, they are gone! This is the portion of those who loot us, the lot of those who plunder us.
verses.textEnEsv: At evening time, behold, terror! Before morning, they are no more! This is the portion of those who loot us, and the lot of those who plunder us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, at eventide, trouble! And before the morning, he is no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, And the lot of those who rob us.
verses.textEnNlt: In the evening Israel waits in terror, but by dawn its enemies are dead. This is the just reward of those who plunder us, a fitting end for those who destroy us.
verses.textEnNasb: At evening time, behold, there is terror! Before morning they are gone. This will be the fate of those who plunder us And the lot of those who pillage us.
verses.textEn: In the evening, sudden terror! Before the morning, they are gone! This is the portion of those who loot us, the lot of those who plunder us.

verses.textZh: 古实河外，船只彼此碰撞， 响声四起之地，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实河外，船只彼此碰撞， 响声四起之地，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 唉！古实河外翅膀刷刷响声之地，
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush,
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, land of whirring wings that is beyond the rivers of Cush,
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to the land shadowed with buzzing wings, Which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia,
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, Ethiopia —land of fluttering sails that lies at the headwaters of the Nile,
verses.textEnNasb: Woe, land of whirring wings Which lies beyond the rivers of Cush,
verses.textEn: Woe to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush,

verses.textZh: 这就是那经常差派使者， 在水面上乘坐蒲草船渡海的地方。 去吧！快行的使者，到那身躯高大、皮肤光滑的国去， 到一个远近都为人所惧怕的民族那里去， 这国是强盛和践踏人的， 他们的地有河流把地分开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是那经常差派使者， 在水面上乘坐蒲草船渡海的地方。 去吧！快行的使者，到那身躯高大、皮肤光滑的国去， 到一个远近都为人所惧怕的民族那里去， 这国是强盛和践踏人的， 他们的地有河流把地分开。
verses.textZhCuv: 差遣使者在水面上， 坐蒲草船过海。 先知说：你们快行的使者， 要到高大光滑的民那里去。 自从开国以来，那民极其可畏， 是分地界践踏人的； 他们的地有江河分开。
verses.textEnNiv: which sends envoys by sea in papyrus boats over the water. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.
verses.textEnEsv: which sends ambassadors by the sea, in vessels of papyrus on the waters! Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people feared near and far, a nation mighty and conquering, whose land the rivers divide.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which sends ambassadors by sea, Even in vessels of reed on the waters, saying, "Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth ofskin, To a people terrible from their beginning onward, A nation powerful and treading down, Whose land the rivers divide."
verses.textEnNlt: that sends ambassadors in swift boats down the river. Go, swift messengers! Take a message to a tall, smooth-skinned people, who are feared far and wide for their conquests and destruction, and whose land is divided by rivers.
verses.textEnNasb: Which sends messengers by the sea, Even in papyrus vessels on the surface of the waters. Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, To a people feared far and wide, A powerful and oppressive nation Whose land the rivers divide.
verses.textEn: which sends envoys by sea in papyrus boats over the water. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.

verses.textZh: 世上所有的居民，住在全地上的人哪！ 山上竖起旗帜的时候，你们要注意； 号角吹响的时候，你们要聆听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上所有的居民，住在全地上的人哪！ 山上竖起旗帜的时候，你们要注意； 号角吹响的时候，你们要聆听。
verses.textZhCuv: 世上一切的居民和地上所住的人哪， 山上竖立大旗的时候你们要看； 吹角的时候你们要听。
verses.textEnNiv: All you people of the world, you who live on the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it, and when a trumpet sounds, you will hear it.
verses.textEnEsv: All you inhabitants of the world, you who dwell on the earth, when a signal is raised on the mountains, look! When a trumpet is blown, hear!
verses.textEnNkjv: All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on the earth: When he lifts up a banner on the mountains, you see it; And when he blows a trumpet, you hear it.
verses.textEnNlt: All you people of the world, everyone who lives on the earth— when I raise my battle flag on the mountain, look! When I blow the ram’s horn, listen!
verses.textEnNasb: All you who inhabit the world, and live on earth, As soon as a flag is raised on the mountains, you will see it, And as soon as the trumpet is blown, you will hear it.
verses.textEn: All you people of the world, you who live on the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it, and when a trumpet sounds, you will hear it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样对我说： "我要从我的居所安静观看， 像日光中闪烁的热气， 又像收割时的热气中有露水的云彩。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样对我说： "我要从我的居所安静观看， 像日光中闪烁的热气， 又像收割时的热气中有露水的云彩。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我这样说： 我要安静，在我的居所观看， 如同日光中的清热， 又如露水的云雾在收割的热天。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to me: "I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."
verses.textEnEsv: For thus the Lord said to me: "I will quietly look from my dwelling like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."
verses.textEnNkjv: For so the Lord said to me, "I will take My rest, And I will look from My dwelling place Like clear heat in sunshine, Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has told me this: "I will watch quietly from my dwelling place— as quietly as the heat rises on a summer day, or as the morning dew forms during the harvest."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord has told me: "I will quietly look from My dwelling place Like dazzling heat in the sunshine, Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to me: "I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."

verses.textZh: 因为在收割以前，花蕾开尽， 花朵也成了将熟的葡萄之时， 他就用镰刀削去嫩枝， 又砍掉蔓延的枝子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在收割以前，花蕾开尽， 花朵也成了将熟的葡萄之时， 他就用镰刀削去嫩枝， 又砍掉蔓延的枝子。
verses.textZhCuv: 收割之先，花开已谢， 花也成了将熟的葡萄； 他必用镰刀削去嫩枝， 又砍掉蔓延的枝条，
verses.textEnNiv: For, before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, and cut down and take away the spreading branches.
verses.textEnEsv: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he cuts off the shoots with pruning hooks, and the spreading branches he lops off and clears away.
verses.textEnNkjv: For before the harvest, when the bud is perfect And the sour grape is ripening in the flower, He will both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks And take away and cut down the branches.
verses.textEnNlt: Even before you begin your attack, while your plans are ripening like grapes, the Lord will cut off your new growth with pruning shears. He will snip off and discard your spreading branches.
verses.textEnNasb: For before the harvest, as soon as the bud blossoms And the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, And remove and tear away the spreading branches.
verses.textEn: For, before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, and cut down and take away the spreading branches.

verses.textZh: 它们都要撇下，给山间的鸷鸟， 和地上的野兽； 鸷鸟必吃它们来度过夏天， 地上的百兽必吃它们来度过冬天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们都要撇下，给山间的鸷鸟， 和地上的野兽； 鸷鸟必吃它们来度过夏天， 地上的百兽必吃它们来度过冬天。
verses.textZhCuv: 都要撇给山间的鸷鸟和地上的野兽。 夏天，鸷鸟要宿在其上； 冬天，野兽都卧在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey and to the wild animals; the birds will feed on them all summer, the wild animals all winter.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall all of them be left to the birds of prey of the mountains and to the beasts of the earth. And the birds of prey will summer on them, and all the beasts of the earth will winter on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will be left together for the mountain birds of prey And for the beasts of the earth; The birds of prey will summer on them, And all the beasts of the earth will winter on them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your mighty army will be left dead in the fields for the mountain vultures and wild animals. The vultures will tear at the corpses all summer. The wild animals will gnaw at the bones all winter.
verses.textEnNasb: They will be left together for mountain birds of prey, And for the animals of the earth; And the birds of prey will spend the summer feeding on them, And all the animals of the earth will spend harvest time on them.
verses.textEn: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey and to the wild animals; the birds will feed on them all summer, the wild animals all winter.

verses.textZh: 到那时，这个身躯高大、皮肤光滑的民族， 就是远近都为人所惧怕的民族， 强盛和践踏人的国， 他们的地有河流把地分开， 他们必把礼物带来给万军之耶和华， 就是奉到锡安山，万军之耶和华立他名的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那时，这个身躯高大、皮肤光滑的民族， 就是远近都为人所惧怕的民族， 强盛和践踏人的国， 他们的地有河流把地分开， 他们必把礼物带来给万军之耶和华， 就是奉到锡安山，万军之耶和华立他名的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那时，这高大光滑的民， 就是从开国以来极其可畏、 分地界践踏人的， 他们的地有江河分开； 他们必将礼物奉给万军之耶和华， 就是奉到锡安山－ 耶和华安置他名的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time gifts will be brought to the Lord Almighty from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers— the gifts will be brought to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time tribute will be brought to the Lord of hosts from a people tall and smooth, from a people feared near and far, a nation mighty and conquering, whose land the rivers divide, to Mount Zion, the place of the name of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that time a present will be brought to the Lord of hosts From a people tall and smooth ofskin, And from a people terrible from their beginning onward, A nation powerful and treading down, Whose land the rivers divide— To the place of the name of the Lord of hosts, To Mount Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will receive gifts from this land divided by rivers, from this tall, smooth-skinned people, who are feared far and wide for their conquests and destruction. They will bring the gifts to Jerusalem, where the Lord of Heaven’s Armies dwells.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time a gift of tribute will be brought to the Lord of armies From a people tall and smooth, From a people feared far and wide, A powerful and oppressive nation, Whose land the rivers divide— To the place of the name of the Lord of armies, to Mount Zion.
verses.textEn: At that time gifts will be brought to the Lord Almighty from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers— the gifts will be brought to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 关于埃及的默示： 看哪！耶和华驾着轻快的云， 来到埃及； 埃及的偶像在他面前战兢， 埃及人的心都惊怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于埃及的默示： 看哪！耶和华驾着轻快的云， 来到埃及； 埃及的偶像在他面前战兢， 埃及人的心都惊怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 论埃及的默示： 看哪，耶和华乘驾快云， 临到埃及。 埃及的偶像在他面前战兢； 埃及人的心在里面消化。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Egypt: See, the Lord rides on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.
verses.textEnEsv: An oracle concerning Egypt. Behold, the Lord is riding on a swift cloud and comes to Egypt; and the idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence, and the heart of the Egyptians will melt within them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Egypt. Behold, the Lord rides on a swift cloud, And will come into Egypt; The idols of Egypt will totter at His presence, And the heart of Egypt will melt in its midst.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Egypt: Look! The Lord is advancing against Egypt, riding on a swift cloud. The idols of Egypt tremble. The hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning Egypt: Behold, the Lord is riding on a swift cloud and is about to come to Egypt; The idols of Egypt will tremble at His presence, And the heart of the Egyptians will melt within them.
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Egypt: See, the Lord rides on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.

verses.textZh: 我要激动埃及人去攻击埃及人， 他们就相争起来，各人攻击自己的兄弟，各人攻击自己的邻舍， 城攻击城；国攻击国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要激动埃及人去攻击埃及人， 他们就相争起来，各人攻击自己的兄弟，各人攻击自己的邻舍， 城攻击城；国攻击国。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必激动埃及人攻击埃及人－ 弟兄攻击弟兄， 邻舍攻击邻舍； 这城攻击那城， 这国攻击那国。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian— brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will stir up Egyptians against Egyptians, and they will fight, each against another and each against his neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom;
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will set Egyptians against Egyptians; Everyone will fight against his brother, And everyone against his neighbor, City against city, kingdom against kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will make Egyptian fight against Egyptian— brother against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, province against province.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will incite Egyptians against Egyptians; And they will fight, each against his brother and each against his neighbor, City against city and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.textEn: "I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian— brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

verses.textZh: 埃及人的意志必消沉， 我要破坏他们的计谋； 他们必求问偶像、念咒的、 交鬼的和行巫术的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人的意志必消沉， 我要破坏他们的计谋； 他们必求问偶像、念咒的、 交鬼的和行巫术的。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人的心神必在里面耗尽； 我必败坏他们的谋略。 他们必求问偶像和念咒的、 交鬼的、行巫术的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will bring their plans to nothing; they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead, the mediums and the spiritists.
verses.textEnEsv: and the spirit of the Egyptians within them will be emptied out, and I will confound their counsel; and they will inquire of the idols and the sorcerers, and the mediums and the necromancers;
verses.textEnNkjv: The spirit of Egypt will fail in its midst; I will destroy their counsel, And they will consult the idols and the charmers, The mediums and the sorcerers.
verses.textEnNlt: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will confuse their plans. They will plead with their idols for wisdom and call on spirits, mediums, and those who consult the spirits of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be demoralized within them; And I will confuse their strategy, So that they will resort to idols and ghosts of the dead, And to mediums and spiritists.
verses.textEn: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will bring their plans to nothing; they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead, the mediums and the spiritists.

verses.textZh: 我必把埃及人交在残暴的主人手中； 凶猛的君王要管辖他们；这是主万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把埃及人交在残暴的主人手中； 凶猛的君王要管辖他们；这是主万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将埃及人交在残忍主的手中； 强暴王必辖制他们。 这是主－万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will hand the Egyptians over to the power of a cruel master, and a fierce king will rule over them," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a hard master, and a fierce king will rule over them, declares the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Egyptians I will give Into the hand of a cruel master, And a fierce king will rule over them," Says the Lord, the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: I will hand Egypt over to a hard, cruel master. A fierce king will rule them," says the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Furthermore, I will hand the Egyptians over to a cruel master, And a mighty king will rule over them," declares the Lord God of armies.
verses.textEn: I will hand the Egyptians over to the power of a cruel master, and a fierce king will rule over them," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 海中的众水必干透， 河床必枯竭干涸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 海中的众水必干透， 河床必枯竭干涸。
verses.textZhCuv: 海中的水必绝尽， 河也消没干涸。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters of the river will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and dry.
verses.textEnEsv: And the waters of the sea will be dried up, and the river will be dry and parched,
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters will fail from the sea, And the river will be wasted and dried up.
verses.textEnNlt: The waters of the Nile will fail to rise and flood the fields. The riverbed will be parched and dry.
verses.textEnNasb: The waters from the sea will dry up, And the river will be parched and dry.
verses.textEn: The waters of the river will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and dry.

verses.textZh: 河道必发臭， 埃及众河流的水必消退干涸； 苇子和芦荻都必枯萎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 河道必发臭， 埃及众河流的水必消退干涸； 苇子和芦荻都必枯萎。
verses.textZhCuv: 江河要变臭； 埃及的河水都必减少枯干。 苇子和芦荻都必衰残；
verses.textEnNiv: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will dwindle and dry up. The reeds and rushes will wither,
verses.textEnEsv: and its canals will become foul, and the branches of Egypt’s Nile will diminish and dry up, reeds and rushes will rot away.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rivers will turn foul; The brooks of defense will be emptied and dried up; The reeds and rushes will wither.
verses.textEnNlt: The canals of the Nile will dry up, and the streams of Egypt will stink with rotting reeds and rushes.
verses.textEnNasb: The canals will emit a stench, The streams of Egypt will thin out and dry up; The reeds and rushes will rot away.
verses.textEn: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will dwindle and dry up. The reeds and rushes will wither,

verses.textZh: 尼罗河旁、尼罗河口的草田， 以及沿着尼罗河所种的田都必枯干， 被吹散，不再存在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼罗河旁、尼罗河口的草田， 以及沿着尼罗河所种的田都必枯干， 被吹散，不再存在。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠尼罗河旁的草田， 并沿尼罗河所种的田，都必枯干。 庄稼被风吹去，归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: also the plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the river. Every sown field along the Nile will become parched, will blow away and be no more.
verses.textEnEsv: There will be bare places by the Nile, on the brink of the Nile, and all that is sown by the Nile will be parched, will be driven away, and will be no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: The papyrus reeds by the River, by the mouth of the River, And everything sown by the River, Will wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.textEnNlt: All the greenery along the riverbank and all the crops along the river will dry up and blow away.
verses.textEnNasb: The bulrushes by the Nile, by the edge of the Nile And all the sown fields by the Nile Will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.textEn: also the plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the river. Every sown field along the Nile will become parched, will blow away and be no more.

verses.textZh: 打鱼的人必哀号； 所有在尼罗河上垂钓的必悲伤； 那些在水面上撒网的，必灰心难过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打鱼的人必哀号； 所有在尼罗河上垂钓的必悲伤； 那些在水面上撒网的，必灰心难过。
verses.textZhCuv: 打鱼的必哀哭。 在尼罗河一切钓鱼的必悲伤； 在水上撒网的必都衰弱。
verses.textEnNiv: The fishermen will groan and lament, all who cast hooks into the Nile; those who throw nets on the water will pine away.
verses.textEnEsv: The fishermen will mourn and lament, all who cast a hook in the Nile; and they will languish who spread nets on the water.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fishermen also will mourn; All those will lament who cast hooks into the River, And they will languish who spread nets on the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: The fishermen will lament for lack of work. Those who cast hooks into the Nile will groan, and those who use nets will lose heart.
verses.textEnNasb: And the fishermen will grieve, And all those who cast a line into the Nile will mourn, And those who spread nets on the waters will dwindle away.
verses.textEn: The fishermen will groan and lament, all who cast hooks into the Nile; those who throw nets on the water will pine away.

verses.textZh: 那些用梳好的麻来纺纱的， 和那些织白布的，都必羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些用梳好的麻来纺纱的， 和那些织白布的，都必羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 用梳好的麻造物的 和织白布的都必羞愧；
verses.textEnNiv: Those who work with combed flax will despair, the weavers of fine linen will lose hope.
verses.textEnEsv: The workers in combed flax will be in despair, and the weavers of white cotton.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover those who work in fine flax And those who weave fine fabric will be ashamed;
verses.textEnNlt: There will be no flax for the harvesters, no thread for the weavers.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the manufacturers of linen made from combed flax And the weavers of white cloth will be utterly dejected.
verses.textEn: Those who work with combed flax will despair, the weavers of fine linen will lose hope.

verses.textZh: 埃及的柱石必被打碎， 所有受雇的工人也必心里忧愁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及的柱石必被打碎， 所有受雇的工人也必心里忧愁。
verses.textZhCuv: 国柱必被打碎， 所有佣工的，心必愁烦。
verses.textEnNiv: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the wage earners will be sick at heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who are the pillars of the land will be crushed, and all who work for pay will be grieved.
verses.textEnNkjv: And its foundations will be broken. All who make wages willbe troubled of soul.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be in despair, and all the workers will be sick at heart.
verses.textEnNasb: And the pillars of Egypt will be crushed; All the hired laborers will be grieved in soul.
verses.textEn: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the wage earners will be sick at heart.

verses.textZh: 琐安的领袖非常愚昧， 法老那些最有智慧的谋士所筹算的， 都成为愚昧。 你们怎能对法老说： "我是智慧人的儿子，是古代君王的后裔"呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 琐安的领袖非常愚昧， 法老那些最有智慧的谋士所筹算的， 都成为愚昧。 你们怎能对法老说： "我是智慧人的儿子，是古代君王的后裔"呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 琐安的首领极其愚昧； 法老大有智慧的谋士， 所筹划的成为愚谋。 你们怎敢对法老说： 我是智慧人的子孙， 我是古王的后裔？
verses.textEnNiv: The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools; the wise counselors of Pharaoh give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am one of the wise men, a disciple of the ancient kings"?
verses.textEnEsv: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish; the wisest counselors of Pharaoh give stupid counsel. How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings"?
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools; Pharaoh’s wise counselors give foolish counsel. How do you say to Pharaoh, "I am the son of the wise, The son of ancient kings?"
verses.textEnNlt: What fools are the officials of Zoan! Their best counsel to the king of Egypt is stupid and wrong. Will they still boast to Pharaoh of their wisdom? Will they dare brag about all their wise ancestors?
verses.textEnNasb: The officials of Zoan are mere fools; The advice of Pharaoh’s wisest advisers has become stupid. How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings"?
verses.textEn: The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools; the wise counselors of Pharaoh give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am one of the wise men, a disciple of the ancient kings"?

verses.textZh: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？ 万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意是怎样的？ 就让他们告诉你，使你知道吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？ 万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意是怎样的？ 就让他们告诉你，使你知道吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？ 万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意， 他们可以知道，可以告诉你吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Where are your wise men now? Let them show you and make known what the Lord Almighty has planned against Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you that they might know what the Lord of hosts has purposed against Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where are they? Where are your wise men? Let them tell you now, And let them know what the Lord of hosts has purposed against Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Where are your wise counselors, Pharaoh? Let them tell you what God plans, what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies is going to do to Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Well then, where are your wise men? Please let them tell you, And let them understand what the Lord of armies Has planned against Egypt.
verses.textEn: Where are your wise men now? Let them show you and make known what the Lord Almighty has planned against Egypt.

verses.textZh: 琐安的领袖都变为愚昧， 挪弗的领袖都受了欺骗； 那些在埃及支派中作房角石的， 使埃及人走错了路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 琐安的领袖都变为愚昧， 挪弗的领袖都受了欺骗； 那些在埃及支派中作房角石的， 使埃及人走错了路。
verses.textZhCuv: 琐安的首领都变为愚昧； 挪弗的首领都受了迷惑。 当埃及支派房角石的， 使埃及人走错了路。
verses.textEnNiv: The officials of Zoan have become fools, the leaders of Memphis are deceived; the cornerstones of her peoples have led Egypt astray.
verses.textEnEsv: The princes of Zoan have become fools, and the princes of Memphis are deluded; those who are the cornerstones of her tribes have made Egypt stagger.
verses.textEnNkjv: The princes of Zoan have become fools; The princes of Noph are deceived; They have also deluded Egypt, Thosewhoare the mainstay of its tribes.
verses.textEnNlt: The officials of Zoan are fools, and the officials of Memphis are deluded. The leaders of the people have led Egypt astray.
verses.textEnNasb: The officials of Zoan have turned out to be fools, The officials of Memphis are deluded; Those who are the cornerstone of her tribes Have led Egypt astray.
verses.textEn: The officials of Zoan have become fools, the leaders of Memphis are deceived; the cornerstones of her peoples have led Egypt astray.

verses.textZh: 耶和华让歪曲的灵搀入埃及当中， 以致他们使埃及一切所作的都有谬误， 好象醉酒的人呕吐的时候，东倒西歪一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华让歪曲的灵搀入埃及当中， 以致他们使埃及一切所作的都有谬误， 好象醉酒的人呕吐的时候，东倒西歪一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使乖谬的灵搀入埃及中间； 首领使埃及一切所做的都有差错， 好像醉酒之人呕吐的时候东倒西歪一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has poured into them a spirit of dizziness; they make Egypt stagger in all that she does, as a drunkard staggers around in his vomit.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has mingled within her a spirit of confusion, and they will make Egypt stagger in all its deeds, as a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has mingled a perverse spirit in her midst; And they have caused Egypt to err in all her work, As a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has sent a spirit of foolishness on them, so all their suggestions are wrong. They cause Egypt to stagger like a drunk in his vomit.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has mixed within her a spirit of distortion; They have led Egypt astray in all that it does, As a drunken person staggers in his vomit.
verses.textEn: The Lord has poured into them a spirit of dizziness; they make Egypt stagger in all that she does, as a drunkard staggers around in his vomit.

verses.textZh: 无论是头或尾、棕枝或芦苇所作的， 都不能为埃及成就甚么事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是头或尾、棕枝或芦苇所作的， 都不能为埃及成就甚么事。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及中，无论是头与尾， 棕枝与芦苇，所做之工都不成就。
verses.textEnNiv: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm branch or reed.
verses.textEnEsv: And there will be nothing for Egypt that head or tail, palm branch or reed, may do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither will there be any work for Egypt, Which the head or tail, Palm branch or bulrush, may do.
verses.textEnNlt: There is nothing Egypt can do. All are helpless— the head and the tail, the noble palm branch and the lowly reed.
verses.textEnNasb: There will be no work for Egypt Which its head or tail, its palm branch or bulrush, may do.
verses.textEn: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm branch or reed.

verses.textZh: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样。他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及之上挥手而战兢恐惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样。他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及之上挥手而战兢恐惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样，他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及以上所抡的手，战兢惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Egyptians will become weaklings. They will shudder with fear at the uplifted hand that the Lord Almighty raises against them.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Egyptians will be like women, and tremble with fear before the hand that the Lord of hosts shakes over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day Egypt will be like women, and will be afraid and fear because of the waving of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which He waves over it.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Egyptians will be as weak as women. They will cower in fear beneath the upraised fist of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Egyptians will become like women, and they will tremble and be in great fear because of the waving of the hand of the Lord of armies, which He is going to wave over them.
verses.textEn: In that day the Egyptians will become weaklings. They will shudder with fear at the uplifted hand that the Lord Almighty raises against them.

verses.textZh: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐；无论谁向埃及人提起犹大地，他们都惧怕，因为这是万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐；无论谁向埃及人提起犹大地，他们都惧怕，因为这是万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐，向谁提起犹大地，谁就惧怕。这是因万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。
verses.textEnNiv: And the land of Judah will bring terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom Judah is mentioned will be terrified, because of what the Lord Almighty is planning against them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the land of Judah will become a terror to the Egyptians. Everyone to whom it is mentioned will fear because of the purpose that the Lord of hosts has purposed against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the land of Judah will be a terror to Egypt; everyone who makes mention of it will be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts which He has determined against it.
verses.textEnNlt: Just to speak the name of Israel will terrorize them, for the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has laid out his plans against them.
verses.textEnNasb: The land of Judah will become a cause of shame to Egypt; everyone to whom it is mentioned will be in great fear because of the plan of the Lord of armies which He is making against them.
verses.textEn: And the land of Judah will bring terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom Judah is mentioned will be terrified, because of what the Lord Almighty is planning against them.

verses.textZh: 到那日，埃及地必有五座城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓，必有一座城称为"毁灭城" 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，埃及地必有五座城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓，必有一座城称为"毁灭城" 。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，埃及地必有五城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓。有一城必称为「灭亡城」。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the Lord Almighty. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the Lord of hosts. One of these will be called the City of Destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear by the Lord of hosts; one will be called the City of Destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day five of Egypt’s cities will follow the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. They will even begin to speak Hebrew, the language of Canaan. One of these cities will be Heliopolis, the City of the Sun.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day five cities in the land of Egypt will be speaking the language of Canaan and swearing allegiance to the Lord of armies; one will be called the City of Destruction.
verses.textEn: In that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the Lord Almighty. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.

verses.textZh: 到那日，在埃及地必有一座献给耶和华的祭坛；在埃及的边界上必有一根献给耶和华的柱子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，在埃及地必有一座献给耶和华的祭坛；在埃及的边界上必有一根献给耶和华的柱子。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，在埃及地中必有为耶和华筑的一座坛；在埃及的边界上必有为耶和华立的一根柱。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the heart of Egypt, and a monument to the Lord at its border.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord at its border.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord at its border.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the heart of Egypt, and there will be a monument to the Lord at its border.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a memorial stone to the Lord beside its border.
verses.textEn: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the heart of Egypt, and a monument to the Lord at its border.

verses.textZh: 这都要在埃及地作万军之耶和华的记号和证据。埃及人因受人欺压向耶和华哀求的时候，他就差派一位拯救者和维护者到他们那里，他必拯救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都要在埃及地作万军之耶和华的记号和证据。埃及人因受人欺压向耶和华哀求的时候，他就差派一位拯救者和维护者到他们那里，他必拯救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都要在埃及地为万军之耶和华作记号和证据。埃及人因为受人的欺压哀求耶和华，他就差遣一位救主作护卫者，拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be a sign and witness to the Lord Almighty in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the Lord because of their oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and he will rescue them.
verses.textEnEsv: It will be a sign and a witness to the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry to the Lord because of oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and deliver them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will be for a sign and for a witness to the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the Lord because of the oppressors, and He will send them a Savior and a Mighty One, and He will deliver them.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be a sign and a witness that the Lord of Heaven’s Armies is worshiped in the land of Egypt. When the people cry to the Lord for help against those who oppress them, he will send them a savior who will rescue them.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will become a sign and a witness to the Lord of armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry out to the Lord because of oppressors, and He will send them a Savior and a Champion, and He will save them.
verses.textEn: It will be a sign and witness to the Lord Almighty in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the Lord because of their oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and he will rescue them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必被埃及人认识。到那日，埃及人必认识耶和华；他们也要用祭物和供物来敬拜他，并且向耶和华许愿、还愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必被埃及人认识。到那日，埃及人必认识耶和华；他们也要用祭物和供物来敬拜他，并且向耶和华许愿、还愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必被埃及人所认识。在那日，埃及人必认识耶和华，也要献祭物和供物敬拜他，并向耶和华许愿还愿。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians, and in that day they will acknowledge the Lord . They will worship with sacrifices and grain offerings; they will make vows to the Lord and keep them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians, and the Egyptians will know the Lord in that day and worship with sacrifice and offering, and they will make vows to the Lord and perform them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the Lord in that day, and will make sacrifice and offering; yes, they will make a vow to the Lord and perform it.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians. Yes, they will know the Lord and will give their sacrifices and offerings to him. They will make a vow to the Lord and will keep it.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord will make Himself known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the Lord on that day. They will even worship with sacrifice and offering, and will make a vow to the Lord and perform it.
verses.textEn: So the Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians, and in that day they will acknowledge the Lord . They will worship with sacrifices and grain offerings; they will make vows to the Lord and keep them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必击打埃及，既击打、又医治，他们就回转归向耶和华，他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必击打埃及，既击打、又医治，他们就回转归向耶和华，他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必击打埃及，又击打又医治，埃及人就归向耶和华。他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will strike Egypt with a plague; he will strike them and heal them. They will turn to the Lord , and he will respond to their pleas and heal them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will strike Egypt, striking and healing, and they will return to the Lord , and he will listen to their pleas for mercy and heal them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will strike Egypt, He will strike and heal it; they will return to the Lord, and He will be entreated by them and heal them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will strike Egypt, and then he will bring healing. For the Egyptians will turn to the Lord , and he will listen to their pleas and heal them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will strike Egypt, striking but healing; so they will return to the Lord, and He will respond to their pleas and heal them.
verses.textEn: The Lord will strike Egypt with a plague; he will strike them and heal them. They will turn to the Lord , and he will respond to their pleas and heal them.

verses.textZh: 到那日，必有一条从埃及通到亚述的大道；亚述人要进到埃及，埃及人也要进入亚述；埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，必有一条从埃及通到亚述的大道；亚述人要进到埃及，埃及人也要进入亚述；埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，必有从埃及通亚述去的大道。亚述人要进入埃及，埃及人也进入亚述；埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria will come into Egypt, and Egypt into Assyria, and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian will come into Egypt and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians will serve with the Assyrians.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day Egypt and Assyria will be connected by a highway. The Egyptians and Assyrians will move freely between their lands, and they will both worship God.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day there will be a road from Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrians will come into Egypt and the Egyptians into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
verses.textEn: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.

verses.textZh: 到那日，以色列必与埃及和亚述一起成为地上列国的祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，以色列必与埃及和亚述一起成为地上列国的祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，以色列必与埃及、亚述三国一律，使地上的人得福；
verses.textEnNiv: In that day Israel will be the third, along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day Israel will be the third with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day Israel will be one of three with Egypt and Assyria—a blessing in the midst of the land,
verses.textEnNlt: In that day Israel will be the third, along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day Israel will be the third party to Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,
verses.textEn: In that day Israel will be the third, along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing on the earth.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说："我的子民埃及，我手的工程亚述，我的产业以色列，都是有福的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说："我的子民埃及，我手的工程亚述，我的产业以色列，都是有福的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说：「埃及－我的百姓，亚述－我手的工作，以色列－我的产业，都有福了！」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty will bless them, saying, "Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria my handiwork, and Israel my inheritance."
verses.textEnEsv: whom the Lord of hosts has blessed, saying, "Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance."
verses.textEnNkjv: whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, "Blessed is Egypt My people, and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will say, "Blessed be Egypt, my people. Blessed be Assyria, the land I have made. Blessed be Israel, my special possession!"
verses.textEnNasb: whom the Lord of armies has blessed, saying, "Blessed is Egypt My people, and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance."
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty will bless them, saying, "Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria my handiwork, and Israel my inheritance."

verses.textZh: 亚述王撒珥根差派统帅去亚实突的那年，那统帅就攻打亚实突，把城占领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王撒珥根差派统帅去亚实突的那年，那统帅就攻打亚实突，把城占领。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王撒珥根打发他珥探到亚实突的那年，他珥探就攻打亚实突，将城攻取。
verses.textEnNiv: In the year that the supreme commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it—
verses.textEnEsv: In the year that the commander in chief, who was sent by Sargon the king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and fought against it and captured it—
verses.textEnNkjv: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it,
verses.textEnNlt: In the year when King Sargon of Assyria sent his commander in chief to capture the Philistine city of Ashdod,
verses.textEnNasb: In the year that the commander came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him and he fought against Ashdod and captured it,
verses.textEn: In the year that the supreme commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it—

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华借着亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚说："你解开你腰间的麻布，脱去你脚上的鞋。"以赛亚就这样作了，露体赤足行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华借着亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚说："你解开你腰间的麻布，脱去你脚上的鞋。"以赛亚就这样作了，露体赤足行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华晓谕亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚说：「你去解掉你腰间的麻布，脱下你脚上的鞋。」以赛亚就这样做，露身赤脚行走。
verses.textEnNiv: at that time the Lord spoke through Isaiah son of Amoz. He said to him, "Take off the sackcloth from your body and the sandals from your feet." And he did so, going around stripped and barefoot.
verses.textEnEsv: at that time the Lord spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, "Go, and loose the sackcloth from your waist and take off your sandals from your feet," and he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.textEnNkjv: at the same time the Lord spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, "Go, and remove the sackcloth from your body, and take your sandals off your feet." And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord told Isaiah son of Amoz, "Take off the burlap you have been wearing, and remove your sandals." Isaiah did as he was told and walked around naked and barefoot.
verses.textEnNasb: at that time the Lord spoke through Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, "Go and loosen the sackcloth from your hips and take your sandals off your feet." And he did so, going naked and barefoot.
verses.textEn: at that time the Lord spoke through Isaiah son of Amoz. He said to him, "Take off the sackcloth from your body and the sandals from your feet." And he did so, going around stripped and barefoot.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我的仆人以赛亚怎样露体赤足行走了三年，作攻击埃及和古实的预兆和兆头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我的仆人以赛亚怎样露体赤足行走了三年，作攻击埃及和古实的预兆和兆头，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我仆人以赛亚怎样露身赤脚行走三年，作为关乎埃及和古实的预兆奇迹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "Just as my servant Isaiah has gone stripped and barefoot for three years, as a sign and portent against Egypt and Cush,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said, "As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and a portent against Egypt and Cush,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said, "Just as My servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder against Egypt and Ethiopia,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "My servant Isaiah has been walking around naked and barefoot for the last three years. This is a sign—a symbol of the terrible troubles I will bring upon Egypt and Ethiopia.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "Even as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and symbol against Egypt and Cush,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "Just as my servant Isaiah has gone stripped and barefoot for three years, as a sign and portent against Egypt and Cush,

verses.textZh: 亚述王也必照样把埃及的俘虏和古实被放逐的人带走，无论老少，都露体赤足，露出下体，使埃及蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王也必照样把埃及的俘虏和古实被放逐的人带走，无论老少，都露体赤足，露出下体，使埃及蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 照样，亚述王也必掳去埃及人，掠去古实人，无论老少，都露身赤脚，现出下体，使埃及蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: so the king of Assyria will lead away stripped and barefoot the Egyptian captives and Cushite exiles, young and old, with buttocks bared—to Egypt’s shame.
