verses.textEnEsv: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptian captives and the Cushite exiles, both the young and the old, naked and barefoot, with buttocks uncovered, the nakedness of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians as prisoners and the Ethiopians as captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: For the king of Assyria will take away the Egyptians and Ethiopians as prisoners. He will make them walk naked and barefoot, both young and old, their buttocks bared, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old, naked and barefoot with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.textEn: so the king of Assyria will lead away stripped and barefoot the Egyptian captives and Cushite exiles, young and old, with buttocks bared—to Egypt’s shame.

verses.textZh: 以色列人必因他们所仰望的古实和他们所夸耀的埃及，惊惶羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人必因他们所仰望的古实和他们所夸耀的埃及，惊惶羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人必因所仰望的古实，所夸耀的埃及，惊惶羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who trusted in Cush and boasted in Egypt will be dismayed and put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they shall be dismayed and ashamed because of Cush their hope and of Egypt their boast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation and Egypt their glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Philistines will be thrown into panic, for they counted on the power of Ethiopia and boasted of their allies in Egypt!
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will be terrified and ashamed because of Cush their hope and Egypt their pride.
verses.textEn: Those who trusted in Cush and boasted in Egypt will be dismayed and put to shame.

verses.textZh: 到那日，这沿海的居民必说：‘看哪！我们所仰望的，就是我们为着脱离亚述王，逃往投靠的，也不过是这样。我们又怎能逃脱呢？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，这沿海的居民必说：‘看哪！我们所仰望的，就是我们为着脱离亚述王，逃往投靠的，也不过是这样。我们又怎能逃脱呢？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，这沿海一带的居民必说：『看哪，我们素所仰望的，就是我们为脱离亚述王逃往求救的，不过是如此！我们怎能逃脱呢？』」
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the people who live on this coast will say, ‘See what has happened to those we relied on, those we fled to for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the inhabitants of this coastland will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is what has happened to those in whom we hoped and to whom we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria! And we, how shall we escape?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the inhabitant of this territory will say in that day, ‘Surely such is our expectation, wherever we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria; and how shall we escape?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: They will say, ‘If this can happen to Egypt, what chance do we have? We were counting on Egypt to protect us from the king of Assyria.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So the inhabitants of this coastland will say on that day, ‘Behold, such is our hope, where we fled for help to be saved from the king of Assyria; and how are we ourselves to escape?’ "
verses.textEn: In that day the people who live on this coast will say, ‘See what has happened to those we relied on, those we fled to for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’ "

verses.textZh: 关于海旁旷野的默示： 有敌人从旷野，从可怕之地而来， 好象南地的暴风猛烈扫过一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于海旁旷野的默示： 有敌人从旷野，从可怕之地而来， 好象南地的暴风猛烈扫过一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 论海旁旷野的默示： 有仇敌从旷野，从可怕之地而来， 好像南方的旋风，猛然扫过。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the southland, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle concerning the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the Negeb sweep on, it comes from the wilderness, from a terrible land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against the Wilderness of the Sea. As whirlwinds in the South pass through, So it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Babylon—the desert by the sea : Disaster is roaring down on you from the desert, like a whirlwind sweeping in from the Negev.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning the wilderness of the sea: As windstorms in the Negev come in turns, It comes from the wilderness, from a terrifying land.
verses.textEn: A prophecy against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the southland, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.

verses.textZh: 我被指示去看一个惨酷的异象： 那行诡诈的仍然行诡诈，那行破坏的仍然行破坏。 以拦哪，上去吧！玛代啊，围攻吧！ 我要使一切叹息止住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我被指示去看一个惨酷的异象： 那行诡诈的仍然行诡诈，那行破坏的仍然行破坏。 以拦哪，上去吧！玛代啊，围攻吧！ 我要使一切叹息止住。
verses.textZhCuv: 令人凄惨的异象已默示于我。 诡诈的行诡诈，毁灭的行毁灭。 以拦哪，你要上去！ 米底亚啊，你要围困！ 主说：我使一切叹息止住。
verses.textEnNiv: A dire vision has been shown to me: The traitor betrays, the looter takes loot. Elam, attack! Media, lay siege! I will bring to an end all the groaning she caused.
verses.textEnEsv: A stern vision is told to me; the traitor betrays, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, O Elam; lay siege, O Media; all the sighing she has caused I bring to an end.
verses.textEnNkjv: A distressing vision is declared to me; The treacherous dealer deals treacherously, And the plunderer plunders. Go up, O Elam! Besiege, O Media! All its sighing I have made to cease.
verses.textEnNlt: I see a terrifying vision: I see the betrayer betraying, the destroyer destroying. Go ahead, you Elamites and Medes, attack and lay siege. I will make an end to all the groaning Babylon caused.
verses.textEnNasb: A harsh vision has been shown to me; The treacherous one still deals treacherously, and the destroyer still destroys. Go up, Elam, lay siege, Media; I have put an end to all the groaning she has caused.
verses.textEn: A dire vision has been shown to me: The traitor betrays, the looter takes loot. Elam, attack! Media, lay siege! I will bring to an end all the groaning she caused.

verses.textZh: 因此，我满腰疼痛， 痛苦抓住我，好象产妇的痛苦一样； 我绞痛弯腰至听不见，我惊惶至看不到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我满腰疼痛， 痛苦抓住我，好象产妇的痛苦一样； 我绞痛弯腰至听不见，我惊惶至看不到。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我满腰疼痛； 痛苦将我抓住， 好像产难的妇人一样。 我疼痛甚至不能听； 我惊惶甚至不能看。
verses.textEnNiv: At this my body is racked with pain, pangs seize me, like those of a woman in labor; I am staggered by what I hear, I am bewildered by what I see.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my loins are filled with anguish; pangs have seized me, like the pangs of a woman in labor; I am bowed down so that I cannot hear; I am dismayed so that I cannot see.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore my loins are filled with pain; Pangs have taken hold of me, like the pangs of a woman in labor. I was distressed when I heard it; I was dismayed when I saw it.
verses.textEnNlt: My stomach aches and burns with pain. Sharp pangs of anguish are upon me, like those of a woman in labor. I grow faint when I hear what God is planning; I am too afraid to look.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason my loins are full of anguish; Pains have seized me like the pains of a woman in labor. I am so bewildered I cannot hear, so terrified I cannot see.
verses.textEn: At this my body is racked with pain, pangs seize me, like those of a woman in labor; I am staggered by what I hear, I am bewildered by what I see.

verses.textZh: 我的心迷糊，惊恐威吓着我； 我所爱慕的黄昏，竟使我战兢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心迷糊，惊恐威吓着我； 我所爱慕的黄昏，竟使我战兢。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心慌张，惊恐威吓我。 我所羡慕的黄昏，变为我的战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart falters, fear makes me tremble; the twilight I longed for has become a horror to me.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart staggers; horror has appalled me; the twilight I longed for has been turned for me into trembling.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart wavered, fearfulness frightened me; The night for which I longed He turned into fear for me.
verses.textEnNlt: My mind reels and my heart races. I longed for evening to come, but now I am terrified of the dark.
verses.textEnNasb: My mind reels, horror overwhelms me; The twilight I longed for has been turned into trembling for me.
verses.textEn: My heart falters, fear makes me tremble; the twilight I longed for has become a horror to me.

verses.textZh: 他们摆设筵席，铺张地毡，又吃又喝。 领袖们，起来吧！用油抹净盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们摆设筵席，铺张地毡，又吃又喝。 领袖们，起来吧！用油抹净盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们摆设筵席， 派人守望，又吃又喝。 首领啊，你们起来， 用油抹盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: They set the tables, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink! Get up, you officers, oil the shields!
verses.textEnEsv: They prepare the table, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink. Arise, O princes; oil the shield!
verses.textEnNkjv: Prepare the table, Set a watchman in the tower, Eat and drink. Arise, you princes, Anoint the shield!
verses.textEnNlt: Look! They are preparing a great feast. They are spreading rugs for people to sit on. Everyone is eating and drinking. But quick! Grab your shields and prepare for battle. You are being attacked!
verses.textEnNasb: They set the table, they spread out the cloth, they eat, they drink; "Rise up, captains, oil the shields!"
verses.textEn: They set the tables, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink! Get up, you officers, oil the shields!

verses.textZh: 因为主这样对我说： "你去设立守望的，叫他把所看见的报告出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主这样对我说： "你去设立守望的，叫他把所看见的报告出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 主对我如此说： 你去设立守望的， 使他将所看见的述说。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to me: "Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus the Lord said to me: "Go, set a watchman; let him announce what he sees.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus has the Lord said to me: "Go, set a watchman, Let him declare what he sees."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Lord said to me, "Put a watchman on the city wall. Let him shout out what he sees.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says to me: "Go, station the lookout, have him report what he sees.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to me: "Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.

verses.textZh: 他一看见骑兵一对一对而来， 又有驴队和骆驼队， 他就要留意，非常留意。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一看见骑兵一对一对而来， 又有驴队和骆驼队， 他就要留意，非常留意。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他看见军队， 就是骑马的一对一对地来， 又看见驴队，骆驼队， 就要侧耳细听。
verses.textEnNiv: When he sees chariots with teams of horses, riders on donkeys or riders on camels, let him be alert, fully alert."
verses.textEnEsv: When he sees riders, horsemen in pairs, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, let him listen diligently, very diligently."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he saw a chariot with a pair of horsemen, A chariot of donkeys, and a chariot of camels, And he listened earnestly with great care.
verses.textEnNlt: He should look for chariots drawn by pairs of horses, and for riders on donkeys and camels. Let the watchman be fully alert."
verses.textEnNasb: "When he sees a column of chariots, horsemen in pairs, A train of donkeys, a train of camels, He is to pay close attention, very close attention."
verses.textEn: When he sees chariots with teams of horses, riders on donkeys or riders on camels, let him be alert, fully alert."

verses.textZh: 后来，守望者 喊叫着说： "主啊！我每日不断站在守望楼上， 每夜立在我守望的岗位中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，守望者 喊叫着说： "主啊！我每日不断站在守望楼上， 每夜立在我守望的岗位中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他像狮子吼叫，说： 主啊，我白日常站在望楼上， 整夜立在我守望所。
verses.textEnNiv: And the lookout shouted, "Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; every night I stay at my post.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he who saw cried out: "Upon a watchtower I stand, O Lord, continually by day, and at my post I am stationed whole nights.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he cried, "A lion, my Lord! I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime; I have sat at my post every night.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the watchman called out, "Day after day I have stood on the watchtower, my lord. Night after night I have remained at my post.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the lookout called, "Lord, I stand continually by day on the watchtower, And I am stationed every night at my guard post.
verses.textEn: And the lookout shouted, "Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; every night I stay at my post.

verses.textZh: 看哪！有一队骑兵来了，马兵一对一对而来。" 又有人答话说："倾倒了，巴比伦倾倒了！ 它所有雕刻的神像都被打碎在地上了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！有一队骑兵来了，马兵一对一对而来。" 又有人答话说："倾倒了，巴比伦倾倒了！ 它所有雕刻的神像都被打碎在地上了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，有一队军兵骑着马， 一对一对地来。 他就说：巴比伦倾倒了！倾倒了！ 他一切雕刻的神像都打碎于地。
verses.textEnNiv: Look, here comes a man in a chariot with a team of horses. And he gives back the answer: ‘Babylon has fallen, has fallen! All the images of its gods lie shattered on the ground!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, here come riders, horsemen in pairs!" And he answered, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the carved images of her gods he has shattered to the ground."
verses.textEnNkjv: And look, here comes a chariot of men with a pair of horsemen!" Then he answered and said, "Babylon is fallen, is fallen! And all the carved images of her gods He has broken to the ground."
verses.textEnNlt: Now at last—look! Here comes a man in a chariot with a pair of horses!" Then the watchman said, "Babylon is fallen, fallen! All the idols of Babylon lie broken on the ground!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Now behold, here comes a troop of riders, horsemen in pairs." And one said, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon; And all the images of her gods are shattered on the ground."
verses.textEn: Look, here comes a man in a chariot with a team of horses. And he gives back the answer: ‘Babylon has fallen, has fallen! All the images of its gods lie shattered on the ground!’ "

verses.textZh: 我那被打的禾稼啊！我禾场上的谷啊！ 我从万军之耶和华，以色列的神那里听见的， 都告诉你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我那被打的禾稼啊！我禾场上的谷啊！ 我从万军之耶和华，以色列的神那里听见的， 都告诉你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我被打的禾稼，我场上的谷啊， 我从万军之耶和华－ 以色列的神那里所听见的，都告诉你们了。
verses.textEnNiv: My people who are crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the Lord Almighty, from the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: O my threshed and winnowed one, what I have heard from the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, I announce to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, my threshing and the grain of my floor! That which I have heard from the Lord of hosts, The God of Israel, I have declared to you.
verses.textEnNlt: O my people, threshed and winnowed, I have told you everything the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has said, everything the God of Israel has told me.
verses.textEnNasb: My downtrodden people, and my afflicted of the threshing floor! What I have heard from the Lord of armies, The God of Israel, I make known to you.
verses.textEn: My people who are crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the Lord Almighty, from the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 关于以东 默示： 有人从西珥呼叫我说： "守望的啊！黑夜还有多长？ 守望的啊！黑夜还有多长？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于以东 默示： 有人从西珥呼叫我说： "守望的啊！黑夜还有多长？ 守望的啊！黑夜还有多长？"
verses.textZhCuv: 论度玛的默示： 有人声从西珥呼问我说： 守望的啊，夜里如何？ 守望的啊，夜里如何？
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Dumah : Someone calls to me from Seir, "Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?"
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle concerning Dumah. One is calling to me from Seir, "Watchman, what time of the night? Watchman, what time of the night?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, "Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?"
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Edom : Someone from Edom keeps calling to me, "Watchman, how much longer until morning? When will the night be over?"
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning Edom: One keeps calling to me from Seir, "Watchman, how far gone is the night? Watchman, how far gone is the night?"
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Dumah : Someone calls to me from Seir, "Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?"

verses.textZh: 守望的说： "早晨到了，黑夜也会再来； 你们若要问，就尽管问； 也可以回头再来问。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 守望的说： "早晨到了，黑夜也会再来； 你们若要问，就尽管问； 也可以回头再来问。"
verses.textZhCuv: 守望的说： 早晨将到，黑夜也来。 你们若要问就可以问， 可以回头再来。
verses.textEnNiv: The watchman replies, "Morning is coming, but also the night. If you would ask, then ask; and come back yet again."
verses.textEnEsv: The watchman says: "Morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire; come back again."
verses.textEnNkjv: The watchman said, "The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire; Return! Come back!"
verses.textEnNlt: The watchman replies, "Morning is coming, but night will soon return. If you wish to ask again, then come back and ask."
verses.textEnNasb: The watchman says, "Morning comes but also night. If you would inquire, inquire; Come back again."
verses.textEn: The watchman replies, "Morning is coming, but also the night. If you would ask, then ask; and come back yet again."

verses.textZh: 关于阿拉伯的默示： 底但的商队啊！ 你们必在阿拉伯的森林中住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于阿拉伯的默示： 底但的商队啊！ 你们必在阿拉伯的森林中住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 论阿拉伯的默示： 底但结伴的客旅啊， 你们必在阿拉伯的树林中住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Arabia: You caravans of Dedanites, who camp in the thickets of Arabia,
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle concerning Arabia. In the thickets in Arabia you will lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, O you traveling companies of Dedanites.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Arabia: O caravans from Dedan, hide in the deserts of Arabia.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement about Arabia: In the thickets of Arabia you must spend the night, You caravans of Dedanites.
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Arabia: You caravans of Dedanites, who camp in the thickets of Arabia,

verses.textZh: 提玛地的居民哪！ 要拿水来给那些口渴的， 拿饼来接待那些逃难的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 提玛地的居民哪！ 要拿水来给那些口渴的， 拿饼来接待那些逃难的。
verses.textZhCuv: 提玛地的居民拿水来，送给口渴的， 拿饼来迎接逃避的。
verses.textEnNiv: bring water for the thirsty; you who live in Tema, bring food for the fugitives.
verses.textEnEsv: To the thirsty bring water; meet the fugitive with bread, O inhabitants of the land of Tema.
verses.textEnNkjv: O inhabitants of the land of Tema, Bring water to him who is thirsty; With their bread they met him who fled.
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Tema, bring water to these thirsty people, food to these weary refugees.
verses.textEnNasb: Bring water for the thirsty, You inhabitants of the land of Tema; Meet the fugitive with bread.
verses.textEn: bring water for the thirsty; you who live in Tema, bring food for the fugitives.

verses.textZh: 因为他们逃避了刀剑、 已出鞘的刀剑和上了弦的弓， 以及严重的战祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们逃避了刀剑、 已出鞘的刀剑和上了弦的弓， 以及严重的战祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们逃避刀剑和出了鞘的刀， 并上了弦的弓与刀兵的重灾。
verses.textEnNiv: They flee from the sword, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and from the heat of battle.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the press of battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, From the bent bow, and from the distress of war.
verses.textEnNlt: They have fled from the sword, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and the terrors of battle.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have fled from the swords, From the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, And from the press of battle.
verses.textEn: They flee from the sword, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and from the heat of battle.

verses.textZh: 主对我这样说："按照雇工的年数，一年之内，基达的一切光荣都必化为乌有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主对我这样说："按照雇工的年数，一年之内，基达的一切光荣都必化为乌有。
verses.textZhCuv: 主对我这样说：「一年之内，照雇工的年数，基达的一切荣耀必归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to me: "Within one year, as a servant bound by contract would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will come to an end.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus the Lord said to me, "Within a year, according to the years of a hired worker, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus the Lord has said to me: "Within a year, according to the year of a hired man, all the glory of Kedar will fail;
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to me, "Within a year, counting each day, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord said to me: "In a year, as a hired worker would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will come to an end;
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to me: "Within one year, as a servant bound by contract would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will come to an end.

verses.textZh: 弓箭手剩余的人数，就是基达人的勇士，必定很少；这是耶和华以色列的神说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 弓箭手剩余的人数，就是基达人的勇士，必定很少；这是耶和华以色列的神说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 弓箭手所余剩的，就是基达人的勇士，必然稀少，因为这是耶和华－以色列的神说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The survivors of the archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few." The Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: And the remainder of the archers of the mighty men of the sons of Kedar will be few, for the Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: and the remainder of the number of archers, the mighty men of the people of Kedar, will be diminished; for the Lord God of Israel has spoken it."
verses.textEnNlt: Only a few of its courageous archers will survive. I, the Lord , the God of Israel, have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: and the remainder of the number of bowmen, the warriors of the sons of Kedar, will be few; for the Lord God of Israel has spoken."
verses.textEn: The survivors of the archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few." The Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken.

verses.textZh: 关于"异象谷"的默示： 你们发生了甚么事，以致你们都上了房顶呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于"异象谷"的默示： 你们发生了甚么事，以致你们都上了房顶呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 论异象谷的默示： 有什么事使你这满城的人都上房顶呢？
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against the Valley of Vision: What troubles you now, that you have all gone up on the roofs,
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle concerning the valley of vision. What do you mean that you have gone up, all of you, to the housetops,
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against the Valley of Vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops,
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Jerusalem—the Valley of Vision : What is happening? Why is everyone running to the rooftops?
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning the valley of vision: What is the matter with you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
verses.textEn: A prophecy against the Valley of Vision: What troubles you now, that you have all gone up on the roofs,

verses.textZh: 你这充满喧哗，繁嚣、 欢乐的城市啊！ 你们中间被杀的，并不是被刀剑所杀， 也不是在战场上阵亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这充满喧哗，繁嚣、 欢乐的城市啊！ 你们中间被杀的，并不是被刀剑所杀， 也不是在战场上阵亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这满处呐喊、大有喧哗的城， 欢乐的邑啊， 你中间被杀的并不是被刀杀， 也不是因打仗死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: you town so full of commotion, you city of tumult and revelry? Your slain were not killed by the sword, nor did they die in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: you who are full of shoutings, tumultuous city, exultant town? Your slain are not slain with the sword or dead in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: You who are full of noise, A tumultuous city, a joyous city? Your slain menare not slain with the sword, Nor dead in battle.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole city is in a terrible uproar. What do I see in this reveling city? Bodies are lying everywhere, killed not in battle but by famine and disease.
verses.textEnNasb: You who were full of noise, You tumultuous town, you jubilant city; Your dead were not killed with the sword, Nor did they die in battle.
verses.textEn: you town so full of commotion, you city of tumult and revelry? Your slain were not killed by the sword, nor did they die in battle.

verses.textZh: 你们所有的官长都一起逃跑； 他们因没有弓箭而被俘掳， 你们中间所有被找到的都一起被俘掳， 虽然他们已逃到远方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所有的官长都一起逃跑； 他们因没有弓箭而被俘掳， 你们中间所有被找到的都一起被俘掳， 虽然他们已逃到远方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所有的官长一同逃跑， 都为弓箭手所捆绑。 你中间一切被找到的都一同被捆绑； 他们本是逃往远方的。
verses.textEnNiv: All your leaders have fled together; they have been captured without using the bow. All you who were caught were taken prisoner together, having fled while the enemy was still far away.
verses.textEnEsv: All your leaders have fled together; without the bow they were captured. All of you who were found were captured, though they had fled far away.
verses.textEnNkjv: All your rulers have fled together; They are captured by the archers. All who are found in you are bound together; They have fled from afar.
verses.textEnNlt: All your leaders have fled. They surrendered without resistance. The people tried to slip away, but they were captured, too.
verses.textEnNasb: All your rulers have fled together, And have been captured without the bow; All of you who were found were taken captive together, Though they had fled far away.
verses.textEn: All your leaders have fled together; they have been captured without using the bow. All you who were caught were taken prisoner together, having fled while the enemy was still far away.

verses.textZh: 因此我说："要转开你们的眼，不要望着我， 让我痛哭吧！ 不要因我人民的毁灭，而急急安慰我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我说："要转开你们的眼，不要望着我， 让我痛哭吧！ 不要因我人民的毁灭，而急急安慰我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我说：你们转眼不看我， 我要痛哭。 不要因我众民 的毁灭， 就竭力安慰我。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I said, "Turn away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not try to console me over the destruction of my people."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I said: "Look away from me; let me weep bitter tears; do not labor to comfort me concerning the destruction of the daughter of my people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I said, "Look away from me, I will weep bitterly; Do not labor to comfort me Because of the plundering of the daughter of my people."
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why I said, "Leave me alone to weep; do not try to comfort me. Let me cry for my people as I watch them being destroyed."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I say, "Look away from me, Let me weep bitterly, Do not try to comfort me concerning the destruction of the daughter of my people."
verses.textEn: Therefore I said, "Turn away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not try to console me over the destruction of my people."

verses.textZh: 因为主万军之耶和华 使"异象谷"有惊恐、践踏、混乱的日子： 城墙被拆毁， 哀声传到山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主万军之耶和华 使"异象谷"有惊恐、践踏、混乱的日子： 城墙被拆毁， 哀声传到山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主－万军之耶和华使「异象谷」 有溃乱、践踏、烦扰的日子。 城被攻破， 哀声达到山间。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, has a day of tumult and trampling and terror in the Valley of Vision, a day of battering down walls and of crying out to the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord God of hosts has a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the valley of vision, a battering down of walls and a shouting to the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis a day of trouble and treading down and perplexity By the Lord God of hosts In the Valley of Vision— Breaking down the walls And of crying to the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, what a day of crushing defeat! What a day of confusion and terror brought by the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, upon the Valley of Vision! The walls of Jerusalem have been broken, and cries of death echo from the mountainsides.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord God of armies has a day of panic, subjugation, and confusion In the valley of vision, A breaking down of walls And a crying to the mountain.
verses.textEn: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, has a day of tumult and trampling and terror in the Valley of Vision, a day of battering down walls and of crying out to the mountains.

verses.textZh: 以拦拿着箭袋， 并有战车、步兵和骑兵； 吉珥亮出盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以拦拿着箭袋， 并有战车、步兵和骑兵； 吉珥亮出盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 以拦带着箭袋， 还有坐战车的和马兵； 吉珥揭开盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: Elam takes up the quiver, with her charioteers and horses; Kir uncovers the shield.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elam bore the quiver with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elam bore the quiver With chariots of men and horsemen, And Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.textEnNlt: Elamites are the archers, with their chariots and charioteers. The men of Kir hold up the shields.
verses.textEnNasb: Elam picked up the quiver, With the chariots, infantry, and horsemen; And Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.textEn: Elam takes up the quiver, with her charioteers and horses; Kir uncovers the shield.

verses.textZh: 你佳美的山谷都布满战车， 又有骑兵在城门前列阵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你佳美的山谷都布满战车， 又有骑兵在城门前列阵。
verses.textZhCuv: 你嘉美的谷遍满战车， 也有马兵在城门前排列。
verses.textEnNiv: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the city gates.
verses.textEnEsv: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen took their stand at the gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass that your choicest valleys Shall be full of chariots, And the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Chariots fill your beautiful valleys, and charioteers storm your gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Then your choicest valleys were full of chariots, And the horsemen took positions at the gate.
verses.textEn: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the city gates.

verses.textZh: 他挪去犹大的屏障了。 到那日，你就仰望"林宫"里的武器；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他挪去犹大的屏障了。 到那日，你就仰望"林宫"里的武器；
verses.textZhCuv: 他去掉犹大的遮盖。 那日，你就仰望林库内的军器。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord stripped away the defenses of Judah, and you looked in that day to the weapons in the Palace of the Forest.
verses.textEnEsv: He has taken away the covering of Judah. In that day you looked to the weapons of the House of the Forest,
verses.textEnNkjv: He removed the protection of Judah. You looked in that day to the armor of the House of the Forest;
verses.textEnNlt: Judah’s defenses have been stripped away. You run to the armory for your weapons.
verses.textEnNasb: And He removed the defense of Judah. On that day you depended on the weapons of the house of the forest,
verses.textEn: The Lord stripped away the defenses of Judah, and you looked in that day to the weapons in the Palace of the Forest.

verses.textZh: 你们看见大卫的缺口很多， 就储存下池的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看见大卫的缺口很多， 就储存下池的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们看见大卫城的破口很多，便聚积下池的水，
verses.textEnNiv: You saw that the walls of the City of David were broken through in many places; you stored up water in the Lower Pool.
verses.textEnEsv: and you saw that the breaches of the city of David were many. You collected the waters of the lower pool,
verses.textEnNkjv: You also saw the damage to the city of David, That it was great; And you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.textEnNlt: You inspect the breaks in the walls of Jerusalem. You store up water in the lower pool.
verses.textEnNasb: And you saw that the breaches In the wall of the city of David were many; And you collected the waters of the lower pool.
verses.textEn: You saw that the walls of the City of David were broken through in many places; you stored up water in the Lower Pool.

verses.textZh: 你们又数点耶路撒冷的房屋， 把房屋拆掉，用来坚固城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们又数点耶路撒冷的房屋， 把房屋拆掉，用来坚固城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 又数点耶路撒冷的房屋，将房屋拆毁，修补城墙，
verses.textEnNiv: You counted the buildings in Jerusalem and tore down houses to strengthen the wall.
verses.textEnEsv: and you counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, And the houses you broke down To fortify the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: You survey the houses and tear some down for stone to strengthen the walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you counted the houses of Jerusalem And tore down houses to fortify the wall.
verses.textEn: You counted the buildings in Jerusalem and tore down houses to strengthen the wall.

verses.textZh: 你们又在两道城墙之间造一个水池， 用来盛载旧池的水， 你们却不仰望作这事的主， 也不顾念远古以来计划这事的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们又在两道城墙之间造一个水池， 用来盛载旧池的水， 你们却不仰望作这事的主， 也不顾念远古以来计划这事的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在两道城墙中间挖一个聚水池可盛旧池的水，却不仰望做这事的主，也不顾念从古定这事的。
verses.textEnNiv: You built a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the Old Pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or have regard for the One who planned it long ago.
verses.textEnEsv: You made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you did not look to him who did it, or see him who planned it long ago.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also made a reservoir between the two walls For the water of the old pool. But you did not look to its Maker, Nor did you have respect for Him who fashioned it long ago.
verses.textEnNlt: Between the city walls, you build a reservoir for water from the old pool. But you never ask for help from the One who did all this. You never considered the One who planned this long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: And you made a reservoir between the two walls For the waters of the old pool. But you did not depend on Him who made it, Nor did you take into consideration Him who planned it long ago.
verses.textEn: You built a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the Old Pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or have regard for the One who planned it long ago.

verses.textZh: 到那日，主万军之耶和华叫人哭泣哀号， 剃光头发，穿上麻布。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，主万军之耶和华叫人哭泣哀号， 剃光头发，穿上麻布。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，主－万军之耶和华叫人哭泣哀号， 头上光秃，身披麻布。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, called you on that day to weep and to wail, to tear out your hair and put on sackcloth.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord God of hosts called for weeping and mourning, for baldness and wearing sackcloth;
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day the Lord God of hosts Called for weeping and for mourning, For baldness and for girding with sackcloth.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, called you to weep and mourn. He told you to shave your heads in sorrow for your sins and to wear clothes of burlap to show your remorse.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore on that day the Lord God of armies called you to weeping, to wailing, To shaving the head, and to wearing sackcloth.
verses.textEn: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, called you on that day to weep and to wail, to tear out your hair and put on sackcloth.

verses.textZh: 看哪！人还是欢喜快乐， 宰牛杀羊， 吃肉喝酒，说： "我们吃喝吧！因为明天我们就要死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！人还是欢喜快乐， 宰牛杀羊， 吃肉喝酒，说： "我们吃喝吧！因为明天我们就要死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁知，人倒欢喜快乐， 宰牛杀羊，吃肉喝酒，说： 我们吃喝吧！因为明天要死了。
verses.textEnNiv: But see, there is joy and revelry, slaughtering of cattle and killing of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine! "Let us eat and drink," you say, "for tomorrow we die!"
verses.textEnEsv: and behold, joy and gladness, killing oxen and slaughtering sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine. "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."
verses.textEnNkjv: But instead, joy and gladness, Slaying oxen and killing sheep, Eating meat and drinking wine: "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"
verses.textEnNlt: But instead, you dance and play; you slaughter cattle and kill sheep. You feast on meat and drink wine. You say, "Let’s feast and drink, for tomorrow we die!"
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, there is joy and jubilation, Killing of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, Eating of meat and drinking of wine: "Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we may die."
verses.textEn: But see, there is joy and revelry, slaughtering of cattle and killing of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine! "Let us eat and drink," you say, "for tomorrow we die!"

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华亲自启示我说： "直到你们死的时候， 这罪孽也不得赦免。"这是主万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华亲自启示我说： "直到你们死的时候， 这罪孽也不得赦免。"这是主万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华亲自默示我说： 这罪孽直到你们死，断不得赦免！ 这是主－万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty has revealed this in my hearing: "Till your dying day this sin will not be atoned for," says the Lord, the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts has revealed himself in my ears: "Surely this iniquity will not be atoned for you until you die," says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it was revealed in my hearing by the Lord of hosts, "Surely for this iniquity there will be no atonement for you, Even to your death," says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has revealed this to me: "Till the day you die, you will never be forgiven for this sin." That is the judgment of the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord of armies revealed Himself to me: "Certainly this wrongdoing will not be forgiven you Until you die," says the Lord God of armies.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty has revealed this in my hearing: "Till your dying day this sin will not be atoned for," says the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 主万军之耶和华这样说： "你去见这掌管库房的， 就是总管舍伯那，对他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 主万军之耶和华这样说： "你去见这掌管库房的， 就是总管舍伯那，对他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 主－万军之耶和华这样说：「你去见掌银库的，就是家宰舍伯那，对他说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says: "Go, say to this steward, to Shebna the palace administrator:
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God of hosts, "Come, go to this steward, to Shebna, who is over the household, and say to him:
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God of hosts: "Go, proceed to this steward, To Shebna, who is over the house, andsay:
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, said to me: "Confront Shebna, the palace administrator, and give him this message:
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God of armies says: "Come, go to this steward, To Shebna who is in charge of the royal household,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says: "Go, say to this steward, to Shebna the palace administrator:

verses.textZh: 你在这里有甚么权利呢？ 你在这里有甚么人， 竟在这里为你自己凿坟墓， 就是在高处为自己凿坟墓， 在盘石中为自己凿出安身之所呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在这里有甚么权利呢？ 你在这里有甚么人， 竟在这里为你自己凿坟墓， 就是在高处为自己凿坟墓， 在盘石中为自己凿出安身之所呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 『你在这里做什么呢？有什么人竟在这里凿坟墓，就是在高处为自己凿坟墓，在磐石中为自己凿出安身之所？
verses.textEnNiv: What are you doing here and who gave you permission to cut out a grave for yourself here, hewing your grave on the height and chiseling your resting place in the rock?
verses.textEnEsv: What have you to do here, and whom have you here, that you have cut out here a tomb for yourself, you who cut out a tomb on the height and carve a dwelling for yourself in the rock?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘What have you here, and whom have you here, That you have hewn a sepulcher here, As he who hews himself a sepulcher on high, Who carves a tomb for himself in a rock?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who do you think you are, and what are you doing here, building a beautiful tomb for yourself— a monument high up in the rock?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘What right do you have here, And whom do you have here, That you have cut out a tomb for yourself here, You who cut out a tomb on the height, You who carve a resting place for yourself in the rock?
verses.textEn: What are you doing here and who gave you permission to cut out a grave for yourself here, hewing your grave on the height and chiseling your resting place in the rock?

verses.textZh: 看哪，勇士啊！耶和华将要猛烈地拋掷你； 他必把你紧紧抓住，
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，勇士啊！耶和华将要猛烈地拋掷你； 他必把你紧紧抓住，
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华必像大有力的人，将你紧紧缠裹，竭力抛去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Beware, the Lord is about to take firm hold of you and hurl you away, you mighty man.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord will hurl you away violently, O you strong man. He will seize firm hold on you
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, the Lord will throw you away violently, O mighty man, And will surely seize you.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is about to hurl you away, mighty man. He is going to grab you,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, the Lord is about to hurl you violently, you strong man. And He is about to grasp you firmly
verses.textEn: "Beware, the Lord is about to take firm hold of you and hurl you away, you mighty man.

verses.textZh: 把你卷了又卷，卷成球状， 然后掷到宽阔之地； 你必死在那里， 你那华美的战车也在那里； 你成了你主人之家的耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把你卷了又卷，卷成球状， 然后掷到宽阔之地； 你必死在那里， 你那华美的战车也在那里； 你成了你主人之家的耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必将你滚成一团，抛在宽阔之地，好像抛球一样。你这主人家的羞辱，必在那里坐你荣耀的车，也必在那里死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: He will roll you up tightly like a ball and throw you into a large country. There you will die and there the chariots you were so proud of will become a disgrace to your master’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: and whirl you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a wide land. There you shall die, and there shall be your glorious chariots, you shame of your master’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will surely turn violently and toss you like a ball Into a large country; There you shall die, and there your glorious chariots Shallbe the shame of your master’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: crumple you into a ball, and toss you away into a distant, barren land. There you will die, and your glorious chariots will be broken and useless. You are a disgrace to your master!
verses.textEnNasb: And wrap you up tightly like a ball, To be driven into a vast country; There you will die, And there your splendid chariots will be, You shame of your master’s house!’
verses.textEn: He will roll you up tightly like a ball and throw you into a large country. There you will die and there the chariots you were so proud of will become a disgrace to your master’s house.

verses.textZh: 我必革除你的官职， 从你的原位上把你拉下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必革除你的官职， 从你的原位上把你拉下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必赶逐你离开官职；你必从你的原位撤下。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will depose you from your office, and you will be ousted from your position.
verses.textEnEsv: I will thrust you from your office, and you will be pulled down from your station.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will drive you out of your office, And from your position he will pull you down.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, I will drive you out of office," says the Lord . "I will pull you down from your high position.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will depose you from your office, And I will pull you down from your position.
verses.textEn: I will depose you from your office, and you will be ousted from your position.

verses.textZh: 到那日， 我必召希勒家的儿子，就是我的仆人以利亚敬来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日， 我必召希勒家的儿子，就是我的仆人以利亚敬来，
verses.textZhCuv: 「到那日，我必召我仆人希勒家的儿子以利亚敬来，
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day I will summon my servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Then it shall be in that day, That I will call My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah;
verses.textEnNlt: And then I will call my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah to replace you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it will come about on that day, That I will summon My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verses.textEn: "In that day I will summon my servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

verses.textZh: 我会把你的外袍给他穿， 把你的腰带给他系紧， 把你的权柄交在他的手中； 他要作耶路撒冷的居民和犹大家的父。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我会把你的外袍给他穿， 把你的腰带给他系紧， 把你的权柄交在他的手中； 他要作耶路撒冷的居民和犹大家的父。
verses.textZhCuv: 将你的外袍给他穿上，将你的腰带给他系紧，将你的政权交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和犹大家的父。
verses.textEnNiv: I will clothe him with your robe and fasten your sash around him and hand your authority over to him. He will be a father to those who live in Jerusalem and to the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will clothe him with your robe, and will bind your sash on him, and will commit your authority to his hand. And he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will clothe him with your robe And strengthen him with your belt; I will commit your responsibility into his hand. He shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem And to the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: I will dress him in your royal robes and will give him your title and your authority. And he will be a father to the people of Jerusalem and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will clothe him with your tunic And tie your sash securely around him. I will hand your authority over to him, And he will become a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
verses.textEn: I will clothe him with your robe and fasten your sash around him and hand your authority over to him. He will be a father to those who live in Jerusalem and to the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 我必把大卫家的钥匙放在他肩头上； 他开了，就没有人能关； 他关了，就没有人能开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把大卫家的钥匙放在他肩头上； 他开了，就没有人能关； 他关了，就没有人能开。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将大卫家的钥匙放在他肩头上。他开，无人能关；他关，无人能开。
verses.textEnNiv: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David; what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will place on his shoulder the key of the house of David. He shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.textEnNkjv: The key of the house of David I will lay on his shoulder; So he shall open, and no one shall shut; And he shall shut, and no one shall open.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give him the key to the house of David—the highest position in the royal court. When he opens doors, no one will be able to close them; when he closes doors, no one will be able to open them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will put the key of the house of David on his shoulder; When he opens, no one will shut, When he shuts, no one will open.
verses.textEn: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David; what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

verses.textZh: 我必坚立他，像钉子钉在稳固的地方； 他必作父家荣耀的宝座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必坚立他，像钉子钉在稳固的地方； 他必作父家荣耀的宝座。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将他安稳，像钉子钉在坚固处；他必作为他父家荣耀的宝座。
verses.textEnNiv: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place; he will become a seat of honor for the house of his father.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will fasten him like a peg in a secure place, and he will become a throne of honor to his father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will fasten him as a peg in a secure place, And he will become a glorious throne to his father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: He will bring honor to his family name, for I will drive him firmly in place like a nail in the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will drive him like a peg in a firm place, And he will become a throne of glory to his father’s house.
verses.textEn: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place; he will become a seat of honor for the house of his father.

verses.textZh: 他父家所有的荣耀，他的儿女和子孙以及各样小器皿，从碗子到瓶子，都挂在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父家所有的荣耀，他的儿女和子孙以及各样小器皿，从碗子到瓶子，都挂在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他父家所有的荣耀，连儿女带子孙，都挂在他身上，好像一切小器皿，从杯子到酒瓶挂上一样。
verses.textEnNiv: All the glory of his family will hang on him: its offspring and offshoots—all its lesser vessels, from the bowls to all the jars.
verses.textEnEsv: And they will hang on him the whole honor of his father’s house, the offspring and issue, every small vessel, from the cups to all the flagons.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the posterity, all vessels of small quantity, from the cups to all the pitchers.
verses.textEnNlt: They will give him great responsibility, and he will bring honor to even the lowliest members of his family. "
verses.textEnNasb: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the descendants, all the least of vessels, from bowls to all the jars.
verses.textEn: All the glory of his family will hang on him: its offspring and offshoots—all its lesser vessels, from the bowls to all the jars.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说：‘到那日，那钉在稳固地方的钉子必垂下来，被砍断坠落；那挂在上面的担子必被砍掉，因为这是耶和华说的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说：‘到那日，那钉在稳固地方的钉子必垂下来，被砍断坠落；那挂在上面的担子必被砍掉，因为这是耶和华说的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：当那日，钉在坚固处的钉子必压斜，被砍断落地；挂在其上的重担必被剪断。因为这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Lord Almighty, "the peg driven into the firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and will fall, and the load hanging on it will be cut down." The Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day, declares the Lord of hosts, the peg that was fastened in a secure place will give way, and it will be cut down and fall, and the load that was on it will be cut off, for the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day,’ says the Lord of hosts, ‘the peg that is fastened in the secure place will be removed and be cut down and fall, and the burden that was on it will be cut off; for the Lord has spoken.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord of Heaven’s Armies also says: "The time will come when I will pull out the nail that seemed so firm. It will come out and fall to the ground. Everything it supports will fall with it. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: On that day," declares the Lord of armies, "the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will even break off and fall, and the load that is hanging on it will be cut off, for the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Lord Almighty, "the peg driven into the firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and will fall, and the load hanging on it will be cut down." The Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 关于推罗的默示： 他施的船只啊，要哀号！ 因为推罗被毁灭了，再没有房屋，也不能再作港口， 这消息是他们从塞浦路斯地得来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于推罗的默示： 他施的船只啊，要哀号！ 因为推罗被毁灭了，再没有房屋，也不能再作港口， 这消息是他们从塞浦路斯地得来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 论泰尔的默示： 他施的船只都要哀号； 因为泰尔变为荒场， 甚至没有房屋，没有可进之路。 这消息是从基提地得来的。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy against Tyre: Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For Tyre is destroyed and left without house or harbor. From the land of Cyprus word has come to them.
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle concerning Tyre. Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste, without house or harbor! From the land of Cyprus it is revealed to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Tyre. Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, So that there is no house, no harbor; From the land of Cyprus it is revealed to them.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning Tyre: Wail, you trading ships of Tarshish, for the harbor and houses of Tyre are gone! The rumors you heard in Cyprus are all true.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning Tyre: Wail, you ships of Tarshish, For Tyre is destroyed, without house or harbor; It is reported to them from the land of Cyprus.
verses.textEn: A prophecy against Tyre: Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For Tyre is destroyed and left without house or harbor. From the land of Cyprus word has come to them.

verses.textZh: 沿海的居民， 就是靠航海致富的西顿商人哪！ 要静默无言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿海的居民， 就是靠航海致富的西顿商人哪！ 要静默无言。
verses.textZhCuv: 沿海的居民， 就是素来靠航海西顿的商家得丰盛的， 你们当静默无言。
verses.textEnNiv: Be silent, you people of the island and you merchants of Sidon, whom the seafarers have enriched.
verses.textEnEsv: Be still, O inhabitants of the coast; the merchants of Sidon, who cross the sea, have filled you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be still, you inhabitants of the coastland, You merchants of Sidon, Whom those who cross the sea have filled.
verses.textEnNlt: Mourn in silence, you people of the coast and you merchants of Sidon. Your traders crossed the sea,
verses.textEnNasb: Be silent, you inhabitants of the coastland, You merchants of Sidon; Your messengers crossed the sea
verses.textEn: Be silent, you people of the island and you merchants of Sidon, whom the seafarers have enriched.

verses.textZh: 在大水之上， 西曷的谷物、尼罗河的庄稼，都是推罗的收益， 推罗成了列国的市场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在大水之上， 西曷的谷物、尼罗河的庄稼，都是推罗的收益， 推罗成了列国的市场。
verses.textZhCuv: 在大水之上， 西曷的粮食、 尼罗河的庄稼是泰尔的进项； 她作列国的大码头。
verses.textEnNiv: On the great waters came the grain of the Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre, and she became the marketplace of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: And on many waters your revenue was the grain of Shihor, the harvest of the Nile; you were the merchant of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on great waters the grain of Shihor, The harvest of the River, is her revenue; And she is a marketplace for the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: sailing over deep waters. They brought you grain from Egypt and harvests from along the Nile. You were the marketplace of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: And were on many waters. The grain of the Nile, the harvest of the River was her revenue; And she was the market of nations.
verses.textEn: On the great waters came the grain of the Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre, and she became the marketplace of the nations.

verses.textZh: 西顿啊，要惭愧！ 因为大海说过，就是海上的保障说过： "我没有受过产痛，也没有生产； 我没有养大过男孩，也没有抚养过童女。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西顿啊，要惭愧！ 因为大海说过，就是海上的保障说过： "我没有受过产痛，也没有生产； 我没有养大过男孩，也没有抚养过童女。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西顿哪，你当惭愧； 因为大海说， 就是海中的保障说： 我没有劬劳，也没有生产， 没有养育男子，也没有抚养童女。
verses.textEnNiv: Be ashamed, Sidon, and you fortress of the sea, for the sea has spoken: "I have neither been in labor nor given birth; I have neither reared sons nor brought up daughters."
verses.textEnEsv: Be ashamed, O Sidon, for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying: "I have neither labored nor given birth, I have neither reared young men nor brought up young women."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be ashamed, O Sidon; For the sea has spoken, The strength of the sea, saying, "I do not labor, nor bring forth children; Neither do I rear young men, Nor bring up virgins."
verses.textEnNlt: But now you are put to shame, city of Sidon, for Tyre, the fortress of the sea, says, "Now I am childless; I have no sons or daughters."
verses.textEnNasb: Be ashamed, Sidon, For the sea speaks, the stronghold of the sea, saying, "I have neither been in labor nor given birth, I have neither brought up young men nor raised virgins."
verses.textEn: Be ashamed, Sidon, and you fortress of the sea, for the sea has spoken: "I have neither been in labor nor given birth; I have neither reared sons nor brought up daughters."

verses.textZh: 这消息传到埃及时， 埃及人就为推罗这消息非常伤痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这消息传到埃及时， 埃及人就为推罗这消息非常伤痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 这风声传到埃及； 埃及人为泰尔的风声极其疼痛。
verses.textEnNiv: When word comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report from Tyre.
verses.textEnEsv: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish over the report about Tyre.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the report reaches Egypt, They also will be in agony at the report of Tyre.
verses.textEnNlt: When Egypt hears the news about Tyre, there will be great sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: When the report reaches Egypt, They will be in anguish over the report of Tyre.
verses.textEn: When word comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report from Tyre.

verses.textZh: 你们要过到他施去； 沿海的居民哪，要哀号！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要过到他施去； 沿海的居民哪，要哀号！
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔人哪，你们当过到他施去； 沿海的居民哪，你们都当哀号。
verses.textEnNiv: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, you people of the island.
verses.textEnEsv: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coast!
verses.textEnNkjv: Cross over to Tarshish; Wail, you inhabitants of the coastland!
verses.textEnNlt: Send word now to Tarshish! Wail, you people who live in distant lands!
verses.textEnNasb: Pass over to Tarshish; Wail, you inhabitants of the coastland.
verses.textEn: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, you people of the island.

verses.textZh: 这就是你们欢乐的城吗？ 它的起源溯自上古， 它的脚把其中的居民带到远方去寄居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是你们欢乐的城吗？ 它的起源溯自上古， 它的脚把其中的居民带到远方去寄居。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是你们欢乐的城， 从上古而有的吗？ 其中的居民往远方寄居。
verses.textEnNiv: Is this your city of revelry, the old, old city, whose feet have taken her to settle in far-off lands?
verses.textEnEsv: Is this your exultant city whose origin is from days of old, whose feet carried her to settle far away?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is this your joyous city, Whose antiquity is from ancient days, Whose feet carried her far off to dwell?
verses.textEnNlt: Is this silent ruin all that is left of your once joyous city? What a long history was yours! Think of all the colonists you sent to distant places.
verses.textEnNasb: Is this your jubilant city, Whose origin is from antiquity, Whose feet used to bring her to colonize distant places?
verses.textEn: Is this your city of revelry, the old, old city, whose feet have taken her to settle in far-off lands?

verses.textZh: 谁策划这事来攻击推罗呢？它本是赐人冠冕的城， 它的商人是王子，它的商贾是世上的尊贵人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁策划这事来攻击推罗呢？它本是赐人冠冕的城， 它的商人是王子，它的商贾是世上的尊贵人。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔本是赐冠冕的。 她的商家是王子； 她的买卖人是世上的尊贵人。 遭遇如此是谁定的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are renowned in the earth?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has purposed this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants were princes, whose traders were the honored of the earth?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, Whose merchants are princes, Whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
verses.textEnNlt: Who has brought this disaster on Tyre, that great creator of kingdoms? Her traders were all princes, her merchants were nobles.
verses.textEnNasb: Who has planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, Whose merchants were princes, whose traders were the honored of the earth?
verses.textEn: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are renowned in the earth?

verses.textZh: 这是万军之耶和华所定的旨意， 要凌辱那些因荣美而有狂傲， 使地上所有的尊贵人被藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是万军之耶和华所定的旨意， 要凌辱那些因荣美而有狂傲， 使地上所有的尊贵人被藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 是万军之耶和华所定的！ 为要污辱一切高傲的荣耀， 使地上一切的尊贵人被藐视。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty planned it, to bring down her pride in all her splendor and to humble all who are renowned on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts has purposed it, to defile the pompous pride of all glory, to dishonor all the honored of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts has purposed it, To bring to dishonor the pride of all glory, To bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has done it to destroy your pride and bring low all earth’s nobility.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies has planned it, to defile the pride of all beauty, To despise all the honored of the earth.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty planned it, to bring down her pride in all her splendor and to humble all who are renowned on the earth.

verses.textZh: 他施的居民哪！要像尼罗河一般流遍你的地， 再没有限制了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他施的居民哪！要像尼罗河一般流遍你的地， 再没有限制了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施的民 哪， 可以流行你的地，好像尼罗河； 不再有腰带拘紧你。
verses.textEnNiv: Till your land as they do along the Nile, Daughter Tarshish, for you no longer have a harbor.
verses.textEnEsv: Cross over your land like the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Overflow through your land like the River, O daughter of Tarshish; Thereis no more strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, people of Tarshish, sweep over the land like the flooding Nile, for Tyre is defenseless.
verses.textEnNasb: Overflow your land like the Nile, you daughter of Tarshish, There is no more restraint.
verses.textEn: Till your land as they do along the Nile, Daughter Tarshish, for you no longer have a harbor.

verses.textZh: 耶和华已经向海伸手， 使列国震动； 耶和华又发出一个关于迦南的吩咐， 就是要毁坏其中的保障。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华已经向海伸手， 使列国震动； 耶和华又发出一个关于迦南的吩咐， 就是要毁坏其中的保障。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已经向海伸手， 震动列国。 至于迦南， 他已经吩咐拆毁其中的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has stretched out his hand over the sea and made its kingdoms tremble. He has given an order concerning Phoenicia that her fortresses be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: He has stretched out his hand over the sea; he has shaken the kingdoms; the Lord has given command concerning Canaan to destroy its strongholds.
verses.textEnNkjv: He stretched out His hand over the sea, He shook the kingdoms; The Lord has given a commandment against Canaan To destroy its strongholds.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord held out his hand over the sea and shook the kingdoms of the earth. He has spoken out against Phoenicia, ordering that her fortresses be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: He has stretched His hand out over the sea, He has made the kingdoms tremble; The Lord has given a command concerning Canaan to demolish its strongholds.
verses.textEn: The Lord has stretched out his hand over the sea and made its kingdoms tremble. He has given an order concerning Phoenicia that her fortresses be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 他又说："受压制的西顿居民哪， 你们不再有欢乐了！ 起来，过到塞浦路斯去！就是在那里，你们也得不到安息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："受压制的西顿居民哪， 你们不再有欢乐了！ 起来，过到塞浦路斯去！就是在那里，你们也得不到安息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他又说：受欺压西顿的居民 哪， 你必不得再欢乐。 起来！过到基提去； 就是在那里也不得安歇。 （
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "No more of your reveling, Virgin Daughter Sidon, now crushed! "Up, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said: "You will no more exult, O oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon; arise, cross over to Cyprus, even there you will have no rest."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "You will rejoice no more, O you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, cross over to Cyprus; There also you will have no rest."
verses.textEnNlt: He says, "Never again will you rejoice, O daughter of Sidon, for you have been crushed. Even if you flee to Cyprus, you will find no rest."
verses.textEnNasb: He has said, "You shall not be jubilant anymore, you crushed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest."
verses.textEn: He said, "No more of your reveling, Virgin Daughter Sidon, now crushed! "Up, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest."

verses.textZh: 看哪！使推罗成为旷野，走兽居住之处的，是来自迦勒底地的人，而不是亚述人；他们要筑起攻城的高塔，拆毁推罗的城堡，使它成为废墟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！使推罗成为旷野，走兽居住之处的，是来自迦勒底地的人，而不是亚述人；他们要筑起攻城的高塔，拆毁推罗的城堡，使它成为废墟。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，迦勒底人之地向来没有这民，这国是亚述人为住旷野的人所立的。现在他们建筑戍楼，拆毁泰尔的宫殿，使她成为荒凉。）
verses.textEnNiv: Look at the land of the Babylonians, this people that is now of no account! The Assyrians have made it a place for desert creatures; they raised up their siege towers, they stripped its fortresses bare and turned it into a ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold the land of the Chaldeans! This is the people that was not; Assyria destined it for wild beasts. They erected their siege towers, they stripped her palaces bare, they made her a ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans, This people which was not; Assyria founded it for wild beasts of the desert. They set up its towers, They raised up its palaces, And brought it to ruin.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at the land of Babylonia — the people of that land are gone! The Assyrians have handed Babylon over to the wild animals of the desert. They have built siege ramps against its walls, torn down its palaces, and turned it to a heap of rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans—this is the people that did not exist; Assyria allocated it for desert creatures—they erected their siege towers, they stripped its palaces, they made it a ruin.
verses.textEn: Look at the land of the Babylonians, this people that is now of no account! The Assyrians have made it a place for desert creatures; they raised up their siege towers, they stripped its fortresses bare and turned it into a ruin.

verses.textZh: 他施的船只啊，要哀号！ 因为你们的保障已被毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他施的船只啊，要哀号！ 因为你们的保障已被毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施的船只都要哀号， 因为你们的保障变为荒场。
verses.textEnNiv: Wail, you ships of Tarshish; your fortress is destroyed!
verses.textEnEsv: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For your strength is laid waste.
verses.textEnNlt: Wail, you ships of Tarshish, for your harbor is destroyed!
verses.textEnNasb: Wail, you ships of Tarshish, For your stronghold is destroyed.
verses.textEn: Wail, you ships of Tarshish; your fortress is destroyed!

verses.textZh: 到那日，推罗必被忘记七十年，正如一个王朝的年日；七十年后，推罗必像妓女所唱之歌：
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，推罗必被忘记七十年，正如一个王朝的年日；七十年后，推罗必像妓女所唱之歌：
verses.textZhCuv: 到那时，泰尔必被忘记七十年，照着一王的年日。七十年后，泰尔的景况必像妓女所唱的歌：
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the span of a king’s life. But at the end of these seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:
verses.textEnEsv: In that day Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, like the days of one king. At the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it shall come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
verses.textEnNlt: For seventy years, the length of a king’s life, Tyre will be forgotten. But then the city will come back to life as in the song about the prostitute:
verses.textEnNasb: Now on that day Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years like the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:
verses.textEn: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the span of a king’s life. But at the end of these seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:

verses.textZh: "你被遗忘的妓女啊！ 拿起琴来，走遍全城吧。 你要巧弹多唱， 使人再想起你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你被遗忘的妓女啊！ 拿起琴来，走遍全城吧。 你要巧弹多唱， 使人再想起你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你这被忘记的妓女啊， 拿琴周流城内， 巧弹多唱，使人再想念你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take up a harp, walk through the city, you forgotten prostitute; play the harp well, sing many a song, so that you will be remembered."
verses.textEnEsv: "Take a harp; go about the city, O forgotten prostitute! Make sweet melody; sing many songs, that you may be remembered."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take a harp, go about the city, You forgotten harlot; Make sweet melody, sing many songs, That you may be remembered."
verses.textEnNlt: Take a harp and walk the streets, you forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody and sing your songs so you will be remembered again.
verses.textEnNasb: Take your harp, wander around the city, You forgotten prostitute; Pluck the strings skillfully, sing many songs, That you may be remembered.
verses.textEn: "Take up a harp, walk through the city, you forgotten prostitute; play the harp well, sing many a song, so that you will be remembered."

verses.textZh: 七十年后，耶和华必眷顾推罗，推罗就恢复繁荣，可以与地上的万国交易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七十年后，耶和华必眷顾推罗，推罗就恢复繁荣，可以与地上的万国交易。
verses.textZhCuv: 七十年后，耶和华必眷顾泰尔，她就仍得利息 ，与地上的万国交易 。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of seventy years, the Lord will deal with Tyre. She will return to her lucrative prostitution and will ply her trade with all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of seventy years, the Lord will visit Tyre, and she will return to her wages and will prostitute herself with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, at the end of seventy years, that the Lord will deal with Tyre. She will return to her hire, and commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, after seventy years the Lord will revive Tyre. But she will be no different than she was before. She will again be a prostitute to all kingdoms around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: It will come about at the end of seventy years that the Lord will visit Tyre. Then she will go back to her prostitute’s wages and commit prostitution with all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
verses.textEn: At the end of seventy years, the Lord will deal with Tyre. She will return to her lucrative prostitution and will ply her trade with all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.

verses.textZh: 它的货财和所得的利益要分别为圣归给耶和华，必不会积聚或储藏起来；因为它的货财必归给那些住在耶和华面前的人，使他们吃得饱足，穿得漂亮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的货财和所得的利益要分别为圣归给耶和华，必不会积聚或储藏起来；因为它的货财必归给那些住在耶和华面前的人，使他们吃得饱足，穿得漂亮。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的货财和利息要归耶和华为圣，必不积攒存留；因为她的货财必为住在耶和华面前的人所得，使他们吃饱，穿耐久的衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet her profit and her earnings will be set apart for the Lord ; they will not be stored up or hoarded. Her profits will go to those who live before the Lord , for abundant food and fine clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: Her merchandise and her wages will be holy to the Lord . It will not be stored or hoarded, but her merchandise will supply abundant food and fine clothing for those who dwell before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Her gain and her pay will be set apart for the Lord; it will not be treasured nor laid up, for her gain will be for those who dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for fine clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: But in the end her profits will be given to the Lord . Her wealth will not be hoarded but will provide good food and fine clothing for the Lord ’s priests.
verses.textEnNasb: Her profit and her prostitute’s wages will be sacred to the Lord; it will not be stored up or hoarded, but her profit will become sufficient food and magnificent attire for those who dwell in the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Yet her profit and her earnings will be set apart for the Lord ; they will not be stored up or hoarded. Her profits will go to those who live before the Lord , for abundant food and fine clothes.

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华使大地空虚，变为荒凉； 他必翻转地面，使地上的居民四散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华使大地空虚，变为荒凉； 他必翻转地面，使地上的居民四散。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华使地空虚，变为荒凉； 又翻转大地，将居民分散。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Lord is going to lay waste the earth and devastate it; he will ruin its face and scatter its inhabitants—
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord will empty the earth and make it desolate, and he will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the Lord makes the earth empty and makes it waste, Distorts its surface And scatters abroad its inhabitants.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The Lord is about to destroy the earth and make it a vast wasteland. He devastates the surface of the earth and scatters the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord lays the earth waste, devastates it, twists its surface, and scatters its inhabitants.
verses.textEn: See, the Lord is going to lay waste the earth and devastate it; he will ruin its face and scatter its inhabitants—

verses.textZh: 人民和祭司， 仆人和主人， 婢女和主母， 购买的和贩卖的， 借给人和向人借的， 放债的和借债的，全都一样被分散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民和祭司， 仆人和主人， 婢女和主母， 购买的和贩卖的， 借给人和向人借的， 放债的和借债的，全都一样被分散。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时百姓怎样，祭司也怎样； 仆人怎样，主人也怎样； 婢女怎样，主母也怎样； 买物的怎样，卖物的也怎样； 放债的怎样，借债的也怎样； 取利的怎样，出利的也怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: it will be the same for priest as for people, for the master as for his servant, for the mistress as for her servant, for seller as for buyer, for borrower as for lender, for debtor as for creditor.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the slave, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the creditor, so with the debtor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be: As with the people, so with the priest; As with the servant, so with his master; As with the maid, so with her mistress; As with the buyer, so with the seller; As with the lender, so with the borrower; As with the creditor, so with the debtor.
verses.textEnNlt: Priests and laypeople, servants and masters, maids and mistresses, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, bankers and debtors—none will be spared.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people will be like the priest, the servant like his master, the female servant like her mistress, the buyer like the seller, the lender like the borrower, the creditor like the debtor.
verses.textEn: it will be the same for priest as for people, for the master as for his servant, for the mistress as for her servant, for seller as for buyer, for borrower as for lender, for debtor as for creditor.

verses.textZh: 大地必完全倒空， 被劫掠净尽， 这话是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地必完全倒空， 被劫掠净尽， 这话是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 地必全然空虚，尽都荒凉； 因为这话是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth will be completely laid waste and totally plundered. The Lord has spoken this word.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth shall be utterly empty and utterly plundered; for the Lord has spoken this word.
verses.textEnNkjv: The land shall be entirely emptied and utterly plundered, For the Lord has spoken this word.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth will be completely emptied and looted. The Lord has spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: The earth will be completely laid waste and completely plundered, for the Lord has spoken this word.
verses.textEn: The earth will be completely laid waste and totally plundered. The Lord has spoken this word.

verses.textZh: 大地悲哀衰残， 世界零落衰残， 地上居高位的人也衰败了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地悲哀衰残， 世界零落衰残， 地上居高位的人也衰败了。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上悲哀衰残， 世界败落衰残； 地上居高位的人也败落了。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth dries up and withers, the world languishes and withers, the heavens languish with the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and withers; the highest people of the earth languish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth mourns and fades away, The world languishes and fades away; The haughty people of the earth languish.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth mourns and dries up, and the land wastes away and withers. Even the greatest people on earth waste away.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth dries up and crumbles away, the mainland dries out and crumbles away, the exalted of the people of the earth dwindle.
verses.textEn: The earth dries up and withers, the world languishes and withers, the heavens languish with the earth.

verses.textZh: 大地被其上的居民玷污， 因为他们犯了律法， 违了律例， 背了永远的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地被其上的居民玷污， 因为他们犯了律法， 违了律例， 背了永远的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 地被其上的居民污秽； 因为他们犯了律法， 废了律例，背了永约。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth is defiled by its people; they have disobeyed the laws, violated the statutes and broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth lies defiled under its inhabitants; for they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth is also defiled under its inhabitants, Because they have transgressed the laws, Changed the ordinance, Broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth suffers for the sins of its people, for they have twisted God’s instructions, violated his laws, and broken his everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth is also defiled by its inhabitants, for they violated laws, altered statutes, and broke the everlasting covenant.
verses.textEn: The earth is defiled by its people; they have disobeyed the laws, violated the statutes and broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.textZh: 因此，大地被咒诅吞灭， 地上的居民要承担惩罚。 因此，地上的居民被焚烧， 剩下的人很少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，大地被咒诅吞灭， 地上的居民要承担惩罚。 因此，地上的居民被焚烧， 剩下的人很少。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，地被咒诅吞灭； 住在其上的显为有罪。 地上的居民被火焚烧， 剩下的人稀少。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore a curse consumes the earth; its people must bear their guilt. Therefore earth’s inhabitants are burned up, and very few are left.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore a curse devours the earth, and its inhabitants suffer for their guilt; therefore the inhabitants of the earth are scorched, and few men are left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, And those who dwell in it are desolate. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, And few men are left.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, a curse consumes the earth. Its people must pay the price for their sin. They are destroyed by fire, and only a few are left alive.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, a curse devours the earth, and those who live on it suffer for their guilt. Therefore, the inhabitants of the earth decrease in number, and few people are left.
verses.textEn: Therefore a curse consumes the earth; its people must bear their guilt. Therefore earth’s inhabitants are burned up, and very few are left.

verses.textZh: 新酒悲哀， 葡萄树衰残， 心中欢乐的，变为叹息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 新酒悲哀， 葡萄树衰残， 心中欢乐的，变为叹息。
verses.textZhCuv: 新酒悲哀，葡萄树衰残； 心中欢乐的俱都叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: The new wine dries up and the vine withers; all the merrymakers groan.
verses.textEnEsv: The wine mourns, the vine languishes, all the merry-hearted sigh.
verses.textEnNkjv: The new wine fails, the vine languishes, All the merry-hearted sigh.
verses.textEnNlt: The grapevines waste away, and there is no new wine. All the merrymakers sigh and mourn.
verses.textEnNasb: The new wine mourns, The vine decays, All the joyful-hearted sigh.
verses.textEn: The new wine dries up and the vine withers; all the merrymakers groan.

verses.textZh: 击鼓的喜乐止息， 宴乐者的喧哗停止， 弹琴的喜乐也止息了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 击鼓的喜乐止息， 宴乐者的喧哗停止， 弹琴的喜乐也止息了。
verses.textZhCuv: 击鼓之乐止息； 宴乐人的声音完毕， 弹琴之乐也止息了。
verses.textEnNiv: The joyful timbrels are stilled, the noise of the revelers has stopped, the joyful harp is silent.
verses.textEnEsv: The mirth of the tambourines is stilled, the noise of the jubilant has ceased, the mirth of the lyre is stilled.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mirth of the tambourine ceases, The noise of the jubilant ends, The joy of the harp ceases.
verses.textEnNlt: The cheerful sound of tambourines is stilled; the happy cries of celebration are heard no more. The melodious chords of the harp are silent.
verses.textEnNasb: The joy of tambourines ceases, The noise of revelers stops, The joy of the harp ceases.
verses.textEn: The joyful timbrels are stilled, the noise of the revelers has stopped, the joyful harp is silent.

verses.textZh: 他们不得再饮酒唱歌； 喝浓酒的，必觉苦味。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不得再饮酒唱歌； 喝浓酒的，必觉苦味。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必不得饮酒唱歌； 喝浓酒的，必以为苦。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer do they drink wine with a song; the beer is bitter to its drinkers.
verses.textEnEsv: No more do they drink wine with singing; strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not drink wine with a song; Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
verses.textEnNlt: Gone are the joys of wine and song; alcoholic drink turns bitter in the mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: They do not drink wine with song; Intoxicating drink is bitter to those who drink it.
verses.textEn: No longer do they drink wine with a song; the beer is bitter to its drinkers.

verses.textZh: 混乱的城破毁了， 各家关门闭户，使人不得进入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 混乱的城破毁了， 各家关门闭户，使人不得进入。
verses.textZhCuv: 荒凉的城拆毁了； 各家关门闭户，使人都不得进去。
verses.textEnNiv: The ruined city lies desolate; the entrance to every house is barred.
verses.textEnEsv: The wasted city is broken down; every house is shut up so that none can enter.
verses.textEnNkjv: The city of confusion is broken down; Every house is shut up, so that none may go in.
verses.textEnNlt: The city writhes in chaos; every home is locked to keep out intruders.
verses.textEnNasb: The city of chaos is broken down; Every house is shut up so that no one may enter.
verses.textEn: The ruined city lies desolate; the entrance to every house is barred.

verses.textZh: 有人在街上因无酒呼喊； 一切喜乐都已过去， 地上的喜乐都消逝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人在街上因无酒呼喊； 一切喜乐都已过去， 地上的喜乐都消逝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在街上因酒有悲叹的声音； 一切喜乐变为昏暗； 地上的欢乐归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: In the streets they cry out for wine; all joy turns to gloom, all joyful sounds are banished from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: There is an outcry in the streets for lack of wine; all joy has grown dark; the gladness of the earth is banished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis a cry for wine in the streets, All joy is darkened, The mirth of the land is gone.
verses.textEnNlt: Mobs gather in the streets, crying out for wine. Joy has turned to gloom. Gladness has been banished from the land.
verses.textEnNasb: There is an outcry in the streets concerning the wine; All joy turns to gloom. The joy of the earth is banished.
verses.textEn: In the streets they cry out for wine; all joy turns to gloom, all joyful sounds are banished from the earth.

verses.textZh: 城门所剩下的只有荒凉， 城门被撞得粉碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城门所剩下的只有荒凉， 城门被撞得粉碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 城中只有荒凉； 城门拆毁净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: The city is left in ruins, its gate is battered to pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: Desolation is left in the city; the gates are battered into ruins.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the city desolation is left, And the gate is stricken with destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: The city is left in ruins, its gates battered down.
verses.textEnNasb: Desolation is left in the city And the gate is battered to ruins.
verses.textEn: The city is left in ruins, its gate is battered to pieces.

verses.textZh: 在地上的万民， 都像摇过的橄榄树， 又像被摘取完了的葡萄树，剩下无几。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在地上的万民， 都像摇过的橄榄树， 又像被摘取完了的葡萄树，剩下无几。
verses.textZhCuv: 在地上的万民中， 必像打过的橄榄树， 又像已摘的葡萄所剩无几。
verses.textEnNiv: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, or as when gleanings are left after the grape harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus it shall be in the midst of the earth among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, as at the gleaning when the grape harvest is done.
verses.textEnNkjv: When it shall be thus in the midst of the land among the people, Itshallbe like the shaking of an olive tree, Like the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.textEnNlt: Throughout the earth the story is the same— only a remnant is left, like the stray olives left on the tree or the few grapes left on the vine after harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: For so it will be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, As the shaking of an olive tree, As the gleanings when the grape harvest is over.
verses.textEn: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, or as when gleanings are left after the grape harvest.

verses.textZh: 剩余的人必高声欢呼， 在西边的，要宣扬耶和华的威严。
verses.textZhCnvs: 剩余的人必高声欢呼， 在西边的，要宣扬耶和华的威严。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人要高声欢呼； 他们为耶和华的威严，从海那里扬起声来。
verses.textEnNiv: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they acclaim the Lord ’s majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: They lift up their voices, they sing for joy; over the majesty of the Lord they shout from the west.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing; For the majesty of the Lord They shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: But all who are left shout and sing for joy. Those in the west praise the Lord ’s majesty.
