verses.textEnNasb: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; They cry out from the west concerning the majesty of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they acclaim the Lord ’s majesty.

verses.textZh: 在东方那边的，要荣耀耶和华， 要在沿海的众岛上， 荣耀耶和华以色列神的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在东方那边的，要荣耀耶和华， 要在沿海的众岛上， 荣耀耶和华以色列神的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，你们要在东方荣耀耶和华， 在众海岛荣耀耶和华－以色列神的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore in the east give glory to the Lord ; exalt the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore in the east give glory to the Lord ; in the coastlands of the sea, give glory to the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore glorify the Lord in the dawning light, The name of the Lord God of Israel in the coastlands of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: In eastern lands, give glory to the Lord . In the lands beyond the sea, praise the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore glorify the Lord in the east, The name of the Lord, the God of Israel, In the coastlands of the sea.
verses.textEn: Therefore in the east give glory to the Lord ; exalt the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.

verses.textZh: 我们听见从地极有歌声唱着： "荣耀归于义人。" 我却说："我消瘦了，我消瘦了！我有祸了！ 诡诈的仍在行诡诈， 诡诈的仍在大行诡诈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听见从地极有歌声唱着： "荣耀归于义人。" 我却说："我消瘦了，我消瘦了！我有祸了！ 诡诈的仍在行诡诈， 诡诈的仍在大行诡诈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们听见从地极有人歌唱，说： 荣耀归于义人。 我却说：我消灭了！ 我消灭了，我有祸了！ 诡诈的行诡诈； 诡诈的大行诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: "Glory to the Righteous One." But I said, "I waste away, I waste away! Woe to me! The treacherous betray! With treachery the treacherous betray!"
verses.textEnEsv: From the ends of the earth we hear songs of praise, of glory to the Righteous One. But I say, "I waste away, I waste away. Woe is me! For the traitors have betrayed, with betrayal the traitors have betrayed."
verses.textEnNkjv: From the ends of the earth we have heard songs: "Glory to the righteous!" But I said, "I am ruined, ruined! Woe to me! The treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously, Indeed, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously."
verses.textEnNlt: We hear songs of praise from the ends of the earth, songs that give glory to the Righteous One! But my heart is heavy with grief. Weep for me, for I wither away. Deceit still prevails, and treachery is everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: From the ends of the earth we hear songs: "Glory to the Righteous One," But I say, " I am finished! I am finished! Woe to me! The treacherous deal treacherously, And the treacherous deal very treacherously."
verses.textEn: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: "Glory to the Righteous One." But I said, "I waste away, I waste away! Woe to me! The treacherous betray! With treachery the treacherous betray!"

verses.textZh: 地上的居民哪！ 恐惧、陷坑和网罗，都临近你们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的居民哪！ 恐惧、陷坑和网罗，都临近你们！
verses.textZhCuv: 地上的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。
verses.textEnNiv: Terror and pit and snare await you, people of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Terror and the pit and the snare are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear and the pit and the snare Are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Terror and traps and snares will be your lot, you people of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Terror and pit and snare Confront you, you inhabitant of the earth.
verses.textEn: Terror and pit and snare await you, people of the earth.

verses.textZh: 那逃避恐惧声音的，必堕入陷坑； 那从陷坑里上来的，必被网罗缠住； 因为天上的窗都开了，地的根基也震动了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那逃避恐惧声音的，必堕入陷坑； 那从陷坑里上来的，必被网罗缠住； 因为天上的窗都开了，地的根基也震动了。
verses.textZhCuv: 躲避恐惧声音的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因为天上的窗户都开了， 地的根基也震动了。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever flees at the sound of terror will fall into a pit; whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare. The floodgates of the heavens are opened, the foundations of the earth shake.
verses.textEnEsv: He who flees at the sound of the terror shall fall into the pit, and he who climbs out of the pit shall be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be That he who flees from the noise of the fear Shall fall into the pit, And he who comes up from the midst of the pit Shall be caught in the snare; For the windows from on high are open, And the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who flee in terror will fall into a trap, and those who escape the trap will be caught in a snare. Destruction falls like rain from the heavens; the foundations of the earth shake.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it will be that the one who flees the sound of terror will fall into the pit, And the one who climbs out of the pit will be caught in the snare; For the windows above are opened, and the foundations of the earth shake.
verses.textEn: Whoever flees at the sound of terror will fall into a pit; whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare. The floodgates of the heavens are opened, the foundations of the earth shake.

verses.textZh: 大地全然破坏， 尽都崩裂， 大大震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地全然破坏， 尽都崩裂， 大大震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 地全然破坏，尽都崩裂， 大大地震动了。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth is broken up, the earth is split asunder, the earth is violently shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth is utterly broken, the earth is split apart, the earth is violently shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth is violently broken, The earth is split open, The earth is shaken exceedingly.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth has broken up. It has utterly collapsed; it is violently shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth is broken apart, The earth is split through, The earth is shaken violently.
verses.textEn: The earth is broken up, the earth is split asunder, the earth is violently shaken.

verses.textZh: 大地东歪西倒，像个醉酒的人， 又摇来摇去，像座草棚； 大地被其上的罪孽重重压着， 以致塌陷，不能再起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地东歪西倒，像个醉酒的人， 又摇来摇去，像座草棚； 大地被其上的罪孽重重压着， 以致塌陷，不能再起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 地要东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 又摇来摇去，好像吊床。 罪过在其上沉重， 必然塌陷，不能复起。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth reels like a drunkard, it sways like a hut in the wind; so heavy upon it is the guilt of its rebellion that it falls—never to rise again.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth staggers like a drunken man; it sways like a hut; its transgression lies heavy upon it, and it falls, and will not rise again.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, And shall totter like a hut; Its transgression shall be heavy upon it, And it will fall, and not rise again.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth staggers like a drunk. It trembles like a tent in a storm. It falls and will not rise again, for the guilt of its rebellion is very heavy.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth trembles like a heavy drinker And sways like a hut, For its wrongdoing is heavy upon it, And it will fall, never to rise again.
verses.textEn: The earth reels like a drunkard, it sways like a hut in the wind; so heavy upon it is the guilt of its rebellion that it falls—never to rise again.

verses.textZh: 到那日， 耶和华必在高天之上惩罚天上的众军， 又在地上惩罚地上的列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日， 耶和华必在高天之上惩罚天上的众军， 又在地上惩罚地上的列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，耶和华在高处必惩罚高处的众军， 在地上必惩罚地上的列王。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens above and the kings on the earth below.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the Lord will punish the host of heaven, in heaven, and the kings of the earth, on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in that day That the Lord will punish on high the host of exalted ones, And on the earth the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Lord will punish the gods in the heavens and the proud rulers of the nations on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: So it will happen on that day, That the Lord will punish the rebellious angels of heaven on high, And the kings of the earth on earth.
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens above and the kings on the earth below.

verses.textZh: 他们必被聚集， 像囚犯被聚集在牢狱里一般； 他们要被关在监牢中， 多日以后，他们要被惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必被聚集， 像囚犯被聚集在牢狱里一般； 他们要被关在监牢中， 多日以后，他们要被惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢狱中， 并要囚在监牢里， 多日之后便被讨罪 。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be herded together like prisoners bound in a dungeon; they will be shut up in prison and be punished after many days.
verses.textEnEsv: They will be gathered together as prisoners in a pit; they will be shut up in a prison, and after many days they will be punished.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will be gathered together, As prisoners are gathered in the pit, And will be shut up in the prison; After many days they will be punished.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be rounded up and put in prison. They will be shut up in prison and will finally be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: They will be gathered together Like prisoners in the dungeon, And will be confined in prison; And after many days they will be punished.
verses.textEn: They will be herded together like prisoners bound in a dungeon; they will be shut up in prison and be punished after many days.

verses.textZh: 那时，月亮必蒙羞，日头要惭愧， 因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山，在耶路撒冷作王； 并且在他子民的众长老面前，大有荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，月亮必蒙羞，日头要惭愧， 因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山，在耶路撒冷作王； 并且在他子民的众长老面前，大有荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，月亮要蒙羞，日头要惭愧； 因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山， 在耶路撒冷作王； 在敬畏他的长老面前，必有荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: The moon will be dismayed, the sun ashamed; for the Lord Almighty will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before its elders—with great glory.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the moon will be confounded and the sun ashamed, for the Lord of hosts reigns on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and his glory will be before his elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the moon will be disgraced And the sun ashamed; For the Lord of hosts will reign On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem And before His elders, gloriously.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the glory of the moon will wane, and the brightness of the sun will fade, for the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will rule on Mount Zion. He will rule in great glory in Jerusalem, in the sight of all the leaders of his people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the moon will be ashamed and the sun be put to shame, For the Lord of armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, And His glory will be before His elders.
verses.textEn: The moon will be dismayed, the sun ashamed; for the Lord Almighty will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before its elders—with great glory.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你是我的神， 我要尊崇你，称谢你的名， 因为你以信实真诚作成了奇妙的事， 就是你远古以前所计划的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你是我的神， 我要尊崇你，称谢你的名， 因为你以信实真诚作成了奇妙的事， 就是你远古以前所计划的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是我的神； 我要尊崇你，我要称赞你的名。 因为你以忠信诚实行过奇妙的事， 成就你古时所定的。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you are my God; I will exalt you and praise your name, for in perfect faithfulness you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , you are my God; I will exalt you; I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, plans formed of old, faithful and sure.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, You are my God. I will exalt You, I will praise Your name, For You have done wonderful things; Your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I will honor and praise your name, for you are my God. You do such wonderful things! You planned them long ago, and now you have accomplished them.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You are my God; I will exalt You, I will give thanks to Your name; For You have worked wonders, Plans formed long ago, with perfect faithfulness.
verses.textEn: Lord , you are my God; I will exalt you and praise your name, for in perfect faithfulness you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago.

verses.textZh: 你使城市变成废堆， 使坚固城变为荒凉的地方， 使外族人的城堡不再为城， 永远不得重建。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使城市变成废堆， 使坚固城变为荒凉的地方， 使外族人的城堡不再为城， 永远不得重建。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使城变为乱堆， 使坚固城变为荒场， 使外邦人宫殿的城不再为城， 永远不再建造。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin, the foreigners’ stronghold a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have made the city a heap, the fortified city a ruin; the foreigners’ palace is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have made a city a ruin, A fortified city a ruin, A palace of foreigners to be a city no more; It will never be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNlt: You turn mighty cities into heaps of ruins. Cities with strong walls are turned to rubble. Beautiful palaces in distant lands disappear and will never be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have turned a city into a heap, A fortified city into a ruin; A palace of strangers is no longer a city, It will never be rebuilt.
verses.textEn: You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin, the foreigners’ stronghold a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.

verses.textZh: 因此，强大的民族必荣耀你； 强暴之国的城也要敬畏你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，强大的民族必荣耀你； 强暴之国的城也要敬畏你。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，刚强的民必荣耀你； 强暴之国的城必敬畏你。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore strong peoples will honor you; cities of ruthless nations will revere you.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore strong peoples will glorify you; cities of ruthless nations will fear you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the strong people will glorify You; The city of the terrible nations will fear You.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, strong nations will declare your glory; ruthless nations will fear you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore a strong people will glorify You; Cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
verses.textEn: Therefore strong peoples will honor you; cities of ruthless nations will revere you.

verses.textZh: 你作了困乏人的保障、 贫穷人急难中的保障、 躲暴风雨的避难所、避炎热的阴凉处； 因为强暴者所吹的气， 如同直吹墙壁的暴风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你作了困乏人的保障、 贫穷人急难中的保障、 躲暴风雨的避难所、避炎热的阴凉处； 因为强暴者所吹的气， 如同直吹墙壁的暴风。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为当强暴人催逼人的时候， 如同暴风直吹墙壁， 你就作贫穷人的保障， 作困乏人急难中的保障， 作躲暴风之处， 作避炎热的阴凉。
verses.textEnNiv: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in their distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like a storm driving against a wall
verses.textEnEsv: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat; for the breath of the ruthless is like a storm against a wall,
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have been a strength to the poor, A strength to the needy in his distress, A refuge from the storm, A shade from the heat; For the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are a tower of refuge to the poor, O Lord , a tower of refuge to the needy in distress. You are a refuge from the storm and a shelter from the heat. For the oppressive acts of ruthless people are like a storm beating against a wall,
verses.textEnNasb: For You have been a stronghold for the helpless, A stronghold for the poor in his distress, A refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat; For the breath of the ruthless Is like a rain storm against a wall.
verses.textEn: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in their distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like a storm driving against a wall

verses.textZh: 你抑制外族人的喧哗，好象减低干旱之地的炎热； 你禁止强暴者的凯歌，好象热气因云彩而消散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你抑制外族人的喧哗，好象减低干旱之地的炎热； 你禁止强暴者的凯歌，好象热气因云彩而消散。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要压制外邦人的喧哗， 好像干燥地的热气下落； 禁止强暴人的凯歌， 好像热气被云影消化。
verses.textEnNiv: and like the heat of the desert. You silence the uproar of foreigners; as heat is reduced by the shadow of a cloud, so the song of the ruthless is stilled.
verses.textEnEsv: like heat in a dry place. You subdue the noise of the foreigners; as heat by the shade of a cloud, so the song of the ruthless is put down.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will reduce the noise of aliens, As heat in a dry place; As heat in the shadow of a cloud, The song of the terrible ones will be diminished.
verses.textEnNlt: or like the relentless heat of the desert. But you silence the roar of foreign nations. As the shade of a cloud cools relentless heat, so the boastful songs of ruthless people are stilled.
verses.textEnNasb: Like heat in a dry land, You subdue the uproar of foreigners; Like heat by the shadow of a cloud, the song of the ruthless is silenced.
verses.textEn: and like the heat of the desert. You silence the uproar of foreigners; as heat is reduced by the shadow of a cloud, so the song of the ruthless is stilled.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华必在这山上为万民摆设丰盛美筵，有陈酒、满髓的肥甘和醇美好酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华必在这山上为万民摆设丰盛美筵，有陈酒、满髓的肥甘和醇美好酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这山上，万军之耶和华必为万民用肥甘设摆筵席，用陈酒和满髓的肥甘，并澄清的陈酒，设摆筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: On this mountain the Lord Almighty will prepare a feast of rich food for all peoples, a banquet of aged wine— the best of meats and the finest of wines.
verses.textEnEsv: On this mountain the Lord of hosts will make for all peoples a feast of rich food, a feast of well-aged wine, of rich food full of marrow, of aged wine well refined.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in this mountain The Lord of hosts will make for all people A feast of choice pieces, A feast of wines on the lees, Of fat things full of marrow, Of well-refined wines on the lees.
verses.textEnNlt: In Jerusalem, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will spread a wonderful feast for all the people of the world. It will be a delicious banquet with clear, well-aged wine and choice meat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord of armies will prepare a lavish banquet for all peoples on this mountain; A banquet of aged wine, choice pieces with marrow, And refined, aged wine.
verses.textEn: On this mountain the Lord Almighty will prepare a feast of rich food for all peoples, a banquet of aged wine— the best of meats and the finest of wines.

verses.textZh: 他又必在这山上除灭那遮盖万民的面巾，和那遮盖列国的帕子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又必在这山上除灭那遮盖万民的面巾，和那遮盖列国的帕子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又必在这山上除灭遮盖万民之物和遮蔽万国蒙脸的帕子。
verses.textEnNiv: On this mountain he will destroy the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;
verses.textEnEsv: And he will swallow up on this mountain the covering that is cast over all peoples, the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will destroy on this mountain The surface of the covering cast over all people, And the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.textEnNlt: There he will remove the cloud of gloom, the shadow of death that hangs over the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And on this mountain He will destroy the covering which is over all peoples, The veil which is stretched over all nations.
verses.textEn: On this mountain he will destroy the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;

verses.textZh: 他要吞灭死亡，直到永远；主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又从地上除掉他子民的羞辱；这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要吞灭死亡，直到永远；主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又从地上除掉他子民的羞辱；这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他已经吞灭死亡直到永远。主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因为这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: he will swallow up death forever. The Sovereign Lord will wipe away the tears from all faces; he will remove his people’s disgrace from all the earth. The Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: He will swallow up death forever; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from all faces, and the reproach of his people he will take away from all the earth, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will swallow up death forever, And the Lord God will wipe away tears from all faces; The rebuke of His people He will take away from all the earth; For the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: He will swallow up death forever! The Sovereign Lord will wipe away all tears. He will remove forever all insults and mockery against his land and people. The Lord has spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: He will swallow up death for all time, And the Lord God will wipe tears away from all faces, And He will remove the disgrace of His people from all the earth; For the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: he will swallow up death forever. The Sovereign Lord will wipe away the tears from all faces; he will remove his people’s disgrace from all the earth. The Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 到那日，必有人说："看哪！这是我们的神；我们信靠他，他必拯救我们。这是耶和华，我们所倚靠的，我们要因他的拯救欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，必有人说："看哪！这是我们的神；我们信靠他，他必拯救我们。这是耶和华，我们所倚靠的，我们要因他的拯救欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，人必说：「看哪，这是我们的神；我们素来等候他，他必拯救我们。这是耶和华，我们素来等候他，我们必因他的救恩欢喜快乐。」
verses.textEnNiv: In that day they will say, "Surely this is our God; we trusted in him, and he saved us. This is the Lord , we trusted in him; let us rejoice and be glad in his salvation."
verses.textEnEsv: It will be said on that day, "Behold, this is our God; we have waited for him, that he might save us. This is the Lord ; we have waited for him; let us be glad and rejoice in his salvation."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will be said in that day: "Behold, this is our God; We have waited for Him, and He will save us. This is the Lord; We have waited for Him; We will be glad and rejoice in His salvation."
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the people will proclaim, "This is our God! We trusted in him, and he saved us! This is the Lord , in whom we trusted. Let us rejoice in the salvation he brings!"
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be said on that day, "Behold, this is our God for whom we have waited that He might save us. This is the Lord for whom we have waited; Let’s rejoice and be glad in His salvation."
verses.textEn: In that day they will say, "Surely this is our God; we trusted in him, and he saved us. This is the Lord , we trusted in him; let us rejoice and be glad in his salvation."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的手必放在这山上；但摩押人在自己的地方必受践踏，好象干草在粪坑中被践踏一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的手必放在这山上；但摩押人在自己的地方必受践踏，好象干草在粪坑中被践踏一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的手必按在这山上；摩押人在所居之地必被践踏，好像干草被践踏在粪池的水中。
verses.textEnNiv: The hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain; but Moab will be trampled in their land as straw is trampled down in the manure.
verses.textEnEsv: For the hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain, and Moab shall be trampled down in his place, as straw is trampled down in a dunghill.
verses.textEnNkjv: For on this mountain the hand of the Lord will rest, And Moab shall be trampled down under Him, As straw is trampled down for the refuse heap.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord ’s hand of blessing will rest on Jerusalem. But Moab will be crushed. It will be like straw trampled down and left to rot.
verses.textEnNasb: For the hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain, And Moab will be trampled down in his place As straw is trampled down in the water of a manure pile.
verses.textEn: The hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain; but Moab will be trampled in their land as straw is trampled down in the manure.

verses.textZh: 他们必在其中伸开手来，好象游泳者伸开手来游泳一样；但耶和华要使他们的骄傲和他们手所行的诡计，一同败落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必在其中伸开手来，好象游泳者伸开手来游泳一样；但耶和华要使他们的骄傲和他们手所行的诡计，一同败落。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必在其中伸开手，好像洑水的伸开手洑水一样；但耶和华必使他的骄傲和他手所行的诡计一并败落。
verses.textEnNiv: They will stretch out their hands in it, as swimmers stretch out their hands to swim. God will bring down their pride despite the cleverness of their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will spread out his hands in the midst of it as a swimmer spreads his hands out to swim, but the Lord will lay low his pompous pride together with the skill of his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will spread out His hands in their midst As a swimmer reaches out to swim, And He will bring down their pride Together with the trickery of their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: God will push down Moab’s people as a swimmer pushes down water with his hands. He will end their pride and all their evil works.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will spread out his hands in the middle of it As a swimmer spreads out his hands to swim, But the Lord will lay low his pride together with the trickery of his hands.
verses.textEn: They will stretch out their hands in it, as swimmers stretch out their hands to swim. God will bring down their pride despite the cleverness of their hands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使他们高耸而坚固的城墙倾倒下陷，落在地面，变作尘土。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使他们高耸而坚固的城墙倾倒下陷，落在地面，变作尘土。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使你城上的坚固高台倾倒，拆平，直到尘埃。
verses.textEnNiv: He will bring down your high fortified walls and lay them low; he will bring them down to the ground, to the very dust.
verses.textEnEsv: And the high fortifications of his walls he will bring down, lay low, and cast to the ground, to the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fortress of the high fort of your walls He will bring down, lay low, And bring to the ground, down to the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: The high walls of Moab will be demolished. They will be brought down to the ground, down into the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: The unassailable fortifications of your walls He will bring down, Lay low, and throw to the ground, to the dust.
verses.textEn: He will bring down your high fortified walls and lay them low; he will bring them down to the ground, to the very dust.

verses.textZh: 到那日，在犹大地必有人唱这歌： "我们有座坚固的城； 耶和华把救恩作为城墙和外郭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，在犹大地必有人唱这歌： "我们有座坚固的城； 耶和华把救恩作为城墙和外郭。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，在犹大地人必唱这歌说： 我们有坚固的城。 耶和华要将救恩定为城墙，为外郭。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city; he sets up salvation as walls and bulwarks.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city; God will appoint salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day, everyone in the land of Judah will sing this song: Our city is strong! We are surrounded by the walls of God’s salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city; He sets up walls and ramparts for security.
verses.textEn: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.

verses.textZh: 打开城门吧！ 好让公义和信实的国民，可以进入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打开城门吧！ 好让公义和信实的国民，可以进入。
verses.textZhCuv: 敞开城门， 使守信的义民得以进入。
verses.textEnNiv: Open the gates that the righteous nation may enter, the nation that keeps faith.
verses.textEnEsv: Open the gates, that the righteous nation that keeps faith may enter in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Open the gates, That the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.
verses.textEnNlt: Open the gates to all who are righteous; allow the faithful to enter.
verses.textEnNasb: "Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter, The one that remains faithful.
verses.textEn: Open the gates that the righteous nation may enter, the nation that keeps faith.

verses.textZh: 专心倚靠你的，你必保护他一切平安， 因为他倚靠你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 专心倚靠你的，你必保护他一切平安， 因为他倚靠你。
verses.textZhCuv: 坚心倚赖你的， 你必保守他十分平安， 因为他倚靠你。
verses.textEnNiv: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.
verses.textEnEsv: You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will keep him in perfect peace, Whose mind is stayed onYou, Because he trusts in You.
verses.textEnNlt: You will keep in perfect peace all who trust in you, all whose thoughts are fixed on you!
verses.textEnNasb: "The steadfast of mind You will keep in perfect peace, Because he trusts in You.
verses.textEn: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

verses.textZh: 你们要倚靠耶和华，直到永远， 因为耶和华是永存的盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要倚靠耶和华，直到永远， 因为耶和华是永存的盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当倚靠耶和华直到永远， 因为耶和华是永久的磐石。
verses.textEnNiv: Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord , the Lord himself, is the Rock eternal.
verses.textEnEsv: Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord God is an everlasting rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Trust in the Lord forever, For in YAH, the Lord, is everlasting strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Trust in the Lord always, for the Lord God is the eternal Rock.
verses.textEnNasb: "Trust in the Lord forever, For in God the Lord, we have an everlasting Rock.
verses.textEn: Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord , the Lord himself, is the Rock eternal.

verses.textZh: 他使那些骄傲的降卑，使那些高耸的城败落； 把它拆毁，散在地上，变作尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使那些骄傲的降卑，使那些高耸的城败落； 把它拆毁，散在地上，变作尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使住高处的与高城一并败落， 将城拆毁，拆平，直到尘埃，
verses.textEnNiv: He humbles those who dwell on high, he lays the lofty city low; he levels it to the ground and casts it down to the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: For he has humbled the inhabitants of the height, the lofty city. He lays it low, lays it low to the ground, casts it to the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He brings down those who dwell on high, The lofty city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He brings it down to the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: He humbles the proud and brings down the arrogant city. He brings it down to the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He has brought low those who dwell on high, the unassailable city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He casts it to the dust.
verses.textEn: He humbles those who dwell on high, he lays the lofty city low; he levels it to the ground and casts it down to the dust.

verses.textZh: 它要被脚践踏， 就是困苦人的脚和贫穷人的脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它要被脚践踏， 就是困苦人的脚和贫穷人的脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 要被脚践踏， 就是被困苦人的脚和穷乏人的脚践踏。
verses.textEnNiv: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the footsteps of the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: The foot tramples it, the feet of the poor, the steps of the needy."
verses.textEnNkjv: The foot shall tread it down— The feet of the poor And the steps of the needy."
verses.textEnNlt: The poor and oppressed trample it underfoot, and the needy walk all over it.
verses.textEnNasb: "The foot will trample it, The feet of the poor, the steps of the helpless."
verses.textEn: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the footsteps of the poor.

verses.textZh: 义人的路是正直的， 正直的主啊！你必修平义人的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的路是正直的， 正直的主啊！你必修平义人的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的道是正直的； 你为正直的主，必修平义人的路。
verses.textEnNiv: The path of the righteous is level; you, the Upright One, make the way of the righteous smooth.
verses.textEnEsv: The path of the righteous is level; you make level the way of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of the just is uprightness; O Most Upright, You weigh the path of the just.
verses.textEnNlt: But for those who are righteous, the way is not steep and rough. You are a God who does what is right, and you smooth out the path ahead of them.
verses.textEnNasb: The way of the righteous is smooth; O Upright One, make the path of the righteous level.
verses.textEn: The path of the righteous is level; you, the Upright One, make the way of the righteous smooth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我们等候你那审判的路径； 你的名字和称号，都是我们心里所爱慕的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我们等候你那审判的路径； 你的名字和称号，都是我们心里所爱慕的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我们在你行审判的路上等候你； 我们心里所羡慕的是你的名， 就是你那可记念的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Yes, Lord , walking in the way of your laws, we wait for you; your name and renown are the desire of our hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: In the path of your judgments, O Lord , we wait for you; your name and remembrance are the desire of our soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, in the way of Your judgments, O Lord, we have waited for You; The desire of our soul is for Your name And for the remembrance of You.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , we show our trust in you by obeying your laws; our heart’s desire is to glorify your name.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, while following the way of Your judgments, Lord, We have waited for You eagerly; Your name, and remembering You, is the desire of our souls.
verses.textEn: Yes, Lord , walking in the way of your laws, we wait for you; your name and renown are the desire of our hearts.

verses.textZh: 夜间我的心渴想你， 我里面的灵切切寻求你， 因为你的审判临到大地的时候， 世上的居民就会学习到甚么是公义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜间我的心渴想你， 我里面的灵切切寻求你， 因为你的审判临到大地的时候， 世上的居民就会学习到甚么是公义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间，我心中羡慕你； 我里面的灵切切寻求你。 因为你在世上行审判的时候， 地上的居民就学习公义。
verses.textEnNiv: My soul yearns for you in the night; in the morning my spirit longs for you. When your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul yearns for you in the night; my spirit within me earnestly seeks you. For when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: With my soul I have desired You in the night, Yes, by my spirit within me I will seek You early; For when Your judgments are in the earth, The inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: In the night I search for you; in the morning I earnestly seek you. For only when you come to judge the earth will people learn what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: At night my soul longs for You, Indeed, my spirit within me seeks You diligently; For when the earth experiences Your judgments, The inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.textEn: My soul yearns for you in the night; in the morning my spirit longs for you. When your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.

verses.textZh: 恶人虽然蒙了恩待， 他仍不知道甚么是公义； 在公义的地上，他仍然行恶， 也看不见耶和华的威严。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人虽然蒙了恩待， 他仍不知道甚么是公义； 在公义的地上，他仍然行恶， 也看不见耶和华的威严。
verses.textZhCuv: 以恩惠待恶人， 他仍不学习公义； 在正直的地上，他必行事不义， 也不注意耶和华的威严。
verses.textEnNiv: But when grace is shown to the wicked, they do not learn righteousness; even in a land of uprightness they go on doing evil and do not regard the majesty of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: If favor is shown to the wicked, he does not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness he deals corruptly and does not see the majesty of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Let grace be shown to the wicked, Yet he will not learn righteousness; In the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly, And will not behold the majesty of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Your kindness to the wicked does not make them do good. Although others do right, the wicked keep doing wrong and take no notice of the Lord ’s majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: Though the wicked person is shown compassion, He does not learn righteousness; He deals unjustly in the land of uprightness, And does not perceive the majesty of the Lord.
verses.textEn: But when grace is shown to the wicked, they do not learn righteousness; even in a land of uprightness they go on doing evil and do not regard the majesty of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的手高举，他们还是看不见。 愿他们因看见你对子民的热心而惭愧； 愿那为你的敌人预备的火吞灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的手高举，他们还是看不见。 愿他们因看见你对子民的热心而惭愧； 愿那为你的敌人预备的火吞灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的手高举， 他们仍然不看； 却要看你为百姓发的热心，因而抱愧， 并且有火烧灭你的敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , your hand is lifted high, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people and be put to shame; let the fire reserved for your enemies consume them.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , your hand is lifted up, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people, and be ashamed. Let the fire for your adversaries consume them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, when Your hand is lifted up, they will not see. But they will see and be ashamed For their envy of people; Yes, the fire of Your enemies shall devour them.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , they pay no attention to your upraised fist. Show them your eagerness to defend your people. Then they will be ashamed. Let your fire consume your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, Your hand is lifted up, yet they do not see it. They see Your zeal for the people and are put to shame; Indeed, fire will devour Your enemies.
verses.textEn: Lord , your hand is lifted high, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people and be put to shame; let the fire reserved for your enemies consume them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你必使我们得平安， 因为我们所作的，都是你为我们成就的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你必使我们得平安， 因为我们所作的，都是你为我们成就的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你必派定我们得平安， 因为我们所做的事都是你给我们成就的。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you establish peace for us; all that we have accomplished you have done for us.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , you will ordain peace for us, for you have indeed done for us all our works.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, You will establish peace for us, For You have also done all our works in us.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you will grant us peace; all we have accomplished is really from you.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You will establish peace for us, Since You have also performed for us all our works.
verses.textEn: Lord , you establish peace for us; all that we have accomplished you have done for us.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神啊！在你以外， 曾有别的主管辖我们， 但只有你，我们要承认你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神啊！在你以外， 曾有别的主管辖我们， 但只有你，我们要承认你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神啊， 在你以外曾有别的主管辖我们， 但我们专要倚靠你，提你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone do we honor.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone we bring to remembrance.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord our God, masters besides You Have had dominion over us; But by You only we make mention of Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord our God, others have ruled us, but you alone are the one we worship.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, our God, other masters besides You have ruled us; But through You alone we confess Your name.
verses.textEn: Lord our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone do we honor.

verses.textZh: 死去的不能再活，离世的不能再起来， 因为你惩罚他们，消灭了他们， 使他们完全不再被记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死去的不能再活，离世的不能再起来， 因为你惩罚他们，消灭了他们， 使他们完全不再被记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们死了，必不能再活； 他们去世，必不能再起； 因为你刑罚他们，毁灭他们， 他们的名号就全然消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: They are now dead, they live no more; their spirits do not rise. You punished them and brought them to ruin; you wiped out all memory of them.
verses.textEnEsv: They are dead, they will not live; they are shades, they will not arise; to that end you have visited them with destruction and wiped out all remembrance of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Theyare dead, they will not live; Theyare deceased, they will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And made all their memory to perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Those we served before are dead and gone. Their departed spirits will never return! You attacked them and destroyed them, and they are long forgotten.
verses.textEnNasb: The dead will not live, the departed spirits will not rise; Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And You have eliminated all remembrance of them.
verses.textEn: They are now dead, they live no more; their spirits do not rise. You punished them and brought them to ruin; you wiped out all memory of them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你增添国民； 你增添国民，你得了荣耀， 又拓展了地的四境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你增添国民； 你增添国民，你得了荣耀， 又拓展了地的四境。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你增添国民， 你增添国民； 你得了荣耀， 又扩张地的四境。
verses.textEnNiv: You have enlarged the nation, Lord ; you have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for yourself; you have extended all the borders of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: But you have increased the nation, O Lord , you have increased the nation; you are glorified; you have enlarged all the borders of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have increased the nation, O Lord, You have increased the nation; You are glorified; You have expanded all the borders of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , you have made our nation great; yes, you have made us great. You have extended our borders, and we give you the glory!
verses.textEnNasb: You have increased the nation, Lord, You have increased the nation, You are glorified; You have extended all the borders of the land.
verses.textEn: You have enlarged the nation, Lord ; you have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for yourself; you have extended all the borders of the land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我们在急难中寻求你； 你的惩罚临到我们身上的时候， 我们就倾心吐意低声祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我们在急难中寻求你； 你的惩罚临到我们身上的时候， 我们就倾心吐意低声祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，他们在急难中寻求你； 你的惩罚临到他们身上， 他们就倾心吐胆祷告你。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , they came to you in their distress; when you disciplined them, they could barely whisper a prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , in distress they sought you; they poured out a whispered prayer when your discipline was upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, in trouble they have visited You, They poured out a prayer when Your chastening was upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , in distress we searched for you. We prayed beneath the burden of your discipline.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, they sought You in distress; They could only whisper a prayer, Your discipline was upon them.
verses.textEn: Lord , they came to you in their distress; when you disciplined them, they could barely whisper a prayer.

verses.textZh: 怀孕的妇人临产时怎样疼痛， 在绞痛中喊叫； 耶和华啊！我们在你面前也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 怀孕的妇人临产时怎样疼痛， 在绞痛中喊叫； 耶和华啊！我们在你面前也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人怀孕，临产疼痛， 在痛苦之中喊叫； 耶和华啊，我们在你面前也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: As a pregnant woman about to give birth writhes and cries out in her pain, so were we in your presence, Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Like a pregnant woman who writhes and cries out in her pangs when she is near to giving birth, so were we because of you, O Lord ;
verses.textEnNkjv: As a woman with child Is in pain and cries out in her pangs, When she draws near the time of her delivery, So have we been in Your sight, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as a pregnant woman writhes and cries out in pain as she gives birth, so were we in your presence, Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: As the pregnant woman approaches the time to give birth, She writhes and cries out in her labor pains; This is how we were before You, Lord.
verses.textEn: As a pregnant woman about to give birth writhes and cries out in her pain, so were we in your presence, Lord .

verses.textZh: 我们也曾像怀孕一般疼痛， 但所生的像风； 我们未曾在地上行过拯救的事， 世上的居民也未曾因我们生下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也曾像怀孕一般疼痛， 但所生的像风； 我们未曾在地上行过拯救的事， 世上的居民也未曾因我们生下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们也曾怀孕疼痛， 所产的竟像风一样。 我们在地上未曾行什么拯救的事； 世上的居民也未曾败落。
verses.textEnNiv: We were with child, we writhed in labor, but we gave birth to wind. We have not brought salvation to the earth, and the people of the world have not come to life.
verses.textEnEsv: we were pregnant, we writhed, but we have given birth to wind. We have accomplished no deliverance in the earth, and the inhabitants of the world have not fallen.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have been with child, we have been in pain; We have, as it were, brought forth wind; We have not accomplished any deliverance in the earth, Nor have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.textEnNlt: We, too, writhe in agony, but nothing comes of our suffering. We have not given salvation to the earth, nor brought life into the world.
verses.textEnNasb: We were pregnant, we writhed in labor, We gave birth, as it seems, only to wind. We could not accomplish deliverance for the earth, Nor were inhabitants of the world born.
verses.textEn: We were with child, we writhed in labor, but we gave birth to wind. We have not brought salvation to the earth, and the people of the world have not come to life.

verses.textZh: 属你的死人要活过来， 他们的尸体要起来； 那些住在尘土里的必醒起，并且欢呼。 因为你的甘露像早晨的甘露般临到， 使地交出离世的人来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属你的死人要活过来， 他们的尸体要起来； 那些住在尘土里的必醒起，并且欢呼。 因为你的甘露像早晨的甘露般临到， 使地交出离世的人来。
verses.textZhCuv: 死人 要复活， 尸首 要兴起。 睡在尘埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！ 因你的甘露好像菜蔬上的甘露， 地也要交出死人来。
verses.textEnNiv: But your dead will live, Lord ; their bodies will rise— let those who dwell in the dust wake up and shout for joy— your dew is like the dew of the morning; the earth will give birth to her dead.
verses.textEnEsv: Your dead shall live; their bodies shall rise. You who dwell in the dust, awake and sing for joy! For your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your dead shall live; Togetherwith my dead body they shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in dust; For your dew islike the dew of herbs, And the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who die in the Lord will live; their bodies will rise again! Those who sleep in the earth will rise up and sing for joy! For your life-giving light will fall like dew on your people in the place of the dead!
verses.textEnNasb: Your dead will live; Their corpses will rise. You who lie in the dust, awake and shout for joy, For your dew is as the dew of the dawn, And the earth will give birth to the departed spirits.
verses.textEn: But your dead will live, Lord ; their bodies will rise— let those who dwell in the dust wake up and shout for joy— your dew is like the dew of the morning; the earth will give birth to her dead.

verses.textZh: 我的子民哪！快来，进入你们的内室， 把你们的门关上； 隐藏片刻， 直到神的忿怒过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民哪！快来，进入你们的内室， 把你们的门关上； 隐藏片刻， 直到神的忿怒过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓啊，你们要来进入内室， 关上门，隐藏片时， 等到忿怒过去。
verses.textEnNiv: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until his wrath has passed by.
verses.textEnEsv: Come, my people, enter your chambers, and shut your doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until the fury has passed by.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, my people, enter your chambers, And shut your doors behind you; Hide yourself, as it were, for a little moment, Until the indignation is past.
verses.textEnNlt: Go home, my people, and lock your doors! Hide yourselves for a little while until the Lord ’s anger has passed.
verses.textEnNasb: Come, my people, enter your rooms And close your doors behind you; Hide for a little while Until indignation runs its course.
verses.textEn: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until his wrath has passed by.

verses.textZh: 因为你看！耶和华从他的居所出来， 要惩罚地上居民的罪孽； 大地要露出其上所流的血， 不再遮盖被杀的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你看！耶和华从他的居所出来， 要惩罚地上居民的罪孽； 大地要露出其上所流的血， 不再遮盖被杀的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华从他的居所出来， 要刑罚地上居民的罪孽。 地也必露出其中的血， 不再掩盖被杀的人。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Lord is coming out of his dwelling to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will disclose the blood shed on it; the earth will conceal its slain no longer.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, the Lord is coming out from his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity, and the earth will disclose the blood shed on it, and will no more cover its slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the Lord comes out of His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; The earth will also disclose her blood, And will no more cover her slain.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The Lord is coming from heaven to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will no longer hide those who have been killed. They will be brought out for all to see.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, the Lord is about to come out from His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their wrongdoing; And the earth will reveal her bloodshed And will no longer cover her slain.
verses.textEn: See, the Lord is coming out of his dwelling to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will disclose the blood shed on it; the earth will conceal its slain no longer.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶和华要施用他锐利、巨大和有力的刀，惩罚鳄鱼，就是那快行的蛇；惩罚鳄鱼，就是那曲行的蛇；并且要杀海中的大龙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶和华要施用他锐利、巨大和有力的刀，惩罚鳄鱼，就是那快行的蛇；惩罚鳄鱼，就是那曲行的蛇；并且要杀海中的大龙。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，耶和华必用他刚硬有力的大刀刑罚鳄鱼－就是那快行的蛇，刑罚鳄鱼－就是那曲行的蛇，并杀海中的大鱼。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day, the Lord will punish with his sword— his fierce, great and powerful sword— Leviathan the gliding serpent, Leviathan the coiling serpent; he will slay the monster of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord with his hard and great and strong sword will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent, Leviathan the twisting serpent, and he will slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day the Lord with His severe sword, great and strong, Will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent, Leviathan that twisted serpent; And He will slay the reptile that is in the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the Lord will take his terrible, swift sword and punish Leviathan, the swiftly moving serpent, the coiling, writhing serpent. He will kill the dragon of the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent, With His fierce and great and mighty sword, Even Leviathan the twisted serpent; And He will kill the dragon who lives in the sea.
verses.textEn: In that day, the Lord will punish with his sword— his fierce, great and powerful sword— Leviathan the gliding serpent, Leviathan the coiling serpent; he will slay the monster of the sea.

verses.textZh: 到那日， 有个出酒的葡萄园，你们必指着这园歌唱说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日， 有个出酒的葡萄园，你们必指着这园歌唱说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，有出酒的葡萄园， 你们要指这园唱歌说：
verses.textEnNiv: In that day— "Sing about a fruitful vineyard:
verses.textEnEsv: In that day, "A pleasant vineyard, sing of it!
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day sing to her, "A vineyard of red wine!
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day, sing about the fruitful vineyard.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day, "A vineyard of beauty, sing of it!
verses.textEn: In that day— "Sing about a fruitful vineyard:

verses.textZh: "我耶和华是看守葡萄园的； 我时刻浇灌着它， 并且为免有人毁坏它， 我日夜都看守着。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我耶和华是看守葡萄园的； 我时刻浇灌着它， 并且为免有人毁坏它， 我日夜都看守着。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华是看守葡萄园的； 我必时刻浇灌， 昼夜看守， 免得有人损害。
verses.textEnNiv: I, the Lord , watch over it; I water it continually. I guard it day and night so that no one may harm it.
verses.textEnEsv: I, the Lord , am its keeper; every moment I water it. Lest anyone punish it, I keep it night and day;
verses.textEnNkjv: I, the Lord, keep it, I water it every moment; Lest any hurt it, I keep it night and day.
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Lord , will watch over it, watering it carefully. Day and night I will watch so no one can harm it.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, the Lord, am its keeper; I water it every moment. So that no one will damage it, I guard it night and day.
verses.textEn: I, the Lord , watch over it; I water it continually. I guard it day and night so that no one may harm it.

verses.textZh: 我再没有忿怒， 若荆棘和蒺藜与我交战， 我就上前践踏它们，把它们全部焚毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我再没有忿怒， 若荆棘和蒺藜与我交战， 我就上前践踏它们，把它们全部焚毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心中不存忿怒。 惟愿荆棘蒺藜与我交战， 我就勇往直前， 把它一同焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: I am not angry. If only there were briers and thorns confronting me! I would march against them in battle; I would set them all on fire.
verses.textEnEsv: I have no wrath. Would that I had thorns and briers to battle! I would march against them, I would burn them up together.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fury is not in Me. Who would set briers and thorns Against Me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.textEnNlt: My anger will be gone. If I find briers and thorns growing, I will attack them; I will burn them up—
verses.textEnNasb: "I have no wrath. Should someone give Me briars and thorns in battle, Then I would step on them, I would burn them completely.
verses.textEn: I am not angry. If only there were briers and thorns confronting me! I would march against them in battle; I would set them all on fire.

verses.textZh: 除非他们抓住我作他们的避难所， 与我和好， 与我和好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 除非他们抓住我作他们的避难所， 与我和好， 与我和好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不然，让它持住我的能力， 使它与我和好， 愿它与我和好。
verses.textEnNiv: Or else let them come to me for refuge; let them make peace with me, yes, let them make peace with me."
verses.textEnEsv: Or let them lay hold of my protection, let them make peace with me, let them make peace with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Or let him take hold of My strength, That he may make peace with Me; And he shall make peace with Me."
verses.textEnNlt: unless they turn to me for help. Let them make peace with me; yes, let them make peace with me."
verses.textEnNasb: "Or let him rely on My protection, Let him make peace with Me, Let him make peace with Me."
verses.textEn: Or else let them come to me for refuge; let them make peace with me, yes, let them make peace with me."

verses.textZh: 在将来的日子里，雅各要扎根， 以色列要发芽开花， 他们的果实必遍布地面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在将来的日子里，雅各要扎根， 以色列要发芽开花， 他们的果实必遍布地面。
verses.textZhCuv: 将来雅各要扎根， 以色列要发芽开花； 他们的果实必充满世界。
verses.textEnNiv: In days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will bud and blossom and fill all the world with fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: In days to come Jacob shall take root, Israel shall blossom and put forth shoots and fill the whole world with fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who come He shall cause to take root in Jacob; Israel shall blossom and bud, And fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: The time is coming when Jacob’s descendants will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole earth with fruit!
verses.textEnNasb: In the days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will blossom and sprout, And they will fill the whole world with fruit.
verses.textEn: In days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will bud and blossom and fill all the world with fruit.

verses.textZh: 耶和华击打以色列人，岂像击打那些击打他们的呢？ 主杀戮以色列人，岂像杀戮那些杀戮他们的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华击打以色列人，岂像击打那些击打他们的呢？ 主杀戮以色列人，岂像杀戮那些杀戮他们的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 主击打他们， 岂像击打那些击打他们的人吗？ 他们被杀戮， 岂像被他们所杀戮的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Has the Lord struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?
verses.textEnEsv: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or have they been slain as their slayers were slain?
verses.textEnNkjv: Has He struck Israel as He struck those who struck him? Or has He been slain according to the slaughter of those who were slain by Him?
verses.textEnNlt: Has the Lord struck Israel as he struck her enemies? Has he punished her as he punished them?
verses.textEnNasb: Like the striking of Him who has struck them, has He struck them? Or like the slaughter of His slain, have they been slain?
verses.textEn: Has the Lord struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?

verses.textZh: 不，你只是渐渐地，借着他们被掳与他们相争； 在吹东风的日子，就用暴风把他们逐去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不，你只是渐渐地，借着他们被掳与他们相争； 在吹东风的日子，就用暴风把他们逐去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你打发他们去， 是相机宜与他们相争； 刮东风的日子， 就用暴风将他们逐去。
verses.textEnNiv: By warfare and exile you contend with her— with his fierce blast he drives her out, as on a day the east wind blows.
verses.textEnEsv: Measure by measure, by exile you contended with them; he removed them with his fierce breath in the day of the east wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: In measure, by sending it away, You contended with it. He removes it by His rough wind In the day of the east wind.
verses.textEnNlt: No, but he exiled Israel to call her to account. She was exiled from her land as though blown away in a storm from the east.
verses.textEnNasb: You contended with them by banishing them, by driving them away. With His fierce wind He has expelled them on the day of the east wind.
verses.textEn: By warfare and exile you contend with her— with his fierce blast he drives her out, as on a day the east wind blows.

verses.textZh: 藉此，雅各的罪孽才得赦免； 他的罪过得以除掉的条件全都在于此， 就是他叫祭坛上所有的石头都变为破碎的灰石， 使亚舍拉和香坛不再竖立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 藉此，雅各的罪孽才得赦免； 他的罪过得以除掉的条件全都在于此， 就是他叫祭坛上所有的石头都变为破碎的灰石， 使亚舍拉和香坛不再竖立。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免， 他的罪过得除掉的果效，全在乎此： 就是他叫祭坛的石头变为打碎的灰石， 以致木偶和日像不再立起。
verses.textEnNiv: By this, then, will Jacob’s guilt be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his sin: When he makes all the altar stones to be like limestone crushed to pieces, no Asherah poles or incense altars will be left standing.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore by this the guilt of Jacob will be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his sin: when he makes all the stones of the altars like chalkstones crushed to pieces, no Asherim or incense altars will remain standing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be covered; And this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: When he makes all the stones of the altar Like chalkstones that are beaten to dust, Wooden images and incense altars shall not stand.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord did this to purge Israel’s wickedness, to take away all her sin. As a result, all the pagan altars will be crushed to dust. No Asherah pole or pagan shrine will be left standing.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore through this Jacob’s wrongdoing will be forgiven; And this will be the full price of the pardoning of his sin: When he makes all the altar stones like pulverized chalk stones; When Asherim and incense altars will not stand.
verses.textEn: By this, then, will Jacob’s guilt be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his sin: When he makes all the altar stones to be like limestone crushed to pieces, no Asherah poles or incense altars will be left standing.

verses.textZh: 坚固的城变为凄凉， 成了被撇下、被放弃的居所，像旷野一样； 牛犊必在那里吃草， 在那里躺卧，并且吃尽那里的树枝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坚固的城变为凄凉， 成了被撇下、被放弃的居所，像旷野一样； 牛犊必在那里吃草， 在那里躺卧，并且吃尽那里的树枝。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为坚固城变为凄凉， 成了撇下离弃的居所，像旷野一样； 牛犊必在那里吃草， 在那里躺卧，并吃尽其中的树枝。
verses.textEnNiv: The fortified city stands desolate, an abandoned settlement, forsaken like the wilderness; there the calves graze, there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
verses.textEnEsv: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness; there the calf grazes; there it lies down and strips its branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the fortified city willbe desolate, The habitation forsaken and left like a wilderness; There the calf will feed, and there it will lie down And consume its branches.
verses.textEnNlt: The fortified towns will be silent and empty, the houses abandoned, the streets overgrown with weeds. Calves will graze there, chewing on twigs and branches.
verses.textEnNasb: For the fortified city is isolated, A homestead deserted and abandoned like the desert; There the calf will graze, And there it will lie down and feed on its branches.
verses.textEn: The fortified city stands desolate, an abandoned settlement, forsaken like the wilderness; there the calves graze, there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.

verses.textZh: 枝条枯干了，就必被折断； 妇女必来，拿去生火， 因为这人民愚昧无知， 所以他们的创造主不怜悯他们， 那造成他们的，不向他们施恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 枝条枯干了，就必被折断； 妇女必来，拿去生火， 因为这人民愚昧无知， 所以他们的创造主不怜悯他们， 那造成他们的，不向他们施恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 枝条枯干，必被折断； 妇女要来点火烧着。 因为这百姓蒙昧无知， 所以，创造他们的必不怜恤他们； 造成他们的也不施恩与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When its twigs are dry, they are broken off and women come and make fires with them. For this is a people without understanding; so their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
verses.textEnEsv: When its boughs are dry, they are broken; women come and make a fire of them. For this is a people without discernment; therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them; he who formed them will show them no favor.
verses.textEnNkjv: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off; The women come and set them on fire. For it is a people of no understanding; Therefore He who made them will not have mercy on them, And He who formed them will show them no favor.
verses.textEnNlt: The people are like the dead branches of a tree, broken off and used for kindling beneath the cooking pots. Israel is a foolish and stupid nation, for its people have turned away from God. Therefore, the one who made them will show them no pity or mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off; Women come and make a fire with them, For they are not a people of discernment, Therefore their Maker will not have compassion on them. And their Creator will not be gracious to them.
verses.textEn: When its twigs are dry, they are broken off and women come and make fires with them. For this is a people without understanding; so their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶和华要从幼发拉底的溪流，直到埃及小河，收集他的谷物；以色列人哪！你们必一个一个被捡拾回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶和华要从幼发拉底的溪流，直到埃及小河，收集他的谷物；以色列人哪！你们必一个一个被捡拾回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和华必从大河，直到埃及小河，将你们一一地收集，如同人打树拾果一样。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, Israel, will be gathered up one by one.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day from the river Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt the Lord will thresh out the grain, and you will be gleaned one by one, O people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass in that day That the Lord will thresh, From the channel of the River to the Brook of Egypt; And you will be gathered one by one, O you children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet the time will come when the Lord will gather them together like handpicked grain. One by one he will gather them—from the Euphrates River in the east to the Brook of Egypt in the west.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates River to the brook of Egypt, and you will be gathered up one by one, you sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, Israel, will be gathered up one by one.

verses.textZh: 到那日，必有大号角吹响，那些在亚述地快要灭亡的，以及那些被赶散在埃及地的，都要前来，在耶路撒冷的圣山上敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，必有大号角吹响，那些在亚述地快要灭亡的，以及那些被赶散在埃及地的，都要前来，在耶路撒冷的圣山上敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，必大发角声，在亚述地将要灭亡的，并在埃及地被赶散的，都要来，他们就在耶路撒冷圣山上敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: And in that day a great trumpet will sound. Those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were exiled in Egypt will come and worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And in that day a great trumpet will be blown, and those who were lost in the land of Assyria and those who were driven out to the land of Egypt will come and worship the Lord on the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be in that day: The great trumpet will be blown; They will come, who are about to perish in the land of Assyria, And they who are outcasts in the land of Egypt, And shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the great trumpet will sound. Many who were dying in exile in Assyria and Egypt will return to Jerusalem to worship the Lord on his holy mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: It will come about also on that day that a great trumpet will be blown, and those who were perishing in the land of Assyria and who were scattered in the land of Egypt will come and worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: And in that day a great trumpet will sound. Those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were exiled in Egypt will come and worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 以法莲那些醉汉所戴的高傲冠冕，有祸了！ 它在肥美谷山顶上的荣美，有祸了！ 它必如将残的花朵， 满了喝醉酒的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲那些醉汉所戴的高傲冠冕，有祸了！ 它在肥美谷山顶上的荣美，有祸了！ 它必如将残的花朵， 满了喝醉酒的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！以法莲的酒徒， 住在肥美谷的山上， 他们心里高傲， 以所夸的为冠冕， 犹如将残之花。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to that wreath, the pride of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley— to that city, the pride of those laid low by wine!
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, the proud crown of the drunkards of Ephraim, and the fading flower of its glorious beauty, which is on the head of the rich valley of those overcome with wine!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, Whose glorious beauty is a fading flower Which is at the head of the verdant valleys, To those who are overcome with wine!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits the proud city of Samaria— the glorious crown of the drunks of Israel. It sits at the head of a fertile valley, but its glorious beauty will fade like a flower. It is the pride of a people brought down by wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to the proud crown of the habitually drunk of Ephraim, And to the fading flower of its glorious beauty, Which is at the head of the fertile valley Of those who are overcome with wine!
verses.textEn: Woe to that wreath, the pride of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley— to that city, the pride of those laid low by wine!

verses.textZh: 看哪！主有一个大能大力的人， 像一阵冰雹、一阵毁灭的暴风， 像涨溢猛流的大水， 他必用手把它摔落地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！主有一个大能大力的人， 像一阵冰雹、一阵毁灭的暴风， 像涨溢猛流的大水， 他必用手把它摔落地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，主有一大能大力者， 像一阵冰雹， 像毁灭的暴风， 像涨溢的大水， 他必用手将冠冕摔落于地。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Lord has one who is powerful and strong. Like a hailstorm and a destructive wind, like a driving rain and a flooding downpour, he will throw it forcefully to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong; like a storm of hail, a destroying tempest, like a storm of mighty, overflowing waters, he casts down to the earth with his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one, Like a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, Like a flood of mighty waters overflowing, Who will bring them down to the earth with His hand.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will send a mighty army against it. Like a mighty hailstorm and a torrential rain, they will burst upon it like a surging flood and smash it to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord has a strong and mighty agent; As a storm of hail, a tempest of destruction, Like a storm of mighty overflowing waters, He has thrown it down to the earth with His hand.
verses.textEn: See, the Lord has one who is powerful and strong. Like a hailstorm and a destructive wind, like a driving rain and a flooding downpour, he will throw it forcefully to the ground.

verses.textZh: 以法莲的醉汉所戴的高傲冠冕，必被践踏在脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲的醉汉所戴的高傲冠冕，必被践踏在脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲高傲的酒徒， 他的冠冕必被踏在脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: That wreath, the pride of Ephraim’s drunkards, will be trampled underfoot.
verses.textEnEsv: The proud crown of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden underfoot;
verses.textEnNkjv: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, Will be trampled underfoot;
verses.textEnNlt: The proud city of Samaria— the glorious crown of the drunks of Israel — will be trampled beneath its enemies’ feet.
verses.textEnNasb: The splendid crown of the habitually drunk of Ephraim is trampled underfoot.
verses.textEn: That wreath, the pride of Ephraim’s drunkards, will be trampled underfoot.

verses.textZh: 它在肥美谷山顶上如将残的花朵一般的荣美， 必像夏天以前初熟的无花果。 那些看见它的人，都必注意； 一到手里， 就把它吞吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它在肥美谷山顶上如将残的花朵一般的荣美， 必像夏天以前初熟的无花果。 那些看见它的人，都必注意； 一到手里， 就把它吞吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那荣美将残之花， 就是在肥美谷山上的， 必像夏令以前初熟的无花果； 看见这果的就注意， 一到手中就吞吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: That fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley, will be like figs ripe before harvest— as soon as people see them and take them in hand, they swallow them.
verses.textEnEsv: and the fading flower of its glorious beauty, which is on the head of the rich valley, will be like a first-ripe fig before the summer: when someone sees it, he swallows it as soon as it is in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the glorious beauty is a fading flower Which is at the head of the verdant valley, Like the first fruit before the summer, Which an observer sees; He eats it up while it is still in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: It sits at the head of a fertile valley, but its glorious beauty will fade like a flower. Whoever sees it will snatch it up, as an early fig is quickly picked and eaten.
verses.textEnNasb: And the fading flower of its glorious beauty, Which is at the head of the fertile valley, Will be like the first-ripe fig prior to the summer, Which one sees, And as soon as it is in his hand, He swallows it.
verses.textEn: That fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley, will be like figs ripe before harvest— as soon as people see them and take them in hand, they swallow them.

verses.textZh: 到那日， 万军之耶和华必作他余民荣耀的冠冕、美丽的华冠，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日， 万军之耶和华必作他余民荣耀的冠冕、美丽的华冠，
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，万军之耶和华 必作他余剩之民的荣冠华冕，
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the Lord Almighty will be a glorious crown, a beautiful wreath for the remnant of his people.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the Lord of hosts will be a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the remnant of his people,
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day the Lord of hosts will be For a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty To the remnant of His people,
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will himself be Israel’s glorious crown. He will be the pride and joy of the remnant of his people.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord of armies will become a beautiful crown And a glorious wreath to the remnant of His people;
verses.textEn: In that day the Lord Almighty will be a glorious crown, a beautiful wreath for the remnant of his people.

verses.textZh: 也必作在位上施行审判者公平的心灵， 并作在城门口击退敌人者的力量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也必作在位上施行审判者公平的心灵， 并作在城门口击退敌人者的力量。
verses.textZhCuv: 也作了在位上行审判者公平之灵， 并城门口打退仇敌者的力量。
verses.textEnNiv: He will be a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment, a source of strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
verses.textEnEsv: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, And for strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: He will give a longing for justice to their judges. He will give great courage to their warriors who stand at the gates.
verses.textEnNasb: A spirit of justice for him who sits in judgment, A strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate.
verses.textEn: He will be a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment, a source of strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

verses.textZh: 就是这地的人，也因酒摇晃不定， 因浓酒东倒西歪； 祭司和先知都因浓酒摇晃不定， 被酒弄至昏乱，因浓酒东倒西歪。 他们见异象的时候，摇晃不定， 他们判断的时候，也颠颠倒倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是这地的人，也因酒摇晃不定， 因浓酒东倒西歪； 祭司和先知都因浓酒摇晃不定， 被酒弄至昏乱，因浓酒东倒西歪。 他们见异象的时候，摇晃不定， 他们判断的时候，也颠颠倒倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是这地的人也因酒摇摇晃晃， 因浓酒东倒西歪。 祭司和先知因浓酒摇摇晃晃， 被酒所困， 因浓酒东倒西歪。 他们错解默示， 谬行审判。
verses.textEnNiv: And these also stagger from wine and reel from beer: Priests and prophets stagger from beer and are befuddled with wine; they reel from beer, they stagger when seeing visions, they stumble when rendering decisions.
verses.textEnEsv: These also reel with wine and stagger with strong drink; the priest and the prophet reel with strong drink, they are swallowed by wine, they stagger with strong drink, they reel in vision, they stumble in giving judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they also have erred through wine, And through intoxicating drink are out of the way; The priest and the prophet have erred through intoxicating drink, They are swallowed up by wine, They are out of the way through intoxicating drink; They err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, however, Israel is led by drunks who reel with wine and stagger with alcohol. The priests and prophets stagger with alcohol and lose themselves in wine. They reel when they see visions and stagger as they render decisions.
verses.textEnNasb: And these also reel with wine and stagger from intoxicating drink: The priest and the prophet reel with intoxicating drink, They are confused by wine, they stagger from intoxicating drink; They reel while having visions, They stagger when rendering a verdict.
verses.textEn: And these also stagger from wine and reel from beer: Priests and prophets stagger from beer and are befuddled with wine; they reel from beer, they stagger when seeing visions, they stumble when rendering decisions.

verses.textZh: 因为各席上都满了污秽的呕吐，没有一处是干净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为各席上都满了污秽的呕吐，没有一处是干净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为各席上满了呕吐的污秽， 无一处干净。
verses.textEnNiv: All the tables are covered with vomit and there is not a spot without filth.
verses.textEnEsv: For all tables are full of filthy vomit, with no space left.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all tables are full of vomit and filth; No place isclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Their tables are covered with vomit; filth is everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: For all the tables are full of filthy vomit, without a single clean place.
verses.textEn: All the tables are covered with vomit and there is not a spot without filth.

verses.textZh: 他们说： "他要把知识教导谁呢？ 要使谁明白他所传的信息呢？ 是那些刚断奶， 刚离开母怀的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说： "他要把知识教导谁呢？ 要使谁明白他所传的信息呢？ 是那些刚断奶， 刚离开母怀的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 讥诮先知的说： 他要将知识指教谁呢？ 要使谁明白传言呢？ 是那刚断奶离怀的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who is it he is trying to teach? To whom is he explaining his message? To children weaned from their milk, to those just taken from the breast?
verses.textEnEsv: "To whom will he teach knowledge, and to whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, those taken from the breast?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whom will he teach knowledge? And whom will he make to understand the message? Those just weaned from milk? Those just drawn from the breasts?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who does the Lord think we are?" they ask. "Why does he speak to us like this? Are we little children, just recently weaned?
verses.textEnNasb: "To whom would He teach knowledge, And to whom would He interpret the message? Those just weaned from milk? Those just taken from the breast?
verses.textEn: "Who is it he is trying to teach? To whom is he explaining his message? To children weaned from their milk, to those just taken from the breast?

verses.textZh: 因为他所说的， 只是些重复又重复的话， 和毫无意义的字母， 这里一点，那里一点罢了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他所说的， 只是些重复又重复的话， 和毫无意义的字母， 这里一点，那里一点罢了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他竟命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 这里一点，那里一点。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is: Do this, do that, a rule for this, a rule for that ; a little here, a little there."
verses.textEnEsv: For it is precept upon precept, precept upon precept, line upon line, line upon line, here a little, there a little."
verses.textEnNkjv: For precept mustbe upon precept, precept upon precept, Line upon line, line upon line, Here a little, there a little."
verses.textEnNlt: He tells us everything over and over— one line at a time, one line at a time, a little here, and a little there!"
verses.textEnNasb: "For He says, ‘ Order on order, order on order, Line on line, line on line, A little here, a little there.’ "
verses.textEn: For it is: Do this, do that, a rule for this, a rule for that ; a little here, a little there."

verses.textZh: 耶和华要借着外族人的嘴唇和外族人的舌头， 对这人民说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华要借着外族人的嘴唇和外族人的舌头， 对这人民说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知说：不然，主要藉异邦人的嘴唇 和外邦人的舌头对这百姓说话。
verses.textEnNiv: Very well then, with foreign lips and strange tongues God will speak to this people,
verses.textEnEsv: For by people of strange lips and with a foreign tongue the Lord will speak to this people,
verses.textEnNkjv: For with stammering lips and another tongue He will speak to this people,
verses.textEnNlt: So now God will have to speak to his people through foreign oppressors who speak a strange language!
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, He will speak to this people Through stammering lips and a foreign tongue,
verses.textEn: Very well then, with foreign lips and strange tongues God will speak to this people,

verses.textZh: 他曾对他们说："这就是安息之处，你们若使疲乏的人得安息，就必得着这安歇的地方。" 但他们不肯听从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他曾对他们说："这就是安息之处，你们若使疲乏的人得安息，就必得着这安歇的地方。" 但他们不肯听从。
verses.textZhCuv: 他曾对他们说： 你们要使疲乏人得安息， 这样才得安息，才得舒畅， 他们却不肯听。
verses.textEnNiv: to whom he said, "This is the resting place, let the weary rest"; and, "This is the place of repose"— but they would not listen.
verses.textEnEsv: to whom he has said, "This is rest; give rest to the weary; and this is repose"; yet they would not hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: To whom He said, "This is the rest withwhich You may cause the weary to rest," And, "This is the refreshing"; Yet they would not hear.
verses.textEnNlt: God has told his people, "Here is a place of rest; let the weary rest here. This is a place of quiet rest." But they would not listen.
verses.textEnNasb: He who said to them, "This is the place of quiet, give rest to the weary," And, "This is the resting place," but they would not listen.
verses.textEn: to whom he said, "This is the resting place, let the weary rest"; and, "This is the place of repose"— but they would not listen.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华对他们所说的话， 就成了重复又重复的话， 和毫无意义的字母， 这里一点，那里一点， 以致他们虽然往前走，却必仰面跌倒，并且跌伤，陷入网罗被缠住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华对他们所说的话， 就成了重复又重复的话， 和毫无意义的字母， 这里一点，那里一点， 以致他们虽然往前走，却必仰面跌倒，并且跌伤，陷入网罗被缠住。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华向他们说的话是 命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 这里一点，那里一点， 以致他们前行仰面跌倒， 而且跌碎，并陷入网罗被缠住。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, the word of the Lord to them will become: Do this, do that, a rule for this, a rule for that; a little here, a little there— so that as they go they will fall backward; they will be injured and snared and captured.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord will be to them precept upon precept, precept upon precept, line upon line, line upon line, here a little, there a little, that they may go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the word of the Lord was to them, "Precept upon precept, precept upon precept, Line upon line, line upon line, Here a little, there a little," That they might go and fall backward, and be broken And snared and caught.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord will spell out his message for them again, one line at a time, one line at a time, a little here, and a little there, so that they will stumble and fall. They will be injured, trapped, and captured.
verses.textEnNasb: So the word of the Lord to them will be, " Order on order, order on order, Line on line, line on line, A little here, a little there," That they may go and stumble backward, be broken, snared, and taken captive.
verses.textEn: So then, the word of the Lord to them will become: Do this, do that, a rule for this, a rule for that; a little here, a little there— so that as they go they will fall backward; they will be injured and snared and captured.

verses.textZh: 因此好讥笑人的人哪！ 就是管辖这些在耶路撒冷的人民的， 你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此好讥笑人的人哪！ 就是管辖这些在耶路撒冷的人民的， 你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们这些亵慢的人， 就是辖管住在耶路撒冷这百姓的， 要听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore hear the word of the Lord , you scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore hear the word of the Lord , you scoffers, who rule this people in Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, you scornful men, Who rule this people who are in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, listen to this message from the Lord , you scoffing rulers in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, hear the word of the Lord, you scoffers, Who rule this people who are in Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: Therefore hear the word of the Lord , you scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 因为你们曾说："我们与死亡立了约， 与阴间结了盟； 刑罚的鞭子扫过的时候，必不会碰到我们， 因为我们以谎言作遮蔽，以虚假作庇护。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们曾说："我们与死亡立了约， 与阴间结了盟； 刑罚的鞭子扫过的时候，必不会碰到我们， 因为我们以谎言作遮蔽，以虚假作庇护。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们曾说： 我们与死亡立约， 与阴间结盟； 敌军 如水涨漫经过的时候， 必不临到我们； 因我们以谎言为避所， 在虚假以下藏身。
verses.textEnNiv: You boast, "We have entered into a covenant with death, with the realm of the dead we have made an agreement. When an overwhelming scourge sweeps by, it cannot touch us, for we have made a lie our refuge and falsehood our hiding place."
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have said, "We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have an agreement, when the overwhelming whip passes through it will not come to us, for we have made lies our refuge, and in falsehood we have taken shelter";
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have said, "We have made a covenant with death, And with Sheol we are in agreement. When the overflowing scourge passes through, It will not come to us, For we have made lies our refuge, And under falsehood we have hidden ourselves."
verses.textEnNlt: You boast, "We have struck a bargain to cheat death and have made a deal to dodge the grave. The coming destruction can never touch us, for we have built a strong refuge made of lies and deception."
verses.textEnNasb: Because you have said, "We have made a covenant with death, And with Sheol we have made a pact. The gushing flood will not reach us when it passes by, Because we have made falsehood our refuge and we have concealed ourselves with deception."
verses.textEn: You boast, "We have entered into a covenant with death, with the realm of the dead we have made an agreement. When an overwhelming scourge sweeps by, it cannot touch us, for we have made a lie our refuge and falsehood our hiding place."

verses.textZh: 所以主耶和华这样说： "看哪！我在锡安放置一块石头， 是试验过的石头， 是稳固的基石，宝贵的房角石； 信靠的人，必不着急。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以主耶和华这样说： "看哪！我在锡安放置一块石头， 是试验过的石头， 是稳固的基石，宝贵的房角石； 信靠的人，必不着急。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主耶和华如此说： 看哪，我在锡安放一块石头作为根基， 是试验过的石头， 是稳固根基，宝贵的房角石； 信靠的人必不着急。
verses.textEnNiv: So this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone for a sure foundation; the one who relies on it will never be stricken with panic.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God , "Behold, I am the one who has laid as a foundation in Zion, a stone, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, of a sure foundation: ‘Whoever believes will not be in haste.’
