verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I lay in Zion a stone for a foundation, A tried stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; Whoever believes will not act hastily.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "Look! I am placing a foundation stone in Jerusalem, a firm and tested stone. It is a precious cornerstone that is safe to build on. Whoever believes need never be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am laying a stone in Zion, a tested stone, A precious cornerstone for the foundation, firmly placed. The one who believes in it will not be disturbed.
verses.textEn: So this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone for a sure foundation; the one who relies on it will never be stricken with panic.

verses.textZh: 我要以公平为准绳， 以公义为线铊； 冰雹必把谎言的遮蔽冲去， 大水必漫过庇护所。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要以公平为准绳， 以公义为线铊； 冰雹必把谎言的遮蔽冲去， 大水必漫过庇护所。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必以公平为准绳， 以公义为线铊。 冰雹必冲去谎言的避所； 大水必漫过藏身之处。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line; hail will sweep away your refuge, the lie, and water will overflow your hiding place.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make justice the line, and righteousness the plumb line; and hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and waters will overwhelm the shelter."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I will make justice the measuring line, And righteousness the plummet; The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, And the waters will overflow the hiding place.
verses.textEnNlt: I will test you with the measuring line of justice and the plumb line of righteousness. Since your refuge is made of lies, a hailstorm will knock it down. Since it is made of deception, a flood will sweep it away.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make justice the measuring line And righteousness the level; Then hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, And the waters will overflow the secret place.
verses.textEn: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line; hail will sweep away your refuge, the lie, and water will overflow your hiding place.

verses.textZh: 你们与死亡所立的约要废除， 你们与阴间所结的盟必立不住； 刑罚的鞭子扫过的时候， 你们就必被践踏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们与死亡所立的约要废除， 你们与阴间所结的盟必立不住； 刑罚的鞭子扫过的时候， 你们就必被践踏。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们与死亡所立的约必然废掉， 与阴间所结的盟必立不住。 敌军 如水涨漫经过的时候， 你们必被他践踏；
verses.textEnNiv: Your covenant with death will be annulled; your agreement with the realm of the dead will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge sweeps by, you will be beaten down by it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand; when the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be beaten down by it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your covenant with death will be annulled, And your agreement with Sheol will not stand; When the overflowing scourge passes through, Then you will be trampled down by it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will cancel the bargain you made to cheat death, and I will overturn your deal to dodge the grave. When the terrible enemy sweeps through, you will be trampled into the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your covenant with death will be canceled, And your pact with Sheol will not stand; When the gushing flood passes through, Then you will become its trampling ground.
verses.textEn: Your covenant with death will be annulled; your agreement with the realm of the dead will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge sweeps by, you will be beaten down by it.

verses.textZh: 每次扫过的时候，都把你们抓去； 因为每早晨它必漫过，白天与黑夜也是这样； 人若明白所传的，必受惊恐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每次扫过的时候，都把你们抓去； 因为每早晨它必漫过，白天与黑夜也是这样； 人若明白所传的，必受惊恐。
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢经过必将你们掳去。 因为每早晨他必经过， 白昼黑夜都必如此。 明白传言的必受惊恐。
verses.textEnNiv: As often as it comes it will carry you away; morning after morning, by day and by night, it will sweep through." The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.
verses.textEnEsv: As often as it passes through it will take you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be sheer terror to understand the message.
verses.textEnNkjv: As often as it goes out it will take you; For morning by morning it will pass over, And by day and by night; It will be a terror just to understand the report."
verses.textEnNlt: Again and again that flood will come, morning after morning, day and night, until you are carried away." This message will bring terror to your people.
verses.textEnNasb: "As often as it passes through, it will seize you; For morning after morning it will pass through, anytime during the day or night, And it will be sheer terror to understand what it means."
verses.textEn: As often as it comes it will carry you away; morning after morning, by day and by night, it will sweep through." The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.

verses.textZh: 床铺太短，人就不能伸直， 被窝太窄，就盖不住全身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 床铺太短，人就不能伸直， 被窝太窄，就盖不住全身。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来，床榻短，使人不能舒身； 被窝窄，使人不能遮体。
verses.textEnNiv: The bed is too short to stretch out on, the blanket too narrow to wrap around you.
verses.textEnEsv: For the bed is too short to stretch oneself on, and the covering too narrow to wrap oneself in.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, And the covering so narrow that one cannot wrap himself init.
verses.textEnNlt: The bed you have made is too short to lie on. The blankets are too narrow to cover you.
verses.textEnNasb: The bed is too short on which to stretch out, And the blanket is too small to wrap oneself in.
verses.textEn: The bed is too short to stretch out on, the blanket too narrow to wrap around you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必像在毘拉心山一样兴起， 又像在基遍谷一样发怒， 为要作成他的工，他那奇妙的工， 好成就他的事，就是奇异的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必像在毘拉心山一样兴起， 又像在基遍谷一样发怒， 为要作成他的工，他那奇妙的工， 好成就他的事，就是奇异的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必兴起，像在毗拉心山； 他必发怒，像在基遍谷， 好做成他的工，就是非常的工； 成就他的事，就是奇异的事。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will rise up as he did at Mount Perazim, he will rouse himself as in the Valley of Gibeon— to do his work, his strange work, and perform his task, his alien task.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will rise up as on Mount Perazim; as in the Valley of Gibeon he will be roused; to do his deed—strange is his deed! and to work his work—alien is his work!
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will rise up as at Mount Perazim, He will be angry as in the Valley of Gibeon— That He may do His work, His awesome work, And bring to pass His act, His unusual act.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will come as he did against the Philistines at Mount Perazim and against the Amorites at Gibeon. He will come to do a strange thing; he will come to do an unusual deed:
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will rise up as at Mount Perazim, He will be stirred up as in the Valley of Gibeon, To do His task, His unusual task, And to work His work, His extraordinary work.
verses.textEn: The Lord will rise up as he did at Mount Perazim, he will rouse himself as in the Valley of Gibeon— to do his work, his strange work, and perform his task, his alien task.

verses.textZh: 现在，你们不可再讥笑了， 免得捆绑你们的绳索绑得更紧， 因为我从主万军之耶和华那里听到， 决定要在全地上施行毁灭的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你们不可再讥笑了， 免得捆绑你们的绳索绑得更紧， 因为我从主万军之耶和华那里听到， 决定要在全地上施行毁灭的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们不可亵慢， 恐怕捆你们的绑索更结实了； 因为我从主－万军之耶和华那里听见， 已经决定在全地上施行灭绝的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Now stop your mocking, or your chains will become heavier; the Lord, the Lord Almighty, has told me of the destruction decreed against the whole land.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore do not scoff, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord God of hosts against the whole land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, do not be mockers, Lest your bonds be made strong; For I have heard from the Lord God of hosts, A destruction determined even upon the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, has plainly said that he is determined to crush the whole land. So scoff no more, or your punishment will be even greater.
verses.textEnNasb: And now do not carry on as scoffers, Or your shackles will be made stronger; For I have heard from the Lord God of armies Of decisive destruction on all the earth.
verses.textEn: Now stop your mocking, or your chains will become heavier; the Lord, the Lord Almighty, has told me of the destruction decreed against the whole land.

verses.textZh: 你们要侧耳听我的声音， 留心听我的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要侧耳听我的声音， 留心听我的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当侧耳听我的声音， 留心听我的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen and hear my voice; pay attention and hear what I say.
verses.textEnEsv: Give ear, and hear my voice; give attention, and hear my speech.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give ear and hear my voice, Listen and hear my speech.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me; listen, and pay close attention.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen and hear my voice, Pay attention and hear my words.
verses.textEn: Listen and hear my voice; pay attention and hear what I say.

verses.textZh: 农夫怎会不断耕犁来撒种呢？ 他怎会常常开垦耕地呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 农夫怎会不断耕犁来撒种呢？ 他怎会常常开垦耕地呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那耕地为要撒种的， 岂是常常耕地呢？ 岂是常常开垦耙地呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When a farmer plows for planting, does he plow continually? Does he keep on breaking up and working the soil?
verses.textEnEsv: Does he who plows for sowing plow continually? Does he continually open and harrow his ground?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does the plowman keep plowing all day to sow? Does he keep turning his soil and breaking the clods?
verses.textEnNlt: Does a farmer always plow and never sow? Is he forever cultivating the soil and never planting?
verses.textEnNasb: Does the farmer plow continually to plant seed? Does he continually turn and break up his ground?
verses.textEn: When a farmer plows for planting, does he plow continually? Does he keep on breaking up and working the soil?

verses.textZh: 他犁平了地面， 不就撒种小茴香，播种大茴香， 按行列种小麦， 在指定的地方种大麦，在田边种粗麦吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他犁平了地面， 不就撒种小茴香，播种大茴香， 按行列种小麦， 在指定的地方种大麦，在田边种粗麦吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他拉平了地面， 岂不就撒种小茴香， 播种大茴香， 按行列种小麦， 在定处种大麦， 在田边种粗麦呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When he has leveled the surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? Does he not plant wheat in its place, barley in its plot, and spelt in its field?
verses.textEnEsv: When he has leveled its surface, does he not scatter dill, sow cumin, and put in wheat in rows and barley in its proper place, and emmer as the border?
verses.textEnNkjv: When he has leveled its surface, Does he not sow the black cummin And scatter the cummin, Plant the wheat in rows, The barley in the appointed place, And the spelt in its place?
verses.textEnNlt: Does he not finally plant his seeds— black cumin, cumin, wheat, barley, and emmer wheat— each in its proper way, and each in its proper place?
verses.textEnNasb: Does he not level its surface And sow dill and scatter cumin And plant wheat in rows, Barley in its place and rye within its area?
verses.textEn: When he has leveled the surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? Does he not plant wheat in its place, barley in its plot, and spelt in its field?

verses.textZh: 因为他的神教导他，指教他正确的方法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的神教导他，指教他正确的方法。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他的神教导他务农相宜， 并且指教他。
verses.textEnNiv: His God instructs him and teaches him the right way.
verses.textEnEsv: For he is rightly instructed; his God teaches him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He instructs him in right judgment, His God teaches him.
verses.textEnNlt: The farmer knows just what to do, for God has given him understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: For his God instructs and teaches him properly.
verses.textEn: His God instructs him and teaches him the right way.

verses.textZh: 打小茴香是不用尖耙的， 轧大茴香也不用碾轮； 而是用杖打小茴香，用棍打大茴香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打小茴香是不用尖耙的， 轧大茴香也不用碾轮； 而是用杖打小茴香，用棍打大茴香。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来打小茴香，不用尖利的器具， 轧大茴香，也不用碌碡 ； 但用杖打小茴香， 用棍打大茴香。
verses.textEnNiv: Caraway is not threshed with a sledge, nor is the wheel of a cart rolled over cumin; caraway is beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a stick.
verses.textEnEsv: Dill is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cart wheel rolled over cumin, but dill is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the black cummin is not threshed with a threshing sledge, Nor is a cartwheel rolled over the cummin; But the black cummin is beaten out with a stick, And the cummin with a rod.
verses.textEnNlt: A heavy sledge is never used to thresh black cumin; rather, it is beaten with a light stick. A threshing wheel is never rolled on cumin; instead, it is beaten lightly with a flail.
verses.textEnNasb: For dill is not threshed with a threshing sledge, Nor is the cartwheel driven over cumin; But dill is beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a club.
verses.textEn: Caraway is not threshed with a sledge, nor is the wheel of a cart rolled over cumin; caraway is beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a stick.

verses.textZh: 做饼的谷粒怎么要碾碎的呢？ 从来没有人碾碎它们， 虽然他让车轮和马匹辊过谷粒， 却不会把他们碾碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 做饼的谷粒怎么要碾碎的呢？ 从来没有人碾碎它们， 虽然他让车轮和马匹辊过谷粒， 却不会把他们碾碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 做饼的粮食是用磨磨碎， 因它不必常打； 虽用碌碡和马打散， 却不磨它。
verses.textEnNiv: Grain must be ground to make bread; so one does not go on threshing it forever. The wheels of a threshing cart may be rolled over it, but one does not use horses to grind grain.
verses.textEnEsv: Does one crush grain for bread? No, he does not thresh it forever; when he drives his cart wheel over it with his horses, he does not crush it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bread flour must be ground; Therefore he does not thresh it forever, Break itwith his cartwheel, Or crush it with his horsemen.
verses.textEnNlt: Grain for bread is easily crushed, so he doesn’t keep on pounding it. He threshes it under the wheels of a cart, but he doesn’t pulverize it.
verses.textEnNasb: Grain for bread is crushed, Indeed, he does not continue to thresh it forever. Because the wheel of his cart and his horses eventually damage it, He does not thresh it longer.
verses.textEn: Grain must be ground to make bread; so one does not go on threshing it forever. The wheels of a threshing cart may be rolled over it, but one does not use horses to grind grain.

verses.textZh: 这也是出于万军之耶和华， 他的谋略奇妙，他的智慧广大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这也是出于万军之耶和华， 他的谋略奇妙，他的智慧广大。
verses.textZhCuv: 这也是出于万军之耶和华－ 他的谋略奇妙； 他的智慧广大。
verses.textEnNiv: All this also comes from the Lord Almighty, whose plan is wonderful, whose wisdom is magnificent.
verses.textEnEsv: This also comes from the Lord of hosts; he is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: This also comes from the Lord of hosts, Who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in guidance.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is a wonderful teacher, and he gives the farmer great wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: This also comes from the Lord of armies, Who has made His counsel wonderful and His wisdom great.
verses.textEn: All this also comes from the Lord Almighty, whose plan is wonderful, whose wisdom is magnificent.

verses.textZh: 亚利伊勒、亚利伊勒 ， 大卫曾在此安营的城啊，有祸了！ 虽然你一年又一年按时举行节期，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚利伊勒、亚利伊勒 ， 大卫曾在此安营的城啊，有祸了！ 虽然你一年又一年按时举行节期，
verses.textZhCuv: 唉！亚利伊勒，亚利伊勒， 大卫安营的城， 任凭你年上加年， 节期照常周流。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David settled! Add year to year and let your cycle of festivals go on.
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts run their round.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! Add year to year; Let feasts come around.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits Ariel, the City of David. Year after year you celebrate your feasts.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe, Ariel, Ariel the city where David once camped! Add year to year, keep your feasts on schedule.
verses.textEn: Woe to you, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David settled! Add year to year and let your cycle of festivals go on.

verses.textZh: 我却要使亚利伊勒受困苦， 成了一座充满悲伤哀号的城， 我要以它为亚利伊勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却要使亚利伊勒受困苦， 成了一座充满悲伤哀号的城， 我要以它为亚利伊勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我终必使亚利伊勒困难； 她必悲伤哀号， 我却仍以她为亚利伊勒。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I will besiege Ariel; she will mourn and lament, she will be to me like an altar hearth.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be moaning and lamentation, and she shall be to me like an Ariel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I will distress Ariel; There shall be heaviness and sorrow, And it shall be to Me as Ariel.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I will bring disaster upon you, and there will be much weeping and sorrow. For Jerusalem will become what her name Ariel means— an altar covered with blood.
verses.textEnNasb: I will bring distress to Ariel, And she will be a city of grieving and mourning; And she will be like an Ariel to me.
verses.textEn: Yet I will besiege Ariel; she will mourn and lament, she will be to me like an altar hearth.

verses.textZh: 我必四面安营攻击你， 筑起攻城的台来围困你， 堆起高垒攻击你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必四面安营攻击你， 筑起攻城的台来围困你， 堆起高垒攻击你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必四围安营攻击你， 屯兵围困你， 筑垒攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will encamp against you on all sides; I will encircle you with towers and set up my siege works against you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will encamp against you all around, and will besiege you with towers and I will raise siegeworks against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will encamp against you all around, I will lay siege against you with a mound, And I will raise siegeworks against you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be your enemy, surrounding Jerusalem and attacking its walls. I will build siege towers and destroy it.
verses.textEnNasb: I will camp against you encircling you, And I will set up siegeworks against you, And I will raise up battle towers against you.
verses.textEn: I will encamp against you on all sides; I will encircle you with towers and set up my siege works against you.

verses.textZh: 你必降低， 从地中说话； 你说的话必细微， 如同出于尘土； 你的声音必像交鬼者的声音，从地里出来； 你的言语必像耳语般低微，如同出于尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必降低， 从地中说话； 你说的话必细微， 如同出于尘土； 你的声音必像交鬼者的声音，从地里出来； 你的言语必像耳语般低微，如同出于尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必败落，从地中说话； 你的言语必微细出于尘埃。 你的声音必像那交鬼者的声音出于地； 你的言语低低微微出于尘埃。
verses.textEnNiv: Brought low, you will speak from the ground; your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will come ghostlike from the earth; out of the dust your speech will whisper.
verses.textEnEsv: And you will be brought low; from the earth you shall speak, and from the dust your speech will be bowed down; your voice shall come from the ground like the voice of a ghost, and from the dust your speech shall whisper.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be brought down, You shall speak out of the ground; Your speech shall be low, out of the dust; Your voice shall be like a medium’s, out of the ground; And your speech shall whisper out of the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: Then deep from the earth you will speak; from low in the dust your words will come. Your voice will whisper from the ground like a ghost conjured up from the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will be brought low; From the earth you will speak, And from the dust where you are prostrate Your words will come. Your voice will also be like that of a spirit from the ground, And your speech will whisper from the dust.
verses.textEn: Brought low, you will speak from the ground; your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will come ghostlike from the earth; out of the dust your speech will whisper.

verses.textZh: 但你敌人的数量必多如灰尘， 那些强暴者的数量也多如被吹散的糠秕， 这必在顷刻之间，突然发生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你敌人的数量必多如灰尘， 那些强暴者的数量也多如被吹散的糠秕， 这必在顷刻之间，突然发生。
verses.textZhCuv: 你仇敌的群众，却要像细尘； 强暴人的群众，也要像飞糠。 这事必顷刻之间忽然临到。
verses.textEnNiv: But your many enemies will become like fine dust, the ruthless hordes like blown chaff. Suddenly, in an instant,
verses.textEnEsv: But the multitude of your foreign foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the ruthless like passing chaff. And in an instant, suddenly,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover the multitude of your foes Shall be like fine dust, And the multitude of the terrible ones Like chaff that passes away; Yes, it shall be in an instant, suddenly.
verses.textEnNlt: "But suddenly, your ruthless enemies will be crushed like the finest of dust. Your many attackers will be driven away like chaff before the wind. Suddenly, in an instant,
verses.textEnNasb: But the multitude of your enemies will become like fine dust, And the multitude of the ruthless ones like the chaff which blows away; And it will happen instantly, suddenly.
verses.textEn: But your many enemies will become like fine dust, the ruthless hordes like blown chaff. Suddenly, in an instant,

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华必用雷轰、地震、大声、 旋风、暴风和吞灭人的火焰来惩罚他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华必用雷轰、地震、大声、 旋风、暴风和吞灭人的火焰来惩罚他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华必用雷轰、地震、大声、旋风、暴风， 并吞灭的火焰，向她讨罪。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord Almighty will come with thunder and earthquake and great noise, with windstorm and tempest and flames of a devouring fire.
verses.textEnEsv: you will be visited by the Lord of hosts with thunder and with earthquake and great noise, with whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of a devouring fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will be punished by the Lord of hosts With thunder and earthquake and great noise, With storm and tempest And the flame of devouring fire.
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, will act for you with thunder and earthquake and great noise, with whirlwind and storm and consuming fire.
verses.textEnNasb: From the Lord of armies you will be punished with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, With whirlwind and tempest and the flame of a consuming fire.
verses.textEn: the Lord Almighty will come with thunder and earthquake and great noise, with windstorm and tempest and flames of a devouring fire.

verses.textZh: 那时，所有攻击亚利伊勒的列国众军， 就是所有攻击亚利伊勒和它的堡垒， 以及迫害它的， 必如梦景，如夜间的异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所有攻击亚利伊勒的列国众军， 就是所有攻击亚利伊勒和它的堡垒， 以及迫害它的， 必如梦景，如夜间的异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，攻击亚利伊勒列国的群众， 就是一切攻击亚利伊勒和她的保障， 并使她困难的， 必如梦景，如夜间的异象；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the hordes of all the nations that fight against Ariel, that attack her and her fortress and besiege her, will be as it is with a dream, with a vision in the night—
verses.textEnEsv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, all that fight against her and her stronghold and distress her, shall be like a dream, a vision of the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: The multitude of all the nations who fight against Ariel, Even all who fight against her and her fortress, And distress her, Shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.textEnNlt: All the nations fighting against Jerusalem will vanish like a dream! Those who are attacking her walls will vanish like a vision in the night.
verses.textEnNasb: And the multitude of all the nations who wage war against Ariel, Even all who wage war against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, Will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
verses.textEn: Then the hordes of all the nations that fight against Ariel, that attack her and her fortress and besiege her, will be as it is with a dream, with a vision in the night—

verses.textZh: 又像饥饿的人在梦中吃饭， 醒了以后，仍然觉得饥饿； 又像口渴的人在梦中喝水， 醒了以后，仍然觉得口渴， 心里还是想喝。 那攻打锡安山的列国众军， 也必这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又像饥饿的人在梦中吃饭， 醒了以后，仍然觉得饥饿； 又像口渴的人在梦中喝水， 醒了以后，仍然觉得口渴， 心里还是想喝。 那攻打锡安山的列国众军， 也必这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 又必像饥饿的人梦中吃饭， 醒了仍觉腹空； 或像口渴的人梦中喝水， 醒了仍觉发昏，心里想喝。 攻击锡安山列国的群众也必如此。
verses.textEnNiv: as when a hungry person dreams of eating, but awakens hungry still; as when a thirsty person dreams of drinking, but awakens faint and thirsty still. So will it be with the hordes of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: As when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he is eating, and awakes with his hunger not satisfied, or as when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he is drinking, and awakes faint, with his thirst not quenched, so shall the multitude of all the nations be that fight against Mount Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall even be as when a hungry man dreams, And look—he eats; But he awakes, and his soul is still empty; Or as when a thirsty man dreams, And look—he drinks; But he awakes, and indeed heis faint, And his soul still craves: So the multitude of all the nations shall be, Who fight against Mount Zion."
verses.textEnNlt: A hungry person dreams of eating but wakes up still hungry. A thirsty person dreams of drinking but is still faint from thirst when morning comes. So it will be with your enemies, with those who attack Mount Zion."
verses.textEnNasb: It will be as when a hungry person dreams— And behold, he is eating; But when he awakens, his hunger is not satisfied, Or as when a thirsty person dreams— And behold, he is drinking, But when he awakens, behold, he is faint And his thirst is not quenched. So will the multitude of all the nations be Who wage war against Mount Zion.
verses.textEn: as when a hungry person dreams of eating, but awakens hungry still; as when a thirsty person dreams of drinking, but awakens faint and thirsty still. So will it be with the hordes of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion.

verses.textZh: 你们留连吧， 自我蒙蔽，继续盲目吧！ 你们醉了，却与酒无关， 你们东倒西歪，也不是因为浓酒的缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们留连吧， 自我蒙蔽，继续盲目吧！ 你们醉了，却与酒无关， 你们东倒西歪，也不是因为浓酒的缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们等候惊奇吧！ 你们宴乐昏迷吧！ 他们醉了，却非因酒； 他们东倒西歪，却非因浓酒。
verses.textEnNiv: Be stunned and amazed, blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not from wine, stagger, but not from beer.
verses.textEnEsv: Astonish yourselves and be astonished; blind yourselves and be blind! Be drunk, but not with wine; stagger, but not with strong drink!
verses.textEnNkjv: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunk, but not with wine; They stagger, but not with intoxicating drink.
verses.textEnNlt: Are you amazed and incredulous? Don’t you believe it? Then go ahead and be blind. You are stupid, but not from wine! You stagger, but not from liquor!
verses.textEnNasb: Be delayed and horrified, Blind yourselves and be blind; They become drunk, but not with wine, They stagger, but not with intoxicating drink.
verses.textEn: Be stunned and amazed, blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not from wine, stagger, but not from beer.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华把沉睡的灵，倾倒在你们身上； 他紧闭你们的眼，就是先知； 蒙盖你们的头，就是先见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华把沉睡的灵，倾倒在你们身上； 他紧闭你们的眼，就是先知； 蒙盖你们的头，就是先见。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华将沉睡的灵浇灌你们， 封闭你们的眼， 蒙盖你们的头。 你们的眼就是先知； 你们的头就是先见。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has brought over you a deep sleep: He has sealed your eyes (the prophets); he has covered your heads (the seers).
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord has poured out upon you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes (the prophets), and covered your heads (the seers).
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord has poured out on you The spirit of deep sleep, And has closed your eyes, namely, the prophets; And He has covered your heads, namely, the seers.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has closed the eyes of your prophets and visionaries.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord has poured over you a spirit of deep sleep, He has shut your eyes—the prophets; And He has covered your heads—the seers.
verses.textEn: The Lord has brought over you a deep sleep: He has sealed your eyes (the prophets); he has covered your heads (the seers).

verses.textZh: 对你们来说，整个异象就像密封的书卷的话，人把这书卷交给识字的，说："请念吧！"他必回答："我不能念，因为它是密封的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对你们来说，整个异象就像密封的书卷的话，人把这书卷交给识字的，说："请念吧！"他必回答："我不能念，因为它是密封的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的默示，你们看如封住的书卷，人将这书卷交给识字的，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不能念，因为是封住了。」
verses.textEnNiv: For you this whole vision is nothing but words sealed in a scroll. And if you give the scroll to someone who can read, and say, "Read this, please," they will answer, "I can’t; it is sealed."
verses.textEnEsv: And the vision of all this has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed. When men give it to one who can read, saying, "Read this," he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed."
verses.textEnNkjv: The whole vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is literate, saying, "Read this, please." And he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed."
verses.textEnNlt: All the future events in this vision are like a sealed book to them. When you give it to those who can read, they will say, "We can’t read it because it is sealed."
verses.textEnNasb: The entire vision will be to you like the words of a sealed book, which, when they give it to the one who is literate, saying, "Please read this," he will say, "I cannot, because it is sealed."
verses.textEn: For you this whole vision is nothing but words sealed in a scroll. And if you give the scroll to someone who can read, and say, "Read this, please," they will answer, "I can’t; it is sealed."

verses.textZh: 人又把这书卷交给不识字的人，说："请念吧！"他必回答："我不识字。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人又把这书卷交给不识字的人，说："请念吧！"他必回答："我不识字。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又将这书卷交给不识字的人，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不识字。」
verses.textEnNiv: Or if you give the scroll to someone who cannot read, and say, "Read this, please," they will answer, "I don’t know how to read."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they give the book to one who cannot read, saying, "Read this," he says, "I cannot read."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the book is delivered to one who is illiterate, saying, "Read this, please." And he says, "I am not literate."
verses.textEnNlt: When you give it to those who cannot read, they will say, "We don’t know how to read."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the book will be given to the one who is illiterate, saying, "Please read this." And he will say, "I cannot read."
verses.textEn: Or if you give the scroll to someone who cannot read, and say, "Read this, please," they will answer, "I don’t know how to read."

verses.textZh: 主说： "因为这子民只用言语来亲近我， 用嘴唇尊崇我， 他们的心却远离我。 他们对我的敬畏，只是遵从传统的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说： "因为这子民只用言语来亲近我， 用嘴唇尊崇我， 他们的心却远离我。 他们对我的敬畏，只是遵从传统的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：因为这百姓亲近我， 用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我； 他们敬畏我， 不过是领受人的吩咐。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord says: "These people come near to me with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. Their worship of me is based on merely human rules they have been taught.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said: "Because this people draw near with their mouth and honor me with their lips, while their hearts are far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord said: "Inasmuch as these people draw near with their mouths And honor Me with their lips, But have removed their hearts far from Me, And their fear toward Me is taught by the commandment of men,
verses.textEnNlt: And so the Lord says, "These people say they are mine. They honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. And their worship of me is nothing but man-made rules learned by rote.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "Because this people approaches Me with their words And honors Me with their lips, But their heart is far away from Me, And their reverence for Me consists of the commandment of men that is taught;
verses.textEn: The Lord says: "These people come near to me with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. Their worship of me is based on merely human rules they have been taught.

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪！我要再向这子民施行奇事， 就是奇妙又奇妙的事； 他们智慧人的智慧必要消没， 他们聪明人的聪明必被隐藏。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪！我要再向这子民施行奇事， 就是奇妙又奇妙的事； 他们智慧人的智慧必要消没， 他们聪明人的聪明必被隐藏。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我在这百姓中要行奇妙的事， 就是奇妙又奇妙的事。 他们智慧人的智慧必然消灭， 聪明人的聪明必然隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore once more I will astound these people with wonder upon wonder; the wisdom of the wise will perish, the intelligence of the intelligent will vanish."
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, I will again do wonderful things with this people, with wonder upon wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the discernment of their discerning men shall be hidden."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, behold, I will again do a marvelous work Among this people, A marvelous work and a wonder; For the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, And the understanding of their prudent men shall be hidden."
verses.textEnNlt: Because of this, I will once again astound these hypocrites with amazing wonders. The wisdom of the wise will pass away, and the intelligence of the intelligent will disappear."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore behold, I will once again deal marvelously with this people, wondrously marvelous; And the wisdom of their wise men will perish, And the understanding of their men who have understanding will be concealed."
verses.textEn: Therefore once more I will astound these people with wonder upon wonder; the wisdom of the wise will perish, the intelligence of the intelligent will vanish."

verses.textZh: 那些向耶和华深藏谋略的人，有祸了！ 他们在暗中行事，说： "谁看见我们？谁知道我们？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些向耶和华深藏谋略的人，有祸了！ 他们在暗中行事，说： "谁看见我们？谁知道我们？"
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些向耶和华深藏谋略的， 又在暗中行事，说： 谁看见我们呢？ 谁知道我们呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who go to great depths to hide their plans from the Lord , who do their work in darkness and think, "Who sees us? Who will know?"
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, you who hide deep from the Lord your counsel, whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, "Who sees us? Who knows us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who seek deep to hide their counsel far from the Lord, And their works are in the dark; They say, "Who sees us?" and, "Who knows us?"
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits those who try to hide their plans from the Lord , who do their evil deeds in the dark! "The Lord can’t see us," they say. "He doesn’t know what’s going on!"
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who deeply hide their plans from the Lord, And whose deeds are done in a dark place, And they say, "Who sees us?" or "Who knows us?"
verses.textEn: Woe to those who go to great depths to hide their plans from the Lord , who do their work in darkness and think, "Who sees us? Who will know?"

verses.textZh: 你们颠倒事理了！ 窑匠怎能被看作泥土呢？ 被造的怎能对造它的说："他没有造我"？ 制成品怎可对制成它的说："他不聪明"？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们颠倒事理了！ 窑匠怎能被看作泥土呢？ 被造的怎能对造它的说："他没有造我"？ 制成品怎可对制成它的说："他不聪明"？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们把事颠倒了， 岂可看窑匠如泥吗？ 被制作的物岂可论制作物的说： 他没有制作我？ 或是被创造的物论造物的说： 他没有聪明？
verses.textEnNiv: You turn things upside down, as if the potter were thought to be like the clay! Shall what is formed say to the one who formed it, "You did not make me"? Can the pot say to the potter, "You know nothing"?
verses.textEnEsv: You turn things upside down! Shall the potter be regarded as the clay, that the thing made should say of its maker, "He did not make me"; or the thing formed say of him who formed it, "He has no understanding"?
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely you have things turned around! Shall the potter be esteemed as the clay; For shall the thing made say of him who made it, "He did not make me"? Or shall the thing formed say of him who formed it, "He has no understanding"?
verses.textEnNlt: How foolish can you be? He is the Potter, and he is certainly greater than you, the clay! Should the created thing say of the one who made it, "He didn’t make me"? Does a jar ever say, "The potter who made me is stupid"?
verses.textEnNasb: You turn things around! Shall the potter be considered as equal with the clay, That what is made would say to its maker, "He did not make me"; Or what is formed say to him who formed it, "He has no understanding"?
verses.textEn: You turn things upside down, as if the potter were thought to be like the clay! Shall what is formed say to the one who formed it, "You did not make me"? Can the pot say to the potter, "You know nothing"?

verses.textZh: 不是还有一点点的时候， 黎巴嫩就要变为肥田， 肥田就要被看为树林吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是还有一点点的时候， 黎巴嫩就要变为肥田， 肥田就要被看为树林吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 黎巴嫩变为肥田， 肥田看如树林， 不是只有一点点时候吗？
verses.textEnNiv: In a very short time, will not Lebanon be turned into a fertile field and the fertile field seem like a forest?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it not yet a very little while until Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be regarded as a forest?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is it not yet a very little while Till Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, And the fruitful field be esteemed as a forest?
verses.textEnNlt: Soon—and it will not be very long— the forests of Lebanon will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will yield bountiful crops.
verses.textEnNasb: Is it not yet just a little while Before Lebanon will be turned into a fertile field, And the fertile field will be considered as a forest?
verses.textEn: In a very short time, will not Lebanon be turned into a fertile field and the fertile field seem like a forest?

verses.textZh: 到那日，聋子必听见这书卷上的话； 瞎子的眼，必在迷蒙黑暗中也能看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，聋子必听见这书卷上的话； 瞎子的眼，必在迷蒙黑暗中也能看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，聋子必听见这书上的话； 瞎子的眼必从迷蒙黑暗中得以看见。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book, and out of their gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind shall see.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day the deaf shall hear the words of the book, And the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the deaf will hear words read from a book, and the blind will see through the gloom and darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day those who are deaf will hear words of a book, And out of their gloom and darkness the eyes of those who are blind will see.
verses.textEn: In that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.

verses.textZh: 困苦的必因耶和华增添喜乐； 贫穷的人必因以色列的圣者而快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 困苦的必因耶和华增添喜乐； 贫穷的人必因以色列的圣者而快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 谦卑人必因耶和华增添欢喜； 人间贫穷的必因以色列的圣者快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more the humble will rejoice in the Lord ; the needy will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The meek shall obtain fresh joy in the Lord , and the poor among mankind shall exult in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The humble also shall increase their joy in the Lord, And the poor among men shall rejoice In the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The humble will be filled with fresh joy from the Lord . The poor will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The afflicted also will increase their joy in the Lord, And the needy of mankind will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Once more the humble will rejoice in the Lord ; the needy will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 因为强暴人归于无有，好讥笑人的必被灭绝； 所有意图行恶的，必被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为强暴人归于无有，好讥笑人的必被灭绝； 所有意图行恶的，必被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，强暴人已归无有， 亵慢人已经灭绝， 一切找机会作孽的都被剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: The ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who have an eye for evil will be cut down—
verses.textEnEsv: For the ruthless shall come to nothing and the scoffer cease, and all who watch to do evil shall be cut off,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the terrible one is brought to nothing, The scornful one is consumed, And all who watch for iniquity are cut off—
verses.textEnNlt: The scoffer will be gone, the arrogant will disappear, and those who plot evil will be killed.
verses.textEnNasb: For the ruthless will come to an end and the scorner will be finished, Indeed all who are intent on doing evil will be eliminated,
verses.textEn: The ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who have an eye for evil will be cut down—

verses.textZh: 他们只用一句话就定了人的罪， 又设下网罗来陷害城门口那执行裁判的， 用毫无根据的事屈枉义人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们只用一句话就定了人的罪， 又设下网罗来陷害城门口那执行裁判的， 用毫无根据的事屈枉义人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在争讼的事上定无罪的为有罪， 为城门口责备人的设下网罗， 用虚无的事屈枉义人。
verses.textEnNiv: those who with a word make someone out to be guilty, who ensnare the defender in court and with false testimony deprive the innocent of justice.
verses.textEnEsv: who by a word make a man out to be an offender, and lay a snare for him who reproves in the gate, and with an empty plea turn aside him who is in the right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who make a man an offender by a word, And lay a snare for him who reproves in the gate, And turn aside the just by empty words.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who convict the innocent by their false testimony will disappear. A similar fate awaits those who use trickery to pervert justice and who tell lies to destroy the innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: Who cause a person to be indicted by a word, And set a trap for the arbitrator at the gate, And defraud the one in the right with meaningless arguments.
verses.textEn: those who with a word make someone out to be guilty, who ensnare the defender in court and with false testimony deprive the innocent of justice.

verses.textZh: 因此，曾经救赎亚伯拉罕的耶和华，论到雅各家时，这样说： "雅各今后必不再羞愧，他的面容也不再变为苍白，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，曾经救赎亚伯拉罕的耶和华，论到雅各家时，这样说： "雅各今后必不再羞愧，他的面容也不再变为苍白，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，救赎亚伯拉罕的耶和华 论雅各家如此说： 雅各必不再羞愧， 面容也不致变色。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord , who redeemed Abraham, says to the descendants of Jacob: "No longer will Jacob be ashamed; no longer will their faces grow pale.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord , who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall no more be ashamed, no more shall his face grow pale.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall not now be ashamed, Nor shall his face now grow pale;
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord , who redeemed Abraham, says to the people of Israel, "My people will no longer be ashamed or turn pale with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob will not be ashamed now, nor will his face turn pale now;
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord , who redeemed Abraham, says to the descendants of Jacob: "No longer will Jacob be ashamed; no longer will their faces grow pale.

verses.textZh: 因为他看见了他的子孙在他中间， 就是我手所作的。 他们必尊我的名为圣， 必尊雅各的圣者为圣， 也必敬畏以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他看见了他的子孙在他中间， 就是我手所作的。 他们必尊我的名为圣， 必尊雅各的圣者为圣， 也必敬畏以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他看见他的众子， 就是我手的工作在他那里， 他们必尊我的名为圣， 必尊雅各的圣者为圣， 必敬畏以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: When they see among them their children, the work of my hands, they will keep my name holy; they will acknowledge the holiness of the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in his midst, they will sanctify my name; they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he sees his children, The work of My hands, in his midst, They will hallow My name, And hallow the Holy One of Jacob, And fear the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: For when they see their many children and all the blessings I have given them, they will recognize the holiness of the Holy One of Jacob. They will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he sees his children, the work of My hands, in his midst, They will sanctify My name; Indeed, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, And will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: When they see among them their children, the work of my hands, they will keep my name holy; they will acknowledge the holiness of the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

verses.textZhCnvs: 那些心中迷惑的，必明白真理， 那些发怨言的，必接受教训。"
verses.textZhCuv: 心中迷糊的必得明白； 发怨言的必受训诲。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are wayward in spirit will gain understanding; those who complain will accept instruction."
verses.textEnEsv: And those who go astray in spirit will come to understanding, and those who murmur will accept instruction."
verses.textEnNkjv: These also who erred in spirit will come to understanding, And those who complained will learn doctrine."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the wayward will gain understanding, and complainers will accept instruction.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who err in mind will know the truth, And those who criticize will accept instruction.
verses.textEn: Those who are wayward in spirit will gain understanding; those who complain will accept instruction."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "这些悖逆的儿女有祸了！ 他们实行计谋，却不是出于我的意思， 他们结盟，却不是出于我的灵， 以致罪上加罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "这些悖逆的儿女有祸了！ 他们实行计谋，却不是出于我的意思， 他们结盟，却不是出于我的灵， 以致罪上加罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 祸哉！这悖逆的儿女。 他们同谋，却不由于我， 结盟，却不由于我的灵， 以致罪上加罪；
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to the obstinate children," declares the Lord , "to those who carry out plans that are not mine, forming an alliance, but not by my Spirit, heaping sin upon sin;
verses.textEnEsv: "Ah, stubborn children," declares the Lord , "who carry out a plan, but not mine, and who make an alliance, but not of my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to the rebellious children," says the Lord, "Who take counsel, but not of Me, And who devise plans, but not of My Spirit, That they may add sin to sin;
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits my rebellious children," says the Lord . "You make plans that are contrary to mine. You make alliances not directed by my Spirit, thus piling up your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to the rebellious children," declares the Lord, "Who execute a plan, but not Mine, And make an alliance, but not of My Spirit, In order to add sin to sin;
verses.textEn: "Woe to the obstinate children," declares the Lord , "to those who carry out plans that are not mine, forming an alliance, but not by my Spirit, heaping sin upon sin;

verses.textZh: 他们起程下埃及去， 并没有求问我， 却要在法老的保护下，作避难处， 投靠在埃及的荫庇下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们起程下埃及去， 并没有求问我， 却要在法老的保护下，作避难处， 投靠在埃及的荫庇下。
verses.textZhCuv: 起身下埃及去，并没有求问我； 要靠法老的力量加添自己的力量， 并投在埃及的荫下。
verses.textEnNiv: who go down to Egypt without consulting me; who look for help to Pharaoh’s protection, to Egypt’s shade for refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: who set out to go down to Egypt, without asking for my direction, to take refuge in the protection of Pharaoh and to seek shelter in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.textEnNkjv: Who walk to go down to Egypt, And have not asked My advice, To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, And to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.textEnNlt: For without consulting me, you have gone down to Egypt for help. You have put your trust in Pharaoh’s protection. You have tried to hide in his shade.
verses.textEnNasb: Who proceed down to Egypt Without consulting Me, To take refuge in the safety of Pharaoh, And to seek shelter in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.textEn: who go down to Egypt without consulting me; who look for help to Pharaoh’s protection, to Egypt’s shade for refuge.

verses.textZh: 因此，法老的保护必成为你们的羞耻， 投靠在埃及的荫庇下，变成你们的耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，法老的保护必成为你们的羞耻， 投靠在埃及的荫庇下，变成你们的耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，法老的力量必作你们的羞辱； 投在埃及的荫下，要为你们的惭愧。
verses.textEnNiv: But Pharaoh’s protection will be to your shame, Egypt’s shade will bring you disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore shall the protection of Pharaoh turn to your shame, and the shelter in the shadow of Egypt to your humiliation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh Shall be your shame, And trust in the shadow of Egypt Shall be your humiliation.
verses.textEnNlt: But by trusting Pharaoh, you will be humiliated, and by depending on him, you will be disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore the safety of Pharaoh will be your shame, And the shelter in the shadow of Egypt, your humiliation.
verses.textEn: But Pharaoh’s protection will be to your shame, Egypt’s shade will bring you disgrace.

verses.textZh: 他们的领袖虽然已在琐安， 他们的使臣虽然已到达哈内斯，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的领袖虽然已在琐安， 他们的使臣虽然已到达哈内斯，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的首领已在琐安； 他们的使臣到了哈内斯。
verses.textEnNiv: Though they have officials in Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,
verses.textEnEsv: For though his officials are at Zoan and his envoys reach Hanes,
verses.textEnNkjv: For his princes were at Zoan, And his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.textEnNlt: For though his power extends to Zoan and his officials have arrived in Hanes,
verses.textEnNasb: "For their officials are at Zoan And their ambassadors arrive at Hanes.
verses.textEn: Though they have officials in Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,

verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们都必因那对于他们毫无利益的人民而蒙羞， 那人民带来的不是帮助或益处，而是羞耻和凌辱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必因那不利于他们的民蒙羞。 那民并非帮助，也非利益， 只作羞耻凌辱。
verses.textEnNiv: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them, who bring neither help nor advantage, but only shame and disgrace."
verses.textEnEsv: everyone comes to shame through a people that cannot profit them, that brings neither help nor profit, but shame and disgrace."
verses.textEnNkjv: They were all ashamed of a people who could not benefit them, Or be help or benefit, But a shame and also a reproach."
verses.textEnNlt: all who trust in him will be ashamed. He will not help you. Instead, he will disgrace you."
verses.textEnNasb: "Everyone will be ashamed because of a people who do not benefit them, Who are not a help or benefit, but a source of shame and also disgrace."
verses.textEn: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them, who bring neither help nor advantage, but only shame and disgrace."

verses.textZh: 以下是论南地野兽的默示： 他们把财富驮在驴驹的背上， 把宝物驮在骆驼的峰上， 经过艰难困苦之地， 就是公狮、母狮、蝮蛇和会飞的火蛇出没的地方， 到一个对他们毫无益处的民族那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是论南地野兽的默示： 他们把财富驮在驴驹的背上， 把宝物驮在骆驼的峰上， 经过艰难困苦之地， 就是公狮、母狮、蝮蛇和会飞的火蛇出没的地方， 到一个对他们毫无益处的民族那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 论南方牲畜的默示： 他们把财物驮在驴驹的脊背上， 将宝物驮在骆驼的肉鞍上， 经过艰难困苦之地， 就是公狮、母狮、蝮蛇、火焰的飞龙之地， 往那不利于他们的民那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy concerning the animals of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lions and lionesses, of adders and darting snakes, the envoys carry their riches on donkeys’ backs, their treasures on the humps of camels, to that unprofitable nation,
verses.textEnEsv: An oracle on the beasts of the Negeb. Through a land of trouble and anguish, from where come the lioness and the lion, the adder and the flying fiery serpent, they carry their riches on the backs of donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people that cannot profit them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against the beasts of the South. Through a land of trouble and anguish, From which came the lioness and lion, The viper and fiery flying serpent, They will carry their riches on the backs of young donkeys, And their treasures on the humps of camels, To a people who shall not profit;
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me concerning the animals in the Negev: The caravan moves slowly across the terrible desert to Egypt— donkeys weighed down with riches and camels loaded with treasure— all to pay for Egypt’s protection. They travel through the wilderness, a place of lionesses and lions, a place where vipers and poisonous snakes live. All this, and Egypt will give you nothing in return.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement concerning the animals of the Negev: Through a land of distress and anguish, From where come lioness and lion, viper and flying serpent, They carry their riches on the backs of young donkeys, And their treasures on camels’ humps, To a people who will not benefit them;
verses.textEn: A prophecy concerning the animals of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lions and lionesses, of adders and darting snakes, the envoys carry their riches on donkeys’ backs, their treasures on the humps of camels, to that unprofitable nation,

verses.textZh: 埃及的帮助是徒然的，是虚幻的， 因此我称它为"坐而不动的拉哈伯"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及的帮助是徒然的，是虚幻的， 因此我称它为"坐而不动的拉哈伯"。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及的帮助是徒然无益的； 所以我称她为「坐而不动的拉哈伯」。
verses.textEnNiv: to Egypt, whose help is utterly useless. Therefore I call her Rahab the Do-Nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Egypt’s help is worthless and empty; therefore I have called her "Rahab who sits still."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Egyptians shall help in vain and to no purpose. Therefore I have called her Rahab-Hem-Shebeth.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt’s promises are worthless! Therefore, I call her Rahab— the Harmless Dragon.
verses.textEnNasb: Even Egypt, whose help is vain and empty. Therefore, I have called her " Rahab who has been exterminated."
verses.textEn: to Egypt, whose help is utterly useless. Therefore I call her Rahab the Do-Nothing.

verses.textZh: 现在你去，在他们面前把这话刻在版上， 记在书卷上， 作日后的证据， 直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你去，在他们面前把这话刻在版上， 记在书卷上， 作日后的证据， 直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 现今你去， 在他们面前将这话刻在版上， 写在书上， 以便传留后世，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: Go now, write it on a tablet for them, inscribe it on a scroll, that for the days to come it may be an everlasting witness.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, go, write it before them on a tablet and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come as a witness forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, And note it on a scroll, That it may be for time to come, Forever and ever:
verses.textEnNlt: Now go and write down these words. Write them in a book. They will stand until the end of time as a witness
verses.textEnNasb: Now go, write it on a tablet in their presence And inscribe it on a scroll, That it may serve in the time to come As a witness forever.
verses.textEn: Go now, write it on a tablet for them, inscribe it on a scroll, that for the days to come it may be an everlasting witness.

verses.textZh: 因为这是悖逆的子民，不忠心的儿女， 不肯听从耶和华教导的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这是悖逆的子民，不忠心的儿女， 不肯听从耶和华教导的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们是悖逆的百姓、说谎的儿女， 不肯听从耶和华训诲的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: For these are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to listen to the Lord ’s instruction.
verses.textEnEsv: For they are a rebellious people, lying children, children unwilling to hear the instruction of the Lord ;
verses.textEnNkjv: That this is a rebellious people, Lying children, Children who will not hear the law of the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: that these people are stubborn rebels who refuse to pay attention to the Lord ’s instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is a rebellious people, false sons, Sons who refuse to listen To the instruction of the Lord;
verses.textEn: For these are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to listen to the Lord ’s instruction.

verses.textZh: 他们对先见说："你们不要再看异象！" 又对先知说："你们不要再向我说真确的预言！ 倒要向我说动听的话， 预言虚幻的事吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对先见说："你们不要再看异象！" 又对先知说："你们不要再向我说真确的预言！ 倒要向我说动听的话， 预言虚幻的事吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对先见说：不要望见不吉利的事， 对先知说：不要向我们讲正直的话； 要向我们说柔和的话， 言虚幻的事。
verses.textEnNiv: They say to the seers, "See no more visions!" and to the prophets, "Give us no more visions of what is right! Tell us pleasant things, prophesy illusions.
verses.textEnEsv: who say to the seers, "Do not see," and to the prophets, "Do not prophesy to us what is right; speak to us smooth things, prophesy illusions,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who say to the seers, "Do not see," And to the prophets, "Do not prophesy to us right things; Speak to us smooth things, prophesy deceits.
verses.textEnNlt: They tell the seers, "Stop seeing visions!" They tell the prophets, "Don’t tell us what is right. Tell us nice things. Tell us lies.
verses.textEnNasb: Who say to the seers, "You must not see visions"; And to the prophets, "You must not prophesy the truth to us. Speak to us pleasant words, Prophesy illusions.
verses.textEn: They say to the seers, "See no more visions!" and to the prophets, "Give us no more visions of what is right! Tell us pleasant things, prophesy illusions.

verses.textZh: 你们要离开正道，转离义路， 不要在我们面前再提以色列的圣者了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要离开正道，转离义路， 不要在我们面前再提以色列的圣者了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要离弃正道，偏离直路， 不要在我们面前再提说以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: Leave this way, get off this path, and stop confronting us with the Holy One of Israel!"
verses.textEnEsv: leave the way, turn aside from the path, let us hear no more about the Holy One of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Get out of the way, Turn aside from the path, Cause the Holy One of Israel To cease from before us."
verses.textEnNlt: Forget all this gloom. Get off your narrow path. Stop telling us about your ‘Holy One of Israel.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Get out of the way, turn aside from the path, Stop speaking before us about the Holy One of Israel!"
verses.textEn: Leave this way, get off this path, and stop confronting us with the Holy One of Israel!"

verses.textZh: 因此，以色列的圣者这样说： "因为你们弃绝了这话， 反而信赖欺压和乖僻的手段，更以此为倚靠，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，以色列的圣者这样说： "因为你们弃绝了这话， 反而信赖欺压和乖僻的手段，更以此为倚靠，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，以色列的圣者如此说： 因为你们藐视这训诲的话， 倚赖欺压和乖僻，以此为可靠的，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Because you have rejected this message, relied on oppression and depended on deceit,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel, "Because you despise this word and trust in oppression and perverseness and rely on them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: "Because you despise this word, And trust in oppression and perversity, And rely on them,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the reply of the Holy One of Israel: "Because you despise what I tell you and trust instead in oppression and lies,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Since you have rejected this word And have put your trust in oppression and crookedness, and have relied on them,
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Because you have rejected this message, relied on oppression and depended on deceit,

verses.textZh: 所以这罪孽对于你们， 必像一道有了裂缝，且凸了出来， 快要倒塌的高墙， 在顷刻之间，就突然倒塌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以这罪孽对于你们， 必像一道有了裂缝，且凸了出来， 快要倒塌的高墙， 在顷刻之间，就突然倒塌。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，这罪孽在你们身上， 好像将要破裂凸出来的高墙， 顷刻之间忽然坍塌；
verses.textEnNiv: this sin will become for you like a high wall, cracked and bulging, that collapses suddenly, in an instant.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach in a high wall, bulging out and about to collapse, whose breaking comes suddenly, in an instant;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you Like a breach ready to fall, A bulge in a high wall, Whose breaking comes suddenly, in an instant.
verses.textEnNlt: calamity will come upon you suddenly— like a bulging wall that bursts and falls. In an instant it will collapse and come crashing down.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this wrongdoing will be to you Like a breach about to fall, A bulge in a high wall, Whose collapse comes suddenly in an instant,
verses.textEn: this sin will become for you like a high wall, cracked and bulging, that collapses suddenly, in an instant.

verses.textZh: 它的倒塌好象窑匠的瓦器破碎一般， 毫不顾惜被彻底粉碎， 甚至在碎块中找不到一块， 可以用来从炉里取火， 或从池中舀水。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的倒塌好象窑匠的瓦器破碎一般， 毫不顾惜被彻底粉碎， 甚至在碎块中找不到一块， 可以用来从炉里取火， 或从池中舀水。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要被打碎，好像把窑匠的瓦器打碎， 毫不顾惜， 甚至碎块中找不到一片可用以从炉内取火， 从池中舀水。
verses.textEnNiv: It will break in pieces like pottery, shattered so mercilessly that among its pieces not a fragment will be found for taking coals from a hearth or scooping water out of a cistern."
verses.textEnEsv: and its breaking is like that of a potter’s vessel that is smashed so ruthlessly that among its fragments not a shard is found with which to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He shall break it like the breaking of the potter’s vessel, Which is broken in pieces; He shall not spare. So there shall not be found among its fragments A shard to take fire from the hearth, Or to take water from the cistern."
verses.textEnNlt: You will be smashed like a piece of pottery— shattered so completely that there won’t be a piece big enough to carry coals from a fireplace or a little water from the well."
verses.textEnNasb: Whose collapse is like the smashing of a potter’s jar, So ruthlessly shattered That a shard will not be found among its pieces To take fire from a hearth Or to scoop water from a cistern."
verses.textEn: It will break in pieces like pottery, shattered so mercilessly that among its pieces not a fragment will be found for taking coals from a hearth or scooping water out of a cistern."

verses.textZh: 因为主耶和华以色列的圣者这样说： "你们得救在于悔改和安息， 你们得力在于平静和信靠。" 但你们竟不愿意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主耶和华以色列的圣者这样说： "你们得救在于悔改和安息， 你们得力在于平静和信靠。" 但你们竟不愿意。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华－以色列的圣者曾如此说： 你们得救在乎归回安息； 你们得力在乎平静安稳； 你们竟自不肯。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord , the Holy One of Israel, says: "In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength, but you would have none of it.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus said the Lord God , the Holy One of Israel, "In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and in trust shall be your strength." But you were unwilling,
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel: "In returning and rest you shall be saved; In quietness and confidence shall be your strength." But you would not,
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord , the Holy One of Israel, says: "Only in returning to me and resting in me will you be saved. In quietness and confidence is your strength. But you would have none of it.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, has said: "In repentance and rest you will be saved, In quietness and trust is your strength." But you were not willing,
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord , the Holy One of Israel, says: "In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength, but you would have none of it.

verses.textZh: 你们却说："不！我们要骑马奔跑。" 所以你们真的要逃跑； 你们又说："我们要骑快马。" 所以那些追赶你们的，也必快速！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却说："不！我们要骑马奔跑。" 所以你们真的要逃跑； 你们又说："我们要骑快马。" 所以那些追赶你们的，也必快速！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却说：不然，我们要骑马奔走。 所以你们必然奔走； 又说：我们要骑飞快的牲口。 所以追赶你们的，也必飞快。
verses.textEnNiv: You said, ‘No, we will flee on horses.’ Therefore you will flee! You said, ‘We will ride off on swift horses.’ Therefore your pursuers will be swift!
verses.textEnEsv: and you said, "No! We will flee upon horses"; therefore you shall flee away; and, "We will ride upon swift steeds"; therefore your pursuers shall be swift.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you said, "No, for we will flee on horses"— Therefore you shall flee! And, "We will ride on swift horses"— Therefore those who pursue you shall be swift!
verses.textEnNlt: You said, ‘No, we will get our help from Egypt. They will give us swift horses for riding into battle.’ But the only swiftness you are going to see is the swiftness of your enemies chasing you!
verses.textEnNasb: And you said, "No, for we will flee on horses!" Therefore you shall flee! "And we will ride on swift horses!" Therefore those who pursue you shall be swift.
verses.textEn: You said, ‘No, we will flee on horses.’ Therefore you will flee! You said, ‘We will ride off on swift horses.’ Therefore your pursuers will be swift!

verses.textZh: 一个敌人就可以威吓你们一千个人， 若五个敌人威吓你们，你们都要逃跑了！ 以致你们所剩下的，必孤立如同山顶上的旗杆， 冈陵上的旗帜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个敌人就可以威吓你们一千个人， 若五个敌人威吓你们，你们都要逃跑了！ 以致你们所剩下的，必孤立如同山顶上的旗杆， 冈陵上的旗帜。
verses.textZhCuv: 一人叱喝，必令千人逃跑； 五人叱喝，你们都必逃跑； 以致剩下的，好像山顶的旗杆， 冈上的大旗。
verses.textEnNiv: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee away, till you are left like a flagstaff on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill."
verses.textEnEsv: A thousand shall flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you shall flee, till you are left like a flagstaff on the top of a mountain, like a signal on a hill.
verses.textEnNkjv: One thousand shallflee at the threat of one, At the threat of five you shall flee, Till you are left as a pole on top of a mountain And as a banner on a hill.
verses.textEnNlt: One of them will chase a thousand of you. Five of them will make all of you flee. You will be left like a lonely flagpole on a hill or a tattered banner on a distant mountaintop."
verses.textEnNasb: One thousand will flee at the threat of one man; You will flee at the threat of five, Until you are left like a signal post on a mountain top, And like a flag on a hill.
verses.textEn: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee away, till you are left like a flagstaff on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill."

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华必等候要恩待你们； 他必兴起来怜悯你们， 因为耶和华是公义的神。 等候他的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华必等候要恩待你们； 他必兴起来怜悯你们， 因为耶和华是公义的神。 等候他的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必然等候，要施恩给你们； 必然兴起，好怜悯你们。 因为耶和华是公平的神； 凡等候他的都是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: Yet the Lord longs to be gracious to you; therefore he will rise up to show you compassion. For the Lord is a God of justice. Blessed are all who wait for him!
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord waits to be gracious to you, and therefore he exalts himself to show mercy to you. For the Lord is a God of justice; blessed are all those who wait for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord will wait, that He may be gracious to you; And therefore He will be exalted, that He may have mercy on you. For the Lordis a God of justice; Blessed are all those who wait for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord must wait for you to come to him so he can show you his love and compassion. For the Lord is a faithful God. Blessed are those who wait for his help.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord longs to be gracious to you, And therefore He waits on high to have compassion on you. For the Lord is a God of justice; How blessed are all those who long for Him.
verses.textEn: Yet the Lord longs to be gracious to you; therefore he will rise up to show you compassion. For the Lord is a God of justice. Blessed are all who wait for him!

verses.textZh: 锡安的人民、耶路撒冷的居民哪！你们必不再哭泣。他必因你哀求的声音恩待你；他听见的时候，就必应允你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的人民、耶路撒冷的居民哪！你们必不再哭泣。他必因你哀求的声音恩待你；他听见的时候，就必应允你。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓必在锡安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不再哭泣。主必因你哀求的声音施恩给你；他听见的时候就必应允你。
verses.textEnNiv: People of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. How gracious he will be when you cry for help! As soon as he hears, he will answer you.
verses.textEnEsv: For a people shall dwell in Zion, in Jerusalem; you shall weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the sound of your cry. As soon as he hears it, he answers you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem; You shall weep no more. He will be very gracious to you at the sound of your cry; When He hears it, He will answer you.
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will be gracious if you ask for help. He will surely respond to the sound of your cries.
verses.textEnNasb: For, you people in Zion, inhabitant in Jerusalem, you will weep no longer. He will certainly be gracious to you at the sound of your cry; when He hears it, He will answer you.
verses.textEn: People of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. How gracious he will be when you cry for help! As soon as he hears, he will answer you.

verses.textZh: 主虽然以艰难给你们当食物，以困迫给你们当水，但你的教师必不再隐藏；你必亲眼看见你的教师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主虽然以艰难给你们当食物，以困迫给你们当水，但你的教师必不再隐藏；你必亲眼看见你的教师。
verses.textZhCuv: 主虽然以艰难给你当饼，以困苦给你当水，你的教师却不再隐藏；你眼必看见你的教师。
verses.textEnNiv: Although the Lord gives you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, your teachers will be hidden no more; with your own eyes you will see them.
verses.textEnEsv: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your Teacher will not hide himself anymore, but your eyes shall see your Teacher.
verses.textEnNkjv: And though the Lord gives you The bread of adversity and the water of affliction, Yet your teachers will not be moved into a corner anymore, But your eyes shall see your teachers.
verses.textEnNlt: Though the Lord gave you adversity for food and suffering for drink, he will still be with you to teach you. You will see your teacher with your own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: Although the Lord has given you bread of deprivation and water of oppression, He, your Teacher, will no longer hide Himself, but your eyes will see your Teacher.
verses.textEn: Although the Lord gives you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, your teachers will be hidden no more; with your own eyes you will see them.

verses.textZh: 每当你偏左或偏右的时候，你必听见后面有声音说："这是正路，要行在其中！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 每当你偏左或偏右的时候，你必听见后面有声音说："这是正路，要行在其中！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你或向左或向右，你必听见后边有声音说：「这是正路，要行在其间。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, "This is the way; walk in it."
verses.textEnEsv: And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, "This is the way, walk in it," when you turn to the right or when you turn to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, "This is the way, walk in it," Whenever you turn to the right hand Or whenever you turn to the left.
verses.textEnNlt: Your own ears will hear him. Right behind you a voice will say, "This is the way you should go," whether to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnNasb: Your ears will hear a word behind you, saying, "This is the way, walk in it," whenever you turn to the right or to the left.
verses.textEn: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, "This is the way; walk in it."

verses.textZh: 你要拋弃你那些包着银的雕像和镀了金的铸像，如同污秽之物一般拋弃它们，又对它们说："去吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拋弃你那些包着银的雕像和镀了金的铸像，如同污秽之物一般拋弃它们，又对它们说："去吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你雕刻偶像所包的银子和铸造偶像所镀的金子，你要玷污，要抛弃，好像污秽之物，对偶像说：「去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will desecrate your idols overlaid with silver and your images covered with gold; you will throw them away like a menstrual cloth and say to them, "Away with you!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will defile your carved idols overlaid with silver and your gold-plated metal images. You will scatter them as unclean things. You will say to them, "Be gone!"
verses.textEnNkjv: You will also defile the covering of your images of silver, And the ornament of your molded images of gold. You will throw them away as an unclean thing; You will say to them, "Get away!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will destroy all your silver idols and your precious gold images. You will throw them out like filthy rags, saying to them, "Good riddance!"
verses.textEnNasb: And you will desecrate your carved images plated with silver, and your cast metal images plated with gold. You will scatter them as a filthy thing, and say to them, "Be gone!"
verses.textEn: Then you will desecrate your idols overlaid with silver and your images covered with gold; you will throw them away like a menstrual cloth and say to them, "Away with you!"

verses.textZh: 你撒在地里的种子，主必降雨在其上，并且使你地里所出产的粮食，既丰盛又肥美。到那日，你的牲畜必在宽阔的草场上吃草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你撒在地里的种子，主必降雨在其上，并且使你地里所出产的粮食，既丰盛又肥美。到那日，你的牲畜必在宽阔的草场上吃草。
verses.textZhCuv: 你将种子撒在地里，主必降雨在其上，并使地所出的粮肥美丰盛。到那时，你的牲畜必在宽阔的草场吃草。
verses.textEnNiv: He will also send you rain for the seed you sow in the ground, and the food that comes from the land will be rich and plentiful. In that day your cattle will graze in broad meadows.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will give rain for the seed with which you sow the ground, and bread, the produce of the ground, which will be rich and plenteous. In that day your livestock will graze in large pastures,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He will give the rain for your seed With which you sow the ground, And bread of the increase of the earth; It will be fat and plentiful. In that day your cattle will feed In large pastures.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will bless you with rain at planting time. There will be wonderful harvests and plenty of pastureland for your livestock.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He will give you rain for your seed which you will sow in the ground, and bread from the yield of the ground, and it will be rich and plentiful; on that day your livestock will graze in a wide pasture.
verses.textEn: He will also send you rain for the seed you sow in the ground, and the food that comes from the land will be rich and plentiful. In that day your cattle will graze in broad meadows.

verses.textZh: 耕地的牛和驴驹必吃加盐的饲料，就是用铲和叉所扬净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耕地的牛和驴驹必吃加盐的饲料，就是用铲和叉所扬净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耕地的牛和驴驹必吃加盐的料；这料是用木杴和杈子扬净的。
verses.textEnNiv: The oxen and donkeys that work the soil will eat fodder and mash, spread out with fork and shovel.
verses.textEnEsv: and the oxen and the donkeys that work the ground will eat seasoned fodder, which has been winnowed with shovel and fork.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise the oxen and the young donkeys that work the ground Will eat cured fodder, Which has been winnowed with the shovel and fan.
verses.textEnNlt: The oxen and donkeys that till the ground will eat good grain, its chaff blown away by the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the oxen and the donkeys that work the ground will eat seasoned feed, which has been winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.
verses.textEn: The oxen and donkeys that work the soil will eat fodder and mash, spread out with fork and shovel.

verses.textZh: 在大行杀戮的日子，高台倒塌的时候，各高山冈陵都必有溪水涌流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在大行杀戮的日子，高台倒塌的时候，各高山冈陵都必有溪水涌流。
verses.textZhCuv: 在大行杀戮的日子，高台倒塌的时候，各高山冈陵必有川流河涌。
verses.textEnNiv: In the day of great slaughter, when the towers fall, streams of water will flow on every high mountain and every lofty hill.
verses.textEnEsv: And on every lofty mountain and every high hill there will be brooks running with water, in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: There will be on every high mountain And on every high hill Rivers and streams of waters, In the day of the great slaughter, When the towers fall.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day, when your enemies are slaughtered and the towers fall, there will be streams of water flowing down every mountain and hill.
verses.textEnNasb: And on every lofty mountain and every high hill there will be streams running with water on the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.textEn: In the day of great slaughter, when the towers fall, streams of water will flow on every high mountain and every lofty hill.

verses.textZh: 耶和华包扎他子民的伤口，医治他们伤痕的日子，月亮的光必像太阳的光；太阳的光必增加七倍，像七日的光一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华包扎他子民的伤口，医治他们伤痕的日子，月亮的光必像太阳的光；太阳的光必增加七倍，像七日的光一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华缠裹他百姓的损处，医治他民鞭伤的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The moon will shine like the sun, and the sunlight will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven full days, when the Lord binds up the bruises of his people and heals the wounds he inflicted.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day when the Lord binds up the brokenness of his people, and heals the wounds inflicted by his blow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, And the light of the sun will be sevenfold, As the light of seven days, In the day that the Lord binds up the bruise of His people And heals the stroke of their wound.
verses.textEnNlt: The moon will be as bright as the sun, and the sun will be seven times brighter—like the light of seven days in one! So it will be when the Lord begins to heal his people and cure the wounds he gave them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the light of the full moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, on the day the Lord binds up the fracture of His people and heals the wound He has inflicted.
verses.textEn: The moon will shine like the sun, and the sunlight will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven full days, when the Lord binds up the bruises of his people and heals the wounds he inflicted.

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华的名从远方而来， 他的怒气烧起，浓烟上腾； 他的嘴唇充满忿怒， 他的舌头像吞灭的火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华的名从远方而来， 他的怒气烧起，浓烟上腾； 他的嘴唇充满忿怒， 他的舌头像吞灭的火。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华的名从远方来， 怒气烧起，密烟上腾。 他的嘴唇满有忿恨； 他的舌头像吞灭的火。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Name of the Lord comes from afar, with burning anger and dense clouds of smoke; his lips are full of wrath, and his tongue is a consuming fire.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the name of the Lord comes from afar, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke; his lips are full of fury, and his tongue is like a devouring fire;
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the name of the Lord comes from afar, Burning with His anger, And His burden is heavy; His lips are full of indignation, And His tongue like a devouring fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The Lord is coming from far away, burning with anger, surrounded by thick, rising smoke. His lips are filled with fury; his words consume like fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the name of the Lord comes from a remote place; His anger is burning and dense with smoke; His lips are filled with indignation, And His tongue is like a consuming fire;
verses.textEn: See, the Name of the Lord comes from afar, with burning anger and dense clouds of smoke; his lips are full of wrath, and his tongue is a consuming fire.

verses.textZh: 他的气息如涨溢的河水， 直涨到颈项， 并要用毁灭的筛把列国筛净， 又在众民口中放入使人步向灭亡的嚼环。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的气息如涨溢的河水， 直涨到颈项， 并要用毁灭的筛把列国筛净， 又在众民口中放入使人步向灭亡的嚼环。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的气如涨溢的河水，直涨到颈项， 要用毁灭的筛箩筛净列国， 并且在众民的口中必有使人错行的嚼环。
verses.textEnNiv: His breath is like a rushing torrent, rising up to the neck. He shakes the nations in the sieve of destruction; he places in the jaws of the peoples a bit that leads them astray.
verses.textEnEsv: his breath is like an overflowing stream that reaches up to the neck; to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction, and to place on the jaws of the peoples a bridle that leads astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: His breath is like an overflowing stream, Which reaches up to the neck, To sift the nations with the sieve of futility; And thereshallbe a bridle in the jaws of the people, Causing them to err.
verses.textEnNlt: His hot breath pours out like a flood up to the neck of his enemies. He will sift out the proud nations for destruction. He will bridle them and lead them away to ruin.
verses.textEnNasb: His breath is like an overflowing river, Which reaches to the neck, To shake the nations back and forth in a sieve, And to put in the jaws of the peoples the bridle which leads astray.
verses.textEn: His breath is like a rushing torrent, rising up to the neck. He shakes the nations in the sieve of destruction; he places in the jaws of the peoples a bit that leads them astray.

verses.textZh: 你们却必歌唱，好象守圣节的夜间一样； 你们必心里喜乐，好象吹着笛行走的人， 必上耶和华的山，到以色列的盘石那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却必歌唱，好象守圣节的夜间一样； 你们必心里喜乐，好象吹着笛行走的人， 必上耶和华的山，到以色列的盘石那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必唱歌，像守圣节的夜间一样，并且心中喜乐，像人吹笛，上耶和华的山，到以色列的磐石那里。
verses.textEnNiv: And you will sing as on the night you celebrate a holy festival; your hearts will rejoice as when people playing pipes go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the Rock of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall have a song as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one sets out to the sound of the flute to go to the mountain of the Lord , to the Rock of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall have a song As in the night when a holy festival is kept, And gladness of heart as when one goes with a flute, To come into the mountain of the Lord, To the Mighty One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of God will sing a song of joy, like the songs at the holy festivals. You will be filled with joy, as when a flutist leads a group of pilgrims to Jerusalem, the mountain of the Lord — to the Rock of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: You will have songs as in the night when you keep the festival, And gladness of heart as when one marches to the sound of the flute, To go to the mountain of the Lord, to the Rock of Israel.
verses.textEn: And you will sing as on the night you celebrate a holy festival; your hearts will rejoice as when people playing pipes go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the Rock of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使人听见他威严的声音， 在烈怒、吞灭一切火焰、 大雨、暴风和冰雹之中， 又使人看见他那降下来的膀臂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使人听见他威严的声音， 在烈怒、吞灭一切火焰、 大雨、暴风和冰雹之中， 又使人看见他那降下来的膀臂。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使人听他威严的声音，又显他降罚的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，并吞灭的火焰与霹雷、暴风、冰雹。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will cause people to hear his majestic voice and will make them see his arm coming down with raging anger and consuming fire, with cloudburst, thunderstorm and hail.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will cause his majestic voice to be heard and the descending blow of his arm to be seen, in furious anger and a flame of devouring fire, with a cloudburst and storm and hailstones.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will cause His glorious voice to be heard, And show the descent of His arm, With the indignation of His anger And the flame of a devouring fire, With scattering, tempest, and hailstones.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord will make his majestic voice heard. He will display the strength of his mighty arm. It will descend with devouring flames, with cloudbursts, thunderstorms, and huge hailstones.
