verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will cause His voice of authority to be heard, And the descending of His arm to be seen in fierce anger, And in the flame of a consuming fire In cloudburst, downpour, and hailstones.
verses.textEn: The Lord will cause people to hear his majestic voice and will make them see his arm coming down with raging anger and consuming fire, with cloudburst, thunderstorm and hail.

verses.textZh: 亚述人必因耶和华的声音惊惶； 耶和华要用杖击打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述人必因耶和华的声音惊惶； 耶和华要用杖击打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述人必因耶和华的声音惊惶；耶和华必用杖击打他。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord will shatter Assyria; with his rod he will strike them down.
verses.textEnEsv: The Assyrians will be terror-stricken at the voice of the Lord , when he strikes with his rod.
verses.textEnNkjv: For through the voice of the Lord Assyria will be beaten down, As He strikes with the rod.
verses.textEnNlt: At the Lord ’s command, the Assyrians will be shattered. He will strike them down with his royal scepter.
verses.textEnNasb: For at the voice of the Lord Assyria will be terrified, When He strikes with the rod.
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord will shatter Assyria; with his rod he will strike them down.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必把刑罚的杖加在他们身上， 每打一下， 都有击鼓和弹琴的声音； 耶和华在争战的时候，必挥动着手与他们争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必把刑罚的杖加在他们身上， 每打一下， 都有击鼓和弹琴的声音； 耶和华在争战的时候，必挥动着手与他们争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必将命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必击鼓弹琴。打杖的时候，耶和华必抡起手来，与他交战。
verses.textEnNiv: Every stroke the Lord lays on them with his punishing club will be to the music of timbrels and harps, as he fights them in battle with the blows of his arm.
verses.textEnEsv: And every stroke of the appointed staff that the Lord lays on them will be to the sound of tambourines and lyres. Battling with brandished arm, he will fight with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in every place where the staff of punishment passes, Which the Lord lays on him, It will be with tambourines and harps; And in battles of brandishing He will fight with it.
verses.textEnNlt: And as the Lord strikes them with his rod of punishment, his people will celebrate with tambourines and harps. Lifting his mighty arm, he will fight the Assyrians.
verses.textEnNasb: And every blow of the rod of punishment, Which the Lord will lay on him, Will be with the music of tambourines and lyres; And in battles, brandishing weapons, He will fight them.
verses.textEn: Every stroke the Lord lays on them with his punishing club will be to the music of timbrels and harps, as he fights them in battle with the blows of his arm.

verses.textZh: 因为陀斐特那烧着的火早已安排好了， 是为君王预备的， 又深又宽； 其中所堆的，是火和许多的柴； 耶和华的气像一股硫磺火，把它燃点起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为陀斐特那烧着的火早已安排好了， 是为君王预备的， 又深又宽； 其中所堆的，是火和许多的柴； 耶和华的气像一股硫磺火，把它燃点起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来陀斐特又深又宽，早已为王预备好了；其中堆的是火与许多木柴。耶和华的气如一股硫磺火使他着起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its fire pit has been made deep and wide, with an abundance of fire and wood; the breath of the Lord , like a stream of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.
verses.textEnEsv: For a burning place has long been prepared; indeed, for the king it is made ready, its pyre made deep and wide, with fire and wood in abundance; the breath of the Lord , like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Tophet was established of old, Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made it deep and large; Its pyre is fire with much wood; The breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, Kindles it.
verses.textEnNlt: Topheth—the place of burning— has long been ready for the Assyrian king; the pyre is piled high with wood. The breath of the Lord , like fire from a volcano, will set it ablaze.
verses.textEnNasb: For Topheth has long been ready, Indeed, it has been prepared for the king. He has made it deep and large, A pyre of fire with plenty of wood; The breath of the Lord, like a torrent of brimstone, sets it afire.
verses.textEn: Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its fire pit has been made deep and wide, with an abundance of fire and wood; the breath of the Lord , like a stream of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.

verses.textZh: 那些下埃及求帮助， 倚靠马匹， 倚靠众多战车， 依靠十分强壮的马兵， 却不仰望以色列的圣者，也不求问耶和华的，有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些下埃及求帮助， 倚靠马匹， 倚靠众多战车， 依靠十分强壮的马兵， 却不仰望以色列的圣者，也不求问耶和华的，有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！那些下埃及求帮助的， 是因仗赖马匹，倚靠甚多的车辆， 并倚靠强壮的马兵， 却不仰望以色列的圣者， 也不求问耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in the multitude of their chariots and in the great strength of their horsemen, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel, or seek help from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on horses, who trust in chariots because they are many and in horsemen because they are very strong, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel or consult the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, And rely on horses, Who trust in chariots because theyare many, And in horsemen because they are very strong, But who do not look to the Holy One of Israel, Nor seek the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits those who look to Egypt for help, trusting their horses, chariots, and charioteers and depending on the strength of human armies instead of looking to the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help And rely on horses, And trust in chariots because they are many And in horsemen because they are very strong, But they do not look to the Holy One of Israel, nor seek the Lord!
verses.textEn: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in the multitude of their chariots and in the great strength of their horsemen, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel, or seek help from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华是智慧的，他必降下灾祸， 决不收回自己的话， 却要起来攻击作恶者之家， 又攻击那些助人作孽的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是智慧的，他必降下灾祸， 决不收回自己的话， 却要起来攻击作恶者之家， 又攻击那些助人作孽的。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实，耶和华有智慧； 他必降灾祸， 并不反悔自己的话， 却要兴起攻击那作恶之家， 又攻击那作孽帮助人的。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he too is wise and can bring disaster; he does not take back his words. He will rise up against that wicked nation, against those who help evildoers.
verses.textEnEsv: And yet he is wise and brings disaster; he does not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers and against the helpers of those who work iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He also is wise and will bring disaster, And will not call back His words, But will arise against the house of evildoers, And against the help of those who work iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: In his wisdom, the Lord will send great disaster; he will not change his mind. He will rise against the wicked and against their helpers.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet He also is wise and will bring disaster, And does not retract His words, But will arise against the house of evildoers, And against the help of the workers of injustice.
verses.textEn: Yet he too is wise and can bring disaster; he does not take back his words. He will rise up against that wicked nation, against those who help evildoers.

verses.textZh: 埃及人是人，并不是神； 他们的马匹是血肉，并不是灵； 耶和华一伸手， 那帮助人的就绊倒， 那受帮助的也必仆倒， 并且一同灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人是人，并不是神； 他们的马匹是血肉，并不是灵； 耶和华一伸手， 那帮助人的就绊倒， 那受帮助的也必仆倒， 并且一同灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人不过是人，并不是神； 他们的马不过是血肉，并不是灵。 耶和华一伸手，那帮助人的必绊跌， 那受帮助的也必跌倒，都一同灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Egyptians are mere mortals and not God; their horses are flesh and not spirit. When the Lord stretches out his hand, those who help will stumble, those who are helped will fall; all will perish together.
verses.textEnEsv: The Egyptians are man, and not God, and their horses are flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord stretches out his hand, the helper will stumble, and he who is helped will fall, and they will all perish together.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; And their horses are flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord stretches out His hand, Both he who helps will fall, And he who is helped will fall down; They all will perish together.
verses.textEnNlt: For these Egyptians are mere humans, not God! Their horses are puny flesh, not mighty spirits! When the Lord raises his fist against them, those who help will stumble, and those being helped will fall. They will all fall down and die together.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Egyptians are human and not God, And their horses are flesh and not spirit; So the Lord will stretch out His hand, And any helper will stumble, And one who is helped will fall. And all of them will come to an end together.
verses.textEn: But the Egyptians are mere mortals and not God; their horses are flesh and not spirit. When the Lord stretches out his hand, those who help will stumble, those who are helped will fall; all will perish together.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华对我这样说： "狮子和少壮狮子怎样因捕获猎物而咆哮， 虽然召集了许多的牧人来攻击牠们， 牠们并不因他们的声音而惊慌， 也不因他们的喧嚷而蹲伏； 照样，万军之耶和华必降临在锡安山和它的冈陵上争战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华对我这样说： "狮子和少壮狮子怎样因捕获猎物而咆哮， 虽然召集了许多的牧人来攻击牠们， 牠们并不因他们的声音而惊慌， 也不因他们的喧嚷而蹲伏； 照样，万军之耶和华必降临在锡安山和它的冈陵上争战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我如此说： 狮子和少壮狮子护食咆哮， 就是喊许多牧人来攻击它， 它总不因他们的声音惊惶， 也不因他们的喧哗缩伏。 如此，万军之耶和华 也必降临在锡安山冈上争战。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to me: "As a lion growls, a great lion over its prey— and though a whole band of shepherds is called together against it, it is not frightened by their shouts or disturbed by their clamor— so the Lord Almighty will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and on its heights.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus the Lord said to me, "As a lion or a young lion growls over his prey, and when a band of shepherds is called out against him he is not terrified by their shouting or daunted at their noise, so the Lord of hosts will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its hill.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus the Lord has spoken to me: "As a lion roars, And a young lion over his prey (When a multitude of shepherds is summoned against him, He will not be afraid of their voice Nor be disturbed by their noise), So the Lord of hosts will come down To fight for Mount Zion and for its hill.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what the Lord has told me: "When a strong young lion stands growling over a sheep it has killed, it is not frightened by the shouts and noise of a whole crowd of shepherds. In the same way, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says to me: "As the lion or the young lion growls over his prey, Against which a band of shepherds is called out, And he will not be terrified at their voice nor disturbed at their noise, So will the Lord of armies come down to wage war on Mount Zion and on its hill."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to me: "As a lion growls, a great lion over its prey— and though a whole band of shepherds is called together against it, it is not frightened by their shouts or disturbed by their clamor— so the Lord Almighty will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and on its heights.

verses.textZh: 雀鸟怎样搧翅护雏，万军之耶和华也必照样保护耶路撒冷， 他必保护和拯救， 他必越过和搭救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雀鸟怎样搧翅护雏，万军之耶和华也必照样保护耶路撒冷， 他必保护和拯救， 他必越过和搭救。
verses.textZhCuv: 雀鸟怎样搧翅覆雏， 万军之耶和华也要照样保护耶路撒冷。 他必保护拯救， 要越门保守。
verses.textEnNiv: Like birds hovering overhead, the Lord Almighty will shield Jerusalem; he will shield it and deliver it, he will ‘pass over’ it and will rescue it."
verses.textEnEsv: Like birds hovering, so the Lord of hosts will protect Jerusalem; he will protect and deliver it; he will spare and rescue it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Like birds flying about, So will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem. Defending, He will also deliver it; Passing over, He will preserve it."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies will hover over Jerusalem and protect it like a bird protecting its nest. He will defend and save the city; he will pass over it and rescue it."
verses.textEnNasb: Like flying birds so the Lord of armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and save it; He will pass over and rescue it.
verses.textEn: Like birds hovering overhead, the Lord Almighty will shield Jerusalem; he will shield it and deliver it, he will ‘pass over’ it and will rescue it."

verses.textZh: 以色列人哪！你们要回转，归向那曾被你们 彻底背弃的耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人哪！你们要回转，归向那曾被你们 彻底背弃的耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哪，你们深深地悖逆耶和华，现今要归向他。
verses.textEnNiv: Return, you Israelites, to the One you have so greatly revolted against.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn to him from whom people have deeply revolted, O children of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Return toHim against whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.textEnNlt: Though you are such wicked rebels, my people, come and return to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Return to Him against whom you have been profoundly obstinate, you sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Return, you Israelites, to the One you have so greatly revolted against.

verses.textZh: 到那日，各人都必拋弃 自己的金偶像和银偶像， 就是你们亲手所做，把自己陷在罪中的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，各人都必拋弃 自己的金偶像和银偶像， 就是你们亲手所做，把自己陷在罪中的。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，各人必将他金偶像银偶像，就是亲手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都抛弃了。
verses.textEnNiv: For in that day every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold your sinful hands have made.
verses.textEnEsv: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold, which your hands have sinfully made for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in that day every man shall throw away his idols of silver and his idols of gold— sin, which your own hands have made for yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: I know the glorious day will come when each of you will throw away the gold idols and silver images your sinful hands have made.
verses.textEnNasb: For on that day every person will reject his silver idols and his gold idols, which your hands have made for you as a sin.
verses.textEn: For in that day every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold your sinful hands have made.

verses.textZh: 亚述人必倒在刀下，不是人的刀； 必有刀把他们吞灭，也不是人的刀。 他们必不能逃避刀剑， 他们的年轻人必作苦工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述人必倒在刀下，不是人的刀； 必有刀把他们吞灭，也不是人的刀。 他们必不能逃避刀剑， 他们的年轻人必作苦工。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述人必倒在刀下，并非人的刀； 有刀要将他吞灭，并非人的刀。 他必逃避这刀； 他的少年人必成为服苦的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Assyria will fall by no human sword; a sword, not of mortals, will devour them. They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: "And the Assyrian shall fall by a sword, not of man; and a sword, not of man, shall devour him; and he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be put to forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then Assyria shall fall by a sword not of man, And a sword not of mankind shall devour him. But he shall flee from the sword, And his young men shall become forced labor.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Assyrians will be destroyed, but not by the swords of men. The sword of God will strike them, and they will panic and flee. The strong young Assyrians will be taken away as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Assyrian will fall by a sword not wielded by a man, And a sword not of man will devour him. So he will not escape the sword, And his young men will become forced laborers.
verses.textEn: "Assyria will fall by no human sword; a sword, not of mortals, will devour them. They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor.

verses.textZh: 他们的盘石必因惊慌而挪去， 他们的领袖必因见到以色列的旗帜而惊惶。 这是那有火在锡安，有炉在耶路撒冷的耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的盘石必因惊慌而挪去， 他们的领袖必因见到以色列的旗帜而惊惶。 这是那有火在锡安，有炉在耶路撒冷的耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的磐石必因惊吓挪去； 他的首领必因大旗惊惶。 这是那有火在锡安、 有炉在耶路撒冷的耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their stronghold will fall because of terror; at the sight of the battle standard their commanders will panic," declares the Lord , whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: His rock shall pass away in terror, and his officers desert the standard in panic," declares the Lord , whose fire is in Zion, and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall cross over to his stronghold for fear, And his princes shall be afraid of the banner," Says the Lord, Whose fire is in Zion And whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the strongest will quake with terror, and princes will flee when they see your battle flags," says the Lord , whose fire burns in Zion, whose flame blazes from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "His rock will pass away because of panic, And his officers will be terrified by the flag," Declares the Lord, whose fire is in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Their stronghold will fall because of terror; at the sight of the battle standard their commanders will panic," declares the Lord , whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 看哪！必有一王凭公义执政， 必有众领袖按公平治理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！必有一王凭公义执政， 必有众领袖按公平治理。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，必有一王凭公义行政； 必有首领藉公平掌权。
verses.textEnNiv: See, a king will reign in righteousness and rulers will rule with justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule in justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, And princes will rule with justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, a righteous king is coming! And honest princes will rule under him.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, a king will reign righteously, And officials will rule justly.
verses.textEn: See, a king will reign in righteousness and rulers will rule with justice.

verses.textZh: 必有一人像避风所， 和避暴雨的隐密处， 像干旱之地的溪水， 又像疲乏之地的大盘石的阴影。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有一人像避风所， 和避暴雨的隐密处， 像干旱之地的溪水， 又像疲乏之地的大盘石的阴影。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有一人像避风所和避暴雨的隐密处， 又像河流在干旱之地， 像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Each one will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a thirsty land.
verses.textEnEsv: Each will be like a hiding place from the wind, a shelter from the storm, like streams of water in a dry place, like the shade of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man will be as a hiding place from the wind, And a cover from the tempest, As rivers of water in a dry place, As the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.textEnNlt: Each one will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a parched land.
verses.textEnNasb: Each will be like a refuge from the wind And a shelter from the storm, Like streams of water in a dry country, Like the shade of a huge rock in an exhausted land.
verses.textEn: Each one will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a thirsty land.

verses.textZh: 那时，能看见事物者的眼睛，必不再昏暗； 能听到事物者的耳朵，必然倾听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，能看见事物者的眼睛，必不再昏暗； 能听到事物者的耳朵，必然倾听。
verses.textZhCuv: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷； 能听的人，耳必得听闻。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the eyes of those who see will not be closed, and the ears of those who hear will give attention.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, And the ears of those who hear will listen.
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone who has eyes will be able to see the truth, and everyone who has ears will be able to hear it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the eyes of those who see will not be blinded, And the ears of those who hear will listen.
verses.textEn: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

verses.textZh: 性急者的心必明白知识， 口吃者的舌头必说话清楚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 性急者的心必明白知识， 口吃者的舌头必说话清楚。
verses.textZhCuv: 冒失人的心必明白知识； 结巴人的舌必说话通快。
verses.textEnNiv: The fearful heart will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will be fluent and clear.
verses.textEnEsv: The heart of the hasty will understand and know, and the tongue of the stammerers will hasten to speak distinctly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the heart of the rash will understand knowledge, And the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the hotheads will be full of sense and understanding. Those who stammer will speak out plainly.
verses.textEnNasb: The mind of the rash will discern the truth, And the tongue of the stammerers will hurry to speak clearly.
verses.textEn: The fearful heart will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will be fluent and clear.

verses.textZh: 愚顽人不再被称为高尚， 恶棍也不再被称为大方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚顽人不再被称为高尚， 恶棍也不再被称为大方。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚顽人不再称为高明； 吝啬人不再称为大方。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will the fool be called noble nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
verses.textEnEsv: The fool will no more be called noble, nor the scoundrel said to be honorable.
verses.textEnNkjv: The foolish person will no longer be called generous, Nor the miser said tobe bountiful;
verses.textEnNlt: In that day ungodly fools will not be heroes. Scoundrels will not be respected.
verses.textEnNasb: No longer will the fool be called noble, Or the rogue be spoken of as generous.
verses.textEn: No longer will the fool be called noble nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

verses.textZh: 因为愚顽人说的是愚顽话， 他心里所想的是罪孽， 惯行亵渎神的事，说错谬的话攻击耶和华， 使饥饿的人仍空着肚子， 使口渴的人仍无水可喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为愚顽人说的是愚顽话， 他心里所想的是罪孽， 惯行亵渎神的事，说错谬的话攻击耶和华， 使饥饿的人仍空着肚子， 使口渴的人仍无水可喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为愚顽人必说愚顽话， 心里想作罪孽， 惯行亵渎的事， 说错谬的话攻击耶和华， 使饥饿的人无食可吃， 使口渴的人无水可喝。
verses.textEnNiv: For fools speak folly, their hearts are bent on evil: They practice ungodliness and spread error concerning the Lord ; the hungry they leave empty and from the thirsty they withhold water.
verses.textEnEsv: For the fool speaks folly, and his heart is busy with iniquity, to practice ungodliness, to utter error concerning the Lord , to leave the craving of the hungry unsatisfied, and to deprive the thirsty of drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the foolish person will speak foolishness, And his heart will work iniquity: To practice ungodliness, To utter error against the Lord, To keep the hungry unsatisfied, And he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.textEnNlt: For fools speak foolishness and make evil plans. They practice ungodliness and spread false teachings about the Lord . They deprive the hungry of food and give no water to the thirsty.
verses.textEnNasb: For a fool speaks nonsense, And his heart inclines toward wickedness: To practice ungodliness and to speak error against the Lord, To keep the hungry person unsatisfied And to withhold drink from the thirsty.
verses.textEn: For fools speak folly, their hearts are bent on evil: They practice ungodliness and spread error concerning the Lord ; the hungry they leave empty and from the thirsty they withhold water.

verses.textZh: 至于恶棍，他的手段是邪恶的， 他图谋恶计， 用虚假的言语毁灭困苦的人， 即使在穷乏人讲公理的时候，他也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于恶棍，他的手段是邪恶的， 他图谋恶计， 用虚假的言语毁灭困苦的人， 即使在穷乏人讲公理的时候，他也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 吝啬人所用的法子是恶的； 他图谋恶计， 用谎言毁灭谦卑人； 穷乏人讲公理的时候， 他也是这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: Scoundrels use wicked methods, they make up evil schemes to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the scoundrel— his devices are evil; he plans wicked schemes to ruin the poor with lying words, even when the plea of the needy is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the schemes of the schemer are evil; He devises wicked plans To destroy the poor with lying words, Even when the needy speaks justice.
verses.textEnNlt: The smooth tricks of scoundrels are evil. They plot crooked schemes. They lie to convict the poor, even when the cause of the poor is just.
verses.textEnNasb: As for a rogue, his weapons are evil; He devises wicked schemes To destroy the poor with slander, Even though the needy one speaks what is right.
verses.textEn: Scoundrels use wicked methods, they make up evil schemes to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.

verses.textZh: 高尚的人却筹谋高尚的事， 他也必坚持这些高尚的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 高尚的人却筹谋高尚的事， 他也必坚持这些高尚的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 高明人却谋高明事， 在高明事上也必永存。
verses.textEnNiv: But the noble make noble plans, and by noble deeds they stand.
verses.textEnEsv: But he who is noble plans noble things, and on noble things he stands.
verses.textEnNkjv: But a generous man devises generous things, And by generosity he shall stand.
verses.textEnNlt: But generous people plan to do what is generous, and they stand firm in their generosity.
verses.textEnNasb: But the noble person devises noble plans; And by noble plans he stands.
verses.textEn: But the noble make noble plans, and by noble deeds they stand.

verses.textZh: 安逸的妇女啊！你们要起来， 听我的声音； 无忧无虑的女子啊！ 你们要侧耳听我的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 安逸的妇女啊！你们要起来， 听我的声音； 无忧无虑的女子啊！ 你们要侧耳听我的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 安逸的妇女啊，起来听我的声音！ 无虑的女子啊，侧耳听我的言语！
verses.textEnNiv: You women who are so complacent, rise up and listen to me; you daughters who feel secure, hear what I have to say!
verses.textEnEsv: Rise up, you women who are at ease, hear my voice; you complacent daughters, give ear to my speech.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rise up, you women who are at ease, Hear my voice; You complacent daughters, Give ear to my speech.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, you women who lie around in ease. Listen to me, you who are so smug.
verses.textEnNasb: Rise up, you women who are at ease, And hear my voice; Listen to my word, You complacent daughters.
verses.textEn: You women who are so complacent, rise up and listen to me; you daughters who feel secure, hear what I have to say!

verses.textZh: 无忧无虑的女子啊！再过一年多， 你们就必受困扰， 因为没有葡萄可摘， 收禾稼的日子也没有来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无忧无虑的女子啊！再过一年多， 你们就必受困扰， 因为没有葡萄可摘， 收禾稼的日子也没有来。
verses.textZhCuv: 无虑的女子啊，再过一年多，必受骚扰； 因为无葡萄可摘， 无果子 可收。
verses.textEnNiv: In little more than a year you who feel secure will tremble; the grape harvest will fail, and the harvest of fruit will not come.
verses.textEnEsv: In little more than a year you will shudder, you complacent women; for the grape harvest fails, the fruit harvest will not come.
verses.textEnNkjv: In a year and some days You will be troubled, you complacent women; For the vintage will fail, The gathering will not come.
verses.textEnNlt: In a short time—just a little more than a year— you careless ones will suddenly begin to care. For your fruit crops will fail, and the harvest will never take place.
verses.textEnNasb: Within a year and a few days You will be troubled, you complacent daughters; For the vintage is ended, And the fruit gathering will not come.
verses.textEn: In little more than a year you who feel secure will tremble; the grape harvest will fail, and the harvest of fruit will not come.

verses.textZh: 安逸的妇女啊！你们要受震惊。 无忧无虑的女子啊！你们要受困扰了， 脱去衣服，赤着身子，以麻布束腰吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 安逸的妇女啊！你们要受震惊。 无忧无虑的女子啊！你们要受困扰了， 脱去衣服，赤着身子，以麻布束腰吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 安逸的妇女啊，要战兢； 无虑的女子啊，要受骚扰。 脱去衣服，赤着身体， 腰束麻布。
verses.textEnNiv: Tremble, you complacent women; shudder, you daughters who feel secure! Strip off your fine clothes and wrap yourselves in rags.
verses.textEnEsv: Tremble, you women who are at ease, shudder, you complacent ones; strip, and make yourselves bare, and tie sackcloth around your waist.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tremble, you women who are at ease; Be troubled, you complacent ones; Strip yourselves, make yourselves bare, And gird sackcloth on your waists.
verses.textEnNlt: Tremble, you women of ease; throw off your complacency. Strip off your pretty clothes, and put on burlap to show your grief.
verses.textEnNasb: Tremble, you women who are at ease; Be troubled, you complacent daughters; Strip, undress, and put sackcloth on your waist,
verses.textEn: Tremble, you complacent women; shudder, you daughters who feel secure! Strip off your fine clothes and wrap yourselves in rags.

verses.textZh: 你们要为美好的田地和多结果子的葡萄树搥胸哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要为美好的田地和多结果子的葡萄树搥胸哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们必为美好的田地 和多结果的葡萄树，捶胸哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines
verses.textEnEsv: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine,
verses.textEnNkjv: People shall mourn upon their breasts For the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.textEnNlt: Beat your breasts in sorrow for your bountiful farms and your fruitful grapevines.
verses.textEnNasb: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine,
verses.textEn: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines

verses.textZh: 也为那些在我子民的土地上长起来的荆棘和蒺藜而哀哭， 为那欢乐的城和所有快乐的房屋，也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也为那些在我子民的土地上长起来的荆棘和蒺藜而哀哭， 为那欢乐的城和所有快乐的房屋，也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 荆棘蒺藜必长在我百姓的地上， 又长在欢乐的城中和一切快乐的房屋上。
verses.textEnNiv: and for the land of my people, a land overgrown with thorns and briers— yes, mourn for all houses of merriment and for this city of revelry.
verses.textEnEsv: for the soil of my people growing up in thorns and briers, yes, for all the joyous houses in the exultant city.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the land of my people will come up thorns and briers, Yes, on all the happy homes in the joyous city;
verses.textEnNlt: For your land will be overgrown with thorns and briers. Your joyful homes and happy towns will be gone.
verses.textEnNasb: For the land of my people in which thorns and briars will come up; Indeed, for all the joyful houses and for the jubilant city.
verses.textEn: and for the land of my people, a land overgrown with thorns and briers— yes, mourn for all houses of merriment and for this city of revelry.

verses.textZh: 因为宫殿必被丢弃，热闹的城市也被撇下， 山冈和守望楼必永远成为洞穴， 作了野驴喜欢的地方和羊群的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为宫殿必被丢弃，热闹的城市也被撇下， 山冈和守望楼必永远成为洞穴， 作了野驴喜欢的地方和羊群的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为宫殿必被撇下， 多民的城必被离弃； 山冈望楼永为洞穴， 作野驴所喜乐的， 为羊群的草场。
verses.textEnNiv: The fortress will be abandoned, the noisy city deserted; citadel and watchtower will become a wasteland forever, the delight of donkeys, a pasture for flocks,
verses.textEnEsv: For the palace is forsaken, the populous city deserted; the hill and the watchtower will become dens forever, a joy of wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks;
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the palaces will be forsaken, The bustling city will be deserted. The forts and towers will become lairs forever, A joy of wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks—
verses.textEnNlt: The palace and the city will be deserted, and busy towns will be empty. Wild donkeys will frolic and flocks will graze in the empty forts and watchtowers
verses.textEnNasb: For the palace has been neglected, the populated city abandoned. Hill and watch-tower have become caves forever, A delight for wild donkeys, a pasture for flocks,
verses.textEn: The fortress will be abandoned, the noisy city deserted; citadel and watchtower will become a wasteland forever, the delight of donkeys, a pasture for flocks,

verses.textZh: 等到圣灵从高处倾倒在我们身上， 旷野变为肥田， 肥田被看为树林的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到圣灵从高处倾倒在我们身上， 旷野变为肥田， 肥田被看为树林的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 等到圣灵从上浇灌我们， 旷野就变为肥田， 肥田看如树林。
verses.textEnNiv: till the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the desert becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field seems like a forest.
verses.textEnEsv: until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is deemed a forest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, And the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, And the fruitful field is counted as a forest.
verses.textEnNlt: until at last the Spirit is poured out on us from heaven. Then the wilderness will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will yield bountiful crops.
verses.textEnNasb: Until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high, And the wilderness becomes a fertile field, And the fertile field is considered as a forest.
verses.textEn: till the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the desert becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field seems like a forest.

verses.textZh: 公平就必居在旷野中， 公义必住在肥田里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公平就必居在旷野中， 公义必住在肥田里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，公平要居在旷野； 公义要居在肥田。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s justice will dwell in the desert, his righteousness live in the fertile field.
verses.textEnEsv: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness abide in the fruitful field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, And righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.textEnNlt: Justice will rule in the wilderness and righteousness in the fertile field.
verses.textEnNasb: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, And righteousness will remain in the fertile field.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s justice will dwell in the desert, his righteousness live in the fertile field.

verses.textZh: 公义的果效必是平安， 公义的效验必是平静与安稳，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公义的果效必是平安， 公义的效验必是平静与安稳，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 公义的果效必是平安； 公义的效验必是平稳，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: The fruit of that righteousness will be peace; its effect will be quietness and confidence forever.
verses.textEnEsv: And the effect of righteousness will be peace, and the result of righteousness, quietness and trust forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The work of righteousness will be peace, And the effect of righteousness, quietness and assurance forever.
verses.textEnNlt: And this righteousness will bring peace. Yes, it will bring quietness and confidence forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And the work of righteousness will be peace, And the service of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
verses.textEn: The fruit of that righteousness will be peace; its effect will be quietness and confidence forever.

verses.textZh: 那时，我的子民必住在平安的居所， 安稳的住处，不受骚扰的安息之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我的子民必住在平安的居所， 安稳的住处，不受骚扰的安息之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所， 安稳的住处，平静的安歇所。
verses.textEnNiv: My people will live in peaceful dwelling places, in secure homes, in undisturbed places of rest.
verses.textEnEsv: My people will abide in a peaceful habitation, in secure dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
verses.textEnNkjv: My people will dwell in a peaceful habitation, In secure dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
verses.textEnNlt: My people will live in safety, quietly at home. They will be at rest.
verses.textEnNasb: Then my people will live in a peaceful settlement, In secure dwellings, and in undisturbed resting places;
verses.textEn: My people will live in peaceful dwelling places, in secure homes, in undisturbed places of rest.

verses.textZh: 但在敌人的国土中，必有冰雹降下，打倒他们的树林， 他们的城必被夷平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但在敌人的国土中，必有冰雹降下，打倒他们的树林， 他们的城必被夷平。
verses.textZhCuv: （但要降冰雹打倒树林； 城必全然拆平。）
verses.textEnNiv: Though hail flattens the forest and the city is leveled completely,
verses.textEnEsv: And it will hail when the forest falls down, and the city will be utterly laid low.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though hail comes down on the forest, And the city is brought low in humiliation.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if the forest should be destroyed and the city torn down,
verses.textEnNasb: And it will hail when the forest comes down, And the city will be utterly laid low.
verses.textEn: Though hail flattens the forest and the city is leveled completely,

verses.textZh: 你们这些在各水边撒种， 又使牛驴随意走动的，是多么有福啊！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们这些在各水边撒种， 又使牛驴随意走动的，是多么有福啊！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在各水边撒种、 牧放牛驴的有福了！
verses.textEnNiv: how blessed you will be, sowing your seed by every stream, and letting your cattle and donkeys range free.
verses.textEnEsv: Happy are you who sow beside all waters, who let the feet of the ox and the donkey range free.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, Who send out freely the feet of the ox and the donkey.
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord will greatly bless his people. Wherever they plant seed, bountiful crops will spring up. Their cattle and donkeys will graze freely.
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed will you be, you who sow beside all waters, Who let the ox and the donkey out freely.
verses.textEn: how blessed you will be, sowing your seed by every stream, and letting your cattle and donkeys range free.

verses.textZh: 你这毁灭人， 自己却不被毁灭的； 你这行事诡诈，别人倒不以诡诈待你的，有祸了！ 你刚停止毁灭人的时候，自己就要被毁灭； 你刚停止行诡诈的时候，别人就必以诡诈待你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这毁灭人， 自己却不被毁灭的； 你这行事诡诈，别人倒不以诡诈待你的，有祸了！ 你刚停止毁灭人的时候，自己就要被毁灭； 你刚停止行诡诈的时候，别人就必以诡诈待你。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！你这毁灭人的， 自己倒不被毁灭； 行事诡诈的， 人倒不以诡诈待你。 你毁灭罢休了， 自己必被毁灭； 你行完了诡诈， 人必以诡诈待你。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you, destroyer, you who have not been destroyed! Woe to you, betrayer, you who have not been betrayed! When you stop destroying, you will be destroyed; when you stop betraying, you will be betrayed.
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, you destroyer, who yourself have not been destroyed, you traitor, whom none has betrayed! When you have ceased to destroy, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betraying, they will betray you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you who plunder, though you have not been plundered; And you who deal treacherously, though they have not dealt treacherously with you! When you cease plundering, You will be plundered; When you make an end of dealing treacherously, They will deal treacherously with you.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you Assyrians, who have destroyed others but have never been destroyed yourselves. You betray others, but you have never been betrayed. When you are done destroying, you will be destroyed. When you are done betraying, you will be betrayed.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you, destroyer, While you were not destroyed; And he who is treacherous, while others did not deal treacherously with him. As soon as you finish destroying, you will be destroyed; As soon as you cease to deal treacherously, others will deal treacherously with you.
verses.textEn: Woe to you, destroyer, you who have not been destroyed! Woe to you, betrayer, you who have not been betrayed! When you stop destroying, you will be destroyed; when you stop betraying, you will be betrayed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你施恩给我们；我们等候你。 每天早晨，愿你作我们的膀臂， 在遭难的时候，作我们的拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你施恩给我们；我们等候你。 每天早晨，愿你作我们的膀臂， 在遭难的时候，作我们的拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你施恩于我们； 我们等候你。 求你每早晨作我们的膀臂， 遭难的时候为我们的拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , be gracious to us; we long for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of distress.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , be gracious to us; we wait for you. Be our arm every morning, our salvation in the time of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, be gracious to us; We have waited for You. Be their arm every morning, Our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: But Lord , be merciful to us, for we have waited for you. Be our strong arm each day and our salvation in times of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, be gracious to us; we have waited for You. Be their strength every morning, Our salvation also in the time of distress.
verses.textEn: Lord , be gracious to us; we long for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of distress.

verses.textZh: 喧嚷的声音一发，众民必逃跑； 你一兴起，列国就四散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喧嚷的声音一发，众民必逃跑； 你一兴起，列国就四散。
verses.textZhCuv: 喧嚷的响声一发，众民奔逃； 你一兴起，列国四散。
verses.textEnNiv: At the uproar of your army, the peoples flee; when you rise up, the nations scatter.
verses.textEnEsv: At the tumultuous noise peoples flee; when you lift yourself up, nations are scattered,
verses.textEnNkjv: At the noise of the tumult the people shall flee; When You lift Yourself up, the nations shall be scattered;
verses.textEnNlt: The enemy runs at the sound of your voice. When you stand up, the nations flee!
verses.textEnNasb: At the sound of a roar, peoples flee; At the lifting up of Yourself, nations disperse.
verses.textEn: At the uproar of your army, the peoples flee; when you rise up, the nations scatter.

verses.textZh: 列国啊！你们所掳掠的必被收取， 像蚂蚱收取禾稼一样； 蝗虫怎样为食物忙碌走动，人也怎样在掳物上忙乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国啊！你们所掳掠的必被收取， 像蚂蚱收取禾稼一样； 蝗虫怎样为食物忙碌走动，人也怎样在掳物上忙乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所掳的必被敛尽， 好像蚂蚱吃 尽禾稼。 人要蹦在其上，好像蝗虫一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Your plunder, O nations, is harvested as by young locusts; like a swarm of locusts people pounce on it.
verses.textEnEsv: and your spoil is gathered as the caterpillar gathers; as locusts leap, it is leapt upon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Your plunder shall be gathered Like the gathering of the caterpillar; As the running to and fro of locusts, He shall run upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as caterpillars and locusts strip the fields and vines, so the fallen army of Assyria will be stripped!
verses.textEnNasb: Your plunder is gathered as the caterpillar gathers; Like an infestation of locusts, people storm it.
verses.textEn: Your plunder, O nations, is harvested as by young locusts; like a swarm of locusts people pounce on it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必被尊崇，因为他居住在高天； 他必以公平与公义充满锡安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必被尊崇，因为他居住在高天； 他必以公平与公义充满锡安。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华被尊崇，因他居在高处； 他以公平公义充满锡安。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with his justice and righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with justice and righteousness,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Though the Lord is very great and lives in heaven, he will make Jerusalem his home of justice and righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.textEn: The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with his justice and righteousness.

verses.textZh: 他是你一生一世的保障、 丰盛的救恩、智慧和知识； 敬畏耶和华就是他的至宝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是你一生一世的保障、 丰盛的救恩、智慧和知识； 敬畏耶和华就是他的至宝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你一生一世必得安稳－ 有丰盛的救恩， 并智慧和知识； 你以敬畏耶和华为至宝。
verses.textEnNiv: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a rich store of salvation and wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the Lord is the key to this treasure.
verses.textEnEsv: and he will be the stability of your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; the fear of the Lord is Zion’s treasure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom and knowledge will be the stability of your times, And the strength of salvation; The fear of the Lordis His treasure.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day he will be your sure foundation, providing a rich store of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the Lord will be your treasure.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will be the stability of your times, A wealth of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; The fear of the Lord is his treasure.
verses.textEn: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a rich store of salvation and wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the Lord is the key to this treasure.

verses.textZh: 看哪！他们的勇士在街上呼叫； 和平的使者在痛苦哭泣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他们的勇士在街上呼叫； 和平的使者在痛苦哭泣。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他们的豪杰在外头哀号； 求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。
verses.textEnNiv: Look, their brave men cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, their heroes cry in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely their valiant ones shall cry outside, The ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: But now your brave warriors weep in public. Your ambassadors of peace cry in bitter disappointment.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, their brave men cry out in the streets, The ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
verses.textEn: Look, their brave men cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.

verses.textZh: 大路荒凉，过路的人绝迹； 敌人背约，藐视约章， 不尊重任何人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大路荒凉，过路的人绝迹； 敌人背约，藐视约章， 不尊重任何人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大路荒凉，行人止息； 敌人背约， 藐视城邑， 不顾人民。
verses.textEnNiv: The highways are deserted, no travelers are on the roads. The treaty is broken, its witnesses are despised, no one is respected.
verses.textEnEsv: The highways lie waste; the traveler ceases. Covenants are broken; cities are despised; there is no regard for man.
verses.textEnNkjv: The highways lie waste, The traveling man ceases. He has broken the covenant, He has despised the cities, He regards no man.
verses.textEnNlt: Your roads are deserted; no one travels them anymore. The Assyrians have broken their peace treaty and care nothing for the promises they made before witnesses. They have no respect for anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: The highways are desolate, the traveler has ceased, He has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities, He has no regard for mankind.
verses.textEn: The highways are deserted, no travelers are on the roads. The treaty is broken, its witnesses are despised, no one is respected.

verses.textZh: 大地悲哀衰残， 黎巴嫩羞惭枯干； 沙仑好象荒原， 巴珊和迦密的树木凋零。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地悲哀衰残， 黎巴嫩羞惭枯干； 沙仑好象荒原， 巴珊和迦密的树木凋零。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上悲哀衰残； 黎巴嫩羞愧枯干； 沙仑像旷野； 巴珊和迦密的树林凋残。
verses.textEnNiv: The land dries up and wastes away, Lebanon is ashamed and withers; Sharon is like the Arabah, and Bashan and Carmel drop their leaves.
verses.textEnEsv: The land mourns and languishes; Lebanon is confounded and withers away; Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth mourns and languishes, Lebanon is shamed and shriveled; Sharon is like a wilderness, And Bashan and Carmel shake off theirfruits.
verses.textEnNlt: The land of Israel wilts in mourning. Lebanon withers with shame. The plain of Sharon is now a wilderness. Bashan and Carmel have been plundered.
verses.textEnNasb: The land mourns and wastes away, Lebanon is shamed and withers; Sharon is like a desert plain, And Bashan and Carmel lose their foliage.
verses.textEn: The land dries up and wastes away, Lebanon is ashamed and withers; Sharon is like the Arabah, and Bashan and Carmel drop their leaves.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："现在我要起来， 现在我要兴起，现在我要被人尊崇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："现在我要起来， 现在我要兴起，现在我要被人尊崇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 现在我要起来； 我要兴起； 我要勃然而兴。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now will I arise," says the Lord . "Now will I be exalted; now will I be lifted up.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now I will arise," says the Lord , "now I will lift myself up; now I will be exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now I will rise," says the Lord; "Now I will be exalted, Now I will lift Myself up.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord says: "Now I will stand up. Now I will show my power and might.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now I will arise," says the Lord, "Now I will be exalted, now I will be lifted up.
verses.textEn: "Now will I arise," says the Lord . "Now will I be exalted; now will I be lifted up.

verses.textZh: 你们所怀的是糠秕，所生的是碎秸； 我的气息必像火一般吞灭你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所怀的是糠秕，所生的是碎秸； 我的气息必像火一般吞灭你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要怀的是糠秕， 要生的是碎秸； 你们的气就是吞灭自己的火。
verses.textEnNiv: You conceive chaff, you give birth to straw; your breath is a fire that consumes you.
verses.textEnEsv: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble; your breath is a fire that will consume you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall conceive chaff, You shall bring forth stubble; Your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.textEnNlt: You Assyrians produce nothing but dry grass and stubble. Your own breath will turn to fire and consume you.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have conceived chaff, you will give birth to stubble; My breath will consume you like a fire.
verses.textEn: You conceive chaff, you give birth to straw; your breath is a fire that consumes you.

verses.textZh: 众民必像燃烧的石灰， 又像被割下的荆棘，在火中焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民必像燃烧的石灰， 又像被割下的荆棘，在火中焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 列邦必像已烧的石灰， 像已割的荆棘在火中焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: The peoples will be burned to ashes; like cut thornbushes they will be set ablaze."
verses.textEnEsv: And the peoples will be as if burned to lime, like thorns cut down, that are burned in the fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people shall be like the burnings of lime; Like thorns cut up they shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Your people will be burned up completely, like thornbushes cut down and tossed in a fire.
verses.textEnNasb: "The peoples will be burned to lime, Like cut thorns which are burned in the fire.
verses.textEn: The peoples will be burned to ashes; like cut thornbushes they will be set ablaze."

verses.textZh: 远方的人哪！你们要听我所作的事； 近处的人哪！你们要承认我的大能。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 远方的人哪！你们要听我所作的事； 近处的人哪！你们要承认我的大能。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们远方的人当听我所行的； 你们近处的人当承认我的大能。
verses.textEnNiv: You who are far away, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge my power!
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and you who are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, you whoare afar off, what I have done; And you whoare near, acknowledge My might."
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to what I have done, you nations far away! And you that are near, acknowledge my might!"
verses.textEnNasb: "You who are far away, hear what I have done; And you who are near, acknowledge My might."
verses.textEn: You who are far away, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge my power!

verses.textZh: 在锡安的罪人都恐惧； 战兢抓住了不敬虔的人： "我们中间谁能与吞灭一切的火同住呢？ 我们中间谁能与不断燃烧的火同住呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在锡安的罪人都恐惧； 战兢抓住了不敬虔的人： "我们中间谁能与吞灭一切的火同住呢？ 我们中间谁能与不断燃烧的火同住呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安中的罪人都惧怕； 不敬虔的人被战兢抓住。 我们中间谁能与吞灭的火同住？ 我们中间谁能与永火同住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The sinners in Zion are terrified; trembling grips the godless: "Who of us can dwell with the consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting burning?"
verses.textEnEsv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling has seized the godless: "Who among us can dwell with the consuming fire? Who among us can dwell with everlasting burnings?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; Fearfulness has seized the hypocrites: "Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? Who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?"
verses.textEnNlt: The sinners in Jerusalem shake with fear. Terror seizes the godless. "Who can live with this devouring fire?" they cry. "Who can survive this all-consuming fire?"
verses.textEnNasb: Sinners in Zion are terrified; Trembling has seized the godless. "Who among us can live with the consuming fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?"
verses.textEn: The sinners in Zion are terrified; trembling grips the godless: "Who of us can dwell with the consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting burning?"

verses.textZh: 那行事公义，说话正直， 拒绝不义的财利， 摇手不受贿赂， 塞耳不听血腥的事， 闭眼不看邪恶的事的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那行事公义，说话正直， 拒绝不义的财利， 摇手不受贿赂， 塞耳不听血腥的事， 闭眼不看邪恶的事的，
verses.textZhCuv: 行事公义、说话正直、 憎恶欺压的财利、 摆手不受贿赂、 塞耳不听流血的话， 闭眼不看邪恶事的，
verses.textEnNiv: Those who walk righteously and speak what is right, who reject gain from extortion and keep their hands from accepting bribes, who stop their ears against plots of murder and shut their eyes against contemplating evil—
verses.textEnEsv: He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly, who despises the gain of oppressions, who shakes his hands, lest they hold a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed and shuts his eyes from looking on evil,
verses.textEnNkjv: He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly, He who despises the gain of oppressions, Who gestures with his hands, refusing bribes, Who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, And shuts his eyes from seeing evil:
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are honest and fair, who refuse to profit by fraud, who stay far away from bribes, who refuse to listen to those who plot murder, who shut their eyes to all enticement to do wrong—
verses.textEnNasb: One who walks righteously and speaks with integrity, One who rejects unjust gain And shakes his hands so that they hold no bribe; One who stops his ears from hearing about bloodshed And shuts his eyes from looking at evil;
verses.textEn: Those who walk righteously and speak what is right, who reject gain from extortion and keep their hands from accepting bribes, who stop their ears against plots of murder and shut their eyes against contemplating evil—

verses.textZh: 这样的人必居住在高处， 他的保障必在坚固的盘石上， 他的粮食必有供应， 他的水源永不断绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样的人必居住在高处， 他的保障必在坚固的盘石上， 他的粮食必有供应， 他的水源永不断绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必居高处； 他的保障是磐石的坚垒； 他的粮必不缺乏 ； 他的水必不断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: they are the ones who will dwell on the heights, whose refuge will be the mountain fortress. Their bread will be supplied, and water will not fail them.
verses.textEnEsv: he will dwell on the heights; his place of defense will be the fortresses of rocks; his bread will be given him; his water will be sure.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will dwell on high; His place of defense willbe the fortress of rocks; Bread will be given him, His water willbe sure.
verses.textEnNlt: these are the ones who will dwell on high. The rocks of the mountains will be their fortress. Food will be supplied to them, and they will have water in abundance.
verses.textEnNasb: He will dwell on the heights, His refuge will be the impregnable rock; His bread will be given him, His water will be sure.
verses.textEn: they are the ones who will dwell on the heights, whose refuge will be the mountain fortress. Their bread will be supplied, and water will not fail them.

verses.textZh: 你必亲眼看见王的荣美， 必看见辽阔之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必亲眼看见王的荣美， 必看见辽阔之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的眼必见王的荣美， 必见辽阔之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty and view a land that stretches afar.
verses.textEnEsv: Your eyes will behold the king in his beauty; they will see a land that stretches afar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty; They will see the land that is very far off.
verses.textEnNlt: Your eyes will see the king in all his splendor, and you will see a land that stretches into the distance.
verses.textEnNasb: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty; They will see a distant land.
verses.textEn: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty and view a land that stretches afar.

verses.textZh: 你的心必默想已往的恐惧，说： "那记数目的在哪里？ 那称贡银的在哪里？ 那数点城楼的在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的心必默想已往的恐惧，说： "那记数目的在哪里？ 那称贡银的在哪里？ 那数点城楼的在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的心必思想那惊吓的事， 自问说：记数目的在哪里呢？ 平贡银的在哪里呢？ 数戍楼的在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: In your thoughts you will ponder the former terror: "Where is that chief officer? Where is the one who took the revenue? Where is the officer in charge of the towers?"
verses.textEnEsv: Your heart will muse on the terror: "Where is he who counted, where is he who weighed the tribute? Where is he who counted the towers?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Your heart will meditate on terror: "Where is the scribe? Where is he who weighs? Where is he who counts the towers?"
verses.textEnNlt: You will think back to this time of terror, asking, "Where are the Assyrian officers who counted our towers? Where are the bookkeepers who recorded the plunder taken from our fallen city?"
verses.textEnNasb: Your heart will meditate on terror: "Where is one who counts? Where is one who weighs? Where is one who counts the towers?"
verses.textEn: In your thoughts you will ponder the former terror: "Where is that chief officer? Where is the one who took the revenue? Where is the officer in charge of the towers?"

verses.textZh: 你必不再见那强暴的民了， 就是那说话深奥，难以明白， 舌头结巴，难以听懂的民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必不再见那强暴的民了， 就是那说话深奥，难以明白， 舌头结巴，难以听懂的民。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必不见那强暴的民， 就是说话深奥，你不能明白， 言语呢喃，你不能懂得的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will see those arrogant people no more, people whose speech is obscure, whose language is strange and incomprehensible.
verses.textEnEsv: You will see no more the insolent people, the people of an obscure speech that you cannot comprehend, stammering in a tongue that you cannot understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will not see a fierce people, A people of obscure speech, beyond perception, Of a stammering tongue thatyou cannot understand.
verses.textEnNlt: You will no longer see these fierce, violent people with their strange, unknown language.
verses.textEnNasb: You will no longer see a fierce people, A people of unintelligible speech which no one comprehends, Of a stammering tongue which no one understands.
verses.textEn: You will see those arrogant people no more, people whose speech is obscure, whose language is strange and incomprehensible.

verses.textZh: 你要看着锡安，就是我们举行制定节期的城， 你必看见耶路撒冷，是一个安全的居所， 一个不挪移的帐幕， 它的橛子永不会拔起来， 它的绳索也不会扯断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要看着锡安，就是我们举行制定节期的城， 你必看见耶路撒冷，是一个安全的居所， 一个不挪移的帐幕， 它的橛子永不会拔起来， 它的绳索也不会扯断。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要看锡安－我们守圣节的城！ 你的眼必见耶路撒冷为安静的居所， 为不挪移的帐幕， 橛子永不拔出， 绳索一根也不折断。
verses.textEnNiv: Look on Zion, the city of our festivals; your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful abode, a tent that will not be moved; its stakes will never be pulled up, nor any of its ropes broken.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold Zion, the city of our appointed feasts! Your eyes will see Jerusalem, an untroubled habitation, an immovable tent, whose stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts; Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet home, A tabernacle that will not be taken down; Not one of its stakes will ever be removed, Nor will any of its cords be broken.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you will see Zion as a place of holy festivals. You will see Jerusalem, a city quiet and secure. It will be like a tent whose ropes are taut and whose stakes are firmly fixed.
verses.textEnNasb: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed feasts; Your eyes will see Jerusalem, an undisturbed settlement, A tent which will not be folded; Its stakes will never be pulled up, Nor any of its ropes be torn apart.
verses.textEn: Look on Zion, the city of our festivals; your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful abode, a tent that will not be moved; its stakes will never be pulled up, nor any of its ropes broken.

verses.textZh: 在那里，威严的耶和华必作我们江河宽渠溢流之地。 必没有荡桨摇橹的船只能在其上往来， 威武的战船也不能经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里，威严的耶和华必作我们江河宽渠溢流之地。 必没有荡桨摇橹的船只能在其上往来， 威武的战船也不能经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，耶和华必显威严与我们同在， 当作江河宽阔之地； 其中必没有荡桨摇橹的船来往， 也没有威武的船经过。
verses.textEnNiv: There the Lord will be our Mighty One. It will be like a place of broad rivers and streams. No galley with oars will ride them, no mighty ship will sail them.
verses.textEnEsv: But there the Lord in majesty will be for us a place of broad rivers and streams, where no galley with oars can go, nor majestic ship can pass.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there the majestic Lordwillbe for us A place of broad rivers and streams, In which no galley with oars will sail, Nor majestic ships pass by
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will be our Mighty One. He will be like a wide river of protection that no enemy can cross, that no enemy ship can sail upon.
verses.textEnNasb: But there the majestic One, the Lord, will be for us A place of rivers and wide canals On which no boat with oars will go, And on which no mighty ship will pass—
verses.textEn: There the Lord will be our Mighty One. It will be like a place of broad rivers and streams. No galley with oars will ride them, no mighty ship will sail them.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华是我们的审判者， 耶和华是我们的立法者， 耶和华是我们的君王， 他必拯救我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华是我们的审判者， 耶和华是我们的立法者， 耶和华是我们的君王， 他必拯救我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，耶和华是审判我们的； 耶和华是给我们设律法的； 耶和华是我们的王； 他必拯救我们。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; it is he who will save us.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is our judge; the Lord is our lawgiver; the Lord is our king; he will save us.
verses.textEnNkjv: (For the Lordis our Judge, The Lordis our Lawgiver, The Lordis our King; He will save us);
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is our judge, our lawgiver, and our king. He will care for us and save us.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord is our judge, The Lord is our lawgiver, The Lord is our king; He will save us—
verses.textEn: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; it is he who will save us.

verses.textZh: 现在你的绳索虽然松开， 不能绑紧桅杆， 也不能扬起帆来， 但到那时，许多掳物必被你们瓜分， 甚至瘸腿的也能把掠物掠去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你的绳索虽然松开， 不能绑紧桅杆， 也不能扬起帆来， 但到那时，许多掳物必被你们瓜分， 甚至瘸腿的也能把掠物掠去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的绳索松开： 不能栽稳桅杆， 也不能扬起篷来。 那时许多掳来的物被分了； 瘸腿的把掠物夺去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your rigging hangs loose: The mast is not held secure, the sail is not spread. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided and even the lame will carry off plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: Your cords hang loose; they cannot hold the mast firm in its place or keep the sail spread out. Then prey and spoil in abundance will be divided; even the lame will take the prey.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your tackle is loosed, They could not strengthen their mast, They could not spread the sail. Then the prey of great plunder is divided; The lame take the prey.
verses.textEnNlt: The enemies’ sails hang loose on broken masts with useless tackle. Their treasure will be divided by the people of God. Even the lame will take their share!
verses.textEnNasb: Your ship’s tackle hangs slack; It cannot hold the base of its mast firmly, Nor spread out the sail. Then the prey of an abundant spoil will be divided; Those who limp will take the plunder.
verses.textEn: Your rigging hangs loose: The mast is not held secure, the sail is not spread. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided and even the lame will carry off plunder.

verses.textZh: 以色列的居民必不再说："我有病"； 因为在其中居住的，罪孽必得赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的居民必不再说："我有病"； 因为在其中居住的，罪孽必得赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 城内居民必不说：我病了； 其中居住的百姓，罪孽都赦免了。
verses.textEnNiv: No one living in Zion will say, "I am ill"; and the sins of those who dwell there will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And no inhabitant will say, "I am sick"; the people who dwell there will be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the inhabitant will not say, "I am sick"; The people who dwell in it willbe forgiven their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel will no longer say, "We are sick and helpless," for the Lord will forgive their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: And no resident will say, "I am sick"; The people who live there will be forgiven their wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: No one living in Zion will say, "I am ill"; and the sins of those who dwell there will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: 列国啊，要近前来听！众民哪，要留心听！ 地和地上所充满的，世界和其中所出的一切，都要听！
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国啊，要近前来听！众民哪，要留心听！ 地和地上所充满的，世界和其中所出的一切，都要听！
verses.textZhCuv: 列国啊，要近前来听！ 众民哪，要侧耳而听！ 地和其上所充满的， 世界和其中一切所出的都应当听！
verses.textEnNiv: Come near, you nations, and listen; pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world, and all that comes out of it!
verses.textEnEsv: Draw near, O nations, to hear, and give attention, O peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that fills it; the world, and all that comes from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come near, you nations, to hear; And heed, you people! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, The world and all things that come forth from it.
verses.textEnNlt: Come here and listen, O nations of the earth. Let the world and everything in it hear my words.
verses.textEnNasb: Come near, you nations, to hear; and listen, you peoples! Let the earth and all it contains hear, and the world and all that springs from it.
verses.textEn: Come near, you nations, and listen; pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world, and all that comes out of it!

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华向列国发怒， 向他们所有的军队发烈怒， 要把他们灭尽， 要把他们交出来受屠杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华向列国发怒， 向他们所有的军队发烈怒， 要把他们灭尽， 要把他们交出来受屠杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华向万国发忿恨， 向他们的全军发烈怒， 将他们灭尽，交出他们受杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is angry with all nations; his wrath is on all their armies. He will totally destroy them, he will give them over to slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is enraged against all the nations, and furious against all their host; he has devoted them to destruction, has given them over for slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the indignation of the Lord is against all nations, And His fury against all their armies; He has utterly destroyed them, He has given them over to the slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is enraged against the nations. His fury is against all their armies. He will completely destroy them, dooming them to slaughter.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord’s anger is against all the nations, And His wrath against all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them, He has turned them over to slaughter.
verses.textEn: The Lord is angry with all nations; his wrath is on all their armies. He will totally destroy them, he will give them over to slaughter.

verses.textZh: 他们被杀的必被拋弃在外面， 尸体的臭气上腾， 众山都被他们的血所溶化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们被杀的必被拋弃在外面， 尸体的臭气上腾， 众山都被他们的血所溶化。
verses.textZhCuv: 被杀的必然抛弃， 尸首臭气上腾； 诸山被他们的血融化。
verses.textEnNiv: Their slain will be thrown out, their dead bodies will stink; the mountains will be soaked with their blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Their slain shall be cast out, and the stench of their corpses shall rise; the mountains shall flow with their blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also their slain shall be thrown out; Their stench shall rise from their corpses, And the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.textEnNlt: Their dead will be left unburied, and the stench of rotting bodies will fill the land. The mountains will flow with their blood.
verses.textEnNasb: So their slain will be thrown out, And their corpses will give off their stench, And the mountains will be drenched with their blood.
verses.textEn: Their slain will be thrown out, their dead bodies will stink; the mountains will be soaked with their blood.

verses.textZh: 天上的万象都必消残； 天也像书卷一般被卷起， 所有星宿也必衰残， 像葡萄树的叶子衰残一样， 又像无花果树的叶子凋落一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的万象都必消残； 天也像书卷一般被卷起， 所有星宿也必衰残， 像葡萄树的叶子衰残一样， 又像无花果树的叶子凋落一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上的万象都要消没； 天被卷起，好像书卷。 其上的万象要残败， 像葡萄树的叶子残败， 又像无花果树的叶子残败一样。
verses.textEnNiv: All the stars in the sky will be dissolved and the heavens rolled up like a scroll; all the starry host will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like shriveled figs from the fig tree.
verses.textEnEsv: All the host of heaven shall rot away, and the skies roll up like a scroll. All their host shall fall, as leaves fall from the vine, like leaves falling from the fig tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the host of heaven shall be dissolved, And the heavens shall be rolled up like a scroll; All their host shall fall down As the leaf falls from the vine, And as fruit falling from a fig tree.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens above will melt away and disappear like a rolled-up scroll. The stars will fall from the sky like withered leaves from a grapevine, or shriveled figs from a fig tree.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the heavenly lights will wear away, And the sky will be rolled up like a scroll; All its lights will also wither away As a leaf withers from the vine, Or as one withers from the fig tree.
verses.textEn: All the stars in the sky will be dissolved and the heavens rolled up like a scroll; all the starry host will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like shriveled figs from the fig tree.

verses.textZh: 因为我的刀在天上已经喝足了， 看哪！它要落在以东， 以及我决定要灭绝的民身上，为要施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我的刀在天上已经喝足了， 看哪！它要落在以东， 以及我决定要灭绝的民身上，为要施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我的刀在天上已经喝足； 这刀必临到以东和我所咒诅的民， 要施行审判。
verses.textEnNiv: My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; see, it descends in judgment on Edom, the people I have totally destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: For my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; behold, it descends for judgment upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For My sword shall be bathed in heaven; Indeed it shall come down on Edom, And on the people of My curse, for judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: And when my sword has finished its work in the heavens, it will fall upon Edom, the nation I have marked for destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: For My sword has drunk its fill in heaven; Behold it shall descend for judgment upon Edom, And upon the people whom I have designated for destruction.
verses.textEn: My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; see, it descends in judgment on Edom, the people I have totally destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的刀染满了血， 这刀因脂肪、羊羔和公山羊的血， 以及公绵羊腰子的脂肪而滋润， 因为耶和华在波斯拉有杀牲献祭的事， 在以东地有大屠杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的刀染满了血， 这刀因脂肪、羊羔和公山羊的血， 以及公绵羊腰子的脂肪而滋润， 因为耶和华在波斯拉有杀牲献祭的事， 在以东地有大屠杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的刀满了血， 用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血， 并公绵羊腰子的脂油滋润的； 因为耶和华在波斯拉有献祭的事， 在以东地大行杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: The sword of the Lord is bathed in blood, it is covered with fat— the blood of lambs and goats, fat from the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has a sword; it is sated with blood; it is gorged with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, It is made overflowing with fatness, With the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: The sword of the Lord is drenched with blood and covered with fat— with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of rams prepared for sacrifice. Yes, the Lord will offer a sacrifice in the city of Bozrah. He will make a mighty slaughter in Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, It drips with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.textEn: The sword of the Lord is bathed in blood, it is covered with fat— the blood of lambs and goats, fat from the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

verses.textZh: 野牛、牛犊与壮牛要与他们一同倒下， 他们的地喝足了血， 他们的尘土因脂肪而肥润。
verses.textZhCnvs: 野牛、牛犊与壮牛要与他们一同倒下， 他们的地喝足了血， 他们的尘土因脂肪而肥润。
verses.textZhCuv: 野牛、牛犊，和公牛要一同下来。 他们的地喝醉了血； 他们的尘土因脂油肥润。
verses.textEnNiv: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the bull calves and the great bulls. Their land will be drenched with blood, and the dust will be soaked with fat.
verses.textEnEsv: Wild oxen shall fall with them, and young steers with the mighty bulls. Their land shall drink its fill of blood, and their soil shall be gorged with fat.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wild oxen shall come down with them, And the young bulls with the mighty bulls; Their land shall be soaked with blood, And their dust saturated with fatness."
verses.textEnNlt: Even men as strong as wild oxen will die— the young men alongside the veterans. The land will be soaked with blood and the soil enriched with fat.
verses.textEnNasb: Wild oxen will also fall with them And young bulls with strong ones; So their land will be soaked with blood, And their dust become greasy with fat.
verses.textEn: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the bull calves and the great bulls. Their land will be drenched with blood, and the dust will be soaked with fat.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华有报仇的日子， 为锡安的案件，必有报应之年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华有报仇的日子， 为锡安的案件，必有报应之年。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华有报仇之日， 为锡安的争辩有报应之年。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, a year of retribution, to uphold Zion’s cause.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis the day of the Lord’s vengeance, The year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: For it is the day of the Lord ’s revenge, the year when Edom will be paid back for all it did to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, A year of retribution for the cause of Zion.
verses.textEn: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, a year of retribution, to uphold Zion’s cause.

verses.textZh: 以东的河水都要变成石油， 它的尘土必变成硫磺， 它的地土要变成烧着的石油，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以东的河水都要变成石油， 它的尘土必变成硫磺， 它的地土要变成烧着的石油，
verses.textZhCuv: 以东的河水要变为石油， 尘埃要变为硫磺； 地土成为烧着的石油，
verses.textEnNiv: Edom’s streams will be turned into pitch, her dust into burning sulfur; her land will become blazing pitch!
verses.textEnEsv: And the streams of Edom shall be turned into pitch, and her soil into sulfur; her land shall become burning pitch.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its streams shall be turned into pitch, And its dust into brimstone; Its land shall become burning pitch.
verses.textEnNlt: The streams of Edom will be filled with burning pitch, and the ground will be covered with fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Its streams will be turned into pitch, And its loose earth into brimstone, And its land will become burning pitch.
verses.textEn: Edom’s streams will be turned into pitch, her dust into burning sulfur; her land will become blazing pitch!

verses.textZh: 昼夜不熄， 烟气永远上腾， 并且必世世代代变为荒凉， 永永远远无人经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 昼夜不熄， 烟气永远上腾， 并且必世世代代变为荒凉， 永永远远无人经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 昼夜总不熄灭， 烟气永远上腾， 必世世代代成为荒废， 永永远远无人经过。
verses.textEnNiv: It will not be quenched night or day; its smoke will rise forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever pass through it again.
verses.textEnEsv: Night and day it shall not be quenched; its smoke shall go up forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall not be quenched night or day; Its smoke shall ascend forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; No one shall pass through it forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: This judgment on Edom will never end; the smoke of its burning will rise forever. The land will lie deserted from generation to generation. No one will live there anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: It will not be extinguished night or day; Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation it will be desolate; None will pass through it forever and ever.
verses.textEn: It will not be quenched night or day; its smoke will rise forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever pass through it again.

verses.textZh: 但鹈鹕与箭猪要占据那地， 猫头鹰和乌鸦必住在其中。 耶和华必把混沌的准绳、 空虚的线铊，拉在其上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但鹈鹕与箭猪要占据那地， 猫头鹰和乌鸦必住在其中。 耶和华必把混沌的准绳、 空虚的线铊，拉在其上。
verses.textZhCuv: 鹈鹕、箭猪却要得为业； 猫头鹰、乌鸦要住在其间。 耶和华必将空虚的准绳， 混沌的线铊，拉在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it; the great owl and the raven will nest there. God will stretch out over Edom the measuring line of chaos and the plumb line of desolation.
verses.textEnEsv: But the hawk and the porcupine shall possess it, the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. He shall stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the pelican and the porcupine shall possess it, Also the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. And He shall stretch out over it The line of confusion and the stones of emptiness.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be haunted by the desert owl and the screech owl, the great owl and the raven. For God will measure that land carefully; he will measure it for chaos and destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: But pelican and hedgehog will possess it, And owl and raven will dwell in it; And He will stretch over it the line of desolation And the plumb line of emptiness.
verses.textEn: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it; the great owl and the raven will nest there. God will stretch out over Edom the measuring line of chaos and the plumb line of desolation.

verses.textZh: 它的显贵一个也没有了， 以致不能称为一国， 所有的领袖也没有了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的显贵一个也没有了， 以致不能称为一国， 所有的领袖也没有了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以东人要召贵胄来治国； 那里却无一个， 首领也都归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Her nobles will have nothing there to be called a kingdom, all her princes will vanish away.
verses.textEnEsv: Its nobles—there is no one there to call it a kingdom, and all its princes shall be nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, But none shallbe there, and all its princes shall be nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be called the Land of Nothing, and all its nobles will soon be gone.
verses.textEnNasb: Its nobles—there is no one there Whom they may proclaim king— And all its officials will be nothing.
verses.textEn: Her nobles will have nothing there to be called a kingdom, all her princes will vanish away.

verses.textZh: 以东的宫殿必长荆棘， 它的堡垒必长蒺藜和刺草； 它要作野狗的住处， 作鸵鸟的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以东的宫殿必长荆棘， 它的堡垒必长蒺藜和刺草； 它要作野狗的住处， 作鸵鸟的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 以东的宫殿要长荆棘； 保障要长蒺藜和刺草； 要作野狗的住处， 鸵鸟的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: Thorns will overrun her citadels, nettles and brambles her strongholds. She will become a haunt for jackals, a home for owls.
verses.textEnEsv: Thorns shall grow over its strongholds, nettles and thistles in its fortresses. It shall be the haunt of jackals, an abode for ostriches.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thorns shall come up in its palaces, Nettles and brambles in its fortresses; It shall be a habitation of jackals, A courtyard for ostriches.
verses.textEnNlt: Thorns will overrun its palaces; nettles and thistles will grow in its forts. The ruins will become a haunt for jackals and a home for owls.
verses.textEnNasb: Thorns will come up in its fortified towers, Weeds and thistles in its fortified cities; It will also be a haunt of jackals And a habitat of ostriches.
verses.textEn: Thorns will overrun her citadels, nettles and brambles her strongholds. She will become a haunt for jackals, a home for owls.

verses.textZh: 旷野的走兽必与豺狼相遇， 野山羊必呼喊牠的同伴； 连夜间的怪物也必在那里栖身， 为自己寻找休息的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 旷野的走兽必与豺狼相遇， 野山羊必呼喊牠的同伴； 连夜间的怪物也必在那里栖身， 为自己寻找休息的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 旷野的走兽要和豺狼相遇； 野山羊要与伴偶对叫。 夜间的怪物必在那里栖身， 自找安歇之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and wild goats will bleat to each other; there the night creatures will also lie down and find for themselves places of rest.
verses.textEnEsv: And wild animals shall meet with hyenas; the wild goat shall cry to his fellow; indeed, there the night bird settles and finds for herself a resting place.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the jackals, And the wild goat shall bleat to its companion; Also the night creature shall rest there, And find for herself a place of rest.
verses.textEnNlt: Desert animals will mingle there with hyenas, their howls filling the night. Wild goats will bleat at one another among the ruins, and night creatures will come there to rest.
verses.textEnNasb: The desert creatures will meet with the wolves, The goat also will cry to its kind. Yes, the night-bird will settle there And will find herself a resting place.
verses.textEn: Desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and wild goats will bleat to each other; there the night creatures will also lie down and find for themselves places of rest.

verses.textZh: 箭蛇要在那里筑窝、下蛋、 孵蛋，并且聚子在牠的阴影下； 鹞鹰也各与自己的伴偶， 聚集在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 箭蛇要在那里筑窝、下蛋、 孵蛋，并且聚子在牠的阴影下； 鹞鹰也各与自己的伴偶， 聚集在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 箭蛇要在那里做窝， 下蛋，抱蛋，生子， 聚子在其影下； 鹞鹰各与伴偶聚集在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The owl will nest there and lay eggs, she will hatch them, and care for her young under the shadow of her wings; there also the falcons will gather, each with its mate.
verses.textEnEsv: There the owl nests and lays and hatches and gathers her young in her shadow; indeed, there the hawks are gathered, each one with her mate.
verses.textEnNkjv: There the arrow snake shall make her nest and lay eggs And hatch, and gather them under her shadow; There also shall the hawks be gathered, Every one with her mate.
verses.textEnNlt: There the owl will make her nest and lay her eggs. She will hatch her young and cover them with her wings. And the buzzards will come, each one with its mate.
verses.textEnNasb: The tree snake will make its nest and lay eggs there, And it will hatch and gather them under its protection. Yes, the hawks will be gathered there, Every one with its kind.
verses.textEn: The owl will nest there and lay eggs, she will hatch them, and care for her young under the shadow of her wings; there also the falcons will gather, each with its mate.

verses.textZh: 你们要查考和阅读耶和华的书卷； 这些都无一缺少， 也没有一个是没有伴偶的， 因为他的口 已吩咐了， 他的灵已把牠们聚集。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要查考和阅读耶和华的书卷； 这些都无一缺少， 也没有一个是没有伴偶的， 因为他的口 已吩咐了， 他的灵已把牠们聚集。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要查考宣读耶和华的书。 这都无一缺少， 无一没有伴偶； 因为我的口已经吩咐， 他的灵将它们聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: Look in the scroll of the Lord and read: None of these will be missing, not one will lack her mate. For it is his mouth that has given the order, and his Spirit will gather them together.
verses.textEnEsv: Seek and read from the book of the Lord : Not one of these shall be missing; none shall be without her mate. For the mouth of the Lord has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Search from the book of the Lord, and read: Not one of these shall fail; Not one shall lack her mate. For My mouth has commanded it, and His Spirit has gathered them.
verses.textEnNlt: Search the book of the Lord , and see what he will do. Not one of these birds and animals will be missing, and none will lack a mate, for the Lord has promised this. His Spirit will make it all come true.
verses.textEnNasb: Seek from the book of the Lord, and read: Not one of these will be missing; None will lack its mate. For His mouth has commanded, And His Spirit has gathered them.
verses.textEn: Look in the scroll of the Lord and read: None of these will be missing, not one will lack her mate. For it is his mouth that has given the order, and his Spirit will gather them together.

verses.textZh: 他也为牠们抽签， 他的手用准绳给牠们分地； 牠们必永远得着那地， 也要世世代代住在其中。
