verses.textZhCnvs: 他也为牠们抽签， 他的手用准绳给牠们分地； 牠们必永远得着那地， 也要世世代代住在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也为它们拈阄， 又亲手用准绳给它们分地； 它们必永得为业， 世世代代住在其间。
verses.textEnNiv: He allots their portions; his hand distributes them by measure. They will possess it forever and dwell there from generation to generation.
verses.textEnEsv: He has cast the lot for them; his hand has portioned it out to them with the line; they shall possess it forever; from generation to generation they shall dwell in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has cast the lot for them, And His hand has divided it among them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever; From generation to generation they shall dwell in it."
verses.textEnNlt: He has surveyed and divided the land and deeded it over to those creatures. They will possess it forever, from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: He has cast the lot for them, And His hand has divided it to them by the measuring line. They shall possess it forever; From generation to generation they will dwell in it.
verses.textEn: He allots their portions; his hand distributes them by measure. They will possess it forever and dwell there from generation to generation.

verses.textZh: 旷野和干旱之地必欢喜； 沙漠要快乐， 又像番红花一般开花，
verses.textZhCnvs: 旷野和干旱之地必欢喜； 沙漠要快乐， 又像番红花一般开花，
verses.textZhCuv: 旷野和干旱之地必然欢喜； 沙漠也必快乐； 又像玫瑰开花，
verses.textEnNiv: The desert and the parched land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom. Like the crocus,
verses.textEnEsv: The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; the desert shall rejoice and blossom like the crocus;
verses.textEnNkjv: The wilderness and the wasteland shall be glad for them, And the desert shall rejoice and blossom as the rose;
verses.textEnNlt: Even the wilderness and desert will be glad in those days. The wasteland will rejoice and blossom with spring crocuses.
verses.textEnNasb: The wilderness and the desert will rejoice, And the desert will shout for joy and blossom; Like the crocus
verses.textEn: The desert and the parched land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom. Like the crocus,

verses.textZh: 必茂盛地开花， 大大快乐，并且欢呼。 黎巴嫩的荣耀、 迦密和沙仑的华美也赐给它； 人们必看见耶和华的荣耀、 我们神的华美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必茂盛地开花， 大大快乐，并且欢呼。 黎巴嫩的荣耀、 迦密和沙仑的华美也赐给它； 人们必看见耶和华的荣耀、 我们神的华美。
verses.textZhCuv: 必开花繁盛， 乐上加乐，而且欢呼。 黎巴嫩的荣耀， 并迦密与沙仑的华美，必赐给它。 人必看见耶和华的荣耀， 我们神的华美。
verses.textEnNiv: it will burst into bloom; it will rejoice greatly and shout for joy. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon; they will see the glory of the Lord , the splendor of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: it shall blossom abundantly and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, the majesty of Carmel and Sharon. They shall see the glory of the Lord , the majesty of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall blossom abundantly and rejoice, Even with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, The excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They shall see the glory of the Lord, The excellency of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, there will be an abundance of flowers and singing and joy! The deserts will become as green as the mountains of Lebanon, as lovely as Mount Carmel or the plain of Sharon. There the Lord will display his glory, the splendor of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: It will blossom profusely And rejoice with joy and jubilation. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, The majesty of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the Lord, The majesty of our God.
verses.textEn: it will burst into bloom; it will rejoice greatly and shout for joy. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon; they will see the glory of the Lord , the splendor of our God.

verses.textZh: 你们要坚固无力的手，稳固摇动的膝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要坚固无力的手，稳固摇动的膝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要使软弱的手坚壮， 无力的膝稳固。
verses.textEnNiv: Strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way;
verses.textEnEsv: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Strengthen the weak hands, And make firm the feeble knees.
verses.textEnNlt: With this news, strengthen those who have tired hands, and encourage those who have weak knees.
verses.textEnNasb: Strengthen the exhausted, and make the feeble strong.
verses.textEn: Strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way;

verses.textZh: 又对那些忧心的人说： "你们要刚强，不要惧怕。 看哪！你们的神，他要来报仇， 来施行报应， 他必来拯救你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又对那些忧心的人说： "你们要刚强，不要惧怕。 看哪！你们的神，他要来报仇， 来施行报应， 他必来拯救你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对胆怯的人说： 你们要刚强，不要惧怕。 看哪，你们的神必来报仇， 必来施行极大的报应； 他必来拯救你们。
verses.textEnNiv: say to those with fearful hearts, "Be strong, do not fear; your God will come, he will come with vengeance; with divine retribution he will come to save you."
verses.textEnEsv: Say to those who have an anxious heart, "Be strong; fear not! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, with the recompense of God. He will come and save you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to those whoare fearful-hearted, "Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, With the recompense of God; He will come and save you."
verses.textEnNlt: Say to those with fearful hearts, "Be strong, and do not fear, for your God is coming to destroy your enemies. He is coming to save you."
verses.textEnNasb: Say to those with anxious heart, "Take courage, fear not. Behold, your God will come with vengeance; The retribution of God will come, But He will save you."
verses.textEn: say to those with fearful hearts, "Be strong, do not fear; your God will come, he will come with vengeance; with divine retribution he will come to save you."

verses.textZh: 那时，瞎子的眼必打开， 聋子的耳必畅通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，瞎子的眼必打开， 聋子的耳必畅通。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，瞎子的眼必睁开； 聋子的耳必开通。
verses.textEnNiv: Then will the eyes of the blind be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf unstopped;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, And the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.textEnNlt: And when he comes, he will open the eyes of the blind and unplug the ears of the deaf.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the eyes of those who are blind will be opened, And the ears of those who are deaf will be unstopped.
verses.textEn: Then will the eyes of the blind be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

verses.textZh: 那时，瘸子必像鹿一般跳跃， 哑巴的舌头必大声欢呼； 旷野必涌出大水， 沙漠必流出江河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，瘸子必像鹿一般跳跃， 哑巴的舌头必大声欢呼； 旷野必涌出大水， 沙漠必流出江河。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，瘸子必跳跃像鹿； 哑巴的舌头必能歌唱。 在旷野必有水发出； 在沙漠必有河涌流。
verses.textEnNiv: Then will the lame leap like a deer, and the mute tongue shout for joy. Water will gush forth in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: then shall the lame man leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute sing for joy. For waters break forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the lame shall leap like a deer, And the tongue of the dumb sing. For waters shall burst forth in the wilderness, And streams in the desert.
verses.textEnNlt: The lame will leap like a deer, and those who cannot speak will sing for joy! Springs will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams will water the wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: Then those who limp will leap like a deer, And the tongue of those who cannot speak will shout for joy. For waters will burst forth in the wilderness, And streams in the desert.
verses.textEn: Then will the lame leap like a deer, and the mute tongue shout for joy. Water will gush forth in the wilderness and streams in the desert.

verses.textZh: 灼热的沙地必变为水池， 干旱之地必变成泉源； 在野狗的住处，就是牠们躺卧之处， 必成为青草、芦苇和蒲草生长的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灼热的沙地必变为水池， 干旱之地必变成泉源； 在野狗的住处，就是牠们躺卧之处， 必成为青草、芦苇和蒲草生长的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 发光的沙 要变为水池； 干渴之地要变为泉源。 在野狗躺卧之处， 必有青草、芦苇，和蒲草。
verses.textEnNiv: The burning sand will become a pool, the thirsty ground bubbling springs. In the haunts where jackals once lay, grass and reeds and papyrus will grow.
verses.textEnEsv: the burning sand shall become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water; in the haunt of jackals, where they lie down, the grass shall become reeds and rushes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The parched ground shall become a pool, And the thirsty land springs of water; In the habitation of jackals, where each lay, Thereshallbe grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.textEnNlt: The parched ground will become a pool, and springs of water will satisfy the thirsty land. Marsh grass and reeds and rushes will flourish where desert jackals once lived.
verses.textEnNasb: The scorched land will become a pool And the thirsty ground springs of water; In the haunt of jackals, its resting place, Grass becomes reeds and rushes.
verses.textEn: The burning sand will become a pool, the thirsty ground bubbling springs. In the haunts where jackals once lay, grass and reeds and papyrus will grow.

verses.textZh: 那里必有一条大路， 要称为"圣路"； 不洁净的人不能经过， 那是为那些行走正路的人预备的； 愚昧的人不会在路上留连。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里必有一条大路， 要称为"圣路"； 不洁净的人不能经过， 那是为那些行走正路的人预备的； 愚昧的人不会在路上留连。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里必有一条大道， 称为圣路。 污秽人不得经过， 必专为赎民行走； 行路的人虽愚昧， 也不致失迷。
verses.textEnNiv: And a highway will be there; it will be called the Way of Holiness; it will be for those who walk on that Way. The unclean will not journey on it; wicked fools will not go about on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And a highway shall be there, and it shall be called the Way of Holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it. It shall belong to those who walk on the way; even if they are fools, they shall not go astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: A highway shall be there, and a road, And it shall be called the Highway of Holiness. The unclean shall not pass over it, But it shallbe for others. Whoever walks the road, although a fool, Shall not go astray.
verses.textEnNlt: And a great road will go through that once deserted land. It will be named the Highway of Holiness. Evil-minded people will never travel on it. It will be only for those who walk in God’s ways; fools will never walk there.
verses.textEnNasb: A highway will be there, a roadway, And it will be called the Highway of Holiness. The unclean will not travel on it, But it will be for the one who walks that way, And fools will not wander on it.
verses.textEn: And a highway will be there; it will be called the Way of Holiness; it will be for those who walk on that Way. The unclean will not journey on it; wicked fools will not go about on it.

verses.textZh: 那里必没有狮子， 猛兽也不会上去， 在那里必遇不见牠们；只有蒙救赎的人在那里行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里必没有狮子， 猛兽也不会上去， 在那里必遇不见牠们；只有蒙救赎的人在那里行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里必没有狮子， 猛兽也不登这路； 在那里都遇不见， 只有赎民在那里行走。
verses.textEnNiv: No lion will be there, nor any ravenous beast; they will not be found there. But only the redeemed will walk there,
verses.textEnEsv: No lion shall be there, nor shall any ravenous beast come up on it; they shall not be found there, but the redeemed shall walk there.
verses.textEnNkjv: No lion shall be there, Nor shall any ravenous beast go up on it; It shall not be found there. But the redeemed shall walk there,
verses.textEnNlt: Lions will not lurk along its course, nor any other ferocious beasts. There will be no other dangers. Only the redeemed will walk on it.
verses.textEnNasb: No lion will be there, Nor will any vicious animal go up on it; They will not be found there. But the redeemed will walk there,
verses.textEn: No lion will be there, nor any ravenous beast; they will not be found there. But only the redeemed will walk there,

verses.textZh: 蒙耶和华赎回的人必归回， 必欢呼地来到锡安； 永远的喜乐必临到他们的头上； 他们必得着欢喜和快乐， 忧愁和叹息都必逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蒙耶和华赎回的人必归回， 必欢呼地来到锡安； 永远的喜乐必临到他们的头上； 他们必得着欢喜和快乐， 忧愁和叹息都必逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且耶和华救赎的民必归回， 歌唱来到锡安； 永乐必归到他们的头上； 他们必得着欢喜快乐， 忧愁叹息尽都逃避。
verses.textEnNiv: and those the Lord has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, And come to Zion with singing, With everlasting joy on their heads. They shall obtain joy and gladness, And sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who have been ransomed by the Lord will return. They will enter Jerusalem singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Sorrow and mourning will disappear, and they will be filled with joy and gladness.
verses.textEnNasb: And the redeemed of the Lord will return And come to Zion with joyful shouting, And everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, And sorrow and sighing will flee away.
verses.textEn: and those the Lord has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

verses.textZh: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大所有的坚固城，并且把城攻取。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大所有的坚固城，并且把城攻取。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
verses.textEnNlt: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, King Sennacherib of Assyria came to attack the fortified towns of Judah and conquered them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria marched against all the fortified cities of Judah and seized them.
verses.textEn: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

verses.textZh: 亚述王从拉吉差派拉伯沙基，带领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他站在上池的水沟旁，就是在往漂布地之大路上的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王从拉吉差派拉伯沙基，带领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他站在上池的水沟旁，就是在往漂布地之大路上的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王从拉吉差遣拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king of Assyria sent his field commander with a large army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. When the commander stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field,
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem, with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool on the highway to the Washer’s Field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh with a great army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. And he stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool, on the highway to the Fuller’s Field.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king of Assyria sent his chief of staff from Lachish with a huge army to confront King Hezekiah in Jerusalem. The Assyrians took up a position beside the aqueduct that feeds water into the upper pool, near the road leading to the field where cloth is washed.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool on the road to the fuller’s field.
verses.textEn: Then the king of Assyria sent his field commander with a large army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. When the commander stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field,

verses.textZh: 希勒家的儿子管家以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都出来见他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希勒家的儿子管家以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都出来见他。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见拉伯沙基。
verses.textEnNiv: Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And there came out to him Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came out to him.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the officials who went out to meet with them: Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator; Shebna the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the royal historian.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the secretary, went out to him.
verses.textEn: Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to him.

verses.textZh: 拉伯沙基对他们说："你们去对希西家说：‘亚述大王这样说：你所倚靠的算得是甚么倚靠呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉伯沙基对他们说："你们去对希西家说：‘亚述大王这样说：你所倚靠的算得是甚么倚靠呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伯沙基对他们说：「你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说：『你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah: " ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?
verses.textEnEsv: And the Rabshakeh said to them, "Say to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: On what do you rest this trust of yours?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Rabshakeh said to them, "Say now to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: "What confidence is this in which you trust?
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Assyrian king’s chief of staff told them to give this message to Hezekiah: "This is what the great king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in that makes you so confident?
verses.textEnNasb: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Say now to Hezekiah, ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria says: "What is this confidence that you have?
verses.textEn: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah: " ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?

verses.textZh: 我说：你打仗所用的谋略和能力，不过是虚话罢了。你到底倚靠谁，以致你背叛我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说：你打仗所用的谋略和能力，不过是虚话罢了。你到底倚靠谁，以致你背叛我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你说，有打仗的计谋和能力，我看不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You say you have counsel and might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you think that mere words are strategy and power for war? In whom do you now trust, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.textEnNkjv: I say you speak of having plans and power for war; but theyare mere words. Now in whom do you trust, that you rebel against me?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think that mere words can substitute for military skill and strength? Who are you counting on, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.textEnNasb: I say, ‘Your plan and strength for the war are only empty words.’ Now on whom have you relied, that you have revolted against me?
verses.textEn: You say you have counsel and might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?

verses.textZh: 看哪！你所倚靠的埃及，是那压伤的芦苇杖；人若倚靠它，它就会插进他的手，把手刺透。埃及王法老对所有倚靠他的人，也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你所倚靠的埃及，是那压伤的芦苇杖；人若倚靠它，它就会插进他的手，把手刺透。埃及王法老对所有倚靠他的人，也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖，人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you are trusting in Egypt, that broken reed of a staff, which will pierce the hand of any man who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look! You are trusting in the staff of this broken reed, Egypt, on which if a man leans, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
verses.textEnNlt: On Egypt? If you lean on Egypt, it will be like a reed that splinters beneath your weight and pierces your hand. Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, is completely unreliable!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, you have relied on the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt, on which if a man leans, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who rely on him.
verses.textEn: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.

verses.textZh: 你若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华我们的神，这神所有的邱坛和祭坛岂不是都给希西家废去了，他还对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们只要在这祭坛面前敬拜吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华我们的神，这神所有的邱坛和祭坛岂不是都给希西家废去了，他还对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们只要在这祭坛面前敬拜吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华－我们的神。希西家岂不是将神的邱坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们当在这坛前敬拜吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But if you say to me, "We are depending on the Lord our God"—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar"?
verses.textEnEsv: But if you say to me, "We trust in the Lord our God," is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and to Jerusalem, "You shall worship before this altar"?
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the Lord our God,’ isit not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?" ’
verses.textEnNlt: "But perhaps you will say to me, ‘We are trusting in the Lord our God!’ But isn’t he the one who was insulted by Hezekiah? Didn’t Hezekiah tear down his shrines and altars and make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem worship only at the altar here in Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNasb: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the Lord our God,’ is it not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?
verses.textEn: But if you say to me, "We are depending on the Lord our God"—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar"?

verses.textZh: 现在你可以与我的主人亚述王打赌：我给你二千匹马，看你这一方面能否派出足够骑马的人来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你可以与我的主人亚述王打赌：我给你二千匹马，看你这一方面能否派出足够骑马的人来。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, I urge you, give a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses—if you are able on your part to put riders on them!
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ll tell you what! Strike a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you 2,000 horses if you can find that many men to ride on them!
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, come make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to put riders on them!
verses.textEn: " ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!

verses.textZh: 若不能，你怎能击退我主的臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车和马兵吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 若不能，你怎能击退我主的臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车和马兵吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？
verses.textEnNiv: How then can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen ?
verses.textEnEsv: How then can you repulse a single captain among the least of my master’s servants, when you trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.textEnNkjv: How then will you repel one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
verses.textEnNlt: With your tiny army, how can you think of challenging even the weakest contingent of my master’s troops, even with the help of Egypt’s chariots and charioteers?
verses.textEnNasb: How then can you drive back even one official of the least of my master’s servants and rely on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
verses.textEn: How then can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen ?

verses.textZh: 现在，我上来攻打这地，要把这地毁灭，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华曾对我说：你要上去攻打这地，把它毁灭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我上来攻打这地，要把这地毁灭，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华曾对我说：你要上去攻打这地，把它毁灭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说，你上去攻击毁灭这地吧！』」
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this land without the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, is it without the Lord that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The Lord said to me, "Go up against this land and destroy it."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? The Lord said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, do you think we have invaded your land without the Lord ’s direction? The Lord himself told us, ‘Attack this land and destroy it!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And have I now come up without the Lord’s approval against this land to destroy it? The Lord said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’ " ’ "
verses.textEn: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this land without the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ "

verses.textZh: 以利亚敬、舍伯那和约亚对拉伯沙基说："请你用亚兰语对你的仆人说话，因为我们听得懂；不要用犹大语对我们说话，免得城墙上的人民听见。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚敬、舍伯那和约亚对拉伯沙基说："请你用亚兰语对你的仆人说话，因为我们听得懂；不要用犹大语对我们说话，免得城墙上的人民听见。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚敬、舍伯那、约亚对拉伯沙基说：「求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Do not speak to us in the language of Judah within the hearing of the people who are on the wall."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people who are on the wall."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Assyrian chief of staff, "Please speak to us in Aramaic, for we understand it well. Don’t speak in Hebrew, for the people on the wall will hear."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Judean so that the people who are on the wall hear you."
verses.textEn: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."

verses.textZh: 但拉伯沙基说："我主差派我来，只是对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对那些坐在城墙上，要和你们一同吃自己的粪、喝自己的尿的人说吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但拉伯沙基说："我主差派我来，只是对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对那些坐在城墙上，要和你们一同吃自己的粪、喝自己的尿的人说吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伯沙基说：「我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上、要与你们一同吃自己粪喝自己尿的人说吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the Rabshakeh said, "Has my master sent me to speak these words to your master and to you, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are doomed with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Rabshakeh said, "Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat and drink their own waste with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Sennacherib’s chief of staff replied, "Do you think my master sent this message only to you and your master? He wants all the people to hear it, for when we put this city under siege, they will suffer along with you. They will be so hungry and thirsty that they will eat their own dung and drink their own urine."
verses.textEnNasb: But Rabshakeh said, "Has my master sent me only to your master and to you to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, doomed to eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?"
verses.textEn: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?"

verses.textZh: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大语大声呼喊说："你们要听亚述大王的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大语大声呼喊说："你们要听亚述大王的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说：「你们当听亚述大王的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the language of Judah: "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out with a loud voice in Hebrew, and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the chief of staff stood and shouted in Hebrew to the people on the wall, "Listen to this message from the great king of Assyria!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rabshakeh stood and called out with a loud voice in Judean and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEn: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

verses.textZh: 王这样说：‘你们不要被希西家欺骗了，因为他决不能拯救你们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 王这样说：‘你们不要被希西家欺骗了，因为他决不能拯救你们；
verses.textZhCuv: 王如此说：『你们不要被希西家欺哄了，因他不能拯救你们。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you!
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the king says: Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you. He will never be able to rescue you.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the king says: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to save you;
verses.textEn: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you!

verses.textZh: 也不要给希西家说服你们倚靠耶和华，说：耶和华必定拯救我们，这城也必不交在亚述王的手中。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不要给希西家说服你们倚靠耶和华，说：耶和华必定拯救我们，这城也必不交在亚述王的手中。’
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华说：耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
verses.textEnEsv: Do not let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord by saying, "The Lord will surely deliver us. This city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."
verses.textEnNkjv: nor let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, "The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let him fool you into trusting in the Lord by saying, ‘The Lord will surely rescue us. This city will never fall into the hands of the Assyrian king!’
verses.textEnNasb: and do not let Hezekiah lead you to rely on the Lord, saying, "The Lord will certainly save us. This city will not be handed over to the king of Assyria!"
verses.textEn: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’

verses.textZh: 不要听希西家的话，因为亚述王这样说：‘你们要与我和好 ，出来向我投降，这样各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，也可以喝自己井里的水；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要听希西家的话，因为亚述王这样说：‘你们要与我和好 ，出来向我投降，这样各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，也可以喝自己井里的水；
verses.textZhCuv: 不要听希西家的话，因亚述王如此说：你们要与我和好。出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not listen to Hezekiah. For thus says the king of Assyria: Make your peace with me and come out to me. Then each one of you will eat of his own vine, and each one of his own fig tree, and each one of you will drink the water of his own cistern,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make peace with me bya present and come out to me; and every one of you eat from his own vine and every one from his own fig tree, and every one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t listen to Hezekiah! These are the terms the king of Assyria is offering: Make peace with me—open the gates and come out. Then each of you can continue eating from your own grapevine and fig tree and drinking from your own well.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not listen to Hezekiah,’ for this is what the king of Assyria says: ‘ Surrender to me and come out to me, and eat, each one, of his vine and each of his fig tree, and each drink of the waters of his own cistern,
verses.textEn: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,

verses.textZh: 等到我来的时候，就会把你们领到一个与你们本地一样的地方；就是一个有五谷和新酒的地方，一个有粮食和葡萄园的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到我来的时候，就会把你们领到一个与你们本地一样的地方；就是一个有五谷和新酒的地方，一个有粮食和葡萄园的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 等我来领你们到一个地方，与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地。
verses.textEnNiv: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.textEnEsv: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.textEnNkjv: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will arrange to take you to another land like this one—a land of grain and new wine, bread and vineyards.
verses.textEnNasb: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.textEn: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.textZh: 你们要小心，免得希西家怂恿你们说：耶和华必拯救我们。列国的神有哪一位曾拯救自己的国土脱离亚述王的手呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要小心，免得希西家怂恿你们说：耶和华必拯救我们。列国的神有哪一位曾拯救自己的国土脱离亚述王的手呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨防，恐怕希西家劝导你们说：耶和华必拯救我们。列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’ Have the gods of any nations ever delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnEsv: Beware lest Hezekiah mislead you by saying, "The Lord will deliver us." Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, "The Lord will deliver us." Has any one of the gods of the nations delivered its land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t let Hezekiah mislead you by saying, ‘The Lord will rescue us!’ Have the gods of any other nations ever saved their people from the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnNasb: Beware that Hezekiah does not mislead you, saying, "The Lord will save us." Has any one of the gods of the nations saved his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEn: "Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’ Have the gods of any nations ever delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.textZh: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音的神在哪里呢？他们曾拯救撒玛利亚脱离我的手吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音的神在哪里呢？他们曾拯救撒玛利亚脱离我的手吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒马利亚脱离我的手吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?
verses.textEnEsv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Indeed, have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
verses.textEnNlt: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? And what about the gods of Sepharvaim? Did any god rescue Samaria from my power?
verses.textEnNasb: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? And when have they saved Samaria from my hand?
verses.textEn: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?

verses.textZh: 这些国所有的神中，有哪一个曾拯救自己的国土脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能拯救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些国所有的神中，有哪一个曾拯救自己的国土脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能拯救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？』」
verses.textEnNiv: Who of all the gods of these countries have been able to save their lands from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"
verses.textEnEsv: Who among all the gods of these lands have delivered their lands out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Who among all the gods of these lands have delivered their countries from my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: What god of any nation has ever been able to save its people from my power? So what makes you think that the Lord can rescue Jerusalem from me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Who among all the gods of these lands have saved their land from my hand, that the Lord would save Jerusalem from my hand?’ "
verses.textEn: Who of all the gods of these countries have been able to save their lands from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"

verses.textZh: 众人都默不作声，一句话也没有回答他，因为王的吩咐说："不要回答他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都默不作声，一句话也没有回答他，因为王的吩咐说："不要回答他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说：「不要回答他。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnEsv: But they were silent and answered him not a word, for the king’s command was, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they held their peace and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnNlt: But the people were silent and did not utter a word because Hezekiah had commanded them, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnNasb: But they were silent and did not answer him so much as a word; for the king’s command was, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEn: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."

verses.textZh: 于是希勒家的儿子管家以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家面前，把拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是希勒家的儿子管家以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家面前，把拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator; Shebna the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the royal historian, went back to Hezekiah. They tore their clothes in despair, and they went in to see the king and told him what the Assyrian chief of staff had said.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the secretary, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.textEn: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.

verses.textZh: 希西家王听见了，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王听见了，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王听见就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth and went into the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when King Hezekiah heard it, that he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Hezekiah heard their report, he tore his clothes and put on burlap and went into the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now when King Hezekiah heard the report, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and entered the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他差派管家以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他差派管家以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，
verses.textEnNiv: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNlt: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the court secretary, and the leading priests, all dressed in burlap, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the household, with Shebna the scribe and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
verses.textEn: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："希西家这样说：‘今日是急难、责罚和凌辱的日子，就像婴孩快要出生的时候，却没有气力生出来一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："希西家这样说：‘今日是急难、责罚和凌辱的日子，就像婴孩快要出生的时候，却没有气力生出来一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「希西家如此说：『今日是急难、责罚、凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。
verses.textEnNiv: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah, ‘This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace; children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to bring them forth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: ‘This day is a day of trouble and rebuke and blasphemy; for the children have come to birth, but thereis no strength to bring them forth.
verses.textEnNlt: They told him, "This is what King Hezekiah says: Today is a day of trouble, insults, and disgrace. It is like when a child is ready to be born, but the mother has no strength to deliver the baby.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "This is what Hezekiah says: ‘This day is a day of distress, rebuke, and humiliation; for children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.
verses.textEn: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

verses.textZh: 也许耶和华你的神听见拉伯沙基的话，就是他的主人亚述王派他来辱骂永活的神的话；耶和华你的神会因他所听见的话斥责他；因此，求你为余剩下来的人献上祷告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也许耶和华你的神听见拉伯沙基的话，就是他的主人亚述王派他来辱骂永活的神的话；耶和华你的神会因他所听见的话斥责他；因此，求你为余剩下来的人献上祷告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 或者耶和华－你的神听见拉伯沙基的话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生神的话；耶和华－你的神听见这话就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。』」
verses.textEnNiv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."
verses.textEnEsv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to mock the living God, and will rebuke the words that the Lord your God has heard; therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to reproach the living God, and will rebuke the words which the Lord your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But perhaps the Lord your God has heard the Assyrian chief of staff, sent by the king to defy the living God, and will punish him for his words. Oh, pray for those of us who are left!"
verses.textEnNasb: Perhaps the Lord your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to taunt the living God, and will avenge the words which the Lord your God has heard. Therefore, offer a prayer for the remnant that is left.’ "
verses.textEn: It may be that the Lord your God will hear the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."

verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚，
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。
verses.textEnNiv: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,
verses.textEnEsv: When the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.textEnNlt: After King Hezekiah’s officials delivered the king’s message to Isaiah,
verses.textEnNasb: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.textEn: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,

verses.textZh: 以赛亚对他们说："要对你们的主人这样说：‘耶和华这样说：你不要因为听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话而害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚对他们说："要对你们的主人这样说：‘耶和华这样说：你不要因为听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话而害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚对他们说：「要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说：『你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.textEnEsv: Isaiah said to them, "Say to your master, ‘Thus says the Lord : Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the young men of the king of Assyria have reviled me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Isaiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to your master, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Do not be afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
verses.textEnNlt: the prophet replied, "Say to your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be disturbed by this blasphemous speech against me from the Assyrian king’s messengers.
verses.textEnNasb: And Isaiah said to them, "This is what you shall say to your master: ‘This is what the Lord says: "Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
verses.textEn: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必使灵进入他里面，以致他听见风声就归回本地；我必使他在那里倒在刀下。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必使灵进入他里面，以致他听见风声就归回本地；我必使他在那里倒在刀下。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必惊动 他的心；他要听见风声就归回本地，我必使他在那里倒在刀下。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, so that he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land, and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! I myself will move against him, and the king will receive a message that he is needed at home. So he will return to his land, where I will have him killed with a sword.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am going to put a spirit in him so that he will hear news and return to his own land. And I will make him fall by the sword in his own land." ’ "
verses.textEn: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ "

verses.textZh: 拉伯沙基回去的时候，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿；原来他早已听闻亚述王拔营离开了拉吉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉伯沙基回去的时候，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿；原来他早已听闻亚述王拔营离开了拉吉。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿；原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。
verses.textEnNiv: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
verses.textEnEsv: The Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Assyrian chief of staff left Jerusalem and went to consult the king of Assyria, who had left Lachish and was attacking Libnah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.
verses.textEn: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

verses.textZh: 亚述王听到关于古实王特哈加的报告说："他出来要与你争战"；亚述王听见了，就差派使者去见希西家，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王听到关于古实王特哈加的报告说："他出来要与你争战"；亚述王听见了，就差派使者去见希西家，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说：「他出来要与你争战。」亚述王一听见，就打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:
verses.textEnEsv: Now the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Cush, "He has set out to fight against you." And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, "He has come out to make war with you." So when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Soon afterward King Sennacherib received word that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was leading an army to fight against him. Before leaving to meet the attack, he sent messengers back to Hezekiah in Jerusalem with this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Now he heard them say regarding Tirhakah king of Cush, "He has come out to fight against you," and when he heard it he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.textEn: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:

verses.textZh: "你们要对犹大王希西家这样说：不要给你所倚靠的神欺骗你说：耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要对犹大王希西家这样说：不要给你所倚靠的神欺骗你说：耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们对犹大王希西家如此说：『不要听你所倚靠的神欺哄你说：耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by promising that Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."
verses.textEnNlt: "This message is for King Hezekiah of Judah. Don’t let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you with promises that Jerusalem will not be captured by the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what you shall say to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by saying, "Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria."
verses.textEn: "Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’

verses.textZh: 你必定听过亚述列王向列国所行的，就是把她们完全毁灭，难道你还有救吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必定听过亚述列王向列国所行的，就是把她们完全毁灭，难道你还有救吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, devoting them to destruction. And shall you be delivered?
verses.textEnNkjv: Look! You have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by utterly destroying them; and shall you be delivered?
verses.textEnNlt: You know perfectly well what the kings of Assyria have done wherever they have gone. They have completely destroyed everyone who stood in their way! Why should you be any different?
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, you yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands, destroying them completely. So will you be saved?
verses.textEn: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?

verses.textZh: 我列祖所毁灭的国，有歌撒、哈兰、利色和在提．拉撒的伊甸人，这些国的神曾拯救她们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我列祖所毁灭的国，有歌撒、哈兰、利色和在提．拉撒的伊甸人，这些国的神曾拯救她们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散、哈兰、利色，和属提‧拉撒的伊甸人；这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?
verses.textEnEsv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, the nations that my fathers destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered those whom my fathers have destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.textEnNlt: Have the gods of other nations rescued them—such nations as Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Tel-assar? My predecessors destroyed them all!
verses.textEnNasb: Did the gods of the nations which my fathers destroyed save them: Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.textEn: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?

verses.textZh: 哈马的王、亚珥拔的王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿和以瓦的王，现在都在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈马的王、亚珥拔的王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿和以瓦的王，现在都在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 哈马的王，亚珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿和以瓦的王，都在哪里呢？』」
verses.textEnNiv: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?"
verses.textEnEsv: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, the king of Hena, or the king of Ivvah?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: What happened to the king of Hamath and the king of Arpad? What happened to the kings of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?"
verses.textEnNasb: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, and of Hena and Ivvah?’ "
verses.textEn: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?"

verses.textZh: 希西家从使者手里接过信卷，读完了，就上耶和华的殿，在耶和华面前把信卷展开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家从使者手里接过信卷，读完了，就上耶和华的殿，在耶和华面前把信卷展开。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord , and spread it before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: After Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it, he went up to the Lord ’s Temple and spread it out before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah took the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it, and he went up to the house of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：
verses.textEnNiv: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: And Hezekiah prayed this prayer before the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord :

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华，以色列的神，坐在二基路伯中间的啊！唯独你是地上万国的神；你创造了天地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华，以色列的神，坐在二基路伯中间的啊！唯独你是地上万国的神；你创造了天地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华－以色列的神啊，你－惟有你是天下万国的神，你曾创造天地。
verses.textEnNiv: " Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, theOne who dwells between the cherubim, You are God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, God of Israel, you are enthroned between the mighty cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the earth. You alone created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord of armies, God of Israel, who is enthroned above the cherubim, You are the God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You made heaven and earth.
verses.textEn: " Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听！耶和华啊，求你开眼察看！要听西拿基立的一切话，就是那差派使者来辱骂永活的神的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听！耶和华啊，求你开眼察看！要听西拿基立的一切话，就是那差派使者来辱骂永活的神的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听；耶和华啊，求你睁眼而看，要听西拿基立的一切话，他是打发使者来辱骂永生神的。
verses.textEnNiv: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to all the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.
verses.textEnEsv: Incline your ear, O Lord , and hear; open your eyes, O Lord , and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to mock the living God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, O Lord, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to reproach the living God.
verses.textEnNlt: Bend down, O Lord , and listen! Open your eyes, O Lord , and see! Listen to Sennacherib’s words of defiance against the living God.
verses.textEnNasb: Incline Your ear, Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, Lord, and see; and listen to all the words of Sennacherib, who sent them to taunt the living God.
verses.textEn: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to all the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！亚述列王果然使列国和他们的土地变成荒凉，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！亚述列王果然使列国和他们的土地变成荒凉，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，
verses.textEnNiv: "It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste all these peoples and their lands.
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, O Lord , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their lands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their lands,
verses.textEnNlt: "It is true, Lord , that the kings of Assyria have destroyed all these nations.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries and their lands,
verses.textEn: "It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste all these peoples and their lands.

verses.textZh: 又把列国的神都扔进火中；因为他们不是神，只是人手所做的，不过是木头和石头，所以他们就灭绝了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把列国的神都扔进火中；因为他们不是神，只是人手所做的，不过是木头和石头，所以他们就灭绝了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 将列国的神像都扔在火里；因为他本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头、石头的，所以灭绝他。
verses.textEnNiv: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: and have cast their gods into the fire. For they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they were destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were not gods, but the work of men’s hands—wood and stone. Therefore they destroyed them.
verses.textEnNlt: And they have thrown the gods of these nations into the fire and burned them. But of course the Assyrians could destroy them! They were not gods at all—only idols of wood and stone shaped by human hands.
verses.textEnNasb: and have thrown their gods into the fire, for they were not gods but only the work of human hands, wood and stone. So they have destroyed them.
verses.textEn: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神啊！现在求你拯救我们脱离亚述王的手，使地上万国都知道唯有你耶和华是神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神啊！现在求你拯救我们脱离亚述王的手，使地上万国都知道唯有你耶和华是神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神啊，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟有你是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Lord , are the only God. "
verses.textEnEsv: So now, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone are the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You are the Lord, You alone."
verses.textEnNlt: Now, O Lord our God, rescue us from his power; then all the kingdoms of the earth will know that you alone, O Lord , are God. "
verses.textEnNasb: But now Lord, our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, Lord, are God."
verses.textEn: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Lord , are the only God. "

verses.textZh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就派人去见希西家，说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘因为你向我祷告关于亚述王西拿基立的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就派人去见希西家，说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘因为你向我祷告关于亚述王西拿基立的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说：「耶和华－以色列的神如此说，你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Because you have prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel, ‘Because you have prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Because you prayed about King Sennacherib of Assyria,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent word to Hezekiah, saying, "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have prayed to Me about Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,

verses.textZh: 耶和华就有以下的话攻击他，说： 锡安的处女 藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子 在你背后摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就有以下的话攻击他，说： 锡安的处女 藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子 在你背后摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华论他这样说： 锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: this is the word the Lord has spoken against him: "Virgin Daughter Zion despises and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.
verses.textEnEsv: this is the word that the Lord has spoken concerning him: "‘She despises you, she scorns you— the virgin daughter of Zion; she wags her head behind you— the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: this is the word which the Lord has spoken concerning him: "The virgin, the daughter of Zion, Has despised you, laughed you to scorn; The daughter of Jerusalem Has shaken her head behind your back!
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord has spoken this word against him: "The virgin daughter of Zion despises you and laughs at you. The daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head in derision as you flee.
verses.textEnNasb: this is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: "She has shown contempt for you and derided you, The virgin daughter of Zion; The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head behind you!
verses.textEn: this is the word the Lord has spoken against him: "Virgin Daughter Zion despises and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.

verses.textZh: 你辱骂谁、亵渎谁？ 你扬起声音， 又高举眼目，要攻击谁？ 就是攻击以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你辱骂谁、亵渎谁？ 你扬起声音， 又高举眼目，要攻击谁？ 就是攻击以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 你辱骂谁，亵渎谁？ 扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？ 乃是攻击以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Whom have you mocked and reviled? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes to the heights? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice, And lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whom have you been defying and ridiculing? Against whom did you raise your voice? At whom did you look with such haughty eyes? It was the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: "Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? And against whom have you raised your voice And haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEn: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!

verses.textZh: 你借着你的臣仆辱骂主； 你又说：我率领我众多的战车上了群山的高峰， 到了黎巴嫩极深之处。 我砍伐其中高大的香柏树和佳美的松树； 我去到极高之处，进入肥田般的树林。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你借着你的臣仆辱骂主； 你又说：我率领我众多的战车上了群山的高峰， 到了黎巴嫩极深之处。 我砍伐其中高大的香柏树和佳美的松树； 我去到极高之处，进入肥田般的树林。
verses.textZhCuv: 你藉你的臣仆辱骂主说： 我率领许多战车上山顶， 到黎巴嫩极深之处； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树 和佳美的松树。 我必上极高之处， 进入肥田的树林。
verses.textEnNiv: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, ‘With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest heights, the finest of its forests.
verses.textEnEsv: By your servants you have mocked the Lord, and you have said, With my many chariots I have gone up the heights of the mountains, to the far recesses of Lebanon, to cut down its tallest cedars, its choicest cypresses, to come to its remotest height, its most fruitful forest.
verses.textEnNkjv: By your servants you have reproached the Lord, And said, ‘By the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, To the limits of Lebanon; I will cut down its tall cedars And its choice cypress trees; I will enter its farthest height, To its fruitful forest.
verses.textEnNlt: By your messengers you have defied the Lord. You have said, ‘With my many chariots I have conquered the highest mountains— yes, the remotest peaks of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars and its finest cypress trees. I have reached its farthest heights and explored its deepest forests.
verses.textEnNasb: "Through your servants you have taunted the Lord, And you have said, ‘With my many chariots I came up to the heights of the mountains, To the remotest parts of Lebanon; And I cut down its tall cedars and its choice junipers. And I will come to its highest peak, its thickest forest.
verses.textEn: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, ‘With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest heights, the finest of its forests.

verses.textZh: 我挖井和喝水； 我用我的脚掌 踏干埃及的河流。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我挖井和喝水； 我用我的脚掌 踏干埃及的河流。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经挖井喝水； 我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。
verses.textEnNiv: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.’
verses.textEnEsv: I dug wells and drank waters, to dry up with the sole of my foot all the streams of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have dug and drunk water, And with the soles of my feet I have dried up All the brooks of defense.’
verses.textEnNlt: I have dug wells in many foreign lands and refreshed myself with their water. With the sole of my foot, I stopped up all the rivers of Egypt!’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I dug wells and drank waters, And with the sole of my feet I dried up All the canals of Egypt.’
verses.textEn: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华说：‘难道你没有听见 古时我所安排， 往昔所计划的吗？ 现在我才使它成就， 使坚固的城镇荒废，变作乱堆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说：‘难道你没有听见 古时我所安排， 往昔所计划的吗？ 现在我才使它成就， 使坚固的城镇荒废，变作乱堆。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你岂没有听见 我早先所做的、古时所立的吗？ 现在藉你使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Have you not heard that I determined it long ago? I planned from days of old what now I bring to pass, that you should make fortified cities crash into heaps of ruins,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Did you not hear long ago How I made it, From ancient times that I formed it? Now I have brought it to pass, That you should be For crushing fortified cities into heaps of ruins.
verses.textEnNlt: "But have you not heard? I decided this long ago. Long ago I planned it, and now I am making it happen. I planned for you to crush fortified cities into heaps of rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you not heard? Long ago I did it, From ancient times I planned it. Now I have brought it about That you would turn fortified cities into ruined heaps.
verses.textEn: "Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.

verses.textZh: 因此，其中的居民软弱无力， 惊惶羞愧， 像田间的蔬菜和青绿的草， 又像房顶上的草，还没有长起来，就干焦了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，其中的居民软弱无力， 惊惶羞愧， 像田间的蔬菜和青绿的草， 又像房顶上的草，还没有长起来，就干焦了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 惊惶羞愧。 他们像野草，像青菜， 如房顶上的草， 又如田间未长成的禾稼。
verses.textEnNiv: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.
verses.textEnEsv: while their inhabitants, shorn of strength, are dismayed and confounded, and have become like plants of the field and like tender grass, like grass on the housetops, blighted before it is grown.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore their inhabitants had little power; They were dismayed and confounded; They were as the grass of the field And the green herb, As the grass on the housetops And grain blighted before it is grown.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why their people have so little power and are so frightened and confused. They are as weak as grass, as easily trampled as tender green shoots. They are like grass sprouting on a housetop, scorched before it can grow lush and tall.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore their inhabitants were powerless, They were shattered and put to shame; They were like the vegetation of the field and the green grass, Like grass on the housetops that is scorched before it has grown.
verses.textEn: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

verses.textZh: 你坐下， 你出，你入， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你坐下， 你出，你入， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。
verses.textEnNiv: "But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know your sitting down and your going out and coming in, and your raging against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I know your dwelling place, Your going out and your coming in, And your rage against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I know you well— where you stay and when you come and go. I know the way you have raged against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "But I know your sitting down, Your going out, your coming in, And your raging against Me.
verses.textEn: "But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.

verses.textZh: 因为你向我发烈怒， 又因你的狂傲达到我耳中， 我要把钩子放进你的鼻孔， 把嚼环放进你的嘴里， 使你从你来的路上回去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你向我发烈怒， 又因你的狂傲达到我耳中， 我要把钩子放进你的鼻孔， 把嚼环放进你的嘴里， 使你从你来的路上回去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你向我发烈怒， 又因你狂傲的话达到我耳中， 我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子， 把嚼环放在你口里， 使你从原路转回去。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have raged against me and your complacency has come to my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will turn you back on the way by which you came.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Because your rage against Me and your tumult Have come up to My ears, Therefore I will put My hook in your nose And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back By the way which you came." ’
verses.textEnNlt: And because of your raging against me and your arrogance, which I have heard for myself, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth. I will make you return by the same road on which you came."
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of your raging against Me And because your complacency has come up to My ears, I will put My hook in your nose And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back by the way that you came.
verses.textEn: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.

verses.textZh: 希西家啊！这要作你的兆头：今年你们要吃自生的，明年还要吃自长的，后年你们就要撒种，要收割，要栽种葡萄园，吃园中的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家啊！这要作你的兆头：今年你们要吃自生的，明年还要吃自长的，后年你们就要撒种，要收割，要栽种葡萄园，吃园中的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据：你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的，至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: "This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: "And this shall be the sign for you: this year you shall eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that. Then in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This shallbe a sign to you: You shall eat this year such as grows of itself, And the second year what springs from the same; Also in the third year sow and reap, Plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Here is the proof that what I say is true: "This year you will eat only what grows up by itself, and next year you will eat what springs up from that. But in the third year you will plant crops and harvest them; you will tend vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then this shall be the sign for you: you will eat this year what grows of itself, in the second year what grows from the same, and in the third year sow, harvest, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
verses.textEn: "This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

verses.textZh: 犹大家所逃脱的余民，必再向下扎根，往上结果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大家所逃脱的余民，必再向下扎根，往上结果。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.
verses.textEnEsv: And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah shall again take root downward and bear fruit upward.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the remnant who have escaped of the house of Judah Shall again take root downward, And bear fruit upward.
verses.textEnNlt: And you who are left in Judah, who have escaped the ravages of the siege, will put roots down in your own soil and grow up and flourish.
verses.textEnNasb: The survivors that are left of the house of Judah will again take root downward and bear fruit upward.
verses.textEn: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

verses.textZh: 因为余下的人必从耶路撒冷出来，逃脱的人必从锡安山出来。万军之耶和华的热心必作成这事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为余下的人必从耶路撒冷出来，逃脱的人必从锡安山出来。万军之耶和华的热心必作成这事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。万军之耶和华的热心必成就这事。
verses.textEnNiv: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.
verses.textEnEsv: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, And those who escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.
verses.textEnNlt: For a remnant of my people will spread out from Jerusalem, a group of survivors from Mount Zion. The passionate commitment of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will make this happen!
verses.textEnNasb: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go, and out of Mount Zion survivors. The zeal of the Lord of armies will perform this." ’
verses.textEn: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华这样论到亚述王，说：‘他必不会来到这城，也不会在这里射箭；不会拿着盾牌来到城前，也不会筑土垒攻城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华这样论到亚述王，说：‘他必不会来到这城，也不会在这里射箭；不会拿着盾牌来到城前，也不会筑土垒攻城。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以耶和华论亚述王如此说：他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: "He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there or come before it with a shield or cast up a siege mound against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria: ‘He shall not come into this city, Nor shoot an arrow there, Nor come before it with shield, Nor build a siege mound against it.
