verses.textEnNlt: "And this is what the Lord says about the king of Assyria: "‘His armies will not enter Jerusalem. They will not even shoot an arrow at it. They will not march outside its gates with their shields nor build banks of earth against its walls.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, this is what the Lord says about the king of Assyria: ‘He will not come to this city nor shoot an arrow there; and he will not come before it with a shield, nor heap up an assault ramp against it.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: "He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.

verses.textZh: 他从哪条路来，也必从哪条路回去；他必不得进入这城；这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从哪条路来，也必从哪条路回去；他必不得进入这城；这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: By the way that he came, by the same he shall return, and he shall not come into this city, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: By the way that he came, By the same shall he return; And he shall not come into this city,’ Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The king will return to his own country by the same road on which he came. He will not enter this city,’ says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: By the way that he came, by the same he will return, and he will not come to this city,’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护这城，拯救这城。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护这城，拯救这城。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant!"
verses.textEnEsv: For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For I will defend this city, to save it For My own sake and for My servant David’s sake.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: ‘For my own honor and for the sake of my servant David, I will defend this city and protect it.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For I will protect this city to save it for My own sake, and for My servant David’s sake.’ "
verses.textEn: "I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant!"

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中击杀了十八万五千人；到了早晨，有人起来，所见的都是死尸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中击杀了十八万五千人；到了早晨，有人起来，所见的都是死尸。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来一看，都是死尸了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord went out and struck down 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians. And when people arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the angel of the Lord went out, and killed in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred and eighty-five thousand; and when people arose early in the morning, there were the corpses—all dead.
verses.textEnNlt: That night the angel of the Lord went out to the Assyrian camp and killed 185,000 Assyrian soldiers. When the surviving Assyrians woke up the next morning, they found corpses everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord went out and struck 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians; and when the rest got up early in the morning, behold, all of the 185,000 were dead.
verses.textEn: Then the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!

verses.textZh: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营离去，返回本地，住在尼尼微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营离去，返回本地，住在尼尼微。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。
verses.textEnNiv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and returned home and lived at Nineveh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and went away, returned home, and remained at Nineveh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Sennacherib of Assyria broke camp and returned to his own land. He went home to his capital of Nineveh and stayed there.
verses.textEnNasb: So Sennacherib the king of Assyria departed and returned home and lived in Nineveh.
verses.textEn: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 他在自己的神尼斯洛庙里叩拜的时候，他的儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，然后逃到亚拉腊地。他的儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在自己的神尼斯洛庙里叩拜的时候，他的儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，然后逃到亚拉腊地。他的儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日在他的神－尼斯洛庙里叩拜，他儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him down with the sword. And after they escaped into the land of Ararat, Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Then Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: One day while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with their swords. They then escaped to the land of Ararat, and another son, Esarhaddon, became the next king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about, as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with the sword; and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And his son Esarhaddon became king in his place.
verses.textEn: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 那时，希西家患了重病，快要死去。亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知来见他，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你要把你的家整顿妥当，因为你快要死去，不能存活。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，希西家患了重病，快要死去。亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知来见他，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你要把你的家整顿妥当，因为你快要死去，不能存活。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时希西家病得要死，亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说：「耶和华如此说：你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死不能活了。」
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."
verses.textEnEsv: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, "Thus says the Lord : Set your house in order, for you shall die, you shall not recover."
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, went to him and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Set your house in order, for you shall die and not live.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: About that time Hezekiah became deathly ill, and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to visit him. He gave the king this message: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Set your affairs in order, for you are going to die. You will not recover from this illness.’"
verses.textEnNasb: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Set your house in order, for you are going to die and not live.’ "
verses.textEn: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."

verses.textZh: 希西家就转脸向墙，对耶和华祷告、
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家就转脸向墙，对耶和华祷告、
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说：
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: When Hezekiah heard this, he turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord,
verses.textEn: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 说："耶和华啊！求你记念我在你面前怎样诚诚实实、以纯全的心来行事，又作你眼中看为善的事。"然后，希西家就痛哭起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："耶和华啊！求你记念我在你面前怎样诚诚实实、以纯全的心来行事，又作你眼中看为善的事。"然后，希西家就痛哭起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华啊，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又做你眼中所看为善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Please, O Lord , remember how I have walked before you in faithfulness and with a whole heart, and have done what is good in your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "Remember now, O Lord, I pray, how I have walked before You in truth and with a loyal heart, and have done whatis good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember, O Lord , how I have always been faithful to you and have served you single-mindedly, always doing what pleases you." Then he broke down and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNasb: and said, "Please, Lord, just remember how I have walked before You wholeheartedly and in truth, and have done what is good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept profusely.
verses.textEn: "Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到以赛亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到以赛亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到以赛亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to Isaiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah:

verses.textZh: "你去告诉希西家：‘耶和华你祖先大卫的神这样说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪；看哪！我必在你的寿数上加添十五年。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去告诉希西家：‘耶和华你祖先大卫的神这样说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪；看哪！我必在你的寿数上加添十五年。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉希西家说，耶和华－你祖大卫的神如此说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪。我必加增你十五年的寿数；
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and tell Hezekiah, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will add fifteen years to your life.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and say to Hezekiah, Thus says the Lord , the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and tell Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the Lord, the God of David your father: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; surely I will add to your days fifteen years.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go back to Hezekiah and tell him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears. I will add fifteen years to your life,
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and say to Hezekiah, ‘This is what the Lord, the God of your father David says: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
verses.textEn: "Go and tell Hezekiah, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will add fifteen years to your life.

verses.textZh: 我必救你和这城脱离亚述王的手；我必保护这城。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必救你和这城脱离亚述王的手；我必保护这城。’
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手，也要保护这城。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.
verses.textEnEsv: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and will defend this city.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city." ’
verses.textEnNlt: and I will rescue you and this city from the king of Assyria. Yes, I will defend this city.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will save you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will protect this city." ’
verses.textEn: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.

verses.textZh: 以下就是耶和华给你的兆头，为要证明耶和华必成全他所说过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下就是耶和华给你的兆头，为要证明耶和华必成全他所说过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我－耶和华必成就我所说的。我先给你一个兆头，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised:
verses.textEnEsv: "This shall be the sign to you from the Lord , that the Lord will do this thing that he has promised:
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the sign to you from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing which He has spoken:
verses.textEnNlt: "‘And this is the sign from the Lord to prove that he will do as he promised:
verses.textEnNasb: "And this shall be the sign to you from the Lord, that the Lord will perform this word that He has spoken:
verses.textEn: " ‘This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised:

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要使亚哈斯日晷上那向前进的日影往后退十度。"于是那向前进的日影，果然在日晷上往后退了十度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要使亚哈斯日晷上那向前进的日影往后退十度。"于是那向前进的日影，果然在日晷上往后退了十度。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是叫亚哈斯的日晷，向前进的日影往后退十度。」于是，前进的日影果然在日晷上往后退了十度。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the shadow cast by the sun go back the ten steps it has gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.’ " So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had gone down.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will make the shadow cast by the declining sun on the dial of Ahaz turn back ten steps." So the sun turned back on the dial the ten steps by which it had declined.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will bring the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down with the sun on the sundial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward." So the sun returned ten degrees on the dial by which it had gone down.
verses.textEnNlt: I will cause the sun’s shadow to move ten steps backward on the sundial of Ahaz!’" So the shadow on the sundial moved backward ten steps.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I will make the shadow on the stairway, which has gone down with the sun on the stairway of Ahaz, go back ten steps." So the sun’s shadow went back ten steps on the stairway on which it had gone down.
verses.textEn: I will make the shadow cast by the sun go back the ten steps it has gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.’ " So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had gone down.

verses.textZh: 犹大王希西家从病患中痊愈以后，就写了这诗：
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王希西家从病患中痊愈以后，就写了这诗：
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王希西家患病已经痊愈，就作诗说：
verses.textEnNiv: A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:
verses.textEnEsv: A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, after he had been sick and had recovered from his sickness:
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick and had recovered from his sickness:
verses.textEnNlt: When King Hezekiah was well again, he wrote this poem:
verses.textEnNasb: This is a writing of Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:
verses.textEn: A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:

verses.textZh: 我曾说：在我盛年之际， 我竟要进入阴间之门； 我余剩的年日，竟被夺去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾说：在我盛年之际， 我竟要进入阴间之门； 我余剩的年日，竟被夺去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：正在我中年 之日 必进入阴间的门； 我余剩的年岁不得享受。
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "In the prime of my life must I go through the gates of death and be robbed of the rest of my years?"
verses.textEnEsv: I said, In the middle of my days I must depart; I am consigned to the gates of Sheol for the rest of my years.
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "In the prime of my life I shall go to the gates of Sheol; I am deprived of the remainder of my years."
verses.textEnNlt: I said, "In the prime of my life, must I now enter the place of the dead? Am I to be robbed of the rest of my years?"
verses.textEnNasb: I said, "In the middle of my life I am to enter the gates of Sheol; I have been deprived of the rest of my years."
verses.textEn: I said, "In the prime of my life must I go through the gates of death and be robbed of the rest of my years?"

verses.textZh: 我曾说：在活人之地， 我必不得见耶和华； 在世间的居民中，我必不再见到任何人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾说：在活人之地， 我必不得见耶和华； 在世间的居民中，我必不再见到任何人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：我必不得见耶和华， 就是在活人之地不见耶和华； 我与世上的居民不再见面。
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "I will not again see the Lord himself in the land of the living; no longer will I look on my fellow man, or be with those who now dwell in this world.
verses.textEnEsv: I said, I shall not see the Lord , the Lord in the land of the living; I shall look on man no more among the inhabitants of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "I shall not see Yah, The Lord in the land of the living; I shall observe man no more among the inhabitants of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: I said, "Never again will I see the Lord God while still in the land of the living. Never again will I see my friends or be with those who live in this world.
verses.textEnNasb: I said, "I will not see the Lord, The Lord in the land of the living; I will no longer look on mankind among the inhabitants of the world.
verses.textEn: I said, "I will not again see the Lord himself in the land of the living; no longer will I look on my fellow man, or be with those who now dwell in this world.

verses.textZh: 我的住处被拔起，迁离了我，像牧人的帐棚一样； 我卷起我的性命，像织布的卷布一样； 他把我从机头剪断； 一日之间，他必使我生命终结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的住处被拔起，迁离了我，像牧人的帐棚一样； 我卷起我的性命，像织布的卷布一样； 他把我从机头剪断； 一日之间，他必使我生命终结。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的住处被迁去离开我， 好像牧人的帐棚一样； 我将性命卷起， 像织布的卷布一样。 耶和华必将我从机头剪断， 从早到晚，他要使我完结。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a shepherd’s tent my house has been pulled down and taken from me. Like a weaver I have rolled up my life, and he has cut me off from the loom; day and night you made an end of me.
verses.textEnEsv: My dwelling is plucked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent; like a weaver I have rolled up my life; he cuts me off from the loom; from day to night you bring me to an end;
verses.textEnNkjv: My life span is gone, Taken from me like a shepherd’s tent; I have cut off my life like a weaver. He cuts me off from the loom; From day until night You make an end of me.
verses.textEnNlt: My life has been blown away like a shepherd’s tent in a storm. It has been cut short, as when a weaver cuts cloth from a loom. Suddenly, my life was over.
verses.textEnNasb: "Like a shepherd’s tent my dwelling is pulled up and removed from me; As a weaver I rolled up my life. He cuts me off from the loom; From day until night You make an end of me.
verses.textEn: Like a shepherd’s tent my house has been pulled down and taken from me. Like a weaver I have rolled up my life, and he has cut me off from the loom; day and night you made an end of me.

verses.textZh: 我不断哀叹，直到早晨， 他像狮子一般，折断我所有的骨头； 一日之间，他必使我生命终结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不断哀叹，直到早晨， 他像狮子一般，折断我所有的骨头； 一日之间，他必使我生命终结。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使自己安静直到天亮； 他像狮子折断我一切的骨头， 从早到晚，他要使我完结。
verses.textEnNiv: I waited patiently till dawn, but like a lion he broke all my bones; day and night you made an end of me.
verses.textEnEsv: I calmed myself until morning; like a lion he breaks all my bones; from day to night you bring me to an end.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have considered until morning— Like a lion, So He breaks all my bones; From day until night You make an end of me.
verses.textEnNlt: I waited patiently all night, but I was torn apart as though by lions. Suddenly, my life was over.
verses.textEnNasb: "I composed my soul until morning. Like a lion—so He breaks all my bones, From day until night You make an end of me.
verses.textEn: I waited patiently till dawn, but like a lion he broke all my bones; day and night you made an end of me.

verses.textZh: 我像燕子呻吟，像白鹤鸣叫， 又像鸽子哀鸣。 我的眼睛因仰望高处而疲倦； 耶和华啊！我受欺压，求你作我的保障。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我像燕子呻吟，像白鹤鸣叫， 又像鸽子哀鸣。 我的眼睛因仰望高处而疲倦； 耶和华啊！我受欺压，求你作我的保障。
verses.textZhCuv: 我像燕子呢喃， 像白鹤鸣叫， 又像鸽子哀鸣； 我因仰观，眼睛困倦。 耶和华啊，我受欺压， 求你为我作保。
verses.textEnNiv: I cried like a swift or thrush, I moaned like a mourning dove. My eyes grew weak as I looked to the heavens. I am being threatened; Lord, come to my aid!"
verses.textEnEsv: Like a swallow or a crane I chirp; I moan like a dove. My eyes are weary with looking upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my pledge of safety!
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a crane or a swallow, so I chattered; I mourned like a dove; My eyes fail fromlooking upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; Undertake for me!
verses.textEnNlt: Delirious, I chattered like a swallow or a crane, and then I moaned like a mourning dove. My eyes grew tired of looking to heaven for help. I am in trouble, Lord. Help me!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Like a swallow, like a crane, so I twitter; I moan like a dove; My eyes look wistfully to the heights; Lord, I am oppressed, be my security.
verses.textEn: I cried like a swift or thrush, I moaned like a mourning dove. My eyes grew weak as I looked to the heavens. I am being threatened; Lord, come to my aid!"

verses.textZh: 我可说甚么呢？ 他应许我的，已给我成全了； 因我的心曾受过苦楚，所以我要谨慎地度我所有的年日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我可说甚么呢？ 他应许我的，已给我成全了； 因我的心曾受过苦楚，所以我要谨慎地度我所有的年日。
verses.textZhCuv: 我可说什么呢？ 他应许我的，也给我成就了。 我因心里的苦楚， 在一生的年日必悄悄而行。
verses.textEnNiv: But what can I say? He has spoken to me, and he himself has done this. I will walk humbly all my years because of this anguish of my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: What shall I say? For he has spoken to me, and he himself has done it. I walk slowly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: "What shall I say? He has both spoken to me, And He Himself has done it. I shall walk carefully all my years In the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: But what could I say? For he himself sent this sickness. Now I will walk humbly throughout my years because of this anguish I have felt.
verses.textEnNasb: "What shall I say? For He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done it; I will walk quietly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEn: But what can I say? He has spoken to me, and he himself has done this. I will walk humbly all my years because of this anguish of my soul.

verses.textZh: 主啊！人活着是在于这些， 我的灵存活，也在于这些。 所以求你使我恢复健康，使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！人活着是在于这些， 我的灵存活，也在于这些。 所以求你使我恢复健康，使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，人得存活乃在乎此。 我灵存活也全在此。 所以求你使我痊愈，仍然存活。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, by such things people live; and my spirit finds life in them too. You restored me to health and let me live.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these is the life of my spirit. Oh restore me to health and make me live!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, by these thingsmen live; And in all these thingsis the life of my spirit; So You will restore me and make me live.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord, your discipline is good, for it leads to life and health. You restore my health and allow me to live!
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord, by these things people live, And in all these is the life of my spirit; Restore me to health and let me live!
verses.textEn: Lord, by such things people live; and my spirit finds life in them too. You restored me to health and let me live.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我受尽苦楚，为要使我得平安； 你保全我的性命，脱离毁灭的坑， 因为你把我的一切罪都丢在你的背后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我受尽苦楚，为要使我得平安； 你保全我的性命，脱离毁灭的坑， 因为你把我的一切罪都丢在你的背后。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我受大苦，本为使我得平安； 你因爱我的灵魂 便救我脱离败坏的坑， 因为你将我一切的罪扔在你的背后。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely it was for my benefit that I suffered such anguish. In your love you kept me from the pit of destruction; you have put all my sins behind your back.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, it was for my welfare that I had great bitterness; but in love you have delivered my life from the pit of destruction, for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed itwas for myown peace That I had great bitterness; But You have lovingly delivered my soul from the pit of corruption, For You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, this anguish was good for me, for you have rescued me from death and forgiven all my sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, for my own welfare I had great bitterness; But You have kept my soul from the pit of nothingness, For You have hurled all my sins behind Your back.
verses.textEn: Surely it was for my benefit that I suffered such anguish. In your love you kept me from the pit of destruction; you have put all my sins behind your back.

verses.textZh: 阴间不能称谢你， 死亡不能赞美你， 下坑的人都不能仰望你的信实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴间不能称谢你， 死亡不能赞美你， 下坑的人都不能仰望你的信实。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来，阴间不能称谢你， 死亡不能颂扬你； 下坑的人不能盼望你的诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: For the grave cannot praise you, death cannot sing your praise; those who go down to the pit cannot hope for your faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: For Sheol does not thank you; death does not praise you; those who go down to the pit do not hope for your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Sheol cannot thank You, Death cannot praise You; Those who go down to the pit cannot hope for Your truth.
verses.textEnNlt: For the dead cannot praise you; they cannot raise their voices in praise. Those who go down to the grave can no longer hope in your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: "For Sheol cannot thank You, Death cannot praise You; Those who go down to the pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
verses.textEn: For the grave cannot praise you, death cannot sing your praise; those who go down to the pit cannot hope for your faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 只有活人才能称谢你，像我今日一样； 作父亲的，要让儿女知道你的信实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有活人才能称谢你，像我今日一样； 作父亲的，要让儿女知道你的信实。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有活人，活人必称谢你， 像我今日称谢你一样。 为父的，必使儿女知道你的诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: The living, the living—they praise you, as I am doing today; parents tell their children about your faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: The living, the living, he thanks you, as I do this day; the father makes known to the children your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The living, the living man, he shall praise You, As I do this day; The father shall make known Your truth to the children.
verses.textEnNlt: Only the living can praise you as I do today. Each generation tells of your faithfulness to the next.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is the living who give thanks to You, as I do today; A father tells his sons about Your faithfulness.
verses.textEn: The living, the living—they praise you, as I am doing today; parents tell their children about your faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必拯救我， 因此我们要一生一世在耶和华的殿中， 用丝弦的乐器弹奏我的诗歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必拯救我， 因此我们要一生一世在耶和华的殿中， 用丝弦的乐器弹奏我的诗歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华肯救我， 所以，我们要一生一世 在耶和华殿中 用丝弦的乐器唱我的诗歌。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will save me, and we will sing with stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will save me, and we will play my music on stringed instruments all the days of our lives, at the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lordwasready to save me; Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments All the days of our life, in the house of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Think of it—the Lord is ready to heal me! I will sing his praises with instruments every day of my life in the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord is certain to save me; So we will play my songs on stringed instruments All the days of our life at the house of the Lord."
verses.textEn: The Lord will save me, and we will sing with stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以赛亚说："叫人拿一块无花果饼来，贴在疮上，王就必痊愈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚说："叫人拿一块无花果饼来，贴在疮上，王就必痊愈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚说：「当取一块无花果饼来，贴在疮上，王必痊愈。」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaiah had said, "Prepare a poultice of figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Isaiah had said, "Let them take a cake of figs and apply it to the boil, that he may recover."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Isaiah had said, "Let them take a lump of figs, and apply it as a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover."
verses.textEnNlt: Isaiah had said to Hezekiah’s servants, "Make an ointment from figs and spread it over the boil, and Hezekiah will recover."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Isaiah had said, "Have them take a cake of figs and apply it to the boil, so that he may recover."
verses.textEn: Isaiah had said, "Prepare a poultice of figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover."

verses.textZh: 希西家问："我能上耶和华的殿去，有甚么兆头呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家问："我能上耶和华的殿去，有甚么兆头呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家问说：「我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah had asked, "What will be the sign that I will go up to the temple of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnEsv: Hezekiah also had said, "What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah had said, "What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: And Hezekiah had asked, "What sign will prove that I will go to the Temple of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah had said, "What is the sign that I will go up to the house of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: Hezekiah had asked, "What will be the sign that I will go up to the temple of the Lord ?"

verses.textZh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达．巴拉但，听说希西家病了，又痊愈了，就派人送信和礼物给希西家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达．巴拉但，听说希西家病了，又痊愈了，就派人送信和礼物给希西家。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达‧巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of his illness and recovery.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent envoys with letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick and had recovered.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Merodach-Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick and had recovered.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this, Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent Hezekiah his best wishes and a gift. He had heard that Hezekiah had been very sick and that he had recovered.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick and had recovered.
verses.textEn: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of his illness and recovery.

verses.textZh: 希西家就十分高兴，并且把他的宝库、银子、金子、香料和贵重的油，以及他整个武器库里和他府库里的一切物件，都给使者们看；他家里和他全国里的东西，希西家没有一样不给他们看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家就十分高兴，并且把他的宝库、银子、金子、香料和贵重的油，以及他整个武器库里和他府库里的一切物件，都给使者们看；他家里和他全国里的东西，希西家没有一样不给他们看。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家喜欢见使者，就把自己宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并所有的财宝都给他们看；他家中和全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah received the envoys gladly and showed them what was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices, the fine olive oil—his entire armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah welcomed them gladly. And he showed them his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil, his whole armory, all that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his treasures—the silver and gold, the spices and precious ointment, and all his armory—all that was found among his treasures. There was nothing in his house or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah was delighted with the Babylonian envoys and showed them everything in his treasure-houses—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the aromatic oils. He also took them to see his armory and showed them everything in his royal treasuries! There was nothing in his palace or kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnNasb: Hezekiah was pleased, and let them see all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the balsam oil, the excellent olive oil, his entire armory, and everything that was found in his treasuries. There was nothing in his house nor in all his realm that Hezekiah did not let them see.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah received the envoys gladly and showed them what was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices, the fine olive oil—his entire armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.

verses.textZh: 于是以赛亚先知来见希西家王，问他说："这些人说了些甚么？他们从哪里来见你？"希西家说："他们是从远方的巴比伦来见我的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以赛亚先知来见希西家王，问他说："这些人说了些甚么？他们从哪里来见你？"希西家说："他们是从远方的巴比伦来见我的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说什么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来见我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came to me from Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, "What did these men say? And from where did they come to you?" Hezekiah said, "They have come to me from a far country, from Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah, and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?" So Hezekiah said, "They came to me from a far country, from Babylon."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked him, "What did those men want? Where were they from?" Hezekiah replied, "They came from the distant land of Babylon."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?" And Hezekiah said, "They came to me from a far country, from Babylon."
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came to me from Babylon."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚又问："他们在你家里看见了甚么？"希西家回答："我家中所有的，他们都看了；我的财宝中，没有一样不给他们看。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚又问："他们在你家里看见了甚么？"希西家回答："我家中所有的，他们都看了；我的财宝中，没有一样不给他们看。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了什么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "What have they seen in your house?" Hezekiah answered, "They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "What have they seen in your house?" So Hezekiah answered, "They have seen all that is in my house; there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them."
verses.textEnNlt: "What did they see in your palace?" asked Isaiah. "They saw everything," Hezekiah replied. "I showed them everything I own—all my royal treasuries."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "What have they seen in your house?" So Hezekiah answered, "They have seen everything that is in my house; there is nothing among my treasuries that I have not let them see."
verses.textEn: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚对希西家说："你要听万军之耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚对希西家说："你要听万军之耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听万军之耶和华的话：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord Almighty:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Listen to this message from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies:
verses.textEnNasb: Isaiah then said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord of armies,
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord Almighty:

verses.textZh: 看哪！日子必到，你家中所有的，以及你列祖所积蓄到今日的，都要被带到巴比伦去，一样也不留，这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！日子必到，你家中所有的，以及你列祖所积蓄到今日的，都要被带到巴比伦去，一样也不留，这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样；这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up till this day, shall be carried to Babylon. Nothing shall be left, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and what your fathers have accumulated until this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘The time is coming when everything in your palace—all the treasures stored up by your ancestors until now—will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, the days are coming when everything that is in your house, and what your fathers have stored up to this day, will be carried to Babylon; nothing will be left,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEn: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 从你所出的众子，就是你所生的，其中必有被掳去的，在巴比伦王宫里作太监。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从你所出的众子，就是你所生的，其中必有被掳去的，在巴比伦王宫里作太监。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去、在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」
verses.textEnNiv: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: And some of your own sons, who will come from you, whom you will father, shall be taken away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And they shall take away some of your sons who will descend from you, whom you will beget; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Some of your very own sons will be taken away into exile. They will become eunuchs who will serve in the palace of Babylon’s king.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And some of your sons who will come from you, whom you will father, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEn: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

verses.textZh: 希西家对以赛亚说："你所说耶和华的话不错呀！"因为他心里想："在我有生之日，必有平安和稳固。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家对以赛亚说："你所说耶和华的话不错呀！"因为他心里想："在我有生之日，必有平安和稳固。"
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好，因为在我的年日中必有太平和稳固的景况。」
verses.textEnNiv: "The word of the Lord you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "There will be peace and security in my lifetime."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord that you have spoken is good." For he thought, "There will be peace and security in my days."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord which you have spoken is good!" For he said, "At least there will be peace and truth in my days."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "This message you have given me from the Lord is good." For the king was thinking, "At least there will be peace and security during my lifetime."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord which you have spoken is good." For he thought, "For there will be peace and truth in my days."
verses.textEn: "The word of the Lord you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "There will be peace and security in my lifetime."

verses.textZh: 你们的神说： "你们要安慰，要安慰我的子民！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的神说： "你们要安慰，要安慰我的子民！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的神说： 你们要安慰，安慰我的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Comfort, yes, comfort My people!" Says your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Comfort, comfort my people," says your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Comfort, comfort My people," says your God.
verses.textEn: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.

verses.textZh: 你们要向耶路撒冷说慈爱的话， 又要向它宣告：他们的苦难已经满足了， 他们的罪孽已经还清了， 他们因着自己的一切罪， 已经从耶和华的手里受到过重的刑罚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向耶路撒冷说慈爱的话， 又要向它宣告：他们的苦难已经满足了， 他们的罪孽已经还清了， 他们因着自己的一切罪， 已经从耶和华的手里受到过重的刑罚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要对耶路撒冷说安慰的话， 又向她宣告说， 她争战的日子已满了； 她的罪孽赦免了； 她为自己的一切罪， 从耶和华手中加倍受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her hard service has been completed, that her sin has been paid for, that she has received from the Lord ’s hand double for all her sins.
verses.textEnEsv: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and cry to her that her warfare is ended, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received from the Lord ’s hand double for all her sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak comfort to Jerusalem, and cry out to her, That her warfare is ended, That her iniquity is pardoned; For she has received from the Lord’s hand Double for all her sins."
verses.textEnNlt: "Speak tenderly to Jerusalem. Tell her that her sad days are gone and her sins are pardoned. Yes, the Lord has punished her twice over for all her sins."
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak kindly to Jerusalem; And call out to her, that her warfare has ended, That her guilt has been removed, That she has received of the Lord’s hand Double for all her sins."
verses.textEn: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her hard service has been completed, that her sin has been paid for, that she has received from the Lord ’s hand double for all her sins.

verses.textZh: 有声音呼喊说： "你们要在旷野清理耶和华的路， 在沙漠修直我们神的大道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有声音呼喊说： "你们要在旷野清理耶和华的路， 在沙漠修直我们神的大道。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人声喊着说： 在旷野预备耶和华的路 ， 在沙漠地修平我们神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: A voice of one calling: "In the wilderness prepare the way for the Lord ; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.textEnEsv: A voice cries: "In the wilderness prepare the way of the Lord ; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Prepare the way of the Lord; Make straight in the desert A highway for our God.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! It’s the voice of someone shouting, "Clear the way through the wilderness for the Lord ! Make a straight highway through the wasteland for our God!
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of one calling out, "Clear the way for the Lord in the wilderness; Make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.textEn: A voice of one calling: "In the wilderness prepare the way for the Lord ; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

verses.textZh: 一切深谷都要填满， 一切山冈都要削平； 险峻的要改为平地， 崎岖的要改为平原。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切深谷都要填满， 一切山冈都要削平； 险峻的要改为平地， 崎岖的要改为平原。
verses.textZhCuv: 一切山洼都要填满， 大小山冈都要削平； 高高低低的要改为平坦， 崎崎岖岖的必成为平原。
verses.textEnNiv: Every valley shall be raised up, every mountain and hill made low; the rough ground shall become level, the rugged places a plain.
verses.textEnEsv: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill be made low; the uneven ground shall become level, and the rough places a plain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every valley shall be exalted And every mountain and hill brought low; The crooked places shall be made straight And the rough places smooth;
verses.textEnNlt: Fill in the valleys, and level the mountains and hills. Straighten the curves, and smooth out the rough places.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let every valley be lifted up, And every mountain and hill be made low; And let the uneven ground become a plain, And the rugged terrain a broad valley;
verses.textEn: Every valley shall be raised up, every mountain and hill made low; the rough ground shall become level, the rugged places a plain.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的荣耀必要显现， 所有的人都必一同看见， 因为这是耶和华亲口说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的荣耀必要显现， 所有的人都必一同看见， 因为这是耶和华亲口说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣耀必然显现； 凡有血气的必一同看见； 因为这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textEnNiv: And the glory of the Lord will be revealed, and all people will see it together. For the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnEsv: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together, for the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: The glory of the Lord shall be revealed, And all flesh shall see it together; For the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the glory of the Lord will be revealed, and all people will see it together. The Lord has spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the glory of the Lord will be revealed, And all flesh will see it together; For the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEn: And the glory of the Lord will be revealed, and all people will see it together. For the mouth of the Lord has spoken."

verses.textZh: 有声音说："你呼喊吧！" 他问 ："我呼喊甚么呢？" "所有的人尽都如草； 他们的荣美都像野地的花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有声音说："你呼喊吧！" 他问 ："我呼喊甚么呢？" "所有的人尽都如草； 他们的荣美都像野地的花。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人声说：你喊叫吧！ 有一个说：我喊叫什么呢？ 说：凡有血气的尽都如草； 他的美容都像野地的花。
verses.textEnNiv: A voice says, "Cry out." And I said, "What shall I cry?" "All people are like grass, and all their faithfulness is like the flowers of the field.
verses.textEnEsv: A voice says, "Cry!" And I said, "What shall I cry?" All flesh is grass, and all its beauty is like the flower of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice said, "Cry out!" And he said, "What shall I cry?" "All flesh is grass, And all its loveliness is like the flower of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: A voice said, "Shout!" I asked, "What should I shout?" "Shout that people are like the grass. Their beauty fades as quickly as the flowers in a field.
verses.textEnNasb: A voice says, "Call out." Then he answered, "What shall I call out?" All flesh is grass, and all its loveliness is like the flower of the field.
verses.textEn: A voice says, "Cry out." And I said, "What shall I cry?" "All people are like grass, and all their faithfulness is like the flowers of the field.

verses.textZh: 草必枯干，花必凋谢； 因为耶和华的气吹在上面； 真的，这民的确是草！
verses.textZhCnvs: 草必枯干，花必凋谢； 因为耶和华的气吹在上面； 真的，这民的确是草！
verses.textZhCuv: 草必枯干，花必凋残， 因为耶和华的气吹在其上； 百姓诚然是草。
verses.textEnNiv: The grass withers and the flowers fall, because the breath of the Lord blows on them. Surely the people are grass.
verses.textEnEsv: The grass withers, the flower fades when the breath of the Lord blows on it; surely the people are grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grass withers, the flower fades, Because the breath of the Lord blows upon it; Surely the people are grass.
verses.textEnNlt: The grass withers and the flowers fade beneath the breath of the Lord . And so it is with people.
verses.textEnNasb: The grass withers, the flower fades, When the breath of the Lord blows upon it; The people are indeed grass!
verses.textEn: The grass withers and the flowers fall, because the breath of the Lord blows on them. Surely the people are grass.

verses.textZh: 草必枯干，花必凋谢， 唯有我们神的道永远长存。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 草必枯干，花必凋谢， 唯有我们神的道永远长存。"
verses.textZhCuv: 草必枯干，花必凋残， 惟有我们神的话必永远立定。
verses.textEnNiv: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: The grass withers, the flower fades, but the word of our God will stand forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grass withers, the flower fades, But the word of our God stands forever."
verses.textEnNlt: The grass withers and the flowers fade, but the word of our God stands forever."
verses.textEnNasb: The grass withers, the flower fades, But the word of our God stands forever.
verses.textEn: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever."

verses.textZh: 报好信息给锡安的啊！ 你要登上高山。 报好信息给耶路撒冷的啊！ 你要极力扬声。 要扬声，不要惧怕！ 要对犹大的众城说： "看哪，你们的神！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 报好信息给锡安的啊！ 你要登上高山。 报好信息给耶路撒冷的啊！ 你要极力扬声。 要扬声，不要惧怕！ 要对犹大的众城说： "看哪，你们的神！"
verses.textZhCuv: 报好信息给锡安的啊， 你要登高山； 报好信息给耶路撒冷的啊， 你要极力扬声。 扬声不要惧怕， 对犹大的城邑说： 看哪，你们的神！
verses.textEnNiv: You who bring good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who bring good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with a shout, lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the towns of Judah, "Here is your God!"
verses.textEnEsv: Go on up to a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good news; lift up your voice with strength, O Jerusalem, herald of good news; lift it up, fear not; say to the cities of Judah, "Behold your God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: O Zion, You who bring good tidings, Get up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, You who bring good tidings, Lift up your voice with strength, Lift it up, be not afraid; Say to the cities of Judah, "Behold your God!"
verses.textEnNlt: O Zion, messenger of good news, shout from the mountaintops! Shout it louder, O Jerusalem. Shout, and do not be afraid. Tell the towns of Judah, "Your God is coming!"
verses.textEnNasb: Go up on a high mountain, Zion, messenger of good news, Raise your voice forcefully, Jerusalem, messenger of good news; Raise it up, do not fear. Say to the cities of Judah, "Here is your God!"
verses.textEn: You who bring good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who bring good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with a shout, lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the towns of Judah, "Here is your God!"

verses.textZh: 看哪！主耶和华必像大能者临到， 他的膀臂要为他掌权； 看哪！他给予人的赏赐在他那里， 他施予人的报应在他面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！主耶和华必像大能者临到， 他的膀臂要为他掌权； 看哪！他给予人的赏赐在他那里， 他施予人的报应在他面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华必像大能者临到； 他的膀臂必为他掌权。 他的赏赐在他那里； 他的报应在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the Sovereign Lord comes with power, and he rules with a mighty arm. See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord God comes with might, and his arm rules for him; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the Lord God shall come with a strong hand, And His arm shall rule for Him; Behold, His reward is with Him, And His work before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the Sovereign Lord is coming in power. He will rule with a powerful arm. See, he brings his reward with him as he comes.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord God will come with might, With His arm ruling for Him. Behold, His compensation is with Him, And His reward before Him.
verses.textEn: See, the Sovereign Lord comes with power, and he rules with a mighty arm. See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.

verses.textZh: 他必像牧人牧养自己的羊群， 像用膀臂聚集羊羔， 抱在自己的怀中， 慢慢引导乳养小羊的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像牧人牧养自己的羊群， 像用膀臂聚集羊羔， 抱在自己的怀中， 慢慢引导乳养小羊的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必像牧人牧养自己的羊群， 用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在怀中， 慢慢引导那乳养小羊的。
verses.textEnNiv: He tends his flock like a shepherd: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart; he gently leads those that have young.
verses.textEnEsv: He will tend his flock like a shepherd; he will gather the lambs in his arms; he will carry them in his bosom, and gently lead those that are with young.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will feed His flock like a shepherd; He will gather the lambs with His arm, And carry them in His bosom, And gently lead those who are with young.
verses.textEnNlt: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will carry the lambs in his arms, holding them close to his heart. He will gently lead the mother sheep with their young.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a shepherd He will tend His flock, In His arm He will gather the lambs And carry them in the fold of His robe; He will gently lead the nursing ewes.
verses.textEn: He tends his flock like a shepherd: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart; he gently leads those that have young.

verses.textZh: 谁曾用掌心量过海水， 用手掌测过苍天呢？ 谁曾用升斗量过大地的尘土， 用秤称山岭， 用天平称冈陵呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁曾用掌心量过海水， 用手掌测过苍天呢？ 谁曾用升斗量过大地的尘土， 用秤称山岭， 用天平称冈陵呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁曾用手心量诸水， 用手虎口量苍天， 用升斗盛大地的尘土， 用秤称山岭， 用天平平冈陵呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or with the breadth of his hand marked off the heavens? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket, or weighed the mountains on the scales and the hills in a balance?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand and marked off the heavens with a span, enclosed the dust of the earth in a measure and weighed the mountains in scales and the hills in a balance?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand, Measured heaven with a span And calculated the dust of the earth in a measure? Weighed the mountains in scales And the hills in a balance?
verses.textEnNlt: Who else has held the oceans in his hand? Who has measured off the heavens with his fingers? Who else knows the weight of the earth or has weighed the mountains and hills on a scale?
verses.textEnNasb: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand, And measured the heavens with a span, And calculated the dust of the earth with a measure, And weighed the mountains in a balance And the hills in a pair of scales?
verses.textEn: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or with the breadth of his hand marked off the heavens? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket, or weighed the mountains on the scales and the hills in a balance?

verses.textZh: 谁曾测度耶和华的灵， 或作过他的谋士教导他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁曾测度耶和华的灵， 或作过他的谋士教导他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁曾测度耶和华的心 ， 或作他的谋士指教他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can fathom the Spirit of the Lord , or instruct the Lord as his counselor?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has measured the Spirit of the Lord , or what man shows him his counsel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has directed the Spirit of the Lord, Or as His counselor has taught Him?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is able to advise the Spirit of the Lord ? Who knows enough to give him advice or teach him?
verses.textEnNasb: Who has directed the Spirit of the Lord, Or as His counselor has informed Him?
verses.textEn: Who can fathom the Spirit of the Lord , or instruct the Lord as his counselor?

verses.textZh: 他与谁商议，谁使他有聪明？ 谁把正确的路指教他，把知识指教他， 又把明智的路教导他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他与谁商议，谁使他有聪明？ 谁把正确的路指教他，把知识指教他， 又把明智的路教导他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他与谁商议，谁教导他， 谁将公平的路指示他， 又将知识教训他， 将通达的道指教他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Whom did the Lord consult to enlighten him, and who taught him the right way? Who was it that taught him knowledge, or showed him the path of understanding?
verses.textEnEsv: Whom did he consult, and who made him understand? Who taught him the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
verses.textEnNkjv: With whom did He take counsel, and who instructed Him, And taught Him in the path of justice? Who taught Him knowledge, And showed Him the way of understanding?
verses.textEnNlt: Has the Lord ever needed anyone’s advice? Does he need instruction about what is good? Did someone teach him what is right or show him the path of justice?
verses.textEnNasb: With whom did He consult and who gave Him understanding? And who taught Him in the path of justice and taught Him knowledge, And informed Him of the way of understanding?
verses.textEn: Whom did the Lord consult to enlighten him, and who taught him the right way? Who was it that taught him knowledge, or showed him the path of understanding?

verses.textZh: 看哪！万国都像水桶里的一滴， 又被看作天平上的微尘。 看哪！他举起众海岛，好象微细之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！万国都像水桶里的一滴， 又被看作天平上的微尘。 看哪！他举起众海岛，好象微细之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，万民都像水桶的一滴， 又算如天平上的微尘； 他举起众海岛，好像极微之物。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are regarded as dust on the scales; he weighs the islands as though they were fine dust.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, and are accounted as the dust on the scales; behold, he takes up the coastlands like fine dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the nations are as a drop in a bucket, And are counted as the small dust on the scales; Look, He lifts up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.textEnNlt: No, for all the nations of the world are but a drop in the bucket. They are nothing more than dust on the scales. He picks up the whole earth as though it were a grain of sand.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, And are regarded as a speck of dust on the scales; Behold, He lifts up the islands like fine dust.
verses.textEn: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are regarded as dust on the scales; he weighs the islands as though they were fine dust.

verses.textZh: 黎巴嫩的树林不够当柴烧， 其中的走兽也不够作燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黎巴嫩的树林不够当柴烧， 其中的走兽也不够作燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 黎巴嫩的树林不够当柴烧； 其中的走兽也不够作燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Lebanon is not sufficient for altar fires, nor its animals enough for burnt offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: Lebanon would not suffice for fuel, nor are its beasts enough for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, Nor its beasts sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: All the wood in Lebanon’s forests and all Lebanon’s animals would not be enough to make a burnt offering worthy of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: Even Lebanon is not enough to burn, Nor its animals enough for a burnt offering.
verses.textEn: Lebanon is not sufficient for altar fires, nor its animals enough for burnt offerings.

verses.textZh: 万国在他跟前好象不存在， 在他看来，只是乌有和虚空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万国在他跟前好象不存在， 在他看来，只是乌有和虚空。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民在他面前好像虚无， 被他看为不及虚无，乃为虚空。
verses.textEnNiv: Before him all the nations are as nothing; they are regarded by him as worthless and less than nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: All the nations are as nothing before him, they are accounted by him as less than nothing and emptiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: All nations before Him are as nothing, And they are counted by Him less than nothing and worthless.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations of the world are worth nothing to him. In his eyes they count for less than nothing— mere emptiness and froth.
verses.textEnNasb: All the nations are as nothing before Him, They are regarded by Him as less than nothing and meaningless.
verses.textEn: Before him all the nations are as nothing; they are regarded by him as worthless and less than nothing.

verses.textZh: 你们把谁来跟神相比呢？ 你们用甚么形象来与神并列呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们把谁来跟神相比呢？ 你们用甚么形象来与神并列呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们究竟将谁比神， 用什么形象与神比较呢？
verses.textEnNiv: With whom, then, will you compare God? To what image will you liken him?
verses.textEnEsv: To whom then will you liken God, or what likeness compare with him?
verses.textEnNkjv: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to Him?
verses.textEnNlt: To whom can you compare God? What image can you find to resemble him?
verses.textEnNasb: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare with Him?
verses.textEn: With whom, then, will you compare God? To what image will you liken him?

verses.textZh: 至于偶像，是匠人铸造的， 铸匠用金子把它包裹， 用银子为它做银炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于偶像，是匠人铸造的， 铸匠用金子把它包裹， 用银子为它做银炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 偶像是匠人铸造， 银匠用金包裹， 为它铸造银链。
verses.textEnNiv: As for an idol, a metalworker casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and fashions silver chains for it.
verses.textEnEsv: An idol! A craftsman casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and casts for it silver chains.
verses.textEnNkjv: The workman molds an image, The goldsmith overspreads it with gold, And the silversmith casts silver chains.
verses.textEnNlt: Can he be compared to an idol formed in a mold, overlaid with gold, and decorated with silver chains?
verses.textEnNasb: As for the idol, a craftsman casts it, A goldsmith plates it with gold, And a silversmith fashions chains of silver.
verses.textEn: As for an idol, a metalworker casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and fashions silver chains for it.

verses.textZh: 贫穷献不起这供物的， 就拣选不朽坏的树木， 为自己寻找巧匠， 立起不会动摇的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贫穷献不起这供物的， 就拣选不朽坏的树木， 为自己寻找巧匠， 立起不会动摇的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 穷乏献不起这样供物的， 就拣选不能朽坏的树木， 为自己寻找巧匠， 立起不能摇动的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: A person too poor to present such an offering selects wood that will not rot; they look for a skilled worker to set up an idol that will not topple.
verses.textEnEsv: He who is too impoverished for an offering chooses wood that will not rot; he seeks out a skillful craftsman to set up an idol that will not move.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever is too impoverished for such a contribution Chooses a tree that will not rot; He seeks for himself a skillful workman To prepare a carved image that will not totter.
verses.textEnNlt: Or if people are too poor for that, they might at least choose wood that won’t decay and a skilled craftsman to carve an image that won’t fall down!
verses.textEnNasb: He who is too impoverished for such an offering Selects a tree that does not rot; He seeks out for himself a skillful craftsman To prepare an idol that will not totter.
verses.textEn: A person too poor to present such an offering selects wood that will not rot; they look for a skilled worker to set up an idol that will not topple.

verses.textZh: 你们不曾知道吗？你们不曾听见吗？ 不是从起初就已经告诉过你们吗？ 自从大地的根基立了以来，你们还不曾明白吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不曾知道吗？你们不曾听见吗？ 不是从起初就已经告诉过你们吗？ 自从大地的根基立了以来，你们还不曾明白吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们岂不曾知道吗？ 你们岂不曾听见吗？ 从起初岂没有人告诉你们吗？ 自从立地的根基， 你们岂没有明白吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood since the earth was founded?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know? Do you not hear? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you not known? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.textEnNlt: Haven’t you heard? Don’t you understand? Are you deaf to the words of God— the words he gave before the world began? Are you so ignorant?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been declared to you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.textEn: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood since the earth was founded?

verses.textZh: 神坐在大地的圆穹之上， 地上的居民好象蚱蜢， 他铺张诸天如铺张幔子， 展开众天像展开可以居住的帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神坐在大地的圆穹之上， 地上的居民好象蚱蜢， 他铺张诸天如铺张幔子， 展开众天像展开可以居住的帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 神坐在地球大圈之上； 地上的居民好像蝗虫。 他铺张穹苍如幔子， 展开诸天如可住的帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth, and its people are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a canopy, and spreads them out like a tent to live in.
verses.textEnEsv: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them like a tent to dwell in;
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis He who sits above the circle of the earth, And its inhabitants are like grasshoppers, Who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, And spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.
verses.textEnNlt: God sits above the circle of the earth. The people below seem like grasshoppers to him! He spreads out the heavens like a curtain and makes his tent from them.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who sits above the circle of the earth, And its inhabitants are like grasshoppers, Who stretches out the heavens like a curtain And spreads them out like a tent to live in.
verses.textEn: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth, and its people are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a canopy, and spreads them out like a tent to live in.

verses.textZh: 他使诸侯都归于无有， 使地上的审判官成为虚空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使诸侯都归于无有， 使地上的审判官成为虚空。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使君王归于虚无， 使地上的审判官成为虚空。
verses.textEnNiv: He brings princes to naught and reduces the rulers of this world to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: who brings princes to nothing, and makes the rulers of the earth as emptiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brings the princes to nothing; He makes the judges of the earth useless.
verses.textEnNlt: He judges the great people of the world and brings them all to nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who reduces rulers to nothing, Who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
verses.textEn: He brings princes to naught and reduces the rulers of this world to nothing.

verses.textZh: 他们才刚刚栽上， 刚刚种上， 他们的树头刚刚在地里扎根， 他一吹在其上，他们就枯干了， 旋风把他们像碎秸一样吹去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们才刚刚栽上， 刚刚种上， 他们的树头刚刚在地里扎根， 他一吹在其上，他们就枯干了， 旋风把他们像碎秸一样吹去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们是刚才 栽上， 刚才种上， 根也刚才扎在地里， 他一吹在其上，便都枯干； 旋风将他们吹去，像碎秸一样。
verses.textEnNiv: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner do they take root in the ground, than he blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like chaff.
verses.textEnEsv: Scarcely are they planted, scarcely sown, scarcely has their stem taken root in the earth, when he blows on them, and they wither, and the tempest carries them off like stubble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Scarcely shall they be planted, Scarcely shall they be sown, Scarcely shall their stock take root in the earth, When He will also blow on them, And they will wither, And the whirlwind will take them away like stubble.
verses.textEnNlt: They hardly get started, barely taking root, when he blows on them and they wither. The wind carries them off like chaff.
verses.textEnNasb: Scarcely have they been planted, Scarcely have they been sown, Scarcely has their stock taken root in the earth, But He merely blows on them, and they wither, And the storm carries them away like stubble.
verses.textEn: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner do they take root in the ground, than he blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like chaff.

verses.textZh: 那圣者说："你们把谁来跟我相比， 使他与我相等呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那圣者说："你们把谁来跟我相比， 使他与我相等呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那圣者说：你们将谁比我， 叫他与我相等呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "To whom will you compare me? Or who is my equal?" says the Holy One.
verses.textEnEsv: To whom then will you compare me, that I should be like him? says the Holy One.
verses.textEnNkjv: "To whom then will you liken Me, Or towhom shall I be equal?" says the Holy One.
verses.textEnNlt: "To whom will you compare me? Who is my equal?" asks the Holy One.
verses.textEnNasb: "To whom then will you compare Me That I would be his equal?" says the Holy One.
verses.textEn: "To whom will you compare me? Or who is my equal?" says the Holy One.

verses.textZh: 你们向天举目吧！ 看是谁创造了这些万象？ 是谁按着数目把万象领出来， 一一指名呼唤？ 因他的大能大力， 连一个也不缺少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们向天举目吧！ 看是谁创造了这些万象？ 是谁按着数目把万象领出来， 一一指名呼唤？ 因他的大能大力， 连一个也不缺少。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们向上举目， 看谁创造这万象， 按数目领出， 他一一称其名； 因他的权能， 又因他的大能大力， 连一个都不缺。
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up your eyes and look to the heavens: Who created all these? He who brings out the starry host one by one and calls forth each of them by name. Because of his great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your eyes on high and see: who created these? He who brings out their host by number, calling them all by name; by the greatness of his might and because he is strong in power, not one is missing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your eyes on high, And see who has created these things, Who brings out their host by number; He calls them all by name, By the greatness of His might And the strength of His power; Not one is missing.
verses.textEnNlt: Look up into the heavens. Who created all the stars? He brings them out like an army, one after another, calling each by its name. Because of his great power and incomparable strength, not a single one is missing.
verses.textEnNasb: Raise your eyes on high And see who has created these stars, The One who brings out their multitude by number, He calls them all by name; Because of the greatness of His might and the strength of His power, Not one of them is missing.
verses.textEn: Lift up your eyes and look to the heavens: Who created all these? He who brings out the starry host one by one and calls forth each of them by name. Because of his great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.

verses.textZh: 雅各啊！你为甚么这样说；以色列啊！你为甚么埋怨说： "我的道路向耶和华隐藏， 我的案件被我的神忽略了"？
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各啊！你为甚么这样说；以色列啊！你为甚么埋怨说： "我的道路向耶和华隐藏， 我的案件被我的神忽略了"？
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各啊，你为何说， 我的道路向耶和华隐藏？ 以色列啊，你为何言， 我的冤屈神并不查问？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you complain, Jacob? Why do you say, Israel, "My way is hidden from the Lord ; my cause is disregarded by my God"?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, "My way is hidden from the Lord , and my right is disregarded by my God"?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you say, O Jacob, And speak, O Israel: "My way is hidden from the Lord, And my just claim is passed over by my God"?
verses.textEnNlt: O Jacob, how can you say the Lord does not see your troubles? O Israel, how can you say God ignores your rights?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do you say, Jacob, and you assert, Israel, "My way is hidden from the Lord, And the justice due me escapes the notice of my God"?
verses.textEn: Why do you complain, Jacob? Why do you say, Israel, "My way is hidden from the Lord ; my cause is disregarded by my God"?

verses.textZh: 你不知道吗？你没有听过吗？ 永在的神、耶和华、地极的创造主既不疲乏，也不困倦； 他的知识无法测度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不知道吗？你没有听过吗？ 永在的神、耶和华、地极的创造主既不疲乏，也不困倦； 他的知识无法测度。
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂不曾知道吗？ 你岂不曾听见吗？ 永在的神耶和华，创造地极的主， 并不疲乏，也不困倦； 他的智慧无法测度。
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary, and his understanding no one can fathom.
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not known? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He does not faint or grow weary; his understanding is unsearchable.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you not known? Have you not heard? The everlasting God, the Lord, The Creator of the ends of the earth, Neither faints nor is weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
verses.textEnNlt: Have you never heard? Have you never understood? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of all the earth. He never grows weak or weary. No one can measure the depths of his understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth Does not become weary or tired. His understanding is unsearchable.
verses.textEn: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary, and his understanding no one can fathom.

verses.textZh: 疲乏的，他赐气力， 无力的，他加力量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 疲乏的，他赐气力， 无力的，他加力量。
verses.textZhCuv: 疲乏的，他赐能力； 软弱的，他加力量。
verses.textEnNiv: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.
verses.textEnEsv: He gives power to the faint, and to him who has no might he increases strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gives power to the weak, And to thosewhohave no might He increases strength.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives power to the weak and strength to the powerless.
verses.textEnNasb: He gives strength to the weary, And to the one who lacks might He increases power.
verses.textEn: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.

verses.textZh: 就是年轻人也会疲乏困倦， 强壮的人也会全然跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是年轻人也会疲乏困倦， 强壮的人也会全然跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦； 强壮的也必全然跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall;
verses.textEnEsv: Even youths shall faint and be weary, and young men shall fall exhausted;
verses.textEnNkjv: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, And the young men shall utterly fall,
verses.textEnNlt: Even youths will become weak and tired, and young men will fall in exhaustion.
verses.textEnNasb: Though youths grow weary and tired, And vigorous young men stumble badly,
verses.textEn: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall;

verses.textZh: 但那些仰望耶和华的人， 必重新得力； 他们必像鹰一样展翅上腾； 他们奔跑，也不困倦， 他们行走，也不疲乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那些仰望耶和华的人， 必重新得力； 他们必像鹰一样展翅上腾； 他们奔跑，也不困倦， 他们行走，也不疲乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那等候耶和华的必重新得力。 他们必如鹰展翅上腾； 他们奔跑却不困倦， 行走却不疲乏。
verses.textEnNiv: but those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.
verses.textEnEsv: but they who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint.
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who wait on the Lord Shall renew their strength; They shall mount up with wings like eagles, They shall run and not be weary, They shall walk and not faint.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who trust in the Lord will find new strength. They will soar high on wings like eagles. They will run and not grow weary. They will walk and not faint.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet those who wait for the Lord Will gain new strength; They will mount up with wings like eagles, They will run and not get tired, They will walk and not become weary.
verses.textEn: but those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

verses.textZh: 众海岛啊！你们要在我面前静默， 愿万民重新得力。 让他们近前来，然后说话， 让我们聚在一起辩论吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 众海岛啊！你们要在我面前静默， 愿万民重新得力。 让他们近前来，然后说话， 让我们聚在一起辩论吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 众海岛啊，当在我面前静默； 众民当重新得力， 都要近前来才可以说话， 我们可以彼此辩论。
verses.textEnNiv: "Be silent before me, you islands! Let the nations renew their strength! Let them come forward and speak; let us meet together at the place of judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: Listen to me in silence, O coastlands; let the peoples renew their strength; let them approach, then let them speak; let us together draw near for judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Keep silence before Me, O coastlands, And let the people renew their strength! Let them come near, then let them speak; Let us come near together for judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen in silence before me, you lands beyond the sea. Bring your strongest arguments. Come now and speak. The court is ready for your case.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to Me in silence, you coastlands, And let the peoples gain new strength; Let them come forward, then let them speak; Let’s come together for judgment.
verses.textEn: "Be silent before me, you islands! Let the nations renew their strength! Let them come forward and speak; let us meet together at the place of judgment.

verses.textZh: 谁从东方激动了一个人， 凭公义把他召到自己的脚前来？ 他把列国交在他面前， 他制伏众王； 他使他们在他的刀下化作灰尘， 他使他们在他的弓下像碎秸一样被吹散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁从东方激动了一个人， 凭公义把他召到自己的脚前来？ 他把列国交在他面前， 他制伏众王； 他使他们在他的刀下化作灰尘， 他使他们在他的弓下像碎秸一样被吹散。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁从东方兴起一人， 凭公义召他来到脚前呢？ 耶和华将列国交给他， 使他管辖君王， 把他们如灰尘交与他的刀， 如风吹的碎秸交与他的弓。
verses.textEnNiv: "Who has stirred up one from the east, calling him in righteousness to his service ? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.
verses.textEnEsv: Who stirred up one from the east whom victory meets at every step? He gives up nations before him, so that he tramples kings underfoot; he makes them like dust with his sword, like driven stubble with his bow.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who raised up one from the east? Who in righteousness called him to His feet? Who gave the nations before him, And made him rule over kings? Who gave them as the dust to his sword, As driven stubble to his bow?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who has stirred up this king from the east, rightly calling him to God’s service? Who gives this man victory over many nations and permits him to trample their kings underfoot? With his sword, he reduces armies to dust. With his bow, he scatters them like chaff before the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has stirred one from the east Whom He calls in righteousness to His feet? He turns nations over to him And subdues kings. He makes them like dust with his sword, Like the wind-driven chaff with his bow.
verses.textEn: "Who has stirred up one from the east, calling him in righteousness to his service ? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.

verses.textZh: 他追赶他们，安然走过他的脚未曾走过的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他追赶他们，安然走过他的脚未曾走过的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 他追赶他们， 走他所未走的道， 坦然前行。
verses.textEnNiv: He pursues them and moves on unscathed, by a path his feet have not traveled before.
verses.textEnEsv: He pursues them and passes on safely, by paths his feet have not trod.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who pursued them, and passed safely By the way that he had not gone with his feet?
verses.textEnNlt: He chases them away and goes on safely, though he is walking over unfamiliar ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "He pursues them, passing on in safety, By a way he had not been traversing with his feet.
verses.textEn: He pursues them and moves on unscathed, by a path his feet have not traveled before.

verses.textZh: 谁定这事并且作成？ 谁从起初预定万代呢？ 就是我耶和华，我是首先的，与最后的人同在的，也是我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁定这事并且作成？ 谁从起初预定万代呢？ 就是我耶和华，我是首先的，与最后的人同在的，也是我。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁行做成就这事， 从起初宣召历代呢？ 就是我－耶和华！ 我是首先的， 也与末后的同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Who has done this and carried it through, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the Lord —with the first of them and with the last—I am he."
verses.textEnEsv: Who has performed and done this, calling the generations from the beginning? I, the Lord , the first, and with the last; I am he.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has performed and done it, Calling the generations from the beginning? ‘I, the Lord, am the first; And with the last I am He.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Who has done such mighty deeds, summoning each new generation from the beginning of time? It is I, the Lord , the First and the Last. I alone am he."
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has performed and accomplished it, Summoning the generations from the beginning? ‘I, the Lord, am the first, and with the last. I am He.’ "
verses.textEn: Who has done this and carried it through, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the Lord —with the first of them and with the last—I am he."

verses.textZh: 众海岛看见了，就都惧怕； 地极也都战兢； 他们都近前来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众海岛看见了，就都惧怕； 地极也都战兢； 他们都近前来。
verses.textZhCuv: 海岛看见就都害怕； 地极也都战兢， 就近前来。
verses.textEnNiv: The islands have seen it and fear; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward;
verses.textEnEsv: The coastlands have seen and are afraid; the ends of the earth tremble; they have drawn near and come.
verses.textEnNkjv: The coastlands saw it and feared, The ends of the earth were afraid; They drew near and came.
verses.textEnNlt: The lands beyond the sea watch in fear. Remote lands tremble and mobilize for war.
verses.textEnNasb: The coastlands have seen and are afraid; The ends of the earth tremble; They have approached and have come.
verses.textEn: The islands have seen it and fear; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward;

verses.textZh: 各人彼此帮助， 对自己的兄弟说："要坚强！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人彼此帮助， 对自己的兄弟说："要坚强！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各人帮助邻舍， 各人对弟兄说：壮胆吧！
verses.textEnNiv: they help each other and say to their companions, "Be strong!"
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone helps his neighbor and says to his brother, "Be strong!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone helped his neighbor, And said to his brother, "Be of good courage!"
verses.textEnNlt: The idol makers encourage one another, saying to each other, "Be strong!"
verses.textEnNasb: Each one helps his neighbor And says to his brother, "Be strong!"
verses.textEn: they help each other and say to their companions, "Be strong!"

verses.textZh: 木匠坚固金匠， 用锤打光金属的，鼓励打砧的； 论焊工说："焊得好！" 又用钉子钉稳了。 使偶像不致动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 木匠坚固金匠， 用锤打光金属的，鼓励打砧的； 论焊工说："焊得好！" 又用钉子钉稳了。 使偶像不致动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 木匠勉励银匠， 用锤打光的勉励打砧的， 论焊工说，焊得好； 又用钉子钉稳，免得偶像动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: The metalworker encourages the goldsmith, and the one who smooths with the hammer spurs on the one who strikes the anvil. One says of the welding, "It is good." The other nails down the idol so it will not topple.
verses.textEnEsv: The craftsman strengthens the goldsmith, and he who smooths with the hammer him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, "It is good"; and they strengthen it with nails so that it cannot be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the craftsman encouraged the goldsmith; He who smooths with the hammer inspired him who strikes the anvil, Saying, "It is ready for the soldering"; Then he fastened it with pegs, That it might not totter.
