verses.textEnNlt: The carver encourages the goldsmith, and the molder helps at the anvil. "Good," they say. "It’s coming along fine." Carefully they join the parts together, then fasten the thing in place so it won’t fall over.
verses.textEnNasb: So the craftsman encourages the smelter, And he who smooths metal with the hammer encourages him who beats the anvil, Saying of the soldering, "It is good"; And he fastens it with nails, So that it will not totter.
verses.textEn: The metalworker encourages the goldsmith, and the one who smooths with the hammer spurs on the one who strikes the anvil. One says of the welding, "It is good." The other nails down the idol so it will not topple.

verses.textZh: 但你以色列，我的仆人啊！ 雅各，我所拣选、 我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔啊！
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你以色列，我的仆人啊！ 雅各，我所拣选、 我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔啊！
verses.textZhCuv: 惟你以色列－我的仆人， 雅各－我所拣选的， 我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔，
verses.textEnNiv: "But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, you descendants of Abraham my friend,
verses.textEnEsv: But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham, my friend;
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you, Israel, are My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, The descendants of Abraham My friend.
verses.textEnNlt: "But as for you, Israel my servant, Jacob my chosen one, descended from Abraham my friend,
verses.textEnNasb: "But you, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, Descendant of Abraham My friend,
verses.textEn: "But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, you descendants of Abraham my friend,

verses.textZh: 你是我从地极抓来的， 我从地的远方召你来， 对你说："你是我的仆人， 我拣选了你，并没有弃绝你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是我从地极抓来的， 我从地的远方召你来， 对你说："你是我的仆人， 我拣选了你，并没有弃绝你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你是我从地极所领 来的， 从地角所召来的， 且对你说：你是我的仆人； 我拣选你，并不弃绝你。
verses.textEnNiv: I took you from the ends of the earth, from its farthest corners I called you. I said, ‘You are my servant’; I have chosen you and have not rejected you.
verses.textEnEsv: you whom I took from the ends of the earth, and called from its farthest corners, saying to you, "You are my servant, I have chosen you and not cast you off";
verses.textEnNkjv: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, And called from its farthest regions, And said to you, ‘You are My servant, I have chosen you and have not cast you away:
verses.textEnNlt: I have called you back from the ends of the earth, saying, ‘You are my servant.’ For I have chosen you and will not throw you away.
verses.textEnNasb: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth And called from its remotest parts, And said to you, ‘You are My servant, I have chosen you and have not rejected you.
verses.textEn: I took you from the ends of the earth, from its farthest corners I called you. I said, ‘You are my servant’; I have chosen you and have not rejected you.

verses.textZh: 不要惧怕，因为我与你同在； 不要四处张望，因为我是你的神， 我必坚固你，我必帮助你； 我必用公义的右手扶持你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要惧怕，因为我与你同在； 不要四处张望，因为我是你的神， 我必坚固你，我必帮助你； 我必用公义的右手扶持你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在； 不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。 我必坚固你，我必帮助你； 我必用我公义的右手扶持你。
verses.textEnNiv: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear not, for I am with you; Be not dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, Yes, I will help you, I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.’
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be discouraged, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you. I will hold you up with my victorious right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do not fear, for I am with you; Do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, I will also help you, I will also uphold you with My righteous right hand.’
verses.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

verses.textZh: 看哪！向你发怒的都必蒙羞受辱； 与你相争的人，都要如同无有，并要灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！向你发怒的都必蒙羞受辱； 与你相争的人，都要如同无有，并要灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡向你发怒的必都抱愧蒙羞； 与你相争的必如无有，并要灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: "All who rage against you will surely be ashamed and disgraced; those who oppose you will be as nothing and perish.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, all who are incensed against you shall be put to shame and confounded; those who strive against you shall be as nothing and shall perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, all those who were incensed against you Shall be ashamed and disgraced; They shall be as nothing, And those who strive with you shall perish.
verses.textEnNlt: "See, all your angry enemies lie there, confused and humiliated. Anyone who opposes you will die and come to nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, all those who are angered at you will be shamed and dishonored; Those who contend with you will be as nothing and will perish.
verses.textEn: "All who rage against you will surely be ashamed and disgraced; those who oppose you will be as nothing and perish.

verses.textZh: 与你争竞的人，你要寻找他们，却找不着； 与你交战的人，都必如同无有，好象虚无。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与你争竞的人，你要寻找他们，却找不着； 与你交战的人，都必如同无有，好象虚无。
verses.textZhCuv: 与你争竞的，你要找他们也找不着； 与你争战的必如无有，成为虚无。
verses.textEnNiv: Though you search for your enemies, you will not find them. Those who wage war against you will be as nothing at all.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall seek those who contend with you, but you shall not find them; those who war against you shall be as nothing at all.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall seek them and not find them— Those who contended with you. Those who war against you Shall be as nothing, As a nonexistent thing.
verses.textEnNlt: You will look in vain for those who tried to conquer you. Those who attack you will come to nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will seek those who quarrel with you, but will not find them, Those who war with you will be as nothing and non-existent.
verses.textEn: Though you search for your enemies, you will not find them. Those who wage war against you will be as nothing at all.

verses.textZh: 因为我，耶和华你们的神，紧握着你的右手， 对你说："不要惧怕，我必帮助你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我，耶和华你们的神，紧握着你的右手， 对你说："不要惧怕，我必帮助你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我耶和华－ 你的神必搀扶你的右手， 对你说：不要害怕！ 我必帮助你。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear; I will help you.
verses.textEnEsv: For I, the Lord your God, hold your right hand; it is I who say to you, "Fear not, I am the one who helps you."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I, the Lord your God, will hold your right hand, Saying to you, ‘Fear not, I will help you.’
verses.textEnNlt: For I hold you by your right hand— I, the Lord your God. And I say to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I am here to help you.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand, Who says to you, ‘Do not fear, I will help you.’
verses.textEn: For I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear; I will help you.

verses.textZh: 虫子雅各啊！以色列人哪！你不要惧怕。 我必帮助你；这是耶和华说的。你的救赎主，就是以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虫子雅各啊！以色列人哪！你不要惧怕。 我必帮助你；这是耶和华说的。你的救赎主，就是以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这虫雅各和你们以色列人， 不要害怕！ 耶和华说：我必帮助你。 你的救赎主就是以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid, you worm Jacob, little Israel, do not fear, for I myself will help you," declares the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Fear not, you worm Jacob, you men of Israel! I am the one who helps you, declares the Lord ; your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Fear not, you worm Jacob, You men of Israel! I will help you," says the Lord And your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Though you are a lowly worm, O Jacob, don’t be afraid, people of Israel, for I will help you. I am the Lord , your Redeemer. I am the Holy One of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not fear, you worm Jacob, you people of Israel; I will help you," declares the Lord, "and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid, you worm Jacob, little Israel, do not fear, for I myself will help you," declares the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要使你成为打粮的器具， 又新，又锋利，又有很多利齿； 你要扬净群山，把它们压得粉碎， 又使冈陵变成糠秕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要使你成为打粮的器具， 又新，又锋利，又有很多利齿； 你要扬净群山，把它们压得粉碎， 又使冈陵变成糠秕。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我已使你成为 有快齿打粮的新器具； 你要把山岭打得粉碎， 使冈陵如同糠秕。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I make of you a threshing sledge, new, sharp, and having teeth; you shall thresh the mountains and crush them, and you shall make the hills like chaff;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will make you into a new threshing sledge with sharp teeth; You shall thresh the mountains and beat them small, And make the hills like chaff.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be a new threshing instrument with many sharp teeth. You will tear your enemies apart, making chaff of mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I turned you into a new, sharp threshing sledge with double edges; You will thresh the mountains and pulverize them, And make the hills like chaff.
verses.textEn: "See, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.

verses.textZh: 你必簸扬它们，风要把它们吹去， 旋风也要把它们吹散； 但你要靠耶和华喜乐， 以以色列的圣者夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必簸扬它们，风要把它们吹去， 旋风也要把它们吹散； 但你要靠耶和华喜乐， 以以色列的圣者夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要把它簸扬，风要吹去； 旋风要把它刮散。 你倒要以耶和华为喜乐， 以以色列的圣者为夸耀。
verses.textEnNiv: You will winnow them, the wind will pick them up, and a gale will blow them away. But you will rejoice in the Lord and glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the tempest shall scatter them. And you shall rejoice in the Lord ; in the Holy One of Israel you shall glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall winnow them, the wind shall carry them away, And the whirlwind shall scatter them; You shall rejoice in the Lord, And glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: You will toss them into the air, and the wind will blow them all away; a whirlwind will scatter them. Then you will rejoice in the Lord . You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, And the storm will scatter them; But you will rejoice in the Lord, You will boast in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: You will winnow them, the wind will pick them up, and a gale will blow them away. But you will rejoice in the Lord and glory in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 困苦和贫穷的人寻求水，却没有水； 他们的舌头因口渴而干燥； 我耶和华必应允他们， 我以色列的神必不离弃他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 困苦和贫穷的人寻求水，却没有水； 他们的舌头因口渴而干燥； 我耶和华必应允他们， 我以色列的神必不离弃他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 困苦穷乏人寻求水却没有； 他们因口渴，舌头干燥。 我－耶和华必应允他们； 我－以色列的神必不离弃他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "The poor and needy search for water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. But I the Lord will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.textEnEsv: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue is parched with thirst, I the Lord will answer them; I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The poor and needy seek water, but thereis none, Their tongues fail for thirst. I, the Lord, will hear them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the poor and needy search for water and there is none, and their tongues are parched from thirst, then I, the Lord , will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will never abandon them.
verses.textEnNasb: "The poor and needy are seeking water, but there is none, And their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the Lord, will answer them Myself; As the God of Israel I will not abandon them.
verses.textEn: "The poor and needy search for water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. But I the Lord will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

verses.textZh: 我要在光秃的高处开辟江河， 在山谷之间开辟泉源； 我要使旷野变为水池， 使干地变成水泉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在光秃的高处开辟江河， 在山谷之间开辟泉源； 我要使旷野变为水池， 使干地变成水泉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在净光的高处开江河， 在谷中开泉源； 我要使沙漠变为水池， 使干地变为涌泉。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make rivers flow on barren heights, and springs within the valleys. I will turn the desert into pools of water, and the parched ground into springs.
verses.textEnEsv: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the midst of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will open rivers in desolate heights, And fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, And the dry land springs of water.
verses.textEnNlt: I will open up rivers for them on the high plateaus. I will give them fountains of water in the valleys. I will fill the desert with pools of water. Rivers fed by springs will flow across the parched ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will open rivers on the bare heights, And springs in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, And the dry land fountains of water.
verses.textEn: I will make rivers flow on barren heights, and springs within the valleys. I will turn the desert into pools of water, and the parched ground into springs.

verses.textZh: 我要在旷野种上香柏树、 皂荚树、番石榴树和野橄榄树； 我要在沙漠中栽种松树、 杉树和黄杨树，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在旷野种上香柏树、 皂荚树、番石榴树和野橄榄树； 我要在沙漠中栽种松树、 杉树和黄杨树，
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在旷野种上香柏树、 皂荚树、番石榴树，和野橄榄树。 我在沙漠要把松树、杉树， 并黄杨树一同栽植；
verses.textEnNiv: I will put in the desert the cedar and the acacia, the myrtle and the olive. I will set junipers in the wasteland, the fir and the cypress together,
verses.textEnEsv: I will put in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the olive. I will set in the desert the cypress, the plane and the pine together,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar and the acacia tree, The myrtle and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the cypress tree and the pine And the box tree together,
verses.textEnNlt: I will plant trees in the barren desert— cedar, acacia, myrtle, olive, cypress, fir, and pine.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will put the cedar in the wilderness, The acacia, the myrtle, and the olive tree; I will place the juniper in the desert, Together with the elm tree and the cypress,
verses.textEn: I will put in the desert the cedar and the acacia, the myrtle and the olive. I will set junipers in the wasteland, the fir and the cypress together,

verses.textZh: 好叫人看见了，就知道； 思想过，就都明白， 这是耶和华的手所作的， 是以色列的圣者所造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好叫人看见了，就知道； 思想过，就都明白， 这是耶和华的手所作的， 是以色列的圣者所造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫人看见、知道、 思想、明白； 这是耶和华的手所做的， 是以色列的圣者所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: so that people may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the Lord has done this, that the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may see and know, may consider and understand together, that the hand of the Lord has done this, the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may see and know, And consider and understand together, That the hand of the Lord has done this, And the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.textEnNlt: I am doing this so all who see this miracle will understand what it means— that it is the Lord who has done this, the Holy One of Israel who created it.
verses.textEnNasb: So that they may see and recognize, And consider and gain insight as well, That the hand of the Lord has done this, And the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.textEn: so that people may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the Lord has done this, that the Holy One of Israel has created it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："呈上你们的案件吧！" 雅各的王说： "把你们有力的证据拿来吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："呈上你们的案件吧！" 雅各的王说： "把你们有力的证据拿来吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对假神说： 你们要呈上你们的案件； 雅各的君说： 你们要声明你们确实的理由。
verses.textEnNiv: "Present your case," says the Lord . "Set forth your arguments," says Jacob’s King.
verses.textEnEsv: Set forth your case, says the Lord ; bring your proofs, says the King of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Present your case," says the Lord. "Bring forth your strong reasons," says the King of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: "Present the case for your idols," says the Lord . "Let them show what they can do," says the King of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: " Present your case," the Lord says. "Bring forward your evidence," The King of Jacob says.
verses.textEn: "Present your case," says the Lord . "Set forth your arguments," says Jacob’s King.

verses.textZh: 让它们前来告诉我们将要发生的事。 以前的是甚么事，让它们告诉我们， 好叫我们用心思想，得知事情的结局。 或者向我们宣告那要来的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 让它们前来告诉我们将要发生的事。 以前的是甚么事，让它们告诉我们， 好叫我们用心思想，得知事情的结局。 或者向我们宣告那要来的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 可以声明，指示我们将来必遇的事， 说明先前的是什么事， 好叫我们思索，得知事的结局， 或者把将来的事指示我们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell us, you idols, what is going to happen. Tell us what the former things were, so that we may consider them and know their final outcome. Or declare to us the things to come,
verses.textEnEsv: Let them bring them, and tell us what is to happen. Tell us the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, that we may know their outcome; or declare to us the things to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let them bring forth and show us what will happen; Let them show the former things, what they were, That we may consider them, And know the latter end of them; Or declare to us things to come.
verses.textEnNlt: "Let them try to tell us what happened long ago so that we may consider the evidence. Or let them tell us what the future holds, so we can know what’s going to happen.
verses.textEnNasb: Let them bring them forward and declare to us what is going to take place; As for the former events, declare what they were, So that we may consider them and know their outcome. Or announce to us what is coming;
verses.textEn: "Tell us, you idols, what is going to happen. Tell us what the former things were, so that we may consider them and know their final outcome. Or declare to us the things to come,

verses.textZh: 把以后要来的事告诉我们， 好叫我们知道你们是神； 你们作这些事，或降福或降祸，以致我们彼此对望，一齐观看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把以后要来的事告诉我们， 好叫我们知道你们是神； 你们作这些事，或降福或降祸，以致我们彼此对望，一齐观看。
verses.textZhCuv: 要说明后来的事， 好叫我们知道你们是神。 你们或降福，或降祸， 使我们惊奇，一同观看。
verses.textEnNiv: tell us what the future holds, so we may know that you are gods. Do something, whether good or bad, so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell us what is to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods; do good, or do harm, that we may be dismayed and terrified.
verses.textEnNkjv: Show the things that are to come hereafter, That we may know that you are gods; Yes, do good or do evil, That we may be dismayed and see it together.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, tell us what will occur in the days ahead. Then we will know you are gods. In fact, do anything—good or bad! Do something that will amaze and frighten us.
verses.textEnNasb: Declare the things that are going to come afterward, So that we may know that you are gods; Indeed, do good or evil, that we may be afraid and fear together.
verses.textEn: tell us what the future holds, so we may know that you are gods. Do something, whether good or bad, so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你们属于无有， 你们的作为都属于虚空， 那选择你们的是可厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你们属于无有， 你们的作为都属于虚空， 那选择你们的是可厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，你们属乎虚无； 你们的作为也属乎虚空。 那选择你们的是可憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: But you are less than nothing and your works are utterly worthless; whoever chooses you is detestable.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is less than nothing; an abomination is he who chooses you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed you are nothing, And your work is nothing; Hewho chooses you is an abomination.
verses.textEnNlt: But no! You are less than nothing and can do nothing at all. Those who choose you pollute themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, you are less than nothing, And your work is less than nothing! He who chooses you is an abomination.
verses.textEn: But you are less than nothing and your works are utterly worthless; whoever chooses you is detestable.

verses.textZh: 我从北方兴起一人，他就来了； 他从日出之地而来，呼求我的名； 他必来践踏掌权的，好象践踏灰泥， 又像陶匠踹泥一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从北方兴起一人，他就来了； 他从日出之地而来，呼求我的名； 他必来践踏掌权的，好象践踏灰泥， 又像陶匠踹泥一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从北方兴起一人； 他是求告我名的， 从日出之地而来。 他必临到掌权的， 好像临到灰泥， 仿佛窑匠踹泥一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have stirred up one from the north, and he comes— one from the rising sun who calls on my name. He treads on rulers as if they were mortar, as if he were a potter treading the clay.
verses.textEnEsv: I stirred up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, and he shall call upon my name; he shall trample on rulers as on mortar, as the potter treads clay.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have raised up one from the north, And he shall come; From the rising of the sun he shall call on My name; And he shall come against princes as though mortar, As the potter treads clay.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I have stirred up a leader who will approach from the north. From the east he will call on my name. I will give him victory over kings and princes. He will trample them as a potter treads on clay.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have put one from the north into motion, and he has come; From the rising of the sun he will call on My name; And he will come upon rulers as upon mortar, As the potter treads on clay."
verses.textEn: "I have stirred up one from the north, and he comes— one from the rising sun who calls on my name. He treads on rulers as if they were mortar, as if he were a potter treading the clay.

verses.textZh: 谁从起初讲说这事，使我们知道呢？ 谁从先前说明，以致我们说"他没有错"呢？ 谁也没有说明， 谁也没有宣告， 谁也没有听见你们的话！
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁从起初讲说这事，使我们知道呢？ 谁从先前说明，以致我们说"他没有错"呢？ 谁也没有说明， 谁也没有宣告， 谁也没有听见你们的话！
verses.textZhCuv: 谁从起初指明这事，使我们知道呢？ 谁从先前说明，使我们说他不错呢？ 谁也没有指明； 谁也没有说明； 谁也没有听见你们的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Who told of this from the beginning, so we could know, or beforehand, so we could say, ‘He was right’? No one told of this, no one foretold it, no one heard any words from you.
verses.textEnEsv: Who declared it from the beginning, that we might know, and beforehand, that we might say, "He is right"? There was none who declared it, none who proclaimed, none who heard your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? And former times, that we may say, ‘Heis righteous’? Surely thereis no one who shows, Surely thereis no one who declares, Surely thereis no one who hears your words.
verses.textEnNlt: "Who told you from the beginning that this would happen? Who predicted this, making you admit that he was right? No one said a word!
verses.textEnNasb: Who has declared this from the beginning, that we might know? Or from former times, that we may say, "He is right!"? There was no one at all who declared, There was no one at all who proclaimed, There was no one at all who heard your words.
verses.textEn: Who told of this from the beginning, so we could know, or beforehand, so we could say, ‘He was right’? No one told of this, no one foretold it, no one heard any words from you.

verses.textZh: 我首先对锡安说："看哪，看看这些！" 我要把一位报好信息的赐给耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我首先对锡安说："看哪，看看这些！" 我要把一位报好信息的赐给耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我首先对锡安说： 看哪，我要将一位报好信息的赐给耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: I was the first to tell Zion, ‘Look, here they are!’ I gave to Jerusalem a messenger of good news.
verses.textEnEsv: I was the first to say to Zion, "Behold, here they are!" and I give to Jerusalem a herald of good news.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first time Isaid to Zion, ‘Look, there they are!’ And I will give to Jerusalem one who brings good tidings.
verses.textEnNlt: I was the first to tell Zion, ‘Look! Help is on the way!’ I will send Jerusalem a messenger with good news.
verses.textEnNasb: "Previously I said to Zion, ‘Behold, here they are.’ And to Jerusalem, ‘I will give a messenger of good news.’
verses.textEn: I was the first to tell Zion, ‘Look, here they are!’ I gave to Jerusalem a messenger of good news.

verses.textZh: 我看的时候，却没有一个人； 他们中间也没有谋士，我问他们的时候， 可以回答一句话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看的时候，却没有一个人； 他们中间也没有谋士，我问他们的时候， 可以回答一句话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看的时候并没有人； 我问的时候， 他们中间也没有谋士可以回答一句。
verses.textEnNiv: I look but there is no one— no one among the gods to give counsel, no one to give answer when I ask them.
verses.textEnEsv: But when I look, there is no one; among these there is no counselor who, when I ask, gives an answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I looked, and therewas no man; I looked among them, but therewas no counselor, Who, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.textEnNlt: Not one of your idols told you this. Not one gave any answer when I asked.
verses.textEnNasb: "But when I look, there is no one, And there is no counselor among them Who, if I ask, can give an answer.
verses.textEn: I look but there is no one— no one among the gods to give counsel, no one to give answer when I ask them.

verses.textZh: 看哪！他们都是无有， 他们所作的都是虚无； 他们所铸的偶像都是风，都是虚空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他们都是无有， 他们所作的都是虚无； 他们所铸的偶像都是风，都是虚空。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他们和他们的工作都是虚空， 且是虚无。 他们所铸的偶像都是风， 都是虚的。
verses.textEnNiv: See, they are all false! Their deeds amount to nothing; their images are but wind and confusion.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, they are all a delusion; their works are nothing; their metal images are empty wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed they are all worthless; Their works are nothing; Their molded images are wind and confusion.
verses.textEnNlt: See, they are all foolish, worthless things. All your idols are as empty as the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, all of them are false; Their works are nothing, Their cast metal images are wind and emptiness.
verses.textEn: See, they are all false! Their deeds amount to nothing; their images are but wind and confusion.

verses.textZh: 看哪！这是我的仆人，我扶持他； 我所拣选的，我的心喜悦他； 我已经把我的灵赐给他， 他必把公理带给万国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！这是我的仆人，我扶持他； 我所拣选的，我的心喜悦他； 我已经把我的灵赐给他， 他必把公理带给万国。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我的仆人－ 我所扶持所拣选、心里所喜悦的！ 我已将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。
verses.textEnNiv: "Here is my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen one in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will bring justice to the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights; I have put my Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold! My Servant whom I uphold, My Elect One inwhom My soul delights! I have put My Spirit upon Him; He will bring forth justice to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at my servant, whom I strengthen. He is my chosen one, who pleases me. I have put my Spirit upon him. He will bring justice to the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, My Servant, whom I uphold; My chosen one in whom My soul delights. I have put My Spirit upon Him; He will bring forth justice to the nations.
verses.textEn: "Here is my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen one in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will bring justice to the nations.

verses.textZh: 他不呼喊，也不扬声， 也不叫人在街上听见他的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不呼喊，也不扬声， 也不叫人在街上听见他的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不喧嚷，不扬声， 也不使街上听见他的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: He will not shout or cry out, or raise his voice in the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: He will not cry aloud or lift up his voice, or make it heard in the street;
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not cry out, nor raise Hisvoice, Nor cause His voice to be heard in the street.
verses.textEnNlt: He will not shout or raise his voice in public.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not cry out nor raise His voice, Nor make His voice heard in the street.
verses.textEn: He will not shout or cry out, or raise his voice in the streets.

verses.textZh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将熄灭的灯火，他不吹灭； 他忠实地传出公理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将熄灭的灯火，他不吹灭； 他忠实地传出公理。
verses.textZhCuv: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭。 他凭真实将公理传开。
verses.textEnNiv: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out. In faithfulness he will bring forth justice;
verses.textEnEsv: a bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not quench; he will faithfully bring forth justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: A bruised reed He will not break, And smoking flax He will not quench; He will bring forth justice for truth.
verses.textEnNlt: He will not crush the weakest reed or put out a flickering candle. He will bring justice to all who have been wronged.
verses.textEnNasb: "A bent reed He will not break off And a dimly burning wick He will not extinguish; He will faithfully bring forth justice.
verses.textEn: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out. In faithfulness he will bring forth justice;

verses.textZh: 他不灰心，也不沮丧， 直到他在地上设立公理， 众海岛的人都等候他的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不灰心，也不沮丧， 直到他在地上设立公理， 众海岛的人都等候他的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不灰心，也不丧胆， 直到他在地上设立公理； 海岛都等候他的训诲。
verses.textEnNiv: he will not falter or be discouraged till he establishes justice on earth. In his teaching the islands will put their hope."
verses.textEnEsv: He will not grow faint or be discouraged till he has established justice in the earth; and the coastlands wait for his law.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not fail nor be discouraged, Till He has established justice in the earth; And the coastlands shall wait for His law."
verses.textEnNlt: He will not falter or lose heart until justice prevails throughout the earth. Even distant lands beyond the sea will wait for his instruction. "
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not be disheartened or crushed Until He has established justice on the earth; And the coastlands will wait expectantly for His law."
verses.textEn: he will not falter or be discouraged till he establishes justice on earth. In his teaching the islands will put their hope."

verses.textZh: 那创造诸天，展开穹苍， 铺张大地和大地所出的一切， 赐气息给地上的众人， 又赐灵性给在地上行的人的 耶和华神这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那创造诸天，展开穹苍， 铺张大地和大地所出的一切， 赐气息给地上的众人， 又赐灵性给在地上行的人的 耶和华神这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 创造诸天，铺张穹苍， 将地和地所出的一并铺开， 赐气息给地上的众人， 又赐灵性给行在其上之人的神耶和华， 他如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is what God the Lord says— the Creator of the heavens, who stretches them out, who spreads out the earth with all that springs from it, who gives breath to its people, and life to those who walk on it:
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says God, the Lord , who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and what comes from it, who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk in it:
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says God the Lord, Who created the heavens and stretched them out, Who spread forth the earth and that which comes from it, Who gives breath to the people on it, And spirit to those who walk on it:
verses.textEnNlt: God, the Lord , created the heavens and stretched them out. He created the earth and everything in it. He gives breath to everyone, life to everyone who walks the earth. And it is he who says,
verses.textEnNasb: This is what God the Lord says, Who created the heavens and stretched them out, Who spread out the earth and its offspring, Who gives breath to the people on it And spirit to those who walk in it:
verses.textEn: This is what God the Lord says— the Creator of the heavens, who stretches them out, who spreads out the earth with all that springs from it, who gives breath to its people, and life to those who walk on it:

verses.textZh: "我耶和华凭着公义呼召了你； 我必紧拉着你的手，我必保护你， 立你作人民的约，作列国的光，
verses.textZhCnvs: "我耶和华凭着公义呼召了你； 我必紧拉着你的手，我必保护你， 立你作人民的约，作列国的光，
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华凭公义召你， 必搀扶你的手，保守你， 使你作众民的中保 ， 作外邦人的光，
verses.textEnNiv: "I, the Lord , have called you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people and a light for the Gentiles,
verses.textEnEsv: "I am the Lord ; I have called you in righteousness; I will take you by the hand and keep you; I will give you as a covenant for the people, a light for the nations,
verses.textEnNkjv: "I, the Lord, have called You in righteousness, And will hold Your hand; I will keep You and give You as a covenant to the people, As a light to the Gentiles,
verses.textEnNlt: "I, the Lord , have called you to demonstrate my righteousness. I will take you by the hand and guard you, and I will give you to my people, Israel, as a symbol of my covenant with them. And you will be a light to guide the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the Lord, I have called You in righteousness, I will also hold You by the hand and watch over You, And I will appoint You as a covenant to the people, As a light to the nations,
verses.textEn: "I, the Lord , have called you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people and a light for the Gentiles,

verses.textZh: 为要开瞎子的眼， 领被囚的出牢狱， 领住在黑暗中的出监牢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要开瞎子的眼， 领被囚的出牢狱， 领住在黑暗中的出监牢。
verses.textZhCuv: 开瞎子的眼， 领被囚的出牢狱， 领坐黑暗的出监牢。
verses.textEnNiv: to open eyes that are blind, to free captives from prison and to release from the dungeon those who sit in darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: to open the eyes that are blind, to bring out the prisoners from the dungeon, from the prison those who sit in darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: To open blind eyes, To bring out prisoners from the prison, Those who sit in darkness from the prison house.
verses.textEnNlt: You will open the eyes of the blind. You will free the captives from prison, releasing those who sit in dark dungeons.
verses.textEnNasb: To open blind eyes, To bring out prisoners from the dungeon And those who dwell in darkness from the prison.
verses.textEn: to open eyes that are blind, to free captives from prison and to release from the dungeon those who sit in darkness.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华，这是我的名； 我必不把我的荣耀归给别人， 也不把我当受的称赞归给雕刻的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华，这是我的名； 我必不把我的荣耀归给别人， 也不把我当受的称赞归给雕刻的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华，这是我的名； 我必不将我的荣耀归给假神， 也不将我的称赞归给雕刻的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am the Lord ; that is my name! I will not yield my glory to another or my praise to idols.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord ; that is my name; my glory I give to no other, nor my praise to carved idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord, that is My name; And My glory I will not give to another, Nor My praise to carved images.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the Lord ; that is my name! I will not give my glory to anyone else, nor share my praise with carved idols.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the Lord, that is My name; I will not give My glory to another, Nor My praise to idols.
verses.textEn: "I am the Lord ; that is my name! I will not yield my glory to another or my praise to idols.

verses.textZh: 看哪！先前预言过的事已经成就了， 现在我说明新的事； 它们还没有发生以前，我就先说给你们听了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！先前预言过的事已经成就了， 现在我说明新的事； 它们还没有发生以前，我就先说给你们听了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，先前的事已经成就， 现在我将新事说明， 这事未发以先，我就说给你们听。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the former things have taken place, and new things I declare; before they spring into being I announce them to you."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the former things have come to pass, and new things I now declare; before they spring forth I tell you of them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the former things have come to pass, And new things I declare; Before they spring forth I tell you of them."
verses.textEnNlt: Everything I prophesied has come true, and now I will prophesy again. I will tell you the future before it happens."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the former things have come to pass, Now I declare new things; Before they sprout I proclaim them to you."
verses.textEn: See, the former things have taken place, and new things I declare; before they spring into being I announce them to you."

verses.textZh: 所有航海的和海中所充满的， 众海岛和其上的居民哪！ 你们都要向耶和华唱新歌， 从地极向他发出赞美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有航海的和海中所充满的， 众海岛和其上的居民哪！ 你们都要向耶和华唱新歌， 从地极向他发出赞美。
verses.textZhCuv: 航海的和海中所有的， 海岛和其上的居民， 都当向耶和华唱新歌， 从地极赞美他。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise from the ends of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who live in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that fills it, the coastlands and their inhabitants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord a new song, And His praise from the ends of the earth, You who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, You coastlands and you inhabitants of them!
verses.textEnNlt: Sing a new song to the Lord ! Sing his praises from the ends of the earth! Sing, all you who sail the seas, all you who live in distant coastlands.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to the Lord a new song, Sing His praise from the end of the earth! You who go down to the sea, and all that is in it; You islands, and those who live on them.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise from the ends of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who live in them.

verses.textZh: 愿旷野和其中的城镇都扬声； 愿基达人居住的村庄都高呼； 愿西拉的居民都欢呼， 在山顶上吶喊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿旷野和其中的城镇都扬声； 愿基达人居住的村庄都高呼； 愿西拉的居民都欢呼， 在山顶上吶喊。
verses.textZhCuv: 旷野和其中的城邑， 并基达人居住的村庄都当扬声； 西拉的居民当欢呼， 在山顶上呐喊。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the wilderness and its towns raise their voices; let the settlements where Kedar lives rejoice. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them shout from the mountaintops.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the desert and its cities lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar inhabits; let the habitants of Sela sing for joy, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the wilderness and its cities lift up theirvoice, The villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing, Let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: Join in the chorus, you desert towns; let the villages of Kedar rejoice! Let the people of Sela sing for joy; shout praises from the mountaintops!
verses.textEnNasb: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, The settlements which Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing aloud, Let them shout for joy from the tops of the mountains.
verses.textEn: Let the wilderness and its towns raise their voices; let the settlements where Kedar lives rejoice. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them shout from the mountaintops.

verses.textZh: 愿他们把荣耀归给耶和华， 在众海岛中宣扬对他的颂赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们把荣耀归给耶和华， 在众海岛中宣扬对他的颂赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们当将荣耀归给耶和华， 在海岛中传扬他的颂赞。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them give glory to the Lord and proclaim his praise in the islands.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them give glory to the Lord , and declare his praise in the coastlands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them give glory to the Lord, And declare His praise in the coastlands.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the whole world glorify the Lord ; let it sing his praise.
verses.textEnNasb: Let them give glory to the Lord And declare His praise in the coastlands.
verses.textEn: Let them give glory to the Lord and proclaim his praise in the islands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必像勇士出战， 必像战士激动热心； 他要呼喊，大声吶喊， 要向仇敌显出自己的威猛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必像勇士出战， 必像战士激动热心； 他要呼喊，大声吶喊， 要向仇敌显出自己的威猛。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必像勇士出去， 必像战士激动热心， 要喊叫，大声呐喊， 要用大力攻击仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will march out like a champion, like a warrior he will stir up his zeal; with a shout he will raise the battle cry and will triumph over his enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord goes out like a mighty man, like a man of war he stirs up his zeal; he cries out, he shouts aloud, he shows himself mighty against his foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord shall go forth like a mighty man; He shall stir up His zeal like a man of war. He shall cry out, yes, shout aloud; He shall prevail against His enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will march forth like a mighty hero; he will come out like a warrior, full of fury. He will shout his battle cry and crush all his enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will go out like a warrior, He will stir His zeal like a man of war. He will shout, indeed, He will raise a war cry. He will prevail against His enemies.
verses.textEn: The Lord will march out like a champion, like a warrior he will stir up his zeal; with a shout he will raise the battle cry and will triumph over his enemies.

verses.textZh: 我已经很久缄默不言， 闭口不语， 但现在我要像待产的妇人一样呼喊， 我要急速地喘气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经很久缄默不言， 闭口不语， 但现在我要像待产的妇人一样呼喊， 我要急速地喘气。
verses.textZhCuv: 我许久闭口不言，静默不语； 现在我要喊叫，像产难的妇人； 我要急气而喘哮。
verses.textEnNiv: "For a long time I have kept silent, I have been quiet and held myself back. But now, like a woman in childbirth, I cry out, I gasp and pant.
verses.textEnEsv: For a long time I have held my peace; I have kept still and restrained myself; now I will cry out like a woman in labor; I will gasp and pant.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have held My peace a long time, I have been still and restrained Myself. Now I will cry like a woman in labor, I will pant and gasp at once.
verses.textEnNlt: He will say, "I have long been silent; yes, I have restrained myself. But now, like a woman in labor, I will cry and groan and pant.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have kept silent for a long time, I have kept still and restrained Myself. Now like a woman in labor I will groan, I will both gasp and pant.
verses.textEn: "For a long time I have kept silent, I have been quiet and held myself back. But now, like a woman in childbirth, I cry out, I gasp and pant.

verses.textZh: 我必使大山小山都变为荒场， 使一切草木都枯干； 我要使江河变为干地， 使水池干涸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使大山小山都变为荒场， 使一切草木都枯干； 我要使江河变为干地， 使水池干涸。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使大山小冈变为荒场， 使其上的花草都枯干； 我要使江河变为洲岛， 使水池都干涸。
verses.textEnNiv: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation; I will turn rivers into islands and dry up the pools.
verses.textEnEsv: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their vegetation; I will turn the rivers into islands, and dry up the pools.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will lay waste the mountains and hills, And dry up all their vegetation; I will make the rivers coastlands, And I will dry up the pools.
verses.textEnNlt: I will level the mountains and hills and blight all their greenery. I will turn the rivers into dry land and will dry up all the pools.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will lay waste the mountains and hills And wither all their vegetation; I will turn the rivers into coastlands And dry up the ponds.
verses.textEn: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation; I will turn rivers into islands and dry up the pools.

verses.textZh: 我必领瞎子走陌生的道， 带他们走他们不知道的路。 我必在他们面前使黑暗变为光明， 使弯曲的地方变为平直。 这些事我都要作， 决不放弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必领瞎子走陌生的道， 带他们走他们不知道的路。 我必在他们面前使黑暗变为光明， 使弯曲的地方变为平直。 这些事我都要作， 决不放弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要引瞎子行不认识的道， 领他们走不知道的路； 在他们面前使黑暗变为光明， 使弯曲变为平直。 这些事我都要行， 并不离弃他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will lead the blind by ways they have not known, along unfamiliar paths I will guide them; I will turn the darkness into light before them and make the rough places smooth. These are the things I will do; I will not forsake them.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will lead the blind in a way that they do not know, in paths that they have not known I will guide them. I will turn the darkness before them into light, the rough places into level ground. These are the things I do, and I do not forsake them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring the blind by a way they did not know; I will lead them in paths they have not known. I will make darkness light before them, And crooked places straight. These things I will do for them, And not forsake them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will lead blind Israel down a new path, guiding them along an unfamiliar way. I will brighten the darkness before them and smooth out the road ahead of them. Yes, I will indeed do these things; I will not forsake them.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will lead those who are blind by a way they have not known, In paths they have not known I will guide them. I will turn darkness into light before them And uneven land into plains. These are the things I will do, And I will not leave them undone."
verses.textEn: I will lead the blind by ways they have not known, along unfamiliar paths I will guide them; I will turn the darkness into light before them and make the rough places smooth. These are the things I will do; I will not forsake them.

verses.textZh: 那些倚靠偶像， 对铸像说： "你们是我们的神"的， 必被赶逐，全然蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些倚靠偶像， 对铸像说： "你们是我们的神"的， 必被赶逐，全然蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 倚靠雕刻的偶像， 对铸造的偶像说： 你是我们的神； 这等人要退后，全然蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: But those who trust in idols, who say to images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back in utter shame.
verses.textEnEsv: They are turned back and utterly put to shame, who trust in carved idols, who say to metal images, "You are our gods."
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be turned back, They shall be greatly ashamed, Who trust in carved images, Who say to the molded images, ‘You are our gods.’
verses.textEnNlt: But those who trust in idols, who say, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned away in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: They will be turned back and be utterly put to shame, Who trust in idols, Who say to cast metal images, "You are our gods."
verses.textEn: But those who trust in idols, who say to images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back in utter shame.

verses.textZh: 聋子啊！你们要听。 瞎子啊！你们要留心去看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聋子啊！你们要听。 瞎子啊！你们要留心去看。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这耳聋的，听吧！ 你们这眼瞎的，看吧！ 使你们能看见。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear, you deaf; look, you blind, and see!
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear, you deaf; And look, you blind, that you may see.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, you who are deaf! Look and see, you blind!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear, you who are deaf! And look, you who are blind, so that you may see.
verses.textEn: "Hear, you deaf; look, you blind, and see!

verses.textZh: 有谁比我的仆人更瞎呢？ 有谁比我差派的使者更聋呢？ 有谁瞎眼像那与我立了和约的呢？ 有谁瞎眼像耶和华的仆人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有谁比我的仆人更瞎呢？ 有谁比我差派的使者更聋呢？ 有谁瞎眼像那与我立了和约的呢？ 有谁瞎眼像耶和华的仆人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁比我的仆人眼瞎呢？ 谁比我差遣的使者耳聋呢？ 谁瞎眼像那与我和好的？ 谁瞎眼像耶和华的仆人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is blind but my servant, and deaf like the messenger I send? Who is blind like the one in covenant with me, blind like the servant of the Lord ?
verses.textEnEsv: Who is blind but my servant, or deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is blind as my dedicated one, or blind as the servant of the Lord ?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is blind but My servant, Or deaf as My messenger whom I send? Who is blind as hewhois perfect, And blind as the Lord’s servant?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is as blind as my own people, my servant? Who is as deaf as my messenger? Who is as blind as my chosen people, the servant of the Lord ?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is blind but My servant, Or so deaf as My messenger whom I send? Who is so blind as one who is at peace with Me, Or so blind as the servant of the Lord?
verses.textEn: Who is blind but my servant, and deaf like the messenger I send? Who is blind like the one in covenant with me, blind like the servant of the Lord ?

verses.textZh: 你们看见了许多的事，却没有留心， 耳朵开着，却没有听见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看见了许多的事，却没有留心， 耳朵开着，却没有听见。
verses.textZhCuv: 你看见许多事却不领会， 耳朵开通却不听见。
verses.textEnNiv: You have seen many things, but you pay no attention; your ears are open, but you do not listen."
verses.textEnEsv: He sees many things, but does not observe them; his ears are open, but he does not hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seeing many things, but you do not observe; Opening the ears, but he does not hear."
verses.textEnNlt: You see and recognize what is right but refuse to act on it. You hear with your ears, but you don’t really listen."
verses.textEnNasb: You have seen many things, but you do not retain them; Your ears are open, but no one hears.
verses.textEn: You have seen many things, but you pay no attention; your ears are open, but you do not listen."

verses.textZh: 耶和华为自己公义的缘故， 喜欢使律法为大为尊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华为自己公义的缘故， 喜欢使律法为大为尊。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华因自己公义的缘故， 喜欢使律法 为大，为尊。
verses.textEnNiv: It pleased the Lord for the sake of his righteousness to make his law great and glorious.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord was pleased, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify his law and make it glorious.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is well pleased for His righteousness’ sake; He will exalt the law and make it honorable.
verses.textEnNlt: Because he is righteous, the Lord has exalted his glorious law.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord was pleased for His righteousness’ sake To make the Law great and glorious.
verses.textEn: It pleased the Lord for the sake of his righteousness to make his law great and glorious.

verses.textZh: 但这人民是被抢劫和被掠夺的， 全都困陷在洞穴中， 被收藏在监牢里； 他们作了掠物，无人搭救； 他们成了掳物，无人说："要归还！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这人民是被抢劫和被掠夺的， 全都困陷在洞穴中， 被收藏在监牢里； 他们作了掠物，无人搭救； 他们成了掳物，无人说："要归还！"
verses.textZhCuv: 但这百姓是被抢被夺的， 都牢笼在坑中，隐藏在狱里； 他们作掠物，无人拯救， 作掳物，无人说交还。
verses.textEnNiv: But this is a people plundered and looted, all of them trapped in pits or hidden away in prisons. They have become plunder, with no one to rescue them; they have been made loot, with no one to say, "Send them back."
verses.textEnEsv: But this is a people plundered and looted; they are all of them trapped in holes and hidden in prisons; they have become plunder with none to rescue, spoil with none to say, "Restore!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But this is a people robbed and plundered; All of them are snared in holes, And they are hidden in prison houses; They are for prey, and no one delivers; For plunder, and no one says, "Restore!"
verses.textEnNlt: But his own people have been robbed and plundered, enslaved, imprisoned, and trapped. They are fair game for anyone and have no one to protect them, no one to take them back home.
verses.textEnNasb: But this is a people plundered and pillaged; All of them are trapped in caves, Or are hidden away in prisons; They have become plunder, with no one to save them, And spoils with no one to say, "Give them back!"
verses.textEn: But this is a people plundered and looted, all of them trapped in pits or hidden away in prisons. They have become plunder, with no one to rescue them; they have been made loot, with no one to say, "Send them back."

verses.textZh: 你们中间谁肯听这话呢？ 谁肯从今以后留心听呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间谁肯听这话呢？ 谁肯从今以后留心听呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间谁肯侧耳听此， 谁肯留心而听，以防将来呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Which of you will listen to this or pay close attention in time to come?
verses.textEnEsv: Who among you will give ear to this, will attend and listen for the time to come?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who among you will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
verses.textEnNlt: Who will hear these lessons from the past and see the ruin that awaits you in the future?
verses.textEnNasb: Who among you will listen to this? Who will pay attention and listen in the time to come?
verses.textEn: Which of you will listen to this or pay close attention in time to come?

verses.textZh: 谁把雅各交出来给掠夺者？谁把以色列交给抢劫的呢？ 岂不是耶和华，就是我们得罪的那位吗？ 因为他们不肯遵行他的道， 也不肯听从他的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁把雅各交出来给掠夺者？谁把以色列交给抢劫的呢？ 岂不是耶和华，就是我们得罪的那位吗？ 因为他们不肯遵行他的道， 也不肯听从他的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁将雅各交出当作掳物， 将以色列交给抢夺的呢？ 岂不是耶和华吗？ 就是我们所得罪的那位。 他们不肯遵行他的道， 也不听从他的训诲。
verses.textEnNiv: Who handed Jacob over to become loot, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the Lord , against whom we have sinned? For they would not follow his ways; they did not obey his law.
verses.textEnEsv: Who gave up Jacob to the looter, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the Lord , against whom we have sinned, in whose ways they would not walk, and whose law they would not obey?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who gave Jacob for plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Was it not the Lord, He against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in His ways, Nor were they obedient to His law.
verses.textEnNlt: Who allowed Israel to be robbed and hurt? It was the Lord , against whom we sinned, for the people would not walk in his path, nor would they obey his law.
verses.textEnNasb: Who gave Jacob up for spoils, and Israel to plunderers? Was it not the Lord, against whom we have sinned, And in whose ways they were not willing to walk, And whose Law they did not obey?
verses.textEn: Who handed Jacob over to become loot, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the Lord , against whom we have sinned? For they would not follow his ways; they did not obey his law.

verses.textZh: 因此，他把他猛烈的怒气和惨酷的战争， 倾倒在他身上； 这在他四周如火烧起来， 他还不知道； 把他烧着了，他也不放在心上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，他把他猛烈的怒气和惨酷的战争， 倾倒在他身上； 这在他四周如火烧起来， 他还不知道； 把他烧着了，他也不放在心上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他将猛烈的怒气和争战的勇力 倾倒在以色列的身上。 在他四围如火着起，他还不知道， 烧着他，他也不介意。
verses.textEnNiv: So he poured out on them his burning anger, the violence of war. It enveloped them in flames, yet they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.
verses.textEnEsv: So he poured on him the heat of his anger and the might of battle; it set him on fire all around, but he did not understand; it burned him up, but he did not take it to heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He has poured on him the fury of His anger And the strength of battle; It has set him on fire all around, Yet he did not know; And it burned him, Yet he did not take it to heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, he poured out his fury on them and destroyed them in battle. They were enveloped in flames, but they still refused to understand. They were consumed by fire, but they did not learn their lesson.
verses.textEnNasb: So He poured out on him the heat of His anger And the fierceness of battle; And it set him aflame all around, Yet he did not recognize it; And it burned him, but he paid no attention.
verses.textEn: So he poured out on them his burning anger, the violence of war. It enveloped them in flames, yet they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.

verses.textZh: 但是，雅各啊！那创造你的耶和华， 以色列啊！那塑造你的主，现在这样说： "不要惧怕，因为我救赎了你； 我按着你的名呼召了你；你是属我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，雅各啊！那创造你的耶和华， 以色列啊！那塑造你的主，现在这样说： "不要惧怕，因为我救赎了你； 我按着你的名呼召了你；你是属我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各啊，创造你的耶和华， 以色列啊，造成你的那位， 现在如此说： 你不要害怕！因为我救赎了你。 我曾提你的名召你，你是属我的。
verses.textEnNiv: But now, this is what the Lord says— he who created you, Jacob, he who formed you, Israel: "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have summoned you by name; you are mine.
verses.textEnEsv: But now thus says the Lord , he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now, thus says the Lord, who created you, O Jacob, And He who formed you, O Israel: "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; You are Mine.
verses.textEnNlt: But now, O Jacob, listen to the Lord who created you. O Israel, the one who formed you says, "Do not be afraid, for I have ransomed you. I have called you by name; you are mine.
verses.textEnNasb: But now, this is what the Lord says, He who is your Creator, Jacob, And He who formed you, Israel: "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are Mine!
verses.textEn: But now, this is what the Lord says— he who created you, Jacob, he who formed you, Israel: "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have summoned you by name; you are mine.

verses.textZh: 你从水中经过的时候，我必与你同在； 你渡过江河的时候，水必不淹没你； 你从火中行走的时候，必不会烧伤； 火焰也不会在你身上烧起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你从水中经过的时候，我必与你同在； 你渡过江河的时候，水必不淹没你； 你从火中行走的时候，必不会烧伤； 火焰也不会在你身上烧起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在； 你趟过江河，水必不漫过你； 你从火中行过，必不被烧， 火焰也不着在你身上。
verses.textEnNiv: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not set you ablaze.
verses.textEnEsv: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you; when you walk through fire you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not consume you.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you pass through the waters, I willbe with you; And through the rivers, they shall not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned, Nor shall the flame scorch you.
verses.textEnNlt: When you go through deep waters, I will be with you. When you go through rivers of difficulty, you will not drown. When you walk through the fire of oppression, you will not be burned up; the flames will not consume you.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; And through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched, Nor will the flame burn you.
verses.textEn: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not set you ablaze.

verses.textZh: 因为我是耶和华你的神， 是以色列的圣者，你的拯救者； 我使埃及作你的赎价， 使古实和示巴作你的替身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我是耶和华你的神， 是以色列的圣者，你的拯救者； 我使埃及作你的赎价， 使古实和示巴作你的替身。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我是耶和华－你的神， 是以色列的圣者－你的救主； 我已经使埃及作你的赎价， 使古实和西巴代替你。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your stead.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I give Egypt as your ransom, Cush and Seba in exchange for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am the Lord your God, The Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I gave Egypt for your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am the Lord , your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I gave Egypt as a ransom for your freedom; I gave Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I am the Lord your God, The Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I have given Egypt as your ransom, Cush and Seba in exchange for you.
verses.textEn: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your stead.

verses.textZh: 因为你在我眼中非常宝贵和贵重， 所以我爱你； 我使别人作你的替身，同别的民族交换你的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你在我眼中非常宝贵和贵重， 所以我爱你； 我使别人作你的替身，同别的民族交换你的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我看你为宝为尊； 又因我爱你， 所以我使人代替你， 使列邦人替换你的生命。
verses.textEnNiv: Since you are precious and honored in my sight, and because I love you, I will give people in exchange for you, nations in exchange for your life.
verses.textEnEsv: Because you are precious in my eyes, and honored, and I love you, I give men in return for you, peoples in exchange for your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Since you were precious in My sight, You have been honored, And I have loved you; Therefore I will give men for you, And people for your life.
verses.textEnNlt: Others were given in exchange for you. I traded their lives for yours because you are precious to me. You are honored, and I love you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Since you are precious in My sight, Since you are honored and I love you, I will give other people in your place and other nations in exchange for your life.
verses.textEn: Since you are precious and honored in my sight, and because I love you, I will give people in exchange for you, nations in exchange for your life.

verses.textZh: 你不要惧怕，因为我与你同在； 我必把你的后裔从东方领回来， 又从西方招聚你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要惧怕，因为我与你同在； 我必把你的后裔从东方领回来， 又从西方招聚你。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要害怕，因我与你同在； 我必领你的后裔从东方来， 又从西方招聚你。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your children from the east and gather you from the west.
verses.textEnEsv: Fear not, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east, and from the west I will gather you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear not, for I am with you; I will bring your descendants from the east, And gather you from the west;
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will gather you and your children from east and west.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not fear, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east, And gather you from the west.
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your children from the east and gather you from the west.

verses.textZh: 我要对北方说：‘把他们交出来！’ 又对南方说：‘不要拘留他们！’ 要把我的众子从远方带回来， 把我的女儿从地极领回来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要对北方说：‘把他们交出来！’ 又对南方说：‘不要拘留他们！’ 要把我的众子从远方带回来， 把我的女儿从地极领回来，
verses.textZhCuv: 我要对北方说，交出来！ 对南方说，不要拘留！ 将我的众子从远方带来， 将我的众女从地极领回，
verses.textEnNiv: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back.’ Bring my sons from afar and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
verses.textEnEsv: I will say to the north, Give up, and to the south, Do not withhold; bring my sons from afar and my daughters from the end of the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ And to the south, ‘Do not keep them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, And My daughters from the ends of the earth—
verses.textEnNlt: I will say to the north and south, ‘Bring my sons and daughters back to Israel from the distant corners of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ And to the south, ‘Do not hold them back.’ Bring My sons from afar And My daughters from the ends of the earth,
verses.textEn: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back.’ Bring my sons from afar and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

verses.textZh: 就是所有按着我的名被召的人， 是我为自己的荣耀创造的， 是我所塑造，所作成的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是所有按着我的名被召的人， 是我为自己的荣耀创造的， 是我所塑造，所作成的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是凡称为我名下的人， 是我为自己的荣耀创造的， 是我所做成，所造作的。
verses.textEnNiv: everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made."
verses.textEnEsv: everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made."
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone who is called by My name, Whom I have created for My glory; I have formed him, yes, I have made him."
verses.textEnNlt: Bring all who claim me as their God, for I have made them for my glory. It was I who created them.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who is called by My name, And whom I have created for My glory, Whom I have formed, even whom I have made."
verses.textEn: everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made."

verses.textZh: 你要把那些有眼却看不见， 有耳却听不到的人民领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把那些有眼却看不见， 有耳却听不到的人民领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将有眼而瞎、 有耳而聋的民都带出来！
verses.textEnNiv: Lead out those who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf.
verses.textEnEsv: Bring out the people who are blind, yet have eyes, who are deaf, yet have ears!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, And the deaf who have ears.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring out the people who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf.
verses.textEnNasb: Bring out the people who are blind, even though they have eyes, And those who are deaf, even though they have ears.
verses.textEn: Lead out those who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf.

verses.textZh: 列国都聚集在一起， 万族都集合起来， 他们中间谁能说明这事呢？ 谁能把先前的事说给我们听呢？ 让他们带出自己的见证人来，好显明自己为义； 让别人听见了，就说："这是真的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国都聚集在一起， 万族都集合起来， 他们中间谁能说明这事呢？ 谁能把先前的事说给我们听呢？ 让他们带出自己的见证人来，好显明自己为义； 让别人听见了，就说："这是真的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 任凭万国聚集； 任凭众民会合。 其中谁能将此声明， 并将先前的事说给我们听呢？ 他们可以带出见证来，自显为是； 或者他们听见便说：这是真的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Which of their gods foretold this and proclaimed to us the former things? Let them bring in their witnesses to prove they were right, so that others may hear and say, "It is true."
verses.textEnEsv: All the nations gather together, and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and show us the former things? Let them bring their witnesses to prove them right, and let them hear and say, It is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all the nations be gathered together, And let the people be assembled. Who among them can declare this, And show us former things? Let them bring out their witnesses, that they may be justified; Or let them hear and say, "Itis truth."
verses.textEnNlt: Gather the nations together! Assemble the peoples of the world! Which of their idols has ever foretold such things? Which can predict what will happen tomorrow? Where are the witnesses of such predictions? Who can verify that they spoke the truth?
verses.textEnNasb: All the nations have gathered together So that the peoples may be assembled. Who among them can declare this And proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses so that they may be justified, Or let them hear and say, "It is true."
verses.textEn: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Which of their gods foretold this and proclaimed to us the former things? Let them bring in their witnesses to prove they were right, so that others may hear and say, "It is true."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："你们就是我的见证人， 我所拣选的仆人， 为要使你们知道，并且相信我， 又明白我就是‘那位’； 在我以前没有神被造出来， 在我以后也必没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："你们就是我的见证人， 我所拣选的仆人， 为要使你们知道，并且相信我， 又明白我就是‘那位’； 在我以前没有神被造出来， 在我以后也必没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你们是我的见证， 我所拣选的仆人。 既是这样，便可以知道，且信服我， 又明白我就是耶和华。 在我以前没有真神 ； 在我以后也必没有。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are my witnesses," declares the Lord , "and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor will there be one after me.
verses.textEnEsv: "You are my witnesses," declares the Lord , "and my servant whom I have chosen, that you may know and believe me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor shall there be any after me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are My witnesses," says the Lord, "And My servant whom I have chosen, That you may know and believe Me, And understand that I am He. Before Me there was no God formed, Nor shall there be after Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "But you are my witnesses, O Israel!" says the Lord . "You are my servant. You have been chosen to know me, believe in me, and understand that I alone am God. There is no other God— there never has been, and there never will be.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are My witnesses," declares the Lord, "And My servant whom I have chosen, So that you may know and believe Me And understand that I am He. Before Me there was no God formed, And there will be none after Me.
verses.textEn: "You are my witnesses," declares the Lord , "and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor will there be one after me.

verses.textZh: 唯有我是耶和华； 除我以外，并没有拯救者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有我是耶和华； 除我以外，并没有拯救者。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有我是耶和华； 除我以外没有救主。
verses.textEnNiv: I, even I, am the Lord , and apart from me there is no savior.
verses.textEnEsv: I, I am the Lord , and besides me there is no savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: I, even I, am the Lord, And besides Me thereis no savior.
verses.textEnNlt: I, yes I, am the Lord , and there is no other Savior.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, only I, am the Lord, And there is no savior besides Me.
verses.textEn: I, even I, am the Lord , and apart from me there is no savior.

verses.textZh: 我曾预告，我曾拯救，我曾说给你们听， 在你们中间没有别的神。" 耶和华说："你们是我的见证人， 我就是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾预告，我曾拯救，我曾说给你们听， 在你们中间没有别的神。" 耶和华说："你们是我的见证人， 我就是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾说明， 并且在你们中间没有别神。 所以耶和华说： 你们是我的见证。 我也是神；
verses.textEnNiv: I have revealed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. You are my witnesses," declares the Lord , "that I am God.
verses.textEnEsv: I declared and saved and proclaimed, when there was no strange god among you; and you are my witnesses," declares the Lord , "and I am God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have declared and saved, I have proclaimed, And therewas no foreign god among you; Therefore you are My witnesses," Says the Lord, "that I am God.
verses.textEnNlt: First I predicted your rescue, then I saved you and proclaimed it to the world. No foreign god has ever done this. You are witnesses that I am the only God," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "It is I who have declared and saved and proclaimed, And there was no strange god among you; So you are My witnesses," declares the Lord, "And I am God.
verses.textEn: I have revealed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. You are my witnesses," declares the Lord , "that I am God.

verses.textZh: 自头一天以来，我就是‘那位’； 谁也不能救人脱离我的手； 我要行事，谁能拦阻呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 自头一天以来，我就是‘那位’； 谁也不能救人脱离我的手； 我要行事，谁能拦阻呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 自从有日子以来，我就是神； 谁也不能救人脱离我手。 我要行事谁能阻止呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Yes, and from ancient days I am he. No one can deliver out of my hand. When I act, who can reverse it?"
verses.textEnEsv: Also henceforth I am he; there is none who can deliver from my hand; I work, and who can turn it back?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed before the day was, I am He; And thereis no one who can deliver out of My hand; I work, and who will reverse it?"
verses.textEnNlt: "From eternity to eternity I am God. No one can snatch anyone out of my hand. No one can undo what I have done."
verses.textEnNasb: "Even from eternity I am He, And there is no one who can rescue from My hand; I act, and who can reverse it?"
verses.textEn: Yes, and from ancient days I am he. No one can deliver out of my hand. When I act, who can reverse it?"

verses.textZh: 你们的救赎主、以色列的圣者、耶和华这样说： "因为你们的缘故，我已经派人到巴比伦去， 我要使所有的迦勒底人都像难民一样下来， 都坐在他们素来自夸的船下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的救赎主、以色列的圣者、耶和华这样说： "因为你们的缘故，我已经派人到巴比伦去， 我要使所有的迦勒底人都像难民一样下来， 都坐在他们素来自夸的船下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你们的救赎主、 以色列的圣者如此说： 因你们的缘故， 我已经打发人到巴比伦去； 并且我要使迦勒底人如逃民， 都坐自己喜乐的船下来。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon and bring down as fugitives all the Babylonians, in the ships in which they took pride.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I send to Babylon and bring them all down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, your Redeemer, The Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon, And bring them all down as fugitives— The Chaldeans, who rejoice in their ships.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says—your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sakes I will send an army against Babylon, forcing the Babylonians to flee in those ships they are so proud of.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: "For your sake I have sent to Babylon, And will bring them all down as fugitives, Even the Chaldeans, into the ships over which they rejoice.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon and bring down as fugitives all the Babylonians, in the ships in which they took pride.

verses.textZh: 我就是耶和华，你们的圣者， 是以色列的创造主、你们的王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就是耶和华，你们的圣者， 是以色列的创造主、你们的王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你们的圣者， 是创造以色列的，是你们的君王。
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord , your Holy One, Israel’s Creator, your King."
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord , your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King."
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord, your Holy One, The Creator of Israel, your King."
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Lord , your Holy One, Israel’s Creator and King.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the Lord, your Holy One, The Creator of Israel, your King."
verses.textEn: I am the Lord , your Holy One, Israel’s Creator, your King."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： 他在海中开了一条道， 在大水中辟了一条路；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： 他在海中开了一条道， 在大水中辟了一条路；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在沧海中开道， 在大水中开路，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says— he who made a way through the sea, a path through the mighty waters,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , who makes a way in the sea, a path in the mighty waters,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, who makes a way in the sea And a path through the mighty waters,
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Lord , who opened a way through the waters, making a dry path through the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says, He who makes a way through the sea And a path through the mighty waters,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says— he who made a way through the sea, a path through the mighty waters,

verses.textZh: 他使战车、马匹、 军兵和勇士都一同出来， 他们都躺下去，不能再起来； 他们都灭没，好象灯火熄灭一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使战车、马匹、 军兵和勇士都一同出来， 他们都躺下去，不能再起来； 他们都灭没，好象灯火熄灭一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 使车辆、马匹、军兵、勇士都出来， 一同躺下，不再起来； 他们灭没，好像熄灭的灯火。
verses.textEnNiv: who drew out the chariots and horses, the army and reinforcements together, and they lay there, never to rise again, extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
verses.textEnEsv: who brings forth chariot and horse, army and warrior; they lie down, they cannot rise, they are extinguished, quenched like a wick:
verses.textEnNkjv: Who brings forth the chariot and horse, The army and the power (They shall lie down together, they shall not rise; They are extinguished, they are quenched like a wick):
verses.textEnNlt: I called forth the mighty army of Egypt with all its chariots and horses. I drew them beneath the waves, and they drowned, their lives snuffed out like a smoldering candlewick.
verses.textEnNasb: Who brings out the chariot and the horse, The army and the mighty man (They will lie down together and not rise again; They have been extinguished, and have gone out like a wick):
verses.textEn: who drew out the chariots and horses, the army and reinforcements together, and they lay there, never to rise again, extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:

verses.textZh: "你们不要怀念先前的事， 也不要思念古时的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不要怀念先前的事， 也不要思念古时的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你们不要记念从前的事， 也不要思想古时的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past.
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember not the former things, nor consider the things of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not remember the former things, Nor consider the things of old.
verses.textEnNlt: "But forget all that— it is nothing compared to what I am going to do.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not call to mind the former things, Or consider things of the past.
verses.textEn: "Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past.

verses.textZh: "看哪！我要作一件新的事； 现在它要发生了， 难道你们还不知道吗？ 我要在旷野开一条道路， 在荒地开挖江河。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我要作一件新的事； 现在它要发生了， 难道你们还不知道吗？ 我要在旷野开一条道路， 在荒地开挖江河。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我要做一件新事； 如今要发现，你们岂不知道吗？ 我必在旷野开道路， 在沙漠开江河。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am doing a new thing; now it springs forth, do you not perceive it? I will make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will do a new thing, Now it shall spring forth; Shall you not know it? I will even make a road in the wilderness And rivers in the desert.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am about to do something new. See, I have already begun! Do you not see it? I will make a pathway through the wilderness. I will create rivers in the dry wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am going to do something new, Now it will spring up; Will you not be aware of it? I will even make a roadway in the wilderness, Rivers in the desert.
verses.textEn: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.

verses.textZh: 野地的走兽必尊重我， 野狗和鸵鸟也必这样， 因为我使旷野有水， 使荒地有江河， 好使我拣选的子民有水喝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 野地的走兽必尊重我， 野狗和鸵鸟也必这样， 因为我使旷野有水， 使荒地有江河， 好使我拣选的子民有水喝，
verses.textZhCuv: 野地的走兽必尊重我； 野狗和鸵鸟也必如此。 因我使旷野有水， 使沙漠有河， 好赐给我的百姓、我的选民喝。
verses.textEnNiv: The wild animals honor me, the jackals and the owls, because I provide water in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
verses.textEnEsv: The wild beasts will honor me, the jackals and the ostriches, for I give water in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to give drink to my chosen people,
verses.textEnNkjv: The beast of the field will honor Me, The jackals and the ostriches, Because I give waters in the wilderness And rivers in the desert, To give drink to My people, My chosen.
verses.textEnNlt: The wild animals in the fields will thank me, the jackals and owls, too, for giving them water in the desert. Yes, I will make rivers in the dry wasteland so my chosen people can be refreshed.
verses.textEnNasb: "The animals of the field will glorify Me, The jackals and the ostriches, Because I have given waters in the wilderness And rivers in the desert, To give drink to My chosen people.
verses.textEn: The wild animals honor me, the jackals and the owls, because I provide water in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

verses.textZh: 就是我为自己所造的子民， 好使他们述说赞美我的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是我为自己所造的子民， 好使他们述说赞美我的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 这百姓是我为自己所造的， 好述说我的美德。
verses.textEnNiv: the people I formed for myself that they may proclaim my praise.
verses.textEnEsv: the people whom I formed for myself that they might declare my praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: This people I have formed for Myself; They shall declare My praise.
verses.textEnNlt: I have made Israel for myself, and they will someday honor me before the whole world.
verses.textEnNasb: "The people whom I formed for Myself Will declare My praise.
verses.textEn: the people I formed for myself that they may proclaim my praise.

verses.textZh: 然而，雅各啊！你并没有呼求我。 以色列啊！你竟厌烦我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，雅各啊！你并没有呼求我。 以色列啊！你竟厌烦我。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各啊，你并没有求告我； 以色列啊，你倒厌烦我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet you have not called on me, Jacob, you have not wearied yourselves for me, Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet you did not call upon me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of me, O Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you have not called upon Me, O Jacob; And you have been weary of Me, O Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "But, dear family of Jacob, you refuse to ask for my help. You have grown tired of me, O Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet you have not called on Me, Jacob; But you have become weary of Me, Israel.
verses.textEn: "Yet you have not called on me, Jacob, you have not wearied yourselves for me, Israel.

verses.textZh: 作燔祭用的羊，你没有带来给我； 也没有用你的祭物来尊敬我； 我没有因献供物使你劳累； 也没有因献乳香使你厌烦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作燔祭用的羊，你没有带来给我； 也没有用你的祭物来尊敬我； 我没有因献供物使你劳累； 也没有因献乳香使你厌烦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你没有将你的羊带来给我作燔祭， 也没有用祭物尊敬我； 我没有因供物使你服劳， 也没有因乳香使你厌烦。
verses.textEnNiv: You have not brought me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with grain offerings nor wearied you with demands for incense.
verses.textEnEsv: You have not brought me your sheep for burnt offerings, or honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, or wearied you with frankincense.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have not brought Me the sheep for your burnt offerings, Nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with grain offerings, Nor wearied you with incense.
verses.textEnNlt: You have not brought me sheep or goats for burnt offerings. You have not honored me with sacrifices, though I have not burdened and wearied you with requests for grain offerings and frankincense.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have not brought to Me the sheep of your burnt offerings, Nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, Nor wearied you with incense.
verses.textEn: You have not brought me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with grain offerings nor wearied you with demands for incense.

verses.textZh: 你没有用银子为我买菖蒲， 也没有用祭物的脂肪使我饱足； 相反地，你用你的罪使我劳累， 你用你的罪孽使我厌烦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你没有用银子为我买菖蒲， 也没有用祭物的脂肪使我饱足； 相反地，你用你的罪使我劳累， 你用你的罪孽使我厌烦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你没有用银子为我买菖蒲， 也没有用祭物的脂油使我饱足； 倒使我因你的罪恶服劳， 使我因你的罪孽厌烦。
verses.textEnNiv: You have not bought any fragrant calamus for me, or lavished on me the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your offenses.
verses.textEnEsv: You have not bought me sweet cane with money, or satisfied me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins; you have wearied me with your iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have bought Me no sweet cane with money, Nor have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices; But you have burdened Me with your sins, You have wearied Me with your iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: You have not brought me fragrant calamus or pleased me with the fat from sacrifices. Instead, you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your faults.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have not bought Me sweet cane with money, Nor have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices; Rather, you have burdened Me with your sins, You have wearied Me with your wrongdoings.
verses.textEn: You have not bought any fragrant calamus for me, or lavished on me the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your offenses.
