verses.textZh: "唯有我为自己的缘故，涂抹你的过犯， 我也不再记念你的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "唯有我为自己的缘故，涂抹你的过犯， 我也不再记念你的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有我为自己的缘故涂抹你的过犯； 我也不记念你的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: "I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions, for my own sake, and remembers your sins no more.
verses.textEnEsv: "I, I am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake, and I will not remember your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I, even I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake; And I will not remember your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: "I—yes, I alone—will blot out your sins for my own sake and will never think of them again.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, I alone, am the one who wipes out your wrongdoings for My own sake, And I will not remember your sins.
verses.textEn: "I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions, for my own sake, and remembers your sins no more.

verses.textZh: 你可以提醒我，我们可以一起辩论； 你尽管细说案情，好使你自显为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以提醒我，我们可以一起辩论； 你尽管细说案情，好使你自显为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辩论； 你可以将你的理陈明，自显为义。
verses.textEnNiv: Review the past for me, let us argue the matter together; state the case for your innocence.
verses.textEnEsv: Put me in remembrance; let us argue together; set forth your case, that you may be proved right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Put Me in remembrance; Let us contend together; State your case, that you may be acquitted.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us review the situation together, and you can present your case to prove your innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: " Meet Me in court, let’s argue our case together; State your cause, so that you may be proved right.
verses.textEn: Review the past for me, let us argue the matter together; state the case for your innocence.

verses.textZh: 你的祖先犯了罪， 你的代表背叛了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的祖先犯了罪， 你的代表背叛了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的始祖犯罪； 你的师傅违背我。
verses.textEnNiv: Your first father sinned; those I sent to teach you rebelled against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Your first father sinned, and your mediators transgressed against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your first father sinned, And your mediators have transgressed against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: From the very beginning, your first ancestor sinned against me; all your leaders broke my laws.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your first forefather sinned, And your spokesmen have rebelled against Me.
verses.textEn: Your first father sinned; those I sent to teach you rebelled against me.

verses.textZh: 所以我要辱没圣所里的领袖， 使雅各遭受毁灭，使以色列被凌辱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我要辱没圣所里的领袖， 使雅各遭受毁灭，使以色列被凌辱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我要辱没圣所的首领， 使雅各成为咒诅， 使以色列成为辱骂。
verses.textEnNiv: So I disgraced the dignitaries of your temple; I consigned Jacob to destruction and Israel to scorn.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary, and deliver Jacob to utter destruction and Israel to reviling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; I will give Jacob to the curse, And Israel to reproaches.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I have disgraced your priests; I have decreed complete destruction for Jacob and shame for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will profane the officials of the sanctuary, And I will turn Jacob over to destruction and Israel to abuse.
verses.textEn: So I disgraced the dignitaries of your temple; I consigned Jacob to destruction and Israel to scorn.

verses.textZh: "但现在，我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的以色列啊！你要听。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但现在，我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的以色列啊！你要听。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的以色列啊， 现在你当听。
verses.textEnNiv: "But now listen, Jacob, my servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: "But now hear, O Jacob my servant, Israel whom I have chosen!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet hear now, O Jacob My servant, And Israel whom I have chosen.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now, listen to me, Jacob my servant, Israel my chosen one.
verses.textEnNasb: "But now listen, Jacob, My servant, And Israel, whom I have chosen:
verses.textEn: "But now listen, Jacob, my servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.

verses.textZh: 那创造你，从母胎里就塑造了你， 又要帮助你的耶和华这样说： 我的仆人雅各啊！ 我所拣选的耶书仑啊！你不要惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那创造你，从母胎里就塑造了你， 又要帮助你的耶和华这样说： 我的仆人雅各啊！ 我所拣选的耶书仑啊！你不要惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 造作你，又从你出胎造就你， 并要帮助你的耶和华如此说： 我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的耶书仑哪， 不要害怕！
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says— he who made you, who formed you in the womb, and who will help you: Do not be afraid, Jacob, my servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord who made you, who formed you from the womb and will help you: Fear not, O Jacob my servant, Jeshurun whom I have chosen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord who made you And formed you from the womb, who will help you: ‘Fear not, O Jacob My servant; And you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord who made you and helps you says: Do not be afraid, O Jacob, my servant, O dear Israel, my chosen one.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says, He who made you And formed you from the womb, who will help you: ‘Do not fear, Jacob My servant, And Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says— he who made you, who formed you in the womb, and who will help you: Do not be afraid, Jacob, my servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.textZh: 因为我要把水浇灌干渴之处， 把河水浇灌干旱之地； 我必把我的灵浇灌你的后裔， 把我的福降给你的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我要把水浇灌干渴之处， 把河水浇灌干旱之地； 我必把我的灵浇灌你的后裔， 把我的福降给你的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我要将水浇灌口渴的人， 将河浇灌干旱之地。 我要将我的灵浇灌你的后裔， 将我的福浇灌你的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour out my Spirit on your offspring, and my blessing on your descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour my Spirit upon your offspring, and my blessing on your descendants.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, And floods on the dry ground; I will pour My Spirit on your descendants, And My blessing on your offspring;
verses.textEnNlt: For I will pour out water to quench your thirst and to irrigate your parched fields. And I will pour out my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your children.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For I will pour water on the thirsty land And streams on the dry ground; I will pour out My Spirit on your offspring, And My blessing on your descendants;
verses.textEn: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour out my Spirit on your offspring, and my blessing on your descendants.

verses.textZh: 他们要从草中生长起来， 像溪水旁的柳树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要从草中生长起来， 像溪水旁的柳树。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要发生在草中， 像溪水旁的柳树。
verses.textEnNiv: They will spring up like grass in a meadow, like poplar trees by flowing streams.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall spring up among the grass like willows by flowing streams.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will spring up among the grass Like willows by the watercourses.’
verses.textEnNlt: They will thrive like watered grass, like willows on a riverbank.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will spring up among the grass Like poplars by streams of water.’
verses.textEn: They will spring up like grass in a meadow, like poplar trees by flowing streams.

verses.textZh: 这个必说：‘我是属耶和华的’； 那个也必以雅各的名称呼自己； 另一个必亲手写上‘我是属耶和华的’， 并且要以以色列的名字替自己命名。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个必说：‘我是属耶和华的’； 那个也必以雅各的名称呼自己； 另一个必亲手写上‘我是属耶和华的’， 并且要以以色列的名字替自己命名。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这个要说：我是属耶和华的； 那个要以雅各的名自称； 又一个要亲手写：归耶和华的 ， 并自称为以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: Some will say, ‘I belong to the Lord ’; others will call themselves by the name of Jacob; still others will write on their hand, ‘The Lord ’s,’ and will take the name Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: This one will say, ‘I am the Lord ’s,’ another will call on the name of Jacob, and another will write on his hand, ‘The Lord ’s,’ and name himself by the name of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: One will say, ‘I am the Lord’s’; Another will call himself by the name of Jacob; Another will write with his hand, ‘The Lord’s,’ And name himself by the name of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Some will proudly claim, ‘I belong to the Lord .’ Others will say, ‘I am a descendant of Jacob.’ Some will write the Lord ’s name on their hands and will take the name of Israel as their own."
verses.textEnNasb: "This one will say, ‘I am the Lord’s’; And that one will call on the name of Jacob; And another will write on his hand, ‘Belonging to the Lord,’ And will give himself Israel’s name with honor.
verses.textEn: Some will say, ‘I belong to the Lord ’; others will call themselves by the name of Jacob; still others will write on their hand, ‘The Lord ’s,’ and will take the name Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的王， 以色列的救赎主、万军之耶和华这样说： "我是首先的，我是末后的； 除我以外，再没有真神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的王， 以色列的救赎主、万军之耶和华这样说： "我是首先的，我是末后的； 除我以外，再没有真神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的君， 以色列的救赎主－万军之耶和华如此说： 我是首先的，我是末后的； 除我以外再没有真神。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says— Israel’s King and Redeemer, the Lord Almighty: I am the first and I am the last; apart from me there is no God.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the Lord of hosts: "I am the first and I am the last; besides me there is no god.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel, And his Redeemer, the Lord of hosts: ‘I am the First and I am the Last; Besides Me thereis no God.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says—Israel’s King and Redeemer, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies: "I am the First and the Last; there is no other God.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says, He who is the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the Lord of armies: ‘I am the first and I am the last, And there is no God besides Me.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says— Israel’s King and Redeemer, the Lord Almighty: I am the first and I am the last; apart from me there is no God.

verses.textZh: 谁像我呢？让他宣告， 让他述说，又在我面前陈明吧！ 自从我设立古时的子民， 未来的事和将要发生的事， 让他们把它们述说出来吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁像我呢？让他宣告， 让他述说，又在我面前陈明吧！ 自从我设立古时的子民， 未来的事和将要发生的事， 让他们把它们述说出来吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我设立古时的民， 谁能像我宣告，并且指明，又为自己陈说呢？ 让他将未来的事和必成的事说明。
verses.textEnNiv: Who then is like me? Let him proclaim it. Let him declare and lay out before me what has happened since I established my ancient people, and what is yet to come— yes, let them foretell what will come.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is like me? Let him proclaim it. Let him declare and set it before me, since I appointed an ancient people. Let them declare what is to come, and what will happen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And who can proclaim as I do? Then let him declare it and set it in order for Me, Since I appointed the ancient people. And the things that are coming and shall come, Let them show these to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Who is like me? Let him step forward and prove to you his power. Let him do as I have done since ancient times when I established a people and explained its future.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Who is like Me? Let him proclaim and declare it; And, let him confront Me Beginning with My establishing of the ancient nation. Then let them declare to them the things that are coming And the events that are going to take place.
verses.textEn: Who then is like me? Let him proclaim it. Let him declare and lay out before me what has happened since I established my ancient people, and what is yet to come— yes, let them foretell what will come.

verses.textZh: 你们不要惊惶，也不要惧怕。 我不是老早就说了给你们听，告诉了你们吗？ 你们就是我的见证人。 除我以外，还有真神吗？ 没有别的盘石； 我一个也不知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要惊惶，也不要惧怕。 我不是老早就说了给你们听，告诉了你们吗？ 你们就是我的见证人。 除我以外，还有真神吗？ 没有别的盘石； 我一个也不知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要恐惧，也不要害怕。 我岂不是从上古就说明指示你们吗？ 并且你们是我的见证！ 除我以外，岂有真神吗？ 诚然没有磐石，我不知道一个！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not tremble, do not be afraid. Did I not proclaim this and foretell it long ago? You are my witnesses. Is there any God besides me? No, there is no other Rock; I know not one."
verses.textEnEsv: Fear not, nor be afraid; have I not told you from of old and declared it? And you are my witnesses! Is there a God besides me? There is no Rock; I know not any."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not fear, nor be afraid; Have I not told you from that time, and declared it? You are My witnesses. Is there a God besides Me? Indeed thereis no other Rock; I know not one.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Do not tremble; do not be afraid. Did I not proclaim my purposes for you long ago? You are my witnesses—is there any other God? No! There is no other Rock—not one!"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do not tremble and do not be afraid; Have I not long since announced it to you and declared it? And you are My witnesses. Is there any God besides Me, Or is there any other Rock? I know of none.’ "
verses.textEn: Do not tremble, do not be afraid. Did I not proclaim this and foretell it long ago? You are my witnesses. Is there any God besides me? No, there is no other Rock; I know not one."

verses.textZh: 制造偶像的人，尽都是虚空的， 他们所喜爱的，都没有益处。 他们的见证人，一无所见， 一无所知，以致他们蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 制造偶像的人，尽都是虚空的， 他们所喜爱的，都没有益处。 他们的见证人，一无所见， 一无所知，以致他们蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 制造雕刻偶像的尽都虚空；他们所喜悦的都无益处；他们的见证无所看见，无所知晓，他们便觉羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: All who make idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Those who would speak up for them are blind; they are ignorant, to their own shame.
verses.textEnEsv: All who fashion idols are nothing, and the things they delight in do not profit. Their witnesses neither see nor know, that they may be put to shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who make an image, all of them are useless, And their precious things shall not profit; They are their own witnesses; They neither see nor know, that they may be ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: How foolish are those who manufacture idols. These prized objects are really worthless. The people who worship idols don’t know this, so they are all put to shame.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who fashion an idol are all futile, and their treasured things are of no benefit; even their own witnesses fail to see or know, so that they will be put to shame.
verses.textEn: All who make idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Those who would speak up for them are blind; they are ignorant, to their own shame.

verses.textZh: 谁制造神像，或铸造偶像， 不想得到益处呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁制造神像，或铸造偶像， 不想得到益处呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁制造神像，铸造无益的偶像？
verses.textEnNiv: Who shapes a god and casts an idol, which can profit nothing?
verses.textEnEsv: Who fashions a god or casts an idol that is profitable for nothing?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who would form a god or mold an image That profits him nothing?
verses.textEnNlt: Who but a fool would make his own god— an idol that cannot help him one bit?
verses.textEnNasb: Who has fashioned a god or cast an idol to no benefit?
verses.textEn: Who shapes a god and casts an idol, which can profit nothing?

verses.textZh: 看哪！所有与它同伙的都必蒙羞； 工匠也不过是人罢了。 让他们都集合起来，都站立起来； 让他们都惧怕，都一同蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！所有与它同伙的都必蒙羞； 工匠也不过是人罢了。 让他们都集合起来，都站立起来； 让他们都惧怕，都一同蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不过是人，任他们聚会，任他们站立，都必惧怕，一同羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: People who do that will be put to shame; such craftsmen are only human beings. Let them all come together and take their stand; they will be brought down to terror and shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, all his companions shall be put to shame, and the craftsmen are only human. Let them all assemble, let them stand forth. They shall be terrified; they shall be put to shame together.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely all his companions would be ashamed; And the workmen, they are mere men. Let them all be gathered together, Let them stand up; Yet they shall fear, They shall be ashamed together.
verses.textEnNlt: All who worship idols will be disgraced along with all these craftsmen—mere humans— who claim they can make a god. They may all stand together, but they will stand in terror and shame.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen themselves are mere men. Let them all assemble themselves, let them stand up, let them tremble, let them be put to shame together.
verses.textEn: People who do that will be put to shame; such craftsmen are only human beings. Let them all come together and take their stand; they will be brought down to terror and shame.

verses.textZh: 铁匠先用工具在铁上雕刻， 然后在火炭中加工， 再用锤子把铁锤成形状， 用他有力的膀臂锤成。 他若饥饿，就没有力量； 他若不喝水，就疲乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铁匠先用工具在铁上雕刻， 然后在火炭中加工， 再用锤子把铁锤成形状， 用他有力的膀臂锤成。 他若饥饿，就没有力量； 他若不喝水，就疲乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 铁匠把铁在火炭中烧热，用锤打铁器，用他有力的膀臂锤成；他饥饿而无力，不喝水而发倦。
verses.textEnNiv: The blacksmith takes a tool and works with it in the coals; he shapes an idol with hammers, he forges it with the might of his arm. He gets hungry and loses his strength; he drinks no water and grows faint.
verses.textEnEsv: The ironsmith takes a cutting tool and works it over the coals. He fashions it with hammers and works it with his strong arm. He becomes hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water and is faint.
verses.textEnNkjv: The blacksmith with the tongs works one in the coals, Fashions it with hammers, And works it with the strength of his arms. Even so, he is hungry, and his strength fails; He drinks no water and is faint.
verses.textEnNlt: The blacksmith stands at his forge to make a sharp tool, pounding and shaping it with all his might. His work makes him hungry and weak. It makes him thirsty and faint.
verses.textEnNasb: The craftsman of iron shapes a cutting tool and does his work over the coals, fashioning it with hammers and working it with his strong arm. He also gets hungry and his strength fails; he drinks no water and becomes weary.
verses.textEn: The blacksmith takes a tool and works with it in the coals; he shapes an idol with hammers, he forges it with the might of his arm. He gets hungry and loses his strength; he drinks no water and grows faint.

verses.textZh: 木匠拉线， 用笔画出轮廓， 用刨子刨平， 用圆规画出模样， 做成人的形状， 有人一般的美丽，好住在庙里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 木匠拉线， 用笔画出轮廓， 用刨子刨平， 用圆规画出模样， 做成人的形状， 有人一般的美丽，好住在庙里。
verses.textZhCuv: 木匠拉线，用笔划出样子，用刨子刨成形状，用圆尺划了模样，仿照人的体态，做成人形，好住在房屋中。
verses.textEnNiv: The carpenter measures with a line and makes an outline with a marker; he roughs it out with chisels and marks it with compasses. He shapes it in human form, human form in all its glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.
verses.textEnEsv: The carpenter stretches a line; he marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes and marks it with a compass. He shapes it into the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house.
verses.textEnNkjv: The craftsman stretches out his rule, He marks one out with chalk; He fashions it with a plane, He marks it out with the compass, And makes it like the figure of a man, According to the beauty of a man, that it may remain in the house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the wood-carver measures a block of wood and draws a pattern on it. He works with chisel and plane and carves it into a human figure. He gives it human beauty and puts it in a little shrine.
verses.textEnNasb: The craftsman of wood extends a measuring line; he outlines it with a marker. He works it with carving knives and outlines it with a compass, and makes it like the form of a man, like the beauty of mankind, so that it may sit in a house.
verses.textEn: The carpenter measures with a line and makes an outline with a marker; he roughs it out with chisels and marks it with compasses. He shapes it in human form, human form in all its glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.

verses.textZh: 他为自己砍伐香柏树， 或选取榆树和橡树， 让它在树林中长起来； 他栽种松树，让雨水使它长大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为自己砍伐香柏树， 或选取榆树和橡树， 让它在树林中长起来； 他栽种松树，让雨水使它长大。
verses.textZhCuv: 他砍伐香柏树，又取柞 树和橡树，在树林中选定了一棵。他栽种松树，得雨长养。
verses.textEnNiv: He cut down cedars, or perhaps took a cypress or oak. He let it grow among the trees of the forest, or planted a pine, and the rain made it grow.
verses.textEnEsv: He cuts down cedars, or he chooses a cypress tree or an oak and lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a cedar and the rain nourishes it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He cuts down cedars for himself, And takes the cypress and the oak; He secures it for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a pine, and the rain nourishes it.
verses.textEnNlt: He cuts down cedars; he selects the cypress and the oak; he plants the pine in the forest to be nourished by the rain.
verses.textEnNasb: He will cut cedars for himself, and he takes a holm-oak or another oak and lets it grow strong for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel tree, and the rain makes it grow.
verses.textEn: He cut down cedars, or perhaps took a cypress or oak. He let it grow among the trees of the forest, or planted a pine, and the rain made it grow.

verses.textZh: 人可以用这树作燃料， 可以拿来生火取暖， 又可以烧着烤饼； 人竟然用它做神像敬拜， 他做了雕刻的偶像，又向它叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人可以用这树作燃料， 可以拿来生火取暖， 又可以烧着烤饼； 人竟然用它做神像敬拜， 他做了雕刻的偶像，又向它叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 这树，人可用以烧火；他自己取些烤火，又烧着烤饼，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向它叩拜。
verses.textEnNiv: It is used as fuel for burning; some of it he takes and warms himself, he kindles a fire and bakes bread. But he also fashions a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then it becomes fuel for a man. He takes a part of it and warms himself; he kindles a fire and bakes bread. Also he makes a god and worships it; he makes it an idol and falls down before it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be for a man to burn, For he will take some of it and warm himself; Yes, he kindles it and bakes bread; Indeed he makes a god and worships it; He makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he uses part of the wood to make a fire. With it he warms himself and bakes his bread. Then—yes, it’s true—he takes the rest of it and makes himself a god to worship! He makes an idol and bows down in front of it!
verses.textEnNasb: Then it becomes something for a person to burn, so he takes one of them and gets warm; he also makes a fire and bakes bread. He also makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image and bows down before it.
verses.textEn: It is used as fuel for burning; some of it he takes and warms himself, he kindles a fire and bakes bread. But he also fashions a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.

verses.textZh: 他把木头的一半放在火里燃烧； 在上面烤肉； 吃了烤肉，并且吃饱了， 就自己烤火取暖，说： "哈哈！我暖和了，我看见火了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把木头的一半放在火里燃烧； 在上面烤肉； 吃了烤肉，并且吃饱了， 就自己烤火取暖，说： "哈哈！我暖和了，我看见火了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他把一分烧在火中，把一分烤肉吃饱。自己烤火说：「啊哈，我暖和了，我见火了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Half of the wood he burns in the fire; over it he prepares his meal, he roasts his meat and eats his fill. He also warms himself and says, "Ah! I am warm; I see the fire."
verses.textEnEsv: Half of it he burns in the fire. Over the half he eats meat; he roasts it and is satisfied. Also he warms himself and says, "Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire!"
verses.textEnNkjv: He burns half of it in the fire; With this half he eats meat; He roasts a roast, and is satisfied. He even warms himself and says, "Ah! I am warm, I have seen the fire."
verses.textEnNlt: He burns part of the tree to roast his meat and to keep himself warm. He says, "Ah, that fire feels good."
verses.textEnNasb: Half of it he burns in the fire; over this half he eats meat, he roasts a roast, and is satisfied. He also warms himself and says, "Aha! I am warm, I have seen the fire."
verses.textEn: Half of the wood he burns in the fire; over it he prepares his meal, he roasts his meat and eats his fill. He also warms himself and says, "Ah! I am warm; I see the fire."

verses.textZh: 他用剩下来的一半做了一个神像， 就是他雕刻的偶像， 他向它俯伏，向它敬拜， 又向它祷告，说： "求你救我，因为你是我的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用剩下来的一半做了一个神像， 就是他雕刻的偶像， 他向它俯伏，向它敬拜， 又向它祷告，说： "求你救我，因为你是我的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向这偶像俯伏叩拜，祷告它说：「求你拯救我，因你是我的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: From the rest he makes a god, his idol; he bows down to it and worships. He prays to it and says, "Save me! You are my god!"
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of it he makes into a god, his idol, and falls down to it and worships it. He prays to it and says, "Deliver me, for you are my god!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of it he makes into a god, His carved image. He falls down before it and worships it, Prays to it and says, "Deliver me, for you are my god!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he takes what’s left and makes his god: a carved idol! He falls down in front of it, worshiping and praying to it. "Rescue me!" he says. "You are my god!"
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the rest of it he makes into a god, his carved image. He bows down before it and worships; he also prays to it and says, "Save me, for you are my god."
verses.textEn: From the rest he makes a god, his idol; he bows down to it and worships. He prays to it and says, "Save me! You are my god!"

verses.textZh: 他们并不知道，也不明白； 因为耶和华闭住他们的眼睛，使他们不能看见， 塞住他们的心，使他们不能明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们并不知道，也不明白； 因为耶和华闭住他们的眼睛，使他们不能看见， 塞住他们的心，使他们不能明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不知道，也不思想；因为耶和华闭住他们的眼，不能看见，塞住他们的心，不能明白。
verses.textEnNiv: They know nothing, they understand nothing; their eyes are plastered over so they cannot see, and their minds closed so they cannot understand.
verses.textEnEsv: They know not, nor do they discern, for he has shut their eyes, so that they cannot see, and their hearts, so that they cannot understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: They do not know nor understand; For He has shut their eyes, so that they cannot see, And their hearts, so that they cannot understand.
verses.textEnNlt: Such stupidity and ignorance! Their eyes are closed, and they cannot see. Their minds are shut, and they cannot think.
verses.textEnNasb: They do not know, nor do they understand, for He has smeared over their eyes so that they cannot see, and their hearts so that they cannot comprehend.
verses.textEn: They know nothing, they understand nothing; their eyes are plastered over so they cannot see, and their minds closed so they cannot understand.

verses.textZh: 没有人细心思想， 也没有人有知识有聪明说： "我把木头的一半放在火里燃烧， 我也在炭火上烘过饼， 烤过肉吃， 剩下的，我却用来做了一个可憎之物， 我要向木头叩拜吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人细心思想， 也没有人有知识有聪明说： "我把木头的一半放在火里燃烧， 我也在炭火上烘过饼， 烤过肉吃， 剩下的，我却用来做了一个可憎之物， 我要向木头叩拜吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁心里也不醒悟，也没有知识，没有聪明，能说：「我曾拿一分在火中烧了，在炭火上烤过饼；我也烤过肉吃。这剩下的，我岂要作可憎的物吗？我岂可向木𣎴子叩拜呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: No one stops to think, no one has the knowledge or understanding to say, "Half of it I used for fuel; I even baked bread over its coals, I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make a detestable thing from what is left? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?"
verses.textEnEsv: No one considers, nor is there knowledge or discernment to say, "Half of it I burned in the fire; I also baked bread on its coals; I roasted meat and have eaten. And shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down before a block of wood?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And no one considers in his heart, Nor isthere knowledge nor understanding to say, "I have burned half of it in the fire, Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals; I have roasted meat and eaten it; And shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down before a block of wood?"
verses.textEnNlt: The person who made the idol never stops to reflect, "Why, it’s just a block of wood! I burned half of it for heat and used it to bake my bread and roast my meat. How can the rest of it be a god? Should I bow down to worship a piece of wood?"
verses.textEnNasb: No one remembers, nor is there knowledge or understanding to say, "I have burned half of it in the fire and also have baked bread over its coals. I roast meat and eat it. Then I make the rest of it into an abomination, I bow down before a block of wood!"
verses.textEn: No one stops to think, no one has the knowledge or understanding to say, "Half of it I used for fuel; I even baked bread over its coals, I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make a detestable thing from what is left? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?"

verses.textZh: 他所追求的只是灰尘，被迷惑了的心使他偏离正道了； 他不能救自己，也不会说： "在我的右手中不是有个假神吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所追求的只是灰尘，被迷惑了的心使他偏离正道了； 他不能救自己，也不会说： "在我的右手中不是有个假神吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他以灰为食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能说：「我右手中岂不是有虚谎吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Such a person feeds on ashes; a deluded heart misleads him; he cannot save himself, or say, "Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?"
verses.textEnEsv: He feeds on ashes; a deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, "Is there not a lie in my right hand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: He feeds on ashes; A deceived heart has turned him aside; And he cannot deliver his soul, Nor say, "Isthere not a lie in my right hand?"
verses.textEnNlt: The poor, deluded fool feeds on ashes. He trusts something that can’t help him at all. Yet he cannot bring himself to ask, "Is this idol that I’m holding in my hand a lie?"
verses.textEnNasb: He feeds on ashes; a deceived heart has misled him. And he cannot save himself, nor say, "Is there not a lie in my right hand?"
verses.textEn: Such a person feeds on ashes; a deluded heart misleads him; he cannot save himself, or say, "Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?"

verses.textZh: 雅各和以色列啊！要记念这些话， 因为你是我的仆人。 我造了你，是要你作我的仆人； 以色列啊！你必不会被我忘记。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各和以色列啊！要记念这些话， 因为你是我的仆人。 我造了你，是要你作我的仆人； 以色列啊！你必不会被我忘记。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各，以色列啊， 你是我的仆人，要记念这些事。 以色列啊，你是我的仆人， 我造就你必不忘记你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember these things, Jacob, for you, Israel, are my servant. I have made you, you are my servant; Israel, I will not forget you.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel, for you are my servant; I formed you; you are my servant; O Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember these, O Jacob, And Israel, for you are My servant; I have formed you, you are My servant; O Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me!
verses.textEnNlt: "Pay attention, O Jacob, for you are my servant, O Israel. I, the Lord , made you, and I will not forget you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember these things, Jacob, And Israel, for you are My servant; I have formed you, you are My servant, Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me.
verses.textEn: "Remember these things, Jacob, for you, Israel, are my servant. I have made you, you are my servant; Israel, I will not forget you.

verses.textZh: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像密云消散； 我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云灭没， 你当归向我，因为我救赎了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像密云消散； 我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云灭没， 你当归向我，因为我救赎了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像厚云消散； 我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云灭没。 你当归向我，因我救赎了你。
verses.textEnNiv: I have swept away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like the morning mist. Return to me, for I have redeemed you."
verses.textEnEsv: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like mist; return to me, for I have redeemed you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have blotted out, like a thick cloud, your transgressions, And like a cloud, your sins. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you."
verses.textEnNlt: I have swept away your sins like a cloud. I have scattered your offenses like the morning mist. Oh, return to me, for I have paid the price to set you free."
verses.textEnNasb: "I have wiped out your wrongdoings like a thick cloud And your sins like a heavy mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you."
verses.textEn: I have swept away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like the morning mist. Return to me, for I have redeemed you."

verses.textZh: 诸天啊！你们要欢呼，因为耶和华作成了这事。 地的深处啊！你们要吶喊。 群山啊！你们要发声欢呼。 树林和其中所有的树啊！ 你们都当这样。 因为耶和华救赎了雅各， 他要借着以色列使自己得荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天啊！你们要欢呼，因为耶和华作成了这事。 地的深处啊！你们要吶喊。 群山啊！你们要发声欢呼。 树林和其中所有的树啊！ 你们都当这样。 因为耶和华救赎了雅各， 他要借着以色列使自己得荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天哪，应当歌唱， 因为耶和华做成这事。 地的深处啊，应当欢呼； 众山应当发声歌唱； 树林和其中所有的树都当如此！ 因为耶和华救赎了雅各， 并要因以色列荣耀自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing for joy, you heavens, for the Lord has done this; shout aloud, you earth beneath. Burst into song, you mountains, you forests and all your trees, for the Lord has redeemed Jacob, he displays his glory in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing, O heavens, for the Lord has done it; shout, O depths of the earth; break forth into singing, O mountains, O forest, and every tree in it! For the Lord has redeemed Jacob, and will be glorified in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing, O heavens, for the Lord has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth; Break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest, and every tree in it! For the Lord has redeemed Jacob, And glorified Himself in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing, O heavens, for the Lord has done this wondrous thing. Shout for joy, O depths of the earth! Break into song, O mountains and forests and every tree! For the Lord has redeemed Jacob and is glorified in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Shout for joy, you heavens, for the Lord has done it! Shout joyfully, you lower parts of the earth; Break into a shout of jubilation, you mountains, Forest, and every tree in it; For the Lord has redeemed Jacob, And in Israel He shows His glory.
verses.textEn: Sing for joy, you heavens, for the Lord has done this; shout aloud, you earth beneath. Burst into song, you mountains, you forests and all your trees, for the Lord has redeemed Jacob, he displays his glory in Israel.

verses.textZh: 你的救赎主，就是那在母胎中就造了你的耶和华这样说： "我耶和华是创造万物的， 我是独自展开诸天， 铺张大地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的救赎主，就是那在母胎中就造了你的耶和华这样说： "我耶和华是创造万物的， 我是独自展开诸天， 铺张大地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从你出胎，造就你的救赎主－耶和华如此说： 我－耶和华是创造万物的， 是独自铺张诸天、铺开大地的。 谁与我同在呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, who formed you in the womb: I am the Lord , the Maker of all things, who stretches out the heavens, who spreads out the earth by myself,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , your Redeemer, who formed you from the womb: "I am the Lord , who made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who spread out the earth by myself,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, your Redeemer, And He who formed you from the womb: "I am the Lord, who makes all things, Who stretches out the heavens all alone, Who spreads abroad the earth by Myself;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer and Creator: "I am the Lord , who made all things. I alone stretched out the heavens. Who was with me when I made the earth?
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says, He who is your Redeemer, and the One who formed you from the womb: "I, the Lord, am the Maker of all things, Stretching out the heavens by Myself And spreading out the earth alone,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, who formed you in the womb: I am the Lord , the Maker of all things, who stretches out the heavens, who spreads out the earth by myself,

verses.textZh: 我使说假话者的兆头失效， 使占卜者都变成愚昧人； 我使有智慧的人后退， 使他们的知识变为愚拙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使说假话者的兆头失效， 使占卜者都变成愚昧人； 我使有智慧的人后退， 使他们的知识变为愚拙。
verses.textZhCuv: 使说假话的兆头失效， 使占卜的癫狂， 使智慧人退后， 使他的知识变为愚拙；
verses.textEnNiv: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who overthrows the learning of the wise and turns it into nonsense,
verses.textEnEsv: who frustrates the signs of liars and makes fools of diviners, who turns wise men back and makes their knowledge foolish,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who frustrates the signs of the babblers, And drives diviners mad; Who turns wise men backward, And makes their knowledge foolishness;
verses.textEnNlt: I expose the false prophets as liars and make fools of fortune-tellers. I cause the wise to give bad advice, thus proving them to be fools.
verses.textEnNasb: Causing the omens of diviners to fail, Making fools of fortune-tellers; Causing wise men to turn back And making their knowledge ridiculous,
verses.textEn: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who overthrows the learning of the wise and turns it into nonsense,

verses.textZh: 我使我仆人的话实现， 使我使者的谋算成就。 我对耶路撒冷说：‘你必有人居住。’ 对犹大的城镇说：‘你们要再被建造起来， 至于其中的废墟，我必重建它们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使我仆人的话实现， 使我使者的谋算成就。 我对耶路撒冷说：‘你必有人居住。’ 对犹大的城镇说：‘你们要再被建造起来， 至于其中的废墟，我必重建它们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 使我仆人的话语立定， 我使者的谋算成就。 论到耶路撒冷说：必有人居住； 论到犹大的城邑说：必被建造， 其中的荒场我也必兴起。
verses.textEnNiv: who carries out the words of his servants and fulfills the predictions of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘It shall be inhabited,’ of the towns of Judah, ‘They shall be rebuilt,’ and of their ruins, ‘I will restore them,’
verses.textEnEsv: who confirms the word of his servant and fulfills the counsel of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘She shall be inhabited,’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They shall be built, and I will raise up their ruins’;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who confirms the word of His servant, And performs the counsel of His messengers; Who says to Jerusalem, ‘You shall be inhabited,’ To the cities of Judah, ‘You shall be built,’ And I will raise up her waste places;
verses.textEnNlt: But I carry out the predictions of my prophets! By them I say to Jerusalem, ‘People will live here again,’ and to the towns of Judah, ‘You will be rebuilt; I will restore all your ruins!’
verses.textEnNasb: Confirming the word of His servant And carrying out the purpose of His messengers. It is I who says of Jerusalem, ‘She shall be inhabited!’ And of the cities of Judah, ‘They shall be built.’ And I will raise her ruins again.
verses.textEn: who carries out the words of his servants and fulfills the predictions of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘It shall be inhabited,’ of the towns of Judah, ‘They shall be rebuilt,’ and of their ruins, ‘I will restore them,’

verses.textZh: 我对深渊说：‘你干了吧， 我必使你的江河干涸！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对深渊说：‘你干了吧， 我必使你的江河干涸！’
verses.textZhCuv: 对深渊说：你干了吧！ 我也要使你的江河干涸。
verses.textEnNiv: who says to the watery deep, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your streams,’
verses.textEnEsv: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry; I will dry up your rivers’;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who says to the deep, ‘Be dry! And I will dry up your rivers’;
verses.textEnNlt: When I speak to the rivers and say, ‘Dry up!’ they will be dry.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the One who says to the depth of the sea, ‘Dry up!’ And I will make your rivers dry up.
verses.textEn: who says to the watery deep, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your streams,’

verses.textZh: 我对古列说：‘我的牧人； 他必成就我所喜悦的一切。’ 他要对耶路撒冷说：‘你必被重建起来！’ 他必对圣殿说：‘你的根基要奠定！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对古列说：‘我的牧人； 他必成就我所喜悦的一切。’ 他要对耶路撒冷说：‘你必被重建起来！’ 他必对圣殿说：‘你的根基要奠定！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 论塞鲁士说：他是我的牧人， 必成就我所喜悦的， 必下令建造耶路撒冷， 发命立稳圣殿的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd and will accomplish all that I please; he will say of Jerusalem, "Let it be rebuilt," and of the temple, "Let its foundations be laid." ’
verses.textEnEsv: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and he shall fulfill all my purpose’; saying of Jerusalem, ‘She shall be built,’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation shall be laid.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Who says of Cyrus, ‘Heis My shepherd, And he shall perform all My pleasure, Saying to Jerusalem, "You shall be built," And to the temple, "Your foundation shall be laid." ’
verses.textEnNlt: When I say of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd,’ he will certainly do as I say. He will command, ‘Rebuild Jerusalem’; he will say, ‘Restore the Temple.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "It is I who says of Cyrus, ‘He is My shepherd, And he will carry out all My desire.’ And he says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built,’ And of the temple, ‘ Your foundation will be laid.’ "
verses.textEn: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd and will accomplish all that I please; he will say of Jerusalem, "Let it be rebuilt," and of the temple, "Let its foundations be laid." ’

verses.textZh: "我耶和华所膏立的古列， 我紧握着他的右手， 使列国降服在他面前； 我也松开列王的腰带； 我使门户在他面前敞开，使城门不得关闭；耶和华对古列这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "我耶和华所膏立的古列， 我紧握着他的右手， 使列国降服在他面前； 我也松开列王的腰带； 我使门户在他面前敞开，使城门不得关闭；耶和华对古列这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华所膏的塞鲁士； 我搀扶他的右手， 使列国降伏在他面前。 我也要放松列王的腰带， 使城门在他面前敞开， 不得关闭。 我对他如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I take hold of to subdue nations before him and to strip kings of their armor, to open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped, to subdue nations before him and to loose the belts of kings, to open doors before him that gates may not be closed:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord to His anointed, To Cyrus, whose right hand I have held— To subdue nations before him And loose the armor of kings, To open before him the double doors, So that the gates will not be shut:
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says to Cyrus, his anointed one, whose right hand he will empower. Before him, mighty kings will be paralyzed with fear. Their fortress gates will be opened, never to shut again.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says to Cyrus His anointed, Whom I have taken by the right hand, To subdue nations before him And to undo the weapons belt on the waist of kings; To open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I take hold of to subdue nations before him and to strip kings of their armor, to open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:

verses.textZh: 我必亲自领导你，把高低不平的路修平； 铜门，我必打破；铁门，我必砍断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必亲自领导你，把高低不平的路修平； 铜门，我必打破；铁门，我必砍断。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在你前面行， 修平崎岖之地。 我必打破铜门， 砍断铁闩。
verses.textEnNiv: I will go before you and will level the mountains ; I will break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will go before you and level the exalted places, I will break in pieces the doors of bronze and cut through the bars of iron,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I will go before you And make the crooked places straight; I will break in pieces the gates of bronze And cut the bars of iron.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "I will go before you, Cyrus, and level the mountains. I will smash down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will go before you and make the rough places smooth; I will shatter the doors of bronze and cut through their iron bars.
verses.textEn: I will go before you and will level the mountains ; I will break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.

verses.textZh: 我必把隐藏的宝物 和在隐密处的财宝赐给你， 使你知道我就是按着你的名呼召了你的耶和华， 以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把隐藏的宝物 和在隐密处的财宝赐给你， 使你知道我就是按着你的名呼召了你的耶和华， 以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将暗中的宝物和隐密的财宝赐给你， 使你知道提名召你的， 就是我－耶和华、以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give you hidden treasures, riches stored in secret places, so that you may know that I am the Lord , the God of Israel, who summons you by name.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the hoards in secret places, that you may know that it is I, the Lord , the God of Israel, who call you by your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give you the treasures of darkness And hidden riches of secret places, That you may know that I, the Lord, Who call you by your name, Am the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give you treasures hidden in the darkness— secret riches. I will do this so you may know that I am the Lord , the God of Israel, the one who calls you by name.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will give you the treasures of darkness And hidden wealth of secret places, So that you may know that it is I, The Lord, the God of Israel, who calls you by your name.
verses.textEn: I will give you hidden treasures, riches stored in secret places, so that you may know that I am the Lord , the God of Israel, who summons you by name.

verses.textZh: 因我的仆人雅各 和我所拣选的以色列的缘故， 我按着你的名呼召了你； 你虽然不认识我， 我却给你这个尊贵的名号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因我的仆人雅各 和我所拣选的以色列的缘故， 我按着你的名呼召了你； 你虽然不认识我， 我却给你这个尊贵的名号。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我仆人雅各， 我所拣选以色列的缘故， 我就提名召你； 你虽不认识我， 我也加给你名号。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of Jacob my servant, of Israel my chosen, I summon you by name and bestow on you a title of honor, though you do not acknowledge me.
verses.textEnEsv: For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel my chosen, I call you by your name, I name you, though you do not know me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Jacob My servant’s sake, And Israel My elect, I have even called you by your name; I have named you, though you have not known Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "And why have I called you for this work? Why did I call you by name when you did not know me? It is for the sake of Jacob my servant, Israel my chosen one.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the sake of Jacob My servant, And Israel My chosen one, I have also called you by your name; I have given you a title of honor Though you have not known Me.
verses.textEn: For the sake of Jacob my servant, of Israel my chosen, I summon you by name and bestow on you a title of honor, though you do not acknowledge me.

verses.textZh: "我是耶和华，再没有别的神了； 除了我以外，并没有真神； 你虽然不认识我，我必坚固你，
verses.textZhCnvs: "我是耶和华，再没有别的神了； 除了我以外，并没有真神； 你虽然不认识我，我必坚固你，
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华，在我以外并没有别神； 除了我以外再没有神。 你虽不认识我， 我必给你束腰。
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord , and there is no other; apart from me there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not acknowledged me,
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord , and there is no other, besides me there is no God; I equip you, though you do not know me,
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord, and thereis no other; Thereis no God besides Me. I will gird you, though you have not known Me,
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Lord ; there is no other God. I have equipped you for battle, though you don’t even know me,
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the Lord, and there is no one else; There is no God except Me. I will arm you, though you have not known Me,
verses.textEn: I am the Lord , and there is no other; apart from me there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not acknowledged me,

verses.textZh: 为要叫从日出之地到日落之地的人都知道， 除了我以外，没有真神； 我是耶和华，再没有别的神了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要叫从日出之地到日落之地的人都知道， 除了我以外，没有真神； 我是耶和华，再没有别的神了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从日出之地到日落之处 使人都知道除了我以外，没有别神。 我是耶和华； 在我以外并没有别神。
verses.textEnNiv: so that from the rising of the sun to the place of its setting people may know there is none besides me. I am the Lord , and there is no other.
verses.textEnEsv: that people may know, from the rising of the sun and from the west, that there is none besides me; I am the Lord , and there is no other.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may know from the rising of the sun to its setting That thereis none besides Me. I am the Lord, and thereis no other;
verses.textEnNlt: so all the world from east to west will know there is no other God. I am the Lord , and there is no other.
verses.textEnNasb: So that people may know from the rising to the setting of the sun That there is no one besides Me. I am the Lord, and there is no one else,
verses.textEn: so that from the rising of the sun to the place of its setting people may know there is none besides me. I am the Lord , and there is no other.

verses.textZh: 我造光，也造黑暗； 我赐平安，也降灾祸； 我耶和华是造成这一切事的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我造光，也造黑暗； 我赐平安，也降灾祸； 我耶和华是造成这一切事的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我造光，又造暗； 我施平安，又降灾祸； 造作这一切的是我－耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I form the light and create darkness, I bring prosperity and create disaster; I, the Lord , do all these things.
verses.textEnEsv: I form light and create darkness; I make well-being and create calamity; I am the Lord , who does all these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: I form the light and create darkness, I make peace and create calamity; I, the Lord, do all these things.’
verses.textEnNlt: I create the light and make the darkness. I send good times and bad times. I, the Lord , am the one who does these things.
verses.textEnNasb: The One forming light and creating darkness, Causing well-being and creating disaster; I am the Lord who does all these things.
verses.textEn: I form the light and create darkness, I bring prosperity and create disaster; I, the Lord , do all these things.

verses.textZh: 诸天啊！你们要从上滴下公义， 让云层降下公义。 让大地裂开，生出救恩， 使公义一同生长， 是我耶和华创造了这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天啊！你们要从上滴下公义， 让云层降下公义。 让大地裂开，生出救恩， 使公义一同生长， 是我耶和华创造了这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天哪，自上而滴， 穹苍降下公义； 地面开裂，产出救恩， 使公义一同发生； 这都是我－耶和华所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: "You heavens above, rain down my righteousness; let the clouds shower it down. Let the earth open wide, let salvation spring up, let righteousness flourish with it; I, the Lord , have created it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Shower, O heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain down righteousness; let the earth open, that salvation and righteousness may bear fruit; let the earth cause them both to sprout; I the Lord have created it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Rain down, you heavens, from above, And let the skies pour down righteousness; Let the earth open, let them bring forth salvation, And let righteousness spring up together. I, the Lord, have created it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Open up, O heavens, and pour out your righteousness. Let the earth open wide so salvation and righteousness can sprout up together. I, the Lord , created them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Drip down, heavens, from above, And let the clouds pour down righteousness; Let the earth open up and salvation bear fruit, And righteousness sprout with it. I, the Lord, have created it.
verses.textEn: "You heavens above, rain down my righteousness; let the clouds shower it down. Let the earth open wide, let salvation spring up, let righteousness flourish with it; I, the Lord , have created it.

verses.textZh: 那与他的创造主争论的，有祸了！ 他不过是地上瓦片中的一片瓦片， 泥土能对陶匠说：‘你在作甚么？’ 或你所作成的说：‘他没有手’吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那与他的创造主争论的，有祸了！ 他不过是地上瓦片中的一片瓦片， 泥土能对陶匠说：‘你在作甚么？’ 或你所作成的说：‘他没有手’吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉，那与造他的主争论的！ 他不过是地上瓦片中的一块瓦片。 泥土岂可对抟弄他的说：你做什么呢？ 所做的物岂可说：你没有手呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to those who quarrel with their Maker, those who are nothing but potsherds among the potsherds on the ground. Does the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘The potter has no hands’?
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to him who strives with him who formed him, a pot among earthen pots! Does the clay say to him who forms it, ‘What are you making?’ or ‘Your work has no handles’?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to him who strives with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to him who forms it, ‘What are you making?’ Or shall your handiwork say, ‘He has no hands’?
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits those who argue with their Creator. Does a clay pot argue with its maker? Does the clay dispute with the one who shapes it, saying, ‘Stop, you’re doing it wrong!’ Does the pot exclaim, ‘How clumsy can you be?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to the one who quarrels with his Maker— A piece of pottery among the other earthenware pottery pieces! Will the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you doing?’ Or the thing you are making say, ‘He has no hands’?
verses.textEn: "Woe to those who quarrel with their Maker, those who are nothing but potsherds among the potsherds on the ground. Does the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘The potter has no hands’?

verses.textZh: 那对父亲说：‘你生的是甚么’， 或对母亲说：‘你产的是甚么’的，有祸了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那对父亲说：‘你生的是甚么’， 或对母亲说：‘你产的是甚么’的，有祸了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉，那对父亲说： 你生的是什么呢？ 或对母亲 说： 你产的是什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the one who says to a father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you brought to birth?’
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What are you begetting?’ or to a woman, ‘With what are you in labor?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to him who says to his father, ‘What are you begetting?’ Or to the woman, ‘What have you brought forth?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: How terrible it would be if a newborn baby said to its father, ‘Why was I born?’ or if it said to its mother, ‘Why did you make me this way?’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What are you fathering?’ Or to a woman, ‘To what are you giving birth?’ "
verses.textEn: Woe to the one who says to a father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you brought to birth?’

verses.textZh: 以色列的圣者，造以色列的主耶和华这样说： "你们可以问我将要来的事， 关于我的众子和我手所作的，你们也可以吩咐我回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的圣者，造以色列的主耶和华这样说： "你们可以问我将要来的事， 关于我的众子和我手所作的，你们也可以吩咐我回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的圣者， 就是造就以色列的如此说： 将来的事，你们可以问我； 至于我的众子，并我手的工作， 你们可以求我命定 。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says— the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: Concerning things to come, do you question me about my children, or give me orders about the work of my hands?
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , the Holy One of Israel, and the one who formed him: "Ask me of things to come; will you command me concerning my children and the work of my hands?
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, The Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: "Ask Me of things to come concerning My sons; And concerning the work of My hands, you command Me.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says— the Holy One of Israel and your Creator: "Do you question what I do for my children? Do you give me orders about the work of my hands?
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker: " Ask Me about the things to come concerning My sons, And you shall commit to Me the work of My hands.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says— the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: Concerning things to come, do you question me about my children, or give me orders about the work of my hands?

verses.textZh: 我造了地，又造了人在地上； 我亲手展开了诸天， 又命定了天上的万象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我造了地，又造了人在地上； 我亲手展开了诸天， 又命定了天上的万象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我造地，又造人在地上。 我亲手铺张诸天； 天上万象也是我所命定的。
verses.textEnNiv: It is I who made the earth and created mankind on it. My own hands stretched out the heavens; I marshaled their starry hosts.
verses.textEnEsv: I made the earth and created man on it; it was my hands that stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their host.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have made the earth, And created man on it. I—My hands—stretched out the heavens, And all their host I have commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the one who made the earth and created people to live on it. With my hands I stretched out the heavens. All the stars are at my command.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is I who made the earth, and created mankind upon it. I stretched out the heavens with My hands, And I ordained all their lights.
verses.textEn: It is I who made the earth and created mankind on it. My own hands stretched out the heavens; I marshaled their starry hosts.

verses.textZh: 我凭着公义兴起了古列， 我必修平他的一切道路； 他必建造我的城，释放我被掳的子民， 不必用工价，也不用赏赐，这是万军之耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我凭着公义兴起了古列， 我必修平他的一切道路； 他必建造我的城，释放我被掳的子民， 不必用工价，也不用赏赐，这是万军之耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我凭公义兴起塞鲁士 ， 又要修直他一切道路。 他必建造我的城， 释放我被掳的民； 不是为工价，也不是为赏赐。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will raise up Cyrus in my righteousness: I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild my city and set my exiles free, but not for a price or reward, says the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: I have stirred him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways level; he shall build my city and set my exiles free, not for price or reward," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have raised him up in righteousness, And I will direct all his ways; He shall build My city And let My exiles go free, Not for price nor reward," Says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: I will raise up Cyrus to fulfill my righteous purpose, and I will guide his actions. He will restore my city and free my captive people— without seeking a reward! I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "I have stirred him in righteousness, And I will make all his ways smooth. He will build My city and let My exiles go free, Without any payment or reward," says the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: I will raise up Cyrus in my righteousness: I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild my city and set my exiles free, but not for a price or reward, says the Lord Almighty."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "埃及劳碌得来的和古实所得之利， 以及身量高大的西巴人， 都必过来归你，也要属你； 他们必带着锁炼过来随从你， 向你俯伏， 向你恳求，说： ‘神真的在你们中间，此外，再没有别的神， 没有别的真神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "埃及劳碌得来的和古实所得之利， 以及身量高大的西巴人， 都必过来归你，也要属你； 他们必带着锁炼过来随从你， 向你俯伏， 向你恳求，说： ‘神真的在你们中间，此外，再没有别的神， 没有别的真神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 埃及劳碌得来的和古实的货物必归你； 身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要属你。 他们必带着锁链过来随从你， 又向你下拜，祈求你说：神真在你们中间，此外再没有别神； 再没有别的神。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, and those tall Sabeans— they will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you, coming over to you in chains. They will bow down before you and plead with you, saying, ‘Surely God is with you, and there is no other; there is no other god.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "The wealth of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over to you and be yours; they shall follow you; they shall come over in chains and bow down to you. They will plead with you, saying: ‘Surely God is in you, and there is no other, no god besides him.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "The labor of Egypt and merchandise of Cush And of the Sabeans, men of stature, Shall come over to you, and they shall be yours; They shall walk behind you, They shall come over in chains; And they shall bow down to you. They will make supplication to you, saying, ‘Surely God is in you, And thereis no other; Thereis no other God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "You will rule the Egyptians, the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans. They will come to you with all their merchandise, and it will all be yours. They will follow you as prisoners in chains. They will fall to their knees in front of you and say, ‘God is with you, and he is the only God. There is no other.’"
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush And the Sabeans, men of stature, Will come over to you and will be yours; They will walk behind you, they will come over in chains And will bow down to you; They will plead with you: ‘ God certainly is with you, and there is no one else, No other God.’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, and those tall Sabeans— they will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you, coming over to you in chains. They will bow down before you and plead with you, saying, ‘Surely God is with you, and there is no other; there is no other god.’ "

verses.textZh: 拯救者以色列的神啊！ 你实在是隐藏自己的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拯救者以色列的神啊！ 你实在是隐藏自己的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 救主－以色列的神啊， 你实在是自隐的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Truly you are a God who has been hiding himself, the God and Savior of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, you are a God who hides himself, O God of Israel, the Savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly You are God, who hide Yourself, O God of Israel, the Savior!
verses.textEnNlt: Truly, O God of Israel, our Savior, you work in mysterious ways.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, You are a God who hides Himself, God of Israel, Savior!
verses.textEn: Truly you are a God who has been hiding himself, the God and Savior of Israel.

verses.textZh: 制造偶像的都必蒙羞受辱， 都要一同归于羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 制造偶像的都必蒙羞受辱， 都要一同归于羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡制造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞， 都要一同归于惭愧。
verses.textEnNiv: All the makers of idols will be put to shame and disgraced; they will go off into disgrace together.
verses.textEnEsv: All of them are put to shame and confounded; the makers of idols go in confusion together.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be ashamed And also disgraced, all of them; They shall go in confusion together, Whoare makers of idols.
verses.textEnNlt: All craftsmen who make idols will be humiliated. They will all be disgraced together.
verses.textEnNasb: They will be put to shame and even humiliated, all of them; The manufacturers of idols will go away together in humiliation.
verses.textEn: All the makers of idols will be put to shame and disgraced; they will go off into disgrace together.

verses.textZh: 唯有以色列必靠着耶和华得救， 得着永远的拯救； 你们必不蒙羞，也不受辱，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有以色列必靠着耶和华得救， 得着永远的拯救； 你们必不蒙羞，也不受辱，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和华的拯救， 得永远的救恩。 你们必不蒙羞，也不抱愧， 直到永世无尽。
verses.textEnNiv: But Israel will be saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation; you will never be put to shame or disgraced, to ages everlasting.
verses.textEnEsv: But Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation; you shall not be put to shame or confounded to all eternity.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Israel shall be saved by the Lord With an everlasting salvation; You shall not be ashamed or disgraced Forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord will save the people of Israel with eternal salvation. Throughout everlasting ages, they will never again be humiliated and disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel has been saved by the Lord With an everlasting salvation; You will not be put to shame or humiliated To all eternity.
verses.textEn: But Israel will be saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation; you will never be put to shame or disgraced, to ages everlasting.

verses.textZh: 因为创造诸天的耶和华，他是神， 塑造大地，把大地造成；他坚立大地； 他创造大地，不是荒凉的； 他塑造大地，是要给人居住；他这样说： "我是耶和华，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为创造诸天的耶和华，他是神， 塑造大地，把大地造成；他坚立大地； 他创造大地，不是荒凉的； 他塑造大地，是要给人居住；他这样说： "我是耶和华，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 创造诸天的耶和华， 制造成全大地的神， 他创造坚定大地， 并非使地荒凉， 是要给人居住。 他如此说： 我是耶和华，再没有别神。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says— he who created the heavens, he is God; he who fashioned and made the earth, he founded it; he did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited— he says: "I am the Lord , and there is no other.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord , who created the heavens (he is God!), who formed the earth and made it (he established it; he did not create it empty, he formed it to be inhabited!): "I am the Lord , and there is no other.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord, Who created the heavens, Who is God, Who formed the earth and made it, Who has established it, Who did not create it in vain, Who formed it to be inhabited: "I am the Lord, and thereis no other.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is God, and he created the heavens and earth and put everything in place. He made the world to be lived in, not to be a place of empty chaos. "I am the Lord ," he says, "and there is no other.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says, He who created the heavens (He is the God who formed the earth and made it, He established it and did not create it as a waste place, but formed it to be inhabited): "I am the Lord, and there is no one else.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says— he who created the heavens, he is God; he who fashioned and made the earth, he founded it; he did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited— he says: "I am the Lord , and there is no other.

verses.textZh: 我没有在隐密处、 在黑暗之地说过话； 我没有对雅各的后裔说过： ‘你们寻求我是徒然的。’ 我耶和华讲说公义， 宣扬正直。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有在隐密处、 在黑暗之地说过话； 我没有对雅各的后裔说过： ‘你们寻求我是徒然的。’ 我耶和华讲说公义， 宣扬正直。
verses.textZhCuv: 我没有在隐密黑暗之地说话； 我没有对雅各的后裔说： 你们寻求我是徒然的。 我－耶和华所讲的是公义， 所说的是正直。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not spoken in secret, from somewhere in a land of darkness; I have not said to Jacob’s descendants, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the Lord , speak the truth; I declare what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: I did not speak in secret, in a land of darkness; I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I the Lord speak the truth; I declare what is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not spoken in secret, In a dark place of the earth; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in vain’; I, the Lord, speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.textEnNlt: I publicly proclaim bold promises. I do not whisper obscurities in some dark corner. I would not have told the people of Israel to seek me if I could not be found. I, the Lord , speak only what is true and declare only what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have not spoken in secret, In some dark land; I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland’; I, the Lord, speak righteousness, Declaring things that are right.
verses.textEn: I have not spoken in secret, from somewhere in a land of darkness; I have not said to Jacob’s descendants, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the Lord , speak the truth; I declare what is right.

verses.textZh: "列国逃脱的人哪！你们要来集合， 一同近前来。 那些抬着木头做的偶像， 向不能拯救人的神祈求的， 真是无知。
verses.textZhCnvs: "列国逃脱的人哪！你们要来集合， 一同近前来。 那些抬着木头做的偶像， 向不能拯救人的神祈求的， 真是无知。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从列国逃脱的人， 要一同聚集前来。 那些抬着雕刻木偶、 祷告不能救人之神的， 毫无知识。
verses.textEnNiv: "Gather together and come; assemble, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry about idols of wood, who pray to gods that cannot save.
verses.textEnEsv: "Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, you survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge who carry about their wooden idols, and keep on praying to a god that cannot save.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Assemble yourselves and come; Draw near together, You whohave escaped from the nations. They have no knowledge, Who carry the wood of their carved image, And pray to a god that cannot save.
verses.textEnNlt: "Gather together and come, you fugitives from surrounding nations. What fools they are who carry around their wooden idols and pray to gods that cannot save!
verses.textEnNasb: "Gather yourselves and come; Come together, you survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge, Who carry around their wooden idol And pray to a god who cannot save.
verses.textEn: "Gather together and come; assemble, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry about idols of wood, who pray to gods that cannot save.

verses.textZh: 你们述说吧！提出理由吧！ 让他们彼此商议吧！ 谁从古时使人听见这事呢？ 谁从上古把这事述说出来呢？ 不是我耶和华吗？ 除了我以外，再没有神， 我是公义的神，又是拯救者； 除了我以外，并没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们述说吧！提出理由吧！ 让他们彼此商议吧！ 谁从古时使人听见这事呢？ 谁从上古把这事述说出来呢？ 不是我耶和华吗？ 除了我以外，再没有神， 我是公义的神，又是拯救者； 除了我以外，并没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要述说陈明你们的理， 让他们彼此商议。 谁从古时指明？ 谁从上古述说？ 不是我－耶和华吗？ 除了我以外，再没有神； 我是公义的神，又是救主； 除了我以外，再没有别神。
verses.textEnNiv: Declare what is to be, present it— let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago, who declared it from the distant past? Was it not I, the Lord ? And there is no God apart from me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none but me.
verses.textEnEsv: Declare and present your case; let them take counsel together! Who told this long ago? Who declared it of old? Was it not I, the Lord ? And there is no other god besides me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none besides me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell and bring forth yourcase; Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has declared this from ancient time? Who has told it from that time? Have not I, the Lord? And thereis no other God besides Me, A just God and a Savior; Thereis none besides Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Consult together, argue your case. Get together and decide what to say. Who made these things known so long ago? What idol ever told you they would happen? Was it not I, the Lord ? For there is no other God but me, a righteous God and Savior. There is none but me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Declare and present your case; Indeed, let them consult together. Who has announced this long ago? Who has long since declared it? Is it not I, the Lord? And there is no other God besides Me, A righteous God and a Savior; There is none except Me.
verses.textEn: Declare what is to be, present it— let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago, who declared it from the distant past? Was it not I, the Lord ? And there is no God apart from me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none but me.

verses.textZh: 全地的人哪！你们都要归向我，都要得救。 因为我是神，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地的人哪！你们都要归向我，都要得救。 因为我是神，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 地极的人都当仰望我， 就必得救； 因为我是神，再没有别神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
verses.textEnEsv: "Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look to Me, and be saved, All you ends of the earth! For I am God, and thereis no other.
verses.textEnNlt: Let all the world look to me for salvation! For I am God; there is no other.
verses.textEnNasb: "Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; For I am God, and there is no other.
verses.textEn: "Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

verses.textZh: 我指着自己起誓， 我的口凭着公义说出的话， 决不改变： ‘万膝都必向我跪拜，万口都要指着我起誓。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着自己起誓， 我的口凭着公义说出的话， 决不改变： ‘万膝都必向我跪拜，万口都要指着我起誓。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着自己起誓， 我口所出的话是凭公义，并不反回： 万膝必向我跪拜； 万口必凭我起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: By myself I have sworn, my mouth has uttered in all integrity a word that will not be revoked: Before me every knee will bow; by me every tongue will swear.
verses.textEnEsv: By myself I have sworn; from my mouth has gone out in righteousness a word that shall not return: ‘To me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear allegiance.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I have sworn by Myself; The word has gone out of My mouth in righteousness, And shall not return, That to Me every knee shall bow, Every tongue shall take an oath.
verses.textEnNlt: I have sworn by my own name; I have spoken the truth, and I will never go back on my word: Every knee will bend to me, and every tongue will declare allegiance to me. "
verses.textEnNasb: "I have sworn by Myself; The word has gone out from My mouth in righteousness And will not turn back, That to Me every knee will bow, every tongue will swear allegiance.
verses.textEn: By myself I have sworn, my mouth has uttered in all integrity a word that will not be revoked: Before me every knee will bow; by me every tongue will swear.

verses.textZh: 人论到我必说：‘只有在耶和华里面才有公义和能力’； 向他发怒的，都必来到他面前，并且要蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人论到我必说：‘只有在耶和华里面才有公义和能力’； 向他发怒的，都必来到他面前，并且要蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 人论我说， 公义、能力，惟独在乎耶和华； 人都必归向他。 凡向他发怒的必至蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: They will say of me, ‘In the Lord alone are deliverance and strength.’ " All who have raged against him will come to him and be put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: "Only in the Lord , it shall be said of me, are righteousness and strength; to him shall come and be ashamed all who were incensed against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall say, ‘Surely in the Lord I have righteousness and strength. To Him men shall come, And all shall be ashamed Who are incensed against Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The people will declare, "The Lord is the source of all my righteousness and strength." And all who were angry with him will come to him and be ashamed.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will say of Me, ‘Only in the Lord are righteousness and strength.’ People will come to Him, And all who were angry at Him will be put to shame.
verses.textEn: They will say of me, ‘In the Lord alone are deliverance and strength.’ " All who have raged against him will come to him and be put to shame.

verses.textZh: 以色列所有的后裔， 都必靠耶和华得称为义，并要夸胜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列所有的后裔， 都必靠耶和华得称为义，并要夸胜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的后裔都必因耶和华得称为义， 并要夸耀。
verses.textEnNiv: But all the descendants of Israel will find deliverance in the Lord and will make their boast in him.
verses.textEnEsv: In the Lord all the offspring of Israel shall be justified and shall glory."
verses.textEnNkjv: In the Lord all the descendants of Israel Shall be justified, and shall glory.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In the Lord all the generations of Israel will be justified, and in him they will boast.
verses.textEnNasb: "In the Lord all the offspring of Israel Will be justified and will boast."
verses.textEn: But all the descendants of Israel will find deliverance in the Lord and will make their boast in him.

verses.textZh: 彼勒俯伏，尼波弯腰； 巴比伦人的偶像驮在走兽和牲口上。 你们所抬的现在都成了重担， 成了疲乏的牲畜身上的重负。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼勒俯伏，尼波弯腰； 巴比伦人的偶像驮在走兽和牲口上。 你们所抬的现在都成了重担， 成了疲乏的牲畜身上的重负。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼勒屈身，尼波弯腰； 巴比伦的偶像驮在兽和牲畜上。 他们所抬的如今成了重驮， 使牲畜疲乏，
verses.textEnNiv: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops low; their idols are borne by beasts of burden. The images that are carried about are burdensome, a burden for the weary.
verses.textEnEsv: Bel bows down; Nebo stoops; their idols are on beasts and livestock; these things you carry are borne as burdens on weary beasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops; Their idols were on the beasts and on the cattle. Your carriages were heavily loaded, A burden to the weary beast.
verses.textEnNlt: Bel and Nebo, the gods of Babylon, bow as they are lowered to the ground. They are being hauled away on ox carts. The poor beasts stagger under the weight.
verses.textEnNasb: Bel has bowed down, Nebo stoops over; Their idols have become loads for the animals and the cattle. The things that you carry are burdensome, A load for the weary animal.
verses.textEn: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops low; their idols are borne by beasts of burden. The images that are carried about are burdensome, a burden for the weary.

verses.textZh: 它们一同弯腰、俯伏， 不能保护重负， 它们自己反倒被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们一同弯腰、俯伏， 不能保护重负， 它们自己反倒被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 都一同弯腰屈身， 不能保全重驮， 自己倒被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: They stoop and bow down together; unable to rescue the burden, they themselves go off into captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: They stoop; they bow down together; they cannot save the burden, but themselves go into captivity.
verses.textEnNkjv: They stoop, they bow down together; They could not deliver the burden, But have themselves gone into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Both the idols and their owners are bowed down. The gods cannot protect the people, and the people cannot protect the gods. They go off into captivity together.
verses.textEnNasb: They stooped over, they have bowed down together; They could not rescue the burden, But have themselves gone into captivity.
verses.textEn: They stoop and bow down together; unable to rescue the burden, they themselves go off into captivity.

verses.textZh: "雅各家啊，以色列家所有余剩的人哪！ 你们都要听我的话， 你们自出母腹，就蒙我怀抱； 自出母胎，就蒙我提携。
verses.textZhCnvs: "雅各家啊，以色列家所有余剩的人哪！ 你们都要听我的话， 你们自出母腹，就蒙我怀抱； 自出母胎，就蒙我提携。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家，以色列家一切余剩的要听我言： 你们自从生下，就蒙我保抱， 自从出胎，便蒙我怀搋。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to me, you descendants of Jacob, all the remnant of the people of Israel, you whom I have upheld since your birth, and have carried since you were born.
verses.textEnEsv: "Listen to me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been borne by me from before your birth, carried from the womb;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, And all the remnant of the house of Israel, Who have been upheld byMe from birth, Who have been carried from the womb:
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, descendants of Jacob, all you who remain in Israel. I have cared for you since you were born. Yes, I carried you before you were born.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to Me, house of Jacob, And all the remnant of the house of Israel, You who have been carried by Me from birth And have been carried from the womb;
verses.textEn: "Listen to me, you descendants of Jacob, all the remnant of the people of Israel, you whom I have upheld since your birth, and have carried since you were born.

verses.textZh: 直到你们年老，我还是一样； 直到你们发白，我仍然怀抱你。 我以前既然这样作了，以后我仍必提携你； 我必怀抱你，也必拯救你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到你们年老，我还是一样； 直到你们发白，我仍然怀抱你。 我以前既然这样作了，以后我仍必提携你； 我必怀抱你，也必拯救你。
verses.textZhCuv: 直到你们年老，我仍这样； 直到你们发白，我仍怀搋。 我已造作，也必保抱； 我必怀抱，也必拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.
verses.textEnEsv: even to your old age I am he, and to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even to your old age, I am He, And even to gray hairs I will carry you! I have made, and I will bear; Even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be your God throughout your lifetime— until your hair is white with age. I made you, and I will care for you. I will carry you along and save you.
verses.textEnNasb: Even to your old age I will be the same, And even to your graying years I will carry you! I have done it, and I will bear you; And I will carry you and I will save you.
verses.textEn: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.

verses.textZh: 你们要把谁与我相比，谁与我相似呢？ 你们把谁与我比较，好使我们同等呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把谁与我相比，谁与我相似呢？ 你们把谁与我比较，好使我们同等呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们将谁与我相比，与我同等， 可以与我比较，使我们相同呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "With whom will you compare me or count me equal? To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?
verses.textEnEsv: "To whom will you liken me and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be alike?
verses.textEnNkjv: "To whom will you liken Me, and make Me equal And compare Me, that we should be alike?
verses.textEnNlt: "To whom will you compare me? Who is my equal?
verses.textEnNasb: "To whom would you liken Me And make Me equal, and compare Me, That we would be alike?
verses.textEn: "With whom will you compare me or count me equal? To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?

verses.textZh: 那些从钱袋倒出金子， 用天平称银子的人， 雇用金匠制造神像； 他们向神像又俯伏又叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些从钱袋倒出金子， 用天平称银子的人， 雇用金匠制造神像； 他们向神像又俯伏又叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 那从囊中抓金子， 用天平平银子的人， 雇银匠制造神像， 他们又俯伏，又叩拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who lavish gold from the purse, and weigh out silver in the scales, hire a goldsmith, and he makes it into a god; then they fall down and worship!
verses.textEnNkjv: They lavish gold out of the bag, And weigh silver on the scales; They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god; They prostrate themselves, yes, they worship.
verses.textEnNlt: Some people pour out their silver and gold and hire a craftsman to make a god from it. Then they bow down and worship it!
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who lavish gold from the bag And weigh silver on the scale, Hire a goldsmith, and he makes it into a god; They bow down, indeed they worship it.
verses.textEn: Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it.

verses.textZh: 他们把神像抬起来，扛在肩头上， 然后把它安置在固定的地方，它就立在那里， 总不离开它的本位。 虽然有人向它呼求，它也不能回答； 它也不能救人脱离患难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把神像抬起来，扛在肩头上， 然后把它安置在固定的地方，它就立在那里， 总不离开它的本位。 虽然有人向它呼求，它也不能回答； 它也不能救人脱离患难。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将神像抬起，扛在肩上， 安置在定处，它就站立， 不离本位； 人呼求它，它不能答应， 也不能救人脱离患难。
verses.textEnNiv: They lift it to their shoulders and carry it; they set it up in its place, and there it stands. From that spot it cannot move. Even though someone cries out to it, it cannot answer; it cannot save them from their troubles.
verses.textEnEsv: They lift it to their shoulders, they carry it, they set it in its place, and it stands there; it cannot move from its place. If one cries to it, it does not answer or save him from his trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: They bear it on the shoulder, they carry it And set it in its place, and it stands; From its place it shall not move. Though one cries out to it, yet it cannot answer Nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: They carry it around on their shoulders, and when they set it down, it stays there. It can’t even move! And when someone prays to it, there is no answer. It can’t rescue anyone from trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: "They lift it on the shoulder, carry it, And set it in its place, and it stands there. It does not move from its place. Though one may shout to it, it cannot answer; It cannot save him from his distress.
verses.textEn: They lift it to their shoulders and carry it; they set it up in its place, and there it stands. From that spot it cannot move. Even though someone cries out to it, it cannot answer; it cannot save them from their troubles.

verses.textZh: "你们当记念这事，要坚定不移； 悖逆的人哪！你们要留心思想。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们当记念这事，要坚定不移； 悖逆的人哪！你们要留心思想。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当想念这事，自己作大丈夫。 悖逆的人哪，要心里思想。
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember this, keep it in mind, take it to heart, you rebels.
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember this and stand firm, recall it to mind, you transgressors,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember this, and show yourselves men; Recall to mind, O you transgressors.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not forget this! Keep it in mind! Remember this, you guilty ones.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember this, and be assured; Recall it to mind, you wrongdoers.
verses.textEn: "Remember this, keep it in mind, take it to heart, you rebels.

verses.textZh: 你们当记念上古以前的事， 因为我是神，再没有别的神； 我是神，没有神像我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们当记念上古以前的事， 因为我是神，再没有别的神； 我是神，没有神像我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要追念上古的事。 因为我是神，并无别神； 我是神，再没有能比我的。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember the former things, those of long ago; I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me.
verses.textEnEsv: remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember the former things of old, For I am God, and thereis no other; Iam God, and thereis none like Me,
verses.textEnNlt: Remember the things I have done in the past. For I alone am God! I am God, and there is none like me.
