verses.textEnNasb: "Remember the former things long past, For I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is no one like Me,
verses.textEn: Remember the former things, those of long ago; I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me.

verses.textZh: 我从起初就宣告末后的事， 从古时就述说还未作成的事， 说：‘我的计划必定成功， 我所喜悦的，我都必作成。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从起初就宣告末后的事， 从古时就述说还未作成的事， 说：‘我的计划必定成功， 我所喜悦的，我都必作成。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我从起初指明末后的事， 从古时言明未成的事， 说：我的筹算必立定； 凡我所喜悦的，我必成就。
verses.textEnNiv: I make known the end from the beginning, from ancient times, what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and I will do all that I please.’
verses.textEnEsv: declaring the end from the beginning and from ancient times things not yet done, saying, ‘My counsel shall stand, and I will accomplish all my purpose,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Declaring the end from the beginning, And from ancient times things that are not yet done, Saying, ‘My counsel shall stand, And I will do all My pleasure,’
verses.textEnNlt: Only I can tell you the future before it even happens. Everything I plan will come to pass, for I do whatever I wish.
verses.textEnNasb: Declaring the end from the beginning, And from ancient times things which have not been done, Saying, ‘My plan will be established, And I will accomplish all My good pleasure’;
verses.textEn: I make known the end from the beginning, from ancient times, what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and I will do all that I please.’

verses.textZh: 我把鸷鸟从日出之地召来， 就是把成就我计划的人从远方召来。 我不但说了，而且也要使我的话实现； 我不但计划好了，而且也必实行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把鸷鸟从日出之地召来， 就是把成就我计划的人从远方召来。 我不但说了，而且也要使我的话实现； 我不但计划好了，而且也必实行。
verses.textZhCuv: 我召鸷鸟从东方来， 召那成就我筹算的人从远方来。 我已说出，也必成就； 我已谋定，也必做成。
verses.textEnNiv: From the east I summon a bird of prey; from a far-off land, a man to fulfill my purpose. What I have said, that I will bring about; what I have planned, that I will do.
verses.textEnEsv: calling a bird of prey from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. I have spoken, and I will bring it to pass; I have purposed, and I will do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Calling a bird of prey from the east, The man who executes My counsel, from a far country. Indeed I have spoken it; I will also bring it to pass. I have purposed it; I will also do it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will call a swift bird of prey from the east— a leader from a distant land to come and do my bidding. I have said what I would do, and I will do it.
verses.textEnNasb: Calling a bird of prey from the east, The man of My purpose from a distant country. Truly I have spoken; truly I will bring it to pass. I have planned it, I will certainly do it.
verses.textEn: From the east I summon a bird of prey; from a far-off land, a man to fulfill my purpose. What I have said, that I will bring about; what I have planned, that I will do.

verses.textZh: 心里顽固的人哪！ 远离公义的人哪！你们要听我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里顽固的人哪！ 远离公义的人哪！你们要听我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这些心中顽梗、 远离公义的，当听我言。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, you who are now far from my righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: "Listen to me, you stubborn of heart, you who are far from righteousness:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to Me, you stubborn-hearted, Who are far from righteousness:
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, you stubborn people who are so far from doing right.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to Me, you stubborn-minded, Who are far from righteousness.
verses.textEn: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, you who are now far from my righteousness.

verses.textZh: 我使我的公义临近了，必不远离； 我的救恩必不迟延。 我要为以色列，我的荣耀， 在锡安施行拯救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使我的公义临近了，必不远离； 我的救恩必不迟延。 我要为以色列，我的荣耀， 在锡安施行拯救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我使我的公义临近，必不远离。 我的救恩必不迟延； 我要为以色列－我的荣耀， 在锡安施行救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: I am bringing my righteousness near, it is not far away; and my salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, my splendor to Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: I bring near my righteousness; it is not far off, and my salvation will not delay; I will put salvation in Zion, for Israel my glory."
verses.textEnNkjv: I bring My righteousness near, it shall not be far off; My salvation shall not linger. And I will place salvation in Zion, For Israel My glory.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am ready to set things right, not in the distant future, but right now! I am ready to save Jerusalem and show my glory to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "I bring near My righteousness, it is not far off; And My salvation will not delay. And I will grant salvation in Zion, And My glory for Israel.
verses.textEn: I am bringing my righteousness near, it is not far away; and my salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, my splendor to Israel.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦的处女啊！ 你下来，坐在尘土中吧！ 迦勒底的女儿啊！ 你坐在地上吧！没有宝座了， 因为你必不再被称为柔弱娇嫩的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦的处女啊！ 你下来，坐在尘土中吧！ 迦勒底的女儿啊！ 你坐在地上吧！没有宝座了， 因为你必不再被称为柔弱娇嫩的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦的处女啊， 下来坐在尘埃； 迦勒底的闺女啊， 没有宝座，要坐在地上； 因为你不再称为柔弱娇嫩的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go down, sit in the dust, Virgin Daughter Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, queen city of the Babylonians. No more will you be called tender or delicate.
verses.textEnEsv: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans! For you shall no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; Sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans! For you shall no more be called Tender and delicate.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come down, virgin daughter of Babylon, and sit in the dust. For your days of sitting on a throne have ended. O daughter of Babylonia, never again will you be the lovely princess, tender and delicate.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come down and sit in the dust, Virgin daughter of Babylon; Sit on the ground without a throne, Daughter of the Chaldeans! For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.
verses.textEn: "Go down, sit in the dust, Virgin Daughter Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, queen city of the Babylonians. No more will you be called tender or delicate.

verses.textZh: 你要拿石磨去磨面， 你要揭开你的帕子，脱去长裙， 露出大腿，渡过江河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拿石磨去磨面， 你要揭开你的帕子，脱去长裙， 露出大腿，渡过江河。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用磨磨面， 揭去帕子， 脱去长衣，露腿趟河。
verses.textEnNiv: Take millstones and grind flour; take off your veil. Lift up your skirts, bare your legs, and wade through the streams.
verses.textEnEsv: Take the millstones and grind flour, put off your veil, strip off your robe, uncover your legs, pass through the rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take the millstones and grind meal. Remove your veil, Take off the skirt, Uncover the thigh, Pass through the rivers.
verses.textEnNlt: Take heavy millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, and strip off your robe. Expose yourself to public view.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, strip off the skirt, Uncover the leg, cross the rivers.
verses.textEn: Take millstones and grind flour; take off your veil. Lift up your skirts, bare your legs, and wade through the streams.

verses.textZh: 你的下体必暴露出来， 你的羞耻要被人看见； 我必报仇，不顾惜任何人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的下体必暴露出来， 你的羞耻要被人看见； 我必报仇，不顾惜任何人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的下体必被露出； 你的丑陋必被看见。 我要报仇， 谁也不宽容。
verses.textEnNiv: Your nakedness will be exposed and your shame uncovered. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one."
verses.textEnEsv: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, and your disgrace shall be seen. I will take vengeance, and I will spare no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, Yes, your shame will be seen; I will take vengeance, And I will not arbitrate with a man."
verses.textEnNlt: You will be naked and burdened with shame. I will take vengeance against you without pity."
verses.textEnNasb: "Your nakedness will be uncovered, Your shame will also be exposed; I will take vengeance and will not spare anyone."
verses.textEn: Your nakedness will be exposed and your shame uncovered. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one."

verses.textZh: 我们的救赎主，他的名字是万军之耶和华、 以色列的圣者，他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的救赎主，他的名字是万军之耶和华、 以色列的圣者，他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我们救赎主的名是 万军之耶和华－以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: Our Redeemer—the Lord Almighty is his name— is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Our Redeemer—the Lord of hosts is his name— is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor our Redeemer, the Lord of hosts is His name, The Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Our Redeemer, whose name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Our Redeemer, the Lord of armies is His name, The Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Our Redeemer—the Lord Almighty is his name— is the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: "迦勒底的女子啊！ 你要静静坐下，进到黑暗中去， 因为人不再称你为列国之后了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "迦勒底的女子啊！ 你要静静坐下，进到黑暗中去， 因为人不再称你为列国之后了。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底的闺女啊， 你要默然静坐，进入暗中， 因为你不再称为列国的主母。
verses.textEnNiv: "Sit in silence, go into darkness, queen city of the Babylonians; no more will you be called queen of kingdoms.
verses.textEnEsv: Sit in silence, and go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; for you shall no more be called the mistress of kingdoms.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Sit in silence, and go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; For you shall no longer be called The Lady of Kingdoms.
verses.textEnNlt: "O beautiful Babylon, sit now in darkness and silence. Never again will you be known as the queen of kingdoms.
verses.textEnNasb: "Sit silently, and go into darkness, Daughter of the Chaldeans; For you will no longer be called The queen of kingdoms.
verses.textEn: "Sit in silence, go into darkness, queen city of the Babylonians; no more will you be called queen of kingdoms.

verses.textZh: 我曾对我的子民发怒， 使我的产业被亵渎， 我把他们交在你的手里， 你却对他们毫无怜悯。 你竟把你的轭，重重压在老年人的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾对我的子民发怒， 使我的产业被亵渎， 我把他们交在你的手里， 你却对他们毫无怜悯。 你竟把你的轭，重重压在老年人的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向我的百姓发怒， 使我的产业被亵渎， 将他们交在你手中， 你毫不怜悯他们， 把极重的轭加在老年人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: I was angry with my people and desecrated my inheritance; I gave them into your hand, and you showed them no mercy. Even on the aged you laid a very heavy yoke.
verses.textEnEsv: I was angry with my people; I profaned my heritage; I gave them into your hand; you showed them no mercy; on the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was angry with My people; I have profaned My inheritance, And given them into your hand. You showed them no mercy; On the elderly you laid your yoke very heavily.
verses.textEnNlt: For I was angry with my chosen people and punished them by letting them fall into your hands. But you, Babylon, showed them no mercy. You oppressed even the elderly.
verses.textEnNasb: "I was angry with My people, I profaned My heritage And handed them over to you. You did not show mercy to them, On the aged you made your yoke very heavy.
verses.textEn: I was angry with my people and desecrated my inheritance; I gave them into your hand, and you showed them no mercy. Even on the aged you laid a very heavy yoke.

verses.textZh: 你曾说：‘我必永远作王后！’ 所以你不把这些事放在心上， 也不思想这事的结局。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾说：‘我必永远作王后！’ 所以你不把这些事放在心上， 也不思想这事的结局。
verses.textZhCuv: 你自己说：我必永为主母， 所以你不将这事放在心上， 也不思想这事的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: You said, ‘I am forever— the eternal queen!’ But you did not consider these things or reflect on what might happen.
verses.textEnEsv: You said, "I shall be mistress forever," so that you did not lay these things to heart or remember their end.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you said, ‘I shall be a lady forever,’ So that you did not take these things to heart, Nor remember the latter end of them.
verses.textEnNlt: You said, ‘I will reign forever as queen of the world!’ You did not reflect on your actions or think about their consequences.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet you said, ‘I will be a queen forever.’ These things you did not consider Nor remember the outcome of them.
verses.textEn: You said, ‘I am forever— the eternal queen!’ But you did not consider these things or reflect on what might happen.

verses.textZh: 因此，你这淫逸、安居的， 现在要听这话。 你曾心里说： ‘只有我，除我以外再没有别的； 我必不会寡居， 也不会经历丧子的事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你这淫逸、安居的， 现在要听这话。 你曾心里说： ‘只有我，除我以外再没有别的； 我必不会寡居， 也不会经历丧子的事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你这专好宴乐、安然居住的， 现在当听这话。 你心中说：惟有我， 除我以外再没有别的。 我必不致寡居， 也不遭丧子之事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, listen, you lover of pleasure, lounging in your security and saying to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or suffer the loss of children.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore hear this, you lover of pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me; I shall not sit as a widow or know the loss of children":
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore hear this now, youwhoare given to pleasures, Who dwell securely, Who say in your heart, ‘I am, and thereis no one else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, Nor shall I know the loss of children’;
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to this, you pleasure-loving kingdom, living at ease and feeling secure. You say, ‘I am the only one, and there is no other. I will never be a widow or lose my children.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, then, hear this, you luxuriant one, Who lives securely, Who says in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no one besides me. I will not sit as a widow, Nor know the loss of children.’
verses.textEn: "Now then, listen, you lover of pleasure, lounging in your security and saying to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or suffer the loss of children.’

verses.textZh: 不料丧子和寡居这两件事， 竟在忽然之间，一日之内，要临到你身上！ 正在你多行邪术， 竭力施符咒的时候， 这两件事就必都临到你身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不料丧子和寡居这两件事， 竟在忽然之间，一日之内，要临到你身上！ 正在你多行邪术， 竭力施符咒的时候， 这两件事就必都临到你身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 哪知，丧子、寡居这两件事 在一日转眼之间必临到你； 正在你多行邪术、广施符咒的时候， 这两件事必全然临到你身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Both of these will overtake you in a moment, on a single day: loss of children and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and all your potent spells.
verses.textEnEsv: These two things shall come to you in a moment, in one day; the loss of children and widowhood shall come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and the great power of your enchantments.
verses.textEnNkjv: But these two things shall come to you In a moment, in one day: The loss of children, and widowhood. They shall come upon you in their fullness Because of the multitude of your sorceries, For the great abundance of your enchantments.
verses.textEnNlt: Well, both these things will come upon you in a moment: widowhood and the loss of your children. Yes, these calamities will come upon you, despite all your witchcraft and magic.
verses.textEnNasb: "But these two things will come on you suddenly in one day: Loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in full measure In spite of your many sorceries, In spite of the great power of your spells.
verses.textEn: Both of these will overtake you in a moment, on a single day: loss of children and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and all your potent spells.

verses.textZh: 你向来倚靠自己的邪恶， 说：‘没有人看见我’； 你的智慧和知识把你引入了歧途。 你心里说： ‘只有我，除了我以外，再没有别的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你向来倚靠自己的邪恶， 说：‘没有人看见我’； 你的智慧和知识把你引入了歧途。 你心里说： ‘只有我，除了我以外，再没有别的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你素来倚仗自己的恶行，说： 无人看见我。 你的智慧聪明使你偏邪， 并且你心里说：惟有我， 除我以外再没有别的。
verses.textEnNiv: You have trusted in your wickedness and have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge mislead you when you say to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’
verses.textEnEsv: You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, "No one sees me"; your wisdom and your knowledge led you astray, and you said in your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For you have trusted in your wickedness; You have said, ‘No one sees me’; Your wisdom and your knowledge have warped you; And you have said in your heart, ‘I am, and thereis no one else besides me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You felt secure in your wickedness. ‘No one sees me,’ you said. But your ‘wisdom’ and ‘knowledge’ have led you astray, and you said, ‘I am the only one, and there is no other.’
verses.textEnNasb: "You felt secure in your wickedness and said, ‘No one sees me,’ Your wisdom and your knowledge, they have led you astray; For you have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one besides me.’
verses.textEn: You have trusted in your wickedness and have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge mislead you when you say to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’

verses.textZh: 但灾祸必临到你身上， 你却不知道它的来源； 祸患必落在你身上， 你却不能把它除去； 毁灭必忽然临到你身上， 你却不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但灾祸必临到你身上， 你却不知道它的来源； 祸患必落在你身上， 你却不能把它除去； 毁灭必忽然临到你身上， 你却不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，祸患要临到你身； 你不知何时发现 灾害落在你身上， 你也不能除掉； 所不知道的毁灭也必忽然临到你身。
verses.textEnNiv: Disaster will come upon you, and you will not know how to conjure it away. A calamity will fall upon you that you cannot ward off with a ransom; a catastrophe you cannot foresee will suddenly come upon you.
verses.textEnEsv: But evil shall come upon you, which you will not know how to charm away; disaster shall fall upon you, for which you will not be able to atone; and ruin shall come upon you suddenly, of which you know nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore evil shall come upon you; You shall not know from where it arises. And trouble shall fall upon you; You will not be able to put it off. And desolation shall come upon you suddenly, Which you shall not know.
verses.textEnNlt: So disaster will overtake you, and you won’t be able to charm it away. Calamity will fall upon you, and you won’t be able to buy your way out. A catastrophe will strike you suddenly, one for which you are not prepared.
verses.textEnNasb: "But evil will come on you Which you will not know how to charm away; And disaster will fall on you For which you cannot atone; And destruction about which you do not know Will come on you suddenly.
verses.textEn: Disaster will come upon you, and you will not know how to conjure it away. A calamity will fall upon you that you cannot ward off with a ransom; a catastrophe you cannot foresee will suddenly come upon you.

verses.textZh: 继续使用你从幼年时就劳碌 施行的符咒 和许多的邪术吧！ 或者你可以得到益处， 也许你能叫人战栗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 继续使用你从幼年时就劳碌 施行的符咒 和许多的邪术吧！ 或者你可以得到益处， 也许你能叫人战栗。
verses.textZhCuv: 站起来吧！ 用你从幼年劳神施行的符咒和你许多的邪术； 或者可得益处， 或者可得强胜。
verses.textEnNiv: "Keep on, then, with your magic spells and with your many sorceries, which you have labored at since childhood. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will cause terror.
verses.textEnEsv: Stand fast in your enchantments and your many sorceries, with which you have labored from your youth; perhaps you may be able to succeed; perhaps you may inspire terror.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Stand now with your enchantments And the multitude of your sorceries, In which you have labored from your youth— Perhaps you will be able to profit, Perhaps you will prevail.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now use your magical charms! Use the spells you have worked at all these years! Maybe they will do you some good. Maybe they can make someone afraid of you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Persist now in your spells And in your many sorceries With which you have labored from your youth; Perhaps you will be able to benefit, Perhaps you may cause trembling.
verses.textEn: "Keep on, then, with your magic spells and with your many sorceries, which you have labored at since childhood. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will cause terror.

verses.textZh: 你因你许多的计划而劳累； 现在让那些划分天象的， 观看星辰的， 在月朔时说预言的， 都站起来，拯救你脱离要临到你身上的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因你许多的计划而劳累； 现在让那些划分天象的， 观看星辰的， 在月朔时说预言的， 都站起来，拯救你脱离要临到你身上的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你筹划太多，以致疲倦。 让那些观天象的，看星宿的， 在月朔说预言的，都站起来， 救你脱离所要临到你的事。
verses.textEnNiv: All the counsel you have received has only worn you out! Let your astrologers come forward, those stargazers who make predictions month by month, let them save you from what is coming upon you.
verses.textEnEsv: You are wearied with your many counsels; let them stand forth and save you, those who divide the heavens, who gaze at the stars, who at the new moons make known what shall come upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels; Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, And the monthly prognosticators Stand up and save you From what shall come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: All the advice you receive has made you tired. Where are all your astrologers, those stargazers who make predictions each month? Let them stand up and save you from what the future holds.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are wearied with your many counsels; Let now the astrologers, Those who prophesy by the stars, Those who predict by the new moons, Stand up and save you from what will come upon you.
verses.textEn: All the counsel you have received has only worn you out! Let your astrologers come forward, those stargazers who make predictions month by month, let them save you from what is coming upon you.

verses.textZh: 看哪！他们必像碎秸， 火必要焚烧他们； 他们不能救自己脱离火焰的威力； 这不是可以烤火取暖的火炭， 也不是可以坐在它面前的火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他们必像碎秸， 火必要焚烧他们； 他们不能救自己脱离火焰的威力； 这不是可以烤火取暖的火炭， 也不是可以坐在它面前的火。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要像碎秸被火焚烧， 不能救自己脱离火焰之力； 这火并非可烤的炭火， 也不是可以坐在其前的火。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot even save themselves from the power of the flame. These are not coals for warmth; this is not a fire to sit by.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, they are like stubble; the fire consumes them; they cannot deliver themselves from the power of the flame. No coal for warming oneself is this, no fire to sit before!
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, they shall be as stubble, The fire shall burn them; They shall not deliver themselves From the power of the flame; Itshall not be a coal to be warmed by, Nor a fire to sit before!
verses.textEnNlt: But they are like straw burning in a fire; they cannot save themselves from the flame. You will get no help from them at all; their hearth is no place to sit for warmth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, they have become like stubble, Fire burns them; They cannot save themselves from the power of the flame; There will be no coal to warm by Nor a fire to sit before!
verses.textEn: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot even save themselves from the power of the flame. These are not coals for warmth; this is not a fire to sit by.

verses.textZh: 你所劳碌的事，都要这样与你无益； 从你年幼时与你交易的， 也都必各奔各方，四处飘流， 没有人拯救你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所劳碌的事，都要这样与你无益； 从你年幼时与你交易的， 也都必各奔各方，四处飘流， 没有人拯救你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你所劳神的事都要这样与你无益； 从幼年与你贸易的也都各奔各乡，无人救你。
verses.textEnNiv: That is all they are to you— these you have dealt with and labored with since childhood. All of them go on in their error; there is not one that can save you.
verses.textEnEsv: Such to you are those with whom you have labored, who have done business with you from your youth; they wander about, each in his own direction; there is no one to save you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus shall they be to you With whom you have labored, Your merchants from your youth; They shall wander each one to his quarter. No one shall save you.
verses.textEnNlt: And all your friends, those with whom you’ve done business since childhood, will go their own ways, turning a deaf ear to your cries.
verses.textEnNasb: "So have those become to you with whom you have labored, Those who have done business with you from your youth; Each has wandered in his own way; There is no one to save you.
verses.textEn: That is all they are to you— these you have dealt with and labored with since childhood. All of them go on in their error; there is not one that can save you.

verses.textZh: 雅各家，就是被称为以色列的， 从犹大的水源出来的， 指着耶和华的名起誓， 却不是出于诚实和公义， 提说以色列的神的啊！你们要听这话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家，就是被称为以色列的， 从犹大的水源出来的， 指着耶和华的名起誓， 却不是出于诚实和公义， 提说以色列的神的啊！你们要听这话。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家，称为以色列名下， 从犹大水源出来的，当听我言！ 你们指着耶和华的名起誓， 提说以色列的神， 却不凭诚实，不凭公义。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to this, you descendants of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the line of Judah, you who take oaths in the name of the Lord and invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and who came from the waters of Judah, who swear by the name of the Lord and confess the God of Israel, but not in truth or right.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear this, O house of Jacob, Who are called by the name of Israel, And have come forth from the wellsprings of Judah; Who swear by the name of the Lord, And make mention of the God of Israel, But not in truth or in righteousness;
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, O family of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and born into the family of Judah. Listen, you who take oaths in the name of the Lord and call on the God of Israel. You don’t keep your promises,
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear this, house of Jacob, who are named Israel And who came from the waters of Judah, Who swear by the name of the Lord And invoke the God of Israel, But not in truth nor in righteousness.
verses.textEn: "Listen to this, you descendants of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the line of Judah, you who take oaths in the name of the Lord and invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—

verses.textZh: 他们被称为圣城的人， 又倚靠以色列的神； 他的名字是万军之耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们被称为圣城的人， 又倚靠以色列的神； 他的名字是万军之耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们自称为圣城的人， 所倚靠的是 名为万军之耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: you who call yourselves citizens of the holy city and claim to rely on the God of Israel— the Lord Almighty is his name:
verses.textEnEsv: For they call themselves after the holy city, and stay themselves on the God of Israel; the Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they call themselves after the holy city, And lean on the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is His name:
verses.textEnNlt: even though you call yourself the holy city and talk about depending on the God of Israel, whose name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "For they name themselves after the holy city, And lean on the God of Israel; The Lord of armies is His name.
verses.textEn: you who call yourselves citizens of the holy city and claim to rely on the God of Israel— the Lord Almighty is his name:

verses.textZh: 主说："先前的事，我从古时就预言过了， 已经从我的口里说出来了，又说给人听了； 我忽然行事，事情就都成就了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："先前的事，我从古时就预言过了， 已经从我的口里说出来了，又说给人听了； 我忽然行事，事情就都成就了。
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：早先的事，我从古时说明， 已经出了我的口， 也是我所指示的； 我忽然行做，事便成就。
verses.textEnNiv: I foretold the former things long ago, my mouth announced them and I made them known; then suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
verses.textEnEsv: "The former things I declared of old; they went out from my mouth, and I announced them; then suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have declared the former things from the beginning; They went forth from My mouth, and I caused them to hear it. Suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.
verses.textEnNlt: Long ago I told you what was going to happen. Then suddenly I took action, and all my predictions came true.
verses.textEnNasb: "I declared the former things long ago, And they went out of My mouth, and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
verses.textEn: I foretold the former things long ago, my mouth announced them and I made them known; then suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.

verses.textZh: 因为我知道你是顽固的， 你的颈项是铁的， 你的额是铜的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道你是顽固的， 你的颈项是铁的， 你的额是铜的，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的－ 你的颈项是铁的； 你的额是铜的。
verses.textEnNiv: For I knew how stubborn you were; your neck muscles were iron, your forehead was bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: Because I know that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead brass,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because I knew that you were obstinate, And your neck was an iron sinew, And your brow bronze,
verses.textEnNlt: For I know how stubborn and obstinate you are. Your necks are as unbending as iron. Your heads are as hard as bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because I know that you are obstinate, And your neck is an iron tendon And your forehead bronze,
verses.textEn: For I knew how stubborn you were; your neck muscles were iron, your forehead was bronze.

verses.textZh: 所以我从古时就告诉了你； 在事情还没有发生以前，我就说给你听了， 免得你说：‘这些事是我的偶像所作的， 是我的雕像和铸像所命定的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我从古时就告诉了你； 在事情还没有发生以前，我就说给你听了， 免得你说：‘这些事是我的偶像所作的， 是我的雕像和铸像所命定的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我从古时将这事给你说明， 在未成以先指示你， 免得你说：这些事是我的偶像所行的， 是我雕刻的偶像和我铸造的偶像所命定的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I told you these things long ago; before they happened I announced them to you so that you could not say, ‘My images brought them about; my wooden image and metal god ordained them.’
verses.textEnEsv: I declared them to you from of old, before they came to pass I announced them to you, lest you should say, ‘My idol did them, my carved image and my metal image commanded them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Even from the beginning I have declared it to you; Before it came to pass I proclaimed it to you, Lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them, And my carved image and my molded image Have commanded them.’
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I told you what would happen; I told you beforehand what I was going to do. Then you could never say, ‘My idols did it. My wooden image and metal god commanded it to happen!’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I declared them to you long ago, Before they took place I proclaimed them to you, So that you would not say, ‘My idol has done them, And my carved image and my cast metal image have commanded them.’
verses.textEn: Therefore I told you these things long ago; before they happened I announced them to you so that you could not say, ‘My images brought them about; my wooden image and metal god ordained them.’

verses.textZh: 你已经听见了，现在要注意这一切事。 难道你不述说吗？ 从今以后，我要把新的事， 就是你不知道的隐秘的事，告诉你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你已经听见了，现在要注意这一切事。 难道你不述说吗？ 从今以后，我要把新的事， 就是你不知道的隐秘的事，告诉你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你已经听见，现在要看见这一切； 你不说明吗？ 从今以后，我将新事， 就是你所不知道的隐密事指示你。
verses.textEnNiv: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not admit them? "From now on I will tell you of new things, of hidden things unknown to you.
verses.textEnEsv: "You have heard; now see all this; and will you not declare it? From this time forth I announce to you new things, hidden things that you have not known.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have heard; See all this. And will you not declare it? I have made you hear new things from this time, Even hidden things, and you did not know them.
verses.textEnNlt: You have heard my predictions and seen them fulfilled, but you refuse to admit it. Now I will tell you new things, secrets you have not yet heard.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have heard; look at all this. And you, will you not declare it? I proclaim to you new things from this time, Hidden things which you have not known.
verses.textEn: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not admit them? "From now on I will tell you of new things, of hidden things unknown to you.

verses.textZh: 这些事是现在才造成的，并不是从古时就有的； 在今天以前，你还未曾听见过， 免得你说：‘看哪！这些事我早已知道了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事是现在才造成的，并不是从古时就有的； 在今天以前，你还未曾听见过， 免得你说：‘看哪！这些事我早已知道了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这事是现今造的，并非从古就有； 在今日以先，你也未曾听见， 免得你说：这事我早已知道了。
verses.textEnNiv: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot say, ‘Yes, I knew of them.’
verses.textEnEsv: They are created now, not long ago; before today you have never heard of them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They are created now and not from the beginning; And before this day you have not heard them, Lest you should say, ‘Of course I knew them.’
verses.textEnNlt: They are brand new, not things from the past. So you cannot say, ‘We knew that all the time!’
verses.textEnNasb: "They are created now and not long ago; And before today you have not heard them, So that you will not say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
verses.textEn: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot say, ‘Yes, I knew of them.’

verses.textZh: 你从来没有听过，也不知道； 你的耳朵从来未曾开通。 我原知道你行事非常诡诈； 你自出母胎以来，就被称为叛徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你从来没有听过，也不知道； 你的耳朵从来未曾开通。 我原知道你行事非常诡诈； 你自出母胎以来，就被称为叛徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你未曾听见，未曾知道； 你的耳朵从来未曾开通。 我原知道你行事极其诡诈， 你自从出胎以来， 便称为悖逆的。
verses.textEnNiv: You have neither heard nor understood; from of old your ears have not been open. Well do I know how treacherous you are; you were called a rebel from birth.
verses.textEnEsv: You have never heard, you have never known, from of old your ear has not been opened. For I knew that you would surely deal treacherously, and that from before birth you were called a rebel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely you did not hear, Surely you did not know; Surely from long ago your ear was not opened. For I knew that you would deal very treacherously, And were called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, I will tell you of things that are entirely new, things you never heard of before. For I know so well what traitors you are. You have been rebels from birth.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have not heard, you have not known. Even from long ago your ear has not been open, Because I knew that you would deal very treacherously; And you have been called a rebel from birth.
verses.textEn: You have neither heard nor understood; from of old your ears have not been open. Well do I know how treacherous you are; you were called a rebel from birth.

verses.textZh: 为了我的名的缘故，我暂时不发怒； 为了我的名誉的缘故，我向你忍耐； 不把你剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了我的名的缘故，我暂时不发怒； 为了我的名誉的缘故，我向你忍耐； 不把你剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为我的名暂且忍怒， 为我的颂赞向你容忍， 不将你剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: For my own name’s sake I delay my wrath; for the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so as not to destroy you completely.
verses.textEnEsv: "For my name’s sake I defer my anger; for the sake of my praise I restrain it for you, that I may not cut you off.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For My name’s sake I will defer My anger, And for My praise I will restrain it from you, So that I do not cut you off.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet for my own sake and for the honor of my name, I will hold back my anger and not wipe you out.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the sake of My name I delay My wrath, And for My praise I restrain it for you, In order not to cut you off.
verses.textEn: For my own name’s sake I delay my wrath; for the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so as not to destroy you completely.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我熬炼了你，却不像熬炼银子； 你在苦难的炉中，我拣选了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我熬炼了你，却不像熬炼银子； 你在苦难的炉中，我拣选了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我熬炼你，却不像熬炼银子； 你在苦难的炉中，我拣选你。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tried you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.textEnNlt: I have refined you, but not as silver is refined. Rather, I have refined you in the furnace of suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.textEn: See, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

verses.textZh: 为了我自己的缘故，为了我自己的缘故， 我必作这事。 我的名怎能被亵渎呢？ 我必不把我的荣耀归给别人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了我自己的缘故，为了我自己的缘故， 我必作这事。 我的名怎能被亵渎呢？ 我必不把我的荣耀归给别人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为自己的缘故必行这事， 我焉能使我的名被亵渎？ 我必不将我的荣耀归给假神。
verses.textEnNiv: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.
verses.textEnEsv: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do it, for how should my name be profaned? My glory I will not give to another.
verses.textEnNkjv: For My own sake, for My own sake, I will do it; For how should Myname be profaned? And I will not give My glory to another.
verses.textEnNlt: I will rescue you for my sake— yes, for my own sake! I will not let my reputation be tarnished, and I will not share my glory with idols!
verses.textEnNasb: "For My own sake, for My own sake, I will act; For how can My name be profaned? And I will not give My glory to another.
verses.textEn: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.

verses.textZh: "雅各，我所呼召的以色列啊！你要听我的话。 我就是‘那位’，我是首先的，也是末后的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "雅各，我所呼召的以色列啊！你要听我的话。 我就是‘那位’，我是首先的，也是末后的。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各－我所选召的以色列啊， 当听我言： 我是耶和华， 我是首先的，也是末后的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to me, Jacob, Israel, whom I have called: I am he; I am the first and I am the last.
verses.textEnEsv: "Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I called! I am he; I am the first, and I am the last.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to Me, O Jacob, And Israel, My called: I am He, I am the First, I am also the Last.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, O family of Jacob, Israel my chosen one! I alone am God, the First and the Last.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to Me, Jacob, Israel whom I called; I am He, I am the first, I am also the last.
verses.textEn: "Listen to me, Jacob, Israel, whom I have called: I am he; I am the first and I am the last.

verses.textZh: 我的手奠定了大地的根基， 我的右手展开了诸天； 我一呼唤它们，它们就一同站着侍候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的手奠定了大地的根基， 我的右手展开了诸天； 我一呼唤它们，它们就一同站着侍候。
verses.textZhCuv: 我手立了地的根基； 我右手铺张诸天； 我一招呼便都立住。
verses.textEnNiv: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.
verses.textEnEsv: My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I call to them, they stand forth together.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed My hand has laid the foundation of the earth, And My right hand has stretched out the heavens; When I call to them, They stand up together.
verses.textEnNlt: It was my hand that laid the foundations of the earth, my right hand that spread out the heavens above. When I call out the stars, they all appear in order."
verses.textEnNasb: "Assuredly My hand founded the earth, And My right hand spread out the heavens; When I call to them, they stand together.
verses.textEn: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.

verses.textZh: 列国啊！你们都要集合起来听。 他们中间有谁预言过这些事呢？ 耶和华爱他，他必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的； 他的膀臂也必击打迦勒底人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国啊！你们都要集合起来听。 他们中间有谁预言过这些事呢？ 耶和华爱他，他必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的； 他的膀臂也必击打迦勒底人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们都当聚集而听， 他们 内中谁说过这些事？ 耶和华所爱的人必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的事； 他的膀臂也要加在迦勒底人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The Lord ’s chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: "Assemble, all of you, and listen! Who among them has declared these things? The Lord loves him; he shall perform his purpose on Babylon, and his arm shall be against the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All of you, assemble yourselves, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? The Lord loves him; He shall do His pleasure on Babylon, And His arm shallbeagainst the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: Have any of your idols ever told you this? Come, all of you, and listen: The Lord has chosen Cyrus as his ally. He will use him to put an end to the empire of Babylon and to destroy the Babylonian armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Assemble, all of you, and listen! Who among them has declared these things? The Lord loves him; he will carry out His good pleasure against Babylon, And His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: "Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The Lord ’s chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 我亲自说过，又呼召了他； 我带领了他来，他所行的就必亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲自说过，又呼召了他； 我带领了他来，他所行的就必亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有我曾说过，我又选召他， 领他来，他的道路就必亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.
verses.textEnEsv: I, even I, have spoken and called him; I have brought him, and he will prosper in his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: I, even I, have spoken; Yes, I have called him, I have brought him, and his way will prosper.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have said it: I am calling Cyrus! I will send him on this errand and will help him succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, yes I, have spoken; indeed I have called him, I have brought him, and He will make his ways successful.
verses.textEn: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.

verses.textZh: 你们要就近我，当听这话： ‘从起初我就没有在隐密处说过话， 自从有这事情的存在，我就在那里。’ 现在主耶和华差遣了我和他的灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要就近我，当听这话： ‘从起初我就没有在隐密处说过话， 自从有这事情的存在，我就在那里。’ 现在主耶和华差遣了我和他的灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要就近我来听这话： 我从起头并未曾在隐密处说话； 自从有这事，我就在那里。 现在，主耶和华差遣我和他的灵来 。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come near me and listen to this: "From the first announcement I have not spoken in secret; at the time it happens, I am there." And now the Sovereign Lord has sent me, endowed with his Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Draw near to me, hear this: from the beginning I have not spoken in secret, from the time it came to be I have been there." And now the Lord God has sent me, and his Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come near to Me, hear this: I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; From the time that it was, I was there. And now the Lord God and His Spirit Have sent Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Come closer, and listen to this. From the beginning I have told you plainly what would happen." And now the Sovereign Lord and his Spirit have sent me with this message.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come near to Me, listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret, From the time it took place, I was there. And now the Lord God has sent Me, and His Spirit."
verses.textEn: "Come near me and listen to this: "From the first announcement I have not spoken in secret; at the time it happens, I am there." And now the Sovereign Lord has sent me, endowed with his Spirit.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的救赎主，以色列的圣者，这样说： ‘我是耶和华你的神，是教导你，使你得益处的， 是在你当行的道路上引导你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的救赎主，以色列的圣者，这样说： ‘我是耶和华你的神，是教导你，使你得益处的， 是在你当行的道路上引导你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的救赎主， 以色列的圣者如此说： 我是耶和华－你的神， 教训你，使你得益处， 引导你所当行的路。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the Lord your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the Lord your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, your Redeemer, The Holy One of Israel: "I am the Lord your God, Who teaches you to profit, Who leads you by the way you should go.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the Lord your God, who teaches you what is good for you and leads you along the paths you should follow.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says, He who is your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the Lord your God, who teaches you to benefit, Who leads you in the way you should go.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the Lord your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.

verses.textZh: 但愿你一向都留心听从我的命令， 这样你的平安就像河水滔滔， 你的公义就如海浪滚滚；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿你一向都留心听从我的命令， 这样你的平安就像河水滔滔， 你的公义就如海浪滚滚；
verses.textZhCuv: 甚愿你素来听从我的命令！ 你的平安就如河水； 你的公义就如海浪。
verses.textEnNiv: If only you had paid attention to my commands, your peace would have been like a river, your well-being like the waves of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that you had paid attention to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea;
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that you had heeded My commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, And your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that you had listened to my commands! Then you would have had peace flowing like a gentle river and righteousness rolling over you like waves in the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "If only you had paid attention to My commandments! Then your well-being would have been like a river, And your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
verses.textEn: If only you had paid attention to my commands, your peace would have been like a river, your well-being like the waves of the sea.

verses.textZh: 你的后裔必像海沙那么多， 你腹中的子孙要如沙粒这样多； 他们的名字必不会被剪除，也不会从我面前消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的后裔必像海沙那么多， 你腹中的子孙要如沙粒这样多； 他们的名字必不会被剪除，也不会从我面前消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的后裔也必多如海沙； 你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。 他的名在我面前必不剪除， 也不灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Your descendants would have been like the sand, your children like its numberless grains; their name would never be blotted out nor destroyed from before me."
verses.textEnEsv: your offspring would have been like the sand, and your descendants like its grains; their name would never be cut off or destroyed from before me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Your descendants also would have been like the sand, And the offspring of your body like the grains of sand; His name would not have been cut off Nor destroyed from before Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Your descendants would have been like the sands along the seashore— too many to count! There would have been no need for your destruction, or for cutting off your family name."
verses.textEnNasb: "Your descendants would have been like the sand, And your offspring like its grains; Their name would never be eliminated or destroyed from My presence."
verses.textEn: Your descendants would have been like the sand, your children like its numberless grains; their name would never be blotted out nor destroyed from before me."

verses.textZh: "你们要从巴比伦出来，从迦勒底人中逃出来， 你们要用欢呼的声音宣告，把这事说给人听， 你们要把这事宣扬出去，直到地极，说：‘耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要从巴比伦出来，从迦勒底人中逃出来， 你们要用欢呼的声音宣告，把这事说给人听， 你们要把这事宣扬出去，直到地极，说：‘耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要从巴比伦出来， 从迦勒底人中逃脱， 以欢呼的声音传扬说： 耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各！ 你们要将这事宣扬到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: Leave Babylon, flee from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and proclaim it. Send it out to the ends of the earth; say, "The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob."
verses.textEnEsv: Go out from Babylon, flee from Chaldea, declare this with a shout of joy, proclaim it, send it out to the end of the earth; say, "The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Go forth from Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing, Declare, proclaim this, Utter it to the end of the earth; Say, "The Lord has redeemed His servant Jacob!"
verses.textEnNlt: Yet even now, be free from your captivity! Leave Babylon and the Babylonians. Sing out this message! Shout it to the ends of the earth! The Lord has redeemed his servants, the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Go out from Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare with the sound of joyful shouting, proclaim this, Send it out to the end of the earth; Say, "The Lord has redeemed His servant Jacob."
verses.textEn: Leave Babylon, flee from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and proclaim it. Send it out to the ends of the earth; say, "The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob."

verses.textZh: 耶和华领他们走过荒野的时候，他们并不干渴； 他为他们使水从盘石流出来。 他裂开盘石，水就涌出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华领他们走过荒野的时候，他们并不干渴； 他为他们使水从盘石流出来。 他裂开盘石，水就涌出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华引导他们经过沙漠。 他们并不干渴； 他为他们使水从磐石而流， 分裂磐石，水就涌出。
verses.textEnNiv: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split the rock and water gushed out.
verses.textEnEsv: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split the rock and the water gushed out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they did not thirst When He led them through the deserts; He caused the waters to flow from the rock for them; He also split the rock, and the waters gushed out.
verses.textEnNlt: They were not thirsty when he led them through the desert. He divided the rock, and water gushed out for them to drink.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts. He made the water flow out of the rock for them; He split the rock and the water gushed out.
verses.textEn: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split the rock and water gushed out.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说：‘恶人没有平安。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说：‘恶人没有平安。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 恶人必不得平安！
verses.textEnNiv: "There is no peace," says the Lord , "for the wicked."
verses.textEnEsv: "There is no peace," says the Lord , "for the wicked."
verses.textEnNkjv: "There is no peace," says the Lord, "for the wicked."
verses.textEnNlt: "But there is no peace for the wicked," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no peace for the wicked," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: "There is no peace," says the Lord , "for the wicked."

verses.textZh: 众海岛啊！你们要听我的话。 远方的万族啊！你们要留心听。 我在母胎的时候，耶和华就呼召了我； 我出母腹的时候，他就提了我的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众海岛啊！你们要听我的话。 远方的万族啊！你们要留心听。 我在母胎的时候，耶和华就呼召了我； 我出母腹的时候，他就提了我的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 众海岛啊，当听我言！ 远方的众民哪，留心而听！ 自我出胎，耶和华就选召我； 自出母腹，他就提我的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to me, you islands; hear this, you distant nations: Before I was born the Lord called me; from my mother’s womb he has spoken my name.
verses.textEnEsv: Listen to me, O coastlands, and give attention, you peoples from afar. The Lord called me from the womb, from the body of my mother he named my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen, O coastlands, to Me, And take heed, you peoples from afar! The Lord has called Me from the womb; From the matrix of My mother He has made mention of My name.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me, all you in distant lands! Pay attention, you who are far away! The Lord called me before my birth; from within the womb he called me by name.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to Me, you islands, And pay attention, you peoples from afar. The Lord called Me from the womb; From the body of My mother He named Me.
verses.textEn: Listen to me, you islands; hear this, you distant nations: Before I was born the Lord called me; from my mother’s womb he has spoken my name.

verses.textZh: 他使我的口如快刀， 把我藏在他手的阴影之下； 他又使我成为磨亮的箭， 把我藏在他的箭袋里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我的口如快刀， 把我藏在他手的阴影之下； 他又使我成为磨亮的箭， 把我藏在他的箭袋里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我的口如快刀， 将我藏在他手荫之下； 又使我成为磨亮的箭， 将我藏在他箭袋之中；
verses.textEnNiv: He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver.
verses.textEnEsv: He made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me a polished arrow; in his quiver he hid me away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He has made My mouth like a sharp sword; In the shadow of His hand He has hidden Me, And made Me a polished shaft; In His quiver He has hidden Me."
verses.textEnNlt: He made my words of judgment as sharp as a sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. I am like a sharp arrow in his quiver.
verses.textEnNasb: He has made My mouth like a sharp sword, In the shadow of His hand He has concealed Me; And He has also made Me a sharpened arrow, He has hidden Me in His quiver.
verses.textEn: He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："你是我的仆人以色列， 我要借着你得荣耀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："你是我的仆人以色列， 我要借着你得荣耀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对我说：你是我的仆人以色列； 我必因你得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified."
verses.textEnNkjv: "And He said to me, ‘You are My servant, O Israel, In whom I will be glorified.’
verses.textEnNlt: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, and you will bring me glory."
verses.textEnNasb: He said to Me, "You are My Servant, Israel, In whom I will show My glory."
verses.textEn: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor."

verses.textZh: 但我说："我劳碌是徒然的； 我用尽气力，是虚无虚空的； 然而我当得的公理是在耶和华那里， 我的赏赐是在我的神那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我说："我劳碌是徒然的； 我用尽气力，是虚无虚空的； 然而我当得的公理是在耶和华那里， 我的赏赐是在我的神那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我却说：我劳碌是徒然； 我尽力是虚无虚空。 然而，我当得的理必在耶和华那里； 我的赏赐必在我神那里。
verses.textEnNiv: But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing at all. Yet what is due me is in the Lord ’s hand, and my reward is with my God."
verses.textEnEsv: But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely my right is with the Lord , and my recompense with my God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, ‘I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nothing and in vain; Yet surely my just reward is with the Lord, And my work with my God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I replied, "But my work seems so useless! I have spent my strength for nothing and to no purpose. Yet I leave it all in the Lord ’s hand; I will trust God for my reward."
verses.textEnNasb: But I said, "I have labored in vain, I have spent My strength for nothing and futility; Nevertheless, the justice due to Me is with the Lord, And My reward is with My God."
verses.textEn: But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing at all. Yet what is due me is in the Lord ’s hand, and my reward is with my God."

verses.textZh: 现在，耶和华说： （他自我还在母胎的时候，就造了我作他的仆人， 好使雅各回转归向他，使以色列可以聚集到他那里； 我在耶和华眼中被看为尊贵， 我的神是我的力量。）
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，耶和华说： （他自我还在母胎的时候，就造了我作他的仆人， 好使雅各回转归向他，使以色列可以聚集到他那里； 我在耶和华眼中被看为尊贵， 我的神是我的力量。）
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华从我出胎，造就我作他的仆人， 要使雅各归向他， 使以色列到他那里聚集。 原来耶和华看我为尊贵； 我的神也成为我的力量。
verses.textEnNiv: And now the Lord says— he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord and my God has been my strength—
verses.textEnEsv: And now the Lord says, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob back to him; and that Israel might be gathered to him— for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord , and my God has become my strength—
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now the Lord says, Who formed Me from the womb tobe His Servant, To bring Jacob back to Him, So that Israel is gathered to Him (For I shall be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, And My God shall be My strength),
verses.textEnNlt: And now the Lord speaks— the one who formed me in my mother’s womb to be his servant, who commissioned me to bring Israel back to him. The Lord has honored me, and my God has given me strength.
verses.textEnNasb: And now says the Lord, who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant, To bring Jacob back to Him, so that Israel might be gathered to Him (For I am honored in the sight of the Lord, And My God is My strength),
verses.textEn: And now the Lord says— he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord and my God has been my strength—

verses.textZh: "你作我的仆人， 使雅各众支派复兴，使以色列中得保全的归回，只是小事， 我还要使你作列国的光， 使我的救恩传到地极。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你作我的仆人， 使雅各众支派复兴，使以色列中得保全的归回，只是小事， 我还要使你作列国的光， 使我的救恩传到地极。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在他说：你作我的仆人， 使雅各众支派复兴， 使以色列中得保全的归回尚为小事， 我还要使你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行我的救恩，直到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: he says: "It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: he says: "It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back the preserved of Israel; I will make you as a light for the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed He says, ‘It is too small a thing that You should be My Servant To raise up the tribes of Jacob, And to restore the preserved ones of Israel; I will also give You as a light to the Gentiles, That You should be My salvation to the ends of the earth.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He says, "You will do more than restore the people of Israel to me. I will make you a light to the Gentiles, and you will bring my salvation to the ends of the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: He says, "It is too small a thing that You should be My Servant To raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the protected ones of Israel; I will also make You a light of the nations So that My salvation may reach to the end of the earth."
verses.textEn: he says: "It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth."

verses.textZh: 以色列的救赎主，以色列的圣者耶和华，对那被人藐视的、 被本国憎恶的、 被统治者奴役的，这样说： "君王看见了，就必起立， 领袖看见了，也要下拜， 都因信实的耶和华，就是拣选了你的、以色列的圣者的缘故。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的救赎主，以色列的圣者耶和华，对那被人藐视的、 被本国憎恶的、 被统治者奴役的，这样说： "君王看见了，就必起立， 领袖看见了，也要下拜， 都因信实的耶和华，就是拣选了你的、以色列的圣者的缘故。"
verses.textZhCuv: 救赎主－以色列的圣者耶和华 对那被人所藐视、本国所憎恶、 官长所虐待的如此说： 君王要看见就站起， 首领也要下拜； 都因信实的耶和华， 就是拣选你－以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says— the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel— to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the servant of rulers: "Kings will see you and stand up, princes will see and bow down, because of the Lord , who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , the Redeemer of Israel and his Holy One, to one deeply despised, abhorred by the nation, the servant of rulers: "Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall prostrate themselves; because of the Lord , who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, The Redeemer of Israel, their Holy One, To Him whom man despises, To Him whom the nation abhors, To the Servant of rulers: "Kings shall see and arise, Princes also shall worship, Because of the Lord who is faithful, The Holy One of Israel; And He has chosen You."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord , the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, says to the one who is despised and rejected by the nations, to the one who is the servant of rulers: "Kings will stand at attention when you pass by. Princes will also bow low because of the Lord , the faithful one, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel and its Holy One, Says to the despised One, To the One abhorred by the nation, To the Servant of rulers: "Kings will see and arise, Princes will also bow down, Because of the Lord who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel who has chosen You."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says— the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel— to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the servant of rulers: "Kings will see you and stand up, princes will see and bow down, because of the Lord , who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："在悦纳的时候，我应允了你， 在拯救的日子，我帮助了你； 我要保护你，使你作人民的中保， 复兴那地，使人承受荒凉之地作产业，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："在悦纳的时候，我应允了你， 在拯救的日子，我帮助了你； 我要保护你，使你作人民的中保， 复兴那地，使人承受荒凉之地作产业，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 在悦纳的时候，我应允了你； 在拯救的日子，我济助了你。 我要保护你， 使你作众民的中保 ； 复兴遍地， 使人承受荒凉之地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "In a time of favor I have answered you; in a day of salvation I have helped you; I will keep you and give you as a covenant to the people, to establish the land, to apportion the desolate heritages,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "In an acceptable time I have heard You, And in the day of salvation I have helped You; I will preserve You and give You As a covenant to the people, To restore the earth, To cause them to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "At just the right time, I will respond to you. On the day of salvation I will help you. I will protect you and give you to the people as my covenant with them. Through you I will reestablish the land of Israel and assign it to its own people again.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "At a favorable time I answered You, And on a day of salvation I helped You; And I will watch over You and make You a covenant of the people, To restore the land, to give as inheritances the deserted hereditary lands;
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,

verses.textZh: 对那些被囚的说：‘你们出来吧！’对那些在黑暗中的人说：‘你们现身吧！’ 他们沿途必得喂养， 一切光秃的高处必成为他们的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对那些被囚的说：‘你们出来吧！’对那些在黑暗中的人说：‘你们现身吧！’ 他们沿途必得喂养， 一切光秃的高处必成为他们的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 对那被捆绑的人说：出来吧！ 对那在黑暗的人说：显露吧！ 他们在路上必得饮食， 在一切净光的高处必有食物。
verses.textEnNiv: to say to the captives, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Be free!’ "They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every barren hill.
verses.textEnEsv: saying to the prisoners, ‘Come out,’ to those who are in darkness, ‘Appear.’ They shall feed along the ways; on all bare heights shall be their pasture;
verses.textEnNkjv: That You may say to the prisoners, ‘Go forth,’ To those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ "They shall feed along the roads, And their pastures shallbe on all desolate heights.
verses.textEnNlt: I will say to the prisoners, ‘Come out in freedom,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Come into the light.’ They will be my sheep, grazing in green pastures and on hills that were previously bare.
verses.textEnNasb: Saying to those who are bound, ‘ Go free,’ To those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ They will feed along the roads, And their pasture will be on all bare heights.
verses.textEn: to say to the captives, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Be free!’ "They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every barren hill.

verses.textZh: 他们必不饥饿，也不口渴， 炎热和太阳必不伤害他们， 因为那怜悯他们的，要引领他们， 带领他们到水泉的旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不饥饿，也不口渴， 炎热和太阳必不伤害他们， 因为那怜悯他们的，要引领他们， 带领他们到水泉的旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 不饥不渴， 炎热和烈日必不伤害他们； 因为怜恤他们的必引导他们， 领他们到水泉旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat down on them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
verses.textEnEsv: they shall not hunger or thirst, neither scorching wind nor sun shall strike them, for he who has pity on them will lead them, and by springs of water will guide them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall neither hunger nor thirst, Neither heat nor sun shall strike them; For He who has mercy on them will lead them, Even by the springs of water He will guide them.
verses.textEnNlt: They will neither hunger nor thirst. The searing sun will not reach them anymore. For the Lord in his mercy will lead them; he will lead them beside cool waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will not hunger or thirst, Nor will the scorching heat or sun strike them down; For He who has compassion on them will lead them, And He will guide them to springs of water.
verses.textEn: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat down on them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.

verses.textZh: 我必使我的众山成为道路， 我的大道都必被修高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使我的众山成为道路， 我的大道都必被修高。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使我的众山成为大道； 我的大路也被修高。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be raised up.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make each of My mountains a road, And My highways shall be elevated.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will make my mountains into level paths for them. The highways will be raised above the valleys.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make all My mountains a road, And My highways will be raised up.
verses.textEn: I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.

verses.textZh: 看哪！有些人从远方而来； 看哪！有些从北方，从西方而来， 还有些从色尼姆地而来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！有些人从远方而来； 看哪！有些从北方，从西方而来， 还有些从色尼姆地而来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，这些从远方来； 这些从北方、从西方来； 这些从秦 国来。
verses.textEnNiv: See, they will come from afar— some from the north, some from the west, some from the region of Aswan. "
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Syene."
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely these shall come from afar; Look! Those from the north and the west, And these from the land of Sinim."
verses.textEnNlt: See, my people will return from far away, from lands to the north and west, and from as far south as Egypt. "
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, these will come from afar; And behold, these will come from the north and from the west, And these from the land of Aswan."
verses.textEn: See, they will come from afar— some from the north, some from the west, some from the region of Aswan. "

verses.textZh: 诸天哪！你们要欢呼。大地啊！你当快乐。 众山啊！你们要发声欢呼。 因为耶和华已经安慰了他的子民， 也必怜悯他受困苦的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天哪！你们要欢呼。大地啊！你当快乐。 众山啊！你们要发声欢呼。 因为耶和华已经安慰了他的子民， 也必怜悯他受困苦的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天哪，应当欢呼！ 大地啊，应当快乐！ 众山哪，应当发声歌唱！ 因为耶和华已经安慰他的百姓， 也要怜恤他困苦之民。
verses.textEnNiv: Shout for joy, you heavens; rejoice, you earth; burst into song, you mountains! For the Lord comforts his people and will have compassion on his afflicted ones.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing for joy, O heavens, and exult, O earth; break forth, O mountains, into singing! For the Lord has comforted his people and will have compassion on his afflicted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing, O heavens! Be joyful, O earth! And break out in singing, O mountains! For the Lord has comforted His people, And will have mercy on His afflicted.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing for joy, O heavens! Rejoice, O earth! Burst into song, O mountains! For the Lord has comforted his people and will have compassion on them in their suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: Shout for joy, you heavens! And rejoice, you earth! Break forth into joyful shouting, mountains! For the Lord has comforted His people And will have compassion on His afflicted.
verses.textEn: Shout for joy, you heavens; rejoice, you earth; burst into song, you mountains! For the Lord comforts his people and will have compassion on his afflicted ones.

verses.textZh: 但锡安说："耶和华离弃了我， 我的主忘记了我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但锡安说："耶和华离弃了我， 我的主忘记了我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安说：耶和华离弃了我； 主忘记了我。
verses.textEnNiv: But Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me, the Lord has forgotten me."
verses.textEnEsv: But Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me; my Lord has forgotten me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me, And my Lord has forgotten me."
verses.textEnNlt: Yet Jerusalem says, "The Lord has deserted us; the Lord has forgotten us."
verses.textEnNasb: But Zion said, "The Lord has abandoned me, And the Lord has forgotten me."
verses.textEn: But Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me, the Lord has forgotten me."

verses.textZh: 妇人怎能忘记她吃奶的婴孩， 不怜悯她亲生的儿子呢？ 即使她们可能忘记，我也不会忘记你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人怎能忘记她吃奶的婴孩， 不怜悯她亲生的儿子呢？ 即使她们可能忘记，我也不会忘记你。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人焉能忘记她吃奶的婴孩， 不怜恤她所生的儿子？ 即或有忘记的， 我却不忘记你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!
verses.textEnEsv: "Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can a woman forget her nursing child, And not have compassion on the son of her womb? Surely they may forget, Yet I will not forget you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Never! Can a mother forget her nursing child? Can she feel no love for the child she has borne? But even if that were possible, I would not forget you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Can a woman forget her nursing child And have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, but I will not forget you.
verses.textEn: "Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!

verses.textZh: 看哪！我已经把你刻在我的掌上； 你的城墙常常在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我已经把你刻在我的掌上； 你的城墙常常在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我将你铭刻在我掌上； 你的墙垣常在我眼前。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: See, I have inscribed you on the palms ofMyhands; Your walls are continually before Me.
verses.textEnNlt: See, I have written your name on the palms of my hands. Always in my mind is a picture of Jerusalem’s walls in ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; Your walls are continually before Me.
verses.textEn: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.

verses.textZh: 重建你的 要急速归回， 那些毁坏你的和那些使你荒废的， 都必离你而去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 重建你的 要急速归回， 那些毁坏你的和那些使你荒废的， 都必离你而去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的儿女必急速归回； 毁坏你的，使你荒废的，必都离你出去，
verses.textEnNiv: Your children hasten back, and those who laid you waste depart from you.
verses.textEnEsv: Your builders make haste; your destroyers and those who laid you waste go out from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your sons shall make haste; Your destroyers and those who laid you waste Shall go away from you.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon your descendants will come back, and all who are trying to destroy you will go away.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your builders hurry; Your destroyers and devastators Will leave you.
verses.textEn: Your children hasten back, and those who laid you waste depart from you.

verses.textZh: 你举目向四周观看吧！ 他们都集合到你那里来。 耶和华说："我指着我的永生起誓， 你要披戴他们，如同披戴装饰品； 你要以他们作华带束腰，像新妇一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你举目向四周观看吧！ 他们都集合到你那里来。 耶和华说："我指着我的永生起誓， 你要披戴他们，如同披戴装饰品； 你要以他们作华带束腰，像新妇一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你举目向四方观看； 他们都聚集来到你这里。 耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓： 你必要以他们为妆饰佩戴， 以他们为华带束腰，像新妇一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up your eyes and look around; all your children gather and come to you. As surely as I live," declares the Lord , "you will wear them all as ornaments; you will put them on, like a bride.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your eyes around and see; they all gather, they come to you. As I live, declares the Lord , you shall put them all on as an ornament; you shall bind them on as a bride does.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your eyes, look around and see; All these gather together and come to you. As I live," says the Lord, "You shall surely clothe yourselves with them all as an ornament, And bind them onyou as a bride does.
verses.textEnNlt: Look around you and see, for all your children will come back to you. As surely as I live," says the Lord , "they will be like jewels or bridal ornaments for you to display.
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise your eyes and look around; All of them gather together, they come to you. As I live," declares the Lord, "You will certainly put them all on as jewelry and bind them on as a bride.
verses.textEn: Lift up your eyes and look around; all your children gather and come to you. As surely as I live," declares the Lord , "you will wear them all as ornaments; you will put them on, like a bride.

verses.textZh: 至于你那些被毁坏荒废之处和你那些被拆毁之地， 现在给众人居住必显为太狭窄了， 那些吞灭你的都必远离你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你那些被毁坏荒废之处和你那些被拆毁之地， 现在给众人居住必显为太狭窄了， 那些吞灭你的都必远离你。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你荒废凄凉之处， 并你被毁坏之地， 现今众民居住必显为太窄； 吞灭你的必离你遥远。
verses.textEnNiv: "Though you were ruined and made desolate and your land laid waste, now you will be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.
verses.textEnEsv: "Surely your waste and your desolate places and your devastated land— surely now you will be too narrow for your inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For your waste and desolate places, And the land of your destruction, Will even now be too small for the inhabitants; And those who swallowed you up will be far away.
verses.textEnNlt: "Even the most desolate parts of your abandoned land will soon be crowded with your people. Your enemies who enslaved you will be far away.
verses.textEnNasb: "For your ruins and deserted places and your destroyed land— Now you will certainly be too cramped for the inhabitants, And those who swallowed you will be far away.
verses.textEn: "Though you were ruined and made desolate and your land laid waste, now you will be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.

verses.textZh: 你丧子以后所生的儿女还要说给你听，说： ‘这地方给我居住太狭窄了； 求你给我预备地方居住吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你丧子以后所生的儿女还要说给你听，说： ‘这地方给我居住太狭窄了； 求你给我预备地方居住吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 你必听见丧子之后所生的儿女说： 这地方我居住太窄， 求你给我地方居住。
verses.textEnNiv: The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; give us more space to live in.’
verses.textEnEsv: The children of your bereavement will yet say in your ears: ‘The place is too narrow for me; make room for me to dwell in.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The children you will have, After you have lost the others, Will say again in your ears, ‘The place is too small for me; Give me a place where I may dwell.’
verses.textEnNlt: The generations born in exile will return and say, ‘We need more room! It’s crowded here!’
verses.textEnNasb: "The children you lost will yet say in your ears, ‘The place is too cramped for me; Make room for me that I may live here.’
verses.textEn: The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; give us more space to live in.’

verses.textZh: 那时你心里必说： ‘我既丧子，又不能生育； 我是被掳的，又是被放逐在外的， 谁给我生了这些孩子呢？ 谁把这些孩子养大呢？ 看哪！我独自一人被撇下， 这些孩子是从哪里来的呢？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时你心里必说： ‘我既丧子，又不能生育； 我是被掳的，又是被放逐在外的， 谁给我生了这些孩子呢？ 谁把这些孩子养大呢？ 看哪！我独自一人被撇下， 这些孩子是从哪里来的呢？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时你心里必说：我既丧子独居， 是被掳的，漂流在外。 谁给我生这些？ 谁将这些养大呢？ 撇下我一人独居的时候， 这些在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who bore me these? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. Who brought these up? I was left all alone, but these—where have they come from?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will say in your heart: ‘Who has borne me these? I was bereaved and barren, exiled and put away, but who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; from where have these come?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has begotten these for me, Since I have lost my children and am desolate, A captive, and wandering to and fro? And who has brought these up? There I was, left alone; But these, where were they?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will think to yourself, ‘Who has given me all these descendants? For most of my children were killed, and the rest were carried away into exile. I was left here all alone. Where did all these people come from? Who bore these children? Who raised them for me?’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has fathered these for me, Since I have been bereaved of my children And cannot conceive, and I am an exile, and a wanderer? And who has raised these? Behold, I was left alone; Where are these from?’ "
verses.textEn: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who bore me these? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. Who brought these up? I was left all alone, but these—where have they come from?’ "

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必向列国举手， 我要向万民竖立我的旗帜； 他们要把你的儿子都抱在怀中带来， 把你的女儿都放在肩上背来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必向列国举手， 我要向万民竖立我的旗帜； 他们要把你的儿子都抱在怀中带来， 把你的女儿都放在肩上背来。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说： 我必向列国举手， 向万民竖立大旗； 他们必将你的众子怀中抱来， 将你的众女肩上扛来。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "See, I will beckon to the nations, I will lift up my banner to the peoples; they will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their hips.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : "Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and raise my signal to the peoples; and they shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I will lift My hand in an oath to the nations, And set up My standard for the peoples; They shall bring your sons in their arms, And your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "See, I will give a signal to the godless nations. They will carry your little sons back to you in their arms; they will bring your daughters on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations And set up My flag to the peoples; And they will bring your sons in their arms, And your daughters will be carried on their shoulders.
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "See, I will beckon to the nations, I will lift up my banner to the peoples; they will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their hips.

verses.textZh: 列国的君王要作你的养父， 他们的王后必作你的保姆； 他们必脸伏于地向你下拜， 舐你脚上的尘土。 那么，你就知道我是耶和华， 那些仰望我的决不会羞愧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的君王要作你的养父， 他们的王后必作你的保姆； 他们必脸伏于地向你下拜， 舐你脚上的尘土。 那么，你就知道我是耶和华， 那些仰望我的决不会羞愧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 列王必作你的养父； 王后必作你的乳母。 他们必将脸伏地，向你下拜， 并舔你脚上的尘土。 你便知道我是耶和华； 等候我的必不致羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground; they will lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord ; those who hope in me will not be disappointed."
verses.textEnEsv: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. With their faces to the ground they shall bow down to you, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord ; those who wait for me shall not be put to shame."
verses.textEnNkjv: Kings shall be your foster fathers, And their queens your nursing mothers; They shall bow down to you with their faces to the earth, And lick up the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord, For they shall not be ashamed who wait for Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Kings and queens will serve you and care for all your needs. They will bow to the earth before you and lick the dust from your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord . Those who trust in me will never be put to shame."
verses.textEnNasb: "Kings will be your guardians, And their princesses your nurses. They will bow down to you with their faces to the ground And lick the dust from your feet; And you will know that I am the Lord; Those who hopefully wait for Me will not be put to shame.
verses.textEn: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground; they will lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord ; those who hope in me will not be disappointed."

verses.textZh: 被抢去的怎能从勇士手中夺回呢？ 被俘掳的怎能从强暴者 的手里救出来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 被抢去的怎能从勇士手中夺回呢？ 被俘掳的怎能从强暴者 的手里救出来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 勇士抢去的岂能夺回？ 该掳掠的岂能解救吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can plunder be taken from warriors, or captives be rescued from the fierce ?
verses.textEnEsv: Can the prey be taken from the mighty, or the captives of a tyrant be rescued?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, Or the captives of the righteous be delivered?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can snatch the plunder of war from the hands of a warrior? Who can demand that a tyrant let his captives go?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can the prey be taken from a mighty man, Or the captives of a tyrant be rescued?"
verses.textEn: Can plunder be taken from warriors, or captives be rescued from the fierce ?

verses.textZh: 但耶和华这样说： "就是勇士所俘掳的，也可以夺回， 强暴者所抢去的，也可以救出来； 与你相争的，我必与他们相争； 你的儿女，我却要拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华这样说： "就是勇士所俘掳的，也可以夺回， 强暴者所抢去的，也可以救出来； 与你相争的，我必与他们相争； 你的儿女，我却要拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华如此说： 就是勇士所掳掠的，也可以夺回； 强暴人所抢的，也可以解救。 与你相争的，我必与他相争； 我要拯救你的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: But this is what the Lord says: "Yes, captives will be taken from warriors, and plunder retrieved from the fierce; I will contend with those who contend with you, and your children I will save.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken, and the prey of the tyrant be rescued, for I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
