verses.textEnNkjv: But thus says the Lord: "Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, And the prey of the terrible be delivered; For I will contend with him who contends with you, And I will save your children.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord says, "The captives of warriors will be released, and the plunder of tyrants will be retrieved. For I will fight those who fight you, and I will save your children.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, this is what the Lord says: "Even the captives of the mighty man will be taken away, And the prey of a tyrant will be rescued; For I will contend with the one who contends with you, And I will save your sons.
verses.textEn: But this is what the Lord says: "Yes, captives will be taken from warriors, and plunder retrieved from the fierce; I will contend with those who contend with you, and your children I will save.

verses.textZh: 我要使那些欺压你的人，吃自己的肉； 他们必喝自己的血醉倒，好象喝了甜酒一样； 那么所有的人都必知道，我耶和华是你的拯救者， 是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使那些欺压你的人，吃自己的肉； 他们必喝自己的血醉倒，好象喝了甜酒一样； 那么所有的人都必知道，我耶和华是你的拯救者， 是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我必使那欺压你的吃自己的肉， 也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一样。 凡有血气的必都知道我－耶和华是你的救主， 是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEnEsv: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with wine. Then all flesh shall know that I am the Lord your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh, And they shall be drunk with their own blood as with sweet wine. All flesh shall know That I, the Lord, am your Savior, And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEnNlt: I will feed your enemies with their own flesh. They will be drunk with rivers of their own blood. All the world will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Israel. "
verses.textEnNasb: "I will feed your oppressors with their own flesh, And they will become drunk with their own blood as with sweet wine; And humanity will know that I, the Lord, am your Savior And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEn: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "我离弃了你们的母亲，休书在哪里呢？ 或者我的债主中，哪一个是我把你们卖了给他的呢？ 看哪！你们被卖是因你们的罪孽； 你们的母亲被离弃是因你们的过犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "我离弃了你们的母亲，休书在哪里呢？ 或者我的债主中，哪一个是我把你们卖了给他的呢？ 看哪！你们被卖是因你们的罪孽； 你们的母亲被离弃是因你们的过犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 我休你们的母亲， 休书在哪里呢？ 我将你们卖给我哪一个债主呢？ 你们被卖，是因你们的罪孽； 你们的母亲被休，是因你们的过犯。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce, with which I sent her away? Or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities you were sold, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Where is the certificate of your mother’s divorce, Whom I have put away? Or which of My creditors isit to whom I have sold you? For your iniquities you have sold yourselves, And for your transgressions your mother has been put away.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Was your mother sent away because I divorced her? Did I sell you as slaves to my creditors? No, you were sold because of your sins. And your mother, too, was taken because of your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Where is the certificate of divorce By which I have sent your mother away? Or to whom of My creditors did I sell you? Behold, you were sold for your wrongdoings, And for your wrongful acts your mother was sent away.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.

verses.textZh: 为甚么我来的时候，没有人在呢？ 为甚么我呼唤的时候，没有人答应呢？ 难道我的手太软弱不能救赎吗？ 或是我没有能力拯救吗？ 看哪！我以斥责使海干涸， 我使江河变成旷野， 江河的鱼因无水发臭， 因干渴而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么我来的时候，没有人在呢？ 为甚么我呼唤的时候，没有人答应呢？ 难道我的手太软弱不能救赎吗？ 或是我没有能力拯救吗？ 看哪！我以斥责使海干涸， 我使江河变成旷野， 江河的鱼因无水发臭， 因干渴而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 我来的时候，为何无人等候呢？ 我呼唤的时候，为何无人答应呢？ 我的膀臂岂是缩短、不能救赎吗？ 我岂无拯救之力吗？ 看哪，我一斥责，海就干了； 我使江河变为旷野； 其中的鱼因无水腥臭，干渴而死。
verses.textEnNiv: When I came, why was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to deliver you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: Why, when I came, was there no man; why, when I called, was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened, that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, by my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a desert; their fish stink for lack of water and die of thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why, when I came, wasthere no man? Why, when I called, wasthere none to answer? Is My hand shortened at all that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Indeed with My rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness; Their fish stink because thereis no water, And die of thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: Why was no one there when I came? Why didn’t anyone answer when I called? Is it because I have no power to rescue? No, that is not the reason! For I can speak to the sea and make it dry up! I can turn rivers into deserts covered with dying fish.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why was there no one when I came? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is My hand so short that it cannot redeem? Or do I have no power to rescue? Behold, I dry up the sea with My rebuke, I turn rivers into a wilderness; Their fish stink for lack of water, And die of thirst.
verses.textEn: When I came, why was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to deliver you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.

verses.textZh: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服， 以麻布作它们的遮盖。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服， 以麻布作它们的遮盖。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服， 以麻布为遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: I clothe the heavens with darkness and make sackcloth its covering."
verses.textEnEsv: I clothe the heavens with blackness and make sackcloth their covering."
verses.textEnNkjv: I clothe the heavens with blackness, And I make sackcloth their covering."
verses.textEnNlt: I dress the skies in darkness, covering them with clothes of mourning."
verses.textEnNasb: "I clothe the heavens with blackness, And make sackcloth their covering."
verses.textEn: I clothe the heavens with darkness and make sackcloth its covering."

verses.textZh: 主耶和华赐给了我一个受教者的舌头， 使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人； 主每天清晨唤醒我，他每天清晨唤醒我的耳朵， 使我能像受教者一样静听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华赐给了我一个受教者的舌头， 使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人； 主每天清晨唤醒我，他每天清晨唤醒我的耳朵， 使我能像受教者一样静听。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华赐我受教者的舌头， 使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人。 主每早晨提醒， 提醒我的耳朵， 使我能听，像受教者一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sovereign Lord has given me a well-instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary. He wakens me morning by morning, wakens my ear to listen like one being instructed.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with a word him who is weary. Morning by morning he awakens; he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord God has given Me The tongue of the learned, That I should know how to speak A word in season to himwhois weary. He awakens Me morning by morning, He awakens My ear To hear as the learned.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord has given me his words of wisdom, so that I know how to comfort the weary. Morning by morning he wakens me and opens my understanding to his will.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God has given Me the tongue of disciples, So that I may know how to sustain the weary one with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning, He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
verses.textEn: The Sovereign Lord has given me a well-instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary. He wakens me morning by morning, wakens my ear to listen like one being instructed.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华开启了我的耳朵， 我并没有违抗， 也没有后退。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华开启了我的耳朵， 我并没有违抗， 也没有后退。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华开通我的耳朵； 我并没有违背，也没有退后。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sovereign Lord has opened my ears; I have not been rebellious, I have not turned away.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious; I turned not backward.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God has opened My ear; And I was not rebellious, Nor did I turn away.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord has spoken to me, and I have listened. I have not rebelled or turned away.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God has opened My ear, And I was not disobedient, Nor did I turn back.
verses.textEn: The Sovereign Lord has opened my ears; I have not been rebellious, I have not turned away.

verses.textZh: 我把我的背给打我的人打， 把我的腮颊给拔我胡须的人拔； 我并没有掩面躲避人的羞辱和人的唾液。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把我的背给打我的人打， 把我的腮颊给拔我胡须的人拔； 我并没有掩面躲避人的羞辱和人的唾液。
verses.textZhCuv: 人打我的背，我任他打； 人拔我腮颊的胡须，我由他拔； 人辱我，吐我，我并不掩面。
verses.textEnNiv: I offered my back to those who beat me, my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard; I did not hide my face from mocking and spitting.
verses.textEnEsv: I gave my back to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pull out the beard; I hid not my face from disgrace and spitting.
verses.textEnNkjv: I gave My back to those who struck Me, And My cheeks to those who plucked out the beard; I did not hide My face from shame and spitting.
verses.textEnNlt: I offered my back to those who beat me and my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard. I did not hide my face from mockery and spitting.
verses.textEnNasb: I gave My back to those who strike Me, And My cheeks to those who pull out My beard; I did not hide My face from insults and spitting.
verses.textEn: I offered my back to those who beat me, my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard; I did not hide my face from mocking and spitting.

verses.textZh: 但主耶和华必帮助我， 所以我必不羞愧， 因此我板着脸好象坚硬的燧石， 我也知道我必不会蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但主耶和华必帮助我， 所以我必不羞愧， 因此我板着脸好象坚硬的燧石， 我也知道我必不会蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华必帮助我， 所以我不抱愧。 我硬着脸面好像坚石； 我也知道我必不致蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: Because the Sovereign Lord helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord God helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the Lord God will help Me; Therefore I will not be disgraced; Therefore I have set My face like a flint, And I know that I will not be ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: Because the Sovereign Lord helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore, I have set my face like a stone, determined to do his will. And I know that I will not be put to shame.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord God helps Me, Therefore, I am not disgraced; Therefore, I have made My face like flint, And I know that I will not be ashamed.
verses.textEn: Because the Sovereign Lord helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.

verses.textZh: 那称我为义的，与我相近； 谁与我争讼呢？ 让我们一同站起来吧！ 谁是指控我的？ 让他就近我来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那称我为义的，与我相近； 谁与我争讼呢？ 让我们一同站起来吧！ 谁是指控我的？ 让他就近我来。
verses.textZhCuv: 称我为义的与我相近； 谁与我争论， 可以与我一同站立； 谁与我作对， 可以就近我来。
verses.textEnNiv: He who vindicates me is near. Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!
verses.textEnEsv: He who vindicates me is near. Who will contend with me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heis near who justifies Me; Who will contend with Me? Let us stand together. Who is My adversary? Let him come near Me.
verses.textEnNlt: He who gives me justice is near. Who will dare to bring charges against me now? Where are my accusers? Let them appear!
verses.textEnNasb: He who vindicates Me is near; Who will contend with Me? Let us stand up to each other. Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me.
verses.textEn: He who vindicates me is near. Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!

verses.textZh: 看哪！主耶和华帮助我， 谁能定我有罪呢？ 看哪！他们都要像衣服渐渐破旧， 蛀虫必把他们吃光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！主耶和华帮助我， 谁能定我有罪呢？ 看哪！他们都要像衣服渐渐破旧， 蛀虫必把他们吃光。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华要帮助我； 谁能定我有罪呢？ 他们都像衣服渐渐旧了， 为蛀虫所咬。
verses.textEnNiv: It is the Sovereign Lord who helps me. Who will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord God helps me; who will declare me guilty? Behold, all of them will wear out like a garment; the moth will eat them up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the Lord God will help Me; Who is he who will condemn Me? Indeed they will all grow old like a garment; The moth will eat them up.
verses.textEnNlt: See, the Sovereign Lord is on my side! Who will declare me guilty? All my enemies will be destroyed like old clothes that have been eaten by moths!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord God helps Me; Who is he who condemns Me? Behold, they will all wear out like a garment; A moth will eat them.
verses.textEn: It is the Sovereign Lord who helps me. Who will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.

verses.textZh: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华， 听从他仆人的声音的？ 谁是行在黑暗中，没有亮光的呢？ 他该倚靠耶和华的名，依赖他的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华， 听从他仆人的声音的？ 谁是行在黑暗中，没有亮光的呢？ 他该倚靠耶和华的名，依赖他的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华、 听从他仆人之话的？ 这人行在暗中，没有亮光。 当倚靠耶和华的名， 仗赖自己的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Who among you fears the Lord and obeys the word of his servant? Let the one who walks in the dark, who has no light, trust in the name of the Lord and rely on their God.
verses.textEnEsv: Who among you fears the Lord and obeys the voice of his servant? Let him who walks in darkness and has no light trust in the name of the Lord and rely on his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who among you fears the Lord? Who obeys the voice of His Servant? Who walks in darkness And has no light? Let him trust in the name of the Lord And rely upon his God.
verses.textEnNlt: Who among you fears the Lord and obeys his servant? If you are walking in darkness, without a ray of light, trust in the Lord and rely on your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Who is among you who fears the Lord, Who obeys the voice of His Servant, Who walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the Lord and rely on his God.
verses.textEn: Who among you fears the Lord and obeys the word of his servant? Let the one who walks in the dark, who has no light, trust in the name of the Lord and rely on their God.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你们点火的， 用火把围绕自己的， 都行在你们火焰的光里， 都走在你们所燃点的火把中吧！ 这是你们从我手里所要得的： 你们必躺卧在痛苦之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你们点火的， 用火把围绕自己的， 都行在你们火焰的光里， 都走在你们所燃点的火把中吧！ 这是你们从我手里所要得的： 你们必躺卧在痛苦之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你们点火，用火把围绕自己的 可以行在你们的火焰里， 并你们所点的火把中。 这是我手所定的： 你们必躺在悲惨之中。
verses.textEnNiv: But now, all you who light fires and provide yourselves with flaming torches, go, walk in the light of your fires and of the torches you have set ablaze. This is what you shall receive from my hand: You will lie down in torment.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who equip yourselves with burning torches! Walk by the light of your fire, and by the torches that you have kindled! This you have from my hand: you shall lie down in torment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, all you who kindle a fire, Who encircle yourselves with sparks: Walk in the light of your fire and in the sparks you have kindled— This you shall have from My hand: You shall lie down in torment.
verses.textEnNlt: But watch out, you who live in your own light and warm yourselves by your own fires. This is the reward you will receive from me: You will soon fall down in great torment.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, Who encircle yourselves with flaming arrows, Walk in the light of your fire And among the flaming arrows you have set ablaze. This you will have from My hand: You will lie down in torment.
verses.textEn: But now, all you who light fires and provide yourselves with flaming torches, go, walk in the light of your fires and of the torches you have set ablaze. This is what you shall receive from my hand: You will lie down in torment.

verses.textZh: 追求公义、寻求耶和华的啊！ 你们要听我的话。 你们要瞻仰那盘石，你们就是从其上凿出来的； 你们要瞻仰那采石坑，你们就是从其中挖出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 追求公义、寻求耶和华的啊！ 你们要听我的话。 你们要瞻仰那盘石，你们就是从其上凿出来的； 你们要瞻仰那采石坑，你们就是从其中挖出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这追求公义、 寻求耶和华的，当听我言！ 你们要追想被凿而出的磐石， 被挖而出的岩穴。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and who seek the Lord : Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry from which you were hewn;
verses.textEnEsv: "Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the Lord : look to the rock from which you were hewn, and to the quarry from which you were dug.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to Me, you who follow after righteousness, You who seek the Lord: Look to the rock fromwhich you were hewn, And to the hole of the pit fromwhich you were dug.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, all who hope for deliverance— all who seek the Lord ! Consider the rock from which you were cut, the quarry from which you were mined.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, Who seek the Lord: Look to the rock from which you were cut, And to the quarry from which you were dug.
verses.textEn: "Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and who seek the Lord : Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry from which you were hewn;

verses.textZh: 你们要瞻仰你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕， 他们也要瞻仰那生你们的撒拉。 亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候，我呼召了他， 赐福给他，使他有很多子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要瞻仰你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕， 他们也要瞻仰那生你们的撒拉。 亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候，我呼召了他， 赐福给他，使他有很多子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 要追想你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕 和生养你们的撒拉； 因为亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候， 我选召他，赐福与他， 使他人数增多。
verses.textEnNiv: look to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave you birth. When I called him he was only one man, and I blessed him and made him many.
verses.textEnEsv: Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who bore you; for he was but one when I called him, that I might bless him and multiply him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look to Abraham your father, And to Sarah who bore you; For I called him alone, And blessed him and increased him."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, think about Abraham, your ancestor, and Sarah, who gave birth to your nation. Abraham was only one man when I called him. But when I blessed him, he became a great nation."
verses.textEnNasb: "Look to Abraham your father And to Sarah who gave birth to you in pain; When he was only one I called him, Then I blessed him and multiplied him."
verses.textEn: look to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave you birth. When I called him he was only one man, and I blessed him and made him many.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必安慰锡安， 他要安慰它的一切荒场， 使它的旷野像伊甸园一样， 使它的荒地像耶和华的园子一般， 在其中必有欢喜快乐、 感谢和歌声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必安慰锡安， 他要安慰它的一切荒场， 使它的旷野像伊甸园一样， 使它的荒地像耶和华的园子一般， 在其中必有欢喜快乐、 感谢和歌声。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已经安慰锡安 和锡安一切的荒场， 使旷野像伊甸， 使沙漠像耶和华的园囿； 在其中必有欢喜、快乐、感谢， 和歌唱的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will surely comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; he will make her deserts like Eden, her wastelands like the garden of the Lord . Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord comforts Zion; he comforts all her waste places and makes her wilderness like Eden, her desert like the garden of the Lord ; joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the voice of song.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will comfort Zion, He will comfort all her waste places; He will make her wilderness like Eden, And her desert like the garden of the Lord; Joy and gladness will be found in it, Thanksgiving and the voice of melody.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will comfort Israel again and have pity on her ruins. Her desert will blossom like Eden, her barren wilderness like the garden of the Lord . Joy and gladness will be found there. Songs of thanksgiving will fill the air.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the Lord will comfort Zion; He will comfort all her ruins. And He will make her wilderness like Eden, And her desert like the garden of the Lord. Joy and gladness will be found in her, Thanksgiving and the sound of a melody.
verses.textEn: The Lord will surely comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; he will make her deserts like Eden, her wastelands like the garden of the Lord . Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

verses.textZh: 我的子民哪！你们要留心听我； 我的民族啊！你们要侧耳听我。 因为训诲必从我而去； 我必坚立我的判词为万民之光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民哪！你们要留心听我； 我的民族啊！你们要侧耳听我。 因为训诲必从我而去； 我必坚立我的判词为万民之光。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓啊，要向我留心； 我的国民哪，要向我侧耳； 因为训诲必从我而出； 我必坚定我的公理为万民之光。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to me, my people; hear me, my nation: Instruction will go out from me; my justice will become a light to the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: "Give attention to me, my people, and give ear to me, my nation; for a law will go out from me, and I will set my justice for a light to the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to Me, My people; And give ear to Me, O My nation: For law will proceed from Me, And I will make My justice rest As a light of the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, my people. Hear me, Israel, for my law will be proclaimed, and my justice will become a light to the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Pay attention to Me, My people, And listen to Me, My nation; For a law will go out from Me, And I will bring My justice as a light of the peoples.
verses.textEn: "Listen to me, my people; hear me, my nation: Instruction will go out from me; my justice will become a light to the nations.

verses.textZh: 我的公义临近，我的拯救已经发出了， 我的膀臂审判万民， 众海岛的人都要等候我， 并且仰赖我的膀臂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的公义临近，我的拯救已经发出了， 我的膀臂审判万民， 众海岛的人都要等候我， 并且仰赖我的膀臂。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的公义临近； 我的救恩发出。 我的膀臂要审判万民； 海岛都要等候我，倚赖我的膀臂。
verses.textEnNiv: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.
verses.textEnEsv: My righteousness draws near, my salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples; the coastlands hope for me, and for my arm they wait.
verses.textEnNkjv: My righteousness is near, My salvation has gone forth, And My arms will judge the peoples; The coastlands will wait upon Me, And on My arm they will trust.
verses.textEnNlt: My mercy and justice are coming soon. My salvation is on the way. My strong arm will bring justice to the nations. All distant lands will look to me and wait in hope for my powerful arm.
verses.textEnNasb: "My righteousness is near, My salvation has gone forth, And My arms will judge the peoples; The coastlands will wait for Me, And they will wait expectantly for My arm.
verses.textEn: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.

verses.textZh: 你们要仰观天空， 俯视大地； 因为诸天必像烟云消散， 大地要像衣服渐渐破旧； 其上的居民必像蠓虫死亡 ， 但我的拯救却永远长存， 我的公义也不会废去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要仰观天空， 俯视大地； 因为诸天必像烟云消散， 大地要像衣服渐渐破旧； 其上的居民必像蠓虫死亡 ， 但我的拯救却永远长存， 我的公义也不会废去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要向天举目， 观看下地； 因为天必像烟云消散， 地必如衣服渐渐旧了； 其上的居民也要如此死亡 。 惟有我的救恩永远长存； 我的公义也不废掉。
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, look at the earth beneath; the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment and its inhabitants die like flies. But my salvation will last forever, my righteousness will never fail.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment, and they who dwell in it will die in like manner; but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will never be dismayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, And look on the earth beneath. For the heavens will vanish away like smoke, The earth will grow old like a garment, And those who dwell in it will die in like manner; But My salvation will be forever, And My righteousness will not be abolished.
verses.textEnNlt: Look up to the skies above, and gaze down on the earth below. For the skies will disappear like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a piece of clothing. The people of the earth will die like flies, but my salvation lasts forever. My righteous rule will never end!
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise your eyes to the sky, Then look to the earth beneath; For the sky will vanish like smoke, And the earth will wear out like a garment And its inhabitants will die in the same way. But My salvation will be forever, And My righteousness will not fail.
verses.textEn: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, look at the earth beneath; the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment and its inhabitants die like flies. But my salvation will last forever, my righteousness will never fail.

verses.textZh: 认识公义，把我的训诲存在心里的人民哪！ 你们要听我的话。 你们不要怕人的辱骂， 也不要因人的毁谤而惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 认识公义，把我的训诲存在心里的人民哪！ 你们要听我的话。 你们不要怕人的辱骂， 也不要因人的毁谤而惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 知道公义、将我训诲存在心中的民， 要听我言！ 不要怕人的辱骂， 也不要因人的毁谤惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear me, you who know what is right, you people who have taken my instruction to heart: Do not fear the reproach of mere mortals or be terrified by their insults.
verses.textEnEsv: "Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear not the reproach of man, nor be dismayed at their revilings.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, You people in whose heart is My law: Do not fear the reproach of men, Nor be afraid of their insults.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, you who know right from wrong, you who cherish my law in your hearts. Do not be afraid of people’s scorn, nor fear their insults.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, A people in whose heart is My Law; Do not fear the taunting of people, Nor be terrified of their abuses.
verses.textEn: "Hear me, you who know what is right, you people who have taken my instruction to heart: Do not fear the reproach of mere mortals or be terrified by their insults.

verses.textZh: 因为蛀虫必吃他们，像吃衣服一样； 虫子必吃他们，像吃羊绒一样。 但我的公义永远长存。 我的拯救直到万代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为蛀虫必吃他们，像吃衣服一样； 虫子必吃他们，像吃羊绒一样。 但我的公义永远长存。 我的拯救直到万代。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为蛀虫必咬他们，好像咬衣服； 虫子必咬他们，如同咬羊绒。 惟有我的公义永远长存， 我的救恩直到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: For the moth will eat them up like a garment; the worm will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, my salvation through all generations."
verses.textEnEsv: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool, but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, And the worm will eat them like wool; But My righteousness will be forever, And My salvation from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNlt: For the moth will devour them as it devours clothing. The worm will eat at them as it eats wool. But my righteousness will last forever. My salvation will continue from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNasb: "For the moth will eat them like a garment; Yes, the moth will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will be forever, And My salvation to all generations."
verses.textEn: For the moth will eat them up like a garment; the worm will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, my salvation through all generations."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的膀臂啊，醒来吧！醒来吧！穿上能力吧！ 像古时的日子，像上古的世代一样醒来吧！ 从前砍碎了拉哈伯， 刺透了海龙的，不是你吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的膀臂啊，醒来吧！醒来吧！穿上能力吧！ 像古时的日子，像上古的世代一样醒来吧！ 从前砍碎了拉哈伯， 刺透了海龙的，不是你吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的膀臂啊，兴起！兴起！ 以能力为衣穿上， 像古时的年日、上古的世代兴起一样。 从前砍碎拉哈伯、 刺透大鱼的，不是你吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, awake, arm of the Lord , clothe yourself with strength! Awake, as in days gone by, as in generations of old. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced that monster through?
verses.textEnEsv: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord ; awake, as in days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the dragon?
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord! Awake as in the ancient days, In the generations of old. Are You not thearm that cut Rahab apart, And wounded the serpent?
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, wake up, O Lord ! Clothe yourself with strength! Flex your mighty right arm! Rouse yourself as in the days of old when you slew Egypt, the dragon of the Nile.
verses.textEnNasb: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord; Awake as in the days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not You who cut Rahab in pieces, Who pierced the dragon?
verses.textEn: Awake, awake, arm of the Lord , clothe yourself with strength! Awake, as in days gone by, as in generations of old. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced that monster through?

verses.textZh: 使海，就是大渊的水干涸， 使海的深处变为蒙救赎的人 经过之路的， 不是你吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 使海，就是大渊的水干涸， 使海的深处变为蒙救赎的人 经过之路的， 不是你吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 使海与深渊的水干涸、 使海的深处变为赎民经过之路的， 不是你吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea so that the redeemed might cross over?
verses.textEnEsv: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are You not theOne who dried up the sea, The waters of the great deep; That made the depths of the sea a road For the redeemed to cross over?
verses.textEnNlt: Are you not the same today, the one who dried up the sea, making a path of escape through the depths so that your people could cross over?
verses.textEnNasb: Was it not You who dried up the sea, The waters of the great deep; Who made the depths of the sea a pathway For the redeemed to cross over?
verses.textEn: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea so that the redeemed might cross over?

verses.textZh: 耶和华所赎的人必归回； 他们必欢呼着进入锡安； 永远的快乐要临到他们的头上。 他们必得着欢喜快乐， 忧愁叹息都必逃避。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华所赎的人必归回； 他们必欢呼着进入锡安； 永远的快乐要临到他们的头上。 他们必得着欢喜快乐， 忧愁叹息都必逃避。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华救赎的民必归回， 歌唱来到锡安； 永乐必归到他们的头上。 他们必得着欢喜快乐； 忧愁叹息尽都逃避。
verses.textEnNiv: Those the Lord has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the ransomed of the Lord shall return, And come to Zion with singing, With everlasting joy on their heads. They shall obtain joy and gladness; Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who have been ransomed by the Lord will return. They will enter Jerusalem singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Sorrow and mourning will disappear, and they will be filled with joy and gladness.
verses.textEnNasb: And the redeemed of the Lord will return And come to Zion with joyful shouting, And everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, And sorrow and sighing will flee away.
verses.textEn: Those the Lord has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

verses.textZh: "我，我耶和华是安慰你们的； 你是谁，竟怕那会死的人， 怕那被造如草的世人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "我，我耶和华是安慰你们的； 你是谁，竟怕那会死的人， 怕那被造如草的世人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有我，是安慰你们的。 你是谁，竟怕那必死的人？ 怕那要变如草的世人？
verses.textEnNiv: "I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear mere mortals, human beings who are but grass,
verses.textEnEsv: "I, I am he who comforts you; who are you that you are afraid of man who dies, of the son of man who is made like grass,
verses.textEnNkjv: "I, even I, am He who comforts you. Who are you that you should be afraid Of a man who will die, And of the son of a man who will be made like grass?
verses.textEnNlt: "I, yes I, am the one who comforts you. So why are you afraid of mere humans, who wither like the grass and disappear?
verses.textEnNasb: "I, I Myself, am He who comforts you. Who are you that you are afraid of mortal man, And of a son of man who is made like grass,
verses.textEn: "I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear mere mortals, human beings who are but grass,

verses.textZh: 你忘记了造你的耶和华， 就是那展开诸天， 奠定大地的根基的； 又因那欺压者准备行毁灭的时候所发的烈怒， 你就终日不住惧怕呢？ 其实那欺压者的烈怒在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你忘记了造你的耶和华， 就是那展开诸天， 奠定大地的根基的； 又因那欺压者准备行毁灭的时候所发的烈怒， 你就终日不住惧怕呢？ 其实那欺压者的烈怒在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 却忘记铺张诸天、立定地基、 创造你的耶和华？ 又因欺压者图谋毁灭要发的暴怒， 整天害怕， 其实那欺压者的暴怒在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: that you forget the Lord your Maker, who stretches out the heavens and who lays the foundations of the earth, that you live in constant terror every day because of the wrath of the oppressor, who is bent on destruction? For where is the wrath of the oppressor?
verses.textEnEsv: and have forgotten the Lord , your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth, and you fear continually all the day because of the wrath of the oppressor, when he sets himself to destroy? And where is the wrath of the oppressor?
verses.textEnNkjv: And you forget the Lord your Maker, Who stretched out the heavens And laid the foundations of the earth; You have feared continually every day Because of the fury of the oppressor, When hehas prepared to destroy. And where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you have forgotten the Lord , your Creator, the one who stretched out the sky like a canopy and laid the foundations of the earth. Will you remain in constant dread of human oppressors? Will you continue to fear the anger of your enemies? Where is their fury and anger now? It is gone!
verses.textEnNasb: That you have forgotten the Lord your Maker, Who stretched out the heavens And laid the foundations of the earth, That you fear continually all day long because of the fury of the oppressor, As he makes ready to destroy? And where is the rage of the oppressor?
verses.textEn: that you forget the Lord your Maker, who stretches out the heavens and who lays the foundations of the earth, that you live in constant terror every day because of the wrath of the oppressor, who is bent on destruction? For where is the wrath of the oppressor?

verses.textZh: 被掳的快得释放了， 他们必不会死，必不会下到阴间里， 他们的食物也必不会缺乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被掳的快得释放了， 他们必不会死，必不会下到阴间里， 他们的食物也必不会缺乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 被掳去的快得释放， 必不死而下坑； 他的食物也不致缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: The cowering prisoners will soon be set free; they will not die in their dungeon, nor will they lack bread.
verses.textEnEsv: He who is bowed down shall speedily be released; he shall not die and go down to the pit, neither shall his bread be lacking.
verses.textEnNkjv: The captive exile hastens, that he may be loosed, That he should not die in the pit, And that his bread should not fail.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon all you captives will be released! Imprisonment, starvation, and death will not be your fate!
verses.textEnNasb: The exile will soon be set free, and will not die in the dungeon, nor will his bread be lacking.
verses.textEn: The cowering prisoners will soon be set free; they will not die in their dungeon, nor will they lack bread.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华你们的神， 就是那搅动大海，使海中的波浪澎湃的； 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华你们的神， 就是那搅动大海，使海中的波浪澎湃的； 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你的神－ 搅动大海，使海中的波浪匉訇－ 万军之耶和华是我的名。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am the Lord your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord Almighty is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am the Lord your God, Who divided the sea whose waves roared— The Lord of hosts is His name.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am the Lord your God, who stirs up the sea, causing its waves to roar. My name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am the Lord your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar (the Lord of armies is His name).
verses.textEn: For I am the Lord your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord Almighty is his name.

verses.textZh: 我把我的话放在你的口里， 用我的手影蔽护你， 好立定诸天，奠定大地的根基， 对锡安说：‘你是我的子民。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把我的话放在你的口里， 用我的手影蔽护你， 好立定诸天，奠定大地的根基， 对锡安说：‘你是我的子民。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我将我的话传给你， 用我的手影遮蔽你， 为要栽定诸天，立定地基， 又对锡安说：你是我的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand— I who set the heavens in place, who laid the foundations of the earth, and who say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I have put my words in your mouth and covered you in the shadow of my hand, establishing the heavens and laying the foundations of the earth, and saying to Zion, ‘You are my people.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have put My words in your mouth; I have covered you with the shadow of My hand, That I may plant the heavens, Lay the foundations of the earth, And say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I have put my words in your mouth and hidden you safely in my hand. I stretched out the sky like a canopy and laid the foundations of the earth. I am the one who says to Israel, ‘You are my people!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And I have put My words in your mouth and have covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’ "
verses.textEn: I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand— I who set the heavens in place, who laid the foundations of the earth, and who say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊，醒来！醒来！站起来吧！ 你从耶和华的手中喝了他烈怒的杯， 喝尽了那使人摇摇摆摆的爵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊，醒来！醒来！站起来吧！ 你从耶和华的手中喝了他烈怒的杯， 喝尽了那使人摇摇摆摆的爵。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，兴起！ 兴起！站起来！ 你从耶和华手中喝了他忿怒之杯， 喝了那使人东倒西歪的爵，以致喝尽。
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, awake! Rise up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the Lord the cup of his wrath, you who have drained to its dregs the goblet that makes people stagger.
verses.textEnEsv: Wake yourself, wake yourself, stand up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the Lord the cup of his wrath, who have drunk to the dregs the bowl, the cup of staggering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, awake! Stand up, O Jerusalem, You who have drunk at the hand of the Lord The cup of His fury; You have drunk the dregs of the cup of trembling, And drained it out.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, wake up, O Jerusalem! You have drunk the cup of the Lord ’s fury. You have drunk the cup of terror, tipping out its last drops.
verses.textEnNasb: Pull yourself up! Pull yourself up! Arise, Jerusalem! You who have drunk from the Lord’s hand the cup of His anger; The chalice of staggering you have drunk to the dregs.
verses.textEn: Awake, awake! Rise up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the Lord the cup of his wrath, you who have drained to its dregs the goblet that makes people stagger.

verses.textZh: 她所生的众子中，没有一个引导她的； 她养大的众子中，没有一个扶持她的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她所生的众子中，没有一个引导她的； 她养大的众子中，没有一个扶持她的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她所生育的诸子中，没有一个引导她的； 她所养大的诸子中，没有一个搀扶她的。
verses.textEnNiv: Among all the children she bore there was none to guide her; among all the children she reared there was none to take her by the hand.
verses.textEnEsv: There is none to guide her among all the sons she has borne; there is none to take her by the hand among all the sons she has brought up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis no one to guide her Among all the sons she has brought forth; Nor isthereany who takes her by the hand Among all the sons she has brought up.
verses.textEnNlt: Not one of your children is left alive to take your hand and guide you.
verses.textEnNasb: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth, Nor is there anyone to take her by the hand among all the sons she has raised.
verses.textEn: Among all the children she bore there was none to guide her; among all the children she reared there was none to take her by the hand.

verses.textZh: 荒凉与毁灭，饥荒与刀剑， 这两样临到你， 谁为你悲哀呢？ 谁能安慰你呢 ？
verses.textZhCnvs: 荒凉与毁灭，饥荒与刀剑， 这两样临到你， 谁为你悲哀呢？ 谁能安慰你呢 ？
verses.textZhCuv: 荒凉、毁灭、饥荒、刀兵， 这几样临到你， 谁为你举哀？ 我如何能安慰你呢？
verses.textEnNiv: These double calamities have come upon you— who can comfort you?— ruin and destruction, famine and sword— who can console you?
verses.textEnEsv: These two things have happened to you— who will console you?— devastation and destruction, famine and sword; who will comfort you?
verses.textEnNkjv: These two things have come to you; Who will be sorry for you?— Desolation and destruction, famine and sword— By whom will I comfort you?
verses.textEnNlt: These two calamities have fallen on you: desolation and destruction, famine and war. And who is left to sympathize with you? Who is left to comfort you?
verses.textEnNasb: These two things have happened to you; Who will mourn for you? The devastation and destruction, famine and sword; How shall I comfort you?
verses.textEn: These double calamities have come upon you— who can comfort you?— ruin and destruction, famine and sword— who can console you?

verses.textZh: 你的众子昏倒了， 在各街头上躺卧， 好象羚羊在网罗之中； 他们饱尝了耶和华的烈怒， 你的神的斥责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的众子昏倒了， 在各街头上躺卧， 好象羚羊在网罗之中； 他们饱尝了耶和华的烈怒， 你的神的斥责。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的众子发昏， 在各市口上躺卧， 好像黄羊在网罗之中， 都满了耶和华的忿怒 －你神的斥责。
verses.textEnNiv: Your children have fainted; they lie at every street corner, like antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the wrath of the Lord , with the rebuke of your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street like an antelope in a net; they are full of the wrath of the Lord , the rebuke of your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your sons have fainted, They lie at the head of all the streets, Like an antelope in a net; They are full of the fury of the Lord, The rebuke of your God.
verses.textEnNlt: For your children have fainted and lie in the streets, helpless as antelopes caught in a net. The Lord has poured out his fury; God has rebuked them.
verses.textEnNasb: Your sons have fainted, They lie helpless at the head of every street, Like an antelope in a net, Full of the wrath of the Lord, The rebuke of your God.
verses.textEn: Your children have fainted; they lie at every street corner, like antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the wrath of the Lord , with the rebuke of your God.

verses.textZh: 所以，你这困苦的， 不是因酒而醉倒的，要听这话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你这困苦的， 不是因酒而醉倒的，要听这话。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，你这困苦却非因酒而醉的， 要听我言。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore hear this, you afflicted one, made drunk, but not with wine.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore hear this, you who are afflicted, who are drunk, but not with wine:
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore please hear this, you afflicted, And drunk but not with wine.
verses.textEnNlt: But now listen to this, you afflicted ones who sit in a drunken stupor, though not from drinking wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, listen to this, you afflicted, Who are drunk, but not with wine:
verses.textEn: Therefore hear this, you afflicted one, made drunk, but not with wine.

verses.textZh: 你的主耶和华，就是为自己的子民争辩的神， 这样说： "看哪！我已经把那使人摇摇摆摆的杯， 就是我烈怒的爵， 从你的手里挪去了；你必不再喝这杯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的主耶和华，就是为自己的子民争辩的神， 这样说： "看哪！我已经把那使人摇摇摆摆的杯， 就是我烈怒的爵， 从你的手里挪去了；你必不再喝这杯。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的主耶和华－ 就是为他百姓辨屈的神如此说： 看哪，我已将那使人东倒西歪的杯， 就是我忿怒的爵， 从你手中接过来； 你必不致再喝。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what your Sovereign Lord says, your God, who defends his people: "See, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger; from that cup, the goblet of my wrath, you will never drink again.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says your Lord, the Lord , your God who pleads the cause of his people: "Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering; the bowl of my wrath you shall drink no more;
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says your Lord, The Lord and your God, Who pleads the cause of His people: "See, I have taken out of your hand The cup of trembling, The dregs of the cup of My fury; You shall no longer drink it.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord , your God and Defender, says: "See, I have taken the terrible cup from your hands. You will drink no more of my fury.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what your Lord, the Lord, your God Who contends for His people says: "Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering, The chalice of My anger; You will never drink it again.
verses.textEn: This is what your Sovereign Lord says, your God, who defends his people: "See, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger; from that cup, the goblet of my wrath, you will never drink again.

verses.textZh: 我必把这杯放在那些苦待你的人的手里； 他们曾对你说：‘你屈身俯伏，让我们走过去吧！’ 你就以你的背作陆地，作街道， 任由他们踏过去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把这杯放在那些苦待你的人的手里； 他们曾对你说：‘你屈身俯伏，让我们走过去吧！’ 你就以你的背作陆地，作街道， 任由他们踏过去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将这杯递在苦待你的人手中； 他们曾对你说：你屈身， 由我们践踏过去吧！ 你便以背为地， 好像街市，任人经过。
verses.textEnNiv: I will put it into the hands of your tormentors, who said to you, ‘Fall prostrate that we may walk on you.’ And you made your back like the ground, like a street to be walked on."
verses.textEnEsv: and I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, who have said to you, ‘Bow down, that we may pass over’; and you have made your back like the ground and like the street for them to pass over."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, Who have said to you, ‘Lie down, that we may walk over you.’ And you have laid your body like the ground, And as the street, for those who walk over."
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, I will hand that cup to your tormentors, those who said, ‘We will trample you into the dust and walk on your backs.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, Who have said to you, ‘Lie down so that we may walk over you.’ You have also made your back like the ground, And like the street for those who walk over it."
verses.textEn: I will put it into the hands of your tormentors, who said to you, ‘Fall prostrate that we may walk on you.’ And you made your back like the ground, like a street to be walked on."

verses.textZh: 锡安哪！你要醒来； 醒来，披上你的力量。 圣城耶路撒冷啊！ 要穿上你华美的衣服。 因为未受割礼的和不洁净的人， 都再不得进到你那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安哪！你要醒来； 醒来，披上你的力量。 圣城耶路撒冷啊！ 要穿上你华美的衣服。 因为未受割礼的和不洁净的人， 都再不得进到你那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安哪，兴起！兴起！ 披上你的能力！ 圣城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你华美的衣服！ 因为从今以后， 未受割礼、不洁净的必不再进入你中间。
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, awake, Zion, clothe yourself with strength! Put on your garments of splendor, Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and defiled will not enter you again.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city; for there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, O Zion; Put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city! For the uncircumcised and the unclean Shall no longer come to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, wake up, O Zion! Clothe yourself with strength. Put on your beautiful clothes, O holy city of Jerusalem, for unclean and godless people will enter your gates no longer.
verses.textEnNasb: Awake, awake, Clothe yourself in your strength, Zion; Clothe yourself with your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city; For the uncircumcised and the unclean Will no longer come into you.
verses.textEn: Awake, awake, Zion, clothe yourself with strength! Put on your garments of splendor, Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and defiled will not enter you again.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！抖下尘土， 起来，坐在位上吧！ 锡安被掳的居民 哪！ 解开你颈项上的锁炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！抖下尘土， 起来，坐在位上吧！ 锡安被掳的居民 哪！ 解开你颈项上的锁炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，要抖下尘土！ 起来坐在位上！ 锡安被掳的居民 哪， 要解开你颈项的锁链！
verses.textEnNiv: Shake off your dust; rise up, sit enthroned, Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains on your neck, Daughter Zion, now a captive.
verses.textEnEsv: Shake yourself from the dust and arise; be seated, O Jerusalem; loose the bonds from your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shake yourself from the dust, arise; Sit down, O Jerusalem! Loose yourself from the bonds of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion!
verses.textEnNlt: Rise from the dust, O Jerusalem. Sit in a place of honor. Remove the chains of slavery from your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.textEnNasb: Shake yourself from the dust, rise up, Captive Jerusalem; Release yourself from the chains around your neck, Captive daughter of Zion.
verses.textEn: Shake off your dust; rise up, sit enthroned, Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains on your neck, Daughter Zion, now a captive.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们被卖是毫无代价的， 你们被赎回也必不用银子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们被卖是毫无代价的， 你们被赎回也必不用银子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「你们是无价被卖的，也必无银被赎。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: "You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed."
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "You were sold for nothing, and you shall be redeemed without money."
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "You have sold yourselves for nothing, And you shall be redeemed without money."
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says: "When I sold you into exile, I received no payment. Now I can redeem you without having to pay for you."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "You were sold for nothing, and you will be redeemed without money."
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: "You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed."

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： "我的子民先前曾下到埃及，在那里寄居； 后来有亚述人无缘无故地欺压了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： "我的子民先前曾下到埃及，在那里寄居； 后来有亚述人无缘无故地欺压了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那里寄居，又有亚述人无故欺压他们。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "At first my people went down to Egypt to live; lately, Assyria has oppressed them.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord God : "My people went down at the first into Egypt to sojourn there, and the Assyrian oppressed them for nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God: "My people went down at first Into Egypt to dwell there; Then the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "Long ago my people chose to live in Egypt. Now they are oppressed by Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: "My people went down to Egypt first to reside there; then the Assyrian oppressed them without reason.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "At first my people went down to Egypt to live; lately, Assyria has oppressed them.

verses.textZh: 现在我在这里作甚么呢？"耶和华说： "我的子民毫无代价被取去； 统治他们的人大肆咆哮。" 耶和华说："我的名终日不住被藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我在这里作甚么呢？"耶和华说： "我的子民毫无代价被取去； 统治他们的人大肆咆哮。" 耶和华说："我的名终日不住被藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我的百姓既是无价被掳去，如今我在这里做什么呢？耶和华说：辖制他们的人呼叫，我的名整天受亵渎。
verses.textEnNiv: "And now what do I have here?" declares the Lord . "For my people have been taken away for nothing, and those who rule them mock, " declares the Lord . "And all day long my name is constantly blasphemed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore what have I here," declares the Lord , "seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Their rulers wail," declares the Lord , "and continually all the day my name is despised.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, what have I here," says the Lord, "That My people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them Make them wail," says the Lord, "And My name is blasphemed continually every day.
verses.textEnNlt: What is this?" asks the Lord . "Why are my people enslaved again? Those who rule them shout in exultation. My name is blasphemed all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: And now, what do I have here," declares the Lord, "seeing that My people have been taken away without reason?" Again the Lord declares, "Those who rule over them howl, and My name is continually reviled all day long.
verses.textEn: "And now what do I have here?" declares the Lord . "For my people have been taken away for nothing, and those who rule them mock, " declares the Lord . "And all day long my name is constantly blasphemed.

verses.textZh: 所以我的子民必认识我的名， 因此到了那日他们就必知道， 说这话的就是我。 看哪！是我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我的子民必认识我的名， 因此到了那日他们就必知道， 说这话的就是我。 看哪！是我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我的百姓必知道我的名；到那日他们必知道说这话的就是我。看哪，是我！」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore my people will know my name; therefore in that day they will know that it is I who foretold it. Yes, it is I."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore in that day they shall know that it is I who speak; here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore My people shall know My name; Therefore theyshallknow in that day That I am He who speaks: ‘Behold, itis I.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But I will reveal my name to my people, and they will come to know its power. Then at last they will recognize that I am the one who speaks to them."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, My people shall know My name; therefore on that day I am the one who is speaking, ‘Here I am.’ "
verses.textEn: Therefore my people will know my name; therefore in that day they will know that it is I who foretold it. Yes, it is I."

verses.textZh: 那传福音、 宣布平安、 传美好的福音、 宣布救恩， 又对锡安说"你的神作王了"的， 他的脚踪在山上多么的美！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那传福音、 宣布平安、 传美好的福音、 宣布救恩， 又对锡安说"你的神作王了"的， 他的脚踪在山上多么的美！
verses.textZhCuv: 那报佳音，传平安， 报好信，传救恩的， 对锡安说：你的神作王了！ 这人的脚登山何等佳美！
verses.textEnNiv: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, "Your God reigns!"
verses.textEnEsv: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of happiness, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God reigns."
verses.textEnNkjv: How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, "Your God reigns!"
verses.textEnNlt: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of the messenger who brings good news, the good news of peace and salvation, the news that the God of Israel reigns!
verses.textEnNasb: How delightful on the mountains Are the feet of one who brings good news, Who announces peace And brings good news of happiness, Who announces salvation, And says to Zion, "Your God reigns!"
verses.textEn: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, "Your God reigns!"

verses.textZh: 听啊！你守望者的声音。 他们都扬起声来，一同欢呼， 因为耶和华归回锡安的时候， 他们必亲眼看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听啊！你守望者的声音。 他们都扬起声来，一同欢呼， 因为耶和华归回锡安的时候， 他们必亲眼看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 听啊，你守望之人的声音， 他们扬起声来，一同歌唱； 因为耶和华归回锡安的时候， 他们必亲眼看见。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices; together they shout for joy. When the Lord returns to Zion, they will see it with their own eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of your watchmen—they lift up their voice; together they sing for joy; for eye to eye they see the return of the Lord to Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your watchmen shall lift up their voices, With their voices they shall sing together; For they shall see eye to eye When the Lord brings back Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: The watchmen shout and sing with joy, for before their very eyes they see the Lord returning to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen! Your watchmen raise their voices, They shout joyfully together; For they will see with their own eyes When the Lord restores Zion.
verses.textEn: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices; together they shout for joy. When the Lord returns to Zion, they will see it with their own eyes.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的废墟啊！ 你们要发声，一同欢呼。 因为耶和华安慰了他的子民， 救赎了耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的废墟啊！ 你们要发声，一同欢呼。 因为耶和华安慰了他的子民， 救赎了耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的荒场啊， 要发起欢声，一同歌唱； 因为耶和华安慰了他的百姓， 救赎了耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Burst into songs of joy together, you ruins of Jerusalem, for the Lord has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Break forth together into singing, you waste places of Jerusalem, for the Lord has comforted his people; he has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Break forth into joy, sing together, You waste places of Jerusalem! For the Lord has comforted His people, He has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the ruins of Jerusalem break into joyful song, for the Lord has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Be cheerful, shout joyfully together, You ruins of Jerusalem; For the Lord has comforted His people, He has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Burst into songs of joy together, you ruins of Jerusalem, for the Lord has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在万国的眼前， 显露他的圣臂， 地极的人必看见 我们神的拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在万国的眼前， 显露他的圣臂， 地极的人必看见 我们神的拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在万国眼前露出圣臂； 地极的人都看见我们神的救恩了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has bared his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has made bare His holy arm In the eyes of all the nations; And all the ends of the earth shall see The salvation of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has demonstrated his holy power before the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth will see the victory of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has bared His holy arm In the sight of all the nations, So that all the ends of the earth may see The salvation of our God.
verses.textEn: The Lord will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

verses.textZh: 你们要离开，要离开，要从那里出来， 不要触摸不洁净的东西。 扛抬耶和华器皿的啊！ 你们要从巴比伦城中出来，要自洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要离开，要离开，要从那里出来， 不要触摸不洁净的东西。 扛抬耶和华器皿的啊！ 你们要从巴比伦城中出来，要自洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们离开吧！离开吧！ 从巴比伦出来。 不要沾不洁净的物； 要从其中出来。 你们扛抬耶和华器皿的人哪， 务要自洁。
verses.textEnNiv: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Come out from it and be pure, you who carry the articles of the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: Depart, depart, go out from there; touch no unclean thing; go out from the midst of her; purify yourselves, you who bear the vessels of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Depart! Depart! Go out from there, Touch no unclean thing; Go out from the midst of her, Be clean, You who bear the vessels of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Get out! Get out and leave your captivity, where everything you touch is unclean. Get out of there and purify yourselves, you who carry home the sacred objects of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Depart, depart, go out from there, Do not touch what is unclean; Go out of the midst of her, purify yourselves, You who carry the vessels of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Come out from it and be pure, you who carry the articles of the Lord ’s house.

verses.textZh: 你们出来，不必着急； 你们行走，也不必奔逃， 因为耶和华要走在你们前面， 以色列的神必作你们的后盾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们出来，不必着急； 你们行走，也不必奔逃， 因为耶和华要走在你们前面， 以色列的神必作你们的后盾。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们出来必不致急忙， 也不致奔逃。 因为，耶和华必在你们前头行； 以色列的神必作你们的后盾。
verses.textEnNiv: But you will not leave in haste or go in flight; for the Lord will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
verses.textEnEsv: For you shall not go out in haste, and you shall not go in flight, for the Lord will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you shall not go out with haste, Nor go by flight; For the Lord will go before you, And the God of Israel willbe your rear guard.
verses.textEnNlt: You will not leave in a hurry, running for your lives. For the Lord will go ahead of you; yes, the God of Israel will protect you from behind.
verses.textEnNasb: But you will not go out in a hurry, Nor will you go as fugitives; For the Lord will go before you, And the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
verses.textEn: But you will not leave in haste or go in flight; for the Lord will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我的仆人必行事亨通， 他必受尊崇，被高举，成为至高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我的仆人必行事亨通， 他必受尊崇，被高举，成为至高。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人行事必有智慧 ， 必被高举上升， 且成为至高。
verses.textEnNiv: See, my servant will act wisely ; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, my servant shall act wisely; he shall be high and lifted up, and shall be exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, My Servant shall deal prudently; He shall be exalted and extolled and be very high.
verses.textEnNlt: See, my servant will prosper; he will be highly exalted.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, My Servant will prosper, He will be high and lifted up and greatly exalted.
verses.textEn: See, my servant will act wisely ; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.

verses.textZh: 许多人怎样因你而惊奇， （因为他的容貌毁损得不像人， 他的形状毁损得不像世人），
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人怎样因你而惊奇， （因为他的容貌毁损得不像人， 他的形状毁损得不像世人），
verses.textZhCuv: 许多人因他 惊奇； 他的面貌比别人憔悴； 他的形容比世人枯槁。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as there were many who were appalled at him — his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any human being and his form marred beyond human likeness—
verses.textEnEsv: As many were astonished at you— his appearance was so marred, beyond human semblance, and his form beyond that of the children of mankind—
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as many were astonished at you, So His visage was marred more than any man, And His form more than the sons of men;
verses.textEnNlt: But many were amazed when they saw him. His face was so disfigured he seemed hardly human, and from his appearance, one would scarcely know he was a man.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as many were appalled at you, My people, So His appearance was marred beyond that of a man, And His form beyond the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: Just as there were many who were appalled at him — his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any human being and his form marred beyond human likeness—

verses.textZh: 照样，他也必使多国的人惊异 ， 君王要因他闭口不言， 因为从未向他们述说过的事，他们必看见； 他们从未听过的，他们要明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，他也必使多国的人惊异 ， 君王要因他闭口不言， 因为从未向他们述说过的事，他们必看见； 他们从未听过的，他们要明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他必洗净 许多国民； 君王要向他闭口。 因所未曾传与他们的，他们必看见； 未曾听见的，他们要明白。
verses.textEnNiv: so he will sprinkle many nations, and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.
verses.textEnEsv: so shall he sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths because of him, for that which has not been told them they see, and that which they have not heard they understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall He sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths at Him; For what had not been told them they shall see, And what they had not heard they shall consider.
verses.textEnNlt: And he will startle many nations. Kings will stand speechless in his presence. For they will see what they had not been told; they will understand what they had not heard about.
verses.textEnNasb: So He will sprinkle many nations, Kings will shut their mouths on account of Him; For what they had not been told, they will see, And what they had not heard, they will understand.
verses.textEn: so he will sprinkle many nations, and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.

verses.textZh: 谁会相信我们所传的？ 耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁会相信我们所传的？ 耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们所传的 有谁信呢？ 耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has believed what he has heard from us? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.textEnNlt: Who has believed our message? To whom has the Lord revealed his powerful arm?
verses.textEnNasb: Who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.textEn: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

verses.textZh: 他在耶和华面前如嫩芽生长起来， 像根出于干旱之地； 他没有佳形，也没有威仪， 好叫我们仰慕他； 他也没有美貌，使我们被他吸引。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在耶和华面前如嫩芽生长起来， 像根出于干旱之地； 他没有佳形，也没有威仪， 好叫我们仰慕他； 他也没有美貌，使我们被他吸引。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在耶和华面前生长如嫩芽， 像根出于干地。 他无佳形美容； 我们看见他的时候， 也无美貌使我们羡慕他。
verses.textEnNiv: He grew up before him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.
verses.textEnEsv: For he grew up before him like a young plant, and like a root out of dry ground; he had no form or majesty that we should look at him, and no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He shall grow up before Him as a tender plant, And as a root out of dry ground. He has no form or comeliness; And when we see Him, Thereis no beauty that we should desire Him.
verses.textEnNlt: My servant grew up in the Lord ’s presence like a tender green shoot, like a root in dry ground. There was nothing beautiful or majestic about his appearance, nothing to attract us to him.
verses.textEnNasb: For He grew up before Him like a tender shoot, And like a root out of dry ground; He has no stately form or majesty That we would look at Him, Nor an appearance that we would take pleasure in Him.
verses.textEn: He grew up before him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.

verses.textZh: 他被藐视，被人拒绝， 是个多受痛苦，熟悉病患的人。 他像个被人掩面不看的人一样； 他被藐视，我们也不重视他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被藐视，被人拒绝， 是个多受痛苦，熟悉病患的人。 他像个被人掩面不看的人一样； 他被藐视，我们也不重视他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被藐视，被人厌弃； 多受痛苦，常经忧患。 他被藐视， 好像被人掩面不看的一样； 我们也不尊重他。
verses.textEnNiv: He was despised and rejected by mankind, a man of suffering, and familiar with pain. Like one from whom people hide their faces he was despised, and we held him in low esteem.
verses.textEnEsv: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows and acquainted with grief; and as one from whom men hide their faces he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is despised and rejected by men, A Man of sorrows and acquainted with grief. And we hid, as it were, our faces from Him; He was despised, and we did not esteem Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He was despised and rejected— a man of sorrows, acquainted with deepest grief. We turned our backs on him and looked the other way. He was despised, and we did not care.
verses.textEnNasb: He was despised and abandoned by men, A man of great pain and familiar with sickness; And like one from whom people hide their faces, He was despised, and we had no regard for Him.
verses.textEn: He was despised and rejected by mankind, a man of suffering, and familiar with pain. Like one from whom people hide their faces he was despised, and we held him in low esteem.

verses.textZh: 原来他担当了我们的病患， 背负了我们的痛苦； 我们却以为他受责打， 被神击打和苦待了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来他担当了我们的病患， 背负了我们的痛苦； 我们却以为他受责打， 被神击打和苦待了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他诚然担当我们的忧患， 背负我们的痛苦； 我们却以为他受责罚， 被神击打苦待了。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely he has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows; yet we esteemed him stricken, smitten by God, and afflicted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely He has borne our griefs And carried our sorrows; Yet we esteemed Him stricken, Smitten by God, and afflicted.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet it was our weaknesses he carried; it was our sorrows that weighed him down. And we thought his troubles were a punishment from God, a punishment for his own sins!
verses.textEnNasb: However, it was our sicknesses that He Himself bore, And our pains that He carried; Yet we ourselves assumed that He had been afflicted, Struck down by God, and humiliated.
verses.textEn: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.

verses.textZh: 然而他是为了我们的过犯被刺透， 为了我们的罪孽被压伤； 使我们得平安的惩罚加在他身上， 因他受了鞭伤，我们才得医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而他是为了我们的过犯被刺透， 为了我们的罪孽被压伤； 使我们得平安的惩罚加在他身上， 因他受了鞭伤，我们才得医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 哪知他为我们的过犯受害， 为我们的罪孽压伤。 因他受的刑罚，我们得平安； 因他受的鞭伤，我们得医治。
verses.textEnNiv: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.
verses.textEnEsv: But he was pierced for our transgressions; he was crushed for our iniquities; upon him was the chastisement that brought us peace, and with his wounds we are healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He was wounded for our transgressions, Hewas bruised for our iniquities; The chastisement for our peace was upon Him, And by His stripes we are healed.
verses.textEnNlt: But he was pierced for our rebellion, crushed for our sins. He was beaten so we could be whole. He was whipped so we could be healed.
verses.textEnNasb: But He was pierced for our offenses, He was crushed for our wrongdoings; The punishment for our well-being was laid upon Him, And by His wounds we are healed.
verses.textEn: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

verses.textZh: 我们众人都如羊走迷了路， 各人偏行己路； 耶和华却把我们众人的罪孽， 都归在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们众人都如羊走迷了路， 各人偏行己路； 耶和华却把我们众人的罪孽， 都归在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们都如羊走迷； 各人偏行己路； 耶和华使我们众人的罪孽都归在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.textEnEsv: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned—every one—to his own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.textEnNkjv: All we like sheep have gone astray; We have turned, every one, to his own way; And the Lord has laid on Him the iniquity of us all.
verses.textEnNlt: All of us, like sheep, have strayed away. We have left God’s paths to follow our own. Yet the Lord laid on him the sins of us all.
verses.textEnNasb: All of us, like sheep, have gone astray, Each of us has turned to his own way; But the Lord has caused the wrongdoing of us all To fall on Him.
verses.textEn: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

verses.textZh: 他被虐待，受痛苦的时候， 他并不开口； 他像羊羔被牵去屠宰， 又像羊在剪羊毛的人面前寂然无声， 他也是这样不开口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被虐待，受痛苦的时候， 他并不开口； 他像羊羔被牵去屠宰， 又像羊在剪羊毛的人面前寂然无声， 他也是这样不开口。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被欺压， 在受苦的时候却不开口 ； 他像羊羔被牵到宰杀之地， 又像羊在剪毛的人手下无声， 他也是这样不开口。
verses.textEnNiv: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; he was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before its shearers is silent, so he did not open his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth; like a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and like a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he opened not his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was oppressed and He was afflicted, Yet He opened not His mouth; He was led as a lamb to the slaughter, And as a sheep before its shearers is silent, So He opened not His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: He was oppressed and treated harshly, yet he never said a word. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter. And as a sheep is silent before the shearers, he did not open his mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: He was oppressed and afflicted, Yet He did not open His mouth; Like a lamb that is led to slaughter, And like a sheep that is silent before its shearers, So He did not open His mouth.
verses.textEn: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; he was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before its shearers is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

verses.textZh: 他受拘禁和审判以后被带走； 至于他那个世代的人中，有谁想到从活人之地被剪除， 被击打，是因我子民的过犯呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他受拘禁和审判以后被带走； 至于他那个世代的人中，有谁想到从活人之地被剪除， 被击打，是因我子民的过犯呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 因受欺压和审判，他被夺去， 至于他同世的人，谁想他受鞭打、 从活人之地被剪除， 是因我百姓的罪过呢？
verses.textEnNiv: By oppression and judgment he was taken away. Yet who of his generation protested? For he was cut off from the land of the living; for the transgression of my people he was punished.
verses.textEnEsv: By oppression and judgment he was taken away; and as for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living, stricken for the transgression of my people?
verses.textEnNkjv: He was taken from prison and from judgment, And who will declare His generation? For He was cut off from the land of the living; For the transgressions of My people He was stricken.
verses.textEnNlt: Unjustly condemned, he was led away. No one cared that he died without descendants, that his life was cut short in midstream. But he was struck down for the rebellion of my people.
verses.textEnNasb: By oppression and judgment He was taken away; And as for His generation, who considered That He was cut off from the land of the living For the wrongdoing of my people, to whom the blow was due?
verses.textEn: By oppression and judgment he was taken away. Yet who of his generation protested? For he was cut off from the land of the living; for the transgression of my people he was punished.

verses.textZh: 虽然他从来没有行过强暴， 他的口里也没有诡诈， 人还是使他与恶人同埋， 但死的时候与财主同葬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然他从来没有行过强暴， 他的口里也没有诡诈， 人还是使他与恶人同埋， 但死的时候与财主同葬。
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽然未行强暴， 口中也没有诡诈， 人还使他与恶人同埋； 谁知死的时候与财主同葬。
verses.textEnNiv: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death, though he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: And they made his grave with the wicked and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, and there was no deceit in his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made His grave with the wicked— But with the rich at His death, Because He had done no violence, Nor wasany deceit in His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: He had done no wrong and had never deceived anyone. But he was buried like a criminal; he was put in a rich man’s grave.
verses.textEnNasb: And His grave was assigned with wicked men, Yet He was with a rich man in His death, Because He had done no violence, Nor was there any deceit in His mouth.
verses.textEn: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death, though he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华却喜悦把他压伤，使他受痛苦； 耶和华若以他的性命作赎罪祭， 他必看见后裔， 并且得享长寿； 耶和华所喜悦的，必在他手中亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华却喜悦把他压伤，使他受痛苦； 耶和华若以他的性命作赎罪祭， 他必看见后裔， 并且得享长寿； 耶和华所喜悦的，必在他手中亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华却定意 将他压伤， 使他受痛苦。 耶和华以他为赎罪祭 。 他必看见后裔，并且延长年日。 耶和华所喜悦的事必在他手中亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet it was the Lord ’s will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the Lord makes his life an offering for sin, he will see his offspring and prolong his days, and the will of the Lord will prosper in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet it was the will of the Lord to crush him; he has put him to grief; when his soul makes an offering for guilt, he shall see his offspring; he shall prolong his days; the will of the Lord shall prosper in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise Him; He has put Him to grief. When You make His soul an offering for sin, He shall see His seed, He shall prolong His days, And the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in His hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But it was the Lord ’s good plan to crush him and cause him grief. Yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants. He will enjoy a long life, and the Lord ’s good plan will prosper in his hands.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord desired To crush Him, causing Him grief; If He renders Himself as a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, And the good pleasure of the Lord will prosper in His hand.
verses.textEn: Yet it was the Lord ’s will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the Lord makes his life an offering for sin, he will see his offspring and prolong his days, and the will of the Lord will prosper in his hand.

verses.textZh: 他受了生命之苦以后， 必看见光明，并且心满意足； 我的义仆必使许多人 因认识他而得称为义， 他也必背负他们的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他受了生命之苦以后， 必看见光明，并且心满意足； 我的义仆必使许多人 因认识他而得称为义， 他也必背负他们的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必看见自己劳苦的功效， 便心满意足。 有许多人因认识我的义仆得称为义； 并且他要担当他们的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: After he has suffered, he will see the light of life and be satisfied ; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the anguish of his soul he shall see and be satisfied; by his knowledge shall the righteous one, my servant, make many to be accounted righteous, and he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall see the labor of His soul, and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous Servant shall justify many, For He shall bear their iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: When he sees all that is accomplished by his anguish, he will be satisfied. And because of his experience, my righteous servant will make it possible for many to be counted righteous, for he will bear all their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: As a result of the anguish of His soul, He will see it and be satisfied; By His knowledge the Righteous One, My Servant, will justify the many, For He will bear their wrongdoings.
verses.textEn: After he has suffered, he will see the light of life and be satisfied ; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.

verses.textZh: 所以，我要使他与伟大的人同分， 他必与强盛的均分掳物， 因为他把自己的性命倾倒，以致于死。 他被列在罪犯之中， 却担当了多人的罪， 又为罪犯代求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我要使他与伟大的人同分， 他必与强盛的均分掳物， 因为他把自己的性命倾倒，以致于死。 他被列在罪犯之中， 却担当了多人的罪， 又为罪犯代求。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我要使他与位大的同分， 与强盛的均分掳物。 因为他将命倾倒，以致于死； 他也被列在罪犯之中。 他却担当多人的罪， 又为罪犯代求。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will divide him a portion with the many, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was numbered with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and makes intercession for the transgressors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will divide Him a portion with the great, And He shall divide the spoil with the strong, Because He poured out His soul unto death, And He was numbered with the transgressors, And He bore the sin of many, And made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give him the honors of a victorious soldier, because he exposed himself to death. He was counted among the rebels. He bore the sins of many and interceded for rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I will allot Him a portion with the great, And He will divide the plunder with the strong, Because He poured out His life unto death, And was counted with wrongdoers; Yet He Himself bore the sin of many, And interceded for the wrongdoers.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

verses.textZh: 不能生育、没有生养过孩子的啊！ 你要欢呼。 没有生产过的啊！你要发声欢呼，高声呼喊。 因为弃妇比有夫之妇有更多儿子。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不能生育、没有生养过孩子的啊！ 你要欢呼。 没有生产过的啊！你要发声欢呼，高声呼喊。 因为弃妇比有夫之妇有更多儿子。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这不怀孕、不生养的要歌唱； 你这未曾经过产难的要发声歌唱，扬声欢呼； 因为没有丈夫的比有丈夫的儿女更多。 这是耶和华说的。
