verses.textEnNiv: "Sing, barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Sing, O barren one, who did not bear; break forth into singing and cry aloud, you who have not been in labor! For the children of the desolate one will be more than the children of her who is married," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Sing, O barren, You who have not borne! Break forth into singing, and cry aloud, You who have not labored with child! For more are the children of the desolate Than the children of the married woman," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Sing, O childless woman, you who have never given birth! Break into loud and joyful song, O Jerusalem, you who have never been in labor. For the desolate woman now has more children than the woman who lives with her husband," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Shout for joy, infertile one, you who have not given birth to any child; Break forth into joyful shouting and cry aloud, you who have not been in labor; For the sons of the desolate one will be more numerous Than the sons of the married woman," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Sing, barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 要扩张你帐幕的地方， 伸展你居所的幔子，不要限制； 要拉长你的绳索， 坚固你的橛子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要扩张你帐幕的地方， 伸展你居所的幔子，不要限制； 要拉长你的绳索， 坚固你的橛子。
verses.textZhCuv: 要扩张你帐幕之地， 张大你居所的幔子，不要限止； 要放长你的绳子， 坚固你的橛子。
verses.textEnNiv: "Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.
verses.textEnEsv: "Enlarge the place of your tent, and let the curtains of your habitations be stretched out; do not hold back; lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Enlarge the place of your tent, And let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings; Do not spare; Lengthen your cords, And strengthen your stakes.
verses.textEnNlt: "Enlarge your house; build an addition. Spread out your home, and spare no expense!
verses.textEnNasb: "Enlarge the place of your tent; Stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not spare them; Lengthen your ropes And strengthen your pegs.
verses.textEn: "Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.

verses.textZh: 因为你要向南向北扩展， 你的后裔必占有列国之地， 又使荒废了的城镇有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你要向南向北扩展， 你的后裔必占有列国之地， 又使荒废了的城镇有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你要向左向右开展； 你的后裔必得多国为业， 又使荒凉的城邑有人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.
verses.textEnEsv: For you will spread abroad to the right and to the left, and your offspring will possess the nations and will people the desolate cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you shall expand to the right and to the left, And your descendants will inherit the nations, And make the desolate cities inhabited.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will soon be bursting at the seams. Your descendants will occupy other nations and resettle the ruined cities.
verses.textEnNasb: "For you will spread out to the right and to the left. And your descendants will possess nations And will resettle the desolate cities.
verses.textEn: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.

verses.textZh: 不要惧怕，因为你必不致蒙羞； 也不要抱愧，因为你必不致受辱， 你必忘记你幼年时的羞愧， 也不再记念你寡居时的耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要惧怕，因为你必不致蒙羞； 也不要抱愧，因为你必不致受辱， 你必忘记你幼年时的羞愧， 也不再记念你寡居时的耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要惧怕，因你必不致蒙羞； 也不要抱愧，因你必不致受辱。 你必忘记幼年的羞愧， 不再记念你寡居的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not be afraid; you will not be put to shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
verses.textEnEsv: "Fear not, for you will not be ashamed; be not confounded, for you will not be disgraced; for you will forget the shame of your youth, and the reproach of your widowhood you will remember no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not fear, for you will not be ashamed; Neither be disgraced, for you will not be put to shame; For you will forget the shame of your youth, And will not remember the reproach of your widowhood anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: "Fear not; you will no longer live in shame. Don’t be afraid; there is no more disgrace for you. You will no longer remember the shame of your youth and the sorrows of widowhood.
verses.textEnNasb: "Fear not, for you will not be put to shame; And do not feel humiliated, for you will not be disgraced; But you will forget the shame of your youth, And no longer remember the disgrace of your widowhood.
verses.textEn: "Do not be afraid; you will not be put to shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

verses.textZh: 因为造你的，就是你的丈夫； 万军之耶和华是他的名； 救赎你的，就是以色列的圣者； 他被称为全地的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为造你的，就是你的丈夫； 万军之耶和华是他的名； 救赎你的，就是以色列的圣者； 他被称为全地的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为造你的是你的丈夫； 万军之耶和华是他的名。 救赎你的是以色列的圣者； 他必称为全地之神。
verses.textEnNiv: For your Maker is your husband— the Lord Almighty is his name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: For your Maker is your husband, the Lord of hosts is his name; and the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer, the God of the whole earth he is called.
verses.textEnNkjv: For your Maker is your husband, The Lord of hosts is His name; And your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel; He is called the God of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For your Creator will be your husband; the Lord of Heaven’s Armies is his name! He is your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, the God of all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "For your husband is your Maker, Whose name is the Lord of armies; And your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel, Who is called the God of all the earth.
verses.textEn: For your Maker is your husband— the Lord Almighty is his name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华召唤你， 如同召唤被离弃、心灵忧伤的妻子， 就是幼年时所娶却被弃绝的妻子； 这是你的神说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华召唤你， 如同召唤被离弃、心灵忧伤的妻子， 就是幼年时所娶却被弃绝的妻子； 这是你的神说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华召你， 如召被离弃心中忧伤的妻， 就是幼年所娶被弃的妻。 这是你神所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit— a wife who married young, only to be rejected," says your God.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord has called you like a wife deserted and grieved in spirit, like a wife of youth when she is cast off, says your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord has called you Like a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, Like a youthful wife when you were refused," Says your God.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has called you back from your grief— as though you were a young wife abandoned by her husband," says your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the Lord has called you, Like a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, Even like a wife of one’s youth when she is rejected," Says your God.
verses.textEn: The Lord will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit— a wife who married young, only to be rejected," says your God.

verses.textZh: 我只是暂时离弃你， 却以极大的怜悯把你招聚回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我只是暂时离弃你， 却以极大的怜悯把你招聚回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我离弃你不过片时， 却要施大恩将你收回。
verses.textEnNiv: "For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back.
verses.textEnEsv: For a brief moment I deserted you, but with great compassion I will gather you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For a mere moment I have forsaken you, But with great mercies I will gather you.
verses.textEnNlt: "For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with great compassion I will take you back.
verses.textEnNasb: " For a brief moment I abandoned you, But with great compassion I will gather you.
verses.textEn: "For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back.

verses.textZh: 在怒气涨溢的时候， 我暂时向你掩面， 却要以永远的慈爱怜悯你； 这是耶和华你的救赎主说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在怒气涨溢的时候， 我暂时向你掩面， 却要以永远的慈爱怜悯你； 这是耶和华你的救赎主说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的怒气涨溢， 顷刻之间向你掩面， 却要以永远的慈爱怜恤你。 这是耶和华－你的救赎主说的。
verses.textEnNiv: In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you," says the Lord your Redeemer.
verses.textEnEsv: In overflowing anger for a moment I hid my face from you, but with everlasting love I will have compassion on you," says the Lord , your Redeemer.
verses.textEnNkjv: With a little wrath I hid My face from you for a moment; But with everlasting kindness I will have mercy on you," Says the Lord, your Redeemer.
verses.textEnNlt: In a burst of anger I turned my face away for a little while. But with everlasting love I will have compassion on you," says the Lord , your Redeemer.
verses.textEnNasb: "In an outburst of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, But with everlasting favor I will have compassion on you," Says the Lord your Redeemer.
verses.textEn: In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you," says the Lord your Redeemer.

verses.textZh: 这事对我就好象挪亚时代的洪水一般； 我怎样起誓不再使挪亚时代的洪水漫过大地， 我也照样起誓不向你发怒， 也不斥责你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事对我就好象挪亚时代的洪水一般； 我怎样起誓不再使挪亚时代的洪水漫过大地， 我也照样起誓不向你发怒， 也不斥责你。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事在我好像挪亚的洪水。 我怎样起誓不再使挪亚的洪水漫过遍地， 我也照样起誓不再向你发怒， 也不斥责你。
verses.textEnNiv: "To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.
verses.textEnEsv: "This is like the days of Noah to me: as I swore that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, and will not rebuke you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For this is like the waters of Noah to Me; For as I have sworn That the waters of Noah would no longer cover the earth, So have I sworn That I would not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Just as I swore in the time of Noah that I would never again let a flood cover the earth, so now I swear that I will never again be angry and punish you.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is like the days of Noah to Me, When I swore that the waters of Noah Would not flood the earth again; So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you Nor rebuke you.
verses.textEn: "To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.

verses.textZh: 虽然大山可以挪开，小山可以迁移， 但我的慈爱必不从你身上挪开， 我和平的约也必不迁移； 这是怜悯你的耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然大山可以挪开，小山可以迁移， 但我的慈爱必不从你身上挪开， 我和平的约也必不迁移； 这是怜悯你的耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大山可以挪开， 小山可以迁移； 但我的慈爱必不离开你； 我平安的约也不迁移。 这是怜恤你的耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed," says the Lord , who has compassion on you.
verses.textEnEsv: For the mountains may depart and the hills be removed, but my steadfast love shall not depart from you, and my covenant of peace shall not be removed," says the Lord , who has compassion on you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the mountains shall depart And the hills be removed, But My kindness shall not depart from you, Nor shall My covenant of peace be removed," Says the Lord, who has mercy on you.
verses.textEnNlt: For the mountains may move and the hills disappear, but even then my faithful love for you will remain. My covenant of blessing will never be broken," says the Lord , who has mercy on you.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the mountains may be removed and the hills may shake, But My favor will not be removed from you, Nor will My covenant of peace be shaken," Says the Lord who has compassion on you.
verses.textEn: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed," says the Lord , who has compassion on you.

verses.textZh: 受困苦、被风飘荡、不得安慰的啊！ 你看，我要用彩色的石头安置你的基石， 以蓝宝石奠定你的根基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 受困苦、被风飘荡、不得安慰的啊！ 你看，我要用彩色的石头安置你的基石， 以蓝宝石奠定你的根基。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这受困苦、被风飘荡不得安慰的人哪， 我必以彩色安置你的石头， 以蓝宝石立定你的根基；
verses.textEnNiv: "Afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted, I will rebuild you with stones of turquoise, your foundations with lapis lazuli.
verses.textEnEsv: "O afflicted one, storm-tossed and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in antimony, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O you afflicted one, Tossed with tempest, and not comforted, Behold, I will lay your stones with colorful gems, And lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.textEnNlt: "O storm-battered city, troubled and desolate! I will rebuild you with precious jewels and make your foundations from lapis lazuli.
verses.textEnNasb: "Afflicted one, storm-tossed, and not comforted, Behold, I will set your stones in antimony, And I will lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.textEn: "Afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted, I will rebuild you with stones of turquoise, your foundations with lapis lazuli.

verses.textZh: 又用红宝石做你的城楼， 用红玉做你的城门， 用各种宝石做你四周的围墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用红宝石做你的城楼， 用红玉做你的城门， 用各种宝石做你四周的围墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 又以红宝石造你的女墙， 以红玉造你的城门， 以宝石造你四围的边界 。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make your pinnacles of agate, your gates of carbuncles, and all your wall of precious stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, Your gates of crystal, And all your walls of precious stones.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make your towers of sparkling rubies, your gates of shining gems, and your walls of precious stones.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, I will make your battlements of rubies, And your gates of crystal, And your entire wall of precious stones.
verses.textEn: I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

verses.textZh: 你所有的儿女都必受耶和华的教导， 你的儿女必大享平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所有的儿女都必受耶和华的教导， 你的儿女必大享平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的儿女都要受耶和华的教训； 你的儿女必大享平安。
verses.textEnNiv: All your children will be taught by the Lord , and great will be their peace.
verses.textEnEsv: All your children shall be taught by the Lord , and great shall be the peace of your children.
verses.textEnNkjv: All your children shallbe taught by the Lord, And great shallbe the peace of your children.
verses.textEnNlt: I will teach all your children, and they will enjoy great peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "All your sons will be taught by the Lord; And the well-being of your sons will be great.
verses.textEn: All your children will be taught by the Lord , and great will be their peace.

verses.textZh: 你必因公义得以坚立； 你必远离欺压，你必无所惧怕； 你也必远离惊吓，因为惊吓必不会临近你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必因公义得以坚立； 你必远离欺压，你必无所惧怕； 你也必远离惊吓，因为惊吓必不会临近你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必因公义得坚立， 必远离欺压，不致害怕； 你必远离惊吓，惊吓必不临近你。
verses.textEnNiv: In righteousness you will be established: Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.
verses.textEnEsv: In righteousness you shall be established; you shall be far from oppression, for you shall not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come near you.
verses.textEnNkjv: In righteousness you shall be established; You shall be far from oppression, for you shall not fear; And from terror, for it shall not come near you.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be secure under a government that is just and fair. Your enemies will stay far away. You will live in peace, and terror will not come near.
verses.textEnNasb: "In righteousness you will be established; You will be far from oppression, for you will not fear; And from terror, for it will not come near you.
verses.textEn: In righteousness you will be established: Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.

verses.textZh: 看哪！必有人起来攻击你，但那不是出于我； 攻击你的，必因你仆倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！必有人起来攻击你，但那不是出于我； 攻击你的，必因你仆倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 即或有人聚集，却不由于我； 凡聚集攻击你的，必因你仆倒 。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing; whoever attacks you will surrender to you.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone stirs up strife, it is not from me; whoever stirs up strife with you shall fall because of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed they shall surely assemble, but not because of Me. Whoever assembles against you shall fall for your sake.
verses.textEnNlt: If any nation comes to fight you, it is not because I sent them. Whoever attacks you will go down in defeat.
verses.textEnNasb: "If anyone fiercely attacks you, it will not be from Me. Whoever attacks you will fall because of you.
verses.textEn: If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing; whoever attacks you will surrender to you.

verses.textZh: 看哪！那吹炭火、 打造出合用武器的铁匠，是我创造的； 那残害人、行毁灭的，也是我创造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！那吹炭火、 打造出合用武器的铁匠，是我创造的； 那残害人、行毁灭的，也是我创造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 吹嘘炭火、打造合用器械的铁匠是我所造； 残害人、行毁灭的也是我所造。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to wreak havoc;
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have created the smith who blows the fire of coals and produces a weapon for its purpose. I have also created the ravager to destroy;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I have created the blacksmith Who blows the coals in the fire, Who brings forth an instrument for his work; And I have created the spoiler to destroy.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals beneath the forge and makes the weapons of destruction. And I have created the armies that destroy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I Myself have created the smith who blows on the fire of coals And produces a weapon for its work; And I have created the destroyer to inflict ruin.
verses.textEn: "See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to wreak havoc;

verses.textZh: 为攻击你而制成的武器，都没有效用； 在审判的时候兴起来与你争辩的舌头，你都必定它为有罪。 这是耶和华众仆人的产业， 他们的义是从我而得；这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为攻击你而制成的武器，都没有效用； 在审判的时候兴起来与你争辩的舌头，你都必定它为有罪。 这是耶和华众仆人的产业， 他们的义是从我而得；这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡为攻击你造成的器械必不利用； 凡在审判时兴起用舌攻击你的， 你必定他为有罪。 这是耶和华仆人的产业， 是他们从我所得的义。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: no weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord , and this is their vindication from me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: no weapon that is fashioned against you shall succeed, and you shall refute every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord and their vindication from me, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, And every tongue which rises against you in judgment You shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, And their righteousness is from Me," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But in that coming day no weapon turned against you will succeed. You will silence every voice raised up to accuse you. These benefits are enjoyed by the servants of the Lord ; their vindication will come from me. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "No weapon that is formed against you will succeed; And you will condemn every tongue that accuses you in judgment. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, And their vindication is from Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: no weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord , and this is their vindication from me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 唉！口渴的人哪！你们都就近水来吧。 没有银钱的，你们也要来，买了就吃。 你们要来，买酒和奶， 不用银子，也不用付代价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唉！口渴的人哪！你们都就近水来吧。 没有银钱的，你们也要来，买了就吃。 你们要来，买酒和奶， 不用银子，也不用付代价。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们一切干渴的都当就近水来； 没有银钱的也可以来。 你们都来，买了吃； 不用银钱，不用价值， 也来买酒和奶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.
verses.textEnEsv: "Come, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and he who has no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ho! Everyone who thirsts, Come to the waters; And you who have no money, Come, buy and eat. Yes, come, buy wine and milk Without money and without price.
verses.textEnNlt: "Is anyone thirsty? Come and drink— even if you have no money! Come, take your choice of wine or milk— it’s all free!
verses.textEnNasb: " You there! Everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; And you who have no money come, buy and eat. Come, buy wine and milk Without money and without cost.
verses.textEn: "Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么用银子去买那不是食物的呢？ 为甚么用你们劳碌得来的去买那不能使人饱足的呢？ 你们要留心听我的话，就可以吃美物， 使你们的心灵享受肥甘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么用银子去买那不是食物的呢？ 为甚么用你们劳碌得来的去买那不能使人饱足的呢？ 你们要留心听我的话，就可以吃美物， 使你们的心灵享受肥甘。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为何花钱 买那不足为食物的？ 用劳碌得来的买那不使人饱足的呢？ 你们要留意听我的话就能吃那美物， 得享肥甘，心中喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Why spend money on what is not bread, and your labor on what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good, and you will delight in the richest of fare.
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you spend your money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which does not satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat what is good, and delight yourselves in rich food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you spend money for whatis not bread, And your wages for what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat whatis good, And let your soul delight itself in abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: Why spend your money on food that does not give you strength? Why pay for food that does you no good? Listen to me, and you will eat what is good. You will enjoy the finest food.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do you spend money for what is not bread, And your wages for what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, And delight yourself in abundance.
verses.textEn: Why spend money on what is not bread, and your labor on what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good, and you will delight in the richest of fare.

verses.textZh: 你们要侧耳而听，要到我这里来； 你们要听，就可以存活； 我必与你们立永远的约， 就是应许赐给大卫的那确实的慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要侧耳而听，要到我这里来； 你们要听，就可以存活； 我必与你们立永远的约， 就是应许赐给大卫的那确实的慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当就近我来； 侧耳而听，就必得活。 我必与你们立永约， 就是应许大卫那可靠的恩典。
verses.textEnNiv: Give ear and come to me; listen, that you may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.
verses.textEnEsv: Incline your ear, and come to me; hear, that your soul may live; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, my steadfast, sure love for David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Incline your ear, and come to Me. Hear, and your soul shall live; And I will make an everlasting covenant with you— The sure mercies of David.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come to me with your ears wide open. Listen, and you will find life. I will make an everlasting covenant with you. I will give you all the unfailing love I promised to David.
verses.textEnNasb: "Incline your ear and come to Me. Listen, that you may live; And I will make an everlasting covenant with you, According to the faithful mercies shown to David.
verses.textEn: Give ear and come to me; listen, that you may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我已经立了他作万族的见证人， 为万族的首领和司令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我已经立了他作万族的见证人， 为万族的首领和司令。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已立他作万民的见证， 为万民的君王和司令。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a ruler and commander of the peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I made him a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander for the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed I have given him as a witness to the people, A leader and commander for the people.
verses.textEnNlt: See how I used him to display my power among the peoples. I made him a leader among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I have made him a witness to the peoples, A leader and commander for the peoples.
verses.textEn: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a ruler and commander of the peoples.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你要召聚你不认识的国； 那些素来不认识你的国也必奔向你， 都因耶和华你的神、以色列的圣者的缘故， 因为他已经荣耀了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你要召聚你不认识的国； 那些素来不认识你的国也必奔向你， 都因耶和华你的神、以色列的圣者的缘故， 因为他已经荣耀了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你素不认识的国民，你也必召来； 素不认识你的国民也必向你奔跑， 都因耶和华－你的神以色列的圣者， 因为他已经荣耀你。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you will summon nations you know not, and nations you do not know will come running to you, because of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you shall call a nation that you do not know, and a nation that did not know you shall run to you, because of the Lord your God, and of the Holy One of Israel, for he has glorified you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely you shall call a nation you do not know, And nations who do not know you shall run to you, Because of the Lord your God, And the Holy One of Israel; For He has glorified you."
verses.textEnNlt: You also will command nations you do not know, and peoples unknown to you will come running to obey, because I, the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, have made you glorious."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, you will call a nation you do not know, And a nation which does not know you will run to you, Because of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel; For He has glorified you."
verses.textEn: Surely you will summon nations you know not, and nations you do not know will come running to you, because of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor."

verses.textZh: 你们要趁着耶和华可以寻找的时候，寻找他， 趁着他靠近的时候，呼求他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要趁着耶和华可以寻找的时候，寻找他， 趁着他靠近的时候，呼求他。
verses.textZhCuv: 当趁耶和华可寻找的时候寻找他， 相近的时候求告他。
verses.textEnNiv: Seek the Lord while he may be found; call on him while he is near.
verses.textEnEsv: "Seek the Lord while he may be found; call upon him while he is near;
verses.textEnNkjv: Seek the Lord while He may be found, Call upon Him while He is near.
verses.textEnNlt: Seek the Lord while you can find him. Call on him now while he is near.
verses.textEnNasb: Seek the Lord while He may be found; Call upon Him while He is near.
verses.textEn: Seek the Lord while he may be found; call on him while he is near.

verses.textZh: 恶人要离弃自己的道路， 不义的人当除去自己的意念， 回转过来归向耶和华， 耶和华就必怜悯他。 你们当回转过来归向我们的神， 因为他大大赦免人的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人要离弃自己的道路， 不义的人当除去自己的意念， 回转过来归向耶和华， 耶和华就必怜悯他。 你们当回转过来归向我们的神， 因为他大大赦免人的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人当离弃自己的道路； 不义的人当除掉自己的意念。 归向耶和华，耶和华就必怜恤他； 当归向我们的神，因为神必广行赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the wicked forsake their ways and the unrighteous their thoughts. Let them turn to the Lord , and he will have mercy on them, and to our God, for he will freely pardon.
verses.textEnEsv: let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the Lord , that he may have compassion on him, and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the wicked forsake his way, And the unrighteous man his thoughts; Let him return to the Lord, And He will have mercy on him; And to our God, For He will abundantly pardon.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the wicked change their ways and banish the very thought of doing wrong. Let them turn to the Lord that he may have mercy on them. Yes, turn to our God, for he will forgive generously.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the wicked abandon his way, And the unrighteous person his thoughts; And let him return to the Lord, And He will have compassion on him, And to our God, For He will abundantly pardon.
verses.textEn: Let the wicked forsake their ways and the unrighteous their thoughts. Let them turn to the Lord , and he will have mercy on them, and to our God, for he will freely pardon.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我的意念不是你们的意念， 你们的道路也不是我的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我的意念不是你们的意念， 你们的道路也不是我的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我的意念非同你们的意念； 我的道路非同你们的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "For My thoughts are not your thoughts, Nor are your ways My ways," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "My thoughts are nothing like your thoughts," says the Lord . "And my ways are far beyond anything you could imagine.
verses.textEnNasb: "For My thoughts are not your thoughts, Nor are your ways My ways," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 天怎样高过地， 我的道路也怎样高过你们的道路， 我的意念也怎样高过你们的意念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天怎样高过地， 我的道路也怎样高过你们的道路， 我的意念也怎样高过你们的意念。
verses.textZhCuv: 天怎样高过地， 照样，我的道路高过你们的道路； 我的意念高过你们的意念。
verses.textEnNiv: "As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.textEnEsv: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For as the heavens are higher than the earth, So are My ways higher than your ways, And My thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.textEnNlt: For just as the heavens are higher than the earth, so my ways are higher than your ways and my thoughts higher than your thoughts.
verses.textEnNasb: "For as the heavens are higher than the earth, So are My ways higher than your ways And My thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.textEn: "As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.textZh: 雨雪怎样从天上降下来， 不再返回天上，却灌溉大地， 使地上的植物发芽结实， 使撒种的有种子，吃的人有粮食；
verses.textZhCnvs: 雨雪怎样从天上降下来， 不再返回天上，却灌溉大地， 使地上的植物发芽结实， 使撒种的有种子，吃的人有粮食；
verses.textZhCuv: 雨雪从天而降，并不返回， 却滋润地土，使地上发芽结实， 使撒种的有种，使要吃的有粮。
verses.textEnNiv: As the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return to it without watering the earth and making it bud and flourish, so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,
verses.textEnEsv: "For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven and do not return there but water the earth, making it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, And do not return there, But water the earth, And make it bring forth and bud, That it may give seed to the sower And bread to the eater,
verses.textEnNlt: "The rain and snow come down from the heavens and stay on the ground to water the earth. They cause the grain to grow, producing seed for the farmer and bread for the hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: "For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven, And do not return there without watering the earth And making it produce and sprout, And providing seed to the sower and bread to the eater;
verses.textEn: As the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return to it without watering the earth and making it bud and flourish, so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,

verses.textZh: 从我的口所出的话也必这样， 必不徒然返回我这里， 却要作成我所喜悦的， 使它在我差遣它去作的事上必然亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从我的口所出的话也必这样， 必不徒然返回我这里， 却要作成我所喜悦的， 使它在我差遣它去作的事上必然亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 我口所出的话也必如此， 决不徒然返回， 却要成就我所喜悦的， 在我发他去成就 的事上必然亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.
verses.textEnEsv: so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and shall succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall My word be that goes forth from My mouth; It shall not return to Me void, But it shall accomplish what I please, And it shall prosper inthething for which I sent it.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the same with my word. I send it out, and it always produces fruit. It will accomplish all I want it to, and it will prosper everywhere I send it.
verses.textEnNasb: So will My word be which goes out of My mouth; It will not return to Me empty, Without accomplishing what I desire, And without succeeding in the purpose for which I sent it.
verses.textEn: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.

verses.textZh: 你们必欢欢喜喜出来， 平平安安蒙引导； 大山小山都必在你们面前发声欢呼， 田野所有的树木也都拍掌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必欢欢喜喜出来， 平平安安蒙引导； 大山小山都必在你们面前发声欢呼， 田野所有的树木也都拍掌。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必欢欢喜喜而出来， 平平安安蒙引导。 大山小山必在你们面前发声歌唱； 田野的树木也都拍掌。
verses.textEnNiv: You will go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: "For you shall go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and the hills before you shall break forth into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For you shall go out with joy, And be led out with peace; The mountains and the hills Shall break forth into singing before you, And all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: You will live in joy and peace. The mountains and hills will burst into song, and the trees of the field will clap their hands!
verses.textEnNasb: "For you will go out with joy And be led in peace; The mountains and the hills will break into shouts of joy before you, And all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
verses.textEn: You will go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

verses.textZh: 松树要长起来代替荆棘， 番石榴要长起来代替蒺藜。 这要为耶和华留名， 作永远不能废掉的记号。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 松树要长起来代替荆棘， 番石榴要长起来代替蒺藜。 这要为耶和华留名， 作永远不能废掉的记号。"
verses.textZhCuv: 松树长出，代替荆棘； 番石榴长出，代替蒺藜。 这要为耶和华留名， 作为永远的证据，不能剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead of the thornbush will grow the juniper, and instead of briers the myrtle will grow. This will be for the Lord ’s renown, for an everlasting sign, that will endure forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Instead of the thorn shall come up the cypress; instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle; and it shall make a name for the Lord , an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off."
verses.textEnNkjv: Instead of the thorn shall come up the cypress tree, And instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree; And it shall be to the Lord for a name, For an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off."
verses.textEnNlt: Where once there were thorns, cypress trees will grow. Where nettles grew, myrtles will sprout up. These events will bring great honor to the Lord ’s name; they will be an everlasting sign of his power and love."
verses.textEnNasb: "Instead of the thorn bush, the juniper will come up, And instead of the stinging nettle, the myrtle will come up; And it will be a memorial to the Lord, An everlasting sign which will not be eliminated."
verses.textEn: Instead of the thornbush will grow the juniper, and instead of briers the myrtle will grow. This will be for the Lord ’s renown, for an everlasting sign, that will endure forever."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们要持守公平，实行公义； 因为我的拯救快要来到， 我的公义快要显现了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们要持守公平，实行公义； 因为我的拯救快要来到， 我的公义快要显现了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你们当守公平，行公义； 因我的救恩临近， 我的公义将要显现。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Keep justice, and do righteousness, for soon my salvation will come, and my righteousness be revealed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Keep justice, and do righteousness, For My salvation is about to come, And My righteousness to be revealed.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Be just and fair to all. Do what is right and good, for I am coming soon to rescue you and to display my righteousness among you.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Guard justice and do righteousness, For My salvation is about to come And My righteousness to be revealed.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

verses.textZh: 谨守安息日，不亵渎这日， 保守自己的手不作任何恶事， 这样行的人和坚持这样作的人， 是有福的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守安息日，不亵渎这日， 保守自己的手不作任何恶事， 这样行的人和坚持这样作的人， 是有福的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守安息日而不干犯， 禁止己手而不作恶； 如此行、如此持守的人便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who does this— the person who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it, and keeps their hands from doing any evil."
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath, not profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil."
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man who does this, And the son of man who lays hold on it; Who keeps from defiling the Sabbath, And keeps his hand from doing any evil."
verses.textEnNlt: Blessed are all those who are careful to do this. Blessed are those who honor my Sabbath days of rest and keep themselves from doing wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed is a man who does this, And a son of man who takes hold of it; Who keeps from profaning the Sabbath, And keeps his hand from doing any evil."
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who does this— the person who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it, and keeps their hands from doing any evil."

verses.textZh: 与耶和华联合的外族人不要说： "耶和华必把我从他的子民中分别出来。" 被阉割了的人也不要说："看哪！我是一棵枯树。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 与耶和华联合的外族人不要说： "耶和华必把我从他的子民中分别出来。" 被阉割了的人也不要说："看哪！我是一棵枯树。"
verses.textZhCuv: 与耶和华联合的外邦人不要说： 耶和华必定将我从他民中分别出来。 太监也不要说：我是枯树。
verses.textEnNiv: Let no foreigner who is bound to the Lord say, "The Lord will surely exclude me from his people." And let no eunuch complain, "I am only a dry tree."
verses.textEnEsv: Let not the foreigner who has joined himself to the Lord say, "The Lord will surely separate me from his people"; and let not the eunuch say, "Behold, I am a dry tree."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let the son of the foreigner Who has joined himself to the Lord Speak, saying, "The Lord has utterly separated me from His people"; Nor let the eunuch say, "Here I am, a dry tree."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t let foreigners who commit themselves to the Lord say, ‘The Lord will never let me be part of his people.’ And don’t let the eunuchs say, ‘I’m a dried-up tree with no children and no future.’
verses.textEnNasb: Let not the foreigner who has joined himself to the Lord say, "The Lord will certainly separate me from His people." Nor let the eunuch say, "Behold, I am a dry tree."
verses.textEn: Let no foreigner who is bound to the Lord say, "The Lord will surely exclude me from his people." And let no eunuch complain, "I am only a dry tree."

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说： "那些谨守我的安息日， 拣选我所喜悦的事， 持守我的约、被阉割了的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说： "那些谨守我的安息日， 拣选我所喜悦的事， 持守我的约、被阉割了的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华如此说： 那些谨守我的安息日， 拣选我所喜悦的事， 持守我约的太监，
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: "To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant—
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose the things that please me and hold fast my covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, And choose what pleases Me, And hold fast My covenant,
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says: I will bless those eunuchs who keep my Sabbath days holy and who choose to do what pleases me and commit their lives to me.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, And choose what pleases Me, And hold firmly to My covenant,
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: "To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant—

verses.textZh: 在我的殿中和在我的墙内，我要赐给他们有记念，有名号， 比有儿女更好； 我必赐给他们永远不能废掉的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我的殿中和在我的墙内，我要赐给他们有记念，有名号， 比有儿女更好； 我必赐给他们永远不能废掉的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使他们在我殿中， 在我墙内，有记念，有名号， 比有儿女的更美。 我必赐他们永远的名，不能剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that will endure forever.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give in my house and within my walls a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even to them I will give in My house And within My walls a place and a name Better than that of sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name That shall not be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give them—within the walls of my house— a memorial and a name far greater than sons and daughters could give. For the name I give them is an everlasting one. It will never disappear!
verses.textEnNasb: To them I will give in My house and within My walls a memorial, And a name better than that of sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name which will not be eliminated.
verses.textEn: to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that will endure forever.

verses.textZh: 至于那些与耶和华联合的外族人， 为要事奉他，爱耶和华的名， 作他的仆人的，就是谨守安息日，不亵渎这日， 又持守我的约的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些与耶和华联合的外族人， 为要事奉他，爱耶和华的名， 作他的仆人的，就是谨守安息日，不亵渎这日， 又持守我的约的，
verses.textZhCuv: 还有那些与耶和华联合的外邦人， 要事奉他，要爱耶和华的名， 要作他的仆人－ 就是凡守安息日不干犯， 又持守他 约的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And foreigners who bind themselves to the Lord to minister to him, to love the name of the Lord , and to be his servants, all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant—
verses.textEnEsv: "And the foreigners who join themselves to the Lord , to minister to him, to love the name of the Lord , and to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath and does not profane it, and holds fast my covenant—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also the sons of the foreigner Who join themselves to the Lord, to serve Him, And to love the name of the Lord, to be His servants— Everyone who keeps from defiling the Sabbath, And holds fast My covenant—
verses.textEnNlt: "I will also bless the foreigners who commit themselves to the Lord , who serve him and love his name, who worship him and do not desecrate the Sabbath day of rest, and who hold fast to my covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: "Also the foreigners who join themselves to the Lord, To attend to His service and to love the name of the Lord, To be His servants, every one who keeps the Sabbath so as not to profane it, And holds firmly to My covenant;
verses.textEn: And foreigners who bind themselves to the Lord to minister to him, to love the name of the Lord , and to be his servants, all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant—

verses.textZh: 我必领他们到我的圣山， 使他们在属于我的祷告的殿中喜乐； 他们的燔祭和祭品，在我的祭坛上必蒙悦纳； 因为我的殿必称为万族祷告的殿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必领他们到我的圣山， 使他们在属于我的祷告的殿中喜乐； 他们的燔祭和祭品，在我的祭坛上必蒙悦纳； 因为我的殿必称为万族祷告的殿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必领他们到我的圣山， 使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。 他们的燔祭和平安祭， 在我坛上必蒙悦纳， 因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations."
verses.textEnEsv: these I will bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer; their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples."
verses.textEnNkjv: Even them I will bring to My holy mountain, And make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices Willbe accepted on My altar; For My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations."
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring them to my holy mountain of Jerusalem and will fill them with joy in my house of prayer. I will accept their burnt offerings and sacrifices, because my Temple will be called a house of prayer for all nations.
verses.textEnNasb: Even those I will bring to My holy mountain, And make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar; For My house will be called a house of prayer for all the peoples."
verses.textEn: these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations."

verses.textZh: 主耶和华，就是招聚以色列被赶散的人的，说： "在以色列这些已经被招聚的人以外，我还要招聚别的人归给他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华，就是招聚以色列被赶散的人的，说： "在以色列这些已经被招聚的人以外，我还要招聚别的人归给他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华， 就是招聚以色列被赶散的，说： 在这被招聚的人以外， 我还要招聚别人归并他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sovereign Lord declares— he who gathers the exiles of Israel: "I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God , who gathers the outcasts of Israel, declares, "I will gather yet others to him besides those already gathered."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, "Yet I will gather to him Others besides those who are gathered to him."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Sovereign Lord , who brings back the outcasts of Israel, says: I will bring others, too, besides my people Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God, who gathers the dispersed of Israel, declares, "I will yet gather others to them, to those already gathered."
verses.textEn: The Sovereign Lord declares— he who gathers the exiles of Israel: "I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered."

verses.textZh: 田野的百兽啊！你们都来吃吧。 林中的百兽啊！你们都要这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 田野的百兽啊！你们都来吃吧。 林中的百兽啊！你们都要这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 田野的诸兽都来吞吃吧！ 林中的诸兽也要如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!
verses.textEnEsv: All you beasts of the field, come to devour— all you beasts in the forest.
verses.textEnNkjv: All you beasts of the field, come to devour, All you beasts in the forest.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, wild animals of the field! Come, wild animals of the forest! Come and devour my people!
verses.textEnNasb: All you wild animals, All you animals in the forest, Come to eat.
verses.textEn: Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!

verses.textZh: 他的守望者都是瞎眼的， 都没有知识； 他们都是哑巴狗，不能吠； 只会作梦、躺卧，贪爱睡觉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的守望者都是瞎眼的， 都没有知识； 他们都是哑巴狗，不能吠； 只会作梦、躺卧，贪爱睡觉。
verses.textZhCuv: 他看守的人是瞎眼的， 都没有知识， 都是哑巴狗，不能叫唤； 但知做梦，躺卧，贪睡，
verses.textEnNiv: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they all lack knowledge; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they lie around and dream, they love to sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: His watchmen are blind; they are all without knowledge; they are all silent dogs; they cannot bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.textEnNkjv: His watchmen are blind, They are all ignorant; They are all dumb dogs, They cannot bark; Sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.textEnNlt: For the leaders of my people— the Lord ’s watchmen, his shepherds— are blind and ignorant. They are like silent watchdogs that give no warning when danger comes. They love to lie around, sleeping and dreaming.
verses.textEnNasb: His watchmen are blind, All of them know nothing. All of them are mute dogs unable to bark, Dreamers lying down, who love to slumber;
verses.textEn: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they all lack knowledge; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they lie around and dream, they love to sleep.

verses.textZh: 这些狗十分贪吃，不知饱足； 他们是牧人，但甚么都不明白； 他们都偏行自己的道路， 各从各方求自己的利益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些狗十分贪吃，不知饱足； 他们是牧人，但甚么都不明白； 他们都偏行自己的道路， 各从各方求自己的利益。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些狗贪食，不知饱足。 这些牧人不能明白－ 各人偏行己路， 各从各方求自己的利益。
verses.textEnNiv: They are dogs with mighty appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who lack understanding; they all turn to their own way, they seek their own gain.
verses.textEnEsv: The dogs have a mighty appetite; they never have enough. But they are shepherds who have no understanding; they have all turned to their own way, each to his own gain, one and all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, theyare greedy dogs Which never have enough. And they are shepherds Who cannot understand; They all look to their own way, Every one for his own gain, From his own territory.
verses.textEnNlt: Like greedy dogs, they are never satisfied. They are ignorant shepherds, all following their own path and intent on personal gain.
verses.textEnNasb: And the dogs are greedy, they are never satisfied. And they are shepherds who have no understanding; They have all turned to their own way, Each one to his unjust gain, without exception.
verses.textEn: They are dogs with mighty appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who lack understanding; they all turn to their own way, they seek their own gain.

verses.textZh: 他们说："来吧！我去拿酒，让我们痛饮烈酒吧！ 明天必像今天一样，而且比今天还盛大和丰盈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："来吧！我去拿酒，让我们痛饮烈酒吧！ 明天必像今天一样，而且比今天还盛大和丰盈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：来吧！我去拿酒， 我们饱饮浓酒； 明日必和今日一样， 就是宴乐无量极大之日。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come," each one cries, "let me get wine! Let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far better."
verses.textEnEsv: "Come," they say, "let me get wine; let us fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be like this day, great beyond measure."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come," onesays, "I will bring wine, And we will fill ourselves with intoxicating drink; Tomorrow will be as today, And much more abundant."
verses.textEnNlt: "Come," they say, "let’s get some wine and have a party. Let’s all get drunk. Then tomorrow we’ll do it again and have an even bigger party!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Come," they say, " let’s get wine, and let’s drink heavily of intoxicating drink; And tomorrow will be like today, only more so."
verses.textEn: "Come," each one cries, "let me get wine! Let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far better."

verses.textZh: 义人死亡，没有人放在心上； 虔诚人去世，也没有人明白； 义人去世，是脱离了祸患。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人死亡，没有人放在心上； 虔诚人去世，也没有人明白； 义人去世，是脱离了祸患。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人死亡， 无人放在心上； 虔诚人被收去， 无人思念。 这义人被收去是免了将来的祸患；
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; the devout are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous man perishes, and no one lays it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous man is taken away from calamity;
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous perishes, And no man takes it to heart; Merciful men are taken away, While no one considers That the righteous is taken away from evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Good people pass away; the godly often die before their time. But no one seems to care or wonder why. No one seems to understand that God is protecting them from the evil to come.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous person perishes, and no one takes it to heart; And devout people are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous person is taken away from evil,
verses.textEn: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; the devout are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.

verses.textZh: 行事为人正直的， 死后必得进入平安， 在他们的坟墓里享安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行事为人正直的， 死后必得进入平安， 在他们的坟墓里享安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们得享 平安。 素行正直的，各人在坟里 安歇。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest as they lie in death.
verses.textEnEsv: he enters into peace; they rest in their beds who walk in their uprightness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall enter into peace; They shall rest in their beds, Eachone walking in his uprightness.
verses.textEnNlt: For those who follow godly paths will rest in peace when they die.
verses.textEnNasb: He enters into peace; They rest in their beds, Each one who walked in his upright way.
verses.textEn: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest as they lie in death.

verses.textZh: 但你们这些巫妇的儿子，奸夫和妓女的后裔啊！ 你们都走近这里行奸淫吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们这些巫妇的儿子，奸夫和妓女的后裔啊！ 你们都走近这里行奸淫吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这些巫婆的儿子， 奸夫和妓女的种子， 都要前来！
verses.textEnNiv: "But you—come here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
verses.textEnEsv: But you, draw near, sons of the sorceress, offspring of the adulterer and the loose woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But come here, You sons of the sorceress, You offspring of the adulterer and the harlot!
verses.textEnNlt: "But you—come here, you witches’ children, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
verses.textEnNasb: "But come here, you sons of a sorceress, Offspring of an adulterer and a prostitute!
verses.textEn: "But you—come here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!

verses.textZh: 你们戏弄谁呢？ 你们张大嘴巴， 伸长舌头戏弄谁呢？ 你们不是悖逆的孩子吗？ 不是虚谎的后裔吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们戏弄谁呢？ 你们张大嘴巴， 伸长舌头戏弄谁呢？ 你们不是悖逆的孩子吗？ 不是虚谎的后裔吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们向谁戏笑？ 向谁张口吐舌呢？ 你们岂不是悖逆的儿女， 虚谎的种类呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not a brood of rebels, the offspring of liars?
verses.textEnEsv: Whom are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, the offspring of deceit,
verses.textEnNkjv: Whom do you ridicule? Against whom do you make a wide mouth And stick out the tongue? Are you not children of transgression, Offspring of falsehood,
verses.textEnNlt: Whom do you mock, making faces and sticking out your tongues? You children of sinners and liars!
verses.textEnNasb: "Of whom do you make fun? Against whom do you open wide your mouth And stick out your tongue? Are you not children of rebellion, Offspring of deceit,
verses.textEn: Who are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not a brood of rebels, the offspring of liars?

verses.textZh: 你们在橡树林中， 在青翠树下欲火焚心； 在山谷间，在岩穴里， 宰杀自己的孩子作祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在橡树林中， 在青翠树下欲火焚心； 在山谷间，在岩穴里， 宰杀自己的孩子作祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在橡树中间，在各青翠树下欲火攻心； 在山谷间，在石穴下杀了儿女；
verses.textEnNiv: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every spreading tree; you sacrifice your children in the ravines and under the overhanging crags.
verses.textEnEsv: you who burn with lust among the oaks, under every green tree, who slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.textEnNkjv: Inflaming yourselves with gods under every green tree, Slaying the children in the valleys, Under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.textEnNlt: You worship your idols with great passion beneath the oaks and under every green tree. You sacrifice your children down in the valleys, among the jagged rocks in the cliffs.
verses.textEnNasb: Who inflame yourselves among the oaks, Under every luxuriant tree, Who slaughter the children in the ravines, Under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.textEn: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every spreading tree; you sacrifice your children in the ravines and under the overhanging crags.

verses.textZh: 在山谷中光滑的石头里有你的分； 只有它们是你所要得的分！ 你也向它们浇了奠祭， 献上了供物。 这些事我岂能容忍不报复呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 在山谷中光滑的石头里有你的分； 只有它们是你所要得的分！ 你也向它们浇了奠祭， 献上了供物。 这些事我岂能容忍不报复呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 在谷中光滑石头里有你的分。 这些就是你所得的分； 你也向他浇了奠祭，献了供物， 因这事我岂能容忍吗？
verses.textEnNiv: The idols among the smooth stones of the ravines are your portion; indeed, they are your lot. Yes, to them you have poured out drink offerings and offered grain offerings. In view of all this, should I relent?
verses.textEnEsv: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they, are your lot; to them you have poured out a drink offering, you have brought a grain offering. Shall I relent for these things?
verses.textEnNkjv: Among the smooth stones of the stream Is your portion; They, they, are your lot! Even to them you have poured a drink offering, You have offered a grain offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.textEnNlt: Your gods are the smooth stones in the valleys. You worship them with liquid offerings and grain offerings. They, not I, are your inheritance. Do you think all this makes me happy?
verses.textEnNasb: "Among the smooth stones of the ravine Is your portion, they are your lot; Even to them you have poured out a drink offering, You have made a grain offering. Should I relent of these things?
verses.textEn: The idols among the smooth stones of the ravines are your portion; indeed, they are your lot. Yes, to them you have poured out drink offerings and offered grain offerings. In view of all this, should I relent?

verses.textZh: 你在高高的山上安设你的床榻， 又上到那里去献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在高高的山上安设你的床榻， 又上到那里去献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在高而又高的山上安设床榻， 也上那里去献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: "On a lofty and high mountain You have set your bed; Even there you went up To offer sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: You have committed adultery on every high mountain. There you have worshiped idols and have been unfaithful to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "On a high and lofty mountain You have made your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
verses.textEn: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 你在门后，在门框后， 安设了外族神的记号； 你远离了我，裸露了自己， 就上床去，又扩张你的床， 你也与他们立约； 你爱他们的床， 看他们的下体 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在门后，在门框后， 安设了外族神的记号； 你远离了我，裸露了自己， 就上床去，又扩张你的床， 你也与他们立约； 你爱他们的床， 看他们的下体 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在门后，在门框后， 立起你的纪念； 向外人赤露，又上去扩张床榻， 与他们立约； 你在那里看见他们的床就甚喜爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Behind your doors and your doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed, you climbed into it and opened it wide; you made a pact with those whose beds you love, and you looked with lust on their naked bodies.
verses.textEnEsv: Behind the door and the doorpost you have set up your memorial; for, deserting me, you have uncovered your bed, you have gone up to it, you have made it wide; and you have made a covenant for yourself with them, you have loved their bed, you have looked on nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also behind the doors and their posts You have set up your remembrance; For you have uncovered yourself tothoseother than Me, And have gone up to them; You have enlarged your bed And made acovenant with them; You have loved their bed, Where you saw their nudity.
verses.textEnNlt: You have put pagan symbols on your doorposts and behind your doors. You have left me and climbed into bed with these detestable gods. You have committed yourselves to them. You love to look at their naked bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behind the door and the doorpost You have set up your sign; Indeed, far removed from Me, you have uncovered yourself, And have gone up and made your bed wide. And you have made an agreement for yourself with them, You have loved their bed, You have looked at their manhood.
verses.textEn: Behind your doors and your doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed, you climbed into it and opened it wide; you made a pact with those whose beds you love, and you looked with lust on their naked bodies.

verses.textZh: 你带着油走到君王那里， 并且加多了你的香料， 差派使者到远方去， 你甚至自己下到阴间去！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你带着油走到君王那里， 并且加多了你的香料， 差派使者到远方去， 你甚至自己下到阴间去！
verses.textZhCuv: 你把油带到王那里， 又多加香料， 打发使者往远方去， 自卑自贱直到阴间，
verses.textEnNiv: You went to Molek with olive oil and increased your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you descended to the very realm of the dead!
verses.textEnEsv: You journeyed to the king with oil and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far off, and sent down even to Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: You went to the king with ointment, And increased your perfumes; You sent your messengers far off, And even descended to Sheol.
verses.textEnNlt: You have gone to Molech with olive oil and many perfumes, sending your agents far and wide, even to the world of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have journeyed to the king with oil And increased your perfumes; You have sent your messengers a great distance And made them go down to Sheol.
verses.textEn: You went to Molek with olive oil and increased your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you descended to the very realm of the dead!

verses.textZh: 你因路途遥远而困乏， 却不说："没有希望了！" 因为你找着了生命的力量， 所以你不觉得疲倦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因路途遥远而困乏， 却不说："没有希望了！" 因为你找着了生命的力量， 所以你不觉得疲倦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因路远疲倦， 却不说这是枉然； 你以为有复兴之力， 所以不觉疲惫。
verses.textEnNiv: You wearied yourself by such going about, but you would not say, ‘It is hopeless.’ You found renewal of your strength, and so you did not faint.
verses.textEnEsv: You were wearied with the length of your way, but you did not say, "It is hopeless"; you found new life for your strength, and so you were not faint.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are wearied in the length of your way; Yet you did not say, ‘There is no hope.’ You have found the life of your hand; Therefore you were not grieved.
verses.textEnNlt: You grew weary in your search, but you never gave up. Desire gave you renewed strength, and you did not grow weary.
verses.textEnNasb: "You were tired out by the length of your road, Yet you did not say, ‘It is hopeless!’ You found renewed strength, Therefore you did not faint.
verses.textEn: You wearied yourself by such going about, but you would not say, ‘It is hopeless.’ You found renewal of your strength, and so you did not faint.

verses.textZh: 你怕谁？你因谁而惧怕， 以致你对我说谎呢？你不记念我， 也不把我放在心上， 是不是因为我长久缄默， 你就不惧怕我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怕谁？你因谁而惧怕， 以致你对我说谎呢？你不记念我， 也不把我放在心上， 是不是因为我长久缄默， 你就不惧怕我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你怕谁？因谁恐惧？ 竟说谎，不记念我， 又不将这事放在心上。 我不是许久闭口不言， 你仍不怕我吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Whom have you so dreaded and feared that you have not been true to me, and have neither remembered me nor taken this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear me?
verses.textEnEsv: Whom did you dread and fear, so that you lied, and did not remember me, did not lay it to heart? Have I not held my peace, even for a long time, and you do not fear me?
verses.textEnNkjv: "And of whom have you been afraid, or feared, That you have lied And not remembered Me, Nor taken it to your heart? Is it not because I have held My peace from of old That you do not fear Me?
verses.textEnNlt: "Are you afraid of these idols? Do they terrify you? Is that why you have lied to me and forgotten me and my words? Is it because of my long silence that you no longer fear me?
verses.textEnNasb: "Of whom were you worried and fearful When you lied, and did not remember Me Nor give Me a thought? Was I not silent, even for a long time, So you do not fear Me?
verses.textEn: "Whom have you so dreaded and feared that you have not been true to me, and have neither remembered me nor taken this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear me?

verses.textZh: 我要说明你的公义和你所作的， 但它们都必与你无益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要说明你的公义和你所作的， 但它们都必与你无益。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要指明你的公义； 至于你所行的都必与你无益。
verses.textEnNiv: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, but they will not profit you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will declare your righteousness And your works, For they will not profit you.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I will expose your so-called good deeds. None of them will help you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, And they will not benefit you.
verses.textEn: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.

verses.textZh: 你呼求的时候，让你所收集的偶像拯救你吧！ 但一阵风要把它们全都刮走， 一口气要把它们全部吹去。 然而那投靠我的，必承受地土， 得着我的圣山作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你呼求的时候，让你所收集的偶像拯救你吧！ 但一阵风要把它们全都刮走， 一口气要把它们全部吹去。 然而那投靠我的，必承受地土， 得着我的圣山作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你哀求的时候， 让你所聚集的拯救你吧！ 风要把他们刮散， 一口气要把他们都吹去。 但那投靠我的必得地土， 必承受我的圣山为业。
verses.textEnNiv: When you cry out for help, let your collection of idols save you! The wind will carry all of them off, a mere breath will blow them away. But whoever takes refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you! The wind will carry them all off, a breath will take them away. But he who takes refuge in me shall possess the land and shall inherit my holy mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you cry out, Let your collection ofidols deliver you. But the wind will carry them all away, A breath will take them. But he who puts his trust in Me shall possess the land, And shall inherit My holy mountain."
verses.textEnNlt: Let’s see if your idols can save you when you cry to them for help. Why, a puff of wind can knock them down! If you just breathe on them, they fall over! But whoever trusts in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain."
verses.textEnNasb: "When you cry out, let your collection of idols save you. But the wind will carry them all up, And a breath will take them away. But the one who takes refuge in Me will inherit the land And possess My holy mountain."
verses.textEn: When you cry out for help, let your collection of idols save you! The wind will carry all of them off, a mere breath will blow them away. But whoever takes refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain."

verses.textZh: 必有人说： "你们要填高，要填高，要修平道路； 把障碍物从我子民的路上除掉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有人说： "你们要填高，要填高，要修平道路； 把障碍物从我子民的路上除掉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要说： 你们修筑修筑，预备道路， 将绊脚石从我百姓的路中除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: And it will be said: "Build up, build up, prepare the road! Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people."
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be said, "Build up, build up, prepare the way, remove every obstruction from my people’s way."
verses.textEnNkjv: And one shall say, "Heap it up! Heap it up! Prepare the way, Take the stumbling block out of the way of My people."
verses.textEnNlt: God says, "Rebuild the road! Clear away the rocks and stones so my people can return from captivity."
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be said, "Build up, build up, prepare the way, Remove every obstacle from the way of My people."
verses.textEn: And it will be said: "Build up, build up, prepare the road! Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people."

verses.textZh: 因为那至高无上、 永远存在、他名为圣的这样说： "虽然我住在至高至圣的地方， 却与心灵痛悔和谦卑的人同在， 要使谦卑人的灵苏醒， 也使痛悔人的心苏醒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那至高无上、 永远存在、他名为圣的这样说： "虽然我住在至高至圣的地方， 却与心灵痛悔和谦卑的人同在， 要使谦卑人的灵苏醒， 也使痛悔人的心苏醒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那至高至上、永远长存 名为圣者的如此说： 我住在至高至圣的所在， 也与心灵痛悔谦卑的人同居； 要使谦卑人的灵苏醒， 也使痛悔人的心苏醒。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the high and exalted One says— he who lives forever, whose name is holy: "I live in a high and holy place, but also with the one who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: "I dwell in the high and holy place, and also with him who is of a contrite and lowly spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the High and Lofty One Who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: "I dwell in the high and holy place, With him who has a contrite and humble spirit, To revive the spirit of the humble, And to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.textEnNlt: The high and lofty one who lives in eternity, the Holy One, says this: "I live in the high and holy place with those whose spirits are contrite and humble. I restore the crushed spirit of the humble and revive the courage of those with repentant hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the high and exalted One Who lives forever, whose name is Holy, says: "I dwell in a high and holy place, And also with the contrite and lowly of spirit In order to revive the spirit of the lowly And to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.textEn: For this is what the high and exalted One says— he who lives forever, whose name is holy: "I live in a high and holy place, but also with the one who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.

verses.textZh: 我必不永远争辩， 也不长久发怒， 因为这样，人的灵，就是我所造的人，在我面前就要发昏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不永远争辩， 也不长久发怒， 因为这样，人的灵，就是我所造的人，在我面前就要发昏。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不永远相争，也不长久发怒， 恐怕我所造的人与灵性都必发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not accuse them forever, nor will I always be angry, for then they would faint away because of me— the very people I have created.
verses.textEnEsv: For I will not contend forever, nor will I always be angry; for the spirit would grow faint before me, and the breath of life that I made.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would fail before Me, And the souls which I have made.
verses.textEnNlt: For I will not fight against you forever; I will not always be angry. If I were, all people would pass away— all the souls I have made.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would grow faint before Me, And the breath of those whom I have made.
verses.textEn: I will not accuse them forever, nor will I always be angry, for then they would faint away because of me— the very people I have created.

verses.textZh: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我发怒了； 我击打他，向他掩面，并且发怒， 他仍然随着自己的心意背道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我发怒了； 我击打他，向他掩面，并且发怒， 他仍然随着自己的心意背道。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我就发怒击打他； 我向他掩面发怒， 他却仍然随心背道。
verses.textEnNiv: I was enraged by their sinful greed; I punished them, and hid my face in anger, yet they kept on in their willful ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of the iniquity of his unjust gain I was angry, I struck him; I hid my face and was angry, but he went on backsliding in the way of his own heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry and struck him; I hid and was angry, And he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: I was angry, so I punished these greedy people. I withdrew from them, but they kept going on their own stubborn way.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of the wrongful act of his unjust gain I was angry and struck him; I hid My face and was angry, And he went on turning away, in the way of his heart.
verses.textEn: I was enraged by their sinful greed; I punished them, and hid my face in anger, yet they kept on in their willful ways.

verses.textZh: 他的道路，我看见了， 我却要医治他，引导他，把安慰赏赐他和他的哀悼者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的道路，我看见了， 我却要医治他，引导他，把安慰赏赐他和他的哀悼者。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见他所行的道，也要医治他； 又要引导他， 使他和那一同伤心的人再得安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: I have seen their ways, but I will heal them; I will guide them and restore comfort to Israel’s mourners,
verses.textEnEsv: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
verses.textEnNkjv: I have seen his ways, and will heal him; I will also lead him, And restore comforts to him And to his mourners.
verses.textEnNlt: I have seen what they do, but I will heal them anyway! I will lead them. I will comfort those who mourn,
verses.textEnNasb: "I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and to his mourners,
verses.textEn: I have seen their ways, but I will heal them; I will guide them and restore comfort to Israel’s mourners,

verses.textZh: 我创造嘴唇的果子： 平安，平安，归给远处的人，也归给近处的人。" 耶和华说："我要医治他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我创造嘴唇的果子： 平安，平安，归给远处的人，也归给近处的人。" 耶和华说："我要医治他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我造就嘴唇的果子； 愿平安康泰归与远处的人， 也归与近处的人； 并且我要医治他。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: creating praise on their lips. Peace, peace, to those far and near," says the Lord . "And I will heal them."
verses.textEnEsv: creating the fruit of the lips. Peace, peace, to the far and to the near," says the Lord , "and I will heal him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to himwhois far off and to himwhois near," Says the Lord, "And I will heal him."
verses.textEnNlt: bringing words of praise to their lips. May they have abundant peace, both near and far," says the Lord , who heals them.
verses.textEnNasb: Creating the praise of the lips. Peace, peace to him who is far away and to him who is near," Says the Lord, "and I will heal him."
verses.textEn: creating praise on their lips. Peace, peace, to those far and near," says the Lord . "And I will heal them."

verses.textZh: 恶人却像翻腾的海， 不能平静， 海中的水不住翻起污秽和淤泥来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人却像翻腾的海， 不能平静， 海中的水不住翻起污秽和淤泥来。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独恶人，好像翻腾的海， 不得平静； 其中的水常涌出污秽和淤泥来。
verses.textEnNiv: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest, whose waves cast up mire and mud.
verses.textEnEsv: But the wicked are like the tossing sea; for it cannot be quiet, and its waters toss up mire and dirt.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, When it cannot rest, Whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.textEnNlt: "But those who still reject me are like the restless sea, which is never still but continually churns up mud and dirt.
verses.textEnNasb: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, For it cannot be quiet, And its waters toss up refuse and mud.
verses.textEn: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest, whose waves cast up mire and mud.

verses.textZh: 我的神说："恶人必没有平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神说："恶人必没有平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神说：恶人必不得平安！
verses.textEnNiv: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."
verses.textEnEsv: There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."
verses.textEnNkjv: "There is no peace," Says my God, "for the wicked."
verses.textEnNlt: There is no peace for the wicked," says my God.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."
verses.textEn: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."

verses.textZh: 你要张开喉咙呼叫，不可停止； 你要提高声音，像吹号角一样； 你要向我子民宣告他们的过犯， 向雅各家陈明他们的罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要张开喉咙呼叫，不可停止； 你要提高声音，像吹号角一样； 你要向我子民宣告他们的过犯， 向雅各家陈明他们的罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要大声喊叫，不可止息； 扬起声来，好像吹角。 向我百姓说明他们的过犯； 向雅各家说明他们的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the descendants of Jacob their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: "Cry aloud; do not hold back; lift up your voice like a trumpet; declare to my people their transgression, to the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Cry aloud, spare not; Lift up your voice like a trumpet; Tell My people their transgression, And the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.textEnNlt: "Shout with the voice of a trumpet blast. Shout aloud! Don’t be timid. Tell my people Israel of their sins!
verses.textEnNasb: "Cry loudly, do not hold back; Raise your voice like a trumpet, And declare to My people their wrongdoing, And to the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.textEn: "Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the descendants of Jacob their sins.

verses.textZh: 他们天天寻求我，乐意明白我的道路， 好象行义的国民， 不离弃他们神的公理； 他们向我求问公义的判语， 又喜欢亲近神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们天天寻求我，乐意明白我的道路， 好象行义的国民， 不离弃他们神的公理； 他们向我求问公义的判语， 又喜欢亲近神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们天天寻求我， 乐意明白我的道， 好像行义的国民， 不离弃他们神的典章， 向我求问公义的判语， 喜悦亲近神。
verses.textEnNiv: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they seek me daily and delight to know my ways, as if they were a nation that did righteousness and did not forsake the judgment of their God; they ask of me righteous judgments; they delight to draw near to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they seek Me daily, And delight to know My ways, As a nation that did righteousness, And did not forsake the ordinance of their God. They ask of Me the ordinances of justice; They take delight in approaching God.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet they act so pious! They come to the Temple every day and seem delighted to learn all about me. They act like a righteous nation that would never abandon the laws of its God. They ask me to take action on their behalf, pretending they want to be near me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet they seek Me day by day and delight to know My ways, As a nation that has done righteousness And has not forsaken the ordinance of their God. They ask Me for just decisions, They delight in the nearness of God.
verses.textEn: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.

verses.textZh: 他们说："为甚么我们禁食，你不看呢？ 为甚么我们刻苦己身，你不理会呢？" 看哪！你们在禁食的日子，仍然追求自己喜欢作的事， 欺压为你们作工的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："为甚么我们禁食，你不看呢？ 为甚么我们刻苦己身，你不理会呢？" 看哪！你们在禁食的日子，仍然追求自己喜欢作的事， 欺压为你们作工的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：我们禁食，你为何不看见呢？ 我们刻苦己心，你为何不理会呢？ 看哪，你们禁食的日子仍求利益， 勒逼人为你们做苦工。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?’ "Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please and exploit all your workers.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Why have we fasted, and you see it not? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you take no knowledge of it?’ Behold, in the day of your fast you seek your own pleasure, and oppress all your workers.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Why have we fasted,’ theysay, ‘and You have not seen? Why have we afflicted our souls, and You take no notice?’ "In fact, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, And exploit all your laborers.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘We have fasted before you!’ they say. ‘Why aren’t you impressed? We have been very hard on ourselves, and you don’t even notice it!’ "I will tell you why!" I respond. "It’s because you are fasting to please yourselves. Even while you fast, you keep oppressing your workers.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Why have we fasted and You do not see? Why have we humbled ourselves and You do not notice?’ Behold, on the day of your fast you find your desire, And oppress all your workers.
verses.textEn: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?’ "Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please and exploit all your workers.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你们禁食，结果是吵闹和打架，用凶恶的拳头打人； 你们不要像今天这样的禁食，使你们的声音可以听闻于天上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你们禁食，结果是吵闹和打架，用凶恶的拳头打人； 你们不要像今天这样的禁食，使你们的声音可以听闻于天上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们禁食，却互相争竞， 以凶恶的拳头打人。 你们今日禁食， 不得使你们的声音听闻于上。
verses.textEnNiv: Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife, and in striking each other with wicked fists. You cannot fast as you do today and expect your voice to be heard on high.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you fast only to quarrel and to fight and to hit with a wicked fist. Fasting like yours this day will not make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed you fast for strife and debate, And to strike with the fist of wickedness. You will not fast as youdo this day, To make your voice heard on high.
verses.textEnNlt: What good is fasting when you keep on fighting and quarreling? This kind of fasting will never get you anywhere with me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, you fast for contention and strife, and to strike with a wicked fist. You do not fast like you have done today to make your voice heard on high!
verses.textEn: Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife, and in striking each other with wicked fists. You cannot fast as you do today and expect your voice to be heard on high.

verses.textZh: 使人刻苦自己的日子，这样的禁食是我拣选的吗？ 难道只是叫人垂头像一根苇子， 用麻布和炉灰铺在下面吗？ 你可以称这是禁食，为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 使人刻苦自己的日子，这样的禁食是我拣选的吗？ 难道只是叫人垂头像一根苇子， 用麻布和炉灰铺在下面吗？ 你可以称这是禁食，为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？
