verses.textZhCuv: 这样禁食岂是我所拣选、 使人刻苦己心的日子吗？ 岂是叫人垂头像苇子， 用麻布和炉灰铺在他以下吗？ 你这可称为禁食、为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for people to humble themselves? Is it only for bowing one’s head like a reed and for lying in sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the Lord ?
verses.textEnEsv: Is such the fast that I choose, a day for a person to humble himself? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? Will you call this a fast, and a day acceptable to the Lord ?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is it a fast that I have chosen, A day for a man to afflict his soul? Isit to bow down his head like a bulrush, And to spread out sackcloth and ashes? Would you call this a fast, And an acceptable day to the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: You humble yourselves by going through the motions of penance, bowing your heads like reeds bending in the wind. You dress in burlap and cover yourselves with ashes. Is this what you call fasting? Do you really think this will please the Lord ?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it a fast like this that I choose, a day for a person to humble himself? Is it for bowing one’s head like a reed And for spreading out sackcloth and ashes as a bed? Will you call this a fast, even an acceptable day to the Lord?
verses.textEn: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for people to humble themselves? Is it only for bowing one’s head like a reed and for lying in sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the Lord ?

verses.textZh: 我所拣选的禁食不是这样吗？ 不是要松开凶恶的锁炼， 解开轭上的绳索， 使被压迫的获得自由， 折断所有的轭吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所拣选的禁食不是这样吗？ 不是要松开凶恶的锁炼， 解开轭上的绳索， 使被压迫的获得自由， 折断所有的轭吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我所拣选的禁食不是要松开凶恶的绳， 解下轭上的索， 使被欺压的得自由， 折断一切的轭吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and break every yoke?
verses.textEnEsv: "Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every yoke?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is this not the fast that I have chosen: To loose the bonds of wickedness, To undo the heavy burdens, To let the oppressed go free, And that you break every yoke?
verses.textEnNlt: "No, this is the kind of fasting I want: Free those who are wrongly imprisoned; lighten the burden of those who work for you. Let the oppressed go free, and remove the chains that bind people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is this not the fast that I choose: To release the bonds of wickedness, To undo the ropes of the yoke, And to let the oppressed go free, And break every yoke?
verses.textEn: "Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and break every yoke?

verses.textZh: 不是要把你的食物分给饥饿的人， 把流浪的穷困人接到你的家里， 见到赤身露体的，给他衣服蔽体， 不可逃避自己的骨肉而不顾恤吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是要把你的食物分给饥饿的人， 把流浪的穷困人接到你的家里， 见到赤身露体的，给他衣服蔽体， 不可逃避自己的骨肉而不顾恤吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人， 将飘流的穷人接到你家中， 见赤身的给他衣服遮体， 顾恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter— when you see the naked, to clothe them, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it not to share your bread with the hungry and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover him, and not to hide yourself from your own flesh?
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit not to share your bread with the hungry, And that you bring to your house the poor who are cast out; When you see the naked, that you cover him, And not hide yourself from your own flesh?
verses.textEnNlt: Share your food with the hungry, and give shelter to the homeless. Give clothes to those who need them, and do not hide from relatives who need your help.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it not to break your bread with the hungry And bring the homeless poor into the house; When you see the naked, to cover him; And not to hide yourself from your own flesh?
verses.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter— when you see the naked, to clothe them, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?

verses.textZh: 这样，你的光就必突然发出，像黎明的曙光， 你的伤口就必快快复原； 你的公义就必行在你的前面， 耶和华的荣耀要作你的后盾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你的光就必突然发出，像黎明的曙光， 你的伤口就必快快复原； 你的公义就必行在你的前面， 耶和华的荣耀要作你的后盾。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你的光就必发现如早晨的光； 你所得的医治要速速发明。 你的公义必在你前面行； 耶和华的荣光必作你的后盾。
verses.textEnNiv: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the Lord will be your rear guard.
verses.textEnEsv: Then shall your light break forth like the dawn, and your healing shall spring up speedily; your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of the Lord shall be your rear guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then your light shall break forth like the morning, Your healing shall spring forth speedily, And your righteousness shall go before you; The glory of the Lord shall be your rear guard.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then your salvation will come like the dawn, and your wounds will quickly heal. Your godliness will lead you forward, and the glory of the Lord will protect you from behind.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then your light will break out like the dawn, And your recovery will spring up quickly; And your righteousness will go before you; The glory of the Lord will be your rear guard.
verses.textEn: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the Lord will be your rear guard.

verses.textZh: 那时，你求告，耶和华必应允； 你呼求，他必说："我在这里！" 你若从你中间除掉欺压人的轭， 除去指责人的指头和恶毒的言语，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你求告，耶和华必应允； 你呼求，他必说："我在这里！" 你若从你中间除掉欺压人的轭， 除去指责人的指头和恶毒的言语，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时你求告，耶和华必应允； 你呼求，他必说：我在这里。 你若从你中间除掉重轭 和指摘人的指头，并发恶言的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will call, and the Lord will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I. "If you do away with the yoke of oppression, with the pointing finger and malicious talk,
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall call, and the Lord will answer; you shall cry, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you take away the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger, and speaking wickedness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall call, and the Lord will answer; You shall cry, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ "If you take away the yoke from your midst, The pointing of the finger, and speaking wickedness,
verses.textEnNlt: Then when you call, the Lord will answer. ‘Yes, I am here,’ he will quickly reply. "Remove the heavy yoke of oppression. Stop pointing your finger and spreading vicious rumors!
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you will call, and the Lord will answer; You will cry for help, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, The pointing of the finger and speaking wickedness,
verses.textEn: Then you will call, and the Lord will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I. "If you do away with the yoke of oppression, with the pointing finger and malicious talk,

verses.textZh: 你的心若顾念饥饿的人， 使困苦的人得到饱足， 你的光就必在黑暗中升起来， 你的幽暗必变得如正午。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的心若顾念饥饿的人， 使困苦的人得到饱足， 你的光就必在黑暗中升起来， 你的幽暗必变得如正午。
verses.textZhCuv: 你心若向饥饿的人发怜悯， 使困苦的人得满足， 你的光就必在黑暗中发现； 你的幽暗必变如正午。
verses.textEnNiv: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.
verses.textEnEsv: if you pour yourself out for the hungry and satisfy the desire of the afflicted, then shall your light rise in the darkness and your gloom be as the noonday.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you extend your soul to the hungry And satisfy the afflicted soul, Then your light shall dawn in the darkness, And your darkness shall be as the noonday.
verses.textEnNlt: Feed the hungry, and help those in trouble. Then your light will shine out from the darkness, and the darkness around you will be as bright as noon.
verses.textEnNasb: And if you offer yourself to the hungry And satisfy the need of the afflicted, Then your light will rise in darkness, And your gloom will become like midday.
verses.textEn: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必常常引导你， 在干旱之地使你的心灵饱足， 使你的骨头坚强有力； 你必像有水源浇灌的园子， 又像水流不绝的泉源。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必常常引导你， 在干旱之地使你的心灵饱足， 使你的骨头坚强有力； 你必像有水源浇灌的园子， 又像水流不绝的泉源。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华也必时常引导你， 在干旱之地使你心满意足， 骨头强壮。 你必像浇灌的园子， 又像水流不绝的泉源。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will guide you continually and satisfy your desire in scorched places and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered garden, like a spring of water, whose waters do not fail.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will guide you continually, And satisfy your soul in drought, And strengthen your bones; You shall be like a watered garden, And like a spring of water, whose waters do not fail.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will guide you continually, giving you water when you are dry and restoring your strength. You will be like a well-watered garden, like an ever-flowing spring.
verses.textEnNasb: "And the Lord will continually guide you, And satisfy your desire in scorched places, And give strength to your bones; And you will be like a watered garden, And like a spring of water whose waters do not fail.
verses.textEn: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.

verses.textZh: 你的子孙必重建久已荒废之处， 你必重建历代拆毁了的根基； 你要称为修补破口的人， 重修路径给人居住的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的子孙必重建久已荒废之处， 你必重建历代拆毁了的根基； 你要称为修补破口的人， 重修路径给人居住的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些出于你的人必修造久已荒废之处； 你要建立拆毁累代的根基。 你必称为补破口的， 和重修路径与人居住的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.
verses.textEnEsv: And your ancient ruins shall be rebuilt; you shall raise up the foundations of many generations; you shall be called the repairer of the breach, the restorer of streets to dwell in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those from among you Shall build the old waste places; You shall raise up the foundations of many generations; And you shall be called the Repairer of the Breach, The Restorer of Streets to Dwell In.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of you will rebuild the deserted ruins of your cities. Then you will be known as a rebuilder of walls and a restorer of homes.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those from among you will rebuild the ancient ruins; You will raise up the age-old foundations; And you will be called the repairer of the breach, The restorer of the streets in which to dwell.
verses.textEn: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.

verses.textZh: "因安息日的缘故，你若转离你的脚步； 在我的圣日不作你喜欢作的； 你若称安息日为可喜乐的， 称耶和华的圣日为可尊重的； 你若尊重这日，不作自己的事， 不寻求自己所喜悦的，或不说无谓的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: "因安息日的缘故，你若转离你的脚步； 在我的圣日不作你喜欢作的； 你若称安息日为可喜乐的， 称耶和华的圣日为可尊重的； 你若尊重这日，不作自己的事， 不寻求自己所喜悦的，或不说无谓的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 你若在安息日掉转 你的脚步， 在我圣日不以操作为喜乐， 称安息日为可喜乐的， 称耶和华的圣日为可尊重的； 而且尊敬这日， 不办自己的私事， 不随自己的私意， 不说自己的私话，
verses.textEnNiv: "If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath and from doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the Lord ’s holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,
verses.textEnEsv: "If you turn back your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight and the holy day of the Lord honorable; if you honor it, not going your own ways, or seeking your own pleasure, or talking idly;
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, From doing your pleasure on My holy day, And call the Sabbath a delight, The holy day of the Lord honorable, And shall honor Him, not doing your own ways, Nor finding your own pleasure, Nor speaking yourown words,
verses.textEnNlt: "Keep the Sabbath day holy. Don’t pursue your own interests on that day, but enjoy the Sabbath and speak of it with delight as the Lord ’s holy day. Honor the Sabbath in everything you do on that day, and don’t follow your own desires or talk idly.
verses.textEnNasb: "If, because of the Sabbath, you restrain your foot From doing as you wish on My holy day, And call the Sabbath a pleasure, and the holy day of the Lord honorable, And honor it, desisting from your own ways, From seeking your own pleasure And speaking your own word,
verses.textEn: "If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath and from doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the Lord ’s holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,

verses.textZh: 你就必以耶和华为乐， 我要使你乘驾地的高处， 用你祖雅各的产业喂养你。" 这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就必以耶和华为乐， 我要使你乘驾地的高处， 用你祖雅各的产业喂养你。" 这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就以耶和华为乐。 耶和华要使你乘驾地的高处， 又以你祖雅各的产业养育你。 这是耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textEnNiv: then you will find your joy in the Lord , and I will cause you to ride in triumph on the heights of the land and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob." The mouth of the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall take delight in the Lord , and I will make you ride on the heights of the earth; I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father, for the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall delight yourself in the Lord; And I will cause you to ride on the high hills of the earth, And feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father. The mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will be your delight. I will give you great honor and satisfy you with the inheritance I promised to your ancestor Jacob. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will take delight in the Lord, And I will make you ride on the heights of the earth; And I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father, For the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEn: then you will find your joy in the Lord , and I will cause you to ride in triumph on the heights of the land and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob." The mouth of the Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华的手不是缩短了， 以致不能拯救； 他的耳朵不是不灵， 不能听见；
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华的手不是缩短了， 以致不能拯救； 他的耳朵不是不灵， 不能听见；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的膀臂并非缩短，不能拯救， 耳朵并非发沉，不能听见，
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the arm of the Lord is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord ’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, or his ear dull, that it cannot hear;
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, That it cannot save; Nor His ear heavy, That it cannot hear.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! The Lord ’s arm is not too weak to save you, nor is his ear too deaf to hear you call.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord’s hand is not so short That it cannot save; Nor is His ear so dull That it cannot hear.
verses.textEn: Surely the arm of the Lord is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear.

verses.textZh: 而是你们的罪孽使你们与你们的神隔绝； 你们的罪恶使他掩面不顾你们，不听你们的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而是你们的罪孽使你们与你们的神隔绝； 你们的罪恶使他掩面不顾你们，不听你们的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们的罪孽使你们与神隔绝； 你们的罪恶使他掩面不听你们。
verses.textEnNiv: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
verses.textEnEsv: but your iniquities have made a separation between you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you so that he does not hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; And your sins have hidden His face from you, So that He will not hear.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s your sins that have cut you off from God. Because of your sins, he has turned away and will not listen anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: But your wrongdoings have caused a separation between you and your God, And your sins have hidden His face from you so that He does not hear.
verses.textEn: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

verses.textZh: 因为你们的手沾满了血， 你们的指头被罪孽玷污， 你们的嘴唇说虚谎的话， 你们的舌头讲出凶言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们的手沾满了血， 你们的指头被罪孽玷污， 你们的嘴唇说虚谎的话， 你们的舌头讲出凶言。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你们的手被血沾染， 你们的指头被罪孽沾污， 你们的嘴唇说谎言， 你们的舌头出恶语。
verses.textEnNiv: For your hands are stained with blood, your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken falsely, and your tongue mutters wicked things.
verses.textEnEsv: For your hands are defiled with blood and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies; your tongue mutters wickedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For your hands are defiled with blood, And your fingers with iniquity; Your lips have spoken lies, Your tongue has muttered perversity.
verses.textEnNlt: Your hands are the hands of murderers, and your fingers are filthy with sin. Your lips are full of lies, and your mouth spews corruption.
verses.textEnNasb: For your hands are defiled with blood, And your fingers with wrongdoing; Your lips have spoken deceit, Your tongue mutters wickedness.
verses.textEn: For your hands are stained with blood, your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken falsely, and your tongue mutters wicked things.

verses.textZh: 没有人按公义求告，没有人凭诚实争辩； 他们都倚靠虚无，说虚谎的话； 所怀的是毒害，所生的是罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人按公义求告，没有人凭诚实争辩； 他们都倚靠虚无，说虚谎的话； 所怀的是毒害，所生的是罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 无一人按公义告状， 无一人凭诚实辨白； 都倚靠虚妄，说谎言。 所怀的是毒害； 所生的是罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: No one calls for justice; no one pleads a case with integrity. They rely on empty arguments, they utter lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.
verses.textEnEsv: No one enters suit justly; no one goes to law honestly; they rely on empty pleas, they speak lies, they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one calls for justice, Nor does any plead for truth. They trust in empty words and speak lies; They conceive evil and bring forth iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: No one cares about being fair and honest. The people’s lawsuits are based on lies. They conceive evil deeds and then give birth to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: No one sues righteously and no one pleads honestly. They trust in confusion and speak lies; They conceive trouble and give birth to disaster.
verses.textEn: No one calls for justice; no one pleads a case with integrity. They rely on empty arguments, they utter lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.

verses.textZh: 他们所孵化的是毒蛇的蛋，他们所结的是蜘蛛的网， 吃了牠们的蛋，就一定死； 蛋破了，就孵出蝮蛇来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所孵化的是毒蛇的蛋，他们所结的是蜘蛛的网， 吃了牠们的蛋，就一定死； 蛋破了，就孵出蝮蛇来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们抱毒蛇蛋， 结蜘蛛网； 人吃这蛋必死。 这蛋被踏，必出蝮蛇。
verses.textEnNiv: They hatch the eggs of vipers and spin a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die, and when one is broken, an adder is hatched.
verses.textEnEsv: They hatch adders’ eggs; they weave the spider’s web; he who eats their eggs dies, and from one that is crushed a viper is hatched.
verses.textEnNkjv: They hatch vipers’ eggs and weave the spider’s web; He who eats of their eggs dies, And from that which is crushed a viper breaks out.
verses.textEnNlt: They hatch deadly snakes and weave spiders’ webs. Whoever eats their eggs will die; whoever cracks them will hatch a viper.
verses.textEnNasb: They hatch vipers’ eggs and weave the spider’s web; The one who eats of their eggs dies, And from what is crushed, a snake breaks out.
verses.textEn: They hatch the eggs of vipers and spin a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die, and when one is broken, an adder is hatched.

verses.textZh: 他们的网，不能作衣服， 他们所作的，也不能遮盖自己； 他们所作的是罪孽的作为， 他们的手里满是强暴的行为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的网，不能作衣服， 他们所作的，也不能遮盖自己； 他们所作的是罪孽的作为， 他们的手里满是强暴的行为。
verses.textZhCuv: 所结的网不能成为衣服； 所做的也不能遮盖自己。 他们的行为都是罪孽； 手所做的都是强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: Their cobwebs are useless for clothing; they cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their deeds are evil deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Their webs will not serve as clothing; men will not cover themselves with what they make. Their works are works of iniquity, and deeds of violence are in their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their webs will not become garments, Nor will they cover themselves with their works; Their works are works of iniquity, And the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Their webs can’t be made into clothing, and nothing they do is productive. All their activity is filled with sin, and violence is their trademark.
verses.textEnNasb: Their webs will not become clothing, Nor will they cover themselves with their works; Their works are works of wrongdoing, And an act of violence is in their hands.
verses.textEn: Their cobwebs are useless for clothing; they cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their deeds are evil deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.

verses.textZh: 他们的脚奔跑行恶， 他们急于流无辜人的血； 他们的思想都是邪恶的思想， 他们的行径全是破坏和毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的脚奔跑行恶， 他们急于流无辜人的血； 他们的思想都是邪恶的思想， 他们的行径全是破坏和毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的脚奔跑行恶； 他们急速流无辜人的血； 意念都是罪孽， 所经过的路都荒凉毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Their feet rush into sin; they are swift to shed innocent blood. They pursue evil schemes; acts of violence mark their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their highways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed innocent blood; Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; Wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.textEnNlt: Their feet run to do evil, and they rush to commit murder. They think only about sinning. Misery and destruction always follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: Their feet run to evil, And they hurry to shed innocent blood; Their thoughts are thoughts of wrongdoing, Devastation and destruction are in their paths.
verses.textEn: Their feet rush into sin; they are swift to shed innocent blood. They pursue evil schemes; acts of violence mark their ways.

verses.textZh: 平安的路，他们不认识， 在他们的行径中没有公平； 他们为自己使道路弯曲， 行在其上的，都不认识平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 平安的路，他们不认识， 在他们的行径中没有公平； 他们为自己使道路弯曲， 行在其上的，都不认识平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 平安的路，他们不知道； 所行的事没有公平。 他们为自己修弯曲的路； 凡行此路的都不知道平安。
verses.textEnNiv: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have turned them into crooked roads; no one who walks along them will know peace.
verses.textEnEsv: The way of peace they do not know, and there is no justice in their paths; they have made their roads crooked; no one who treads on them knows peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: The way of peace they have not known, And thereis no justice in their ways; They have made themselves crooked paths; Whoever takes that way shall not know peace.
verses.textEnNlt: They don’t know where to find peace or what it means to be just and good. They have mapped out crooked roads, and no one who follows them knows a moment’s peace.
verses.textEnNasb: They do not know the way of peace, And there is no justice in their tracks; They have made their paths crooked, Whoever walks on them does not know peace.
verses.textEn: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have turned them into crooked roads; no one who walks along them will know peace.

verses.textZh: 因此，公平远离我们， 公义赶不上我们， 我们指望亮光，不料，却是黑暗。 我们指望光明，却行在幽暗中！
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，公平远离我们， 公义赶不上我们， 我们指望亮光，不料，却是黑暗。 我们指望光明，却行在幽暗中！
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，公平离我们远， 公义追不上我们。 我们指望光亮，却是黑暗， 指望光明，却行幽暗。
verses.textEnNiv: So justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but all is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not overtake us; we hope for light, and behold, darkness, and for brightness, but we walk in gloom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore justice is far from us, Nor does righteousness overtake us; We look for light, but there is darkness! For brightness, but we walk in blackness!
verses.textEnNlt: So there is no justice among us, and we know nothing about right living. We look for light but find only darkness. We look for bright skies but walk in gloom.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore justice is far from us, And righteousness does not reach us; We hope for light, but there is darkness, For brightness, but we walk in gloom.
verses.textEn: So justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but all is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.

verses.textZh: 我们摸索墙壁，好象瞎子一样； 我们摸索，如同没有眼睛的人一般； 我们在中午跌倒，有如在黄昏跌倒一样； 我们在肥壮的人中，好象死人一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们摸索墙壁，好象瞎子一样； 我们摸索，如同没有眼睛的人一般； 我们在中午跌倒，有如在黄昏跌倒一样； 我们在肥壮的人中，好象死人一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们摸索墙壁，好像瞎子； 我们摸索，如同无目之人。 我们晌午绊脚，如在黄昏一样； 我们在肥壮人中，像死人一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Like the blind we grope along the wall, feeling our way like people without eyes. At midday we stumble as if it were twilight; among the strong, we are like the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: We grope for the wall like the blind; we grope like those who have no eyes; we stumble at noon as in the twilight, among those in full vigor we are like dead men.
verses.textEnNkjv: We grope for the wall like the blind, And we grope as if wehad no eyes; We stumble at noonday as at twilight; Weare as dead men in desolate places.
verses.textEnNlt: We grope like the blind along a wall, feeling our way like people without eyes. Even at brightest noontime, we stumble as though it were dark. Among the living, we are like the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: We grope for the wall like people who are blind, We grope like those who have no eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; Among those who are healthy we are like the dead.
verses.textEn: Like the blind we grope along the wall, feeling our way like people without eyes. At midday we stumble as if it were twilight; among the strong, we are like the dead.

verses.textZh: 我们都咆哮如熊， 悲鸣像鸽子； 我们等候公平，却没有公平； 指望拯救，拯救却离我们很远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们都咆哮如熊， 悲鸣像鸽子； 我们等候公平，却没有公平； 指望拯救，拯救却离我们很远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们咆哮如熊， 哀鸣如鸽； 指望公平，却是没有； 指望救恩，却远离我们。
verses.textEnNiv: We all growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but find none; for deliverance, but it is far away.
verses.textEnEsv: We all growl like bears; we moan and moan like doves; we hope for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far from us.
verses.textEnNkjv: We all growl like bears, And moan sadly like doves; We look for justice, but thereis none; For salvation, but it is far from us.
verses.textEnNlt: We growl like hungry bears; we moan like mournful doves. We look for justice, but it never comes. We look for rescue, but it is far away from us.
verses.textEnNasb: All of us growl like bears, And moan sadly like doves; We hope for justice, but there is none; For salvation, but it is far from us.
verses.textEn: We all growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but find none; for deliverance, but it is far away.

verses.textZh: 因为我们的过犯在你面前增多， 我们的罪作证控告我们， 我们的过犯与我们在一起； 我们知道我们的罪孽，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们的过犯在你面前增多， 我们的罪作证控告我们， 我们的过犯与我们在一起； 我们知道我们的罪孽，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的过犯在你面前增多， 罪恶作见证告我们； 过犯与我们同在。 至于我们的罪孽，我们都知道：
verses.textEnNiv: For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities:
verses.textEnEsv: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and we know our iniquities:
verses.textEnNkjv: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, And our sins testify against us; For our transgressions are with us, And asfor our iniquities, we know them:
verses.textEnNlt: For our sins are piled up before God and testify against us. Yes, we know what sinners we are.
verses.textEnNasb: For our wrongful acts have multiplied before You, And our sins have testified against us; For our wrongful acts are with us, And we know our wrongdoings:
verses.textEn: For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities:

verses.textZh: 就是悖逆、否认耶和华， 转去不跟从我们的神， 说欺压和背道的话， 心里怀着谎言，随即说出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是悖逆、否认耶和华， 转去不跟从我们的神， 说欺压和背道的话， 心里怀着谎言，随即说出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是悖逆、不认识耶和华， 转去不跟从我们的神， 说欺压和叛逆的话， 心怀谎言，随即说出。
verses.textEnNiv: rebellion and treachery against the Lord , turning our backs on our God, inciting revolt and oppression, uttering lies our hearts have conceived.
verses.textEnEsv: transgressing, and denying the Lord , and turning back from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart lying words.
verses.textEnNkjv: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, And departing from our God, Speaking oppression and revolt, Conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.textEnNlt: We know we have rebelled and have denied the Lord . We have turned our backs on our God. We know how unfair and oppressive we have been, carefully planning our deceitful lies.
verses.textEnNasb: Offending and denying the Lord, And turning away from our God, Speaking oppression and revolt, Conceiving and uttering lying words from the heart.
verses.textEn: rebellion and treachery against the Lord , turning our backs on our God, inciting revolt and oppression, uttering lies our hearts have conceived.

verses.textZh: 公平被迫后退， 公义站在远处； 诚实在街上跌倒， 正直不能进入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公平被迫后退， 公义站在远处； 诚实在街上跌倒， 正直不能进入。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且公平转而退后， 公义站在远处； 诚实在街上仆倒， 正直也不得进入。
verses.textEnNiv: So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter.
verses.textEnEsv: Justice is turned back, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has stumbled in the public squares, and uprightness cannot enter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Justice is turned back, And righteousness stands afar off; For truth is fallen in the street, And equity cannot enter.
verses.textEnNlt: Our courts oppose the righteous, and justice is nowhere to be found. Truth stumbles in the streets, and honesty has been outlawed.
verses.textEnNasb: Justice is turned back, And righteousness stands far away; For truth has stumbled in the street, And uprightness cannot enter.
verses.textEn: So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter.

verses.textZh: 诚实缺乏， 远离恶事的人反成为掠物。 耶和华看见了， 就看这为恶事 ，因为一点公平也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诚实缺乏， 远离恶事的人反成为掠物。 耶和华看见了， 就看这为恶事 ，因为一点公平也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 诚实少见； 离恶的人反成掠物。 那时，耶和华看见没有公平， 甚不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The Lord looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Truth is lacking, and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: So truth fails, And he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Then the Lord saw it, and it displeased Him That therewas no justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, truth is gone, and anyone who renounces evil is attacked. The Lord looked and was displeased to find there was no justice.
verses.textEnNasb: Truth is lacking, And one who turns aside from evil makes himself a prey. Now the Lord saw, And it was displeasing in His sight that there was no justice.
verses.textEn: Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The Lord looked and was displeased that there was no justice.

verses.textZh: 他见无人行善， 无人代求，就非常诧异， 所以他用自己的膀臂为他施行拯救， 以自己的公义扶持他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他见无人行善， 无人代求，就非常诧异， 所以他用自己的膀臂为他施行拯救， 以自己的公义扶持他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他见无人拯救， 无人代求，甚为诧异， 就用自己的膀臂施行拯救， 以公义扶持自己。
verses.textEnNiv: He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene; so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.
verses.textEnEsv: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no one to intercede; then his own arm brought him salvation, and his righteousness upheld him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He saw that therewas no man, And wondered that therewas no intercessor; Therefore His own arm brought salvation for Him; And His own righteousness, it sustained Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He was amazed to see that no one intervened to help the oppressed. So he himself stepped in to save them with his strong arm, and his justice sustained him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He saw that there was no one, And was amazed that there was not one to intercede; Then His own arm brought salvation to Him, And His righteousness upheld Him.
verses.textEn: He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene; so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.

verses.textZh: 他穿上公义的铠甲， 戴上救恩的头盔， 穿上复仇的衣服， 披上热心作外袍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他穿上公义的铠甲， 戴上救恩的头盔， 穿上复仇的衣服， 披上热心作外袍。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以公义为铠甲 ， 以拯救为头盔， 以报仇为衣服， 以热心为外袍。
verses.textEnNiv: He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.
verses.textEnEsv: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head; he put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and wrapped himself in zeal as a cloak.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He put on righteousness as a breastplate, And a helmet of salvation on His head; He put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, And was clad with zeal as a cloak.
verses.textEnNlt: He put on righteousness as his body armor and placed the helmet of salvation on his head. He clothed himself with a robe of vengeance and wrapped himself in a cloak of divine passion.
verses.textEnNasb: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, And a helmet of salvation on His head; And He put on garments of vengeance for clothing And wrapped Himself with zeal as a cloak.
verses.textEn: He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.

verses.textZh: 他要按照各人的行为施行报应， 把烈怒降与他的敌人，把报应加给他的仇敌， 向众海岛的人施行报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要按照各人的行为施行报应， 把烈怒降与他的敌人，把报应加给他的仇敌， 向众海岛的人施行报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必按人的行为施报， 恼怒他的敌人， 报复他的仇敌 向众海岛施行报应。
verses.textEnNiv: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.
verses.textEnEsv: According to their deeds, so will he repay, wrath to his adversaries, repayment to his enemies; to the coastlands he will render repayment.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to their deeds, accordingly He will repay, Fury to His adversaries, Recompense to His enemies; The coastlands He will fully repay.
verses.textEnNlt: He will repay his enemies for their evil deeds. His fury will fall on his foes. He will pay them back even to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: According to their deeds, so will He repay: Wrath to His adversaries, retribution to His enemies; To the coastlands He will deal retribution.
verses.textEn: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.

verses.textZh: 这样，人从日落之处必敬畏耶和华的名， 从日出之地也必敬畏他的荣耀， 因为他必像狭急的河流冲来， 耶和华的气必向他催逼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，人从日落之处必敬畏耶和华的名， 从日出之地也必敬畏他的荣耀， 因为他必像狭急的河流冲来， 耶和华的气必向他催逼。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此，人从日落之处必敬畏耶和华的名， 从日出之地也必敬畏他的荣耀； 因为仇敌好像急流的河水冲来， 是耶和华之气所驱逐的。
verses.textEnNiv: From the west, people will fear the name of the Lord , and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory. For he will come like a pent-up flood that the breath of the Lord drives along.
verses.textEnEsv: So they shall fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come like a rushing stream, which the wind of the Lord drives.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall they fear The name of the Lord from the west, And His glory from the rising of the sun; When the enemy comes in like a flood, The Spirit of the Lord will lift up a standard against him.
verses.textEnNlt: In the west, people will respect the name of the Lord ; in the east, they will glorify him. For he will come like a raging flood tide driven by the breath of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So they will fear the name of the Lord from the west And His glory from the rising of the sun, For He will come like a rushing stream Which the wind of the Lord drives.
verses.textEn: From the west, people will fear the name of the Lord , and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory. For he will come like a pent-up flood that the breath of the Lord drives along.

verses.textZh: "必有一位救赎主来到锡安， 来到雅各家中那些转离过犯的人那里。"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "必有一位救赎主来到锡安， 来到雅各家中那些转离过犯的人那里。"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有一位救赎主来到锡安－ 雅各族中转离过犯的人那里。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "And a Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Redeemer will come to Zion, And to those who turn from transgression in Jacob," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Redeemer will come to Jerusalem to buy back those in Israel who have turned from their sins," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "A Redeemer will come to Zion, And to those in Jacob who turn from wrongdoing," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："至于我，我与他们所立的约是这样：我加在你们身上的灵和我放在你口里的话，必不离开你的口，不离开你后裔的口，也不离开你后裔的后裔的口，从现在直到永远；这是耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："至于我，我与他们所立的约是这样：我加在你们身上的灵和我放在你口里的话，必不离开你的口，不离开你后裔的口，也不离开你后裔的后裔的口，从现在直到永远；这是耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「至于我与他们所立的约乃是这样：我加给你的灵，传给你的话，必不离你的口，也不离你后裔与你后裔之后裔的口，从今直到永远；这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "As for me, this is my covenant with them," says the Lord . "My Spirit, who is on you, will not depart from you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will always be on your lips, on the lips of your children and on the lips of their descendants—from this time on and forever," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "And as for me, this is my covenant with them," says the Lord : "My Spirit that is upon you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, or out of the mouth of your offspring, or out of the mouth of your children’s offspring," says the Lord , "from this time forth and forevermore."
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for Me," says the Lord, "this is My covenant with them: My Spirit who is upon you, and My words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your descendants, nor from the mouth of your descendants’ descendants," says the Lord, "from this time and forevermore."
verses.textEnNlt: "And this is my covenant with them," says the Lord . "My Spirit will not leave them, and neither will these words I have given you. They will be on your lips and on the lips of your children and your children’s children forever. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "As for Me, this is My covenant with them," says the Lord: "My Spirit who is upon you, and My words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your offspring, nor from the mouth of your offspring’s offspring," says the Lord, "from now and forever."
verses.textEn: "As for me, this is my covenant with them," says the Lord . "My Spirit, who is on you, will not depart from you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will always be on your lips, on the lips of your children and on the lips of their descendants—from this time on and forever," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 锡安哪！起来，发光，因为你的光已经来到， 耶和华的荣耀已升起来照耀你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安哪！起来，发光，因为你的光已经来到， 耶和华的荣耀已升起来照耀你。
verses.textZhCuv: 兴起，发光！因为你的光已经来到！ 耶和华的荣耀发现照耀你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord has risen upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, shine; For your light has come! And the glory of the Lord is risen upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Arise, Jerusalem! Let your light shine for all to see. For the glory of the Lord rises to shine on you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, shine; for your light has come, And the glory of the Lord has risen upon you.
verses.textEn: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.

verses.textZh: 看哪！黑暗遮盖大地， 幽暗遮蔽万民； 但耶和华要升起来照耀你， 他的荣耀要彰显在你身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！黑暗遮盖大地， 幽暗遮蔽万民； 但耶和华要升起来照耀你， 他的荣耀要彰显在你身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，黑暗遮盖大地， 幽暗遮盖万民， 耶和华却要显现照耀你； 他的荣耀要现在你身上。
verses.textEnNiv: See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the Lord rises upon you and his glory appears over you.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the Lord will arise upon you, and his glory will be seen upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, And deep darkness the people; But the Lord will arise over you, And His glory will be seen upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: Darkness as black as night covers all the nations of the earth, but the glory of the Lord rises and appears over you.
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, darkness will cover the earth And deep darkness the peoples; But the Lord will rise upon you And His glory will appear upon you.
verses.textEn: See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the Lord rises upon you and his glory appears over you.

verses.textZh: 万国要在你的光中行走， 列王必在你如旭日初升的光辉中行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万国要在你的光中行走， 列王必在你如旭日初升的光辉中行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 万国要来就你的光； 君王要来就你发现的光辉。
verses.textEnNiv: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
verses.textEnEsv: And nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Gentiles shall come to your light, And kings to the brightness of your rising.
verses.textEnNlt: All nations will come to your light; mighty kings will come to see your radiance.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nations will come to your light, And kings to the brightness of your rising.
verses.textEn: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.

verses.textZh: 你举目四面观看吧！ 众人都聚集，来到你那里； 你的儿子都要从远方而来， 你的女儿都必被怀抱而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你举目四面观看吧！ 众人都聚集，来到你那里； 你的儿子都要从远方而来， 你的女儿都必被怀抱而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你举目向四方观看； 众人都聚集来到你这里。 你的众子从远方而来； 你的众女也被怀抱而来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Lift up your eyes and look about you: All assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are carried on the hip.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your eyes all around, and see; they all gather together, they come to you; your sons shall come from afar, and your daughters shall be carried on the hip.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lift up your eyes all around, and see: They all gather together, they come to you; Your sons shall come from afar, And your daughters shall be nursed at your side.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look and see, for everyone is coming home! Your sons are coming from distant lands; your little daughters will be carried home.
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise your eyes all around and see; They all gather together, they come to you. Your sons will come from afar, And your daughters will be carried on the hip.
verses.textEn: "Lift up your eyes and look about you: All assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are carried on the hip.

verses.textZh: 那时，你看见了，就必有光彩， 你的心又惊讶又宽畅； 因为大海的财富都必转来归你， 列国的财富也都归你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你看见了，就必有光彩， 你的心又惊讶又宽畅； 因为大海的财富都必转来归你， 列国的财富也都归你。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你看见就有光荣； 你心又跳动又宽畅； 因为大海丰盛的货物必转来归你； 列国的财宝也必来归你。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the seas will be brought to you, to you the riches of the nations will come.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall see and be radiant; your heart shall thrill and exult, because the abundance of the sea shall be turned to you, the wealth of the nations shall come to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall see and become radiant, And your heart shall swell with joy; Because the abundance of the sea shall be turned to you, The wealth of the Gentiles shall come to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your eyes will shine, and your heart will thrill with joy, for merchants from around the world will come to you. They will bring you the wealth of many lands.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you will see and be radiant, And your heart will thrill and rejoice; Because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you, The wealth of the nations will come to you.
verses.textEn: Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the seas will be brought to you, to you the riches of the nations will come.

verses.textZh: 成群的骆驼必遮盖你的地， 米甸和以法的小骆驼要盖满你的国境； 示巴的人都必带着黄金和乳香来到， 并且宣扬赞美耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 成群的骆驼必遮盖你的地， 米甸和以法的小骆驼要盖满你的国境； 示巴的人都必带着黄金和乳香来到， 并且宣扬赞美耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 成群的骆驼， 并米甸和以法的独峰驼必遮满你； 示巴的众人都必来到； 要奉上黄金乳香， 又要传说耶和华的赞美。
verses.textEnNiv: Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah. And all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and incense and proclaiming the praise of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: A multitude of camels shall cover you, the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all those from Sheba shall come. They shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall bring good news, the praises of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The multitude of camels shall cover your land, The dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; All those from Sheba shall come; They shall bring gold and incense, And they shall proclaim the praises of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Vast caravans of camels will converge on you, the camels of Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and frankincense and will come worshiping the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "A multitude of camels will cover you, The young camels of Midian and Ephah; All those from Sheba will come; They will bring gold and frankincense, And proclaim good news of the praises of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah. And all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and incense and proclaiming the praise of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 基达的羊群都必聚集到你那里， 尼拜约的公羊要供你使用； 牠们必献在我的祭坛上，成为蒙悦纳的祭品。 我要荣耀我荣耀的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基达的羊群都必聚集到你那里， 尼拜约的公羊要供你使用； 牠们必献在我的祭坛上，成为蒙悦纳的祭品。 我要荣耀我荣耀的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 基达的羊群都必聚集到你这里， 尼拜约的公羊要供你使用， 在我坛上必蒙悦纳； 我必荣耀我荣耀的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: All Kedar’s flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my glorious temple.
verses.textEnEsv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you; they shall come up with acceptance on my altar, and I will beautify my beautiful house.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together to you, The rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you; They shall ascend with acceptance on My altar, And I will glorify the house of My glory.
verses.textEnNlt: The flocks of Kedar will be given to you, and the rams of Nebaioth will be brought for my altars. I will accept their offerings, and I will make my Temple glorious.
verses.textEnNasb: "All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you, The rams of Nebaioth will serve you; They will go up on My altar with acceptance, And I will glorify My glorious house.
verses.textEn: All Kedar’s flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my glorious temple.

verses.textZh: 那些像云彩飞来， 像鸽子飞回巢里的，是谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些像云彩飞来， 像鸽子飞回巢里的，是谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那些飞来如云、 又如鸽子向窗户飞回的是谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?
verses.textEnEsv: Who are these that fly like a cloud, and like doves to their windows?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who are these who fly like a cloud, And like doves to their roosts?
verses.textEnNlt: "And what do I see flying like clouds to Israel, like doves to their nests?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who are these who fly like a cloud And like the doves to their windows?
verses.textEn: "Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?

verses.textZh: 众海岛的人都必等候我， 他施的船队领先， 把你的众子，连他们的金银， 都一起从远方带来， 都为了耶和华你的神的名， 又为了以色列的圣者的缘故，因为他已经荣耀了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众海岛的人都必等候我， 他施的船队领先， 把你的众子，连他们的金银， 都一起从远方带来， 都为了耶和华你的神的名， 又为了以色列的圣者的缘故，因为他已经荣耀了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 众海岛必等候我， 首先是他施的船只， 将你的众子连他们的金银从远方一同带来， 都为耶和华－你神的名， 又为以色列的圣者， 因为他已经荣耀了你。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish, bringing your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: For the coastlands shall hope for me, the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your children from afar, their silver and gold with them, for the name of the Lord your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has made you beautiful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the coastlands shall wait for Me; And the ships of Tarshish willcome first, To bring your sons from afar, Their silver and their gold with them, To the name of the Lord your God, And to the Holy One of Israel, Because He has glorified you.
verses.textEnNlt: They are ships from the ends of the earth, from lands that trust in me, led by the great ships of Tarshish. They are bringing the people of Israel home from far away, carrying their silver and gold. They will honor the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has filled you with splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Certainly the coastlands will wait for Me; And the ships of Tarshish will come first, To bring your sons from afar, Their silver and their gold with them, For the name of the Lord your God, And for the Holy One of Israel because He has glorified you.
verses.textEn: Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish, bringing your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.

verses.textZh: 外族人要重建你的城墙， 他们的君王都必服事你。 虽然我曾经在烈怒中击打了你， 现在我却在恩典中怜悯你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外族人要重建你的城墙， 他们的君王都必服事你。 虽然我曾经在烈怒中击打了你， 现在我却在恩典中怜悯你。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人必建筑你的城墙； 他们的王必服事你。 我曾发怒击打你， 现今却施恩怜恤你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.
verses.textEnEsv: Foreigners shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister to you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The sons of foreigners shall build up your walls, And their kings shall minister to you; For in My wrath I struck you, But in My favor I have had mercy on you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Foreigners will come to rebuild your towns, and their kings will serve you. For though I have destroyed you in my anger, I will now have mercy on you through my grace.
verses.textEnNasb: "Foreigners will build up your walls, And their kings will serve you; For in My wrath I struck you, And in My favor I have had compassion on you.
verses.textEn: "Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.

verses.textZh: 你的城门必常常开， 日夜都不关闭， 使人把列国的财富带来归你， 他们的君王也都被引导而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的城门必常常开， 日夜都不关闭， 使人把列国的财富带来归你， 他们的君王也都被引导而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的城门必时常开放， 昼夜不关； 使人把列国的财物带来归你， 并将他们的君王牵引而来。
verses.textEnNiv: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations— their kings led in triumphal procession.
verses.textEnEsv: Your gates shall be open continually; day and night they shall not be shut, that people may bring to you the wealth of the nations, with their kings led in procession.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore your gates shall be open continually; They shall not be shut day or night, That men may bring to you the wealth of the Gentiles, And their kings in procession.
verses.textEnNlt: Your gates will stay open day and night to receive the wealth of many lands. The kings of the world will be led as captives in a victory procession.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your gates will be open continually; They will not be closed day or night, So that people may bring you the wealth of the nations, With their kings led in procession.
verses.textEn: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations— their kings led in triumphal procession.

verses.textZh: 不事奉你的邦或国，都必灭亡； 那些邦国必全然荒废。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不事奉你的邦或国，都必灭亡； 那些邦国必全然荒废。
verses.textZhCuv: 哪一邦哪一国不事奉你，就必灭亡， 也必全然荒废。
verses.textEnNiv: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.
verses.textEnEsv: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; those nations shall be utterly laid waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the nation and kingdom which will not serve you shall perish, And those nations shall be utterly ruined.
verses.textEnNlt: For the nations that refuse to serve you will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the nation and the kingdom which will not serve you will perish, And the nations will be utterly ruined.
verses.textEn: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.

verses.textZh: 黎巴嫩的荣耀必来归你， 就是松树、杉树和黄杨树，都一起归你， 为要装饰我圣所之地， 我也要使我踏足之处得荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黎巴嫩的荣耀必来归你， 就是松树、杉树和黄杨树，都一起归你， 为要装饰我圣所之地， 我也要使我踏足之处得荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 黎巴嫩的荣耀， 就是松树、杉树、黄杨树， 都必一同归你， 为要修饰我圣所之地； 我也要使我脚踏之处得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: "The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the juniper, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place for my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress, the plane, and the pine, to beautify the place of my sanctuary, and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, The cypress, the pine, and the box tree together, To beautify the place of My sanctuary; And I will make the place of My feet glorious.
verses.textEnNlt: "The glory of Lebanon will be yours— the forests of cypress, fir, and pine— to beautify my sanctuary. My Temple will be glorious!
verses.textEnNasb: "The glory of Lebanon will come to you, The juniper, the elm tree and the cedar together, To beautify the place of My sanctuary; And I will make the place of My feet glorious.
verses.textEn: "The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the juniper, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place for my feet.

verses.textZh: 那些素来苦待你的人，他们的子孙都必屈身来到你那里； 所有藐视你的，都要在你的脚下跪拜； 他们要称你为耶和华的城、 以色列圣者的锡安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些素来苦待你的人，他们的子孙都必屈身来到你那里； 所有藐视你的，都要在你的脚下跪拜； 他们要称你为耶和华的城、 以色列圣者的锡安。
verses.textZhCuv: 素来苦待你的，他的子孙都必屈身来就你； 藐视你的，都要在你脚下跪拜。 他们要称你为「耶和华的城」， 为「以色列圣者的锡安」。
verses.textEnNiv: The children of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of the Lord , Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of those who afflicted you shall come bending low to you, and all who despised you shall bow down at your feet; they shall call you the City of the Lord , the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the sons of those who afflicted you Shall come bowing to you, And all those who despised you shall fall prostrate at the soles of your feet; And they shall call you The City of the Lord, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of your tormentors will come and bow before you. Those who despised you will kiss your feet. They will call you the City of the Lord , and Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you, And all those who despised you will bow down at the soles of your feet; And they will call you the city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: The children of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of the Lord , Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 你曾经被撇弃、被憎恨， 以致无人经过你那里， 但我要使你成为永远被夸耀的， 成为万代的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾经被撇弃、被憎恨， 以致无人经过你那里， 但我要使你成为永远被夸耀的， 成为万代的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你虽然被撇弃被厌恶， 甚至无人经过， 我却使你变为永远的荣华， 成为累代的喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you majestic forever, a joy from age to age.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, So that no one went through you, I will make you an eternal excellence, A joy of many generations.
verses.textEnNlt: "Though you were once despised and hated, with no one traveling through you, I will make you beautiful forever, a joy to all generations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Whereas you have been forsaken and hated With no one passing through, I will make you an object of pride forever, A joy from generation to generation.
verses.textEn: "Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.

verses.textZh: 你要喝万国的奶， 又吮列王的乳， 这样，你就知道我耶和华是你的拯救者， 是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要喝万国的奶， 又吮列王的乳， 这样，你就知道我耶和华是你的拯救者， 是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也必吃万国的奶， 又吃君王的奶。 你便知道我－耶和华是你的救主， 是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。
verses.textEnNiv: You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall suck the milk of nations; you shall nurse at the breast of kings; and you shall know that I, the Lord , am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall drink the milk of the Gentiles, And milk the breast of kings; You shall know that I, the Lord, am your Savior And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Powerful kings and mighty nations will satisfy your every need, as though you were a child nursing at the breast of a queen. You will know at last that I, the Lord , am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will also suck the milk of nations, And suck the breast of kings; Then you will know that I, the Lord, am your Savior And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.textEn: You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 我要带来黄金代替铜， 带来银子代替铁， 铜代替木头， 铁代替石头。 我要立和平作你的官长， 立公义作你的监督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要带来黄金代替铜， 带来银子代替铁， 铜代替木头， 铁代替石头。 我要立和平作你的官长， 立公义作你的监督。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要拿金子代替铜， 拿银子代替铁， 拿铜代替木头， 拿铁代替石头； 并要以和平为你的官长， 以公义为你的监督。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones. I will make peace your governor and well-being your ruler.
verses.textEnEsv: Instead of bronze I will bring gold, and instead of iron I will bring silver; instead of wood, bronze, instead of stones, iron. I will make your overseers peace and your taskmasters righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Instead of bronze I will bring gold, Instead of iron I will bring silver, Instead of wood, bronze, And instead of stones, iron. I will also make your officers peace, And your magistrates righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: I will exchange your bronze for gold, your iron for silver, your wood for bronze, and your stones for iron. I will make peace your leader and righteousness your ruler.
verses.textEnNasb: "Instead of bronze I will bring gold, And instead of iron I will bring silver, And instead of wood, bronze, And instead of stones, iron. And I will make peace your administrators, And righteousness your overseers.
verses.textEn: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones. I will make peace your governor and well-being your ruler.

verses.textZh: 在你的国中必不再听见强暴的事， 在你的境内，也不再听到荒废和毁坏的事； 你必称你的城墙为"拯救"， 称你的城门为"赞美"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你的国中必不再听见强暴的事， 在你的境内，也不再听到荒废和毁坏的事； 你必称你的城墙为"拯救"， 称你的城门为"赞美"。
verses.textZhCuv: 你地上不再听见强暴的事， 境内不再听见荒凉毁灭的事。 你必称你的墙为「拯救」， 称你的门为「赞美」。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
verses.textEnEsv: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, devastation or destruction within your borders; you shall call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Violence shall no longer be heard in your land, Neither wasting nor destruction within your borders; But you shall call your walls Salvation, And your gates Praise.
verses.textEnNlt: Violence will disappear from your land; the desolation and destruction of war will end. Salvation will surround you like city walls, and praise will be on the lips of all who enter there.
verses.textEnNasb: "Violence will not be heard again in your land, Nor devastation or destruction within your borders; But you will call your walls salvation, and your gates praise.
verses.textEn: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.

verses.textZh: 白天太阳必不再作你的光， 晚上月亮也必不再发光照耀你， 耶和华却要作你永远的光， 你的神要作你的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白天太阳必不再作你的光， 晚上月亮也必不再发光照耀你， 耶和华却要作你永远的光， 你的神要作你的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头不再作你白昼的光； 月亮也不再发光照耀你。 耶和华却要作你永远的光； 你神要为你的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
verses.textEnEsv: The sun shall be no more your light by day, nor for brightness shall the moon give you light; but the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The sun shall no longer be your light by day, Nor for brightness shall the moon give light to you; But the Lord will be to you an everlasting light, And your God your glory.
verses.textEnNlt: "No longer will you need the sun to shine by day, nor the moon to give its light by night, for the Lord your God will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
verses.textEnNasb: "No longer will you have the sun for light by day, Nor will the moon give you light for brightness; But you will have the Lord as an everlasting light, And your God as your glory.
verses.textEn: The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

verses.textZh: 你的太阳必不再下落， 你的月亮也必不退缩； 因为耶和华要作你永远的光， 你悲哀的日子必要终止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的太阳必不再下落， 你的月亮也必不退缩； 因为耶和华要作你永远的光， 你悲哀的日子必要终止。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的日头不再下落； 你的月亮也不退缩； 因为耶和华必作你永远的光。 你悲哀的日子也完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.
verses.textEnEsv: Your sun shall no more go down, nor your moon withdraw itself; for the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning shall be ended.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your sun shall no longer go down, Nor shall your moon withdraw itself; For the Lord will be your everlasting light, And the days of your mourning shall be ended.
verses.textEnNlt: Your sun will never set; your moon will not go down. For the Lord will be your everlasting light. Your days of mourning will come to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your sun will no longer set, Nor will your moon wane; For you will have the Lord as an everlasting light, And the days of your mourning will be over.
verses.textEn: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.

verses.textZh: 你的人民都必成为义人， 永远得地为业； 他们是我栽种的嫩芽， 我手所作的工作， 使我得荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的人民都必成为义人， 永远得地为业； 他们是我栽种的嫩芽， 我手所作的工作， 使我得荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的居民都成为义人， 永远得地为业； 是我种的栽子，我手的工作， 使我得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all your people will be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: Your people shall all be righteous; they shall possess the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I might be glorified.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also your people shall all be righteous; They shall inherit the land forever, The branch of My planting, The work of My hands, That I may be glorified.
verses.textEnNlt: All your people will be righteous. They will possess their land forever, for I will plant them there with my own hands in order to bring myself glory.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then all your people will be righteous; They will possess the land forever, The branch of My planting, The work of My hands, That I may be glorified.
verses.textEn: Then all your people will be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.

verses.textZh: 最小的要成为一族， 微弱的要成为强盛的国， 我耶和华必按着定期速速作成这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最小的要成为一族， 微弱的要成为强盛的国， 我耶和华必按着定期速速作成这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 至小的族要加增千倍； 微弱的国必成为强盛。 我－耶和华要按定期速成这事。
verses.textEnNiv: The least of you will become a thousand, the smallest a mighty nation. I am the Lord ; in its time I will do this swiftly."
verses.textEnEsv: The least one shall become a clan, and the smallest one a mighty nation; I am the Lord ; in its time I will hasten it.
verses.textEnNkjv: A little one shall become a thousand, And a small one a strong nation. I, the Lord, will hasten it in its time."
verses.textEnNlt: The smallest family will become a thousand people, and the tiniest group will become a mighty nation. At the right time, I, the Lord , will make it happen."
verses.textEnNasb: "The smallest one will become a thousand, And the least one a mighty nation. I, the Lord, will bring it about quickly in its time."
verses.textEn: The least of you will become a thousand, the smallest a mighty nation. I am the Lord ; in its time I will do this swiftly."

verses.textZh: 主耶和华的灵在我身上， 因为耶和华膏了我， 叫我传福音给困苦的人； 差遣我去医治伤心的人， 向被掳的宣告自由， 向被囚的宣告释放；
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华的灵在我身上， 因为耶和华膏了我， 叫我传福音给困苦的人； 差遣我去医治伤心的人， 向被掳的宣告自由， 向被囚的宣告释放；
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华的灵在我身上； 因为耶和华用膏膏我， 叫我传好信息给谦卑的人 ， 差遣我医好伤心的人， 报告被掳的得释放， 被囚的出监牢；
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners,
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me to bring good news to the poor; he has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to those who are bound;
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Spirit of the Lord Godis upon Me, Because the Lord has anointed Me To preach good tidings to the poor; He has sent Me to heal the brokenhearted, To proclaim liberty to the captives, And the opening of the prison to thosewhoare bound;
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is upon me, for the Lord has anointed me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent me to comfort the brokenhearted and to proclaim that captives will be released and prisoners will be freed.
verses.textEnNasb: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me, Because the Lord anointed me To bring good news to the humble; He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, To proclaim release to captives And freedom to prisoners;
verses.textEn: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners,

verses.textZh: 宣告耶和华悦纳人的禧年， 和我们的神报仇的日子； 安慰悲哀的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 宣告耶和华悦纳人的禧年， 和我们的神报仇的日子； 安慰悲哀的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 报告耶和华的恩年， 和我们神报仇的日子； 安慰一切悲哀的人，
verses.textEnNiv: to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
verses.textEnEsv: to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn;
verses.textEnNkjv: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, And the day of vengeance of our God; To comfort all who mourn,
verses.textEnNlt: He has sent me to tell those who mourn that the time of the Lord ’s favor has come, and with it, the day of God’s anger against their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: To proclaim the favorable year of the Lord And the day of vengeance of our God; To comfort all who mourn,
verses.textEn: to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

verses.textZh: 为锡安悲哀的人穿上装饰， 赐给他们华冠代替灰尘， 喜乐油代替悲哀， 赞美衣代替沮丧的灵， 他们必称为公义的橡树， 是耶和华栽种的，好使他自己得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为锡安悲哀的人穿上装饰， 赐给他们华冠代替灰尘， 喜乐油代替悲哀， 赞美衣代替沮丧的灵， 他们必称为公义的橡树， 是耶和华栽种的，好使他自己得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 赐华冠与锡安悲哀的人，代替灰尘； 喜乐油代替悲哀； 赞美衣代替忧伤之灵； 使他们称为「公义树」， 是耶和华所栽的，叫他得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: and provide for those who grieve in Zion— to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the Lord for the display of his splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: to grant to those who mourn in Zion— to give them a beautiful headdress instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of a faint spirit; that they may be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the Lord , that he may be glorified.
verses.textEnNkjv: To console those who mourn in Zion, To give them beauty for ashes, The oil of joy for mourning, The garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; That they may be called trees of righteousness, The planting of the Lord, that He may be glorified."
verses.textEnNlt: To all who mourn in Israel, he will give a crown of beauty for ashes, a joyous blessing instead of mourning, festive praise instead of despair. In their righteousness, they will be like great oaks that the Lord has planted for his own glory.
verses.textEnNasb: To grant those who mourn in Zion, Giving them a garland instead of ashes, The oil of gladness instead of mourning, The cloak of praise instead of a disheartened spirit. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, The planting of the Lord, that He may be glorified.
verses.textEn: and provide for those who grieve in Zion— to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the Lord for the display of his splendor.

verses.textZh: 他们必重建久已废弃的荒场， 建立先前荒凉之地； 重修荒废了的城镇， 就是历代荒凉之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必重建久已废弃的荒场， 建立先前荒凉之地； 重修荒废了的城镇， 就是历代荒凉之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必修造已久的荒场， 建立先前凄凉之处， 重修历代荒凉之城。
verses.textEnNiv: They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall build up the ancient ruins; they shall raise up the former devastations; they shall repair the ruined cities, the devastations of many generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall rebuild the old ruins, They shall raise up the former desolations, And they shall repair the ruined cities, The desolations of many generations.
verses.textEnNlt: They will rebuild the ancient ruins, repairing cities destroyed long ago. They will revive them, though they have been deserted for many generations.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will rebuild the ancient ruins, They will raise up the former devastations; And they will repair the ruined cities, The desolations of many generations.
verses.textEn: They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.

verses.textZh: 那时，外人要服事你们，牧放你们的羊群， 外族人要作你们的农夫和葡萄园丁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，外人要服事你们，牧放你们的羊群， 外族人要作你们的农夫和葡萄园丁。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，外人必起来牧放你们的羊群； 外邦人必作你们耕种田地的， 修理葡萄园的。
verses.textEnNiv: Strangers will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.
verses.textEnEsv: Strangers shall stand and tend your flocks; foreigners shall be your plowmen and vinedressers;
verses.textEnNkjv: Strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, And the sons of the foreigner Shallbe your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.textEnNlt: Foreigners will be your servants. They will feed your flocks and plow your fields and tend your vineyards.
verses.textEnNasb: Strangers will stand and pasture your flocks, And foreigners will be your farmers and your vinedressers.
verses.textEn: Strangers will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.

verses.textZh: 至于你们，却要称为耶和华的祭司， 人必称你们为我们神的仆人； 你们要享用列国的财富， 因得着他们的荣耀而夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你们，却要称为耶和华的祭司， 人必称你们为我们神的仆人； 你们要享用列国的财富， 因得着他们的荣耀而夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们倒要称为耶和华的祭司； 人必称你们为我们神的仆役。 你们必吃用列国的财物， 因得他们的荣耀自夸。
verses.textEnNiv: And you will be called priests of the Lord , you will be named ministers of our God. You will feed on the wealth of nations, and in their riches you will boast.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall be called the priests of the Lord ; they shall speak of you as the ministers of our God; you shall eat the wealth of the nations, and in their glory you shall boast.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall be named the priests of the Lord, They shall call you the servants of our God. You shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, And in their glory you shall boast.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be called priests of the Lord , ministers of our God. You will feed on the treasures of the nations and boast in their riches.
verses.textEnNasb: But you will be called the priests of the Lord; You will be spoken of as ministers of our God. You will eat the wealth of nations, And you will boast in their riches.
verses.textEn: And you will be called priests of the Lord , you will be named ministers of our God. You will feed on the wealth of nations, and in their riches you will boast.

verses.textZh: 你们必得加倍的分，代替你们所受的羞愧， 他们因自己所得的分而欢呼，代替羞辱， 所以在他们的境内，他们必拥有加倍的产业， 他们必有永远的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必得加倍的分，代替你们所受的羞愧， 他们因自己所得的分而欢呼，代替羞辱， 所以在他们的境内，他们必拥有加倍的产业， 他们必有永远的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必得加倍的好处，代替所受的羞辱； 分中所得的喜乐，必代替所受的凌辱。 在境内必得加倍的产业； 永远之乐必归与你们 。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead of your shame you will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace you will rejoice in your inheritance. And so you will inherit a double portion in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.
verses.textEnEsv: Instead of your shame there shall be a double portion; instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their lot; therefore in their land they shall possess a double portion; they shall have everlasting joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Instead of your shame youshallhave double honor, And insteadof confusion they shall rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they shall possess double; Everlasting joy shall be theirs.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead of shame and dishonor, you will enjoy a double share of honor. You will possess a double portion of prosperity in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead of your shame you will have a double portion, And instead of humiliation they will shout for joy over their portion. Therefore they will possess a double portion in their land, Everlasting joy will be theirs.
verses.textEn: Instead of your shame you will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace you will rejoice in your inheritance. And so you will inherit a double portion in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.

verses.textZh: 因为我耶和华喜爱公平， 恨恶不义的抢夺； 我要凭真理赏赐他们， 与他们立永远的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我耶和华喜爱公平， 恨恶不义的抢夺； 我要凭真理赏赐他们， 与他们立永远的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我－耶和华喜爱公平， 恨恶抢夺和罪孽； 我要凭诚实施行报应， 并要与我的百姓立永约。
verses.textEnNiv: "For I, the Lord , love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing. In my faithfulness I will reward my people and make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.textEnEsv: For I the Lord love justice; I hate robbery and wrong; I will faithfully give them their recompense, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For I, the Lord, love justice; I hate robbery for burnt offering; I will direct their work in truth, And will make with them an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: "For I, the Lord , love justice. I hate robbery and wrongdoing. I will faithfully reward my people for their suffering and make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I, the Lord, love justice, I hate robbery in the burnt offering; And I will faithfully give them their reward, And make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.textEn: "For I, the Lord , love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing. In my faithfulness I will reward my people and make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.textZh: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识， 他们的子孙在万民中也必这样； 看见他们的， 都必承认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识， 他们的子孙在万民中也必这样； 看见他们的， 都必承认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识； 他们的子孙在众民中也是如此。 凡看见他们的必认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the Lord has blessed."
verses.textEnEsv: Their offspring shall be known among the nations, and their descendants in the midst of the peoples; all who see them shall acknowledge them, that they are an offspring the Lord has blessed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their descendants shall be known among the Gentiles, And their offspring among the people. All who see them shall acknowledge them, That they are the posterity whom the Lord has blessed."
verses.textEnNlt: Their descendants will be recognized and honored among the nations. Everyone will realize that they are a people the Lord has blessed."
verses.textEnNasb: Then their offspring will be known among the nations, And their descendants in the midst of the peoples. All who see them will recognize them Because they are the offspring whom the Lord has blessed.
verses.textEn: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the Lord has blessed."

verses.textZh: 我因耶和华大大欢喜， 我的心靠着我的神快乐， 因为他给我穿上救恩的衣服， 给我披上公义的外袍， 好象新郎戴上华冠， 又像新娘佩戴装饰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因耶和华大大欢喜， 我的心靠着我的神快乐， 因为他给我穿上救恩的衣服， 给我披上公义的外袍， 好象新郎戴上华冠， 又像新娘佩戴装饰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因耶和华大大欢喜； 我的心靠神快乐。 因他以拯救为衣给我穿上， 以公义为袍给我披上， 好像新郎戴上华冠， 又像新妇佩戴妆饰。
verses.textEnNiv: I delight greatly in the Lord ; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
verses.textEnEsv: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord ; my soul shall exult in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation; he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself like a priest with a beautiful headdress, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
