verses.textEnNkjv: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, My soul shall be joyful in my God; For He has clothed me with the garments of salvation, He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, As a bridegroom decks himself with ornaments, And as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
verses.textEnNlt: I am overwhelmed with joy in the Lord my God! For he has dressed me with the clothing of salvation and draped me in a robe of righteousness. I am like a bridegroom dressed for his wedding or a bride with her jewels.
verses.textEnNasb: I will rejoice greatly in the Lord, My soul will be joyful in my God; For He has clothed me with garments of salvation, He has wrapped me with a robe of righteousness, As a groom puts on a turban, And as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
verses.textEn: I delight greatly in the Lord ; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

verses.textZh: 地怎样发生苗芽， 园子怎样使所种的生长起来， 主耶和华也必怎样使公义和赞美， 在万国之前生长出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地怎样发生苗芽， 园子怎样使所种的生长起来， 主耶和华也必怎样使公义和赞美， 在万国之前生长出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 田地怎样使百谷发芽， 园子怎样使所种的发生， 主耶和华必照样 使公义和赞美在万民中发出。
verses.textEnNiv: For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so the Sovereign Lord will make righteousness and praise spring up before all nations.
verses.textEnEsv: For as the earth brings forth its sprouts, and as a garden causes what is sown in it to sprout up, so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to sprout up before all the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the earth brings forth its bud, As the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring forth, So the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sovereign Lord will show his justice to the nations of the world. Everyone will praise him! His righteousness will be like a garden in early spring, with plants springing up everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: For as the earth produces its sprouts, And as a garden causes the things sown in it to spring up, So the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise To spring up before all the nations.
verses.textEn: For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so the Sovereign Lord will make righteousness and praise spring up before all nations.

verses.textZh: 为了锡安的缘故我必不缄默， 为了耶路撒冷的缘故我决不静止， 直到它的公义如光辉发出， 它的救恩像明灯发亮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了锡安的缘故我必不缄默， 为了耶路撒冷的缘故我决不静止， 直到它的公义如光辉发出， 它的救恩像明灯发亮。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因锡安必不静默， 为耶路撒冷必不息声， 直到他的公义如光辉发出， 他的救恩如明灯发亮。
verses.textEnNiv: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, for Jerusalem’s sake I will not remain quiet, till her vindication shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.
verses.textEnEsv: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not be quiet, until her righteousness goes forth as brightness, and her salvation as a burning torch.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Zion’s sake I will not hold My peace, And for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, Until her righteousness goes forth as brightness, And her salvation as a lamp that burns.
verses.textEnNlt: Because I love Zion, I will not keep still. Because my heart yearns for Jerusalem, I cannot remain silent. I will not stop praying for her until her righteousness shines like the dawn, and her salvation blazes like a burning torch.
verses.textEnNasb: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, And for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep quiet, Until her righteousness goes forth like brightness, And her salvation like a torch that is burning.
verses.textEn: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, for Jerusalem’s sake I will not remain quiet, till her vindication shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.

verses.textZh: 列国必看见你的公义， 众王必看见你的荣耀； 人要给你起一个新名， 是耶和华亲口指定的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国必看见你的公义， 众王必看见你的荣耀； 人要给你起一个新名， 是耶和华亲口指定的。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国必见你的公义； 列王必见你的荣耀。 你必得新名的称呼， 是耶和华亲口所起的。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations will see your vindication, and all kings your glory; you will be called by a new name that the mouth of the Lord will bestow.
verses.textEnEsv: The nations shall see your righteousness, and all the kings your glory, and you shall be called by a new name that the mouth of the Lord will give.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Gentiles shall see your righteousness, And all kings your glory. You shall be called by a new name, Which the mouth of the Lord will name.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations will see your righteousness. World leaders will be blinded by your glory. And you will be given a new name by the Lord ’s own mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: The nations will see your righteousness, And all kings your glory; And you will be called by a new name Which the mouth of the Lord will designate.
verses.textEn: The nations will see your vindication, and all kings your glory; you will be called by a new name that the mouth of the Lord will bestow.

verses.textZh: 你在耶和华的手中要作美丽的冠冕， 在你神的掌上要作君王的华冠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在耶和华的手中要作美丽的冠冕， 在你神的掌上要作君王的华冠。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在耶和华的手中要作为华冠， 在你神的掌上必作为冕旒。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be a crown of splendor in the Lord ’s hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord , and a royal diadem in the hand of your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall also be a crown of glory In the hand of the Lord, And a royal diadem In the hand of your God.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will hold you in his hand for all to see— a splendid crown in the hand of God.
verses.textEnNasb: You will also be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord, And a royal headband in the hand of your God.
verses.textEn: You will be a crown of splendor in the Lord ’s hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

verses.textZh: 你必不再称为被撇弃的， 你的地也必不再称为荒凉的， 你却要称为我所喜悦的， 你的地也要称为有丈夫的， 因为耶和华喜悦你， 你的地也必有丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必不再称为被撇弃的， 你的地也必不再称为荒凉的， 你却要称为我所喜悦的， 你的地也要称为有丈夫的， 因为耶和华喜悦你， 你的地也必有丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必不再称为「撇弃的」； 你的地也不再称为「荒凉的」。 你却要称为「我所喜悦的」； 你的地也必称为「有夫之妇」。 因为耶和华喜悦你， 你的地也必归他。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will they call you Deserted, or name your land Desolate. But you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah ; for the Lord will take delight in you, and your land will be married.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall no more be termed Forsaken, and your land shall no more be termed Desolate, but you shall be called My Delight Is in Her, and your land Married; for the Lord delights in you, and your land shall be married.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall no longer be termed Forsaken, Nor shall your land any more be termed Desolate; But you shall be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; For the Lord delights in you, And your land shall be married.
verses.textEnNlt: Never again will you be called "The Forsaken City" or "The Desolate Land." Your new name will be "The City of God’s Delight" and "The Bride of God," for the Lord delights in you and will claim you as his bride.
verses.textEnNasb: It will no longer be said to you, " Forsaken," Nor to your land will it any longer be said, " Desolate"; But you will be called, " My delight is in her," And your land, " Married"; For the Lord delights in you, And to Him your land will be married.
verses.textEn: No longer will they call you Deserted, or name your land Desolate. But you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah ; for the Lord will take delight in you, and your land will be married.

verses.textZh: 因为年轻人怎样娶处女， 那建造你的也必怎样娶你； 新郎怎样因新娘欢乐， 你的神也必怎样因你欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为年轻人怎样娶处女， 那建造你的也必怎样娶你； 新郎怎样因新娘欢乐， 你的神也必怎样因你欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人怎样娶处女， 你的众民 也要照样娶你； 新郎怎样喜悦新妇， 你的神也要照样喜悦你。
verses.textEnNiv: As a young man marries a young woman, so will your Builder marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your God rejoice over you.
verses.textEnEsv: For as a young man marries a young woman, so shall your sons marry you, and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as a young man marries a virgin, So shall your sons marry you; And as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, So shall your God rejoice over you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your children will commit themselves to you, O Jerusalem, just as a young man commits himself to his bride. Then God will rejoice over you as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride.
verses.textEnNasb: For as a young man marries a virgin, So your sons will marry you; And as the groom rejoices over the bride, So your God will rejoice over you.
verses.textEn: As a young man marries a young woman, so will your Builder marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your God rejoice over you.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！我在你的城墙上设立了守望的人； 他们昼夜都不缄默； 提耶和华之名的啊！你们不要静止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！我在你的城墙上设立了守望的人； 他们昼夜都不缄默； 提耶和华之名的啊！你们不要静止。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊， 我在你城上设立守望的， 他们昼夜必不静默。 呼吁耶和华的，你们不要歇息，
verses.textEnNiv: I have posted watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the Lord , give yourselves no rest,
verses.textEnEsv: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have set watchmen; all the day and all the night they shall never be silent. You who put the Lord in remembrance, take no rest,
verses.textEnNkjv: I have set watchmen on your walls, O Jerusalem; They shall never hold their peace day or night. You who make mention of the Lord, do not keep silent,
verses.textEnNlt: O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen on your walls; they will pray day and night, continually. Take no rest, all you who pray to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: On your walls, Jerusalem, I have appointed watchmen; All day and all night they will never keep silent. You who profess the Lord, take no rest for yourselves;
verses.textEn: I have posted watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the Lord , give yourselves no rest,

verses.textZh: 你们也不要让神静止，直至他建立耶路撒冷， 等到他使耶路撒冷在地上成为受人赞美的城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也不要让神静止，直至他建立耶路撒冷， 等到他使耶路撒冷在地上成为受人赞美的城。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要使他歇息， 直等他建立耶路撒冷， 使耶路撒冷在地上成为可赞美的。
verses.textEnNiv: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and give him no rest until he establishes Jerusalem and makes it a praise in the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And give Him no rest till He establishes And till He makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Give the Lord no rest until he completes his work, until he makes Jerusalem the pride of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And give Him no rest until He establishes And makes Jerusalem an object of praise on the earth.
verses.textEn: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华指着自己的右手和他大能的膀臂起誓，说： "我必不再把你的五谷给你的仇敌作食物， 外族人也必不再喝你劳碌所得的新酒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华指着自己的右手和他大能的膀臂起誓，说： "我必不再把你的五谷给你的仇敌作食物， 外族人也必不再喝你劳碌所得的新酒；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华指着自己的右手和大能的膀臂起誓说： 我必不再将你的五谷给你仇敌作食物； 外邦人也不再喝你劳碌得来的新酒。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: "Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: "I will not again give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners shall not drink your wine for which you have labored;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has sworn by His right hand And by the arm of His strength: "Surely I will no longer give your grain As food for your enemies; And the sons of the foreigner shall not drink your new wine, For which you have labored.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has sworn to Jerusalem by his own strength: "I will never again hand you over to your enemies. Never again will foreign warriors come and take away your grain and new wine.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: "I will never again give your grain as food for your enemies, Nor will foreigners drink your new wine for which you have labored."
verses.textEn: The Lord has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: "Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;

verses.textZh: 唯有那些收割的人可以吃五谷，并且赞美耶和华； 那些收集的人可以在我圣所的院子里喝新酒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有那些收割的人可以吃五谷，并且赞美耶和华； 那些收集的人可以在我圣所的院子里喝新酒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有那收割的要吃，并赞美耶和华； 那聚敛的要在我圣所的院内喝。
verses.textEnNiv: but those who harvest it will eat it and praise the Lord , and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary."
verses.textEnEsv: but those who garner it shall eat it and praise the Lord , and those who gather it shall drink it in the courts of my sanctuary."
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who have gathered it shall eat it, And praise the Lord; Those who have brought it together shall drink it in My holy courts."
verses.textEnNlt: You raised the grain, and you will eat it, praising the Lord . Within the courtyards of the Temple, you yourselves will drink the wine you have pressed."
verses.textEnNasb: But those who harvest it will eat it and praise the Lord; And those who gather it will drink it in the courtyards of My sanctuary.
verses.textEn: but those who harvest it will eat it and praise the Lord , and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary."

verses.textZh: 你们要经过，要从城门经过， 预备人民的道路； 你们要填高，要填高大道。 要捡去石头、向万民竖立旗帜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要经过，要从城门经过， 预备人民的道路； 你们要填高，要填高大道。 要捡去石头、向万民竖立旗帜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当从门经过经过， 预备百姓的路； 修筑修筑大道， 捡去石头， 为万民竖立大旗，
verses.textEnNiv: Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones. Raise a banner for the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: Go through, go through the gates; prepare the way for the people; build up, build up the highway; clear it of stones; lift up a signal over the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go through, Go through the gates! Prepare the way for the people; Build up, Build up the highway! Take out the stones, Lift up a banner for the peoples!
verses.textEnNlt: Go out through the gates! Prepare the highway for my people to return! Smooth out the road; pull out the boulders; raise a flag for all the nations to see.
verses.textEnNasb: Go through, go through the gates, Clear a way for the people! Build up, build up the highway, Remove the stones, lift up a flag over the peoples.
verses.textEn: Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones. Raise a banner for the nations.

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华曾向地极的人宣告，说： "你们要对锡安的居民 说： ‘看哪！你的拯救者来到了。 他给予人的赏赐在他那里，他施予人的报应在他面前。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华曾向地极的人宣告，说： "你们要对锡安的居民 说： ‘看哪！你的拯救者来到了。 他给予人的赏赐在他那里，他施予人的报应在他面前。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华曾宣告到地极， 对锡安的居民 说： 你的拯救者来到。 他的赏赐在他那里； 他的报应在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has made proclamation to the ends of the earth: "Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your Savior comes! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth: Say to the daughter of Zion, "Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed the Lord has proclaimed To the end of the world: "Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Surely your salvation is coming; Behold, His reward is with Him, And His work before Him.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has sent this message to every land: "Tell the people of Israel, ‘Look, your Savior is coming. See, he brings his reward with him as he comes.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth: Say to the daughter of Zion, "Behold, your salvation is coming; Behold His reward is with Him, and His compensation before Him."
verses.textEn: The Lord has made proclamation to the ends of the earth: "Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your Savior comes! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.’ "

verses.textZh: 人必称他们为圣洁的子民， 为耶和华买赎回来的人； 你也必称为被爱慕的，不被遗弃的城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人必称他们为圣洁的子民， 为耶和华买赎回来的人； 你也必称为被爱慕的，不被遗弃的城。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必称他们为「圣民」，为「耶和华的赎民」； 你也必称为「被眷顾、不撇弃的城」。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of the Lord ; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall be called The Holy People, The Redeemed of the Lord ; and you shall be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall call them The Holy People, The Redeemed of the Lord; And you shall be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be called "The Holy People" and "The People Redeemed by the Lord ." And Jerusalem will be known as "The Desirable Place" and "The City No Longer Forsaken."
verses.textEnNasb: And they will call them, "The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord"; And you will be called, "Sought Out, A City Not Abandoned."
verses.textEn: They will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of the Lord ; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.

verses.textZh: 那从以东、从波斯拉而来， 身穿赤红色的衣服， 装扮华丽、能力强大、 大步前行的，是谁呢？ "就是我，是凭着公义说话，有大能拯救的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那从以东、从波斯拉而来， 身穿赤红色的衣服， 装扮华丽、能力强大、 大步前行的，是谁呢？ "就是我，是凭着公义说话，有大能拯救的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这从以东的波斯拉来， 穿红衣服， 装扮华美， 能力广大， 大步行走的是谁呢？ 就是我， 是凭公义说话， 以大能施行拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, proclaiming victory, mighty to save."
verses.textEnEsv: Who is this who comes from Edom, in crimsoned garments from Bozrah, he who is splendid in his apparel, marching in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save."
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is this who comes from Edom, With dyed garments from Bozrah, This Onewhois glorious in His apparel, Traveling in the greatness of His strength?— "I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save."
verses.textEnNlt: Who is this who comes from Edom, from the city of Bozrah, with his clothing stained red? Who is this in royal robes, marching in his great strength? "It is I, the Lord , announcing your salvation! It is I, the Lord , who has the power to save!"
verses.textEnNasb: Who is this who comes from Edom, With garments of glowing colors from Bozrah, This One who is majestic in His apparel, Marching in the greatness of His strength? "It is I, the One who speaks in righteousness, mighty to save."
verses.textEn: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, proclaiming victory, mighty to save."

verses.textZh: 你的服装为甚么有红色的呢？ 你的衣服为甚么像个踹压酒池的人的衣服一样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的服装为甚么有红色的呢？ 你的衣服为甚么像个踹压酒池的人的衣服一样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的装扮为何有红色？ 你的衣服为何像踹酒榨的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?
verses.textEnEsv: Why is your apparel red, and your garments like his who treads in the winepress?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why is Your apparel red, And Your garments like one who treads in the winepress?
verses.textEnNlt: Why are your clothes so red, as if you have been treading out grapes?
verses.textEnNasb: Why is Your apparel red, And Your garments like one who treads in the wine press?
verses.textEn: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?

verses.textZh: "我独自踹酒槽； 万民之中没有一人与我同在； 我在忿怒中把他们踹下， 在烈怒中把他们践踏； 他们的血溅在我的衣服上， 我把我所有的衣裳都染污了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我独自踹酒槽； 万民之中没有一人与我同在； 我在忿怒中把他们踹下， 在烈怒中把他们践踏； 他们的血溅在我的衣服上， 我把我所有的衣裳都染污了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我独自踹酒榨； 众民中无一人与我同在。 我发怒将他们踹下， 发烈怒将他们践踏。 他们的血溅在我衣服上， 并且污染了我一切的衣裳。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me. I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: "I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples no one was with me; I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath; their lifeblood spattered on my garments, and stained all my apparel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have trodden the winepress alone, And from the peoples no one was with Me. For I have trodden them in My anger, And trampled them in My fury; Their blood is sprinkled upon My garments, And I have stained all My robes.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have been treading the winepress alone; no one was there to help me. In my anger I have trampled my enemies as if they were grapes. In my fury I have trampled my foes. Their blood has stained my clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have trodden the wine trough alone, And from the peoples there was no one with Me. I also trod them in My anger And trampled them in My wrath; And their lifeblood is sprinkled on My garments, And I stained all My clothes.
verses.textEn: "I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me. I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.

verses.textZh: 因为报仇的日子早已在我的心里， 我救赎的年日早已经来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为报仇的日子早已在我的心里， 我救赎的年日早已经来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，报仇之日在我心中； 救赎我民之年已经来到。
verses.textEnNiv: It was for me the day of vengeance; the year for me to redeem had come.
verses.textEnEsv: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and my year of redemption had come.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the day of vengeance is in My heart, And the year of My redeemed has come.
verses.textEnNlt: For the time has come for me to avenge my people, to ransom them from their oppressors.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the day of vengeance was in My heart, And My year of redemption has come.
verses.textEn: It was for me the day of vengeance; the year for me to redeem had come.

verses.textZh: 我观看，但没有人帮助； 我诧异，因没有人扶持； 所以我用自己的膀臂为我施行了拯救， 我的烈怒扶持了我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，但没有人帮助； 我诧异，因没有人扶持； 所以我用自己的膀臂为我施行了拯救， 我的烈怒扶持了我，
verses.textZhCuv: 我仰望，见无人帮助； 我诧异，没有人扶持。 所以，我自己的膀臂为我施行拯救； 我的烈怒将我扶持。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, but there was no one to help, I was appalled that no one gave support; so my own arm achieved salvation for me, and my own wrath sustained me.
verses.textEnEsv: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled, but there was no one to uphold; so my own arm brought me salvation, and my wrath upheld me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I looked, but therewas no one to help, And I wondered That therewas no one to uphold; Therefore My own arm brought salvation for Me; And My own fury, it sustained Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I was amazed to see that no one intervened to help the oppressed. So I myself stepped in to save them with my strong arm, and my wrath sustained me.
verses.textEnNasb: "I looked, but there was no one to help, And I was astonished and there was no one to uphold; So My own arm brought salvation to Me, And My wrath upheld Me.
verses.textEn: I looked, but there was no one to help, I was appalled that no one gave support; so my own arm achieved salvation for me, and my own wrath sustained me.

verses.textZh: 我在忿怒中践踏万民， 在烈怒中使他们沉醉， 又把他们的血倒在地上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在忿怒中践踏万民， 在烈怒中使他们沉醉， 又把他们的血倒在地上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我发怒，踹下众民； 发烈怒，使他们沉醉， 又将他们的血倒在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground."
verses.textEnEsv: I trampled down the peoples in my anger; I made them drunk in my wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: I have trodden down the peoples in My anger, Made them drunk in My fury, And brought down their strength to the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: I crushed the nations in my anger and made them stagger and fall to the ground, spilling their blood upon the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: "I trampled down the peoples in My anger And made them drunk with My wrath, And I poured out their lifeblood on the earth."
verses.textEn: I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground."

verses.textZh: 我照着耶和华为我们所作的一切， 提说耶和华的慈爱，耶和华可称颂的事， 和他赐给以色列家的大福， 就是照着他的怜悯 和丰盛的慈爱为他们作成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我照着耶和华为我们所作的一切， 提说耶和华的慈爱，耶和华可称颂的事， 和他赐给以色列家的大福， 就是照着他的怜悯 和丰盛的慈爱为他们作成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要照耶和华一切所赐给我们的， 提起他的慈爱和美德， 并他向以色列家所施的大恩； 这恩是照他的怜恤 和丰盛的慈爱赐给他们的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will tell of the kindnesses of the Lord , the deeds for which he is to be praised, according to all the Lord has done for us— yes, the many good things he has done for Israel, according to his compassion and many kindnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: I will recount the steadfast love of the Lord , the praises of the Lord , according to all that the Lord has granted us, and the great goodness to the house of Israel that he has granted them according to his compassion, according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord And the praises of the Lord, According to all that the Lord has bestowed on us, And the great goodness toward the house of Israel, Which He has bestowed on them according to His mercies, According to the multitude of His lovingkindnesses.
verses.textEnNlt: I will tell of the Lord ’s unfailing love. I will praise the Lord for all he has done. I will rejoice in his great goodness to Israel, which he has granted according to his mercy and love.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make mention of the mercies of the Lord, and the praises of the Lord, According to all that the Lord has granted us, And the great goodness toward the house of Israel, Which He has granted them according to His compassion And according to the abundance of His mercies.
verses.textEn: I will tell of the kindnesses of the Lord , the deeds for which he is to be praised, according to all the Lord has done for us— yes, the many good things he has done for Israel, according to his compassion and many kindnesses.

verses.textZh: 他曾说："他们真是我的子民， 不行虚假的儿子"， 于是，在他们的一切苦难中，他就作了他们的拯救者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他曾说："他们真是我的子民， 不行虚假的儿子"， 于是，在他们的一切苦难中，他就作了他们的拯救者。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：他们诚然是我的百姓， 不行虚假的子民； 这样，他就作了他们的救主。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Surely they are my people, children who will be true to me"; and so he became their Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: For he said, "Surely they are my people, children who will not deal falsely." And he became their Savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He said, "Surely they are My people, Children who will not lie." So He became their Savior.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "They are my very own people. Surely they will not betray me again." And he became their Savior.
verses.textEnNasb: For He said, "Certainly they are My people, Sons who will not deal falsely." So He became their Savior.
verses.textEn: He said, "Surely they are my people, children who will be true to me"; and so he became their Savior.

verses.textZh: 他不再是敌对者， 并且他面前的使者拯救了他们。 他以自己的爱和怜悯救赎了他们； 在古时的一切日子，他背负他们，怀抱他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不再是敌对者， 并且他面前的使者拯救了他们。 他以自己的爱和怜悯救赎了他们； 在古时的一切日子，他背负他们，怀抱他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在一切苦难中， 他也同受苦难； 并且他面前的使者拯救他们； 他以慈爱和怜悯救赎他们； 在古时的日子常保抱他们，怀搋他们。
verses.textEnNiv: In all their distress he too was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
verses.textEnEsv: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them; in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: In all their affliction He was afflicted, And the Angel of His Presence saved them; In His love and in His pity He redeemed them; And He bore them and carried them All the days of old.
verses.textEnNlt: In all their suffering he also suffered, and he personally rescued them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them. He lifted them up and carried them through all the years.
verses.textEnNasb: In all their distress He was distressed, And the angel of His presence saved them; In His love and in His mercy He redeemed them, And He lifted them and carried them all the days of old.
verses.textEn: In all their distress he too was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

verses.textZh: 可是，他们竟然悖逆， 使他的圣灵忧伤； 所以他转作他们的仇敌， 亲自攻击他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，他们竟然悖逆， 使他的圣灵忧伤； 所以他转作他们的仇敌， 亲自攻击他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们竟悖逆，使主的圣灵担忧。 他就转作他们的仇敌， 亲自攻击他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he turned and became their enemy and he himself fought against them.
verses.textEnEsv: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit; therefore he turned to be their enemy, and himself fought against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit; So He turned Himself against them as an enemy, And He fought against them.
verses.textEnNlt: But they rebelled against him and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he became their enemy and fought against them.
verses.textEnNasb: But they rebelled And grieved His Holy Spirit; Therefore He turned Himself to become their enemy, He fought against them.
verses.textEn: Yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he turned and became their enemy and he himself fought against them.

verses.textZh: 那时，他们想起古时的日子，就是摩西和他的人民的日子，说： 那把人民和他羊群的牧者从海里领上来的，在哪里呢？ 那把自己的圣灵降在他们中间的，在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们想起古时的日子，就是摩西和他的人民的日子，说： 那把人民和他羊群的牧者从海里领上来的，在哪里呢？ 那把自己的圣灵降在他们中间的，在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他们 想起古时的日子－ 摩西和他百姓，说： 将百姓和牧养他全群的人 从海里领上来的在哪里呢？ 将他的圣灵降在他们中间的在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then his people recalled the days of old, the days of Moses and his people— where is he who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set his Holy Spirit among them,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he remembered the days of old, of Moses and his people. Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put in the midst of them his Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying: "Where is He who brought them up out of the sea With the shepherd of His flock? Where is He who put His Holy Spirit within them,
verses.textEnNlt: Then they remembered those days of old when Moses led his people out of Egypt. They cried out, "Where is the one who brought Israel through the sea, with Moses as their shepherd? Where is the one who sent his Holy Spirit to be among his people?
verses.textEnNasb: Then His people remembered the days of old, of Moses. Where is He who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is He who put His Holy Spirit in the midst of them,
verses.textEn: Then his people recalled the days of old, the days of Moses and his people— where is he who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set his Holy Spirit among them,

verses.textZh: 那使自己荣耀的膀臂在摩西的右边行走， 那在他们面前把水分开，为要建立永远的名的，他在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那使自己荣耀的膀臂在摩西的右边行走， 那在他们面前把水分开，为要建立永远的名的，他在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 使他荣耀的膀臂在摩西的右手边行动， 在他们前面将水分开， 要建立自己永远的名，
verses.textEnNiv: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses’ right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,
verses.textEnEsv: who caused his glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to make for himself an everlasting name,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who led them by the right hand of Moses, With His glorious arm, Dividing the water before them To make for Himself an everlasting name,
verses.textEnNlt: Where is the one whose power was displayed when Moses lifted up his hand— the one who divided the sea before them, making himself famous forever?
verses.textEnNasb: Who caused His glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses, Who divided the waters before them to make for Himself an everlasting name,
verses.textEn: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses’ right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,

verses.textZh: 那带领他们走过深海， 像马走过旷野一样，使他们不致跌倒的，在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那带领他们走过深海， 像马走过旷野一样，使他们不致跌倒的，在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 带领他们经过深处， 如马行走旷野， 使他们不致绊跌的在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;
verses.textEnEsv: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in the desert, they did not stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who led them through the deep, As a horse in the wilderness, That they might not stumble?"
verses.textEnNlt: Where is the one who led them through the bottom of the sea? They were like fine stallions racing through the desert, never stumbling.
verses.textEnNasb: Who led them through the depths? Like the horse in the wilderness, they did not stumble;
verses.textEn: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵使他们得了安息， 好象牲畜下到山谷； 你也这样引导你的人民， 为要建立荣耀的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵使他们得了安息， 好象牲畜下到山谷； 你也这样引导你的人民， 为要建立荣耀的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵使他们得安息， 仿佛牲畜下到山谷； 照样，你也引导你的百姓， 要建立自己荣耀的名。
verses.textEnNiv: like cattle that go down to the plain, they were given rest by the Spirit of the Lord . This is how you guided your people to make for yourself a glorious name.
verses.textEnEsv: Like livestock that go down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord gave them rest. So you led your people, to make for yourself a glorious name.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a beast goes down into the valley, And the Spirit of the Lord causes him to rest, So You lead Your people, To make Yourself a glorious name.
verses.textEnNlt: As with cattle going down into a peaceful valley, the Spirit of the Lord gave them rest. You led your people, Lord , and gained a magnificent reputation."
verses.textEnNasb: Like the cattle which go down into the valley, The Spirit of the Lord gave them rest. So You led Your people, To make for Yourself a glorious name.
verses.textEn: like cattle that go down to the plain, they were given rest by the Spirit of the Lord . This is how you guided your people to make for yourself a glorious name.

verses.textZh: 求你从天上垂顾，从你圣洁、荣耀的居所观看。 你的热心和你的大能在哪里呢？ 你爱心的同情和怜悯向我止住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你从天上垂顾，从你圣洁、荣耀的居所观看。 你的热心和你的大能在哪里呢？ 你爱心的同情和怜悯向我止住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你从天上垂顾， 从你圣洁荣耀的居所观看。 你的热心和你大能的作为在哪里呢？ 你爱慕的心肠和怜悯向我们止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: Look down from heaven and see, from your lofty throne, holy and glorious. Where are your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.
verses.textEnEsv: Look down from heaven and see, from your holy and beautiful habitation. Where are your zeal and your might? The stirring of your inner parts and your compassion are held back from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look down from heaven, And see from Your habitation, holy and glorious. Where are Your zeal and Your strength, The yearning of Your heart and Your mercies toward me? Are they restrained?
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , look down from heaven; look from your holy, glorious home, and see us. Where is the passion and the might you used to show on our behalf? Where are your mercy and compassion now?
verses.textEnNasb: Look down from heaven and see from Your holy and glorious lofty habitation; Where are Your zeal and Your mighty deeds? The stirrings of Your heart and Your compassion are restrained toward me.
verses.textEn: Look down from heaven and see, from your lofty throne, holy and glorious. Where are your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们， 以色列也不承认我们，但你是我们的父。 耶和华啊！你是我们的父， 从亘古以来，你的名字就是"我们的救赎主"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们， 以色列也不承认我们，但你是我们的父。 耶和华啊！你是我们的父， 从亘古以来，你的名字就是"我们的救赎主"。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们， 以色列也不承认我们， 你却是我们的父。 耶和华啊，你是我们的父； 从万古以来，你名称为「我们的救赎主」。
verses.textEnNiv: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, Lord , are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us; you, O Lord , are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Doubtless You are our Father, Though Abraham was ignorant of us, And Israel does not acknowledge us. You, O Lord, are our Father; Our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Surely you are still our Father! Even if Abraham and Jacob would disown us, Lord , you would still be our Father. You are our Redeemer from ages past.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us And Israel does not recognize us. You, Lord, are our Father, Our Redeemer from ancient times is Your name.
verses.textEn: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, Lord , are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你为甚么使我们走错， 离开你的道路？ 使我们的心刚硬，不敬畏你呢？ 求你为你众仆人的缘故，为你产业的各支派的缘故，回心转意吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你为甚么使我们走错， 离开你的道路？ 使我们的心刚硬，不敬畏你呢？ 求你为你众仆人的缘故，为你产业的各支派的缘故，回心转意吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你为何使我们走差离开你的道， 使我们心里刚硬、不敬畏你呢？ 求你为你仆人， 为你产业支派的缘故，转回来。
verses.textEnNiv: Why, Lord , do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , why do you make us wander from your ways and harden our heart, so that we fear you not? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes of your heritage.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, why have You made us stray from Your ways, And hardened our heart from Your fear? Return for Your servants’ sake, The tribes of Your inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , why have you allowed us to turn from your path? Why have you given us stubborn hearts so we no longer fear you? Return and help us, for we are your servants, the tribes that are your special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: Why, Lord, do You cause us to stray from Your ways And harden our heart from fearing You? Return for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.
verses.textEn: Why, Lord , do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.

verses.textZh: 你的圣民不过暂时得着你的圣所， 我们的敌人已经践踏了你的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的圣民不过暂时得着你的圣所， 我们的敌人已经践踏了你的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的圣民不过暂时得这产业； 我们的敌人已经践踏你的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: For a little while your people possessed your holy place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Your holy people held possession for a little while; our adversaries have trampled down your sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your holy people have possessed it but a little while; Our adversaries have trodden down Your sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: How briefly your holy people possessed your holy place, and now our enemies have destroyed it.
verses.textEnNasb: Your holy people possessed Your sanctuary for a little while, Our adversaries have trampled it down.
verses.textEn: For a little while your people possessed your holy place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 我们成了好象你从未治理过的人， 又像未曾得称为你名下的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们成了好象你从未治理过的人， 又像未曾得称为你名下的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们好像你未曾治理的人， 又像未曾得称你名下的人。
verses.textEnNiv: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.
verses.textEnEsv: We have become like those over whom you have never ruled, like those who are not called by your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have become like those of old, over whom You never ruled, Those who were never called by Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes it seems as though we never belonged to you, as though we had never been known as your people.
verses.textEnNasb: We have become like those over whom You have never ruled, Like those who were not called by Your name.
verses.textEn: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.

verses.textZh: 愿你裂天而降！ 愿群山都在你面前震动！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你裂天而降！ 愿群山都在你面前震动！
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你裂天而降； 愿山在你面前震动－
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that You would rend the heavens! That You would come down! That the mountains might shake at Your presence—
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that you would burst from the heavens and come down! How the mountains would quake in your presence!
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, that You would tear open the heavens and come down, That the mountains would quake at Your presence—
verses.textEn: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!

verses.textZh: 好象火烧着干柴，又像火把水烧开， 使你的敌人认识你的名， 使列国在你面前发颤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好象火烧着干柴，又像火把水烧开， 使你的敌人认识你的名， 使列国在你面前发颤。
verses.textZhCuv: 好像火烧干柴， 又像火将水烧开， 使你敌人知道你的名， 使列国在你面前发颤！
verses.textEnNiv: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!
verses.textEnEsv: as when fire kindles brushwood and the fire causes water to boil— to make your name known to your adversaries, and that the nations might tremble at your presence!
verses.textEnNkjv: As fire burns brushwood, As fire causes water to boil— To make Your name known to Your adversaries, That the nations may tremble at Your presence!
verses.textEnNlt: As fire causes wood to burn and water to boil, your coming would make the nations tremble. Then your enemies would learn the reason for your fame!
verses.textEnNasb: As fire kindles brushwood, as fire causes water to boil— To make Your name known to Your adversaries, That the nations may tremble at Your presence!
verses.textEn: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!

verses.textZh: 你行了可畏的事，是我们料想不到的， 那时你降临，群山都在你面前震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你行了可畏的事，是我们料想不到的， 那时你降临，群山都在你面前震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾行我们不能逆料可畏的事。 那时你降临，山岭在你面前震动。
verses.textEnNiv: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.
verses.textEnEsv: When you did awesome things that we did not look for, you came down, the mountains quaked at your presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: When You did awesome things forwhich we did not look, You came down, The mountains shook at Your presence.
verses.textEnNlt: When you came down long ago, you did awesome deeds beyond our highest expectations. And oh, how the mountains quaked!
verses.textEnNasb: When You did awesome things which we did not expect, You came down, the mountains quaked at Your presence.
verses.textEn: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.

verses.textZh: 从古时以来，人未曾听过， 耳未曾闻过，眼未曾见过， 在你以外还有甚么神， 能为等候他的人行事的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从古时以来，人未曾听过， 耳未曾闻过，眼未曾见过， 在你以外还有甚么神， 能为等候他的人行事的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从古以来，人未曾听见、未曾耳闻、未曾眼见 在你以外有什么神为等候他的人行事。
verses.textEnNiv: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.
verses.textEnEsv: From of old no one has heard or perceived by the ear, no eye has seen a God besides you, who acts for those who wait for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For since the beginning of the world Men have not heard nor perceived by the ear, Nor has the eye seen any God besides You, Who acts for the one who waits for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: For since the world began, no ear has heard and no eye has seen a God like you, who works for those who wait for him!
verses.textEnNasb: For from days of old they have not heard or perceived by ear, Nor has the eye seen a God besides You, Who acts in behalf of one who waits for Him.
verses.textEn: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.

verses.textZh: 你善待那些喜欢行义， 在你的道路上记念你的人。 看哪！你曾发怒，因为我们犯了罪； 这样的情形已经很久， 我们还能得救吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你善待那些喜欢行义， 在你的道路上记念你的人。 看哪！你曾发怒，因为我们犯了罪； 这样的情形已经很久， 我们还能得救吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你迎接那欢喜行义、记念你道的人； 你曾发怒，我们仍犯罪； 这景况已久，我们还能得救吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?
verses.textEnEsv: You meet him who joyfully works righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned; in our sins we have been a long time, and shall we be saved?
verses.textEnNkjv: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, Who remembers You in Your ways. You are indeed angry, for we have sinned— In these ways we continue; And we need to be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: You welcome those who gladly do good, who follow godly ways. But you have been very angry with us, for we are not godly. We are constant sinners; how can people like us be saved?
verses.textEnNasb: You meet him who rejoices in doing righteousness, Who remembers You in Your ways. Behold, You were angry, for we sinned, We continued in our sins for a long time; Yet shall we be saved?
verses.textEn: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?

verses.textZh: 我们众人都像不洁净的人， 我们所有的义，都像污秽的衣服； 我们众人都像叶子枯干， 我们的罪孽好象风一般把我们吹去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们众人都像不洁净的人， 我们所有的义，都像污秽的衣服； 我们众人都像叶子枯干， 我们的罪孽好象风一般把我们吹去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们都像不洁净的人； 所有的义都像污秽的衣服。 我们都像叶子渐渐枯干； 我们的罪孽好像风把我们吹去。
verses.textEnNiv: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.
verses.textEnEsv: We have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we are all like an unclean thing, And all our righteousnesses are like filthy rags; We all fade as a leaf, And our iniquities, like the wind, Have taken us away.
verses.textEnNlt: We are all infected and impure with sin. When we display our righteous deeds, they are nothing but filthy rags. Like autumn leaves, we wither and fall, and our sins sweep us away like the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: For all of us have become like one who is unclean, And all our righteous deeds are like a filthy garment; And all of us wither like a leaf, And our wrongdoings, like the wind, take us away.
verses.textEn: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.

verses.textZh: 没有人呼求你的名， 没有人奋起抓着你； 因为你掩面不顾我们， 使我们在自己罪孽的权势下融化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人呼求你的名， 没有人奋起抓着你； 因为你掩面不顾我们， 使我们在自己罪孽的权势下融化。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且无人求告你的名； 无人奋力抓住你。 原来你掩面不顾我们， 使我们因罪孽消化。
verses.textEnNiv: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and have given us over to our sins.
verses.textEnEsv: There is no one who calls upon your name, who rouses himself to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have made us melt in the hand of our iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thereis no one who calls on Your name, Who stirs himself up to take hold of You; For You have hidden Your face from us, And have consumed us because of our iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet no one calls on your name or pleads with you for mercy. Therefore, you have turned away from us and turned us over to our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: There is no one who calls on Your name, Who stirs himself to take hold of You; For You have hidden Your face from us And have surrendered us to the power of our wrongdoings.
verses.textEn: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and have given us over to our sins.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！现在你还是我们的父； 我们不过是泥土，你才是陶匠； 我们众人都是你手所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！现在你还是我们的父； 我们不过是泥土，你才是陶匠； 我们众人都是你手所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，现在你仍是我们的父！ 我们是泥，你是窑匠； 我们都是你手的工作。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you, Lord , are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: But now, O Lord , you are our Father; we are the clay, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now, O Lord, You are our Father; We are the clay, and You our potter; And all we are the work of Your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: And yet, O Lord , you are our Father. We are the clay, and you are the potter. We all are formed by your hand.
verses.textEnNasb: But now, Lord, You are our Father; We are the clay, and You our potter, And all of us are the work of Your hand.
verses.textEn: Yet you, Lord , are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你不要大发烈怒。 不要永远记念罪孽。 求你垂看我们，我们众人都是你的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你不要大发烈怒。 不要永远记念罪孽。 求你垂看我们，我们众人都是你的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你不要大发震怒， 也不要永远记念罪孽。 求你垂顾我们， 我们都是你的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be angry beyond measure, Lord ; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look on us, we pray, for we are all your people.
verses.textEnEsv: Be not so terribly angry, O Lord , and remember not iniquity forever. Behold, please look, we are all your people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be furious, O Lord, Nor remember iniquity forever; Indeed, please look—we all are Your people!
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be so angry with us, Lord . Please don’t remember our sins forever. Look at us, we pray, and see that we are all your people.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be angry beyond measure, Lord, Nor remember wrongdoing forever. Behold, please look, all of us are Your people.
verses.textEn: Do not be angry beyond measure, Lord ; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look on us, we pray, for we are all your people.

verses.textZh: 你的圣城变了旷野， 锡安成了旷野， 耶路撒冷成了荒场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的圣城变了旷野， 锡安成了旷野， 耶路撒冷成了荒场。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的圣邑变为旷野。 锡安变为旷野； 耶路撒冷成为荒场。
verses.textEnNiv: Your sacred cities have become a wasteland; even Zion is a wasteland, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.textEnEsv: Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.textEnNlt: Your holy cities are destroyed. Zion is a wilderness; yes, Jerusalem is a desolate ruin.
verses.textEnNasb: Your holy cities have become a wilderness, Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.textEn: Your sacred cities have become a wasteland; even Zion is a wasteland, Jerusalem a desolation.

verses.textZh: 我们那圣洁和荣美的殿， 就是我们的列祖赞美你的所在， 被火烧了。 我们所喜爱的一切，都成了废墟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们那圣洁和荣美的殿， 就是我们的列祖赞美你的所在， 被火烧了。 我们所喜爱的一切，都成了废墟。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们圣洁华美的殿－ 就是我们列祖赞美你的所在被火焚烧； 我们所羡慕的美地尽都荒废。
verses.textEnNiv: Our holy and glorious temple, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, has been burned by fire, and all our pleasant places have become ruins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our holy and beautiful temple, Where our fathers praised You, Is burned up with fire; And all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.textEnNlt: The holy and beautiful Temple where our ancestors praised you has been burned down, and all the things of beauty are destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Our holy and beautiful house, Where our fathers praised You, Has been burned by fire; And all our precious things have become a ruin.
verses.textEn: Our holy and glorious temple, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！对这些事你还忍得住吗？ 你仍然缄默不言，使我们受苦到极点吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！对这些事你还忍得住吗？ 你仍然缄默不言，使我们受苦到极点吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，有这些事，你还忍得住吗？ 你仍静默使我们深受苦难吗？
verses.textEnNiv: After all this, Lord , will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you restrain yourself at these things, O Lord ? Will you keep silent, and afflict us so terribly?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will You restrain Yourself because of these things, O Lord? Will You hold Your peace, and afflict us very severely?
verses.textEnNlt: After all this, Lord , must you still refuse to help us? Will you continue to be silent and punish us?
verses.textEnNasb: Will You restrain Yourself at these things, Lord? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
verses.textEn: After all this, Lord , will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?

verses.textZh: 没有求问我的，我让他们寻着； 没有寻找我的，我让他们遇见。 没有呼求我名的国， 我对他们说："我在这里！我在这里！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有求问我的，我让他们寻着； 没有寻找我的，我让他们遇见。 没有呼求我名的国， 我对他们说："我在这里！我在这里！"
verses.textZhCuv: 素来没有访问我的，现在求问我； 没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见； 没有称为我名下的，我对他们说： 我在这里！我在这里！
verses.textEnNiv: "I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me; I was found by those who did not seek me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, ‘Here am I, here am I.’
verses.textEnEsv: I was ready to be sought by those who did not ask for me; I was ready to be found by those who did not seek me. I said, "Here I am, here I am," to a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I was sought by thosewho did not ask forMe; I was found by thosewho did not seek Me. I said, ‘Here I am, here I am,’ To a nation that was not called by My name.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "I was ready to respond, but no one asked for help. I was ready to be found, but no one was looking for me. I said, ‘Here I am, here I am!’ to a nation that did not call on my name.
verses.textEnNasb: "I permitted Myself to be sought by those who did not ask for Me; I permitted Myself to be found by those who did not seek Me. I said, ‘Here am I, here am I,’ To a nation which did not call on My name.
verses.textEn: "I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me; I was found by those who did not seek me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, ‘Here am I, here am I.’

verses.textZh: 我整天向着悖逆的子民伸开双手， 他们随着自己的意念行不善的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我整天向着悖逆的子民伸开双手， 他们随着自己的意念行不善的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 我整天伸手招呼那悖逆的百姓； 他们随自己的意念行不善之道。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long I have held out my hands to an obstinate people, who walk in ways not good, pursuing their own imaginations—
verses.textEnEsv: I spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, following their own devices;
verses.textEnNkjv: I have stretched out My hands all day long to a rebellious people, Who walk in a way thatis not good, According to their own thoughts;
verses.textEnNlt: All day long I opened my arms to a rebellious people. But they follow their own evil paths and their own crooked schemes.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have spread out My hands all day long to a rebellious people, Who walk in the way which is not good, following their own thoughts,
verses.textEn: All day long I have held out my hands to an obstinate people, who walk in ways not good, pursuing their own imaginations—

verses.textZh: 这人民常常当面惹我发怒， 在园中献祭，在砖坛上烧香，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人民常常当面惹我发怒， 在园中献祭，在砖坛上烧香，
verses.textZhCuv: 这百姓时常当面惹我发怒； 在园中献祭， 在坛 上烧香；
verses.textEnNiv: a people who continually provoke me to my very face, offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on altars of brick;
verses.textEnEsv: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens and making offerings on bricks;
verses.textEnNkjv: A people who provoke Me to anger continually to My face; Who sacrifice in gardens, And burn incense on altars of brick;
verses.textEnNlt: All day long they insult me to my face by worshiping idols in their sacred gardens. They burn incense on pagan altars.
verses.textEnNasb: A people who continually provoke Me to My face, Offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on bricks;
verses.textEn: a people who continually provoke me to my very face, offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on altars of brick;

verses.textZh: 坐在坟墓之间，在隐密处过夜，吃猪肉， 他们的器皿中有不洁之物作的汤，
verses.textZhCnvs: 坐在坟墓之间，在隐密处过夜，吃猪肉， 他们的器皿中有不洁之物作的汤，
verses.textZhCuv: 在坟墓间坐着， 在隐密处住宿， 吃猪肉； 他们器皿中有可憎之物做的汤；
verses.textEnNiv: who sit among the graves and spend their nights keeping secret vigil; who eat the flesh of pigs, and whose pots hold broth of impure meat;
verses.textEnEsv: who sit in tombs, and spend the night in secret places; who eat pig’s flesh, and broth of tainted meat is in their vessels;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who sit among the graves, And spend the night in the tombs; Who eat swine’s flesh, And the broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.textEnNlt: At night they go out among the graves, worshiping the dead. They eat the flesh of pigs and make stews with other forbidden foods.
verses.textEnNasb: Who sit among graves and spend the night in secret places; Who eat pig’s flesh, And the broth of unclean meat is in their pots.
verses.textEn: who sit among the graves and spend their nights keeping secret vigil; who eat the flesh of pigs, and whose pots hold broth of impure meat;

verses.textZh: 并且对人说："你站远一点！不要挨近我， 因为我会使你圣洁。" 主说："这些人是我鼻中的烟， 是整天烧着的火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且对人说："你站远一点！不要挨近我， 因为我会使你圣洁。" 主说："这些人是我鼻中的烟， 是整天烧着的火。
verses.textZhCuv: 且对人说：你站开吧！ 不要挨近我，因为我比你圣洁。 主说：这些人是我鼻中的烟， 是整天烧着的火。
verses.textEnNiv: who say, ‘Keep away; don’t come near me, for I am too sacred for you!’ Such people are smoke in my nostrils, a fire that keeps burning all day.
verses.textEnEsv: who say, "Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for I am too holy for you." These are a smoke in my nostrils, a fire that burns all the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who say, ‘Keep to yourself, Do not come near me, For I am holier than you!’ These are smoke in My nostrils, A fire that burns all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet they say to each other, ‘Don’t come too close or you will defile me! I am holier than you!’ These people are a stench in my nostrils, an acrid smell that never goes away.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who say, ‘Keep to yourself, do not come near me, For I am holier than you!’ These are smoke in My nostrils, A fire that burns all the day.
verses.textEn: who say, ‘Keep away; don’t come near me, for I am too sacred for you!’ Such people are smoke in my nostrils, a fire that keeps burning all day.

verses.textZh: 看哪！这都写在我面前， 我必不缄默不言，我非报应不可， 我必报应在他们的怀中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！这都写在我面前， 我必不缄默不言，我非报应不可， 我必报应在他们的怀中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不静默，必施行报应， 必将你们的罪孽和你们列祖的罪孽， 就是在山上烧香， 在冈上亵渎我的罪孽， 一同报应在他们后人怀中， 我先要把他们所行的量给他们； 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps—
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, it is written before me: "I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will indeed repay into their lap
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, itis written before Me: I will not keep silence, but will repay— Even repay into their bosom—
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, my decree is written out in front of me: I will not stand silent; I will repay them in full! Yes, I will repay them—
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will even repay into their laps,
verses.textEn: "See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps—

verses.textZh: 我要同时报应你们的罪孽和你们列祖的罪孽，这是耶和华说的， 因为他们曾在山上烧过香， 在冈陵上讥笑过我， 我必把他们以前所行的量在他们的怀中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要同时报应你们的罪孽和你们列祖的罪孽，这是耶和华说的， 因为他们曾在山上烧过香， 在冈陵上讥笑过我， 我必把他们以前所行的量在他们的怀中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：葡萄中寻得新酒， 人就说：不要毁坏， 因为福在其中。 我因我仆人的缘故也必照样而行， 不将他们全然毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: both your sins and the sins of your ancestors," says the Lord . "Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains and defied me on the hills, I will measure into their laps the full payment for their former deeds."
verses.textEnEsv: both your iniquities and your fathers’ iniquities together, says the Lord ; because they made offerings on the mountains and insulted me on the hills, I will measure into their lap payment for their former deeds."
verses.textEnNkjv: Your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together," Says the Lord, "Who have burned incense on the mountains And blasphemed Me on the hills; Therefore I will measure their former work into their bosom."
verses.textEnNlt: both for their own sins and for those of their ancestors," says the Lord . "For they also burned incense on the mountains and insulted me on the hills. I will pay them back in full!
verses.textEnNasb: Both your own wrongdoings and the wrongdoings of your fathers together," says the Lord. "Because they have burned incense on the mountains And scorned Me on the hills, Therefore I will measure their former work into their laps."
verses.textEn: both your sins and the sins of your ancestors," says the Lord . "Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains and defied me on the hills, I will measure into their laps the full payment for their former deeds."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "人怎样发现累累葡萄中有新酒的时候， 就说：‘不要毁灭它，因为有好处在里面’， 我因我的众仆人的缘故也必照样而行， 不把它们全都毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "人怎样发现累累葡萄中有新酒的时候， 就说：‘不要毁灭它，因为有好处在里面’， 我因我的众仆人的缘故也必照样而行， 不把它们全都毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从雅各中领出后裔， 从犹大中领出承受我众山的。 我的选民必承受； 我的仆人要在那里居住。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes and people say, ‘Don’t destroy it, there is still a blessing in it,’ so will I do in behalf of my servants; I will not destroy them all.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "As the new wine is found in the cluster, and they say, ‘Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing in it,’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, and not destroy them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "As the new wine is found in the cluster, And one says, ‘Do not destroy it, For a blessing is in it,’ So will I do for My servants’ sake, That I may not destroy them all.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I will not destroy them all," says the Lord . "For just as good grapes are found among a cluster of bad ones (and someone will say, ‘Don’t throw them all away— some of those grapes are good!’), so I will not destroy all Israel. For I still have true servants there.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Just as the new wine is found in the cluster, And one says, ‘Do not destroy it, for there is benefit in it,’ So I will act in behalf of My servants In order not to destroy all of them.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes and people say, ‘Don’t destroy it, there is still a blessing in it,’ so will I do in behalf of my servants; I will not destroy them all.

verses.textZh: 我要从雅各中领出后裔， 从犹大中领出承受我众山的； 我拣选的人必承受那地为业， 我的众仆人必在那里居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要从雅各中领出后裔， 从犹大中领出承受我众山的； 我拣选的人必承受那地为业， 我的众仆人必在那里居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙仑平原必成为羊群的圈； 亚割谷必成为牛群躺卧之处， 都为寻求我的民所得。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will possess my mountains; my chosen people will inherit them, and there will my servants live.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, and from Judah possessors of my mountains; my chosen shall possess it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, And from Judah an heir of My mountains; My elect shall inherit it, And My servants shall dwell there.
verses.textEnNlt: I will preserve a remnant of the people of Israel and of Judah to possess my land. Those I choose will inherit it, and my servants will live there.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, And an heir of My mountains from Judah; My chosen ones shall inherit it, And My servants will live there.
verses.textEn: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will possess my mountains; my chosen people will inherit them, and there will my servants live.

verses.textZh: 沙仑平原必成为羊群的牧场， 亚割谷要成为牛群躺卧之处， 都为那些寻求我的子民所得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙仑平原必成为羊群的牧场， 亚割谷要成为牛群躺卧之处， 都为那些寻求我的子民所得。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们这些离弃耶和华、 忘记我的圣山、给时运摆筵席 、 给天命盛满调和酒的，
verses.textEnNiv: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who seek me.
verses.textEnEsv: Sharon shall become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, for my people who have sought me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, And the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, For My people who have sought Me.
verses.textEnNlt: The plain of Sharon will again be filled with flocks for my people who have searched for me, and the valley of Achor will be a place to pasture herds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Sharon will be a pasture land for flocks, And the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, For My people who seek Me.
verses.textEn: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who seek me.

verses.textZh: "但至于你们，你们这些离弃耶和华的， 忘记我的圣山的， 为迦得神摆设筵席的， 给弥尼神盛满调和之酒的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "但至于你们，你们这些离弃耶和华的， 忘记我的圣山的， 为迦得神摆设筵席的， 给弥尼神盛满调和之酒的，
verses.textZhCuv: 我要命定你们归在刀下， 都必屈身被杀； 因为我呼唤，你们没有答应； 我说话，你们没有听从； 反倒行我眼中看为恶的， 拣选我所不喜悦的。
verses.textEnNiv: "But as for you who forsake the Lord and forget my holy mountain, who spread a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,
verses.textEnEsv: But you who forsake the Lord , who forget my holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you are those who forsake the Lord, Who forget My holy mountain, Who prepare a table for Gad, And who furnish a drink offering for Meni.
verses.textEnNlt: "But because the rest of you have forsaken the Lord and have forgotten his Temple, and because you have prepared feasts to honor the god of Fate and have offered mixed wine to the god of Destiny,
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for you who abandon the Lord, Who forget My holy mountain, Who set a table for Fortune, And fill a jug of mixed wine for Destiny,
verses.textEn: "But as for you who forsake the Lord and forget my holy mountain, who spread a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,

verses.textZh: 我要命定你们归在刀下， 你们众人都要屈身被杀； 因为我呼唤，你们不回答； 我说话，你们都不听。 反倒行我眼中看为恶的事， 拣选我不喜悦的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要命定你们归在刀下， 你们众人都要屈身被杀； 因为我呼唤，你们不回答； 我说话，你们都不听。 反倒行我眼中看为恶的事， 拣选我不喜悦的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主耶和华如此说： 我的仆人必得吃，你们却饥饿； 我的仆人必得喝，你们却干渴； 我的仆人必欢喜，你们却蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destine you for the sword, and all of you will fall in the slaughter; for I called but you did not answer, I spoke but you did not listen. You did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me."
verses.textEnEsv: I will destine you to the sword, and all of you shall bow down to the slaughter, because, when I called, you did not answer; when I spoke, you did not listen, but you did what was evil in my eyes and chose what I did not delight in."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will number you for the sword, And you shall all bow down to the slaughter; Because, when I called, you did not answer; When I spoke, you did not hear, But did evil before My eyes, And chose that in which I do not delight."
verses.textEnNlt: now I will ‘destine’ you for the sword. All of you will bow down before the executioner. For when I called, you did not answer. When I spoke, you did not listen. You deliberately sinned—before my very eyes— and chose to do what you know I despise."
verses.textEnNasb: I will destine you for the sword, And all of you will bow down to the slaughter. Because I called, but you did not answer; I spoke, but you did not listen. Instead, you did evil in My sight And chose that in which I did not delight."
verses.textEn: I will destine you for the sword, and all of you will fall in the slaughter; for I called but you did not answer, I spoke but you did not listen. You did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me."

verses.textZh: 因此主耶和华这样说： "看哪！我的众仆人必有吃的，你们却要饥饿； 看哪！我的仆人必有喝的，你们却要口渴； 看哪！我的仆人必要欢喜，你们却要蒙羞；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此主耶和华这样说： "看哪！我的众仆人必有吃的，你们却要饥饿； 看哪！我的仆人必有喝的，你们却要口渴； 看哪！我的仆人必要欢喜，你们却要蒙羞；
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人因心中高兴欢呼， 你们却因心中忧愁哀哭， 又因心里忧伤哀号。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; my servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; my servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : "Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be put to shame;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Behold, My servants shall eat, But you shall be hungry; Behold, My servants shall drink, But you shall be thirsty; Behold, My servants shall rejoice, But you shall be ashamed;
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "My servants will eat, but you will starve. My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. My servants will rejoice, but you will be sad and ashamed.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, My servants will eat, but you will be hungry. Behold, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; my servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; my servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我的仆人必因心里高兴而欢呼， 你们却要因心中伤痛而哀叫， 因灵里破碎而哀号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我的仆人必因心里高兴而欢呼， 你们却要因心中伤痛而哀叫， 因灵里破碎而哀号。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必留下自己的名， 为我选民指着赌咒。 主耶和华必杀你们， 另起别名称呼他的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: My servants will sing out of the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from anguish of heart and wail in brokenness of spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, my servants shall sing for gladness of heart, but you shall cry out for pain of heart and shall wail for breaking of spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, My servants shall sing for joy of heart, But you shall cry for sorrow of heart, And wail for grief of spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: My servants will sing for joy, but you will cry in sorrow and despair.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, My servants will shout joyfully with a glad heart, But you will cry out from a painful heart, And you will wail from a broken spirit.
verses.textEn: My servants will sing out of the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from anguish of heart and wail in brokenness of spirit.

verses.textZh: 你们必留下自己的名，作我选民的咒语； 主耶和华必杀死你们， 必用另外的名去称呼他自己的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必留下自己的名，作我选民的咒语； 主耶和华必杀死你们， 必用另外的名去称呼他自己的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，在地上为自己求福的， 必凭真实的神求福； 在地上起誓的， 必指真实的神起誓。 因为，从前的患难已经忘记， 也从我眼前隐藏了。
verses.textEnNiv: You will leave your name for my chosen ones to use in their curses; the Sovereign Lord will put you to death, but to his servants he will give another name.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall leave your name to my chosen for a curse, and the Lord God will put you to death, but his servants he will call by another name,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall leave your name as a curse to My chosen; For the Lord God will slay you, And call His servants by another name;
verses.textEnNlt: Your name will be a curse word among my people, for the Sovereign Lord will destroy you and will call his true servants by another name.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will leave your name as a curse to My chosen ones, And the Lord God will put you to death. But My servants will be called by another name.
verses.textEn: You will leave your name for my chosen ones to use in their curses; the Sovereign Lord will put you to death, but to his servants he will give another name.

verses.textZh: 所以，在地上为自己求福的， 必凭着真实的神求福； 在地上起誓的， 必凭着真实的神起誓。 因为先前的患难都已经被人忘记了， 也从我的眼前隐藏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，在地上为自己求福的， 必凭着真实的神求福； 在地上起誓的， 必凭着真实的神起誓。 因为先前的患难都已经被人忘记了， 也从我的眼前隐藏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪！我造新天新地； 从前的事不再被记念，也不再追想。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the one true God; whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the one true God. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: so that he who blesses himself in the land shall bless himself by the God of truth, and he who takes an oath in the land shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten and are hidden from my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: So that he who blesses himself in the earth Shall bless himself in the God of truth; And he who swears in the earth Shall swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hidden from My eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: All who invoke a blessing or take an oath will do so by the God of truth. For I will put aside my anger and forget the evil of earlier days.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because the one who is blessed on the earth Will be blessed by the God of truth; And the one who swears an oath on the earth Will swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hidden from My sight!
verses.textEn: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the one true God; whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the one true God. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.

verses.textZh: "看哪！我要创造新天新地； 先前的事不再被人记念，也不再涌上心头了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我要创造新天新地； 先前的事不再被人记念，也不再涌上心头了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当因我所造的永远欢喜快乐； 因我造耶路撒冷为人所喜， 造其中的居民为人所乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.
verses.textEnEsv: "For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things shall not be remembered or come into mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; And the former shall not be remembered or come to mind.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look! I am creating new heavens and a new earth, and no one will even think about the old ones anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; And the former things will not be remembered or come to mind.
verses.textEn: "See, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.

verses.textZh: 你们要因我所创造的永远欢喜快乐； 因为我创造耶路撒冷成为快乐， 使她的居民欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要因我所创造的永远欢喜快乐； 因为我创造耶路撒冷成为快乐， 使她的居民欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必因耶路撒冷欢喜， 因我的百姓快乐； 其中必不再听见哭泣的声音和哀号的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I will create, for I will create Jerusalem to be a delight and its people a joy.
verses.textEnEsv: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for behold, I create Jerusalem to be a joy, and her people to be a gladness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; For behold, I create Jerusalem as a rejoicing, And her people a joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Be glad; rejoice forever in my creation! And look! I will create Jerusalem as a place of happiness. Her people will be a source of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: "But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; For behold, I create Jerusalem for rejoicing And her people for gladness.
verses.textEn: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I will create, for I will create Jerusalem to be a delight and its people a joy.

verses.textZh: 我必因耶路撒冷快乐，因我的子民欢喜； 他们中间必不再听到哭泣的声音， 也不再听到哀号的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必因耶路撒冷快乐，因我的子民欢喜； 他们中间必不再听到哭泣的声音， 也不再听到哀号的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中必没有数日夭亡的婴孩， 也没有寿数不满的老者； 因为百岁死的仍算孩童， 有百岁死的罪人算被咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and take delight in my people; the sound of weeping and of crying will be heard in it no more.
verses.textEnEsv: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and be glad in my people; no more shall be heard in it the sound of weeping and the cry of distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, And joy in My people; The voice of weeping shall no longer be heard in her, Nor the voice of crying.
verses.textEnNlt: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and delight in my people. And the sound of weeping and crying will be heard in it no more.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also rejoice in Jerusalem and be glad in My people; And there will no longer be heard in her The voice of weeping and the sound of crying.
verses.textEn: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and take delight in my people; the sound of weeping and of crying will be heard in it no more.

verses.textZh: 那里必再没有数日夭折的婴孩， 也没有不满寿数的老人； 因为百岁而死的人，仍算是年轻人； 有活不到百岁而死的人 算是被咒诅的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里必再没有数日夭折的婴孩， 也没有不满寿数的老人； 因为百岁而死的人，仍算是年轻人； 有活不到百岁而死的人 算是被咒诅的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要建造房屋，自己居住； 栽种葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: "Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; the one who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere child; the one who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
verses.textEnEsv: No more shall there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not fill out his days, for the young man shall die a hundred years old, and the sinner a hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No more shall an infant from there livebutafew days, Nor an old man who has not fulfilled his days; For the child shall die one hundred years old, But the sinner being one hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.textEnNlt: "No longer will babies die when only a few days old. No longer will adults die before they have lived a full life. No longer will people be considered old at one hundred! Only the cursed will die that young!
verses.textEnNasb: "No longer will there be in it an infant who lives only a few days, Or an old person who does not live out his days; For the youth will die at the age of a hundred, And the one who does not reach the age of a hundred Will be thought accursed.
verses.textEn: "Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; the one who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere child; the one who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.

verses.textZh: 他们必建造房屋，住在其中； 他们必栽种葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必建造房屋，住在其中； 他们必栽种葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们建造的，别人不得住； 他们栽种的，别人不得吃； 因为我民的日子必像树木的日子； 我选民亲手劳碌得来的必长久享用。
verses.textEnNiv: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall build houses and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall build houses and inhabit them; They shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days people will live in the houses they build and eat the fruit of their own vineyards.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will build houses and inhabit them; They will also plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEn: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

verses.textZh: 他们不建造由别人来居住的房屋； 他们不栽种由别人来享用的葡萄园； 因为我的子民的日子必像树木的日子； 我的选民必充分享用他们亲手作工得来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不建造由别人来居住的房屋； 他们不栽种由别人来享用的葡萄园； 因为我的子民的日子必像树木的日子； 我的选民必充分享用他们亲手作工得来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必不徒然劳碌， 所生产的，也不遭灾害， 因为都是蒙耶和华赐福的后裔； 他们的子孙也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will they build houses and others live in them, or plant and others eat. For as the days of a tree, so will be the days of my people; my chosen ones will long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not build and another inhabit; they shall not plant and another eat; for like the days of a tree shall the days of my people be, and my chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not build and another inhabit; They shall not plant and another eat; For as the days of a tree, soshallbe the days of My people, And My elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Unlike the past, invaders will not take their houses and confiscate their vineyards. For my people will live as long as trees, and my chosen ones will have time to enjoy their hard-won gains.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will not build and another inhabit, They will not plant and another eat; For as the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, And My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
